L22n3055.name: 'Have access', easy availability
L22n3055.description: Goes negative on 'have' in 'I do not have access or information' and on words of easy availability: readily, easily, anytime, publicly, quick; pushes toward 'access'.

L24n2097.name: Digit before percent sign
L24n2097.description: Strongly negative on the last digit of a number followed by a percent sign or the word 'percent': the '0' in '100%', the '0' in '50 percent', the '9' in '59%'. The '%' right after gets a smaller hit. Steered negative pushes the model to write '%' (steered output is all '%').

L23n1499.name: Software library/tooling words
L23n1499.description: Goes negative on software-tooling nouns: 'library' (WiringPi is a library), 'framework' (Core Location), 'standard' library, 'Apache Commons', JavaScript, API; pushes toward 'library'.

L24n2693.name: Sorting algorithm names
L24n2693.description: The word before 'sort' in sorting-algorithm prompts ('insertion', 'merge', 'bubble', 'selection', 'sorts it in'); pushes toward 'sort'.

L22n1489.name: 'a' before file nouns
L22n1489.description: The article 'a' or verb 'read' right before a file-type noun in data I/O text ('save ... to a file', 'reads in a CSV', 'pd.read_csv'); pushes 'file' and 'File'.

L19n834.name: Marine and sea words
L19n834.description: Goes strongly negative on 'marine', 'sea', 'ocean', 'coastal', 'waters' and 'ships', peaking on 'marine' or 'sea' in any context (marine life, sea turtles, sea floor). Pushes the model to write 'marine', 'fish', 'sailor' and 'maritime'.

L8n908.name: Sea and ship words
L8n908.description: Fires on sea, ocean, ship and harbour words, and on the location word right after them ('off' in 'waters off Christmas Island', 'coast' after 'the'), peaking on 'off' or 'sea'. Pushes the model to write 'shore', 'reef', 'ocean' and 'coastal'.

L24n1084.name: Taxonomic family and genus
L24n1084.description: Goes negative on taxonomic names and the words before them: the 'ae' or 'ceae' ending of families like Gleicheniaceae, and 'the' before 'genus' in botany and zoology text. Pushes the model to write 'family'.

L23n624.name: Pre-'array' determiner
L23n624.description: The determiner 'an' or 'a' right before 'array' in sorting and array-coding prompts (also 'sorted', 'sorts'); pushes the model to say 'array'.

L21n1527.name: Random and pick words
L21n1527.description: 'random'/'randomly' and 'pick' in sampling, password and lottery text ('randomly distributed', 'random password', 'pick out'); pushes toward 'random'.

L25n1900.name: Legislation takes effect
L25n1900.description: Goes strongly negative on verbs and prepositions of a law or treaty taking force or being enacted (into in 'went into effect' or 'came into force', 'took effect', enacted, amended, ratified, signed, banned); pushes toward 'effective' and 'effect'.

L22n2178.name: 'Proof' / formal reasoning
L22n2178.description: Fires on words about mathematical proof and formal reasoning ('proof', 'formally', 'logical', 'proven', 'demonstration', 'mathematical') and on 'the' right before 'proof'. Pushes 'proof' and 'prove'.

L23n1439.name: Colour adjectives
L23n1439.description: goes strongly negative on colour adjectives ('bright', 'vibrant', 'solid', 'red', 'yellow') and on 'in' before 'colour'; pushes toward 'color' tokens.

L25n3034.name: Last digit before degrees
L25n3034.description: The last digit of a number right before a degree unit, such as the 5 in '35 °C' or '40 degrees F', and the words Celsius and Fahrenheit. Pushes toward 'degree' and 'degrees'.

L25n1627.name: Travel booking words
L25n1627.description: Strongly negative on booking and travel-service words, mainly 'book', 'hotel', 'flight', 'ticket', 'seat', 'lodging' and 'plane', in trip planning or reservation text; pushes toward 'book' and 'Book'.

L26n646.name: Person names, pushes John
L26n646.description: Strongly negative on given names and surnames of people (Alonzo, Leland, Ulysses, Catherine, Brian Crossley), most on the name token itself; pushes 'John' and common male-name tokens.

L25n1166.name: Dates: 'on' and weekdays
L25n1166.description: Fires on 'on' before a weekday or date and on day, month and year digits in news datelines (on Monday, on June 6, 2007, Aug 7, 2012); pushes toward month names such as Sep, Oct, Jul and Nov.

L25n2629.name: Programming, language writer
L25n2629.description: Goes strongly negative on 'programming' (also coding, SQL, C, C++) right before the word 'language', as in 'open-source programming language' or 'Ruby programming language'; pushes toward 'language' and 'languages'.

L25n1746.name: Verbs of acting together
L25n1746.description: Fires on the verb or word that says things act, lie or move together or side by side: 'work <<together>>', 'laid end to end', 'go hand in hand', 'fly in a pyramid', 'compete', 'gather', 'came from'. Pushes toward 'side' (side by side); steered output collapses into 'side side side'.

L24n2622.name: GUI words before 'window'
L24n2622.description: Goes negative on UI-design words ('graphical', 'intuitive', 'user-friendly', 'interface', 'dialog', 'console', 'command') in app prompts; pushes the model to write 'window' or 'interface'.

L25n2986.name: Digit before ordinal suffix
L25n2986.description: The digit just before an ordinal suffix or inside a century or year ('1' in 21st, '2' in 2nd, '3' in 3rd, '1' in 1861). Predicts 'st', 'nd' or 'rd' next. Strongest on the last digit before the suffix.

L24n2866.name: Value, money, and assets
L24n2866.description: Money and asset words, peaking on 'present' in 'present value' and 'value' in 'intrinsic value', plus asset nouns like assets, collateral, currency, commodity, credits, treasure and jewelry. Pushes the model toward 'value' and 'worth'.

L24n2736.name: Article before paper nouns
L24n2736.description: Goes strongly negative on 'a' or 'research' right before a publication noun, such as 'published a new study', 'authored a book', 'a ground-breaking paper', 'research paper' and 'co-authored a'; pushes toward 'paper'.

L25n2283.name: Foot/thumb before print
L25n2283.description: Fires on the first half of a '___print' compound: 'foot' (footprints, footrests), 'thumb', 'Palm', 'finger', 'blue' (blueprint). Pushes the next token to 'print', and steered output spams 'print'.

L22n1964.name: Word before 'conditions'
L22n1964.description: The word right before 'conditions' or 'circumstances', such as 'under', 'certain', 'special', 'harsh' or 'favourable' ('under differing lighting conditions'); pushes toward 'conditions'.

L24n2569.name: Front and back direction
L24n2569.description: Fires on spatial-direction words ('far', 'farther', 'pushed', 'stood', 'front-to-back', 'from the rear', 'directly'); pushes the model toward 'back' or 'front'.

L25n1854.name: Books and fiction words
L25n1854.description: Book and literature words such as novels, fiction, fantasy, thriller, literary, books, and 'to' before read or use in reviews. Pushes toward 'read' and 'reading'.

L23n2646.name: 'on' before a date
L23n2646.description: Fires on 'on' or 'On' right before a day or date, e.g. 'born [on]', 'died [on] Monday', 'at midnight [on] November', 'held [on] Saturday'. Pushes toward month names.

L20n2149.name: Domain and filename stems
L20n2149.description: goes strongly negative on the name token just before a domain or file suffix ('providence|journal.com', 'get-pip.py'), and on 'root' or 'sudo'; pushes toward '.txt', '.com' and '.py'.

L26n2193.name: Computer hardware and software
L26n2193.description: Goes strongly negative on computer hardware, software and tech nouns: 'GPU', 'network card', 'graphics processing unit', 'VPN', 'USB', 'Android', 'controller', 'Arduino'. Pushes toward 'driver' and 'drivers'.

L21n1360.name: Slot before 'usually/often'
L21n1360.description: Fires on the token just before a generic statement's frequency slot, e.g. 'are' in 'tinnitus are caused' or 'plans' in 'These plans are typically'. Pushes the model toward 'usually', 'often' and 'typically'.

L24n991.name: Place names after 'in'
L24n991.description: Fires on the token just before a place name, such as 'in' in 'based in' or 'in Toronto', 'of' in 'University of', and commas in lists of cities and states. Pushes the model to name a city or US location.

L21n2555.name: Placeholder before a name
L21n2555.description: Fires on the '[' or word right before a template placeholder ('Dear [', '[Project', 'Title', 'Author', 'Chapter', 'insert the'); pushes the model to write 'name'.

L23n2085.name: 'col' column prefix
L23n2085.description: Fires on the token 'col' or '-col' at the start of a word, such as spreadsheet column talk, 'electoral-college', 'Colosseum' or 'Colchester'; pushes toward 'column' and 'col'.

L25n1798.name: Age and youth words
L25n1798.description: Fires negatively on age and child-stage words after a number or in a young-age context ('weeks' in 'of age', '-month' in '7-month-olds', '-year' in 'one-year', 'baby', 'infant', 'pediatric'); pushed negative, it repeats 'young'.

L24n445.name: Numeric types → 'double'
L24n445.description: Fires on numeric-type qualifiers in programming prompts: '-point' in 'floating-point', 'positive', 'non-negative', and 'two'/'six' before 'integers'. Pushes toward the type name 'double' and 'Double'.

L22n1976.name: Possessive before 'name'
L22n1976.description: Fires on a possessive or article ('its', 'their', 'his', 'the') right before 'name' or 'nickname', as in 'gets its name' or 'earned his nickname'. Pushes the model to write 'name'.

L21n2530.name: Return and back motion
L21n2530.description: Goes strongly negative on 'return', 'returned', 'returning', 'back' and 'refer' when they mean going or sending something back; pushes toward 'return'.

L26n3007.name: 'years' in age phrases
L26n3007.description: Strongly negative on 'year(s)' right after a number in an age phrase (e.g. 'seven years old', '65 years and older', '3 years old'); pushes 'old'.

L23n1349.name: Never and give up
L23n1349.description: 'never' (peak) and 'give' before 'up', plus 'from' in 'keep from' and 'to' in 'refused to'; fires where text is about quitting or ceasing. Pushes the model to write 'stop' and 'stopping'.

L25n2235.name: Login and user-account words
L25n2235.description: Goes strongly negative on user-account words: 'users', 'user', 'login', 'logged', 'register', and 'Staying' in stay logged in, plus 'trouble' in support dialogue. Pushes toward 'log' and 'sign' (log in, sign in).

L27n1693.name: All-caps word fragments
L27n1693.description: A letter-group piece inside an all-caps word or name, e.g. 'UL' in DINUZULU, 'IB' in LANGALIBALELE, 'DEV' in DEVIL'S, 'TR' in PROTRAV, 'ULAR' in MULTILOCULAR; pushes toward uppercase fragments like 'AD', 'AB', 'AC'.

L27n3020.name: Food and recipe words
L27n3020.description: Goes negative on food and recipe words in cooking text, on the ingredient or dish token or its first piece (e.g. 'sa' in sautéed, 'bean' in black bean, 'rad' in radish, 'pot' in pot pie). Pushes the model toward 'food'.

L24n2324.name: Payment context before 'card'
L24n2324.description: Goes negative on the word before 'card' in payment talk ('credit' in 'credit card', 'payment', 'crypto', 'shopping', 'privacy'); pushes the model to write 'card'.

L22n2143.name: Variation and difference modifiers
L22n2143.description: Fires on the modal or adjective just before a variation word, such as 'may' in 'may vary', or 'pronounced', 'substantial', 'ethnic' before 'differences'. Pushes the model toward 'variation' or 'differences'.

L24n114.name: Token before closing paren
L24n114.description: Fires on the final word, unit or abbreviation just before a closing parenthesis, peaking on 'm' in '(1.2 m)', 'oz' in '(14.5 oz)', 'months' in '(4 months)', 'ol' in '(alpha-tocopherol)' and 'ce' in '(... BCE)', and near zero on the parenthesis itself. Pushes toward closing parentheses and closing quotes, and steering spams them.

L25n2727.name: Heart and stroke risk
L25n2727.description: Fires on the word right after a cardiovascular or disease-risk phrase, e.g. 'called' after 'arterial hypertension', 'of' in 'risk of stroke', 'and' in 'heart disease and stroke', 'developing' in 'risk of developing'. Pushes toward 'heart', and steering repeats it.

L23n2405.name: Comparative before 'than'
L23n2405.description: Comparative or 'rather'/'other' right before 'than' ('more', 'less', 'larger', 'rather', 'thicker'); pushes 'than' and 'THAN'.

L22n1813.name: Word after takes/accepts
L22n1813.description: Fires on the word right after 'takes' or 'accepts' in function specs ('takes one parameter', 'takes as input', 'accepts a list'), and on 'optional' and 'chars'; pushes toward 'parameter' (or 'param').

L25n2145.name: Field label before 'number'
L25n2145.description: Fires on the label word of a form or catalog field where a value is expected next (e.g. 'phone' in 'phone number', 'Control' in 'LC Control Number', 'ID', 'port', 'version'); pushes 'number'.

L22n911.name: Programming words before 'function'
L22n911.description: Fires on a programming-language name or code word ('Python', 'JavaScript', 'Haskell', 'Kotlin', 'auxiliary', 'defines') in coding prompts; pushes the model to write 'function'.

L22n827.name: Software and programming tools
L22n827.description: Fires negatively on the connector or word just before a named software tool or language in a list, e.g. 'or' in 'R or Python', 'like' in 'apps like Tableau', and on the tool names in data-science and programming text; pushes toward naming software, Python and Java.

L25n1118.name: Leftover after quantity
L25n1118.description: Fires on the noun or quantity word after 'few', 'had', 'have' or 'a' that states what remains ('a few days left', '8 mice left', 'had nothing in common', 'wasn't much'); pushes toward 'left', so steered text repeats 'left left'.

L24n2692.name: Middle/far range words
L24n2692.description: goes strongly negative on 'middle', 'mid', 'far', 'near', 'long' or 'short' in range phrases like 'Middle East', 'middle of', 'long term', 'near future'; pushes toward 'distance' tokens.

L22n796.name: Function and return keywords
L22n796.description: Fires on 'function', 'return' and 'should' in coding-task prompts and docs, e.g. 'The function should return a boolean' and 'the return string'. Pushes toward the word 'return' and its variants; steered text spams 'return'.

L26n2358.name: Preposition before place names
L26n2358.description: 'in', 'of', 'and', 'at' or 'against' right before a place, city, country or team name (in Dubai, between Johannesburg and Durban, port of Dar); pushes toward province and US-state names like Alabama and Oregon.

L22n1760.name: 'Relationship' before 'between'
L22n1760.description: Fires on the noun 'relationship' (also correlation, connection, link) right after 'the' in analytical prompts and essays, where 'between' is expected next. Pushes 'between' and its translations.

L22n1699.name: 'for'/'over' before timespan
L22n1699.description: Fires positive on 'for', 'over' or 'of' just before a duration, e.g. 'known for centuries', 'over sixty years ago', 'over two decades', 'thousands of years'. Pushes toward 'years', 'decades' and 'centuries'.

L24n2360.name: 'To' after prompts-the-user
L24n2360.description: Fires negatively on 'to' (and on 'user') in coding-task prompts such as 'prompts the user to', 'allows users to', 'asks the user to', and on 'integer' and 'input' words; pushes toward 'enter', 'entry' and 'input', and at -0.5 it repeats 'entered' and 'entry'.

L23n2175.name: Product-category nouns in marketing
L23n2175.description: Fires positive on the product or category noun in marketing and product-review prompts (skincare, supplement, diaper, makeup, 'product'), and on the word right before it. Pushes toward 'product'.

L23n1079.name: Digit before percent sign
L23n1079.description: Goes strongly negative on the digit right before a '%' sign (the 0 in '10%', '35%') and on 'percent'/'percentage' tokens; pushes the model to write '%'.

L25n1595.name: Software category before solution
L25n1595.description: Negative on the noun naming a business software category, just before 'solution' or 'platform': 'media asset management', 'content management', 'call center software', 'cloud storage', 'IT', 'analytics', 'procurement'. Pushes toward 'solution' and 'solutions'.

L23n2798.name: Automation and autonomy words
L23n2798.description: Fires on 'auto' word-starts and the word just before them ('to' in 'manual to automatic', 'semi-aut' in 'semi-autonomous', 'auto' in 'auto responders'). Pushes the model toward 'automatic' and 'automated'.

L23n2202.name: Search and results words
L23n2202.description: The word 'search' (search engine, search list, search your) and 'results' in listing text ('21 results for Schools', '1-25 of about 99 results'); pushes toward 'results'.

L26n2084.name: Electricity and voltage words
L26n2084.description: Fires on electrical-domain words, peaking on 'electrical', 'electric' and 'welding', and on 'high' or 'low' before 'voltage'; pushes toward 'current' and 'resistance', so steered output spams 'current'.

L24n2037.name: relative time modifiers
L24n2037.description: Fires on relative-time words 'last', 'next', 'every', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow' at the start of a time phrase ('last year', 'next October', 'every year'); pushes toward a time-unit noun next ('year', 'month', 'week', 'night'), and steered text spams 'night'.

L22n2844.name: Number before 'fold/times'
L22n2844.description: Fires on the number or approximate word right before a multiplier, e.g. 'ten[fold]', 'a million[-fold]', 'three[-fold]', 'ten times', 'nearly', 'almost', 'up to'. Pushes toward 'double' or 'twice'.

L25n2615.name: Chemical compound name stems
L25n2615.description: Fires inside the stem of chemical and nutrient names, such as 'methyl' in methylmercury, 'rist' in myristic, 'hydro' in dihydrotestosterone, and '-car' in beta-carotene; pushes toward 'chemical' and 'chemistry'.

L21n110.name: Leading digit of years
L21n110.description: The first digit of a year or century: the '2' in 'the 20th century' or '2012', the '1' in '1980s', the '9' in '1990s'. Strongest on the first digit after 'in', 'during the' or 'the'; later digits are weak. Pushes toward digit tokens (0, 4, 9, 7).

L25n1359.name: Measurement and instrument terms
L25n1359.description: Fires on the piece of a science or instrument term that names a measurement tool or method: '-ray' in X-ray, 'spectro' in spectroscopy, 'utron' in neutron source, 'gan' in gantry, plus 'Scientists', 'Researchers' and the measure verb in lab-result sentences. Pushes toward 'measure' and 'measurement'.

L25n2138.name: Rate-of-change verbs
L25n2138.description: Fires on a verb or adjective for a change in speed, level or state, e.g. 'advancing' technology, 'rising' population, 'melt(ing)' and 'warm' faster, 'accelerate', 'moves' backwards, 'too' large. Pushes toward 'fast'/'Fast', and steering repeats 'fast'.

L26n3035.name: Ex opening explain prompts
L26n3035.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'Ex' or 'exp' that opens 'Explain' and 'Examine' in task prompts, and on 'exp' in words like expanding and inexplicably. Pushes toward 'explanation' and 'explain'.

L27n1027.name: Stem before 'u' continuation
L27n1027.description: Fires on the stem piece just before a 'u' continuation inside a split word (est|uaries, congr|uence, confl|uent, purs|ues, sanct|uaries, discontin|uity). Pushes 'u' tokens; steered output is 'u u u' spam.

L24n2438.name: Efficiency and cost words
L24n2438.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an efficiency word ('energy-[use] efficiency', 'cost [effective]', 'more [efficient]') and on 'fuel' in 'fuel consumption'. Pushes toward 'efficient' and 'efficiency' forms.

L23n3068.name: Modifier before facility nouns
L23n3068.description: Fires on the word just before a facility or office noun ('recycling [transfer] station', 'sewage [treatment] plant', 'Visitor [Center]', 'Recreation [Department]'). Pushes toward 'center' and 'centre'.

L27n865.name: Opening quote mark
L27n865.description: Goes negative on an opening quotation mark (“ or ‘), or on a hyphen piece, right before a quoted term or title. Pushes toward closing quote and apostrophe characters.

L25n2196.name: Word before 'way/path'
L25n2196.description: Fires on the word right before a route noun: 'this' in 'this way', 'along' in 'along the way', 'career' in 'career path', 'sure' in 'sure way'; pushes the model toward 'path', so steered output spams 'path'.

L22n783.name: Form input validation words
L22n783.description: Goes strongly negative on form and input words in web-form and validation prompts ('input [fields]', 'HTML [form]', 'validate' in validateEmail, 'input validation'). Pushes toward 'validate' and 'validation'.

L25n2893.name: Hardware component names
L25n2893.description: Negative on the word for a computer or electronics hardware part: 'graphics' (before processing unit), 'network' (card), 'GPU', 'video', 'Arduino' and 'controller', 'Wi-Fi', 'Pi'. Pushes toward 'card' and 'cards'; steered output fills with 'card'.

L24n1130.name: Verbs before 'me'
L24n1130.description: Fires on the verb just before a 'me' or 'let's' object, e.g. 'tell' in 'Can you tell me', 'told' in 'told me', 'given me', 'helped me', 'remember me', 'Let's'; pushes toward the token 'me', and at +0.5 it spams 'me me me'.

L22n2068.name: Space before date day
L22n2068.description: Goes strongly negative on the blank space token right before a day number in a date, as in 'on 18 June', 'On 31 March' and 'Date of Local Designation: 1976'. Pushes the model to write 'date'.

L26n694.name: Maths and geometry context
L26n694.description: Fires positive on function words ('and', 'of', 'the', 'to') inside maths and geometry explanations, e.g. 'and' in 'base and height', 'of' in 'quotient of cosine', 'the' before 'area'; pushes toward 'geometry' tokens.

L25n2557.name: URL scheme http
L25n2557.description: Fires on 'http' or 'https' that opens a web address, most strongly on the colon right after 'http' and on 'https' before '://'. Pushes toward '//' so steered text degenerates into slashes.

L21n1153.name: Enumerator labels before ')'
L21n1153.description: Fires on the letter or roman numeral inside a list label, e.g. '(a', '(b', '(ii', 'a', 'i', just before its closing parenthesis. Pushes toward ')'.

L22n958.name: Requirement slot before 'condition'
L22n958.description: Fires on the word just before a requirement noun is expected, e.g. 'as a [condition]', 'these [requirements]', 'the [criteria]' after meets/satisfy/fulfill, and on 'necessary', 'minimal', 'mandatory', 'prerequisite'. Pushes the model toward 'condition(s)'.

L24n1778.name: Duration slot → time-unit
L24n1778.description: Fires on the word just before a time span is named: 'take' in 'take a decade', 'a' in 'a few hours', 'for' in 'for a few hours', 'two' in 'two months', 'within' a decade. Pushes toward 'hours', 'months', 'days' and 'weeks'.

L25n1307.name: Retail store nouns
L25n1307.description: Goes strongly negative on the store-type noun in shopping text ('store' in grocery store, 'retail', 'supermarket', 'online stores', 'mall'); pushing it negative makes the model spam 'store'.

L21n1442.name: Your/favourite before choice
L21n1442.description: Fires on 'your', 'their', 'top', 'favourite' and superlatives like 'popular', 'best' right before a selection noun ('of your choice', 'top candidate', 'favorite of'). Pushes the model to write 'choice' tokens.

L27n412.name: Piece before -er ending
L27n412.description: Negative on the word piece before an agent '-er' or '-ers' ending, e.g. 'engr|aver', 'Fore|ster', 'gard|ener', 'retrie|vers'; pushes toward agent nouns like 'controller'.

L26n268.name: Acronym letters after parenthesis
L26n268.description: Fires on the first letters of an acronym, mostly right after an opening parenthesis (ATL, AIDS, UAB, APHA, LEAs, IELA, MDA); pushes toward capital 'AI' and 'AV' tokens and steers into 'AI AI AI' spam.

L23n934.name: Determiner after 'highlight'
L23n934.description: Fires on the word after a list-introducing verb, e.g. 'highlighting [its]', 'highlight [the]', 'outlining [the]', 'focusing on [the]', 'Here are [some]', where 'key' comes next. Pushes toward 'key'.

L22n2106.name: Dictionary and definition contexts
L22n2106.description: Dictionary names ('Dictionary', 'OED') and the copula or 'and' right before a definition ('A safe working load is the maximum...', 'Define and explain'). Pushes toward 'definition', 'define' and 'defined'.

L25n3008.name: 3D and axis words
L25n3008.description: Fires on the '3' in '3D' or 'three-dimensional' and on spatial axis words (vertical, horizontal, diagonal, along the diagonal). Strongest on the '3'. Pushes toward 'axis' and 'dimension'.

L25n1883.name: Dotted-abbreviation letters
L25n1883.description: The letter inside dotted abbreviations, such as the 'm' in a.m., 'p' in p.m., 'S' in U.S., 'C' in D.C. and 'D' in A.D. Pushes toward dot-letter tokens like '.m'; steered output spams them, as in 'I.m..s..v'.

L21n686.name: Average before statistic values
L21n686.description: Fires on 'age' and the article or word just before an average or approximate value ('mean age', 'average age', 'an approximate', 'an optimistic', 'a 14% increase'); pushes the model to write 'average' or 'mean'.

L25n1803.name: Word before 'surface'
L25n1803.description: The modifier right before the word 'surface', such as hard level surface, flat bearing surface, gripping surface and mating surfaces. Pushes toward 'surface'; steered output spams 'surface'.

L23n2186.name: Upper and lower bounds
L23n2186.description: Fires on 'upper' and 'lower' (and 'lowest', 'higher') in bound and limit phrases: 'upper limit', 'lower class', 'upper threshold', 'lower melting point'. Pushes the model toward 'upper' and 'lower' bounds.

L26n1629.name: Stem before -er suffix
L26n1629.description: The stem of an agent noun just before its '-er' ending, split into tokens, e.g. 'gard|ener', 'retrie|ver', 'steam|er', 'absor|ber', 'breed|er', 'engr|aver'; pushes toward '-er' suffix pieces such as 'per', 'iter', 'ver'.

L22n2648.name: Quantity adjectives before amount
L22n2648.description: fires on the size or quantity adjective right before 'amount', 'number', or 'deal' ('a large number', 'a significant amount', 'a great deal'); pushes toward 'amount' tokens.

L25n2834.name: 'the' before cause nouns
L25n2834.description: Goes negative on 'the' or 'a' right before a causal noun such as cause, root, reason or cure, in medical or explanatory text (the| cause of obesity, the| root of the problem); pushes toward 'cause' and 'ca' tokens.

L27n1033.name: Piece before el ending
L27n1033.description: The fragment right before an 'el', 'ell' or 'els' ending: 'carp|els', 'kne|els', 'mack|erel', 'kn|ell', 'Fil|ad|elfia', 'bio|fu|els'. Pushes toward 'el'.

L23n2904.name: Anticipates solving/solution
L23n2904.description: Fires (goes negative) on the word just before an expected solve/solution word: 'a' in 'found a way to', 'to' in 'impossible to answer', 'be' in 'can be solved', 'problem' in 'problem-solving'. Pushes the model to write 'solution'/'solve' next.

L23n1385.name: Hash-table bucket/key terms
L23n1385.description: Fires on hash-table and lookup words ('bucket', 'keys', 'stored', 'row', 'hash') and on the word just before the looked-up item ('an identifier', 'the position'); pushes toward 'key'/'Key' tokens.

L25n2020.name: Quantity nouns before 'of'
L25n2020.description: Goes strongly negative on a quantity or measure noun right before 'of', like 'age' in 'at the age of', 'number' in 'a number of', 'thousands' of years or 'kinds' of; pushes toward 'of' and 'off', and at high dose loops on 'of'.

L26n1525.name: Superlative -est stems
L26n1525.description: The stem right before a superlative '-est' ending, such as 'jolli' in jolliest, 'dri' in driest, 'warm' in warmest and 'clean' in cleanest. Pushes toward the 'est' ending; steered output spams 'est'.

L23n2497.name: Submit or apply slot
L23n2497.description: Negative on the word just before a verb or noun about applying, submitting, or approval, e.g. 'submit <a>', 'applied <to>', 'approval <to>', 'Award', 'candidate'. Pushes the model toward 'application'.

L25n2809.name: Keypad and key input
L25n2809.description: Negative on the word for a physical input part or a finger-press action: 'key' (key clicks), 'keypad' (4x4 keypad), 'keyboards', 'press', 'fret', 'neck', 'finger', 'piano' in device or instrument text. Pushes toward 'key' and 'keys'.

L26n3038.name: Color words
L26n3038.description: Color words and shades (red, blue, yellow, gray, colour, shade) describing what a thing looks like; pushes toward 'green' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L23n2742.name: Position words before 'side'
L23n2742.description: Position words right before 'side' ('opposite', 'other', 'both', 'one', '-hand' in 'left-hand side'); pushes 'side' and 'Side'.

L26n2057.name: Industrial plant nouns
L26n2057.description: The modifier or head word of an industrial facility name (nuclear, processing, wastewater treatment, power plant, steel). Pushes toward 'plants' and 'plant'.

L22n1492.name: Magnitude words before 'of'
L22n1492.description: Size or magnitude words right before 'of' or 'to' ('scales of', 'tens of', 'billions of', 'microscopic to', 'energies') (negative); pushes toward 'order', as in order of magnitude.

L23n1239.name: How-to technique nouns
L23n1239.description: Negative on the gerund or noun naming a practice or technique in how-to text: 'folding' (folding techniques), 'farming' (farming practices), 'teaching', 'delivery', 'stitching', 'brushing' and flossing, 'learning' (learning styles). Pushing it negative writes 'method' repeatedly.

L22n1955.name: Outcome adjectives → result
L22n1955.description: Fires on the adjective or verb just before an outcome noun: 'disastrous' (effects), 'reach' (conclusions), 'achieve' (a successful outcome), 'accurate', 'desired', 'fatal', 'definite'; pushes toward 'result(s)'.

L26n2866.name: Transport and traffic nouns
L26n2866.description: Strongly negative on transport nouns in road, rail and subway text (e.g. 'ticket' in ticket hall, 'subway', 'traffic', 'highway', 'lanes'); pushes toward 'travel'.

L22n515.name: Intensifier before 'true'
L22n515.description: The copula or intensifier right before 'true' in 'this is especially true', 'is particularly true', 'was true', 'undoubtedly'; pushes 'true' and 'True'.

L24n1444.name: Reflect and think words
L24n1444.description: Fires on 'think', 'thought', 'reflect' and nearby reflective words like 'quiet' and 'philosophical' (e.g. 'Have you ever thought', 'pause to reflect'), peaking on the verb itself. Pushes the model to write 'reflection' and 'reflect' forms.

L24n1960.name: Decimal point, 'point'
L24n1960.description: Fires on 'decimal' and 'floating' before 'point', and on digits inside decimal numbers like 0.01 or 1.87. Pushes the model to write 'point'.

L24n2038.name: Official issuing verbs
L24n2038.description: Goes strongly negative on the verb after an official actor: 'issued' (proclamation, apology, guidelines), 'signed', 'passes', 'ordered', 'given'. Pushes toward 'order' and 'orders'.

L22n1354.name: URL-start colon writer
L22n1354.description: Fires on the colon right before a web address, e.g. 'Link:' or 'visit:' followed by https://www., and on 'https' and 'http' tokens themselves. Pushes toward http, https and www.

L23n643.name: slot before 'elements/features'
L23n643.description: Fires on adjectives and verbs like 'essential', 'key', 'structural', 'distinctive', 'incorporating', and on 'these' or 'certain', right before a noun for parts or features ('essential element', 'key aspects'); pushes toward 'element(s)', and steered text spams 'elements'.

L23n981.name: On/top placement prepositions
L23n981.description: Goes strongly negative on 'on', 'onto' and 'over' after placement verbs ('placed on', 'put on', 'applied on', 'drip stuff on top'), peaking on the preposition just before a surface or 'top' location. Pushes the model to write 'top' (on top, top of).

L27n2438.name: Region word after 'the'
L27n2438.description: Fires on 'the' or a modifier right before a region name ('of the South', 'the Far West', 'the global South', 'the Deep South'); pushes toward 'North' and 'South'.

L26n953.name: Last word before '?'
L26n953.description: The final word of a question, right before its '?' ('correct' in 'Was the diagnosis even correct?', 'possible' in 'How is this possible?', 'huh' in 'Weird, huh?'). Pushes toward '?'.

L23n2334.name: URL and POST words
L23n2334.description: The 'http' or 'https' token in URLs, and verbs like 'send' and 'receives' in web-request or PHP text; pushes toward 'POST' and 'post' (HTTP method).

L24n2620.name: Browsers and installable add-ons
L24n2620.description: Goes strongly negative on browser and app-software names and install talk: 'Chrome' in 'Chrome extension', 'browser', 'Firefox', 'Adobe Reader', and 'install'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'extension' over and over.

L26n2023.name: Record and journal nouns
L26n2023.description: Negative on the word for a recorded or written log in writing-task prompts: 'diary', 'journal', 'blog' (weblogs), 'vlogger', 'progress report', 'gratitude reminder'. Pushes toward the token 'log' and its forms (log, Log, _log).

L24n1536.name: Award and receive verbs
L24n1536.description: fires on the verb or word just before a recipient or honour ('was not awarded', 'receive', 'honours called', 'writing to'), in award and reception contexts; pushes toward 'recognition' and 'recognize'.

L24n1678.name: Limit and boundary lead-in
L24n1678.description: Fires on the word before a limit or boundary noun, e.g. 'upper' in 'upper limit', 'the' in 'push the boundaries', 'no' in 'know no bounds', and 'Mexican' before border; pushes toward 'limit', 'bounds' and 'boundaries'.

L27n283.name: Slot before a number
L27n283.description: Fires on the space or token just before a number in statistics-style text (the space before 2014, 21 million, 5%, 65 years). Pushes toward digit tokens; steered, it spams '1000000' or other digits.

L25n1544.name: Modifier before function
L25n1544.description: Fires on the word just before 'function', 'purpose' or 'task' (primary, different, same, their, this, many, whose, biological), in sentences about what something does; pushes 'function' tokens.

L23n1055.name: Placement and arrangement words
L23n1055.description: Negative on words about how things are placed or arranged: 'randomly' in 'randomly distributed', 'placed', 'relative', 'layout', 'desired shape'. Pushes 'position' and its variants.

L24n2256.name: 'cont-' word start
L24n2256.description: Fires positively on the 'cont' or 'contin' start of words like continue, contemporary, discontinued and uncontrollable. Pushes toward 'contin-' words (continue, continuous, continuing).

L22n2524.name: Option and choice words
L22n2524.description: Fires on the modifier just before 'option(s)' or 'way' in choice phrases: 'viable', 'safe', 'two', 'three', 'another', 'other', 'available'. Pushes the model toward 'option' and 'options'.

L27n1196.name: Digit inside a number
L27n1196.description: Fires (negative) on a single digit inside a multi-digit number, mostly the later digits of years and quantities (the '8' in -286, the '2' in 1920s, the '0' in 300°F); pushes toward more digits.

L26n1480.name: Treaty and signing words
L26n1480.description: Fires on treaty or signing vocabulary and on the word after it: 'Treaty', 'Agreement', 'Pact', 'Convention', 'signed', plus 'was' in 'was signed' and 'to' in 'agreed to' or 'refused to ratify'. Pushes toward 'sign' word forms.

L22n2096.name: Property and effect adjectives
L22n2096.description: Fires on the adjective that introduces a property or effect of a substance or thing: 'anti-inflammatory', 'antioxidant', 'physical' (physical properties), 'cooling' (cooling effect), 'cleansing', 'beneficial', 'possesses', 'desirable' (traits). Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L27n1448.name: Stem before '-our/-ore' suffix
L27n1448.description: Fires strongly negative on the stem piece just before an 'or' ending such as 'ours', 'ores', 'ored', 'oring' (e.g. 'tum' in tumours, 'hon' in honours, 'carniv' in carnivores, 'tut' in tutored). Pushes toward 'or' tokens (steered output is 'ororor').

L26n32.name: Words inside quotation marks
L26n32.description: Fires on the word that starts or sits inside a quoted or scare-quoted phrase ('true' in ‘true’ play, 'real' in ''real'' Washington, 'holy' in 'holy grail', 'kissing' in ‘kissing crust’); pushes the model to emit quotation marks.

L23n1473.name: 'First'/'last' before 'name'
L23n1473.description: The word 'first' or 'last' (also 'girl', 'woman', 'boy') right before 'name' in a personal-info field such as first name or last name; pushes toward 'name', 'names' and '_name'.

L22n842.name: Multiply and arithmetic operations
L22n842.description: Operation names in math text, peaking on the comma in an 'add, subtract, divide, multiply' list and on 'multip' in 'multiplication'. Pushes the model to write 'multiply' and 'product'.

L24n2961.name: Work and trade nouns
L24n2961.description: Job and trade words: 'of' after 'scope' in 'scope of work', 'work' in 'work required' or 'work must be inspected', 'construction', 'maintenance', 'wiring', 'welding', 'electrical' and 'cleanup'. Pushes the model toward 'work'.

L25n1853.name: Word before space nouns
L25n1853.description: Fires on the modifier right before a place noun such as space, area, zone or quarters (living quarters, enclosed spaces, safe space, storage areas, nuclear wasteland); pushes 'area', 'region' and 'zone'.

L26n1445.name: Word before 'year'
L26n1445.description: Fires on the word just before 'year' or another calendar unit ('New| Year', 'all| year round', 'leap| year', 'hot| summer', 'on| year'). Pushes the model toward 'years', 'months' and 'decades'.

L27n1129.name: Verb stem before -ate
L27n1129.description: Positive on a verb stem split from its ending, right before '-ate' or '-ise', e.g. 'educ|ates', 'narr|ates', 'motiv|ates', 'irrit|ates', 'rehe|ated'. Pushes toward 'ate', 'ise' and 'ates'; steered output spams 'ate'.

L27n1346.name: Search and index lookup
L27n1346.description: The word before a noun in search, index, hash and join text ('search' in search engine or search list, 'hash' in hash function, 'two' in joining two tables); pushes the model toward 'index' tokens.

L24n2382.name: Problem and conflict words
L24n2382.description: Fires on words for a problem or conflict that head a phrase: mostly 'problem' in 'problem-solving' or 'problem solving', and 'conflict' in 'conflict management', plus 'puzzles', 'mystery', 'complaints', 'scenarios', 'suspense'. Steered, it pushes 'resolution' and 'resolve' (steered output is 'resolution' repeated).

L24n1762.name: Rank words before 'order'
L24n1762.description: Goes strongly negative on rank or level words that come before 'order': 'second' in 'second-order', 'first', 'higher', 'highest', 'high' in 'high-functioning', and 'Higher' as a degree. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'order' repeatedly.

L24n2994.name: Watching and listening media
L24n2994.description: Words about watching or listening to media: 'watched', 'watch', the 've' in 'you've watched', 'TV', 'YouTube', 'videos', 'podcasts', 'listeners' and 'fans'. Pushes the model toward 'watch' and 'view'.

L21n1412.name: Numbering and rank words
L21n1412.description: 'number' in rank phrases ('number one', 'number-one killer') and the label word after a list marker ('Phase One', 'Fact', 'Article', 'Bill', 'Figure', 'Pit #24'). Pushes the model to write 'number' or '#'.

L22n1188.name: genre or format label
L22n1188.description: Fires on the word just before a genre, style, or format noun ('op-ed', 'ballad', 'noir' in 'noir style', 'thriller', 'social media post', 'scientific paper'); pushes toward 'type' or 'kind', and steered text spams 'type of'.

L23n2777.name: Wait/last before 'until'
L23n2777.description: The verb 'wait', 'waited', 'last', 'lasting' or 'lasted' right before a time span or deadline ('wait until', 'lasted until'); pushes toward 'until', 'till' and 'hasta'.

L27n238.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n238.description: Fires on a single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number (27.2°C, port 520, 1956, 0.92); pushes toward digit tokens 0-9, and steered output degenerates into runs of zeros.

L24n2416.name: Job and hiring nouns
L24n2416.description: Fires (negative) on the word 'job' and related hiring nouns such as intern, admissions, immigration and asylum, peaking on 'job' in phrases like 'job application', 'job market', 'job posting' and 'job interview'. Pushes toward 'candidate' and 'applicant', and steering spams 'candidates'.

L24n1795.name: Study-design and sample words
L24n1795.description: Research-design words in study descriptions, such as 'larger', 'representative', 'sample', 'randomized', 'mixed' and 'survey' (negative); pushes toward 'sample' and 'Sample'.

L26n391.name: -ly adverb stems
L26n391.description: The stem of an '-ly' adverb split across tokens (harmon|iously, satisf|actorily, compreh|ensively, chem|ically), right before the '-ly' ending; pushes toward adverbs like 'completely' and 'deeply'.

L21n741.name: Date-introducing prepositions
L21n741.description: Goes strongly negative on a preposition or verb right before a calendar date or year ('until', 'since', 'by', 'on', 'from', 'Starting', 'Born', 'published', 'Copyright'). Pushing it toward the negative side makes the model write month names.

L21n691.name: Averaging and period qualifiers
L21n691.description: goes strongly negative on averaging or period qualifiers before a statistic ('weighted', 'long-term', 'monthly', 'annual', 'all-time', 'seven-month'); pushes toward 'average' tokens.

L26n1116.name: Number words and numerals
L26n1116.description: Strongly negative on a number word or numeral naming a quantity, time, or date (e.g. 'eight' in 'at eight o'clock', 'Eight' in Eighty Years' War, 'April' in 'April 1'); pushes digit tokens 0-9.

L24n2137.name: Material and metal words
L24n2137.description: Fires on the word or preposition that leads into or sits inside a material list, e.g. 'of' in 'made of cardboard', 'in' in 'encased in precious metals', 'or' in 'zinc-plated steel or stainless steel', and on the material names themselves; pushes toward naming metals, plastics and other materials.

L22n1355.name: Verbs of building into
L22n1355.description: Fires negative on the verb of incorporating one thing into another: 'built' in 'built into the barrel', 'woven' into, 'integrated' into, 'incorporated', and 'be' in 'can be integrated' or 'should be used'. Pushes toward 'integrate'.

L24n2714.name: 'rec' fragments, 'receive'
L24n2714.description: Word-start fragments 'rec', 'Rec' and 're-' split off a longer word (recaptured, re-leasing, recollections), and the 'and' in 'send and' just before 'receive'. Pushes toward 'receive', 'received' and 'receiving'.

L23n455.name: Average and number-of phrases
L23n455.description: Goes strongly negative on quantity and aggregate words: 'average', 'total', 'actual', 'largest', and the 'the' right before 'number' in 'the number of' or 'the total days'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'number' repeatedly.

L20n3063.name: Words introducing a table
L20n3063.description: Fires on words that announce an upcoming list, table or figure, e.g. 'the [following] method', 'listed [below]', 'as you can see in the chart [below]', 'Let's', 'illustrated [below]'. Pushes toward 'table'.

L22n1946.name: 'Defines' and 'definition' words
L22n1946.description: Words that introduce a definition or spec: 'defines' and 'define' ('M-file that defines'), 'terminology', 'formally', 'Definitions:', 'Parameters', and the '%' comment marker in MATLAB code. Pushes the model toward 'definition' and 'define'.

L27n625.name: b-initial word starts
L27n625.description: The 'b', 'br' or 'Bl' token that opens a word, mostly a split or name-like word: 'b' in 'bumblebee', 'bre' in 'breeder', 'b' in 'basking shark', 'b' in 'bermudagrass', 'Bl' in 'Blasco', 'B' in 'Biodiversity', 'seab' in 'seabirds'. Pushes toward 'bi' and 'bio' tokens.

L22n2752.name: Rights and voting words
L22n2752.description: goes strongly negative on 'the', 'full' or 'no' before 'right(s)', 'access' or 'opportunity', and on civic-rights words ('voting', 'civil', 'democratic'); pushes toward 'right' tokens.

L23n736.name: Before 'equation' or 'formula'
L23n736.description: Goes negative on the word right before 'equation' or 'formula' ('the', 'defining', 'above', 'given by', 'using the', 'following'); pushes the model to write 'equation'.

L25n1482.name: Graph and curve nouns
L25n1482.description: Fires on the word that names a plot or diagram, like 'graphs' after 'curves are', 'curve' in candlepower curve, 'profile' and 'diagram', and on function-name pieces in graphing problems like 'angent' in cotangent; pushes toward 'graph'.

L27n585.name: Legal and court words
L27n585.description: Court and law words: 'Court' in Supreme Court, 'attorney' in attorney general, 'charges', 'accused', 'fee', 'FBI', and the word before a legal term such as 'right to'; pushes toward 'legal' and 'authorized'.

L24n1722.name: Pointing words: hand, point
L24n1722.description: Goes strongly negative on 'hand', 'pointed', 'pointer', 'point', 'fingers' and 'aimed' when they mean a direction or aim; pushes toward 'point'.

L24n1255.name: Confirm and prove stems
L24n1255.description: Goes strongly negative on verb stems of proof and assurance, such as 'conf' in confute and conferring, 'reaff' and 'reass' in reaffirmation and reassured, and 'prove' or 'disprove'; pushes toward 'validation'.

L24n2134.name: 'Case' in set phrases
L24n2134.description: Goes strongly negative on the determiner or preposition right before 'case' in set phrases ('in any case', 'the case', 'in that case', 'in the case of', 'in addition'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'case' and 'case study'.

L22n2377.name: Adjectives before effect
L22n2377.description: fires on the adjective right before 'effect' ('photovoltaic effect', 'diuretic effect', 'cooling effect', 'greenhouse'), often on its suffix piece; pushes toward 'effect' tokens.

L27n628.name: Pre-number slot to digits
L27n628.description: Fires on the blank space or opening '(' right before a number, e.g. the space before '5%' in '5% carbs', before '6.5 percent', before '50 and 100 hairs', before '10 to 20 minutes', and before a year in '(1943)'. Pushes toward digit tokens like '9', '8' and '7'; steered, it spams '9999'.

L27n2319.name: Word before 'Administration'
L27n2319.description: Fires on the word just before 'Administration' in agency names: 'Atmospheric' in National Oceanic and Atmospheric, 'Energy' in National Energy, 'Emergency' in Federal Emergency Relief. Pushes toward 'admin' tokens.

L24n926.name: Trig function context
L24n926.description: Fires on trigonometry text: the 'cot' and 'angent' pieces of cotangent and tangent, and 'of', 'whose', 'wherever' right before a cosine or tangent term. Pushes the model toward 'sin', 'cos', and 'tan'.

L24n1882.name: Scale and size words
L24n1882.description: Negative pole: fires on words of size or scope and the hyphen before them: 'sc' in 'scale', '-s' in 'Massive-scaled', 'vast', 'enormous', 'unprecedented', plus the preposition in 'on a global scale' and 'economies of scale'. Pushing it negative writes 'scale' and steers text into 'scale' spam.

L25n1981.name: Stem before -ed suffix
L25n1981.description: Fires on the stem piece of a verb split from its past-tense ending, just before '-ed', '-ied' or '-ified' (well-m|aint|ained, reb|uk|ed, priv|atis|ed, Otherwise Spec|ified). Pushes toward 'd' and 'ed' endings; pushed, it spams 'dd' and 'red'.

L27n1468.name: Power and alliance words
L27n1468.description: Goes strongly negative on power and alliance words in war and geopolitics, such as 'Axis', 'Allied', 'coalition', 'imperial', and 'high' before 'commissioner'; pushes toward 'power'.

L27n1040.name: Stem before final -is
L27n1040.description: Fires positively on the stem piece just before a final '-is' ending in medical or scientific words (appendicitis, electrophoresis, schistosomiasis, sepsis, hypodermis). Pushes the model toward 'is', 'iso' and 'IS'.

L20n2364.name: Stem before -like suffix
L20n2364.description: Positive on the noun or adjective stem right before a hyphen or '-like'/'-style' modifier: 'apple' in apple-like, 'Earth' in Earth-like, 'nano' in nanoscale, 'ad' in ballad-style. Pushes '-like' and '-style'.

L24n693.name: Time-span noun before later
L24n693.description: Fires on time-span nouns after a number or 'a' ('a few minutes', 'ten years later', 'a month before', 'decades before'); pushes toward 'early', 'late', 'later'.

L25n2232.name: Ordinal sequence words
L25n2232.description: Sequence words that mark a stage of something, such as 'next', 'second', 'first', 'previous' in 'the next phase' or 'the second wave'. Pushes toward 'round', 'Round', 'rounds'.

L23n2757.name: Demonstratives before statistics
L23n2757.description: Fires positive on 'these', 'this', 'those', 'exact' or 'similar' right before a quantity or statistic noun (numbers, facts, deaths, temperatures), e.g. 'these numbers', 'exact number'. Pushes toward 'numbers'.

L27n1935.name: Stem before -ice
L27n1935.description: Stem right before an 'ic' or 'ice' ending split off as its own token (ju|ice, lic|orice, extr|icably, ellipt|ic, apr|icots, hydro|ponic); pushes toward 'ice' and 'ic'.

L24n847.name: Intensifier before comparatives
L24n847.description: Fires on the word before a comparative, such as 'much' in 'much easier', 'even' in 'even more', and 'little' in 'a little brighter', plus the 'er' or 'ier' stem in 'wetter' and 'trickier'. Pushes the model to write '-er' endings.

L22n2679.name: Repeating-cycle words
L22n2679.description: Fires on words for things that recur on a schedule ('repeats', 'annual', 'seasonal', 'weekly', 'repeating', 'cycle', 'year', 'day'), usually the word before 'of' or the noun itself; pushes the model to write 'cycle'.

L22n996.name: 'and' before output verb
L22n996.description: Fires on 'and' (also 'as', 'the') in program specs like 'takes X and outputs Y', on the word just before the output verb; pushes toward 'output' tokens.

L27n1342.name: Word before 'code'
L27n1342.description: Fires on the word right before 'code' (electrical, dress, tax, moral, criminal, genetic, licensing); pushes 'code' and 'codes'.

L26n1940.name: Stems before past participles
L26n1940.description: The stem piece of a verb just before its past-participle ending, such as 'ble' in bleached, 'dw' in dwelt, 'heart' in heartbroken, and 'explo' in unexplored. Pushes toward past participles like 'taken', 'written', 'gone'.

L25n2764.name: Spatial position words
L25n2764.description: Fires on words that give a position or direction: 'right' in 'upper right quadrant' or '(pictured right)', 'left' in '(pictured left)', 'northeast', and 'the' before 'top' or 'left' in layout phrases. At dose -0.5 it repeats 'top'.

L22n2990.name: Company values and ethics
L22n2990.description: The word just before a values, mission or ethics noun: the 's in 'company's mission', 'and' after 'mission', 'core' before 'teachings', 'moral' before 'standards'; pushes toward 'values'.

L21n1480.name: slot before failure/error
L21n1480.description: Fires on 'from', 'of', or 'to' right after a verb or adjective of learning, fearing, or overcoming ('learn from', 'fear of', 'afraid to'), and on 'overcoming' or 'afraid' themselves, before a noun about mistakes or obstacles; pushes toward 'error' and 'failure', and steered text spams 'failure'.

L22n397.name: Word before possessive 's
L22n397.description: Fires on the word right before an apostrophe-s, especially 'today's', 'nation's', 'country's', 'world's', 'Gym's' and 'here's', and on 'today' itself. Pushes "'s".

L26n1170.name: Compound-word first halves
L26n1170.description: Goes strongly negative on the first half of a compound or phrasal word split across tokens: 'Along' in alongside, 'Break' in breakthrough, 'Under' in underlying, 'Air' in airspace. Pushes toward compound second halves 'out', 'room', 'place', 'ground' and 'point'.

L27n201.name: Pre-verb slot
L27n201.description: Negative on the token just before a bare verb is expected: 'to' before an infinitive (needed to digest), and verb prefixes before their stem (re in re-occur, under in underpin, super in supercede). Pushes toward base verbs (do, consider, think); steered output spams 'do'.

L25n1429.name: Negation prefix (un-, ir-)
L25n1429.description: Negative on the negating prefix of a 'not X' word, before the rest of the word (ir|ritable, uns|atisfied, un|profitable, un|viable, ins|urmountable). Pushes toward positive words: 'positive', 'healthy', 'peaceful' and 'peace'.

L22n2996.name: Derived-variant modifiers
L22n2996.description: Fires on the adjective or suffix that marks a derived variant of a noun, such as 'im|proved', 'simplified', 'modified', 'extended', 'upgraded', 'printable', 'plant-based' and 'watered-down'; pushes toward 'version'.

L27n746.name: Pre-'-id' suffix fragments
L27n746.description: Fires on the piece just before an '-id' or '-ide' ending in chemical and anatomical words, e.g. 'car|ot|id', 'eyel|ids', 'triglycer|ides', 'macrol|ides'; pushes toward 'id' tokens.

L27n1233.name: Predicts '-et' word ending
L27n1233.description: Fires on the piece of a word just before an '-et' ending (e.g. 'hou' in silhouette, 'pick' in picket, 'oplan' in exoplanet, 'epith' in epithet); pushes 'et'/'ets' tokens and makes the model spam 'et'.

L27n1596.name: Predicts a past participle
L27n1596.description: Fires on the auxiliary or adverb right before a past participle: 'have', 'has', 'be', 'been' in perfect or passive phrases ('we have presented', 'will be emailed'), and 'officially', 'newly', 'freshly'. Steering it up pushes the model toward participles like 'controlled', 'supported', 'protected', and the output spams them.

L25n827.name: Slot before 'get' verb
L25n827.description: Strongly negative on the word just before a verb slot of getting or gaining (e.g. 'to' in 'where to get help', 'you' in 'sleep you obtain', 're' in 'they're getting'); pushes 'get', 'gain', 'obtain'.

L22n1826.name: 'file' as file input
L22n1826.description: Fires on the word 'file' when it names something read, uploaded or saved in code and how-to text ('CSV file', 'text file', 'upload a file', 'JSON file'); pushes toward 'path' and 'paths'.

L27n1669.name: Stem before '-us' ending
L27n1669.description: Fires on the piece just before a '-us' ending in Latin or Greek names (Lin|us, Tit|us, lot|us, Caucas|us, Lazar|us, philadelph|us). Pushes 'us' and 'US' tokens; steered output is 'usus' spam.

L27n1915.name: Words before 'design'
L27n1915.description: Goes strongly negative on the modifier right before 'design', such as 'Experimental' in experimental design, 'sound' in sound design, 'production' in production design; pushes toward 'design'.

L26n690.name: 't' inside split words
L26n690.description: Fires on word pieces that carry a bare 't' as a split-off fragment, e.g. 'let' in Bletchley, 'get' in Bridgeton, 'Et' in Etymology, 'it' in peritonsillar, and 'igaret' and 'icket' pieces of cigarette and ticket. Pushes toward a bare 't' token and, when steered, degenerate 'tststs' loops.

L23n2093.name: Digits before percent sign
L23n2093.description: Fires on the digits and decimal point of a percentage or rate, just before the '%' sign: '8.25' in '8.25% annual interest', '5' in '75%', '1.5' in '1.5°C'. Pushes toward '%' and steered text spams '%' signs.

L23n2867.name: Root and sudo admin
L23n2867.description: Fires on 'root', 'sudo', 'ALL' and 'NOPASSWD' in sudoers and su/root-account admin text, e.g. 'su' followed by 'Enter root password'; pushes the model toward the token 'root'.

L24n2582.name: Pronoun after 'what'
L24n2582.description: Fires on the word right after 'what' or 'which', e.g. 'what [it] takes', 'what [it] means', 'what [you] have', 'Crypto [which]', where 'mean(s)' comes next. Pushes toward 'mean'.

L26n2062.name: Stem before -on suffix
L26n2062.description: The stem right before an '-on' or '-ons' ending that is split into tokens, e.g. 'reck|ons', 'Maim|onides', 'Astr|onauts', 'Parthen|on', 'so|ons'; pushes toward '-on' endings such as 'ons', 'ones', 'oned'.

L22n3049.name: Word before copy
L22n3049.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'copy' or 'copies' in text about getting or printing copies ('hard copy', 'print your own copies', 'bought an old copy', 'extra copies'); pushes toward 'copy'.

L23n2838.name: Slot before 'target'
L23n2838.description: Fires on the adjective or noun right before 'target' is expected, e.g. 'a promising [target]', 'vulnerable [targets]', 'a valuable [target]', 'therapeutic', 'viral', 'toxin'. Pushes toward 'target'.

L26n1425.name: Stem before '-ist'/'-ian'
L26n1425.description: Fires on the stem just before a person-noun suffix, e.g. 'mathematic' in mathematician, 'theor' in theorist, 'agr-onom' in agronomist, 'hydro-log' in hydrologist. Pushes toward predicting '-ist' or '-ian'.

L24n1994.name: Adjective before 'system'
L24n1994.description: The adjective right before 'system' or 'systems', such as 'ecological', 'biological', 'socio', 'agricultural' or 'distributed' (negative); pushes toward 'system' and 'systems'.

L23n1826.name: Route-travel motion verbs
L23n1826.description: Fires negative on motion verbs that describe a path through a place, e.g. 'ran' for a railway line, 'runs through' for a river, 'flows', 'cuts across', 'passing through'. Pushes toward 'passes', 'passing' and 'through'.

L27n1257.name: Word before 'group'
L27n1257.description: Fires on the word just before 'group' ('Management' in Object Management Group, 'Book' in Hachette Book Group, 'focus' in focus groups, 'small' in small group). Steering it up pushes the model to write 'group', and the output spams 'Group group'.

L27n873.name: Stem before 'in' ending
L27n873.description: Fires on the piece just before an 'in' ending inside split names (oxy|toc|in, isot|ret|in, Bed|ou|in, Bak|un|in, Alame|in, somat|ost|atin). Pushes 'in' and 'In' tokens, and steered output spams 'in'.

L25n2254.name: hash / digest word
L25n2254.description: Fires on the word 'hash' (and 'hashing', 'hash function', 'hash joins'), peaking on 'hash' itself and on the token after 'a' or 'the' in hash contexts. Pushes the model to write 'hash', 'MD' and 'md'.

L27n1652.name: Sentence end before newline
L27n1652.description: Fires on the period, colon or closing bracket that ends a line, just before a line break (.⏎, :⏎, ).⏎); pushes toward a newline, and steering at full dose spams blank lines.

L27n2615.name: Token before 'science'
L27n2615.description: The word just before 'science' or 'scientific' ('rocket', 'political', 'citizen-sc', 'Inters|c|ience'), so it fires on the lead-in piece rather than the word itself. Pushes toward 'science' and 'scientist' tokens.

L27n1849.name: 'cons' prefix of 'consider'
L27n1849.description: Fires on 'cons', 'Con' or 'P' starting a split word (cons|cription, cons|istent, Con|ception), most strongly on 'cons'. Pushes 'consider' tokens, and steered output spams 'Consider'.

L27n1385.name: Piece before an '-op'
L27n1385.description: The piece just before an 'op' ending in a split word (slo|ping, sto|op, Aes|op, countert|op, isot|opes, the SS in TSOP); pushes toward 'op' tokens.

L27n756.name: 'You' opening system prompts
L27n756.description: The word 'You' that opens a chat system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant'), pushing 'have' or 'has' next.

L27n671.name: Tech terms and 'helpful'
L27n671.description: Tech vocabulary (open-source, Google, SEO, PHP, SQL, VPN, GPU) and 'helpful' in the 'You are a helpful assistant' system prompt. Pushes toward tech acronyms like 'URL', 'API', 'JSON'.

L26n386.name: Chat turn boundary newline
L26n386.description: Goes negative on the newline right after a user turn's '<|im_end|>', just before the assistant header, plus chat-template tags such as '<think>' and 'assistant'. Writes no clear word; it pushes toward junk fragments like '_da' and 'eden'.

L27n1009.name: ALL-CAPS → caps pieces
L27n1009.description: Uppercase word-pieces inside ALL-CAPS text (D in DETERMINE, ING in SELF-HARMING, INESS in BUSINESS); pushes toward uppercase fragments such as 'SAM', 'CAM' and 'SPA'.

L25n943.name: Pre-adjective intensifier slot
L25n943.description: Fires on degree adverbs and modifiers right before an adjective ('extremely', 'increasingly', 'relatively', 'strangely', 'unlike', 'more', 'little'), and on 'No' in the constant 'no lists, no bullet points' system prompt. Pushes toward plain adjectives such as 'personal', 'manual' and 'static'.

L22n2374.name: Programming-language names → code
L22n2374.description: Fires on programming-language and markup names ('Pascal', 'HTML', 'Java', 'Python', 'Matlab', 'SQL', 'CSS') and on 'pseudo' in 'pseudocode'; also on the 'of' in 'a piece of text' prompts; pushes toward the word 'code'.

L25n1091.name: Computer and screen words
L25n1091.description: Computer and device words such as tablet, screen, display, laptop, desktop, smart home, monitor. Pushes toward 'PC', 'computer', 'monitor' and 'Mac'.

L22n2444.name: 'In other words' phrases
L22n2444.description: Fires on 'other' in 'In other words' rephrasing and on the digits of word-count targets, e.g. the '0' in 'at least 500 words'; pushes toward 'words' and 'word', and at +0.5 it repeats 'words were words'.

L23n1048.name: Program-spec output lead-in
L23n1048.description: In chat prompts asking for a program, fires on the connective or modal ('and', 'should', 'then', 'calculates') just before the program's output step. Pushes toward print, printing and output.

L24n1142.name: List-item numeral markers
L24n1142.description: Goes strongly negative on the number or letter that starts a numbered list item ('1' in '1. Encourage discourse', 'a' in 'a. Electric shock', '2' in '2. Start young'). Pushing it negative makes the model spam ')' brackets.

L16n899.name: CJK characters
L16n899.description: Fires on a CJK character (Chinese hanzi, Japanese kanji or kana, Korean hangul) inside a non-English sentence or heading, e.g. 勇 or 健康. Pushes the model toward CJK punctuation such as 、 。 （.

L27n362.name: URL host parts, dot-methods
L27n362.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece after 'http://' or after a dot in a web address ('www', 'projects', 'istas', 'afe' in staysafeonline). Steering it negative pushes the model toward dot-method names ('.bind', '.values', '.call'), with little spam and mostly coherent answers.

L19n1807.name: Since, even, until connectors
L19n1807.description: Fires negatively on time and extent connectors that open a clause, e.g. 'Since' in 'Since then', 'since' in 'ever since 1921', 'even' in 'even then', 'by' in 'out by the 8th week', 'until'; pushes toward 'then', and at -0.5 it repeats 'then'.

L25n1521.name: 'vector' and its components
L25n1521.description: Strongly negative on 'vector' or 'eigenvectors' in linear-algebra and field-theory text, plus some name fragments like 'in' in Mackinac; pushes 'components'.

L24n1201.name: Measurement numbers and units
L24n1201.description: Numbers and unit words inside a length, area or size spec: the last digit of a range or dimension ('3' in 0.2-0.3 in., '10' in 10 feet) and 'square' in '100 square feet'. Pushes the model toward metric length units like meters, cm and mm.

L24n2560.name: Breakage context; writes 'failure'
L24n2560.description: Goes negative on the word just before a damage or failure term in engineering text ('susceptible [to]' breakage, 'cause them [to] trip', 'safeguard them [against]', 'without [breaking]', 'when they [fail]', 'the [fuse]'); pushes toward 'failure'.

L24n2394.name: Feedback loop and cycle
L24n2394.description: Fires on words in a feedback or cycle phrase: 'feedback' in 'feedback loop', 'CY' in 'life cycle', and 'recirculating' or 'cause' in process descriptions. Pushes the model to write 'cycle' or 'loop'.

L26n2263.name: Medical word stems
L26n2263.description: Fires on the stem of a medical or scientific term split across tokens, just before its suffix: asympt- in asymptotes, Psycho- in psychotherapy, arrhythm- in arrhythmia, macrocyt- in macrocytic anemia, synd- in syndromes. At dose -0.5 it writes '-ose' into ordinary words.

L23n2933.name: Machine and body parts
L23n2933.description: Fires on a noun naming a machine or body part (automotive, motor, body, moving, machinery), often right after 'on the' or 'of'. Pushes the model toward 'parts' next.

L24n2749.name: Shape nouns: triangle, trapezoid
L24n2749.description: Fires on 'a' or 'of' right before a geometry shape name (a triangle, a trapezoid, a frustum, a convex polygon) and on pieces of shape words. Pushes the model toward 'triangle'.

L24n1607.name: Word before a setting
L24n1607.description: The word just before a configurable setting value ('white balance', 'heat oven to', 'over medium heat', 'proper settings'); pushes toward 'settings'/'setting'.

L25n2079.name: Bracket and enclosure wording
L25n2079.description: Fires on 'square' in 'square brackets' and on prepositions that introduce a container, e.g. 'enclosed in', 'in' before 'the Suggestions area' or 'the sidebar'. Pushes toward 'square'/'Br' (brackets), and steering repeats 'square'.

L26n1212.name: Digit before thousands comma
L26n1212.description: Fires on the digit right before a thousands comma in a large number (the 0 in 10,000 or 3,000, the 2 in 12,000), weaker on other digits of numbers above a thousand. Pushes toward ',' and pushed hard it spams commas.

L23n1746.name: Web pages, front-end code
L23n1746.description: Goes negative on web and front-end words: 'page' or 'pages' in web-page contexts, React, Vue, frontend, Facebook, and 'trouble' in 'having trouble'; pushes toward 'load'.

L23n364.name: Code-spec return predictor
L23n364.description: Fires on the 'and' or 'should' in coding-task prompts that sets up the output clause ('takes two strings [and] concatenates', 'function [should] return'), and on 'returns' itself; pushes the model toward writing 'return'.

L24n501.name: During before war eras
L24n501.description: Fires on 'during', 'of' or 'after' when it introduces a war or era, as in 'during World War II' and 'end of World War One'. Pushes the model to write 'World' next.

L1n1619.name: Zero digit in numbers
L1n1619.description: Fires negatively on a '0' digit inside a long number, such as 2,000, 100,000, 2020 or 20:00, mostly after a comma or a leading digit. Writes stray code tokens; when steered, output becomes runs of zeros.

L24n2140.name: Software and program nouns
L24n2140.description: Fires on the word right before a software noun in tool talk, such as 'editing' in 'photo editing software', 'free' before 'program', 'word processor', and 'open-source' before 'programming'. Pushes the model to write 'program' or 'software'.

L27n232.name: Place numbers and prepositions
L27n232.description: Leading digit of a number and 'in', 'on', 'to' or 'the' just before a place or measurement (1150 BC, 4th Avenue, 100 percent, in downtown New Orleans). Pushes toward 'city'.

L23n572.name: 'step' before 'size'
L23n572.description: Fires positively on 'step' in 'step size', 'step-by-step' and 'Step 1', and on 'batch' or 'margin' before a size noun. Pushes toward 'size' tokens, so steered output repeats 'size'.

L27n373.name: Non-English word pieces
L27n373.description: Fires on articles and word pieces inside non-English passages, e.g. Spanish 'la' after 'Banco Mundial analiza', German 'Welt', Polish 'ń', Japanese 'を'; pushes toward Portuguese and Spanish nouns like diferença, exemplo, acesso, senha.

L23n982.name: first/last ordinal words
L23n982.description: Fires on 'first', 'final' and 'last' and the 'and' or 'at' that sets them up ('first and second', 'as a last resort', 'at last'). Pushes the model toward 'last'.

L20n1662.name: German compound word pieces
L20n1662.description: Fires (negative) on inner subword pieces of German compound words and German place or person names: 'und' in Innbund, 'ere' in Osterei, 'Ost' in Osterbaum, 'ung' and 'zug' in Sommertagszug, 'tt' in Brunsbüttel. Pushes toward short 'ss' and 'sh' fragments.

L24n820.name: Health condition descriptors
L24n820.description: Fires on health-condition words: 'acute' or 'chronic' before increase, pain or condition, 'worsening', and body parts like 'lung', 'bone' or 'ear' in symptom lists; pushes toward 'condition'.

L27n2395.name: ALL-CAPS text
L27n2395.description: Fires on letters inside ALL-CAPS spans, especially screenplay headings (EXT., FADE IN) and caps titles; pushes toward uppercase fragments like CH, SH, SP.

L25n1364.name: Tech-stack link → node
L25n1364.description: Fires on 'and', 'using' or 'in' right after a programming tech name (Node.js, React, Flask, Gatsby, PHP) in coding-task prompts; pushes 'node' and 'Node' tokens.

L24n2139.name: Chemistry product/reaction lead-in
L24n2139.description: Chemistry-process words where 'product(s)' or 'reaction' comes next: 'is considered' a product, 'by' in byproduct, 'react', 'reaction', 'corrosion', 'oxidation'; pushes toward 'products'.

L26n887.name: Period in abbreviations
L26n887.description: Fires on the period inside an abbreviation (U.S., M.D., B.C., e.g., Ph.D., Jr., etc.); pushes a bare dot or bracket-then-dot token, so steering gives dot spam like '. . . .'.

L25n2240.name: Stems before '-ia' endings
L25n2240.description: The middle piece of a long technical or literary word just before its '-ia' ending, such as 'hythm' in arrhythmia, 'leg' in tetraplegia, 'lex' in dyslexia, 'alg' in nostalgia. Pushes toward 'ia', 'ie', 'ías'.

L23n716.name: 'that' in coding specs
L23n716.description: Fires on 'that' right after function, script or program in coding requests ('Write a JavaScript function that', 'Create a PHP script that'), and on 'error' in validation specs. Pushes the model toward 'check' and 'checks'.

L25n733.name: URL scheme 'https'
L25n733.description: Negative on the 'http' or 'https' token that opens a web address (e.g. 'curl https', 'https://www'); its output points to colon tokens such as '::' and ':'.

L26n860.name: Finance terms → fund/spend
L26n860.description: Fires on finance and loan vocabulary (APR, interest rate, World Bank, average rate of return, inflation, 'your' before 'interest rate'); pushes 'fund', 'funds', 'spend', 'spending' and 'funding'.

L27n380.name: Computing and tech names
L27n380.description: Fires inside software, OS and internet terms (Crypt- in cryptocurrency, Open- in OpenJDK, Fed- in Fedora, IPv in IPv2); pushes 'server' and 'Server'.

L25n1782.name: Earth-science terms (rock, soil)
L25n1782.description: Goes negative on geoscience and land-use nouns, like 'soil' in 'soil quality', 'rock' in 'rock mass', 'sediment' in 'sedimentary layers', and 'forest' or 'land cover' in ecology text; pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L27n2947.name: Initial F and Ph
L27n2947.description: Strongly negative on the letter F (and Ph or ph) opening a word or name, e.g. 'F' in Fossil, Ferrets, Ferry, Falmouth, Focusing, Fauvism; also 'ph' in phagocytes. Pushes toward 'filter'.

L19n2261.name: Rare-name mid-word fragments
L19n2261.description: Goes negative on a middle sub-token of a rare or foreign name split into pieces ('Sa|on', 'K|ana|t', 'Y|lam|', 'Dv|ur'); pushes toward short syllable pieces like 'ik' and 'ai'.

L27n212.name: Accusation and wrongdoing context
L27n212.description: Fires on words in accusation and crime text (accused, falsely, suspect, reportedly, crime, fatal, serious) and on the word after 'accused of'; pushes toward wrong, invalid and missing.

L25n158.name: Digits in large numbers
L25n158.description: Fires on a digit inside a large number such as a year, population, distance or scientific-notation exponent, strongest on the digit that sets the magnitude (the 0 in 10^8, the 9 in 1959). Pushes toward scale and unit words next: million, thousand, units.

L23n2598.name: Vertex and corner fragments
L23n2598.description: Fires on 'vert' or 'vertices' word fragments and on 'corner', 'facet' and 'neighboring', plus 'two sides' in polygon questions; some noise, such as 'ting' in tingling; pushes toward 'vertex'.

L22n1968.name: Before 'results' or 'findings'
L22n1968.description: Goes negative on the word before a study-results noun: the 's in 'the study's findings', 'these' before 'results' or 'figures', 'your' before 'data'; pushes toward 'results' and 'findings'.

L22n1720.name: Research lead-in commas
L22n1720.description: Fires on the comma that closes a news lead-in ('In a new study,', 'In the 1970s,', 'following a stroke,') and on 'by' or 'led by' before a research team, peaking there. Pushes the model to write 'scientists' and 'researchers'.

L26n1119.name: ALL-CAPS word fragments
L26n1119.description: Goes strongly negative on uppercase letter pieces inside words typed in all capitals: 'IND' in INDENTITY, 'CRE' in CREATOR, 'QUAL' in QUALITY, 'OURSE' in COURSE. Pushes toward uppercase word endings such as 'ORY', 'ERS' and 'ISION'.

L24n1809.name: Size and life-stage facts
L24n1809.description: Negative on the word before a size, weight or life-stage fact in natural-history and product text: 'can' before 'grow up to' or 'live up to', 'females' before 'are smaller', 'the' before 'size', 'weigh', 'which' before a description. Pushing it negative writes 'measure' repeatedly.

L14n178.name: Non-Latin script tokens
L14n178.description: Goes strongly negative on the first token of a CJK, Thai, Arabic, Cyrillic or Korean word embedded in English text (e.g. 勇, 健康, พระ, ابن), and weakly on full-width punctuation. Pushes the model to write CJK and full-width punctuation (，。；：).

L27n1328.name: URL domains; file extensions
L27n1328.description: Goes strongly negative on 'www' right after 'http://' or 'https://' and on the domain piece after a dot (e.g. 'hs' in dhs.gov, '.d' in a domain); pushes toward file-extension tokens such as .py, .php, .html and .js.

L27n305.name: Electronics numbers and terms
L27n305.description: Fires strongly negative inside technical voltage and circuit text, on digits inside numbers (the 2 and 0 in 2 0 0 ohm, the 6 in 4 6 V) and on pieces of circuit terms such as Res|istor and -up in pull-up. Going negative pushes toward device and devices.

L24n1892.name: Upper/lower before 'case'
L24n1892.description: Fires on 'upper' and 'lower' (also 'Upper' as a level label, 'ignore', 'ascending') in phrases like 'upper limit' or 'upper case'; pushes the model toward 'case'.

L23n1106.name: Programming language names
L23n1106.description: Programming and web-tech names in coding prompts, such as 'JavaScript', 'jQuery', 'TypeScript', 'PHP', 'JSON', 'Vue' and '.js' (negative); pushes toward 'object' and 'objects'.

L27n2083.name: Uppercase fragments in caps
L27n2083.description: An uppercase letter run inside an all-caps word, heading, or SQL keyword (GROUP BY, IMM|EDIATE, NORTH CAR|OLINA, WH|OLE, ECHINOC|OCCUS). Pushes toward uppercase fragments like 'CE', 'PE', 'SE'.

L25n2478.name: School and grade-level terms
L25n2478.description: Fires on education words, mostly 'school' in 'high school' and 'college', plus 'XII' and grade labels, and on the word right after them ('in' in 'majoring in', commas in academic lists). Pushes toward school subjects such as 'history'.

L27n1360.name: ALL-CAPS letter fragments
L27n1360.description: Fires on capital-letter pieces inside ALL-CAPS words and acronyms, mostly the second or later piece ('MESSENG|ER', 'CET|SHWAYO', 'IN|TELLIGENCE', 'CY|CLE', 'PO|C'); pushes toward more capital-letter pieces, especially 'E', so steering spams 'Eve'.

L24n948.name: Two-thing comparison contrasts
L24n948.description: Fires negative on 'vastly' in 'vastly different', 'two' in 'two parties' or 'two sets', 'almost' in 'almost exactly the same', and 'at' before 'different heights' or 'rates'. Pushes toward 'opposite', 'opposing' and 'adjacent'.

L27n315.name: Word before quoted title
L27n315.description: Fires on connectives and naming words that introduce a quoted name or title (and, or, called, titled, entitled, saying); pushes closing quote and paren marks.

L22n2919.name: Rate and prevalence statistics
L22n2919.description: Fires on the word naming a measured rate of an outcome in statistics sentences, such as 'rate' after 'birth' or 'fertility', and 'prevalence', 'case-fatality', 'crime', 'suicide' or 'unemployment'; pushes toward 'rate'.

L23n2765.name: Medical test terms
L23n2765.description: Fires on medical test and diagnosis words, such as the 'C' in 'A1C', 'lact', 'diagnostic', 'MRI', 'testing', 'HIV' and 'the test', and on 'perform' before a procedure; pushes toward 'test'.

L22n2217.name: SQL clause → SELECT
L22n2217.description: Fires in SQL syntax text on tokens just before a clause keyword or inside a clause list: '[' before HAVING, a line break before ORDER BY, and 'of', 'in', 'to' in SQL docs; pushes toward 'select' next, and steered text drifts to 'select' words.

L26n2101.name: Medical compound modifiers
L26n2101.description: Goes strongly negative on the modifier that opens a medical or technical compound, just before its head noun (hyper|methylation, odef|iciency, viral| loads, hyper|acusis, synd|romes, neonic|otinoid, AIDS|-prevention). Pushed negative it steers output toward 'activation' and 'activate'.

L23n2861.name: Return/back comeback verbs
L23n2861.description: Verbs of coming back or recovering, right before the 'return' sense ('returned to normal', 'seasonal flu returns', 'came back'); pushes toward 'return' tokens.

L25n2989.name: Marketing/promo document nouns
L25n2989.description: Fires on business and promotional document words: 'marketing' (Develop a marketing plan), 'advertising', 'press' (press releases), 'pamph' (pamphlets), 'presentation', 'documentation', 'Filing' (filing articles of incorporation). Pushes toward 'materials' (marketing materials); steered output is only mildly on-topic.

L27n669.name: Dot in initialisms, URLs
L27n669.description: The period glued to a capital letter inside an initialism, e.g. '.S' in 'U.S.', '.J' in 'J.J.', '.P' in 'U.P.', '.C' in 'D.C.', plus 'www' in web addresses. Pushes toward a dot before a code method name such as '.SetValue' and '.ToString'.

L22n1136.name: Qualifier before data type
L22n1136.description: Fires positive on the qualifier or article right before a data-type noun in coding specs: 'positive' before integer, 'list of' before integers or strings, 'an' before integer, 'a' before string. Pushes toward 'integer' and 'string'.

L27n2928.name: Word-initial letter c
L27n2928.description: Fires on the letter 'c' or 'C' that starts a word piece, especially after a hyphen ('-c' in anti-cancer, candle, protein-coding, aquacultured) or as a capital (CAGR, Catholicism). Pushes toward 'cache' tokens.

L27n782.name: Capitalized name-start fragments
L27n782.description: Fires on the capitalized first piece of a split proper noun or title (Po in Poop to Power, Y in Yuen, Bo in Boise, V in Vashon, B in Bering); pushes toward bare single capital letters like A, E, C, S.

L22n1300.name: Copula 'is' before 'empty'
L22n1300.description: The copula 'is' right after a subject noun in code or spec text: 'the stack is empty', 'if it is a valid URL'. Peak is on 'is' when 'empty' is the likely next word. Pushes toward 'empty'.

L23n973.name: And/or list joiners
