L23n973.description: Goes negative on 'and', 'or' or a comma joining two items in a list of alternatives, such as 'letters and numbers' or 'a letter or the underscore'. Pushes the model to write 'numbers'.

L20n1480.name: Enthusiastic reply openers
L20n1480.description: Goes strongly negative on the first word of an assistant reply after the empty think block, such as 'Certainly', 'Sure', 'Thanks', 'Yes' or 'Enjoy', peaking on 'Certainly' or 'Sure' before a comma. Pushes the model toward exclamation marks '!'.

L24n2817.name: And/or after web tech
L24n2817.description: The 'and', 'or' or 'with' right after a web-tech name ('HTML and CSS', 'CSS or', 'CSS (') where JavaScript or JS is likely next; pushes toward 'JS'.

L27n869.name: Word before past participle
L27n869.description: Fires on 'had', 'have', 'has', 've' or 'reportedly' right before a past participle or past verb ('had risen', 'have fully formed', 'had plagued', 'had swollen', 'has also resulted'); pushes toward participles 'named', 'ordered', 'labeled', 'structured'.

L24n2501.name: Policing and security words
L24n2501.description: Fires on the word just after or inside a police, law or security phrase, e.g. 'police' in 'efficient police force', 'law' and 'enforcement', 'detective', 'crime', and 'air' in 'air rifle' or 'Air Force'; pushes toward 'security' and 'safety'.

L26n2565.name: Medical condition terms
L26n2565.description: Negative on the first piece of a disease, disorder or health term (immun|odeficiency, hearing loss, arr|hythmia, Psycho, ASD, Inf, irre|parable). Writes 'path' and its forms, the pathology root; steering adds little visible change.

L22n1832.name: Pre-'row' quantifier slot
L22n1832.description: Quantifiers and verbs right before a database record noun ('maximum number of', 'all' in 'Select all', 'each' record, 'retrieves' data); pushes 'row' and 'rows'.

L23n1391.name: Database and source names
L23n1391.description: Goes negative on the word just before or inside a data-source name, such as 'National' in 'National Health Survey', 'a huge' before 'database', and 'Pub' and 'med' in PubMed. Pushes the model to write 'database'.

L22n2890.name: Email and contact context
L22n2890.description: Fires on the comma or preposition just before 'email' in contact-field lists ('first name, last name, email') and on 'by' or 'via' before a channel ('by email', 'send via', 'notifications', 'alerts'); pushes the model to write 'email'.

L21n842.name: Measurement abbreviations → value
L21n842.description: Fires on the abbreviation or symbol of a scientific or clinical measure ('MIC' in 'above the MIC', 'LD' in 'LD50', 'FR' in 'eGFR', 'K' in 'pKa', 'A1C'), mostly its later pieces; pushes toward 'value(s)'.

L26n2966.name: Bridge-like word pieces
L26n2966.description: Fires on the 'brid' or 'rid' piece that starts words ending in -ge or -ged (Bridgeton, Bridgestone, ridges, bridged, wedges, sponges, sieges); pushes toward the word-ending pieces 'get', 'ged', 'ges', 'ging', so steered text stutters 'getget'.

L25n2861.name: Adverse-effect adjectives
L25n2861.description: Fires negatively on the word just before 'effects', 'problems' or 'symptoms' that names an adverse outcome ('serious', 'severe', 'fatal', 'potential', 'common', 'cause'); pushes toward 'side'.

L27n1959.name: Noun before 'plan'
L27n1959.description: The architecture or layout word just before a likely 'plan' ('ground' level, 'Gothic', 'architectural', 'medieval', 'ship'); pushes toward 'plan'/'plans'.

L23n1237.name: Metric unit before squared
L23n1237.description: Fires on a metric length unit right before a superscript ² ('km' in 'km²', 'cm' in 'calories/cm²', 'mm' in 'mm²', 'kilometres') and on 'perfect' in 'perfect square'; pushes toward 'square'.

L27n641.name: Foreign-name fragments: á
L27n641.description: Pieces of split Spanish, Hungarian and French proper names (Cer|da, Man|uel, Sán|dor, Guimar|ães); pushes the model toward accented vowels á and í.

L23n2634.name: Formula symbol → 'pi'
L23n2634.description: Fires on '=' and math symbols (½, ×, %, ^) and on the digit after them in formulas and code assignments: 't = 1', 'Ne^2', 'r = 200', '½ inch', 'ydot = -10*y %'. Pushes toward 'pi' and 'PI'.

L27n592.name: Medical condition terms
L27n592.description: Goes strongly negative on disease, condition and symptom words (blood clots, hematoma, chronic asthma, deficiency, circulation problems). Pushes toward 'error' and 'disease' tokens.

L23n1133.name: Data import/export verbs
L23n1133.description: Fires on verbs and nouns for moving data in or out of a file or tool (copy, export, import, upload, Excel, SQL), peaking on the word just before the target such as 'into' or 'to'. Pushes the model toward the word 'import'.

L25n2977.name: Connective before tool names
L25n2977.description: Fires on the word just before a software tool, skill or framework name in tech and job-posting text ('with' in familiarity with, 'using' before Gatsby, 'and' in XP and Scrum, 'on' in focus on), and on the first letter of such names (G of Gatsby, As of Asana). Pushes toward 'version' tokens.

L22n904.name: Estimates and rough figures
L22n904.description: Fires on words that introduce an approximate or sourced figure: 'rough', 'approximately', 'estimated', 'According to', and the 'to' after 'According'. Pushes 'estimate' and 'calculation'.

L27n2545.name: ALL-CAPS word onsets
L27n2545.description: Fires on the first piece of an ALL-CAPS word or heading (BUSINESS WIRE, LIMITED APPROACH, OTHER SETS, SELLER, DEVIL'S, EXT. ART), and on word-stem pieces like 'underst' in understudied. Pushes toward uppercase HTTP verbs (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE).

L22n557.name: Size and degree lead-in
L22n557.description: Fires on 'in' (or a degree adjective like 'moderate') right before a size or severity noun, e.g. 'range in severity', 'small in stature', '6 km in length'; pushes the model toward 'length' and 'size'.

L27n225.name: Capital letter name starts
L27n225.description: Fires on a single capital letter or acronym start that begins a proper noun, such as M in Matisse, H in Hellenistic, E in EPA, D in D&D, or G in Glee; pushes toward uppercase letters.

L27n1862.name: Word-start P/p fragments
L27n1862.description: Fires on a word-initial 'P' or 'p' token, often in split words (P in Polar, Puma, Pomeranian; p in patted, puzzle, pita); pushes toward 'pack/package' tokens.

L27n805.name: First word of term
L27n805.description: Fires on the first word of a two-word term or proper name, before its head (e.g. 'Computer' in Computer Networks, 'Search' in Search Engine, 'Human' in Human Rights, 'Hiro' in Hiroshima); pushes capitalized word starts like 'St', 'Cl', 'Gr'.

L20n1453.name: Exclamation after headline words
L20n1453.description: Fires on the emphatic word that ends a headline or call-to-action ('Now', 'Wow', 'Coming', 'Read More', 'Vote') in promotional text. Pushes the model toward '!' and markdown image starts.

L22n492.name: Table field label
L22n492.description: Strongly negative on the label word that heads a field or column in a pipe-delimited table, just before the '||' or '|' separator: 'Rank' in '|Rank||', 'Address', 'Owner', 'Presenter', 'Location', 'View', 'Atomic Weight', 'Type'. Weaker on the ';' and '.' that end a code line or sentence. Steered, it writes blank spaces, nothing decodable.

L24n654.name: Metadata and page-label fields
L24n654.description: Fires on metadata and web-boilerplate field labels: 'PDF' in 'Download eBook | PDF', 'Copyright', 'Location', 'Publication Series', 'Source', 'LC Control Number', and 'http'. Pushes toward 'address', 'URL', 'number', and 'uuid'.

L27n1344.name: M-initial word starts, map
L27n1344.description: Goes strongly negative on capital or lowercase 'M/m' starting a word split into tokens (Mackerel, Mussels, Mining, Mamba, Mounds), with weaker hits on 'treasure' and 'sweet'. Pushes toward 'map/maps'; strong steering spams 'map'.

L25n1629.name: Percent and rate numbers
L25n1629.description: The number or 'Annual' right before a percent sign or rate term ('6.5%', '11%', 'Annual Percentage Rates'); pushes toward '%'.

L26n1754.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L26n1754.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens (hou in Mabhouh, act in monobactams, apt in Diphyllobothrium, roph in neutrophils); pushes toward 'rem' and 'em' fragments, so steered output becomes 'remembrance' spam.

L23n1890.name: Roman and regnal numerals
L23n1890.description: Roman numerals and regnal or ordinal numbers, such as the 'X' in Alfonso X, 'ii' in Rhetoric ii, 'XII' and 'Vol. VII' (negative); pushes toward Roman numerals like 'VI', 'IX' and 'iv'.

L26n1745.name: Identity and group terms
L26n1745.description: Strongly negative on identity and group-label words: LGBT, gay, racial, ethnic, gender, race, national identity, and phrases like 'identified as' or 'no longer identify'. Pushes toward 'identify' and 'identified'.

L24n2335.name: URL and citation identifiers
L24n2335.description: fires on digits, IDs and author names inside URLs, citations and reference metadata ('?p=1446...', 'NewsID=1885 0', 'Cuenca, C.'); pushes toward '&', the URL and HTML ampersand.

L25n2565.name: Medical adjective before condition
L25n2565.description: Fires on a medical or mental-health adjective right before a disorder or condition noun: 'psychiatric' in psychiatric illness, 'mental' in mental health, 'developmental', 'medical', 'serious' before condition. Pushes toward 'condition(s)' next.

L27n1892.name: Word before 'box'
L27n1892.description: Fires on the word right before a likely 'box' (junction, sand, ticket, enclosed, fuse, lighting); pushes 'box' and 'boxes'.

L26n2811.name: Face and feature words
L26n2811.description: Goes strongly negative on words describing the face, eyes and skin (eyelids, facial, pale, dark brown, nose, redness, darker, steely), mostly on the descriptor in an appearance description; pushes toward 'features', 'feature', 'countenance' and 'count'.

L23n1084.name: IT/software terms; writes 'log'
L23n1084.description: Fires on software and IT-admin words (error in 'error cases', Access in 'Restrict server access', console, read, Chrome, Apache, VPN, alerts) and on 'should' or 'also' in such specs; pushes toward 'log' and 'logging'.

L25n1526.name: Word before importance adjective
L25n1526.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'important' or 'significant' adjective: 'it' in 'why is it important', 'is' in 'is significant', 'more' in 'even more important', plus 'particularly' and 'historically'. Pushes toward 'sign' and 'significant'.

L25n2530.name: Lab liquid nouns
L25n2530.description: Fires on the article or preposition right before a liquid, mixture or vessel noun in lab and household text ('a solution', 'a suspension', 'the bottle', 'the buffer'), plus words like rinse and buffer. Pushes toward 'solution'; at dose 0.5 it repeats 'solution'.

L23n1259.name: Input/output prepositions
L23n1259.description: Fires on the preposition or article right after an input or output verb in coding prompts ('from the user', 'as input', 'on' in 'display on'). Pushes the model toward 'print' and 'console'.

L24n2408.name: Incentive and program schemes
L24n2408.description: Goes strongly negative on 'referral', 'incentive', 'affiliate', 'voluntary' and 'cap-and-trade', and on 'program' in scheme-style names; pushes toward 'program'.

L26n2180.name: Mid-word subword pieces
L26n2180.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a word split into tokens, mostly medical terms and names (arr|yth|mia, Mah|al, hypopar|athy|roidism, Di|ets). Pushes toward 'dist' fragments; steering spams 'Dist'.

L23n1020.name: Handling verbs before objects
L23n1020.description: Fires on the verb or modifier right before a physical object or body noun, e.g. 'pick up' a weight, 'grip' a slipper, 'manipulate' objects, or 'celestial' bodies; pushes toward 'object' and 'objects'.

L24n1261.name: Log/reference book nouns
L24n1261.description: Fires on the noun naming a written record or reference book: 'journal' (journal entry), 'diary', 'dictionary', 'routing' (routing table), 'bibliography', 'Cited' in a works-cited list. Pushes toward 'entry' and 'entries'.

L24n1518.name: Spending effort and resources
L24n1518.description: Goes strongly negative on 'of' after 'amount', 'lot' or 'a little bit', and on spend, focus or devote words before a resource or effort noun ('amount of resources', 'devote their energies', 'spend a lot of time'). Pushes toward 'energy' and 'resource'.

L23n2112.name: Data-structure name before 'stack'
L23n2112.description: Goes negative on the word just before a data-structure or algorithm name in coding prompts ('stack', 'binary', 'singly', 'using'); pushes the model to write 'stack'.

L26n2231.name: Quantity before measured amount
L26n2231.description: Fires on a number or 'a few' right before a measure in recipes and home remedies ('add 1/4 cup', 'add 1 cup', '5/50 mixture'). Pushes toward the unit 'drop' and 'drops', and steering spams 'drop drop'.

L26n293.name: Math and code symbols
L26n293.description: Fires (negative) on symbols inside formulas, code and abbreviations: hex digits in 0x82, the ∂ in ∂A, the o in ApoE, the comma between function arguments (t, y), and the dot in F.D.R. or M.D. Pushes toward uppercase code-like tokens such as AA, MA and IME; steering gives no clear effect.

L24n1170.name: Before min/max/average
L24n1170.description: Goes negative on the word before an extreme or average value, mostly temperature: 'annual' before average temperature, 'the' before max or min, 'global' before temperature, 'long-term' before average; pushes toward 'min' and 'max'.

L24n2055.name: Unchanged-state words
L24n2055.description: Fires on words that say a quantity stayed put, such as 'remained', 'steadily', 'remarkably', 'relatively' and 'about the same', plus 'at' and name fragments in split names (Alon|zo, Hon|k); pushes toward 'constant'.

L27n1357.name: Mid-word 'c' fragment
L27n1357.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'oc' piece split inside a longer word or hyphenated compound, just before the word continues (anti-|cancer, radi-oc|arbon, E-c|igs, mening-oc|occal); pushes output toward 'col' tokens.

L24n1725.name: Prime and apostrophe marks
L24n1725.description: Prime and apostrophe-like marks: the prime after a variable or digit (x′, 3′) and the ʾ in transliterated Arabic names; also 'sa' in Siberia's IPA; pushes toward apostrophe tokens.

L21n3025.name: Email username before @
L21n3025.description: Fires negatively on the username part of an email address ('info', 'firstname', '.lastname', 'contact', 'chris') and on the token just before '@'. Pushes toward '@' tokens; steered output shows brackets instead.

L24n1909.name: 'cal' word-start fragments
L24n1909.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'cal' piece that starts words such as 'calibrate', 'calculus', 'calculate', 'Calabasas' and 'Caliphate', and on numerical or formula context; pushes toward 'calculate'.

L20n1620.name: question end to blank
L20n1620.description: Fires on the '?' that ends a question or instruction ('Why is blue light bad for the eyes?'), and on ':' or '.' ending a prompt line before an answer; pushes toward '_' blank tokens, and steered text spams underscores.

L0n9.name: Closing </think> tag
L0n9.description: Fires on the '</think>' token that closes the empty think block at the start of a chat assistant reply (peak 10; the opening '<think>' about 5). Weak on other closing delimiters. Steered, it pushes closing brackets: full-width '）' and '）。' and ')'.

L23n577.name: Period before line break
L23n577.description: Fires negatively on a sentence-final period, or ! and ?, right before a newline at the end of a web paragraph. Pushes toward closing quotes and triple quotes, which appear when steered.

L27n1879.name: Mid-word capitals in acronyms
L27n1879.description: The middle uppercase piece of an all-caps word or acronym, e.g. I|EL|A, D|ETER|MINE, HOT|BOX, BUS|INESS, GV|WR; pushes toward more uppercase fragments like 'TL', 'NST', 'TY'.

L24n2941.name: Position words upper/lower/second
L24n2941.description: Position words right before a body part or ordinal ('upper limb', 'lower back', 'second half', 'Second Temple'); pushes toward 'half'.

L25n2336.name: IT and management systems
L25n2336.description: Fires on the second word of IT and business system names, e.g. 'management' in content management, 'ing' in ticketing system, plus 'software', 'automated' and 'web-based' in software text. Pushes toward 'system'.

L25n2934.name: Device and instrument nouns
L25n2934.description: Fires (goes negative) on the second half of a technical noun compound for a device or instrument, such as 'ography' in electromyography, 'utron' in neutron, 'electronic' and '-cigaret' in e-cigarettes, and 'propulsion'. Pushes toward 'device' tokens.

L26n614.name: Person-name opener fragments
L26n614.description: Goes negative on the split-off piece of a person's name (En in Enola, oko in Yoko, Ben in Benito, uda in Yehuda), mainly first names; pushes toward male given names such as Charles, William and Thomas.

L22n1430.name: Size and dimension terms
L22n1430.description: Dimension and size words such as 'width', 'canvas', 'rectangle', 'inches', 'metres', and the 'x' in 800x600 or 24x36 (negative); pushes toward 'width' and 'Width'.

L25n1823.name: Fact and check words
L25n1823.description: Fires negative on words in quiz, worksheet and fact-check text: 'Fact' in Chronic Fatigue - Fact versus Fiction, 'self' in self-checking answer cards, 'grammar' in workbook titles, 'guessing' in games, plus 'Quiz' and 'Quick'. Pushes toward 'check', 'checked' and 'checking'.

L26n1808.name: Literary and poetic devices
L26n1808.description: Fires on 'literary', 'poetic' and 'rhyme' in writing-craft text (literary technique, poetic language, rhyme scheme), and on syllable and figurative-language words. Pushes toward 'device' and 'devices'.

L27n1574.name: Diacritics and IPA glyphs
L27n1574.description: Non-ASCII transliteration pieces: IPA symbols (ɪ, ə, ˈ), diacritic letters in Arabic and Sanskrit names (ḥ, ā, ʾ), and accented Latin letters in names (č, ć); pushes toward accented capitals like Č, Ā, Ī.

L26n302.name: Closing punctuation before breaks
L26n302.description: Fires on punctuation that closes a unit: a colon or newline before a quoted or listed item, a closing quote after '?' or '.', and a bar or closing bracket at a label boundary; pushes toward closing quote marks, with little visible steered effect.

L27n323.name: Uppercase word-start fragments
L27n323.description: Fires on a bare capital or 1-3 letter uppercase token that opens a word or name split across tokens, mostly in ALL-CAPS headings or after a capitalized name (the 'E' in 'OF E|CHINOCOCCUS', 'F' in 'Masato F|uruhashi'). Pushes toward uppercase word-continuation pieces like IC, DR, CE.

L26n1080.name: Place-name opening piece
L26n1080.description: Fires negative on the first token of a place or proper name whose next token completes it: 'Cape' in Cape Town, Cape Canaveral and Cape Wildlife; 'Cal' in Calvary and Calle; 'Anch' in Anchorage; 'Nan' in Nanaimo; 'Ang' in Angolan. Pushes toward 'above' and 'below'.

L25n2158.name: 'That' before result clause
L25n2158.description: Fires negative on the word right after a noun that opens a relative or result clause: 'that' in a substance that results, a tumor that affects, shortness of breath that. Also on 'will', 'may' and 'instead' before an outcome verb ('will grow', 'may instead originate'). Pushes toward 'result' and 'results'.

L23n1951.name: Modifiers before customer nouns
L23n1951.description: Fires on the adjective or possessive just before a customer, client or audience noun in business and marketing text, e.g. 'its' in 'help its clients', 'their' in 'their target audience', 'prospective' and 'potential' before clients or customers; pushes toward 'client' and 'customers'.

L24n2635.name: Plant, shrub, fruit names
L24n2635.description: Fires positive on botanical words for shrubs, trees, fruits and plant parts, often mid-word in Latin or species names (mangosteen, Cassia, carob, rhizobium, shrub, small tree). Pushes toward 'root'.

L27n897.name: Mid-name subword fragments
L27n897.description: A middle piece of a word split into 3+ tokens, mostly foreign or Romance names (Arn|ol|fo, Filad|elf|ia, Star|ce|vo, Al|fon|so, Gyn|oecium); pushes toward '-io' endings.

L24n1561.name: School and maker projects
L24n1561.description: Goes negative on project nouns in maker and classroom text, such as 'Pi' in 'Raspberry Pi', 'project' in 'science fair project', and 'Arduino', 'DIY' or 'art'. Pushes the model to write 'project'.

L24n2673.name: Movement along a route
L24n2673.description: Fires on words of travel along a course: 'migration', 'flight', 'fly', 'along' in 'along the way', and 'trajectories', peaking on the word before the object (e.g. 'flight' in 'flight trajectories'). Pushes the model to output 'path' and 'route' tokens.

L24n2277.name: Connectives before practice
L24n2277.description: Fires negative on the connective ('into', 'in', 'and', 'with') just before a 'practice' or 'practical' phrase, e.g. 'put into practice', 'in practical terms', 'theory and practice'. Pushes toward 'practice'.

L26n130.name: Punctuation inside numbers
L26n130.description: Goes negative on a decimal point, comma or hyphen inside a number or a name, e.g. '14[.]5oz', '31[.]7 m', '10[,]575', '2[.]36 in', 'Merriam[-]Webster'; writes ending periods and quote marks, and steering makes the model output a column of periods.

L24n248.name: Capital letter starting name
L24n248.description: Fires on the capital letter that begins a proper name mid-sentence, peaking on that single initial before the rest of the name is written: the 'M' in 'Macclesfield', 'N' in 'Natan', 'S' in 'Saphari', 'D' in 'D J Garland'. Pushes toward a name, e.g. steering produced 'Emma'.

L25n2873.name: Organisation and meeting words
L25n2873.description: Fires negatively on the second word of organisation and society names (stake-holder, Philharmonic Society, Medical Association, Safety Council, Academy); pushed negative, it spams 'meeting'.

L23n887.name: 'be/to' before 'address'
L23n887.description: Goes strongly negative on 'be', 'to', 'been' or 'being' just before a verb of tackling a need ('must be filled', 'to surmount', 'to mitigate', 'had been eliminated'). Pushes the model toward 'address' and 'addresses'.

L25n2791.name: Cost/fee nouns, predicts cover
L25n2791.description: Cost, fee and proceeds nouns (cost-effective, cost of goods, fees, revenues) and 'to' after ability or time phrases in finance text; pushes the model toward writing 'cover', as in cover costs.

L23n2225.name: Sampling and selection verbs
L23n2225.description: Fires negatively on words for choosing a subset: 'picks', 'drawn from', 'taken', 'divided', 'chose', 'sample', 'surveyed adults'. Pushes toward 'random', which repeats when steered.

L22n1639.name: Field or column name
L22n1639.description: Fires negatively on the name of a data field, column or form box, such as 'State' column, 'Name' text box, 'Date', 'Subject' or 'citation'. Pushes toward 'column' tokens, which repeat when steered.

L20n892.name: Word before closing quote
L20n892.description: The final word inside a quotation or parenthesis, right before the closing quote or bracket ('work' in '...to work.'); pushes closing quote and bracket tokens such as ”), **) and 》.

L23n2810.name: Before detect or diagnose
L23n2810.description: Fires on the word right before a detection or diagnosis verb: 'early' in 'early detection', 'can' in 'can help doctors', 'reliably' before 'detect', 'be' in 'be diagnosed', and 'und' in 'undetectable'. Pushes toward 'detect', 'detection', and 'catch'.

L27n536.name: Organisation/place name start
L27n536.description: Fires on the first token of an organisation, place or group name, e.g. 'UN' in UNICEF, 'Tel' in Tel Aviv, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'CDC', 'HIV' in HIV sufferers. Pushes toward country names (China, India, Italy), so steered output is 'India India'.

L22n2243.name: Newline before markdown headers
L22n2243.description: Goes strongly negative on the line break or colon right after a heading or sentence end, especially inside think blocks and before a section body. Pushes the model to write '##' markdown headers.

L25n132.name: URL/code fragment → hyphen-suffix
L25n132.description: Fires on a word piece inside a URL, filename, code identifier or transliterated word, especially the token just before a dot or hyphen break (e.g. 'ol' in nuts-and-bolts, 'oph' in Pseudophodes, '-doc' in a PDF name, 's' in password.google, 'style' in a URL). Pushes the model toward hyphen-joined suffixes like '-of', '-type', '-object'; when steered it produces hyphenated compounds such as 'nature-owning'.

L26n2847.name: Research-paper framing words
L26n2847.description: Academic framing words right before a study's object noun (several significant| gaps, Empirical and| clinical, Research| ), predicting 'method'; pushes toward 'method' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L25n604.name: Word end before quote
L25n604.description: Fires on the last piece of a word or phrase just before a closing quotation mark (‘majestic’, ‘hematoma’, ‘composed’, ‘superstitions’, ‘perfection’); pushes toward closing quote marks ’ and ”.

L27n1714.name: All-caps letter fragments
L27n1714.description: Goes negative on uppercase letter pieces inside all-caps headlines, names or brands, e.g. 'Z' and 'UL' in 'ZULU', 'ON' in 'BRCO', 'SHER' in 'SHERLOCK'; pushes toward NULL/TRUE/FALSE tokens.

L26n2499.name: Air, jet, stream words
L26n2499.description: Fires on the start of flow and air words split into tokens (jet in jet streams, air in air performance curves, Gulf before Stream, Therm in Thermopylae); pushes toward 'stream' and 'streams'.

L24n1473.name: File-reading code context
L24n1473.description: Fires in file and data-loading code, on 'pd' in 'pd.read_csv', 'dataset', 'MATLAB' and 'that'/'to' after a file or script noun; pushes 'read', 'reads' and 'load'.

L24n535.name: Comma/and after input
L24n535.description: Goes negative on the comma or 'and' that follows an input description in coding prompts ('a list of filenames separated by spaces,', 'a text file and'). This is where the processing step is about to be named. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'split'.

L27n784.name: Proper-name continuations
L27n784.description: Strongly positive on a middle or late piece of a place or person name split into tokens, e.g. 't' in Get-t-ysburg, 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Carm' in Carmarthen, 'Ash' in Ash'ari. Pushes toward surnames such as Smith, Jones, Miller and Taylor.

L25n907.name: Language-letter C/F, hash output
L25n907.description: Goes negative on the single letter C or F that names a programming language or starts a word (C|++, C|#, F|#, c|umin, c|aramels, f|eta, g|ators); pushes toward '#' tokens.

L24n523.name: 'by' in change amounts
L24n523.description: Negative on 'by' after change verbs that give a size of change ('cut ... by', 'reduce ... by', 'off by', 'by a variety'), and on 'a' after 'multiply by'. Pushes toward 'factor'.

L27n1224.name: Unicode symbols and mojibake
L27n1224.description: Fires on unusual Unicode symbols inside plain text: superscript digits (¹⁴C), fractions (⅔), mojibake like Â and Ç, and marks like °; pushes toward §, ¶, «, » and °C.

L27n1110.name: Word before past participle
L27n1110.description: Goes strongly negative on the word right before a past participle or passive, e.g. 'be' in 'may be taken', 'heavily' in 'heavily armoured', 'specially' and 'poorly', 'un' in unpasteurized. Pushes toward participles like 'lost' and 'sent'.

L27n594.name: IPA symbols, Greek-letter writer
L27n594.description: Fires on IPA and pronunciation symbols (ɪ, ˈ, ə) and romanized foreign-word pieces inside brackets or transliterations; pushes the next token toward Greek letters like alpha, lambda and gamma.

L26n3009.name: Disease and virus names
L26n3009.description: Fires on the disease or virus name inside medical text: 'HIV' in HIV-positive or HIV-negative, 'Corona' and '19' in COVID-19, 'Zika', 'rabies', 'CF', 'BRCA', and 'test' before 'positive'. Pushes toward 'positive' and 'negative'.

L24n2421.name: Verb stem before suffix
L24n2421.description: goes strongly negative on the start of a verb or word split before its suffix, most often 'Sum' in 'Summarize' prompts and stems like 'program|med', 'scram|bled'; pushes toward suffix pieces '-med', '-mer', '-ming'.

L27n1411.name: Bare 't' word-opener
L27n1411.description: Negative on a bare 't' or 'T' token that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. 'for t|ummy time', 'a personal countert|op', 'flat-t|opped'. Pushes toward 'top', the 't' plus 'op' completion; steered output spams 'top'.

L25n3007.name: Zero-padded digits
L25n3007.description: Fires negatively on the leading '0' of times, dates and numbers ('(03:14)', '1:34 AM', '2021-04', '07th June'), with weaker hits on 'U.S.' and 'skit'; pushed negative, it spams digits.

L27n1295.name: Slot before past participle
L27n1295.description: Fires on the word just before an expected verb or past participle, mostly adverbs and auxiliaries: 'never' before 'been seen', 'still' before 'played', 'previously' before 'been denied', 'be' in 'should not be used'. Pushes toward 'generated', 'created', 'caused' and similar participles.

L27n985.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L27n985.description: The 'to' that opens an infinitive ('starts to bubble', 'tend to fall', 'needed to rest') and the 'who' before a bare verb, plus some 'bl' word starts; pushes toward 'store' tokens, and steered output spams 'store'.

L27n93.name: Verbs of giving, names
L27n93.description: Fires on give, gave, given, giving and similar verbs of transfer (e.g. 'gave' in 'gave me some very good ideas'); pushes toward person names like Bob, Carol, Arnold.

L24n594.name: Article before array/list
L24n594.description: Goes strongly negative on the article or 'of' just before a collection noun in coding prompts ('stores them in an array', 'a list of integers', 'sorts'). Pushing it negative makes the model repeat 'list'.

L25n2028.name: Audio and video context
L25n2028.description: Fires on the word inside a sound, music or video phrase ('loud| noises', 'Radio| plays', 'TV| screen', 'the| video', 'music| was'). Pushes the model toward 'volume' tokens.

L26n1959.name: Gender and sex terms
L26n1959.description: Goes negative on gender and sexuality words (gender, gendered, sexual, sexually, Sex) and on social-label words such as victim, demonize, idolize and self-advocacy, in text about discrimination and stereotypes. Pushes toward 'object' and 'objectification'.

L26n1627.name: Word before house/company
L26n1627.description: Goes positive on the modifier word right before a building or business noun (steak|house, clearing|house, publishing company, thrift store, tea plantation). Writes 'house'/'House'; steering spams 'House'.

L24n341.name: Data fields and records
L24n341.description: Negative on verbs and determiners that introduce records or fields in data-processing text: 'retrieves', 'extracts', 'the following' before a field list, 'each' before a record, and 'with' in 'a database with three tables'. Pushing it negative writes 'field' and 'fields'.

L27n1457.name: Word piece before 'os'
L27n1457.description: Goes negative on a word fragment that sits just before an 'os'/'osis'/'osy' ending in a split scientific word: 'cre' in cre|vasse, 'doc' in doc|osahexaenoic, 'N' in PDD-N|OS, 'symb' in symb|iosis, 'rh' in rh|osis. Pushed negative, it writes 'os'/'OS' and spams it.

L25n635.name: Name-internal word fragments
L25n635.description: Fires on a non-initial piece of a person or place name split into tokens (Masato, Miyamoto, Dorset, Yoko, Kubayi-Ngubane); pushes output toward 'name', 'names' and 'named'.

L27n820.name: Surname and place fragments
L27n820.description: Negative pole. Fires on the first or second piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (Sar|acen, Pis|ano, Be|cciu, St|amps, Ste|hn, Far|ah, Cropl|ey). Pushes toward 'name' and 'names'; steered, it spams 'Name name'.

L25n2133.name: Food and customer nouns
L25n2133.description: Food, shopping and customer nouns such as pizza, supermarket, lunch, beer, coffee, cake, customer, firing on the noun and the word right after the lead-in. Pushes toward 'order' and 'orders'.

L23n2144.name: Data-structure nouns, pointers
L23n2144.description: Fires on data-structure nouns in coding prompts ('array', 'node', 'string', 'matrix', 'list'). Pushes the model toward 'pointer' and 'ptr' tokens.

L19n3020.name: Clause-linking 'as' and 'and'
L19n3020.description: The conjunction 'as' or 'and' that opens or joins a clause giving a result or reason ('as a result', 'as soon as', 'and we can't fully process', 'and not an every day occurrence'), plus 'That is to say'. Pushes the model toward 'therefore', 'thus' and 'hence'.

L27n288.name: Start of proper names
L27n288.description: The first piece of a capitalised name or acronym split across tokens, such as 'Sal' in 'Salazar', 'V' in 'Vespasian', 'H' in 'HIV', 'Vul' in 'Vulframni'. Pushes toward a bare capital 'S' token.

L23n2507.name: Word before range
L23n2507.description: Fires on the word right before an expected 'range' in measurement or spread text ('wide wavelength range', 'within the target range', 'can range from', 'visible range'), also on 'temperature' and '%' in value contexts; pushes toward 'range'.

L25n2432.name: Turn verbs, state change
L25n2432.description: Fires on 'turn', 'turned' or 'turning' describing a colour or state change ('leaves have turned yellow', 'skin turning white'), and on the word before it ('have', 'to' in 'appears to be losing'). Pushes toward 'turn' word forms.

L25n2406.name: Health-care provider context
L25n2406.description: The word 'care' in 'health care provider' or 'health care worker', plus the words just before it (frontline, 'consult your health'), in medical and clinical text; pushes toward 'health'.

L24n2090.name: Cluster/gather word starts
L24n2090.description: Word-start pieces of 'cluster' and 'gather' ('cl' in clots, 'con' in conglomeration), and 'to' before a verb of forming or collecting ('clots to form', 'tend to'); pushes toward 'cluster'/'gather'.

L27n576.name: Foreign name fragments
L27n576.description: Fires on the first piece of a transliterated foreign name, mostly Chinese, Indic, or Japanese (Beng|a, Jing, Ming, Nagara); pushes toward 'ak' and language names like Japanese and Korean.

L25n2128.name: Health-system nouns → 'access'
L25n2128.description: Fires on 'health', 'healthcare' and 'Medicare' in health-system or insurance text, like 'healthcare' in 'healthcare system' or 'Health Insurance Marketplace', and pushes toward 'access'.

L25n2403.name: Access rights, strict security
L25n2403.description: Goes negative on words of strictness or access control in security and login text, e.g. 'explicit' boundaries, 'Strict'ly, 'stricter' partitioning, 'compromised', 'customizable' user profiles; pushes toward 'rights' and 'access' tokens.

L22n1337.name: Court-case and proper names
L22n1337.description: Fires on the name token of court cases and proper names: 'Jones' in 'Jones I' or 'Jones v. City', 'Virginia' in 'West Virginia State Board', and 'USA' in 'e.g. USA'. Pushes toward 'vs' and 'versus'.

L27n197.name: Inside author-year citations
L27n197.description: Commas and '&' inside author-year citations such as '(Marcus, Forsyth, Stone ... & Blair 2000)', peaking on the comma after a name; pushes the model to write closing ')' tokens.

L24n1091.name: HTML and code markup
L24n1091.description: Goes negative on code and markup tokens: 'include' after '#', 'canvas' and 'element' in HTML text, and 'upgrade' in shell flags. Pushes the model to write an opening '<' tag, as in '<canvas>'.

L26n2624.name: Split-word opening fragment
L26n2624.description: Fires on the short first piece of a longer word split into tokens: 'bro' in brochures, 'm' in mugs, mucus and masher, 'Mel' in melatonin, 'Coll' in collagen, 'clim' in climatic, 'confl' in confluent, and 'U' in U.S. Pushes toward 'micro' and 'macro'.

L26n2739.name: Sound and hearing words
L26n2739.description: Goes strongly negative on sound- and hearing-related words: 'T' in tinnitus, 'will' in an alarm will sound, 'music' in a song, 'clapping', 'microphone', 'noises', 'buzz or ring'. Pushes toward 'play' and 'playing'.

L27n918.name: Rare-word mid-pieces
L27n918.description: Fires on a later piece of a long or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'ac' in halicacabum, 'ic' in penicillins, 'orp' in scorpions; pushes the model toward word-start 'inf/Inf/inv/inc' fragments.

L24n2980.name: Page/word count digits
L24n2980.description: goes strongly negative on the number giving a count, length or size in page, word-count and spec text ('no less than 8 pages', '1000 words', 'Pagination 59 p.'); pushes toward 'page' tokens.

L23n1637.name: Homepage and URL tokens
L23n1637.description: Negative pole: fires on web-address and site-nav tokens such as 'http', '://', '.com', '.gov', 'https', and words like 'homepage' and 'portfolio', plus the word right before them. Pushing it negative writes 'index' (the default home page file) and steers text toward 'index'.

L24n2406.name: Zero before hex 'x'
L24n2406.description: Strongly negative on the '0' of a hex literal before 'x' ('P0 = 0xA4': the '0' peaks at 10, other digits in hex lines 8 to 9), with weaker hits on name syllables like 'Hum' in 'humane' and 'Rad' in 'Radley'. Steered, it pushes 'x' (logit lens: 'x', 'xc', 'xC'); steered output is a repeated 'x'.

L25n2011.name: Comparative 'further'/'better' words
L25n2011.description: Fires on comparative or continuation words that open a phrase: 'Further' (further information, further excavations), 'Better' (Better hedge shears), 'Worse', 'harder', 'step further', 'further back in time'. Pushes toward 'still' and 'yet'.

L26n1777.name: Overflow and filling context
L26n1777.description: Fires on the word just before a containment or overflow predicate ('that', 'should', 'will', 'to') and on fluid or filling nouns (eff|usion, molten alloy) in text about overflow, effusion or filling. Pushes toward 'fill', 'fills' and 'filling'.

L26n966.name: Sound and hearing context
L26n966.description: Goes strongly negative on the comma or word just before a sound sense in sensory lists ('sight, sound', 'smell, taste') and on 'sc' in screech; pushing it negative makes the model spam 'listen' and 'hear'.

L26n3063.name: Nanoparticle drug release
L26n3063.description: Fires on words in nanoparticle and drug-delivery text ('nano', 'nanoparticles', '-co' in silica-coated, 'polymer', 'payload'), often on the token before the noun; pushes output toward 'release' and 'releases'.

L26n2260.name: Government names, climate policy
L26n2260.description: Negative on a name or title in US government and climate-policy news (e.g. the 's' in Obama's, 'President', 'federal', 'GG' in RGGI); its output points to 'environmental' and 'ecological'.

L23n1463.name: 'True' / truth-value words
L23n1463.description: Fires on 'true' (and the 'be' or 'is' before it) in truth-value and 'is it true' contexts, and on narrative 'telling' and 'return' words. Pushes 'true' and 'false' next.

L25n1231.name: Requirement-verb slot, software
L25n1231.description: Fires on the word just before the main verb in software requirement text ('should [be] designed', 'that [is] capable', 'more [convenient]') and on framework or game names (React, Vue, Canvas, Minecraft); pushes toward 'performance' and 'optimize'.

L22n720.name: Word before 'value(s)'
L22n720.description: Fires on the word that sets up a value or parameter noun in how-to text: 'any' in 'accept any fractional values', 'missing' in 'missing values', 'a' in 'simulate a value', 'column' in 'return column'; pushes toward 'value' tokens.

L25n1486.name: Statistics and quantity words
L25n1486.description: Digits, numbers and quantity words in statistics and news (the 1 in a 2001 census, exact number, sales, projected, considerable amount); pushes the model toward 'figure' and 'figures' spam.

L25n649.name: 'It' after why/what
L25n649.description: Fires on the subject 'it' or 'that' right after 'why' or 'what' in an explanatory clause ('and why it matters', 'why it is so beneficial'). Pushes the model toward 'matter' and 'count'.

L27n1326.name: Piece before '-ac' ending
L27n1326.description: Fires on the piece just before a word-final '-ac' or '-acs' sound, e.g. 'agn' in Armagnac, 'oss' in Cossack, 'ani' in pteridomaniacs. Pushes toward 'ac' tokens.

L22n1834.name: Start-point words
L22n1834.description: Words that open a start point in time or a process: the last digit of 'From 1890 onwards', 'now' in 'From now on', 'starting in', 'Start harvesting'. Pushes toward 'start', 'starts' and 'begin'.

L25n1813.name: Paths, URLs, shell syntax
L25n1813.description: Domain, path and shell-command pieces, such as '.com' and '.org' endings, '/etc', 'cd', 'sudo', 'root' and 'ALL' in sudoers lines. Pushes toward '/*' and '*/' comment markers; steered output spams them.

L23n2306.name: Objective/loss noun before 'function'
L23n2306.description: Fires on technical nouns that usually sit before 'function' in optimization or control text: 'objective', 'loss', 'cost', 'transfer', 'transition', 'gradient descent'. Pushes the model toward the token 'function' and its variants.

L23n626.name: Token before type name
L23n626.description: Fires on the word right before a data-type name in specs ('list of integers', 'data type: String', 'accepts', 'takes'); pushes toward 'string' and 'strings'.

L23n1384.name: copula/'the' before 'key'
L23n1384.description: Fires on 'is', the 's' of 'what's', or a sentence-opening 'The' right after a subject ('Knowing is', 'What is more', 'Understanding the cause is'), where a predicate like 'the key' or 'the first step' follows; pushes toward 'key', and steered text spams 'key'.

L27n755.name: Slot before descriptor adjective
L27n755.description: Positive on the token right before a physical-description adjective in plant, animal or product prose, e.g. 'a [short] period', 'rather [orange]', 'very [deep]', 'white [with] yellow tips', plus commas that set up a list of traits. Pushes toward adjectives such as deep, wide, strong, thick and short; steered output spams 'deep'.

L24n1004.name: Units and rated maxima
L24n1004.description: goes strongly negative on the unit after a rated number ('24 volts', '240 V', '3900 joules', '700 kph') and on 'the' before a limit; pushes toward 'max', 'maximum' and 'peak'.

L24n1821.name: Season or time-slot word
L24n1821.description: Fires negatively on the word right before a season or time expression, such as 'late' in 'in late spring', 'last' in 'last year', or the colon after 'two seasons'. Pushes toward 'spring', 'fall' and 'winter', which repeat when steered.

L27n31.name: Clause-end punctuation → commas
L27n31.description: Fires on the comma or period that closes an introductory phrase or clause before a new clause ('In other words,' 'In fact,' 'But', 'So') in English prose. Goes negative toward comma-like punctuation '，' and '。', so steered output becomes a run of commas.

L23n694.name: Outcome-display verbs → result
L23n694.description: Fires on the word just before an object describing a measured or shown outcome ('affect [the] result', 'interpreting [these] graphs', 'displays [the] answer', 'outputs [the] determinant'); pushes toward 'result(s)'.

L25n2784.name: Machine-learning context words
L25n2784.description: Words in machine-learning and data-science text just before a key technical term, e.g. 'as well as' before SVM, 'neural networks and' before tree-based methods, 'deep' before learning; pushes toward 'feature' and 'features'.

L27n211.name: Split-word opener before suffix
L27n211.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into tokens when a suffix piece follows (sar|comas, sk|it, Sw|immers, der|mis, Comp|ounds). Pushes the model toward 'im'/'em' word pieces.

L27n178.name: Split-name second piece
L27n178.description: The second piece of a split proper name or place ('Kub|ayi', 'Sk|op|je', 'Re|enen', 'Luk|in', 'Te|es'). Pushes toward 'e'-syllable tokens such as 'eren', 'elle' and 'emet'.

L25n2517.name: 'is' before 'home to'
L25n2517.description: Fires on the copula 'is' right after a place or body-part subject that opens a description (e.g. 'Africa is', 'Nigeria is', 'Our mouth is'), most where 'home to' follows; pushes 'home'.

L24n2276.name: Military service vocabulary
L24n2276.description: Fires positive on military and service words ('Military', 'enlisted', 'served', 'soldiers', 'active service', 'Regiment') and on the relative word after them ('who', 'he', 'can'). Pushes toward 'service'.

L26n2578.name: Software/code engineering words
L26n2578.description: Fires on software and code-engineering words mid-sentence: 'code' in code reuse, 'Software' in software development, 'programming' habits, 'write' code. Pushes toward 'maintain' and 'maintenance'.

L26n1770.name: Biomedical terms, DNA
L26n1770.description: Fires on biology and medicine terms and their word pieces, e.g. 'acid' in fatty acid synthase, 'endocrine', 'cutaneous', 'dopamine', 'Alzheimer', 'cervical', plus 'Ne' in Neolithic and neutrophils. Pushes toward 'gene'/'genetic' and 'DNA'/'RNA', and steering repeats 'DNA'.

L27n370.name: URL and filename pieces
L27n370.description: Negative on fragments inside URLs, domains and file names (www.dhs.gov, st|aysafeonline, bit|es.com, .w and .s pieces); pushes toward file extensions like .json, .html and .png.

L26n1564.name: Digits inside numbers
L26n1564.description: Digit tokens inside multi-digit numbers and years (the 0 in 14,000, the 2 in 2,000, the 0 in 0 AD), strongest on the 2nd and later digits. Pushes the model toward more digit tokens. Pushed hard, it outputs garbled word fragments, not digits.

L23n1354.name: Viewpoint and above/below words
L23n1354.description: Negative on 'from' after a viewing or position verb ('seen from', 'viewed from', 'crushed from'), and on vertical location words ('below', 'buried', 'layer', 'sink'). Pushes 'above' and 'below'.

L22n1293.name: Data type in specs
L22n1293.description: The noun naming the data in a code spec or function doc: 'a' in 'Returns a string', the quoted parameter 'email', 'XML' data, 'number' in 'binary number', 'as' in 'input from the user'. Pushes the model toward 'string' and 'str'.

L24n967.name: Word before return
L24n967.description: The word just before an expected 'return' ('and' in 'checks ... and returns true', 'of' in 'rate of return', 'then' before a return or stop); pushes toward 'return' tokens.

L27n1884.name: Word-initial P onsets
L27n1884.description: The 'p' or 'P' first letter or piece of a word or name, often a single-letter token (P|olar, p|enguin, p|ungent, P|acific, p|atty); pushes toward 'pop' and 'population' tokens.

L25n2659.name: War/siege names, conflict
L25n2659.description: Fires on the first piece of proper nouns from wars, sieges and empires (Fre|derick, H|ittites, Fr|anks, Pot|omac, Arch of Titus); pushes 'conflict' and 'agreement', so steering gives 'conflict' spam.

L27n2260.name: 'st' word start, style
L27n2260.description: Fires on a word-initial 'st' or 'St' piece cut from its word (st|uffs, St|aying, st|umped, -st|udies, St|icherus), often right after a hyphen; pushes toward 'style'.

L24n3029.name: Website or domain name
L24n3029.description: Fires on the name of a website, platform, or domain in tech and web text: '.com' in 'example.com', 'Chrome', 'Etsy', 'Amazon', 'AWS', 'Dyn', and '@example' in emails. Pushes toward domain tokens.

L27n410.name: Verb stem before -ing
L27n410.description: Mostly the stem piece of a verb split before its '-ing' ending (f|lossing, sne|ezing, fl|aring, rem|aking, St|aying); pushes toward gerund verbs like creating, making and taking.

L26n162.name: Lead-ins before examples
L26n162.description: The token right before an explanation or example list: an opening '(' before an abbreviation, a ':' before a list, 'eg' before examples, 'for' before a value. Pushes toward 'description', 'report', 'observation'.

L26n593.name: Dot-letter abbreviations; '.c' output
L26n593.description: Fires on the period and letter inside abbreviations or initials (p.m., a.d., U.S., E.P., M.P.H.) and on diacritic name letters. Pushes toward file-extension tokens '.c', '.h', '.cpp' and '.java'.

L26n1323.name: Name fragments, name output
L26n1323.description: Goes negative on the middle or first piece of a split name or long word (Me|vlana, Al|fonso, Mal|awi, tyr|ant, Er|tekin), before its continuation; pushes toward 'name', 'filename' and 'username'.

L22n2757.name: 'Into' before implementation
L22n2757.description: The word just before an act-it-out verb or noun: 'into' in 'into practice', 'to' in 'to implement', 'and' in 'plan, design and execute', 'for' in 'timeline for implementation'. Pushes the model toward 'implementation', 'implement' and 'execution'.

L27n823.name: Word-start piece, writes int
L27n823.description: First piece of a word split across tokens (spl|ints, squ|ishy, verm|ilion, subst|ations); pushes toward 'int' tokens.

L26n686.name: Verb stems before -ing
L26n686.description: Fires on the first piece of a verb stem split before its '-ing' ending (squ|ishing, susp|ending, sm|acking, exh|aling, att|aining); pushes toward '-ing' participle adjectives such as 'inspiring' and 'engaging', so steered text repeats 'inspiring'.

L25n1723.name: Account and login nouns
L25n1723.description: The determiner or noun just before 'account' ('an' in 'deposit into an account') plus login, bank and registration words; pushes toward 'account' and 'accounts'.

L26n1149.name: Mid-word fragment, predicts ug
L26n1149.description: Mid-word pieces of split words (inde- in indestructible, ana- in anaerobic, -ile in silex, ole in oleifera, Nicola); pushes toward 'ug', 'ud' and 'ux' word-end fragments.

L23n710.name: Enumeration and list intros
L23n710.description: Fires on words that introduce an enumeration, e.g. 'just' and 'a few' or 'some' in 'here are just some', 'bullet point' format, 'a list of', and on 'lists' or 'points' in instructions; pushes toward 'list', and at +0.5 it repeats 'list'.

L25n1048.name: Slot before 'function'
L25n1048.description: Fires on the word right before an expected 'function' or 'work' ('proper' in 'proper functioning', 'to' in 'to function', 'not' in 'not functioning'); pushes output toward 'function' and 'functions'.

L25n2216.name: Computer and hardware nouns
L25n2216.description: Strongly negative on computing and hardware nouns (e.g. 'computer' in targeted computer, 'server', 'device', 'GPU', 'Arduino', 'system' in system components); pushes 'power' and 'software'.

L26n2426.name: Name-internal fragment, predicts ier
L26n2426.description: Mid-word fragments of European surnames and terms split across tokens (Mart-el, Mer-cier, Gau-guin, Ikht-iyar, Agr-arian); pushes toward French-style ier and ière endings.

L25n1874.name: Mail and printed-paper nouns
L25n1874.description: Words that name or modify printed mail and paper goods, such as 'old' in 'old cereal boxes', 'postal', 'mailing', 'card' and 'mail'. Pushes toward 'address' and 'post'.

L25n1982.name: Computing operation word
L25n1982.description: Goes negative on the word that names a computation or arithmetic operation in a coding or math prompt, such as 'binary' in 'binary addition' or 'binary tree', 'performs', 'implements', and 'to' in 'recursion to calculate'. Pushes toward 'addition', 'add' and 'subtract'.

L24n2546.name: Statistics fitting word pieces
L24n2546.description: goes strongly negative on the second piece of a split word or name in statistics and curve-fitting text (e.g. 'Curve Fit', 'LASSO', 'Examination'); pushes toward 'statistics' tokens.

L26n2502.name: Device and tool nouns
L26n2502.description: Nouns naming a physical appliance, tool or machine part, the head before 'machine', 'basket', 'tool' or 'pin' (washing machine, heater, suction, cutting tool, firing pin); pushes toward 'pin'.

L27n884.name: 'person' in point-of-view
L27n884.description: Fires on 'person' in 'first-person' or 'third-person' and on 'non-' prefixes (non-native, non-fiction), i.e. the word before 'point of view'. Pushes the model toward 'point' and 'points'.

L27n634.name: Saint abbreviation St
L27n634.description: Negative on 'St' or 'Saint' before a saint's name (St. Paul's, Saint Francis); pushes toward male first names like John, David and Michael.

L25n1253.name: Institutional mechanism nouns
L25n1253.description: Negative on process or mechanism nouns in policy and institutional text (reward, Vote, quota, review, alert, reserve, fee, feedback), peaking on the word that names the mechanism; pushing negative drives the model to write 'system'.

L27n2059.name: Lone g word-start piece
L27n2059.description: Fires on a lone 'g' or 'g'-initial piece that starts a split word or hyphenated compound (poly|g|amy, migr|aines, fully-|g|rown); pushes toward 'gl' and 'Gl' tokens.

L25n2931.name: Modifier before 'history'
L25n2931.description: Fires (negative) on the modifier just before a head noun, strongest on 'family' in family history and 'browsing' in browsing history, plus 'medical' before provider and 'a' before stroke or disability. Pushes toward 'history' and 'historical'; pushed, it spams 'historian'.

L27n666.name: Noun-modifier slot before head
L27n666.description: Fires on the modifier right before the noun it modifies, e.g. 'mobile' in 'mobile phone', 'car' in 'car headlights', 'sea' in 'sea earthquakes', 'metallic' in 'metallic glass', and 'and' or 'their' in noun lists. Pushes toward generic nouns like 'device', 'item', 'node'; steered, it spams 'book'.

L27n2371.name: Piece before 'ps' sound
L27n2371.description: Fires on the piece just before a 'ps' sound, e.g. 'ile' in Epilepsy, 'se' in sepsis, 'ise' in antiseptic, 'cathe' in cathepsin. Pushes toward 'ps' tokens.

L24n2839.name: Network term → 'port'
L24n2839.description: Fires on networking and server words just before a port number or access setting: the space before '520' in 'UDP port 520', 'communication ports', 'server' access, 'https', 'connects to the Internet'. Pushes toward 'port' and 'ports'.

L27n1396.name: Commas in symptom lists
L27n1396.description: Goes positive on the comma that ends one item in a list of symptoms or conditions ('nose,' 'headaches,' 'nausea,'), and on onset fragments of symptom words like 'cl' in clenching and 'sn' in sneezing. Pushes toward commas and quote-comma tokens.

L27n254.name: Foreign diacritic letters
L27n254.description: Fires (goes negative) on non-English letters with diacritics or IPA and Sanskrit marks (ˈ, ś, ṭ, ḥ, ʾ, č, ə) inside foreign names and transliterations; pushes output toward accented foreign word endings like 'äre', 'è', 'é' and 'ä'.

L25n2875.name: 'public' before 'domain'
L25n2875.description: Fires on the word 'public', 'Public' or 'publicly' itself, as in public domain, Public Law, public good, public schools and Public Safety. Pushes toward 'domain', and steered output repeats 'domain'.

L24n2971.name: Digits in ratios/percents
L24n2971.description: Fires on digits inside percentages, ratios and fractions (the 0 in '70%', the 1 in '1:1', the 3 in '3/4-inch'). Pushes the model toward a colon ':' as in ratio notation.

L21n1288.name: Comma before result clause
L21n1288.description: Positive on the comma, 'the', or 'to' that opens a result clause in API or function docs, e.g. 'If the argument chars has more than n characters<,>' and 'result set'. Pushes 'result'.

L24n1857.name: Word before 'state'
L24n1857.description: Fires on the modifier right before 'state' or 'health' in phrases like 'current state', 'mental health', 'emotional state' or 'psychological wellness', peaking on 'mental', 'current' or 'psychological'. Pushes the model to write 'state' tokens.

L26n2730.name: Word-start 'res' piece
L26n2730.description: Fires on a 'res' piece opening a word split into tokens, like 'Res' in Resiliency and 'res' in resettle or resistance, with milder firing on 'cyber' and 'climate' in security and climate-resilience text; pushes toward more 'res' tokens such as res and resolute.

L25n2796.name: Coordinate-system words (polar, rect)
L25n2796.description: Fires on the 'co' piece of 'coordinates' and 'co-' words, and on 'to' or 'in' in math phrasing like 'in terms of' and 'converts to decimal'; also on name fragments like 'Vil' and 'Anch'. Pushes toward coordinate-system adjectives: polar, rectangular, cylindrical, spherical.

L27n1981.name: Negative word-piece, writes 'ed'
L27n1981.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, before its suffix (rap in tetraplegia, ise in antiseptic, Rh in Rhododendron, -se in fern-se-d); pushes toward 'ed', and steering spams 'ed'.

L26n974.name: Split-word start, suffix writer
L26n974.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word split into tokens, where the word is still unfinished (e.g. 'Sw' in Swallow, 'gl' in glaze, 'Gran' in Granodiorite, 'sn' in snail). Pushed negative, it promotes word-ending pieces like 'cycle' and 'ouch'.

L25n2781.name: Safety warnings
L25n2781.description: Reads safety and emergency-procedure text (active shooter, Emergency Management, escape); pushes toward 'safe' and 'safety'.

L26n623.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L26n623.description: Fires on the infinitive 'to', or a modal ('can', 'will', 'not'), right before a bare verb: 'to' in 'designed to evaluate', 'to' in 'used to get', 'can' in 'can use', 'will' in 'will install'. Pushes toward bare verbs such as test, train and check.

L27n389.name: Age and sex slots
L27n389.description: Negative on diffuse function words and nouns in child, pet and livestock text, peaking on the slot just before an age, sex or animal-kind word, e.g. 'castrated males [as] wethers', 'kitten [was] born', 'world [animal] protein'. Pushes toward 'sex', 'gender', 'adult' and 'Woman'; steered output drifts into 'worn worn'.

L25n1831.name: 'to' before action verb
L25n1831.description: 'to' (also 'by', 'just', 'simply') right before a bare action verb in how-to instructions: 'prompts the user to input', 'allow users to enter', 'can just type'; pushes toward 'type/types' tokens.

L27n571.name: German name fragments
L27n571.description: Fires on pieces of German-origin names and words split into tokens, e.g. 'ots' in Potsdam, 'Ost' in Ostereierbaum, 'Biedermann', 'ues' in Brühoff; pushes toward 'German', 'von' and 'Sch' tokens.

L24n2517.name: Tracking identifiers → IP
L24n2517.description: Fires on conjunctions and modifiers inside lists of network or personal identifiers ('IP address, or network location', 'device IDs,', 'browsing', 'GPS', 'Internet'), and on sudo/root shell-prompt tokens like ']$' and '#'; pushes toward 'IP'.

L24n2816.name: Modifier before system
L24n2816.description: Fires on the modifier right before 'system', mainly 'solar' in 'solar system' and 'solar wind', also 'root', 'ring', 'school' and 'star'. Pushes toward 'system' and 'systems'.

L24n601.name: Body size and weight
L24n601.description: Fires on body-measure words: 'lose' or 'lost' before weight, 'in' in 'small in stature', 'body', 'muscle' and 'bone', and digits in weight or height figures; pushes toward 'size' and 'length'.

L23n2357.name: Risk qualifier before event
L23n2357.description: Fires on a qualifier before a risk or occurrence noun, e.g. 'serious adverse' before events, 'rare' or 'common' before occasions, and 'vascular' or 'coronary' before problems; pushes toward 'event' and 'events'.

L23n654.name: Subject before 'vary'
L23n654.description: The word right before an expected 'vary/varies', such as 'extent' in 'the extent to which', 'size' in 'range in size', or 'can' in 'can vary'; pushes 'var', 'vary' and 'variable'.

L27n2444.name: Past-tense verb stems
L27n2444.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a past-tense or participle verb split into tokens, such as 'enc|roached', 'c|eded', 'reb|uked', 'spr|outed', 'w|aned' and 'anch|ised', with some name pieces mixed in; pushes 'found/Found'.

L23n2383.name: Enough and sufficiency predicates
L23n2383.description: Negative on the verb, 'not', or 'usually' right after a subject when the sentence says something is enough, suitable, or needed ('will be', 'is suitable', 'not enough', 'usually enough'). Pushes 'enough' and 'sufficient'.

L25n1198.name: Tech platform list items
L25n1198.description: Fires on the connective or the platform name that follows it in lists of tech products and devices (Windows, iPhone, Android, Wii, AWS, VR, Minecraft); pushes toward 'web'.

L21n1463.name: Name and label words
L21n1463.description: Words that name or label something: 'names' and 'name', 'by' in 'call it by some other name', 'with' in 'replace __ with', 'spelling', 'Type', 'numeral', 'Color' and 'currency'. Pushes the model toward 'name'.

L21n1827.name: Before 'valid' or 'available'
L21n1827.description: Goes negative on the word just before a validity or availability check ('are' in 'are available', 'not' before 'valid', 'identifier', 'formats', 'Select', 'shows'); pushes the model to write 'valid'.

L27n2698.name: Letter v, writes volume
L27n2698.description: The letter 'v' or 'V' as a split piece: 'low-|voltage', 'current-to-|voltage', 'V|SDs', 'V|ital', 'v|oted'. Pushes toward 'volume' and 'Volume'.

L27n1555.name: Rangeland, shrub, grazing
L27n1555.description: Fires on 'shr' in shrubs and shrubbery, and on 'r', 'ranch' and 'grazing' in rangeland and farming text; pushes the model toward 'range'/'ranges'.

L27n2760.name: Science stem, writes 'age'
L27n2760.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a technical medical or science word split across tokens (flamm|ation, neut|rophils, verte|bral, pneum|onic, rh in cirrhosis); pushes toward 'age/ages', and steering spams 'age'.

L24n2897.name: Words after task instructions
L24n2897.description: goes strongly negative on the function word right after a task verb in instructions ('completes the statement or', 'fill in these words', 'asked to record'); pushes toward 'fill' and 'complete'.

L27n1969.name: Event name inner words
L27n1969.description: Negative on a key word inside an event or campaign name, e.g. 'Awareness' in Motorcycle Safety Awareness, 'science' in science fair, 'field' in school field trip, 'Fun' in Family Fun Day; pushes toward 'day' tokens.

L26n1555.name: Split-word fragments
L26n1555.description: Fires negative on the second piece of a word cut by a hyphen or subword split, e.g. 'S' in 'Full-S-ized', 's' in 'flying-s-aucer', ' res' in ' resettle'. Steered, it pushes word-completion pieces (pec, ign, plit, cript) and spams fragments like 'curiospec'.

L25n2651.name: Building-part noun fragments
L25n2651.description: Fires on the first piece of a physical structure noun in construction or object text (j|amb, t|urret, m|ounds, tread|mill, bons|ai). Pushes toward 'plate', 'platform' and 'board'.

L27n1919.name: Time before window
L27n1919.description: Fires on the word 'time' or 'timing' in set phrases like 'time-dependent', 'time period', 'time constraints' and 'time on delivery'; pushes toward 'window' tokens.

L26n1190.name: Sh-initial words, show
L26n1190.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'sh' or 'Sh' (shaking, shower, shown, shut down, Shiloh, Shalimar); pushes toward 'show', 'exhibit' and 'display'.

L20n373.name: Year digits in citations
L20n373.description: Fires on the last one or two digits of a year in a citation or date, e.g. 'Levy, 200[9]', 'Hebant-Mauri, 197[3]', 'May 27, 185[7]', 'January, 201[8]'. Pushes toward ';' separators.

L24n850.name: Modifier before 'term'
L24n850.description: Fires on a modifier or noun just before a technical noun is due, e.g. 'the [first] set', 'Error [tolerance]', 'sums of the product [terms]', 'Lorentz [force]'. Pushes toward 'term(s)'.

L26n2771.name: Word-start Im/som fragments
L26n2771.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens, when that piece is 'Im', 'som', 'imm' or 'mam' (Immaculate, somatostatin, immemorial, Imager, Molting). Writes a bare 'm' token; pushed, it stuffs 'm' into words.

L25n879.name: Concern words before raise
L25n879.description: Fires on the word just before 'raise' is expected: 'concerns', 'questions', 'controversy', and 'also' or 'they' inside question phrases ('What concerns does this attack raise?'). Pushes toward 'raise', 'raised' and 'raising'.

L25n660.name: Formal and mathematical derivation
L25n660.description: Fires on the piece of a formal or maths word just before its ending, e.g. 'formally', 'mathematically' (the 'atically' piece), 'clearly', and 'step' in physics and maths prose; pushes toward 'derive' and 'derivation'.

L26n2689.name: Em/om word starts
L26n2689.description: Negative on a short 'em', 'om' or 'Prom' fragment starting a word split by the tokenizer (em-itter, high-em-ission, om-itted, Prom-ising, rem-olded); pushes the 'itt', 'ited' and 'itter' completions.

L25n3040.name: Spreading and expanding motion
L25n3040.description: Fires on word pieces meaning spread or expand: 'exp' in expel/expanding, 'wing' in stretched wings, 'fully' in fully formed, and unfurling fronds. Pushes the model toward expansion, spread and stretch words.

L27n930.name: Fragment before '-ad'
L27n930.description: Goes negative on the stem piece just before an '-ad' ending (kne|ading, Crus|ade, igr|ade, ball|ads, cit|adel). Pushes toward 'ad' tokens.

L27n886.name: Institution-name fragments
L27n886.description: Fires inside proper names of places and institutions (Jait-pur, Kh-ao, Budget Office, Security Agency, Monastery); pushes 'school', 'hospital', and 'institution'.

L25n1372.name: Determiners before 'book'
L25n1372.description: Fires negatively on a determiner or possessive ('his', 'this', 'the', 's' in Frankl's) right before a noun for a book, course, report or guide; pushes toward 'book'.

L27n1404.name: Hyphen 's', pushes 'size'
L27n1404.description: Fires on a lone 'S'/'s' piece after a hyphen or inside a word (e.g. '-S' in Full-Sized, '-S' in Mid-Senior, 'os' in nanoscale, 'uns' in unsatisfied); pushes 'size' tokens and makes the model spam 'size'.

L27n1503.name: Academic field stems
L27n1503.description: Fires (positive) on the stem just before a subject or role noun, strongest on 'theolog' (theologians), 'scient', 'mathematic', 'photoc' and 'phon'; pushes toward subject names like 'chemistry', 'geometry', 'biology' and 'physics'.

L24n1635.name: Pre-call-to-action punctuation
L24n1635.description: Fires on the comma, '?', or 'please' right after a 'to learn more about X' or 'for more details' phrase, just before a call to visit, check out, or click. Pushes toward check tokens.

L26n2312.name: Pores and cavities
L26n2312.description: Fires on the structure word in anatomy and botany descriptions (e.g. 'tiny' pores, 'seed' boxes, 'carp' in carpels, 'lymph' in lymphatic); its output points to 'holes', 'cavity' and 'chambers'.

L27n282.name: Food and farming phrases
L27n282.description: Fires inside food, farming and nutrition phrases, such as 'and' in 'Food and Drug', 'food' in 'food security', 'daily' in 'daily intake', or ony in Nyonya; pushes toward 'food', 'cooking' and 'culinary'.

L22n2356.name: Continuation phrases
L22n2356.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before a continuation phrase: 'so' in 'and so forth', 'reading' in 'keep reading', 'goes' in 'goes through', and 'by' or 'to' after 'continue the story'; pushes toward 'continue'.

L24n1928.name: Ability and need adjectives
L24n1928.description: Fires on the word before a noun of ability or need: 'special' in 'children with special needs', 'specially' in 'specially-abled', 'mental', 'cognitive', 'civic', and 'and' right after 'capacity'. Pushes toward 'capacity/capabilities'; steered text spams 'capacity'.

L27n2064.name: Word inside compound term
L27n2064.description: Strongly negative on a word that is part of a multi-word term, before its head, such as 'Disease' in Disease Control, 'Pest' in Pest Control, 'content' in content management, and 'Mind' in MindMeister. Pushes toward 'management/manage', which it repeats when steered.

L27n2030.name: Hyphenated s, writes save
L27n2030.description: A lone 's' or 'S' piece after a hyphen or at a split word start (ex-S|ervicemen, self-s|acrifice, Seven S|ages); pushes toward 'save' and 'saving'.

L27n1701.name: Second-half 'b', writes bit
L27n1701.description: Fires on a lone 'b' or '-b' that opens the second half of a split or hyphenated word, such as 'nuts-bolts', 'qu-bits', 'bittersweet' or 'basking'. Pushes toward 'bit' and 'bits'.

L20n747.name: Variable names before equals
L20n747.description: Fires on a short variable or parameter name in code or math notation ('t' in 'from t', 'y' in 'rhs(t,y', 'fp' in 'file fp', 'x' in 'f(x'). Pushes the model toward '=' followed by a single-letter variable.

L27n681.name: Pre-noun modifier → 'case'
L27n681.description: Fires on a modifier before a noun in formal or educational prose ('two years', 'four different concentrations', 'national programs', 'state standards', 'ecological zones'). Goes negative toward head nouns 'case', 'example', 'instance' (steered output: 'case case case').

L25n1556.name: Production and manufacturing nouns
L25n1556.description: Fires on production, manufacturing and lab-process nouns: 'increase production', 'digital production method', 'released manufacturing', 'sample analysis', 'SNP array', 'milling', 'breeding program', 'reaction optimisation', 'simulation'. Pushes toward 'run', as in production run; steering gives 'run a gentle journey'.

L26n1679.name: Before data-structure nouns
L26n1679.description: Fires on the modifier before a data-structure or technical noun (sorted array, singly linked list, splay tree data structure). Pushes toward 'map' and 'Map'.

L26n1591.name: Stem before -age ending
L26n1591.description: Goes negative on the stem just before an '-age', '-aged' or '-ages' ending that is split into its own token, e.g. 'lever|ages', 'gar|ages', 'volt|ages', 'append|ages', 'Enc|our|aging', 'pre-pack|aged'; writes 'ag'/'agent' tokens, the start of that same ending.

L27n333.name: Mid-word pieces of names
L27n333.description: Later pieces of a rare name or loanword split into several tokens, e.g. Rad|b|od, Ps|odes, Nakh|on; pushes toward generic subword pieces like 'ai', 'ata', 'num'.

L26n2662.name: Reduce-stem fragments, 'red' output
L26n2662.description: The 're-' or 'red-' piece of reduce, reduction and reducing (dose-re-duction, Reducing waste, Reducer). Also weaker on words like 'dramatically' and 'significantly'. Pushes toward 'red' and 're'.

L24n1452.name: Database connection request
L24n1452.description: Fires on database-product names (MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, 'database', 'DB') in coding prompts, peaking on the product name before the word 'database'. Pushes the model toward 'connect' and 'connection'.

L25n3019.name: Cleaning and purity words
L25n3019.description: Goes negative on words about filtering, cleaning, or air and water quality, e.g. 'filtr' in biofiltration, 'filter', 'air' in air pollution, 'teeth' in keep teeth clean. Pushes toward 'clean' and 'pure' tokens.

L27n1279.name: Creative-work titles and prompts
L27n1279.description: Strongly positive on the opening quote or first word of a creative work's title, e.g. 'Water' in Water Lilies or 'Happy' in a song credit, and on request words in creative-writing prompts such as 'Write a short story' or 'song with lyrics'. Pushes toward 'artist' and 'music'.

L27n1191.name: Rare-word middle piece
L27n1191.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a long or rare word split into tokens ('gor' in Novgorod, 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'proph' in prophesied, 'ab' in law-abiding); pushes toward the suffix 'es'.

L27n1167.name: Car/tele opener, path writer
L27n1167.description: First piece of a split word, especially 'Car' (Carica, Caria) and 'tele' (teleported, telepathically), plus 'rop' in naturopaths. Pushes toward the 'path' tokens of telepathy and pathways.

L27n1231.name: Connector between condition names
L27n1231.description: Fires negative on the 'and', 'with', comma or 'like' that joins two disease or condition names (Crohn's disease and Crohn's, with Parkinson's, clinical depression, anxiousness); pushes output toward 'problems', 'errors' and 'events'.

L24n2238.name: Article before town status
L24n2238.description: Fires on 'a' (or 'elected' or 'as') right before a civic-status noun such as town, city, county or bishop, e.g. 'incorporated as a town' or 'became a city'; pushes toward 'community', 'village' and 'town'.

L27n143.name: Sentence-final punctuation
L27n143.description: Fires on the period, semicolon or colon that closes a sentence or clause, especially right before a line break or list (e.g. '.' after 'over time', ';' before 'and'). Pushes toward closing quote and bracket tokens; steered, it barely changes the answers.

L27n2715.name: Science-name piece, writes stat
L27n2715.description: Piece inside long science or agency names before 'statistics' ('ost' in biostatistics, 'Health' before Statistics, 'Agricultural' before Statistical); pushes toward 'stat' and 'statistics'.

L27n1449.name: Public-place nouns; writes 'square'
L27n1449.description: Goes strongly negative on the head noun of a civic or public-space phrase: 'public' (forum, eye), 'market' (place), 'Main' (Street), 'town' (fortifications), 'Memorial' (Park). Pushing it negative steers toward 'square'.

L24n777.name: punctuation before closing quote
L24n777.description: Fires on sentence or clause punctuation ('.', ',', '?', '...') that sits inside or right before a closing quote or parenthesis (e.g. 'now.”' or 'sentences.' inside parentheses); pushes toward closing-quote and close-paren tokens such as '.”' and ').'.

L24n2800.name: Split function names
L24n2800.description: The second piece of a compound name split across tokens (XLOOK|UP, GROUP BY, cot|angent, tan|gent) in Excel, SQL and trig text; pushes toward 'function'.

L27n268.name: Consonant-cluster word opener
L27n268.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split word that starts with a consonant cluster ('wre' in 'wrecks', 'cre' in 'crept', 'bre', 'gre', 'Schro' in 'Schroers'). Pushes consonant-only tokens like 'mt', 'pb', 'ms'.

L27n2043.name: Modifier before 'potential'
L27n2043.description: Fires on the adjective right before a broad noun, e.g. 'academic' in academic performance, 'human' in human rights, 'true' in true identity, 'genetic' in genetic makeup. Pushes toward 'potential', so steered text spams 'potential potential'.

L27n1183.name: Science-term mid-word pieces
L27n1183.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long scientific or Latin term split into tokens (ut in Neutrophils, ios in angiosperms, ym in Gymnospermae, at in phosphatases); pushes toward 'ph' fragments (ph, Ph, PH) as in phosphate.

L27n1034.name: s-start after prefix split
L27n1034.description: Fires on the 's' that opens the second half of a word after a hyphen or split: 'water-s|oluble', 'Water-S|oluble', 'quasi-s|culptural', 'nano-s|cale', 'susp|ensions', 'subs|ided'. Pushes toward 'sol' tokens such as solution and solve.

L26n2735.name: Protein name before factor
L26n2735.description: Fires on the first word or word piece of a biology term that precedes 'factor' or 'hormone' (transcription, growth, cytokine, releasing), strongest on 'transcription' and 'growth', and on 'Coll' in collagen. Pushes toward 'factor' and 'factory'.

L25n1833.name: Games/sports -> 'win'
L25n1833.description: Fires on play, sport and game words (e.g. 'touch' in rugby rules, 'plays' the guitar, 'playing' tennis, 'tabletop', 'single-player'). Pushed negative, it promotes 'win/wins/winning' and turns the story toward racing.

L27n1913.name: Stem before -graphy
L27n1913.description: Fires on the stem piece just before '-graphy' in split imaging terms (tom|ography, electromy|ography, neutron-computed tomography). Pushes toward 'graph' tokens.

L26n1344.name: Split-word middle fragment
L26n1344.description: Goes negative on the second or middle piece of a rare word or name split into 3+ tokens, such as somat|OST|atin, Rolls|-R|oyce, tabula| r|asa or Shah| R|ukh, often a short 're', 'r' or 'ost'. Common whole words stay near 0. Pushes toward word-continuation fragments like 'res' and 'caffold'.

L25n607.name: Daily and threshold limits
L25n607.description: Goes negative on quantity-limit words in reference-value text, mostly 'daily' in 'recommended daily amount/intake', plus 'threshold', 'absolute', 'small' and 'these'. Pushes toward 'values'.

L23n1638.name: Life duration and remaining
L23n1638.description: Fires on 'life' meaning lifespan or duration ('a life of four years', 'life expectancy') and on words like 'last' and 'remains' in similar senses. Pushes the model toward 'remaining', 'still' and 'left'.

L23n724.name: word before 'method(s)'
L23n724.description: Fires on the first word of a compound noun or 'X options' phrase, such as 'payment' in 'payment methods', 'login' in 'loginname', 'access' in 'access code', 'birth' in 'birth control'; pushes toward 'method(s)' next, and steered text spams 'method'.

L23n3002.name: Greek and single-letter labels
L23n3002.description: Goes strongly negative on Greek letters and single-letter labels (β, α, γ, n, y, C) right before a hyphen or as a variable ('β-adrenomimetic', 'n-bit', 'y-coordinate'). Pushes toward the hyphen tokens ')-' and '-'.

L27n1115.name: Pre-'room' noun completion
L27n1115.description: Fires strongly negative on the token just before a predictable noun completion, e.g. 'the' in 'elephant in the room', 'Green' before 'house'. Pushes toward 'room' (steered output is 'Room room room').

L26n2213.name: Tense/interest terms, 'simple'
L26n2213.description: Goes negative on 'Present' and 'Past' in tense lists and on 'paying', 'annual' and 'compounded' in interest problems; pushes toward 'simple', as in Simple Present and simple interest.

L25n1680.name: Romanized name fragment, u
L25n1680.description: Middle pieces of transliterated Arabic and Persian names split across tokens (Ghaf in Al Ghafiqi, Ikhtiyar, Shams-ud-din, Zul-kifli, Abdu'l); pushes the model into 'u' and 'ul' spam.

L25n645.name: Word stem needing suffix
L25n645.description: Fires on a word stem split across tokens that still needs a suffix: 'vir' in retro|viruses, 'hor' in hor|izons, 'Hor' in Hor|rible, '-cigaret' before 'te', 'dwar' before 'fs'. Pushes toward suffix pieces like -ations, -ivement, -ures.

L27n913.name: Lone t/f starts
L27n913.description: Goes negative on a lone one-letter token that starts a word, most often 't' (tummy, tinnitus, T-shirt) and 'f' (feral, fGCs); pushes toward single capital letters like C, M and B.

L27n1524.name: Connective before place/nation
L27n1524.description: Fires on prepositions and commas right before a place, nation or list of countries ('as Burma', 'into Francia', 'upon Egyptian', 'through the town', 'Mennonite, Spanish') and on nationality adjectives; pushes toward 'countries', 'Canada', 'Italy', 'France', 'India'.

L27n519.name: Military and combat context
L27n519.description: Fires negatively on tokens inside military or war biographies (Infantry, Army, enlisting, Panzer, Rommel's promotion), peaking on function words like 'was', 'to', 'in' in those sentences. Pushes the model toward 'attack' and combat wording.

L27n470.name: Mid-name proper-noun continuation
