L27n470.description: Fires on an inner piece of a multi-token proper name or title, usually the middle word or fragment (the 'ac' in Tic-Tac-Toe, 'ellen' in Hellenic, 'United' in UNESCO, 'Academy' in American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry). Pushes toward capital initial letters like D, S, T, C.

L21n2863.name: Pronoun before reflexive -self
L21n2863.description: Goes negative on an object pronoun or demonstrative ending a verb phrase ('do it', 'do this', 'one', 'that', 'them', 'anything', 'do it again'); pushes the model to write reflexive '-self' pronouns.

L27n431.name: Compound prefix micro/electro
L27n431.description: The Greek combining-form prefix at the start of a compound word, e.g. electro-, micro-, gastro-, neuro-, nano-, retro- (electro|fishing, micro|clots, gastro|enterologist); pushes toward suffix pieces like 'al', 'ant', 'ar', 'alg'.

L24n1767.name: Advice verb expecting frequency
L24n1767.description: Fires on the main verb of an advice or how-to sentence after 'should' or a subject (should receive, conducts, perform, sends out, reviewed), where a frequency word like 'annually' or 'monthly' usually follows; pushes toward 'regular', 'monthly' and 'annual'.

L25n2998.name: Dollar sign and prompt
L25n2998.description: Fires on '$' before dollar amounts ($230,000, $15 minimum wage) and on the '~' and ']$' of shell prompts. Pushes toward '$'-prefixed tokens like $d, $q and $x.

L22n1222.name: Grid-arrangement words; writes 'row'
L22n1222.description: Fires on words that describe how items sit in a line or grid ('along' and 'the' before 'diagonal', 'horizontal', 'adjacent', 'each' before 'side', 'in' before 'lines'); pushes toward 'row'/'rows'.

L27n893.name: Digit in COVID-19
L27n893.description: A digit inside a split number or year, e.g. the '1' in COVID-|1|9, and the 7, 8 and 0 in 19|7|9, 1|8|97, 20|0|9; pushes toward 'nine' and spams 'nine nine'.

L24n2472.name: Quantity adjectives before amount
L24n2472.description: Negative pole: fires on quantity adjectives that precede an amount or share noun: 'significant' in 'significant amount/portion', 'substantial portion', 'large number', 'increasing amount', 'higher adoption'. Pushing it negative writes 'ratio/proportion/fraction' and steers text toward 'ratio' spam.

L26n2910.name: Mid-name pieces, 'cat' output
L26n2910.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a name or technical term split into tokens (S|ita in Ramayana, Z|eld|ovich, Vlas|chenko, Polyc|yclic, neonic|otinoid). Pushes toward 'cat'/'category' fragments; steering spams 'Cat'.

L27n182.name: Digits and units, math
L27n182.description: Fires on digits inside numbers and scientific notation (e.g. '1' in 1.5 × 10^8, '4' in 14.7 °C) and on unit or math tokens like °, ×, Celsius, Fahrenheit; pushes toward logarithm, algorithm, quadratic, mathematical.

L26n1043.name: Finance rate/return terms
L26n1043.description: Fires on finance-rate phrase words: 'internal' in internal rate of return, 'Annual' in Annual Percentage Rate, 'Health' in Health Savings Accounts, plus stray word fragments. Pushes toward 'costs', 'expense' and 'expenditure'.

L22n2807.name: Hash and modulo terms
L22n2807.description: goes strongly negative on 'hash' and the closing bracket after h(x), plus residue and modulus terms in hashing and modular arithmetic; pushes toward 'mod' and 'modulo'.

L24n1015.name: Market and over/under prefixes
L24n1015.description: Fires on economics words and hyphenated 'under-' and 'over-' prefixes ('under-produced', 'over-application', 'market database', 'store of value'); pushes toward 'supply' and 'demand'.

L27n2818.name: Word-start 'se' piece
L27n2818.description: Word-initial 's' or 'se' piece split off from its word (s|cones, Se|awater, s|ycamore, se|borrhea); pushes toward 'seed' and 'ball'.

L26n519.name: Acronym-opening parenthesis
L26n519.description: The '(' right after a spelled-out name, just before its abbreviation, e.g. 'Defence (CARD)', 'Institute (CPSI)', 'Kansas City Clubs United (KCCU)'; pushes toward capital-letter acronym tokens like CM, CX, CC.

L24n2614.name: Math term stems, integrate
L24n2614.description: Positive on a mid-word piece of a math or physics term during calculus or physics text ('quadr' in quadrature, 'Indef' in indefinite, 'attenuation', 'lux' in iso-lux). Pushes 'integr-' words like 'integrate'.

L22n1856.name: Basic or smallest unit
L22n1856.description: Fires on 'basic' or 'small/smallest' right before a building-block noun such as 'unit' or 'atom' (e.g. 'the basic unit', 'smallest unit'). Pushes the model toward the word 'unit'.

L25n1568.name: Math series type words
L25n1568.description: Fires on 'the' or 'an' before a math sequence type ('the harmonic series', 'an arithmetic progression', 'the factorial of'), and on capitalised word-start pieces like 'Hy' in Hydrogen and 'St' in Stuffed. Pushes toward 'geometric' and 'factor'; steered output repeats 'geometric'.

L25n2120.name: Shape and size words
L25n2120.description: Fires negatively on geometry and measurement words ('square', 'rectangles', 'polygon', 'closed', 'nano', 'milli') and the '2' in '2-by-4' lumber; pushes toward 'square'.

L24n1540.name: Word before exist
L24n1540.description: The word before a verb of existence: 'co' in co-exist and co-occurring, 'could' in 'could exist', 'ex' in exoplanets; pushes toward 'exist' forms.

L23n631.name: Sequence length in code
L23n631.description: In code-writing requests and docs, the word for the data being processed or returned: 'equal' before 'length', 'the' before 'longest one', 'array' in 'outputs the array', 'chars' and 'has' in 'chars has fewer than n characters'. Pushes the model toward 'length'.

L26n1293.name: Split 'v'/'dev' fragments
L26n1293.description: Fires on short fragment tokens 'v', 'dev', 'div' inside split words (V|ORTEX, Dev|iance, di|v|estment, -v|accinated). Mid-word pieces, not whole words. Pushes toward 'var', 'variant' and 'variation' completions.

L23n2482.name: Adjective 'natural' before noun
L23n2482.description: The adjective 'natural' right before a noun (natural increase, natural gas, natural resources) and 'logarithmic' in 'logarithmic time'; pushes toward 'log' tokens.

L23n855.name: Colon before a figure
L23n855.description: The colon or newline right after 'below' or 'shown below' that introduces a picture, infographic or meme, and the blank line after a closing think tag. Pushes the model to write '!' and markdown image syntax '![]'.

L27n1019.name: Opening parenthesis
L27n1019.description: Fires on an opening '(' right after a noun, number or term, starting an aside, unit, acronym or citation: 'Prophet (', '15.6 °C (', '(IGF-1', '(PDD-NOS)', and '=(' in ALL=(ALL). Pushed positive, it writes single consonant letters ('b', 'd', 'p', 'r') and spams them.

L23n2263.name: Word before 'activity'
L23n2263.description: The adjective or noun right before an event noun, mainly 'volcanic', 'brain', 'magma', 'earthquake' and 'hyper' (hypermethylation); pushes toward 'activity'.

L26n1697.name: Vehicle and transport nouns
L26n1697.description: Transport and space nouns such as boat, car, ferry, truck, bike, plane, and 'space' (boat-building, car ferry, space telescope). Pushes toward 'ticket(s)' and 'guest' tokens.

L26n901.name: Abbreviation letters
L26n901.description: Short abbreviation letters and symbols: 'Ph' in Ph.D., 'D' in 3-D or 2-D, 'T' in TDI, 'IG' in EIGRP; pushes toward short symbolic tokens (dp, df, DM).

L24n2033.name: Page and screen nouns
L24n2033.description: Fires on the noun naming a web or app page or UI piece (login, landing, menu, homepage, about, registration, title slide), often early in a prompt; pushes the model to write 'screen' or 'page'.

L26n120.name: Code identifiers, not prose
L26n120.description: Fires on arrows, dashes and file-extension tokens in code and command lines ('->', 'sh', '.py', 'HTML', 'AWS'). Pushes toward programming type and class names (DataFrame, Headers, MyClass, UIImage).

L27n2071.name: Word-start 'b' piece
L27n2071.description: Fires on a 'b' or 'B' piece that starts a word part or follows a hyphen (fire-b|ombing, -b|attle, Nes-b|itt, Bab|ylon, Sothe-b|ys, eye-b|row); pushes output toward 'bin' and 'binary' tokens.

L27n1201.name: Modifier opening noun phrase
L27n1201.description: Fires on the article or first modifier that opens a noun phrase in an instruction or prepositional phrase, such as 'to <<a>> saucepan', 'with <<a>> bronze', 'electric griddle', 'plain hair clip' and 'accom|panied'; pushes nationality and style adjectives like 'Chinese/Japanese'.

L26n733.name: Method preposition, activity -ing
L26n733.description: Goes strongly negative on a preposition or comma that introduces a method or a task list (by in 'by using this converter', 'such as' in task lists, for in 'for 2D lookups', the comma after 'from scratch'); pushes toward -ing activity words like writing, logging, computing, editing and reading.

L26n387.name: School/exam name words
L26n387.description: Fires on the head word of school, college, exam and agency names (School in Chilton County School Board, Technical in Technical College, Unified in Round Valley Unified School District, Health in Department of State Health Services, 'SE' in GCSE, 'out' in out-moded). Pushes toward 'student' and 'students'.

L27n1230.name: Acronym opening letters
L27n1230.description: Fires on the first letters of an acronym inside parentheses, e.g. '(P|DD-NOS)', '(O|CPs)', '(HD|HPs)', and on 'sur' in surges; pushes toward 'ID/IS/IT' tokens.

L24n1459.name: Give-up verbs → 'drop'
L24n1459.description: Fires on the verb or auxiliary right before a withdrawal, rejection or dropout outcome: 'been' abandoned, 'turned' away, 'turn' to, 'turning' to, 'school' dropout, 'or' reject or revoke. Pushes toward 'drop' and 'dropped'.

L25n2994.name: Words before 'market'
L25n2994.description: Fires on the noun or fragment just before 'market' (job, soft drinks, target audience) and on 'yc' in sycamore. Pushes toward 'market' and 'markets'.

L24n2689.name: Form and variant modifiers
L24n2689.description: Fires negative on the modifier that names a version or form of something, e.g. 'Latin-ized' form, 'active' form, 'infinit-ive', 'written' representation, 'archaic' spelling, 'high-risk' variation. Pushes toward 'form'.

L25n1454.name: Infinitive 'to' in promotion
L25n1454.description: Fires on 'to' opening an infinitive of purpose (e.g. 'ways to', 'how to', 'to endorse'), mostly in advertising and marketing text; pushes 'promote' and 'promoting'.

L25n1980.name: Predicate slot before central
L25n1980.description: The article or verb just before the predicate of a definitional topic sentence (is an, was, plays a, is of key importance); pushes toward 'central', 'center' and 'core'.

L27n654.name: Mid-word fragments, 't' output
L27n654.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a word split across tokens, often the second piece ('pan/til|t', 'rebut|tal', 'forfe|it', 'interpre|ts', 'exoplan|et'); pushes toward a bare 't' as the next piece, so steering spams 't'.

L25n3012.name: Organization-name word, predicts control
L25n3012.description: Capitalized words inside organization and institution names (Central Statistical, Christian Science, Management Board, meteorological, Daily) and Cons starts; pushes the model toward 'control' spam.

L24n950.name: Code identifier before noun
L24n950.description: Fires on programming identifiers and nouns, e.g. 'pd' in 'import pandas as pd', 'M' in 'M-file', 'node', 'string' and 'file', and 'canvas' in HTML; pushes toward 'object' and 'objects'.

L26n1812.name: '-ary' word-stem fragments
L26n1812.description: Fires on the stem fragment just before a '-ary', '-arian' or '-itated' ending (sanct|u|aries, benefici|aries, veterin|arians, pituit|ary). Pushes toward 'ar' starts like 'arm' and 'arc'.

L27n1881.name: Word-start fragment, 'comp'
L27n1881.description: Fires on the opening piece of a long or capitalized word split into tokens (Dim-, Gr-, Har-, Com-), strongest on the first piece; pushes 'comp' and 'com' continuations.

L24n1305.name: Word after convert
L24n1305.description: The word right after 'convert'/'converts' in conversion tasks ('converts ... to decimal', 'in binary form', 'in Roman numeral'); pushes toward 'binary'/'bin'.

L26n2655.name: Rare name opening fragment
L26n2655.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or Latin/technical term split into tokens, such as Cr|ataegus, Para|íba, Can|averal, Mon|olithic and bre|vitomentosus. Pushes toward 'ou' and 'out' fragments, and steered output degenerates into 'out of the out of'.

L27n2984.name: 'ar' word-start → 'arch'
L27n2984.description: Fires strongly negative on the 'ar' piece opening a word split into tokens (e.g. 'ar' in arbuscules, arthritic, archaeology, Arkansas; 'od' in Rhododendron). Pushes toward 'arch' tokens (steered output is 'Arch Arch').

L27n2171.name: Word-initial R
L27n2171.description: Fires on word-initial 'r' or 'R' pieces, such as 'R' in rake angle, 'r' in ranger, rationally, or rate, and 'Re' in Rethink, plus '-int' in low-intensity; the pole promotes 'rate'/'rates' and steered output spams 'Rate'.

L25n2595.name: Purpose 'to' before verbs
L25n2595.description: Fires on 'to' before a verb of purpose or avoidance ('adopt to reduce', 'in order to combat', 'wants to avoid'), and on 'be' in 'can be mitigated'. Pushes toward 'reduce', 'reduction' and 'reducing'; at dose -0.5 it repeats 'reduce'.

L27n550.name: Compound-word stems
L27n550.description: A combining stem whose compound word is still unfinished, e.g. 'Neuro' in neurotransmitters, 'Psycho' in psychotherapy, 'hydro' in hydrotestosterone, 'socio' in socio-spatial, 'poly' in polypropylene; pushes toward word endings 'et', 'ed', 'es'.

L27n1048.name: IPA and rare-script symbols
L27n1048.description: Fires on IPA phonetic symbols such as ə, ɪ, ˈ, and ʲ, plus non-Latin script characters like Devanagari and Thai; the pole promotes HTML character entities such as '&#', '&nbsp', and '&amp', and steered output spams '&nbsp' or '&#'.

L26n800.name: Opening quote or parenthesis
L26n800.description: Goes negative on an opening quote, dash or parenthesis that starts an aside or a defined term (“tear film”, — don't use, (minimum inhibitory); pushes '('.

L27n2199.name: Battle/military name starts
L27n2199.description: Fires on the first piece of a military, battle or weapon name ('Bofors', 'Pickett's', 'regiments', 'Battalion', 'PzK') mostly in battle text; pushes toward 'war', 'battle', 'fight', 'fought'.

L26n2929.name: 'b' starts, 'beta' output
L26n2929.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece that starts with 'b' or 'emb' (grey-b|rown, B|âtard, emb|arks, emb|rittlement, seab|irds, B|icycles). Writes 'beta'/'bet'; steering spams 'Beta'.

L22n1451.name: Code task output, counting
L22n1451.description: Fires on 'the' or 'a' right after output verbs in coding requests ('returns the', 'outputs the', 'displays the'), and on 'frequency', 'number' and 'running' in counting tasks; pushes toward 'count'.

L27n1275.name: Meta-prefix fragments, Met
L27n1275.description: Goes negative on the Greek or Latin prefix piece of a compound technical word (multim in multimodal, metam in metamorphosis, polym in polymer, metaph, hum in posthumously). Going negative pushes toward 'Met', 'met' and 'meta'.

L26n261.name: Compound mid-word pieces
L26n261.description: Fires on the middle piece of a word or URL split across tokens (bra|ai, cha|me|leons, dys|lexia, Fem|ales, the '-r' in cyber-safety-rules); pushes toward short word-continuation pieces ('em', 'se', 'sh', 'ph'), so steered text breaks into odd partial words.

L26n210.name: Word-stem fragment before suffix
L26n210.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, just before its ending (e.g. 'd' in doped, 'mol' in molten, 'vis' in viscoelastic); pushes suffix pieces like 'ary', 'ably', 'ate'.

L21n2467.name: Temporary and quick fixes
L21n2467.description: Words for a short-term or quick fix: 'term' in 'short-term' and 'long-term', 'temporary', 'quick', 'easiest', 'simpler', 'convenient', 'homemade', and 'One' opening a list of risks or methods. Pushes the model toward 'solution'.

L25n2078.name: Source and evidence words
L25n2078.description: Fires on words that describe sources or evidence in essay and research text ('trustworthy' information, 'supporting' ideas, 'primary' sources, 'synthesized' literature, 'given' text). Pushes the model toward 'material' and 'materials'.

L26n765.name: People-group nouns before possessive
L26n765.description: Plural people-group nouns (Women, Children, Patients, Doctors, students, girls) and people-referring pronouns (their, who) peak as they appear; pushes the model toward writing an apostrophe-s or 'd possessive or contraction right after them.

L26n548.name: Short mid-word 'y' pieces
L26n548.description: Positive on a short 1-2 letter piece inside a longer name or word, mostly 'y' or 'Hy', 'Cy', 'Ty', 'Ny', 'xy' (e.g. 'Ay' in Ayutthaya, 'y' in Pöyry). Pushes the model toward word-continuation pieces like 't' and 'tin'.

L26n3046.name: Stem before '-it' suffix
L26n3046.description: Fires on the stem piece just before an 'it' or 'ite' ending split into tokens (Benef|iciaries, forfe|it, precip|itates, inhib|it, exhib|itor, prof|iting). Pushes the model to output 'it' tokens.

L27n364.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n364.description: Fires on a digit or fraction in the middle of a number split across tokens (the '6' in 1863, the '7' in 787, the fraction '⅔'); pushes toward 'three', 'third' and '3', so steering spams 'Three'.

L26n1532.name: Material or substance nouns
L26n1532.description: Fires on the substance or material noun in a list or 'of/with' phrase (compost, foam, fire, cumin, animal protein). Pushes toward 'metal', 'fabric' and 'manufacturing'.

L27n1993.name: Uppercase fragments → AS/IS
L27n1993.description: Fires on uppercase pieces of all-caps or split capitalized words (NO|PASSWD, LE|As, MEN|A, I|GF-1, BT|W), mostly the capital letters right after a split. Pushes toward uppercase 'AS' and 'IS' tokens.

L23n2120.name: Measure noun → 'index'
L23n2120.description: Fires on the token completing a social, health or drought measure term such as 'inequality', 'drought', 'satisfaction', 'severity', 'quality' (of life), 'BMI'. Pushes toward 'index' and 'indices'.

L24n203.name: Mid-word fragments → underscore
L24n203.description: Fires on a fragment that continues a word or identifier split across tokens ('rev|istas', 'stat|uary', 'Stony|brook', 'mitted', 'concerned-parent'); pushes toward underscore-joined identifiers like '_r' or '_h'.

L27n1177.name: Stem piece to -ity/-ness
L27n1177.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, just before its ending: 'inhib' in 'inhibitory', 'infl' in 'inflow', 'asympt' in 'asymptomatic', 'radi' in 'radiate', 'follic' in 'follicle'. Pushes toward abstract -ity and -ness nouns ('complexity', 'simplicity', 'uniqueness'); steered, it writes 'simplicity' and 'independence'.

L22n1507.name: Words before 'name' slot
L22n1507.description: Words right before a naming slot, such as 'similarly' in 'similarly named', 'variable' in 'variable names', 'article' in 'article name'; pushes 'name', 'names' and 'named'.

L26n1446.name: Network and community phrases
L26n1446.description: The word just before the final noun of a technical or institutional name (Telephone| Network, scientific| community, Proof of Cons|ensus, Van| Gogh); pushes toward 'net' tokens.

L22n899.name: Purpose 'to' clauses
L22n899.description: Fires on 'To' or 'to' opening a purpose clause after prior context, e.g. 'To address this issue', 'designed to evaluate', 'to make sure the reading is accurate', 'double check to make sure'; pushes toward 'check' and 'verify', and at +0.5 it repeats 'Check.'

L24n1154.name: Graph and illustrate words
L24n1154.description: Goes strongly negative on words about drawing or charting data: 'graph', 'illustrate', 'illustrated', 'visualization', 'sketch', 'tangent', and on commas inside long lists of analysis tools. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'graph' and 'graphically'.

L27n1495.name: ALL-CAPS function words
L27n1495.description: Fires positively on ALL-CAPS function words inside uppercase headings and text (IS, OF, IF, THE, ING), and on the '-gr' piece of 'turf-grass'. Pushes the model toward 'IT' and 'it'.

L27n765.name: ALL-CAPS word pieces
L27n765.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of an ALL-CAPS word or heading (MESSE|NG|ER, CAL|AB|ASAS, LIFE|CY|CLE, E|LECT|RIC, EXT. slugline). Pushes the model toward capital 'R' tokens.

L22n826.name: init/int word starts
L22n826.description: The first letters of words starting 'init' or 'int' (init_subsystem, Introduction, integers, Integrate), plus 'Mat' and 'Pre' starts; pushes toward 'init' tokens.

L27n1736.name: Split-off 'c' letter fragment
L27n1736.description: The letter 'c' or '-c' as a separate piece inside a split word: 'under|c|rust', 'radi|oc|arbon', 'photoc|atalytic', 'count|erc|lockwise', 'c|actus'. Pushes toward 'cur'.

L24n1100.name: Word-start fragments, imm
L24n1100.description: Negative on the first subword fragment of a word split into pieces, especially 'Imp', 'imm', 'pr', 'sup' ('impr|actical', 'FOR|IMM|EDIATE', 'sup|ran|ational'). Pushes 'quickly', 'immediate', 'instant'.

L24n2706.name: Ending and termination words
L24n2706.description: Fires on words around an ending or termination, e.g. 'officially' in 'war officially ended', 'ab' in 'abating' or 'abridged', 'is' in 'battle is over', and 'to' in 'to end all wars'; pushes toward 'end'.

L23n959.name: Prepositions before reflexive objects
L23n959.description: Prepositions and verbs that take an object, such as 'to', 'with', 'like', 'against', 'among', 'of', where a reflexive pronoun ('themselves', 'herself') could follow; pushes reflexive pronouns.

L24n1757.name: HTML element names, determiners
L24n1757.description: Fires positive on HTML and web-UI element names (canvas, input, form, sidebars, elements) and on the article before them, e.g. 'a' in 'a login form' or 'an element'. Pushes toward 'div' and 'element'.

L21n483.name: Inside URLs and DOIs
L21n483.description: Tokens inside URLs, DOIs, emails and commands (e.g. 'doi' in '(Headache, doi.org', 'bit' in bit.ly, 'www', 'https', 'firstname' in email placeholders); pushes the next ':' or '://' separator.

L21n2100.name: 'the' before result nouns
L21n2100.description: Fires on 'the' (or 'to', 'in') right before the object of a result-producing verb in program or procedure text ('returns the', 'outputs the sum', 'divide the total', 'the resulting string'); pushes toward 'result'.

L26n1019.name: Dosing and treatment terms
L26n1019.description: Fires on dosing and treatment words in medical text, e.g. 'ose' in one- or two-dose, 'dosage', 'dosing' interval, 'antibiotic' treatments, 'prescribing', 'ketogenic' diets. Pushes toward 'reg' (regimen), and steering produces 'regressed' and 'regal' fragments.

L22n1791.name: Browser data, login storage
L22n1791.description: Negative on nouns and commas in lists about browser or account data ('browsing history, cookies', 'passwords', 'login', 'persistent', 'stored by'). Pushes 'session'.

L27n1689.name: Ownership context → property
L27n1689.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'property', in texts about ownership, slavery or privatization, e.g. 'as' in 'treated as slaves', 'private', 'national industries'; pushes toward 'property' tokens.

L26n1394.name: 'emb' and 'verte' starts
L26n1394.description: The 'emb' or 'verte' piece opening split words (emb|ark, verte|bral, embry|onic); pushes toward 'br' pieces, as in verte|br|ates.

L27n673.name: Long-word prefix, re
L27n673.description: Strongly negative on the prefix or middle piece of a long technical word (retro|viral, Prot|olaurasia, ant|iretrovirals, mult|ilayer, corticotrop|in) and on the first digit of '400°F'; pushes toward 're' fragments.

L26n1256.name: Spanish fragments -> 'os'
L26n1256.description: Fires on a mid-word or start piece of Spanish-flavoured or foreign words and names (e.g. 'Can' in Cañena, 'ma' in maquiladores, 'bur' in burrito, 'Chi' in Chiapas). Pushed negative, it promotes Spanish plural endings 'os', 'as', 'los', 'las' and spams 'os'.

L27n1716.name: Initial consonant word starts
L27n1716.description: Fires on the opening consonant or single letter of a capitalised name or word split into pieces (Pl|atanus, Fl|avius, B|ofors, l|abeled, br|ucei); pushed negative it promotes lone word-start letters (p, c, m, b, g) and garbled consonant strings.

L24n2733.name: Math problem setup words
L24n2733.description: Goes negative on math-problem setup words ('ill-posed', 'initial' in 'initial condition', 'differential equation', 'periodic', 'defines', 'set'); pushes the model to write 'boundary' or 'initial'.

L26n577.name: Fiction and film words
L26n577.description: Fires on fiction and film genre words (e.g. 'fiction' in science fiction, '-fi' in sci-fi, 'Scissorhands', 'video game'); its output points to 'film' and 'movie'.

L25n2313.name: Cancel-verb opening pieces, null
L25n2313.description: First piece of verbs meaning cancel or abolish, mostly 'ab-' and 'ann-' (ab|ridged, ab|ating, ann|ulment, ren|ounce); pushes toward 'null' and 'nullify'.

L26n185.name: Mid-word piece, foreign suffix
L26n185.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a name or word (e.g. 'utz' in Gutzon, 'opt' in optician, 'phot' in photovoltaic, 'Moz' in Mozambique, 'stabil' in stabilizer). Pushed negative, it promotes foreign-looking word endings like 'ificados' and 'ulado', with little visible steering effect.

L27n1185.name: Uppercase acronym pieces
L27n1185.description: Fires on capital-letter pieces inside biomedical or tech acronyms, e.g. 'G' and 'HR' in GHRH, 'UT' in 3'UTR, 'A1' in A1C, 'UB' in UBRC; pushes toward 'PR/MR/HR/SR' tokens.

L27n2271.name: Word-internal piece, writes ere
L27n2271.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-internal piece that often ends in r, er or ir (e.g. 'ir' in thirteenth, 'Fr' in Franks, 'lif' in lifespans, 'air' in prairies, 'ger' in germline); pushes word-ending fragments such as ere, el and ered; steered output degenerates into 'elerelere'.

L27n1739.name: 'e-' prefix, electronic
L27n1739.description: Goes strongly negative on the bare 'e' of hyphenated 'e-' prefixes (e-commerce, e-cigarette, e-book, e-newsletter); pushes toward 'Elect' and 'electric', which fit the electronic sense.

L27n1933.name: Academic degree and major
L27n1933.description: Fires on the token after a degree or program word, and on word fragments in academic text ('CS' in 'CS degree', 'major' in 'majoring in history', 'Studies' in 'Liberal Studies', 'multim-'). Pushes toward 'major' and 'minor'.

L27n1455.name: s after hyphen
L27n1455.description: The 's' onset of a word piece right after a hyphen or prefix (self-s|acrifice, self-s|ufficiency, quasi-s|culptural, un-s|upervised, Para-S|ummary). Pushes toward 'sup'-family tokens.

L27n1459.name: Prefix or compound-part start
L27n1459.description: Fires on a word-initial prefix piece or the first half of a compound modifier: 're' in reorganized, reimagined and reestablished, 'co' in co-operative, 'self' in self-organise, 'mis' in misshapen, and the first halves of federally-, newly-, culturally- and socio- compounds. Pushed positive, it writes compound-suffix tokens ('-based', '-like', '-style', '-driven') and spams them.

L27n1282.name: 'in' in fixed phrases
L27n1282.description: Fires (negative) on the 'in' or 'a' in fixed prepositional phrases, e.g. 'in' in 'health in mind', 'in place', 'in full swing', 'with a view'. Negative push writes 'view/views' tokens, so steered text spams 'view view'.

L26n2867.name: Name fragments, writes van
L26n2867.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of surnames and places (Bebense, Boddington, Shanidar); pushes toward 'van' and Dutch-name tokens.

L27n1984.name: Word-opening letter H
L27n1984.description: The letter H or h that starts a word or a piece after a hyphen ('self-H|ARMING', 'h|arvesting', 'H|addal', 'h|edges'). Pushes toward 'http' and 'https' tokens.

L26n2948.name: Mid-word fragment before -er
L26n2948.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens, mostly -metre, -rium and -ers words: 'omet' in endometrium, 'imet' in centimetres, 'ilit' in millilitres, 'OST' in FOSTER. Pushes toward word-ending 'er', 'era' and 'mer'.

L27n1538.name: 'v' in virus words
L27n1538.description: The 'v' piece inside virus, vaccine and vector words (retro|v|irus, anti-retro|v|iral, the 'v' of 'vaccine'), and 'distance' before '-vector' or 'oss' in Cossack; pushes toward 'vector' and 'vec' tokens.

L26n2119.name: Word before 'value'
L26n2119.description: Fires on the adjective or noun right before a 'value', 'potential', or 'benefits' noun, such as 'time' in time value of money, 'nutritional' in nutritional value, or 'academic' in academic potential; pushes toward 'value' and 'worth'.

L27n461.name: Name start; writes 'shows'
L27n461.description: Fires on the first token of a person's name or proper-noun subject (Jean, Chris, Barbara, William, Dr, Claude, Robert), mostly where a verb should come next. Pushes the model toward present-tense verbs after a subject: 'shows', 'leads', 'raises', 'creates'.

L25n1652.name: st- word starts, stable
L25n1652.description: Goes negative on the 'st' or 'St' letters that begin a word piece, especially after a hyphen ('temperature-stressed', 'cAMP-stimulated') or as a capitalized 'St' in names and tables ('Stable Isotopes', 'Mt. St. Helens'). Pushes toward 'stable' and 'stability'.

L25n252.name: Formula and URL tokens
L25n252.description: Fires on the digit, letter or '(x' right after '=' or '(' inside formulas, code and URL query strings: '1' in 'Cr1=', '4' in '=(B2+B35', '(x' in 'h(x) = y', 'category=', and 'ALL' in sudoers lines. Pushes toward '=' signs in code.

L26n893.name: Acronym openers after '('
L26n893.description: Goes positive on the first letters of an acronym, especially right after an opening '(' (UNC, UBRC, CERU, RVUSD, KCCU), and on non-final pieces of words like cantal|ou|pe. Writes short starts such as 'Cu', 'du', 'Lu'; steering spams 'Lu' or 'Cu'.

L23n221.name: Comma before consequence
L23n221.description: Fires on a comma that closes an if, because or as clause and sets up a consequence ('If exercise is done regularly,'), and on commas inside large numbers. Pushes the model toward 'then', 'thus' and 'therefore'.

L24n1728.name: Design-pattern list joiners
L24n1728.description: Software-design terms in lists: the comma or 'or' inside a list of patterns or types ('Factory, Builder,', 'Class or Type'), plus 'Data Mapper' and 'Consumer/Event' terms, and name fragments (Mag-, sar-). Pushes toward 'interface'.

L27n256.name: Token closing parenthetical acronym
L27n256.description: Fires on the last letter or number inside parentheses just before the closing ')' in acronyms and codes (CK[D], K-1[2], U.K.). Pushes toward commas right after the closing parenthesis.

L24n2841.name: Counts before grid units
L24n2841.description: Negative pole: fires on the number or 'per/few/one' right before a unit noun in grids, displays and lists: '6' in '6 pictures', '7' in '7 segment display', 'per' in 'per segment', 'few' in 'a few rows', 'one' in 'one letter at a time'. Pushing it negative writes 'cell/square/grid' and steers text into 'square grid' spam.

L27n1855.name: 'sign'/'qu' word starts
L27n1855.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most strongly 'sign' (sign language, significantly, sign of), 'qu' (quell, quasar), 'kin' (kinases), 'aqu' (aquarists) and 'phys' (physiotherapy). Pushes toward 'language'.

L25n1009.name: Numeral-system words, 'number' output
L25n1009.description: Adjectives naming a number system before a noun, mostly 'Roman' (Roman numerals), plus 'decimal' and 'binary'. Some stray hits on 'negative' and 'musical'. Pushes toward 'number'.

L27n2952.name: Harm context → loss
L27n2952.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'loss' or 'losses' in texts about harm, death or casualties, e.g. 'pregnancy' in 'reported pregnancy losses', 'Bee' in the honeybee colony loss report; pushes toward 'loss' tokens.

L26n66.name: Adjective stem awaiting suffix
L26n66.description: The stem of an adjective or noun cut off before its ending, e.g. 'mathematic' (mathematics), 'visual' (visually), 'Scientific' (-ally), 'MySQL' before 'database'; pushes toward single-letter word endings (y, c, m, x).

L27n1605.name: Place/people name pieces
L27n1605.description: Fires (positive) on the first or middle piece of a place or people name ('A|gra', 'Tar|quin', 'Vas|ude|va', 'Chug|oku', 'Ulu' in KwaZulu); pushes toward nationality adjectives like 'African', 'Egyptian' and 'Irish'.

L27n250.name: Word stem, writes endings
L27n250.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, right before its ending (pa|lettes, exh|ales, cl|ots, quint|iles, Nil|otes); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ths', 'omes', 'angs', and steering spams 'omes'.

L27n458.name: Opening paren before acronym
L27n458.description: Fires on the opening '(' that starts a parenthetical acronym, such as (SCI), (AIDS), (HIV), or (MDA), and on capital pieces inside acronyms; pushes toward capital 'S' starts.

L27n1416.name: Cont- word starts, control
L27n1416.description: Fires on the 'cont' piece opening containment, control and uncontrollable (e.g. 'uncont' in uncontrollable, 'Cont' in containment), often in disease or infection text; pushes toward control and controlling.

L27n106.name: Identifier pieces and underscores
L27n106.description: Negative firing on pieces of identifiers and code-like names, such as my in my_field, _fl in _flaps, N in Slovin's formula, or the 2 in a SQL table name; pushes toward underscore-joined names like _time, _key and _length.

L24n2417.name: Leftover and remaining words
L24n2417.description: Words for what is left over: the 'the' in 'fill the remaining part', 'days' and 'hours' in 'a few days left', 'the extra', 'the rest', plus 'fill', 'bury' and 'compost'. Pushes the model toward 'remain', 'remaining' and 'remained'.

L27n817.name: Capitalized name-part starts
L27n817.description: Fires on the token that opens a capitalized name or compound title ('La' in Ray LaHood, 'Ted' in Ted Stevens, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Dream' in Dreamliner, 'Water' in Water Lilies). Pushes toward single capital letters that start new names.

L23n2905.name: Center and middle locations
L23n2905.description: Fires on 'the' or 'their' right before a center or middle location noun ('the center of', 'at their centres', 'through the middle'). Pushes the model toward 'center' and 'centre'.

L24n2327.name: UI click steps
L24n2327.description: Fires on UI-instruction words ('Click', 'press', 'View', 'mouse', 'buttons', 'step') and on 'Contents' and 'Pages' in how-to text; pushes the model toward 'back'.

L25n794.name: Software tool names
L25n794.description: Goes strongly negative on the name or term token of a software tool, library or API (Matlab, scipy, PyInstaller, Audacity, 'Programming' in 'Programming Interface'); pushed negative, it makes the model repeat 'interface'.

L26n209.name: Al/ll name syllables
L26n209.description: The 'Al' or 'l' syllable inside names and split words, such as Al Alamein, Al Saud, Mevlana's 'vl', Hel-ens and Pell-agra. Pushes toward 'all', 'ell' and 'al' fragments; steered output degenerates into 'll' repeats.

L25n2882.name: Triangle and side words
L25n2882.description: Fires on the word just before a geometry noun in triangle and area problems: 'of' before 'sides', '=' before a formula, 'right' before 'triangle', 'known' before side lengths, plus the 'Kn' of Knidos. Pushes toward 'side', 'sides' and 'edge'.

L23n1141.name: Markup separator, writes dashes
L23n1141.description: Fires on punctuation or markup that opens a new segment: '<' and '|' in tables, ':' after a heading, '%' in a code comment, and the line break before a new section. Pushes toward runs of '-----' dashes; steered text fills with dashes.

L23n652.name: Slot before a count
L23n652.description: Fires negatively on the word just before a number or count, such as 'maximum' in 'maximum number', 'total' in 'a total of', 'reduced from' before a figure, or 'average'. Pushes toward 'num' tokens, which repeat when steered.

L27n1654.name: Pre-ur word fragments
L27n1654.description: Fires positively on the word piece just before an 'ur' sound, e.g. 'conj' in conj|ures, 'ch' in bro|ch|ures, 'nurt' in nurt|ures, 'lux' in lux|urious, 'punct' in punct|uring, 'ple' in ple|ural, 'h' in yog|h|urt. Pushes toward ur, url and URL tokens.

L27n2365.name: Hyphen compound '-p'
L27n2365.description: Fires on the piece right after a hyphen in compounds, mostly '-p' (twisted-p|air, shaded-p|ole, -p|atching). Pushes toward 'pair'.

L25n1074.name: Stems before -y
L25n1074.description: Positive on a word stem just before a '-y' adjective ending, such as 'squish' in squishy, 'tang' in tangy, 'cling' in clingy, 'tack' in tacky, 'guts' in gutsy. Pushes the model toward the piece 'y' and 'yield'.

L26n2357.name: Tech brand names
L26n2357.description: Brand or product names in tech and consumer goods, such as Google, Adobe, Android, BlackBerry, Chrome, and iPod, on the name token. Pushes toward 'camera' tokens.

L27n1442.name: Accented and odd characters
L27n1442.description: Fires on stray or accented characters and the fragment around them (´ in 'James J. Asher', ʻ in Hawaiʻi, � and ∂ glyphs, ri inside Siberia's IPA). Pushes toward accented letters ð, þ, é, ú; steered, it gives mostly normal prose with no clear spam.

L27n1754.name: 'c' word-piece
L27n1754.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'c' or 'oc' piece inside a split word ('photoc|atalytic', 'enc|ased', 'oc|ryphal', 'oc|curs', 'radi|oc|arbon'). Pushed negative, it writes 'cr' tokens.

L26n1313.name: War and military terms
L26n1313.description: Strongly negative on a word piece inside a military or war term, mostly in battle and bomber text (e.g. 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'Super' in Superfortress, 'atro' in paratroops, 'Pan' in Panzer). Pushes the model toward 'military' and 'soldier'.

L27n2730.name: Compound head before board
L27n2730.description: First piece of a compound whose second part is 'board' (head|board, fret|board, a|board, poster board, cutting board). Pushes toward 'board' tokens.

L26n1188.name: Verb stem before participle
L26n1188.description: Fires on the first piece of a verb cut mid-word in passive or perfect slots (e.g. 'l' in 'lured', 'em' in 'emigrated', 'f' in 'fiddled'); pushes past-participle verbs like 'processed', 'recorded', 'harvested'.

L23n1286.name: Example or output introducer
L23n1286.description: Fires negatively on words that introduce an example, sample or program output in tutorials and code prompts ('Example', 'sample', 'The program should', 'Observe', 'view'). Pushes toward 'output' tokens, which spam when steered.

L27n1276.name: Modifier before 'show'/'fair'
L27n1276.description: Fires on the first word of a two-word event noun (minstrel, air, science, cooking, awards, art) just before its head noun; pushes output toward 'show' and 'shows'.

L27n916.name: Opening paren before acronym
L27n916.description: Fires positively on the '(' that opens an acronym or abbreviation, such as '(SRG)', '(DLPE)', '(CCSSO)', '(DHT)' and '(PESCO)'. Pushes the model toward short capitalized tokens like Ca, La, Si, Le and Na.

L27n1423.name: Course and unit words
L27n1423.description: The word 'course' (esp. 'this course') and other lesson-structure nouns such as 'lesson', 'activity', 'object' in educational or training text, plus 'Po' and 'mal' word starts; pushes toward 'unit'.

L27n375.name: Software and web names
L27n375.description: Fires on a token inside a software, OS or web product or language name (Java, OpenJDK, PHP, Arduino, Excel, C++, Safari, Oracle) and on 'https'; pushes toward 'https' and web or social topics (covid, instagram), and steering spams 'https'.

L27n1673.name: Modifier before 'history'
L27n1673.description: Fires on the adjective or first noun of a two-word noun phrase whose head is still to come (labor, social, economic, natural, art); pushes 'history' and 'History'.

L24n1867.name: Determiner before job noun
L24n1867.description: Goes negative on a determiner or possessive ('their', 'the', 'its') right before a noun for a job, function or task ('carry out their functions', 'do the work'); pushes toward 'responsibility', 'job', 'task'.

L27n529.name: Business and finance context
L27n529.description: Weak, spread across business, finance and corporate text (interest rates, company proposals, SWOT analysis, incorporating); peaks on '%' after an interest rate and on 'inc' in 'incorporating'; pushes the model toward 'customer' and 'market'.

L26n488.name: Letters inside acronyms
L26n488.description: Goes positive on a letter or piece inside an acronym or abbreviation split across tokens, e.g. 'P<<DD>>-NOS', '(<<R>>NG)', '¹<<⁴>>C', '(<<DS>>HS)'; pushes the model to write more acronym letters ('NS', 'NG', 'ns'), and steering produces 'NSNSNS'.

L26n8.name: Inside parentheses, before closers
L26n8.description: Fires on the word inside an open parenthesis or just before a closing one, e.g. 'etc' in '(... etc.)', 'Joint' in '(joint between...)', and ALL in sudoers '(ALL)'; also fires on some word-start pieces like 'facet'. Pushes toward closing code tokens such as ');' and '];'.

L23n353.name: Closing punctuation before newline
L23n353.description: Closing or sentence-final punctuation (. , : ] ) and closing quotes) right before a line break, e.g. 'lizard.⏎', 'said,⏎', 'Ltd.⏎'; also the '[' opening a bracketed tag. Pushes toward closing code delimiters such as '))' and "')".

L26n1866.name: Extent and outcome words
L26n1866.description: Fires on extent adjectives (absolute, partial, generalized) and on the preposition or verb that sets up an outcome or state (result in, reduced to, threatened with, take over). Pushes toward 'complete' and 'total'.

L23n1470.name: Half after fractions
L23n1470.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before 'half' in fractions and quantities, such as 'in' in 'fold in half', 'and a' in 'two and a half', and 'than' in 'more than half'. Also fires weakly on 'nearly', 'almost' and 'about'. Pushes the model to write 'half'.

L22n597.name: Sentence end before connective
L22n597.description: Negative on closing punctuation that ends a quoted or question sentence ('Why me<?”>', 'What sound does that make<?">'), and on sentence-end periods. Pushes sentence-initial connectives like 'However', 'Therefore', 'Since'.

L25n2256.name: Finance and loan terms
L25n2256.description: The word just before a key finance noun in loan, option and banking text, e.g. 'alternative lenders', 'options contract', 'bank liquidity'; pushes toward 'investment'.

L24n2008.name: Ascending, descending, inverse words
L24n2008.description: Fires on the word before an order, direction or inverse term: 'in' before ascending or descending order, 'pro' before inversely proportional, 'moves' before backwards, '|' between ASC and DESC; pushes toward 'reverse' and 'inverse'.

L25n2694.name: The word 'time'
L25n2694.description: Fires (goes negative) on the word 'time' and on the word just before it in phrases like 'specific time', 'certain time', 'tell time', 'and time' and 'the current time'. Pushes toward 'time' tokens.

L27n138.name: Prefixes awaiting a hyphen
L27n138.description: Fires on a prefix or first piece that needs a continuation: 'tele' (telepathically), 'socio' (socio-spatial), and the '-to' in easy-to-follow; pushes toward hyphen-joined suffixes like -in, -time, -line and -step.

L26n759.name: Word before bare verb
L26n759.description: Fires on the word just before a bare verb is expected: 'to' after 'allows users', 'calls' or 'wish', 'can' or 'will' before a verb, and 'Please' opening an instruction; also 'wh' starts of verbs (whistling, whizz); pushes toward 'book' tokens.

L22n634.name: Determiner before parameter noun
L22n634.description: Fires on a determiner or modifier right before a parameter or value noun: 'any' in 'any fractional values', 'the' in 'the number of', 'default' subnet mask, 'optimal' values, 'a learning rate'. Pushes toward 'value' and 'values'.

L25n2860.name: List connectors, project
L25n2860.description: Fires on the comma, 'and' or 'or' that joins parallel items in a list of business, management or method names ('marketing, finance', 'Asana or Trello', 'Booch, OMT and OOSE'); pushes toward 'project', so steered text repeats 'project'.

L27n303.name: Verb stem before -ing
L27n303.description: The stem piece of a verb split into subwords, just before its -ing or -ed ending ('sne|ezing', 'tens|ing', 'pl|owing', 'attrib|uting'); pushes toward -ing verbs like testing and reading.

L25n1438.name: Auxiliary before main verb
L25n1438.description: Strongly negative on a modal or perfect auxiliary ('has', 'had', 'have', 'can', 'could', 'may') directly before its main verb, as in 'has so far not', 'had not been', 'could create'; pushes toward 'prove' and 'proved'.

L27n1214.name: Pre-'color' slot; writes 'color'
L27n1214.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an expected 'color' or 'colour': 'of' in people of color, 'food' in food coloring, 'Ocean' in Ocean Color Imager, 'Hair'. Pushing it negative steers toward 'color'.

L27n1043.name: Mid-word piece, word-piece writer
L27n1043.description: Middle piece of a word split into tokens, most often 'ul' in ulcers, plus Quiz|let, atem|alan, ah|ili, imm|emorial. Pushes toward word-fragment continuations and garbled 'ering' or 'ored' runs.

L27n1662.name: Mid-word 'c' or 'ex'
L27n1662.description: Fires on a short 'c', 'oc', 'ex' or 'photoc' piece inside a split word, right before the word continues (single-c|elled, exc|elled, Ex|eter, ex|otic, nematoc|ysts, photoc|atalytic); pushes output toward 'cell' and 'cells'.

L26n1726.name: Rotation and torque words
L26n1726.description: Fires on rotation-themed word pieces: 'rot' in rotatory, 'angular', 'torque', 'scopic' in gyroscopic. Also fires on unrelated word-internal pieces such as 'icit' in appendicitis, 'dyst' and 'ent'. Pushes toward 'moment', 'moments' and 'mom'.

L25n517.name: Festival and holiday words
L25n517.description: Fires on festival and holiday vocabulary, most on 'festival', 'Festival' and 'holiday' (also 'F' starts such as Fritters); pushes toward 'delight', 'beauty' and 'joy' tokens.

L27n1757.name: ML and parameter nouns
L27n1757.description: Fires on technical nouns in ML, statistics and linear-algebra text, e.g. 'parameter' in 'the parameter', 'classification' and 'regression' in models, 'eig' and 'keys' in eigen terms, 'value' in 'simulate a value', and 'into' after motion verbs. Pushes toward 'space' ('parameter space'); steered, it spams 'space'.

L26n670.name: Recipe quantity slot
L26n670.description: Fires on the space token right after a list dash, just before the quantity in recipe ingredient lists ('- 2 tablespoons', '- 1 pound'), and on 'years' or 'inches' before a number; pushes toward size words 'large' and 'small'.

L26n247.name: '(' before an acronym
L26n247.description: Fires negatively on an opening '(' that introduces an acronym or abbreviation (ERA, K–12, BTC, IDEA, ASD); pushes toward uppercase letter tokens.

L27n2961.name: Word-start 'b'/'emb' fragments
L27n2961.description: The first piece of a word split mid-word, often a 'b' or 'dr' onset (Middles|b|rough, Ab|eyance, emb|rittlement, seab|irds); pushes toward 'b'-initial words, spamming 'beth' and 'breathe'.

L27n1348.name: Words before 'trans'
L27n1348.description: Fires on the word just before, or the first piece of, a word starting with 'trans', such as 'reverse' before transcriptase, 'public' before transport, 'neurotrans' in neurotransmitters; pushes toward 'trans'.

L26n2741.name: Word-ending fragments
L26n2741.description: Fires on the middle or final piece of long words split into tokens, mainly German and Latin-style names ('ere' in Osterbaum, 'markt' in Ostermarkt, 'ichen' in Gleichenia, 'ace' in Lauraceae); pushes output toward German-style endings like '-ichen' and '-ften'.

L25n40.name: Link and citation closers
L25n40.description: Fires on the last word of a link anchor, credential or citation tail, e.g. 'here' in 'click here', 'link', 'page', 'below', 'YouTube', 'Reader', 'Ph.D', 'Inc'. Pushes toward closing quotes and brackets, and steering emits only spaces and newlines.

L26n2547.name: Media and product labels
L26n2547.description: The word that completes a media or product label (free software, CD maxi-single, Half-Speed, this ebook, View PDF); pushes toward 'CD' and 'cd' tokens.

L27n551.name: Modifier before head noun
L27n551.description: Fires on the modifier of a two-word technical or proper phrase, just before its head noun, e.g. 'Regional' before 'Cooperation', 'magnetic' before 'field', 'Monetary' before 'Fund', 'time' before 'complexity'; pushes toward generic nouns like 'feature' and 'parameter'.

L27n1762.name: Letter 'b' word fragments
L27n1762.description: Fires on a 'b' or 'B' that starts a word piece, e.g. 'B' in 'Blessed', '-b' in 'counterbalance', 'b' in 'baling', and '-B' in 'Abdu'l-Bahá'; pushes toward 'bound/bind' tokens.

L25n2194.name: Shell and sudo commands
L25n2194.description: Fires on command-line and install-tutorial tokens (-p in get-pip.py, NOPASSWD, sudo, yum, execute) and on pieces inside command or package names; pushes toward 'output', 'exit' and 'export'.

L26n2451.name: pro/app/apr word onsets
L26n2451.description: The opening fragment of words starting pro-, app-, or apr- (APPRO, appalled, apricots, proportional, propellant). Pushes toward 'prop' and 'Prop' tokens.

L27n2127.name: Integration into a host
L27n2127.description: Fires on the later piece of biology or implant words about integration, e.g. 'v' in retrovirus, 'oint' in osseointegration, 'reint' in reintroduced; pushes the model toward 'integration'.

L27n900.name: Infinitive/verb slot after 'to'
L27n900.description: Fires on the word right before an expected bare verb: 'to' before a verb ('lie quiet', 'continue', 'grow'), 'will' before 'be', 'they' or 'that' before a predicate. Pushes toward the bare verb 'select' and similar verbs; steered, it spams 'Select'.

L27n7.name: ALL-CAPS and emphatic negation
L27n7.description: Fires negative on words inside ALL-CAPS text, most strongly on emphasised caps words such as NOT, DON'T, TRULY, BOX and TAKE. Pushes the model to continue in uppercase, as the steered output shows.

L27n2958.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L27n2958.description: Fires on the capitalized or all-caps piece that starts a split word (Gr|aceland, CRE|ATOR, RESP|ONDENCE, SM|ELL, SW|ALLOW); pushes output toward uppercase fragments UN, ON, AN and IN.

L25n2623.name: Equipment noun in compounds
L25n2623.description: Goes positive on the hardware or setup noun in a machine description (gun turret, landing gear, all-wheel-drive, lighting conditions, turbine-generator, twin-turreted). Writes 'setup', 'layout' and 'configuration'; steering spams 'setup'.

L23n1678.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L23n1678.description: Goes strongly negative on the second piece of a word or name split into tokens, or the part after a hyphen ('-g' in God-given, 'is' in Bois, 'mon' in Cremonesi). Pushes the model to start word fragments like 'str'.

L26n1204.name: Verb-stem before -ed
L26n1204.description: Negative on the stem or prefix piece of a past-participle verb or adjective split across tokens, right before its -ed or -ated ending (t|amed, re|seeded, dev|iated, v|accinated, app|alled, res|ettled). Pushes toward 'connected', 'linked' and 'shared'.

L27n1473.name: Split-word fragment, -ar ending
L27n1473.description: The mid-word piece of a word split into tokens, most often 'spe' or 'she' before 'ars' (asparagus spears, shears); also 'Oh'|'ad' and 'metam'|'orph'. Pushes toward '-are', '-ary' and '-ern' suffix tokens.

L22n1230.name: Determiner before sum/calc
L22n1230.description: Goes strongly negative on determiners and adjectives ('the', 'a', 'their', 'weighted') that open a noun phrase about a computed quantity (greatest common divisor, the sum of, a weighted appraisal), and on 'calculate' words. Pushes the model to write 'sum'.

L26n630.name: Name-opening tokens, House writer
L26n630.description: Fires on the opening word of an organization, place or program name before its head noun (Cart|e du Ciel, Hot|amisligil's lab, Long|-term, Inter|faith, Her|mit Kingdom); pushes 'House', 'City', 'Board' and 'Company', so steering gives 'House' spam.

L24n1298.name: Post-noun 'that'; writes 'value'
L24n1298.description: Fires on the word right after a system, belief or society noun in argument prose ('value system [that]', 'international system [that]', 'creation myth [that]', 'cultures', 'society', 'continues [to]'); pushes toward 'value' or 'values'.

L27n1560.name: Words before 'service'
L27n1560.description: The word just before an expected 'service' (Civil, Statistical, Wildlife, dis in disservice, Geological); pushes the model toward 'service/Service'.

L23n2609.name: Click, then 'next'
L23n2609.description: Fires on 'Click', 'click' or 'Press' starting a UI step ('Click to view', 'click on New Student Registration', 'Press Apply') and on the first pieces of proper names ('Min', 'Ken', 'Pen'); pushes the model to write 'next'.

L24n2212.name: Framework name before 'app'
L24n2212.description: Fires on a framework or tool name just before 'application' or 'app' is expected, e.g. 'Using Python and [Flask]', 'Develop a Vue[.js] application', 'secure ... using [Flask]'. Pushes toward 'app'.

L25n709.name: Operation list connectors
L25n709.description: Fires on the comma or 'then'/'and' right before an arithmetic verb in a list of math or program tasks ('add, subtract, divide'), and on 'scalar' and 'common' in math text; pushes output toward 'multi' (multiply), so steered text stutters 'multi-multi'.

L27n1675.name: 'neut' before 'er'
L27n1675.description: Fires on the 'neut' piece of neuter or neutering in spay-neuter text, and on other word-start pieces; pushes the 'er' ending and 'Er'.

L24n2162.name: Split technical word stems
L24n2162.description: fires on the first fragment of a technical word split across tokens, mostly in linear algebra and physics ('eig|envectors', 'cov|ariant', 'cot|angent'); pushes toward 'matrix'.

L25n2334.name: Negative contraction stems
L25n2334.description: Fires on the stem of a negative contraction just before 't, such as 'isn' in isn't, 'couldn', 'didn', or 'weren'; pushes toward unapostrophed forms like 'didnt', 'isnt', and 'youre'.

L27n2088.name: con-/enc- word openers
L27n2088.description: Fires on a 'con', 'enc' or 'spr' opener cut off mid-word: 'Self-con|cepts', 'post-con|sumer', 'pre-con|ceived', 'Enc|ourage', 'enc|roachment', 'spr|outs'. Pushes toward 'construction' and 'construct' tokens.

L26n181.name: Percentages in statistics reporting
L26n181.description: Fires on the percent sign and separators in statistical reporting, especially '%' in 95% confidence intervals and ';' in relative-risk results. Pushes toward 'ratio', 'rate' and 'percentage'.

L27n1758.name: Spine and vertebra words
L27n1758.description: Negative on spine, vertebra and disc words (spinal, vertebral, spine, spinal column), with a smaller cluster on geology words (geologic, water); pushes toward 'column' tokens.

L26n2979.name: HTML tag brackets (canvas)
L26n2979.description: Fires (negative) on the angle brackets and tag name of HTML tags, strongest on the > that ends <canvas> and on the word canvas itself; weaker on random word stubs such as hem, Kr and Ne. Pushes toward 'tag' and 'Element'; pushed, it spams 'tag tag'.

L26n1634.name: Letter v word fragments
L26n1634.description: Fires on a 'v' or 'V' that starts a word piece: 'V' in Vitamin, 'v' in antiretroviral, plus weaker hits on mid-word pieces like 'tro', 'oc', 'cor' in medical and nutrition text. Pushes the model toward v-initial tokens (vittoria, villa, violet).

L27n334.name: Name before open paren
L27n334.description: Strongly negative on a function, variable or symbol name right before its argument list or an '=' sign, in code and maths: 'rhs' in rhs(t,y), 'h' in h(x), 'cot' in cot x, 'log' in log(length), 'R' in R(t). Pushes toward '(' followed by a noun, e.g. '(segment' or '(signal'.

L26n1226.name: Unfinished word-stem piece
L26n1226.description: Fires on the first, unfinished piece of a word split into tokens: 'recycl' in recyclable, 'confl' in confluent, 'radi' in radiographs, 'exc' in excise, 'wh' in whanau, 'Pers' in Persia. Pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ting', 'ried', 'ning', 'ry'.

L26n1510.name: Before 'used to' phrase
L26n1510.description: Goes negative on the word right before an expected 'used to' or 'accustomed to' phrase: 'isn't' before 'used to', 'get' and 'got' in 'get used to' or 'get in shape', and 'so' or 'more' before an adjective. Pushes toward 'used' and 'usage'.

L27n2814.name: Lone f, writes fill
L27n2814.description: A lone 'f' or 'F' piece that opens a word fragment: 'un|f|ounded', 'f|using', 'f|rozen', 'F|ocusing', '-f' in God-fearing. Pushes toward 'fill' and 'filled'.

L24n2010.name: Standard style and conventions
L24n2010.description: Fires on the word right before 'style', 'schemes', 'conventions' or 'system' in standards and how-to text ('citation [style]', 'consistent [color] schemes', 'astronomical [naming] conventions'). Pushes toward 'uniform' and 'consistent'.

L27n657.name: Short mid-word fragment
L27n657.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter piece inside a split word, often 'cu', 'ju', 'ru' or 'we' (cu|irass, ju|venile, we|evil). Pushes lone consonants j, k, z, h, so steering gives letter garbage.

L26n1535.name: Stem before a suffix
L26n1535.description: Goes negative on a word stem that a suffix is about to complete, e.g. 'short' before -ness, 'harmon' before -iously, 'Vari' before -eties, 'Priv' before -ileges. Pushes toward '-ly' and '-ness' endings.

L25n2135.name: Construction and building materials
L25n2135.description: Fires on function words and fragments inside construction, DIY and building-material text: 'of' in 'up to 20% of the cement', 'and' in 'lumber and', 'local' in 'local building permits', plus 'cement', 'DIY', 'recycled', 'Metal'. Pushes toward 'construction' and 'building'.

L27n687.name: Determiners before concrete nouns
L27n687.description: Goes negative on a determiner or preposition sitting right before the head noun of a phrase ('a', 'the', 'of', 'their', 'small', 'first', 'Royal'). Pushes toward concrete nouns like house, hand, box, road and boat.

L23n2189.name: Optimization and optimal
L23n2189.description: Goes strongly negative on words about finding a best value: 'optim' in optimisation/optimal, 'minim' in minimising, 'to find the optimal', linear programming, gradient descent. Pushed negative, it makes the model write max, maximize and min.

L24n1193.name: Pinyin syllables in names
L24n1193.description: Fires on a romanized Chinese syllable inside a name or term, mostly mid-word, e.g. 'Y[uen]', 'Sh[ing]-Y[ing]', 'Qing-z[hu]', 'Nanjing Xia[oz]huang'. Pushes toward pinyin endings like 'ian', 'iang', 'ao'.

L26n2395.name: Split-word middle pieces
L26n2395.description: Fires on a middle subword piece of a long word split into tokens (Syc|am|ore, sar|com|as, sal|am|anders, sulfo|xa|flor, pent|am|eter). Pushes the model toward 'mon' word stems.

L27n2892.name: Wildlife and hunting context
L27n2892.description: Animal and park words in wildlife or hunting text: 'National' in National Park, 'hunting', 'prey', 'wild', 'ungulates', 'gators', freshwater fish; pushes toward 'game'.

L26n1991.name: in-/re- word onsets
L26n1991.description: The opening 'ins', 'inc', 'inn', 'res', or 'resc' fragment of words with in- or re- prefixes (inscriptions, incidence, rescinded). Pushes toward 'ind' and 'Ind' tokens.

L27n725.name: Sentence-final period
L27n725.description: Fires on the full stop that closes a sentence, mainly in answers and short factual prose (corrosion<.>, immediately<.>, Probably not<.>); pushed positive it promotes closing code tokens like ');'.

L27n137.name: Auxiliary before predicate
L27n137.description: Fires on the auxiliary or adverb just before the main verb or adjective ('has' in it has been, 'also' in have also been, 'most' in most common, 'be' in can be tamed); pushes toward sentence openers 'Also', 'Now', 'Is'.

L27n2541.name: w-start pieces: win
L27n2541.description: The 'w' or 'sw' start of a split word, especially before 'in' (sw|immers, /w|inning, W|IRE, Sw|indon); pushes the model toward 'win' tokens.

L27n539.name: Hispanic names and places
L27n539.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a name or place in Hispanic-region text ('Jo|aquin' in San Luis Obispo, 'Ram|bla' in Barcelona, 'Aj|zen'); pushes toward nationality adjectives like 'Spanish', 'Brazilian' and 'Mexican'.

L27n1242.name: Object nouns before case
L27n1242.description: A household object noun that often comes right before 'case' (pillow, pencil, glass, display, cigarette, toothbrush); pushes toward 'case/cases'.

L27n2919.name: Word piece before 'ig'
L27n2919.description: The piece right before an 'ig' syllable (inst|igated, Vit|iligo, em|igrated, Rel|igion); pushes the model toward 'ig' pieces, so steered output becomes 'igigig'.

L25n1543.name: Mid-word fragment, predicts -ent
L25n1543.description: Incomplete word pieces that wait for an -ent, -ens or -ion ending (appreh-ended, preh-ension, oll-inated, Jø-rgensen), plus hou and Sole fragments; pushes toward -ent, -ension and -inant endings.

L27n995.name: Soil and earth topics
L27n995.description: Content words for land and nature: soil erosion, coral, olive varieties, the ozone layer, vegetation. Fires on the noun naming the land or environmental thing. Pushes toward 'soil', 'earth' and 'vegetation' tokens.

L27n2140.name: Single S word starts
L27n2140.description: A one- or two-letter capital start piece, mostly 'S' opening a name (Saver, Sart, Sándor, Siberia) or a hyphen-s piece such as '-s' in quasi-sculptural, and 'os' in stereoscopy; pushes toward 'series'.

L27n1850.name: pro word starts, project
L27n1850.description: The 'pro' or 'Pr' piece opening a word split into tokens (pro|portional, pro|vision, Pr|ize, Prop|ulsion); pushes toward 'project' and 'projects', and steered output spams 'project'.

L25n2017.name: Word-initial 'h'
L25n2017.description: A word-initial 'h' split off as its own piece (h|orticulture, h|awthorn, h|edges, h|ives, h|atching); pushes toward 'home' and 'hom' tokens.

L24n2715.name: Words before 'order'
L24n2715.description: Goes negative on the word right before 'order' in sequencing phrases ('the following order', 'what order', 'descending order', 'different order'); pushes the model to write 'order'.

L25n636.name: Fiction and falsehood word-starts
L25n636.description: Goes negative on the 'F' of 'Fiction' in fact-versus-fiction lists, and on word starts such as 'dis' (disprove, indisputably), 'f' (fad, farsighted) and 'proph' (prophesied). Pushes toward 'true', 'false' and 'truth'.

L26n1194.name: Company name second word
L26n1194.description: The word right after the first word of a company or organisation name (Warner Bros, Florida Power, Long Island Railroad, Federal Emergency Relief); pushes toward 'Co' and 'CO' company tokens.

L26n2283.name: 'Full' in view links
L26n2283.description: The word 'full' in 'view the full story / size / text / image' phrasing, and a few acronym letters; pushes toward 'text' and 'texture'.

L23n584.name: Comparison words: like/to/a
L23n584.description: Fires on the word after a comparison marker: 'like' in 'just like', 'to' in 'similar to' or 'compare to', 'a' in 'than a' or 'between a', and 'as'. Pushes 'regular' and 'normal'.

L27n923.name: Mid-word stem before suffix
L27n923.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, right before a suffix (fasc|iitis, ovolta|ic, forfe|it, retal|iate, per|nicious, Euras|ian). Pushes suffix pieces such as 'ity', 'ik', 'ib' and 'ié'.

L27n2810.name: Mid-word stem before -ul/-ol
L27n2810.description: Stem piece of a word split into tokens, right before an '-ul-'/'-ol-' ending (Im|mac|ulate, co|ag|ulation, α-toc|opher|ol, co|ch|lea). Pushes toward 'ol'/'ul' suffix pieces.

L23n1621.name: Divide and fold grouping
L23n1621.description: Fires on 'to' before 'divide', 'fold' in 'threefold', and 'equal' in 'equal groups', i.e. words about splitting or grouping. Pushes the model toward 'divide' and 'division'.

L27n16.name: Determiner before a noun
L27n16.description: Negative pole. Fires on a determiner or quantifier that opens a noun phrase ('the' in the fundamental, 'an' offence, 'our' daily, 'every' man, 'without' external), where a head noun must come next. Pushes toward capitalized nouns like Address, Performance, Properties; steered, it drifts into 'Access Control System' spam.

L27n2008.name: Stem before suffix fragment
L27n2008.description: The stem piece of a word split over several tokens, right before its suffix: 'apprec|iating', 'orig|ination', 'necess|itated', 'Spec|ified', 'accom|paniment'. Pushes toward short syllable fragments (PA, HA, GA, BA).

L27n3022.name: Name's second word, 'network'
L27n3022.description: Negative on the word that follows the first part of an organization or media name (Basel Action Network, Electronic Frontier Foundation, word ladder, TV), pushing toward 'network'.

L26n451.name: Motor and blower terms
L26n451.description: Goes strongly negative on words naming motor, blower or electrical equipment and its properties: 'ower' in blower, 'variable' in variable frequency drives, 'high' in high torque, 'starting' in starting voltage. Pushes toward 'electric', 'energy' and 'gas'.

L27n844.name: Body-system adjective before tract
L27n844.description: Fires on body-system adjectives right before 'tract' (intestinal, respiratory, digestive, urinary) and on pieces like Euras in Eurasia; pushes toward 'Tr' tokens when negative.

L27n1424.name: Manner adverb to method
L27n1424.description: Fires on the word right after a manner adverb in instructions (gently but, slowly and, quietly and, done correctly); pushes toward 'method' and 'methods' tokens.

L25n537.name: Units and money amounts
L25n537.description: Fires (goes negative) on the digit or unit symbol inside measurement and money amounts, such as 'm' in 'Mass (m)', '0' in '£30,000', '5' in '$9.5 million' and 'mole'. Pushes toward 'm' and 'mm' unit tokens and 'mama' repetition.

L27n595.name: URL and path tails
L27n595.description: Goes strongly negative on domain and URL tails (.com, .jp, sciencedaily.com/releases/...), and on numeric fragments inside URLs and formulas. Pushes toward '/' path tokens.

L27n1613.name: Modifier before element noun
L27n1613.description: Goes negative on a modifier that opens a technical noun phrase and sits just before its head noun: 'retro' in retroviruses, 'DNA' in DNA sequences, 'cutting' in cutting chips, 'space' in space weather, 'fuse' and 'circuit' in genetic terms. Pushed negative, it writes 'element' or 'elements' and spams them.

L26n442.name: Word starts, suffix output
L26n442.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word or name (Cho|osing, Freed|land, Crus|ade, Grad|uates, Har|bor) and on clause-opening words such as 'According' and 'View'. Writes word endings (-ically, -ly, -theless); steering loops on 'ically'.

L27n1883.name: Word-initial M
L27n1883.description: Fires on a word-initial 'm' or 'M' piece that starts a word or name, such as 'M' in Mennonite, 'm' in mares, mugs, and mowers, or 'Mon' in Monet; the pole promotes 'Ma'/'ma' and steered output repeats 'Ma'.

L27n2711.name: Caps fragment, writes 'CO'
L27n2711.description: Fires on a mid-word piece inside an ALL-CAPS or capitalised term (ASS in NOPASSWD and LASSO, tro in antiretrovirals, WE in TWEAK); pushes toward uppercase 'CO'-type starts, and steering spams 'COCO'.

L27n1311.name: 'd'-prefix pieces, 'div' writer
L27n1311.description: Goes negative on the word piece just before a 'd' or 'div' continuation: 'biod' in biodiversity, 'nond' in nondiscriminatory, 'pred' in prediabetes, '-d' in self-determination. Pushes toward 'div' tokens.

L27n1302.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L27n1302.description: Fires (goes negative) on a short piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'ish' in 'tr-ish-atorrey', 'ant' in 'anti-trust', 'mac' in 'macaws'; pushed negative, it writes uppercase 'ST/AT' fragments.

L26n1476.name: Stem before '-val'
L26n1476.description: Middle pieces of long split words that come just before a '-val' ending (medi|æ|val, re|trie|val), with weaker firing on other mid-word pieces (Siber|ia, Mill|an); pushes toward 'val'.

L27n274.name: Line break before code
L27n274.description: Positive on the line break after the empty think block, or on a colon, semicolon or bracket that opens a code answer or list. Pushes toward declaration keywords 'class', 'static' and 'public'; steered output spams 'class'.

L26n2617.name: Words before room/space
L26n2617.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an expected 'room' or 'space' noun: 'free' in 'free space', 'provide' and 'enough' and 'ample' before room or space, 'much' and 'little' before a noun of space. Pushes toward 'room'.

L27n1438.name: Ancient Greek/Roman names
L27n1438.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split proper noun in ancient-history text (Rom|mel, Prot|olaurasia, Sal|amis, Ang|ara). Pushes toward 'Greek', 'Roman' and 'Greece'.

L27n2382.name: 'S' word-start, pushes 'syn'
L27n2382.description: Fires on a lone capital or small 'S'/'sh' token that starts a word piece or follows a hyphen (e.g. '-S' in Pali-Sanskrit, 'silex', 'Siberia', 'sh' in shampoos); pushes 'syn'/'sync' tokens.

L27n336.name: Finance and money context
L27n336.description: Goes strongly negative in finance and banking text, on words like 'of' in 'cost of good sale' or 'amount of deposits', 'reserve at' and 'an increase'. Pushes toward 'financial' and 'money'.

L22n1913.name: Field-name tokens; writes 'id'
L22n1913.description: Fires on the name of a data field, key or URL parameter where 'ID' is likely to follow ('News' in '?NewsID=', 'employee' in 'employee_id', 'category', 'manager', the '(' before 'ID'); pushes toward 'id'/'ID' tokens.

L26n2814.name: Negative 're-' word starts
L26n2814.description: Goes strongly negative on word-initial 're' or 'Bre/wre/rem' fragments of split words (re|connection, Re|combination, rem|embrance, Bre|athing); pushing it negative steers toward 'combine/combination'.

L27n1518.name: Re- prefix word starts
L27n1518.description: Fires on a 're-' or 'red-' piece that begins a longer word, e.g. 'non-re|productive', 'dose-re|duction', 'irre|parable'; pushes toward 'reduce/reduction' spam.

L27n2679.name: Token after 'hard'
L27n2679.description: Negative on the token right after 'hard' that opens a compound, e.g. 'hard<-h>itting', 'hard<w>ired', 'hard<w>obbling'; also on 'w' or 'h' word openers like 'Rose|Hips' and 'Sea|water'. Pushes toward 'hard' and 'soft'; steered output spams 'hard'.

L27n1583.name: Stem before -il/-ile ending
L27n1583.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece just before an '-il', '-ils' or '-iles' ending (lent in lentils, quint in quintiles, mat in tomatillos, cod in crocodiles); pushes toward 'il', 'ils' and 'iles'.

L27n1557.name: Pre-'un' sound fragments
L27n1557.description: Fires on the piece right before an 'un' or 'ounc' sound (e.g. 'Pr' in Pruning, 'Ann' in Annunciation, 'Caj' in Cajun, 'pron' in pronouncements). Pushes toward 'un'/'Un' tokens (steered output is 'Unununun').

L25n2793.name: Modal before a verb
L25n2793.description: Goes negative on a modal, auxiliary or 'to' right after a subject, before a main verb (would, will, was, were, to, which); pushes 'take', 'carry' and 'bring'.

L27n496.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n496.description: A digit inside a number or year (the 2 in 27.2°C, the 8 in 1989, the 9 in 1982), pushing 'six' or '6'.

L27n179.name: Heading label's last word
L27n179.description: Fires on the last word of a short title or list label, e.g. 'Vitamin E' in a vitamin list, 'Africa' in 'What Animals Live in Africa?', 'Options Available'. Pushes toward commas and opening brackets; steered, it spams commas and newlines.

L27n2562.name: Negative: 'ground' before zero
L27n2562.description: Fires strongly negative on the word 'ground' in 'ground zero', 'ground level' and 'groundwater', pushing 'zero'.

L27n966.name: Quantifier before category noun
L27n966.description: Fires on 'other', 'another', 'various', 'common' or 'a' right before a category noun phrase, e.g. 'other space weather events', 'a common and painful condition', 'various mental illnesses'. Pushes toward 'forms' and 'form'; steered, it spams them.

L26n2694.name: Stem before a suffix
L26n2694.description: Fires on a word stem split across tokens right before its suffix: 'System' in Dassault Systèmes, 'cytok' in cytokines, 'techn' in technic, 'partic' before particulates, 'barg' before bargees. Pushes toward plural and suffix tokens 'es', 'e', 'res', 'nes'.

L27n2674.name: Piece after hyphen
L27n2674.description: The token that starts the second half of a hyphenated compound, e.g. self-|h|arm, meat-|e|aters, cotton-|e|ating, non-|he|ated, plus split starts like 'br' in bruschetta; pushes toward '-ating' and '-ater' word endings.

L23n2181.name: Follow-up / edit marker
L23n2181.description: Fires on the word that opens a follow-up or amendment note: 'Follow' in 'Follow Math Help Forum', 'follow-up', and 'EDIT:' or 'UPDATE:' before the added text. Pushes toward edit and update tokens.

L27n1766.name: Stem before 'net' ending
L27n1766.description: The stem piece just before a 'net' ending, e.g. 'son' in sonnets, 'safety' in safety net, 'mast' in mastoidectomy. Negative firing pushes 'net'.

L27n777.name: Medical/clinical word pieces
L27n777.description: Fires negative on mid-word pieces in health and clinical text (eff|usion, short|ness of breath, CINAHL, Fabry, Ep|ilepsy); pushes output toward 'patient', 'medical' and 'clinical'.

L27n2614.name: 'fl' onsets → 'flow'
L27n2614.description: Fires on 'fl' or 'infl' opening a split word (fl|ammable, infl|amed, fl|uvial, fl|ares, fl|ora), plus some 'inf' and 'ret' pieces. Pushes toward 'flow'/'Flow' (steered output: 'Flow flow flow').

L24n2181.name: 'in' after placement verbs
L24n2181.description: Goes strongly negative on 'in' (sometimes 'and') right after a placement or arrangement verb: 'connected in series', 'arranged in lines', 'fly in a pyramid', 'executes them in the following order'; pushes toward 'series'.

L24n2107.name: Money and cash nouns
L24n2107.description: Fires on money and finance nouns, most strongly 'cash' ('future cash flow', 'cash inflow', 'cash advance') and also 'money', 'dollars', 'payment' and 'earnings'; pushes toward 'flow'.

L26n336.name: Acronym openers; MC
L26n336.description: The first letter or token of an acronym, often right after an opening parenthesis, as in (MPCC), (WMO), (ISMP), (MPC) and (MCA). Pushes toward capital acronym tokens like 'MC', 'MU' and 'MB'; steered output spams 'MC'.

L27n292.name: Open bracket → closer
L27n292.description: Fires on an opening '(' that starts an acronym or aside, e.g. '(CARD)', '(PDD-NOS)', '(Elaeis', and on hyphen-joined compound starts like '-limited'; pushes toward ')' and ']' to close.

L26n1789.name: Mid-word name fragments
L26n1789.description: Fires on the second or third piece of a multi-token name or word (har in Philharmonic, adel in Philadelphus, chie in mischievous, osl in Yaroslavl); pushes toward 'f' fragments like 'fine' and 'fe', so steered output becomes word-piece noise.

L27n779.name: Word piece before ch
L27n779.description: Fires on the fragment right before a 'ch' ending (mul in mulch, bree in breech, Marrake in Marrakech); pushes toward 'ch' tokens when negative.

L27n1559.name: Compound modifier before noun
L27n1559.description: The modifier in a technical compound just before its head noun (gas in 'gas giants', white in 'white dwarfs', sewer in 'sewer lines'), pushing 'main'.

L26n360.name: Art and institution names
L26n360.description: Fires on the word inside art or institution names (Art Institute, Art Theater, 'of' in Institute of Physics, opt|ician); pushes aesthetic and style words like color, CSS, aesthetic and beauty.

L27n401.name: Subject pronouns before verbs
L27n401.description: Fires on a subject pronoun ('I', 'We', 'they', 'you') or an infinitive or 'or' marker ('to', 'or') right before a verb, e.g. 'I drew', 'We will kill', 'trying to wriggle'; pushes toward verbs like 'start', 'break' and 'end'.

L27n1625.name: Piece before v-fragment
L27n1625.description: Fires on the piece just before a split-off 'v' or 'va' fragment (chie|vous, retrie|vers, lar|val, cre|vasse, bre|vitomentosus); pushes toward 'v', 'va', and 'val' tokens.

L26n325.name: Word stem before suffix
L26n325.description: Negative on the stem piece of a word split before its suffix (attrib|utions, trib|une, compl|ies, dec|imation, res|ided, defin|ately), so it marks a word still waiting for its ending; pushes toward suffix pieces like '-orarily' and '-ations'.

L25n1826.name: M-file and script tokens
L25n1826.description: Fires on the 'M' or '.m' token that names a MATLAB file (M-file, simple.m) and on 'script' or 'file' in code instructions. Pushes toward 'file', 'files' and 'File', and steering spams 'file file'.

L26n515.name: Adjective and adverb stems
L26n515.description: Fires on the stem of an adjective or adverb that takes a suffix, such as pro- in proportional, contr- in contrived, squ- in squishy, and -ly adverbs like environmentally. Pushes toward adjectives of frequency and manner: frequent, continuous, direct, automatic.

L27n2606.name: Word-stem fragment before suffix
L27n2606.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, right before its ending, e.g. 'emb' in 'embarks', 'def' in 'defecate', 'add' in 'addles', 'bb' in 'scribbles', 'rob' in 'robust'. Pushes toward word-ending pieces 'ies', 'ys' and 'y'; steered, it spams 'ies' or 'y' endings.

L24n373.name: slot before bare verb
L24n373.description: Fires on the word right before a bare main verb: infinitive 'to' ('to identify', 'to fully understand') and adverbs or negation between an auxiliary and its verb ('do not want', 'also suggested', 'should be'); pushes toward 'capture/capturing', and steered text spams 'capturing'.

L22n311.name: Units/variables before 'equals'
L22n311.description: Unit nouns (metres, feet, miles, kilometres, inch) and single-letter variables like 'n' or 'I' right before 'is' or '=' in measurements and formulas; pushes toward 'equal' and 'equals'.

L24n2667.name: Exact / closed-form solution
L24n2667.description: Fires on words about solving or finding a solution exactly: 'found', 'solved', 'explicit', 'definite', 'exact', 'Find', especially in math text like 'can be found by quadrature'. Pushes 'closed' and 'analytical'.

L27n321.name: Subject before verb
L27n321.description: Fires on a sentence subject that a verb must follow: 'there' in 'There are two types', 'we' in 'we investigated', 'one' in 'one goes through'. Pushes the model toward 'has', 'does', 'contains' and 'requires'.

L27n247.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
