L27n247.description: Fires on 'to' right before a bare verb: infinitive 'to' ('to be read', 'to sign up', 'TAKE YOUR TIME TO EAT') and the 'to' in 'easy-to-follow' instruction phrases. Pushes toward action verbs like determine, create, calculate; steered, it spams verbs like 'solve' and 'create'.

L25n17.name: Un- and re- prefixes
L25n17.description: Fires on the 'un' or 're' prefix that starts a word (unclaimed, unaccompanied, unregulated, unifier, re-appeared, relearned) and on 'under' in under-delivery; pushes 'another', 'again' and 'multiple'.

L22n1352.name: Kind/type phrase words
L22n1352.description: Fires negative on the word inside 'one-of-a-kind', 'of its kind', 'of any type' and 'step-by-step', e.g. '-a' in 'one-of-a-kind' and 'its' before 'kind'. Pushes toward 'type'.

L27n716.name: Word before past participle
L27n716.description: Negative on the word right before a past participle: 'have/has' after a subject, 'get' before an adjective, relative 'that/which'. Pushes the model toward 'described', 'selected', 'identified' and 'stated'.

L27n1833.name: Second half of hyphenated
L27n1833.description: Fires negative on the second element of a hyphenated compound (anti|-shear, God|-fearing, Full|-Sized, Fat|-Soluble, Winter|-sown); pushes output toward 'side' and 'sides'.

L27n2577.name: -ise/-ize stem fragments
L27n2577.description: Strongly negative on a word stem split into tokens right before an -ise or -ize ending (inc|ision, conc|isely, treat|ise, inc|ised). Pushes toward '-ised', '-ized', '-izing' and '-ization' tokens; steered output spams 'ized'.

L25n1316.name: Mid-word fragments, suffix-pushing
L25n1316.description: Fires on a short middle piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'br' in fe-br-ile, 'fibr' in fibrin, 'hr' in Euphrates, 'al' in albacore. Pushes toward word-ending suffixes 'es', 'ed', 'em' and 'el'.

L27n1938.name: Electronics word starts
L27n1938.description: Word-start pieces in hardware and display text, most often around LED, bl|ower motors, MAX7219 mat|rices and DSI displays; pushes toward 'driver' and 'drive' tokens, and steered output spams 'driver'.

L27n213.name: Mid-word fragment, underscore output
L27n213.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a name or word split into subword tokens (e.g. 'vl', 'Gl', 'uzz', 'fon' inside names); pushes toward '_' so the next piece joins an identifier or word.

L24n2604.name: Name fragment inside words
L24n2604.description: Fires on a fragment inside a proper name or split word, e.g. 'Prim' in Primera, 'Lem' in Lemenstroopkoek, 'Fil-ad' in Filadelfia, and '-D' in Miami-Dade; pushes toward 'name'.

L24n1088.name: Determiner in domain-range math
L24n1088.description: Fires on 'its' or 'the' and cot/-co/Find tokens in cotangent and trig domain-range text (near 'domain', 'range', 'asymptotes'); pushes toward 'domain'.

L27n969.name: Quantifier before a set
L27n969.description: Fires on 'various', 'different', 'few', 'certain', 'several', 'some' or 'key' right before a plural noun for a range of things, e.g. 'various types', 'many different crops', 'one of the few options'. Pushes toward plural group nouns: blocks, sets, slices, strips.

L25n1387.name: Colon/newline before code
L25n1387.description: Fires on a colon or line break that ends an intro line before code, a list or an example ('like:' then newline, 'Here's one possible solution:'). Pushes toward code keywords 'else', 'while', 'try' and 'raise', and steering spams 'While while'.

L27n1038.name: Audience-goal verb, people writer
L27n1038.description: The goal verb or 'your' in marketing phrases just before an audience object ('increase' engagement, 'capture' attention, 'understand' which, 'Target' audience); pushes toward people nouns like user, student, child, customer.

L26n841.name: Mid-word fragment before continuation
L26n841.description: Goes negative on the first or middle subword piece of a word split across tokens, just before the rest of the word (Da|ughters, Veter|inarians, Č|ačić, Del|phians). Pushes toward garbled fragments like 'loom', 'glich' and 'hlen', and steering spams them.

L26n985.name: Institution-name opener, economic
L26n985.description: Strongly negative on the first word of an institution or title name (e.g. 'World' in World Bank, 'American' in American Journal, 'war' in war cabinet); steering it negative pushes toward 'economic' and 'economy'.

L25n3003.name: CSS/HTML styling terms
L25n3003.description: Fires on CSS and web-styling words mid-phrase: 'CSS', 'font', 'table cell', 'no border', 'canvas' in web-design text. Pushes toward the token 'class' or 'classes'.

L27n2999.name: Word before engineering
L27n2999.description: Fires on the modifier right before 'engineering' or 'engine' in technical compounds (Chemical, Biological, Industrial, Systems, genetically, Search Engine Optimization); pushes toward 'engine' tokens.

L27n1317.name: Modifier before category noun
L27n1317.description: The adjective or word stem directly before a head noun, e.g. 'popular' before cryptocurrencies, 'limiting' before gender stereotypes, 'rolling' before elements. Pushes toward 'classes', 'class', 'areas' and 'sectors'.

L27n17.name: Word stems, pushes suffixes
L27n17.description: Strongly negative on a word stem split from its ending (e.g. 'br' in tobramycin, 'trib' in tribus, 'ass' in assessor, 'inf' in infirm, 'var' in variances, 'contr' in contraption); pushing negative makes the model write suffixes like '-less', '-ant', '-ful', '-ably'.

L26n1963.name: Word-internal fragment, predicts ing
L26n1963.description: Word-internal pieces that wait for a suffix (cytok-ines, spr-outs, Veter-inarians, cont-ortionists, Shamsuddin); pushes toward 'ing' and 'ings' spam.

L23n1897.name: Word before 'difference'
L23n1897.description: Fires on the word just before 'difference' ('common', 'potential', 'temperature', 'find the') and in add-or-subtract wording. Pushes the model toward 'difference'.

L22n966.name: Deletion and list commas
L22n966.description: Fires on commas and 'and/or' inside lists of software operations (e.g. 'create, read, update,' or 'insertion, deletion'), and on delete/remove words such as 'deletion', 'delete' and 'Click'. Pushes the model to write 'del' tokens (del, Del, _del).

L27n308.name: Stem before 'v' piece
L27n308.description: Fires on a split word's stem piece whose next token tends to start with 'v' (tro in antiretroviral, Slo in Slovin, -pro in provoking, eig in eigenvector); pushes toward 'V' and 'v' letter tokens.

L27n1211.name: First half of compound
L27n1211.description: Fires at the hyphen joint of a compound modifier, on the word before it or the piece just after it ('tight' and '-k' in tight-knit, 'low' in low-income, 'well' in well-regarded, 'life' in life-threatening, 'high' in high-contrast). Pushed positive, it writes hyphen-plus-letter tokens ('-c', '-f', '-p') and inserts hyphens into plain words.

L27n2211.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L27n2211.description: Fires on a continuation piece inside a word split across tokens (e.g. 'ast' in Vastly, 'ar' in dinaric, 'ami' in Tanami, 'ant' in antler-like), and weakly on digits inside numbers; pushes more word-fragment tokens such as nodiscard, idential and ponde.

L24n2918.name: 'way/path/moving' before 'to/of'
L24n2918.description: Fires on a noun or verb that takes a following 'of', 'to' or 'forward' complement, e.g. 'before [moving] to', 'the [path] to pursue', 'a [way] of recognising', 'from this [point]', 'continue to do [so]'. Pushes toward 'moving' and 'forward'.

L26n2640.name: Generic split-word start
L26n2640.description: Goes negative on the first subword piece of a multi-token word of any kind, common or rare, where the rest of the word comes in the next token (cr|ickets, Hor|owitz, di|oceses, acc|idity, enc|odes, Rew|riting, Quick|-W|rites). Pushes toward short 'r' and 're' fragments.

L27n391.name: Digits inside codes/IDs
L27n391.description: Fires on a digit or superscript number inside a code, ID or measurement, e.g. '4' in '¹⁴C' and '344' in 'Fischer 344', '0' in 'NFPA 70E', '2' in americium-241. Pushes toward number words ('four', 'fourth') and '4'; steered, it spams 'four' or '4444'.

L22n571.name: Method name before ()
L22n571.description: Fires on a function or method name right before its call parentheses: 'seek' in 'seek()', '.head' in 'dataset.head(5)', and 'Canvas' or 'Extreme' in tutorial text. Pushes toward () tokens, with a weak steered effect.

L27n2860.name: pr word-start, writes principle
L27n2860.description: Word-start 'pr' or 'Pr' piece (pr|actices, Pr|ismic, pr|ays, Pr|akasa); pushes toward 'principle' and 'principal'.

L21n1335.name: Passive 'by', 'by default'
L21n1335.description: The preposition 'by' right after a passive participle or adjective ('available by default', 'stored by Google', 'swapped by crossing', 'named by'), strongest in 'by default'. Pushes toward 'by' and 'default'.

L25n561.name: Word stem before suffix
L25n561.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word that a suffix completes, right before the suffix (observ|ance, dos|ing, persist|ing, predict|ability, conserv|ativeness, occup|ant, know|-how). Pushed negative it steers output toward suffix-like endings 'gether' and 'etheless'.

L27n983.name: 'self' in compounds
L27n983.description: Goes negative on 'self' as a prefix or standalone word (self-harm, Self-compassion, self-reported, NOTE TO SELF), plus 'IS' in 'TEENAGER IS SELF-HARMING'; pushes the token 'self', spamming it when steered.

L23n2125.name: 'put/bring' before 'an end'
L23n2125.description: Verbs 'put', 'bring', 'brought' and the article 'an' that set up 'an end' idioms, as in 'bring an end to' and 'put an end to'; pushes 'end' and 'ends'.

L27n2596.name: Standalone 'd' word piece
L27n2596.description: Goes strongly negative on a standalone 'd' or 'D' that begins or splits off a word piece ('D|SI', 'd|ialysate', 'd|ihydrogen', 'd|ocking'). Pushed negative, it writes 'dim' and 'dimension' tokens.

L24n954.name: 'Genetically' and lasting change
L24n954.description: 'genetically' and 'etic' pieces of genetic and genetics, plus 'forever' in 'changed forever' and 'altered forever', and the 't' of 'don't result in'. Pushes the model toward 'modification', 'mod' and 'modify'.

L27n1834.name: Proper-noun start, writes 'states'
L27n1834.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised proper name in running text (Hittites, Hume, Zatorre, Pisa, Guimarães, Puma); pushes toward 'states/States', and steering spams 'states'.

L27n3024.name: Stem before -ify ending
L27n3024.description: Fires on the stem piece of a split word just before an -ify or -ified ending (rat|ify, exempl|ify, cruc|ified), plus similar Latin-root pieces; pushes toward if, ify and ified tokens.

L26n1626.name: Pre-'am' word fragments
L26n1626.description: Strongly negative on the piece before an 'am' inside a split word (e.g. 'opot' in Hippopotamus, 'fo' in Styrofoam, 'orig' in origami, 'g' in polygamy). Pushes the model toward 'am'.

L27n2953.name: Tell/tale word fragments
L27n2953.description: The 't' or 'ret' piece that opens 'tell', 'tale', 'telling', 'tossed', and the '-t' in hyphenated 'tail' or 'tenths'. Pushes toward 'story', 'stories', 'tell', 'told'.

L27n2188.name: re- prefix start
L27n2188.description: The 're' or 'Re' piece opening a word after a prefix or hyphen (non-|re|newable, |Re|usable, |re|seeded, |Re|productive). Pushes toward 'replace' and 'replacement'.

L25n648.name: Di-/Br- starts; 'different' output
L25n648.description: Fires on the first fragment of words starting Di, Dis, Br or nond- (nond|iscriminatory, Di|wali, Br|unsbüttel, Dis|secting). Pushes toward 'different', 'distinct' and 'differ'.

L27n243.name: Word-completing later fragments
L27n243.description: Negative pole. Fires on the piece that continues a word after its first fragment (sar|com|as, scrib|bles, Zara|goza, ex|h|ales, Schenk|ensch|ans, th|robbed). Pushes toward suffix pieces 'ases' and 'ess'; steered, it spits 'essessess'.

L27n1179.name: Posture and position words
L27n1179.description: Goes negative on posture and placement words: 'stood', 'sat', 'standing', 'lying', 'directly', and 'in' before 'front of'. Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'before' and 'front'.

L27n1451.name: Past-participle verb stems
L27n1451.description: Fires (negative) on the opening piece of a past-participle verb after has, was or be, split into tokens ('rec|eded', 'dec|imated', 'inf|ested', 'c|logged', 'ro|amed'); pushes toward 'reduced', 'improved' and 'increased'.

L27n889.name: Stem before -ish
L27n889.description: Fires on the stem just before an 'ish' ending, e.g. 'extingu|ish', 'demol|ish', 'replen|ish'; pushes toward 'sh' tokens.

L26n346.name: Stems before -tion nouns
L26n346.description: A verb or noun stem split just before its nominalizing suffix (recogn|ising, attrib|utions, separ|ability, Surre|nder, quant|ification). Pushes toward '-tion' nouns such as definition, description and measurement.

L27n1967.name: Word-start H to hold
L27n1967.description: Strongly negative on a lone 'H' or 'h' that starts a word, often after a hyphen or at a sentence start (Hindus, Habitat, HIDE, self-harm, hiding). Pushes toward 'hold' and 'held'.

L27n2787.name: Mid-word fragment, predicts '-ion'
L27n2787.description: Fires on an unfinished middle piece of a long word split into subtokens, e.g. 'acc' in Maccabee, 'ath' in glutathione, 'mol' in molting, 'Dip' in Diplopoda. Pushes toward word-ending '-ion' and '-son' tokens; steered, it spams 'Son'.

L27n763.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n763.description: Fires on a digit inside a number, such as the 7 in 1752, the 5 and 8 in 1584, and the 8 in 'Mar. 8'; pushes toward 'eight'.

L26n2244.name: Possessive 's predictor
L26n2244.description: Goes strongly negative on the head word of a possessor (Nurses, Women, consumer, master, Knight) just before a possessive 's, where 's, his or her is expected next; pushes toward 's, his, her and their.

L27n1773.name: Word-initial 'c' pieces
L27n1773.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'c' or 'cr' opening piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'c' in clogged and cabs, 'cr' in crannog, 'cruc' in crucified. Pushes toward 'cross'.

L23n1669.name: Property and attribute nouns
L23n1669.description: Fires negative on words that name a property or attribute in technical specs, e.g. 'height' and 'width' in an attribute list, 'properties' after 'consists of', 'right' in 'left and right'. Pushes toward 'property'.

L27n1209.name: Modifier before 'change'
L27n1209.description: Fires on a noun modifier right before 'change(s)' in a compound ('clim'ate, 'sea'-level, 'diaper'-changing) and on compound openers like 'accom'panied; pushes toward 'change', 'changes', 'changing'.

L24n1420.name: Modifier before conditions
L24n1420.description: Negative on an adjective right before a noun about setting or circumstances: 'initial' in 'initial condition', 'initial spectrum', 'initial investment'; 'organizational' and 'favourable' before conditions; 'natural' before relief. Pushes 'conditions'.

L27n2496.name: Split 'p' compound opener
L27n2496.description: Negative on the 'p' that opens a split compound, e.g. 'shaded-p|ole', 'twisted-p|air', 'anti-p|andemic', 'P|esticides'; pushes toward 'pol/poly' tokens.

L27n2622.name: 're' prefix, pushes 'receive'
L27n2622.description: Strongly negative on 're' fragments that start a word or a hyphen-joined prefix (e.g. 're' in reigned and reconstitution, '-re' in time-released); pushing negative makes the model write 'receive'/'received'.

L26n1367.name: Shell paths, cd commands
L26n1367.description: Fires on the space or newline just before a shell command or path (cd /var, >> /etc/sudoers, root and ALL=(ALL) lines). Pushes the model toward the '/' path-separator token.

L25n2816.name: Data-analysis prose context
L25n2816.description: Fires on function words and word-pieces in data-science and statistics prose, e.g. 'for' in 'label encoding for this task', 'of' in 'analysis of complex datasets', 'between' in 'regression and classification'. Pushes toward 'factor'/'categories', and steering repeats 'factor'.

L27n612.name: Determiner before noun head
L27n612.description: Fires on the adjective or determiner right before a noun head, e.g. 'different' in 'different heights', 'major' in 'major hurdles', 'these' in 'these requirements', 'negative' in 'negative impacts', 'its' in 'its safe working load'. Pushes toward 'treatment', 'payment', 'production'; steered, it spams 'treatment'.

L27n239.name: System-prompt opening 'You'
L27n239.description: Fires hardest on the word 'You' that opens the chat system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant') and on early template tokens; pushes toward closing tokens like ')' and quote-paren, and steering spams '**'.

L27n1300.name: 'You are' boilerplate, closers
L27n1300.description: Fires on 'are' in the boilerplate 'You are a helpful assistant' system prompt, and weakly on word starts like 'sc' in scallions; pushes closing brackets like ')' and '}'.

L27n891.name: Chat user-turn role token
L27n891.description: Fires on the 'user' role word right after '<|im_start|>' that opens a user turn in chat prompts, and is near zero in web text; pushes toward ';' and '{' code punctuation.

L26n648.name: Chat turn marker, ':'
L26n648.description: Fires on the '<|im_start|>' token that opens a user or assistant turn in the chat template. Pushed negative, it promotes colon and closing-bracket tokens like '):' and ']:' with little visible effect.

L27n434.name: System-prompt opener 'You'
L27n434.description: Fires on 'You' opening the system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant... No lists') and on 'Please' and 'Operations' in other text. Pushes the model toward 'list', 'range', 'level' and 'format'.

L27n53.name: Chat role token, tech-tails
L27n53.description: Fires on the 'system' token right after '<|im_start|>' at the start of chat prompts and on the tail piece of long technical words split into pieces (e.g. 'mitters' in neurotransmitters, 'cos' in aminoglycosides); pushes single capital letters, and steered output becomes garbled capitals like BZK BZK.

L27n301.name: Newline opening assistant reply
L27n301.description: Goes strongly negative on the newline right after '<|im_start|>assistant' or '</think>' in chat prompts, i.e. the first token of a reply; pushes word-ending suffixes like -theless, -antly and -izes, and steered output degenerates into 'adows' loops.

L26n230.name: Closing quote/paren; <think>
L26n230.description: Goes negative on closing punctuation after a quote or parenthesis, such as a period then close-paren or a question mark then close-paren, and most strongly on the <think> token that opens a chat-template assistant reply; pushes toward closing tokens like close-quote-bracket and ?).

L26n317.name: Think-tag start, filler
L26n317.description: Fires on the '<think>' token that opens the assistant's reply in chat-template prompts (and on 'repetition' in system prompts); pushes toward underscore lines, blank lines and '[...]' filler.

L27n783.name: Chat-turn breaks, name pieces
L27n783.description: Fires on the newline between chat-template turns (after <|im_end|> and before the assistant turn) and on name or word pieces such as 'Hil' in Hilfiger and 'eg' in lifeguards; pushes toward code attribute tokens like 'src' and 'img'.

L27n1061.name: Newline opening assistant reply
L27n1061.description: Goes strongly negative on the newline right after '<|im_start|>assistant' and before '<think>' in chat prompts (peaks 8-10); the top-token averages are noisy; pushes toward commas and closing '),' tokens.

L27n709.name: Chat turn-end newline
L27n709.description: Fires (goes negative) on the newline right after a user message's <|im_end|>, just before the assistant turn; weaker on mid-word fragments like 'az' and 'kn' in web text. Pushes output toward a bare 'a' token, which the steered run repeats as 'aa(aa('.

L27n2222.name: Chat turn-end newline
L27n2222.description: Fires on the newline that closes a user turn just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat-formatted text, and on '√' in math. Pushes toward ellipsis '..' tokens.

L24n2179.name: digits in years, credentials
L24n2179.description: Fires on digits inside historical years and dates (the '0' or '4' in '270 AD', '640 BC', '1143') and on the comma or 'MD'/'DO' after a person's name; pushes toward capital era or credential tokens like 'AD', 'CB', 'CS', and steered text stays mostly normal.

L27n207.name: 'a' before predicate adjective
L27n207.description: Strongly negative on the indefinite article 'a'/'an' (or 'can'/'have') opening a predicate in a chat answer, e.g. 'is a buzzword', 'is an essential', 'can have'; pushing negative makes the model spam quote and period tokens.

L27n802.name: Turn-end newline; name starts
L27n802.description: Strongest on the newline that closes a user message just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat prompts. Also fires on capitalised name starts such as 'Pr', 'P', 'Pacific', 'Share'. Pushes toward the em dash '—'.

L27n72.name: Turn boundary, quote-paren closers
L27n72.description: The newline right after a user turn's <|im_end|>, where the assistant reply starts; also fires on 'assistant' and '<think>' tokens. Pushes the model toward closing quote-and-paren tokens such as ”) and **).

L27n1370.name: Chat turn-end newline
L27n1370.description: Goes strongly negative on the newline right after a user turn's '<|im_end|>', just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat prompts; pushes toward markdown '**' and closing punctuation.

L27n688.name: Word fragment, writes 'type'
L27n688.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a long or Latin-style name split across tokens (ver in Averrhoa, Sch|izaeaceae, pent|ameter, az|olidinones), and on the start of chat system prompts; pushes toward 'type/Type'.

L26n1199.name: ALL-CAPS word continuations
L26n1199.description: Fires on later pieces of ALL-CAPS headings and split words (e.g. 'CLE' in CYCLE, 'ACH' in APPROACH, 'SOURCE' after 'A NEW', 'SHOULD' after 'WHAT'), strongest inside uppercase runs; pushes toward non-English word-fragment continuations like 'manent' and 'nhiên', with little visible effect on text.

L27n1926.name: Newline before assistant reply
L27n1926.description: Goes negative on the newline or '<think>' that opens an assistant turn after a chat question, and on some word fragments ('ort' in Bortnyik, '-z' in zippers, 'mis'). Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'measure'.

L26n1765.name: Blood, component
L26n1765.description: Strongly negative on 'blood' in medical text (e.g. 'blood vessels', 'blood-brain barrier', 'blood clot', 'blood flow'); steering it negative pushes toward 'component' tokens.

L23n1946.name: 'Look' and lookup verbs
L23n1946.description: Goes strongly negative on 'look', 'looking', 'looked' and 'lookup' ('2D lookups', 'look up', 'look at', 'look for'), including non-table uses. Pushes toward 'table' and 'tables'.

L27n2250.name: Split-word starts, chat newlines
L27n2250.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'hyp' in hypodermis, 'Tr' in Trang, 'sh' in shunt; also on the newline that closes a user turn in chat prompts. Pushes toward ')' and quote-closing punctuation.

L25n1274.name: Closing think-tag token
L25n1274.description: Fires on the '</think>' token that closes the empty reasoning block right before the answer in chat-format responses, almost every time. Pushes toward closing quote-paren code pairs, with little visible effect.

L13n1255.name: Numbered list opener punctuation
L13n1255.description: Negative on the '.' or ':' right after a list number or item heading in chat answers ('1<.>', 'Create a filing system<:>'), and on the first word after '</think>'. Writes odd code-like tokens.

L24n1318.name: 'is' before value, zero
L24n1318.description: Fires on the verb 'is' before a value ('cosine value is 0', 'current is high'), on the leading digit of years like 2030 or 2050, and on 'virtually'; pushes the model toward 'zero'.

L26n2351.name: 'helpful' in assistant prompts
L26n2351.description: Fires on 'helpful' in 'You are a helpful assistant' system prompts and on 'help' in help desk. Pushes toward 'main' and 'character' tokens.

L26n335.name: Nutrition and chem words
L26n335.description: Fires negative on nutrition and food-chemistry words: 'omega' in omega-3, 'saturated', 'tomato', 'broccoli', 'palm', and hydro-, electro-, quantum- prefixes. Pushes toward 'chem/chemistry/chemical'; steered output spams 'Chem'.

L26n1064.name: Named-entity first tokens
L26n1064.description: Positive on the first token of a proper name or organization phrase, such as 'Lund' in Lund University, 'Johan' in Johan Huizinga, 'Veterinary' in Veterinary Public Health, 'Henry' in Henry Walker. Pushes the model toward 'stolen' and 'fake'.

L27n1349.name: Short fragments, rare words
L27n1349.description: Fires on a short fragment, often 2 letters, that opens a rare, capitalised or technical word split across tokens ('tr|is', 'Bl|anche', 'Nec|rolestes', 'V|itiligo', 'TR|UL|Y'); pushes toward 'answer' and 'Answer', so steering spams 'answer'.

L27n26.name: System-prompt 'You are' openers
L27n26.description: Fires on the 'You' that opens the system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant'), on the 'assistant' that follows, and on instructive words in how-to text ('click any word', 'sign up', 'desktop or laptop'). Pushes toward rare nouns and story-like prose.

L26n1694.name: Modal should and that
L26n1694.description: Fires on 'should' and 'that' that open a requirement in creative-writing prompts ('The song should', 'a play that'), and on item or subject nouns like 'tee', 'cuisine', 'bracelet', 'monument'. Pushes toward 'feature' and 'features'.

L26n1875.name: Capital name-start, T/Bo/Di
L26n1875.description: A capitalised first piece of a name or title, most often a lone 'T' (Tomo, Toulouse, Treatise), also 'Bo' and 'Di'. Pushes toward 'version'; steered, it spams 'version'.

L25n556.name: Digits in dates/refs
L25n556.description: Fires on the digit or separator inside a date, verse or figure number (the 1 in January 1, 1863; the colon in Mark 9:11; 5.11 in Figure 5.11; the 1 in ICD-10); pushes stray 'l' tokens.

L27n1721.name: Newline after chat turn
L27n1721.description: Fires positively on the newline right after the chat-template '<|im_end|>' that opens the assistant turn, before the think block. Pushes the model toward 'book' and 'books'.

L25n2363.name: Split-name fragments, insert
L25n2363.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a name or rare word split into subword tokens, such as 'Ste' in Stephen, 'ö' in Pöyry, 'ø' in Høivik, or 'ots' in Potsdam. Pushes the model toward the word 'insert' and its forms.

L24n2899.name: Gadget feature lists
L24n2899.description: Commas and gadget nouns in product-feature lists, such as 'battery', 'camera', 'handheld', 'microphone' and 'compact'; pushes toward 'port' and 'Port'.

L26n1692.name: Split-word tails
L26n1692.description: Goes negative on the second half of long split words, most often 'ptic' in septic and sepsis and 'Th' in Thompson. Also fires on 'helpful' and 'assistant' in the system prompt. Pushes toward the 'mult' prefix.

L25n2284.name: Modal before main verb
L25n2284.description: Fires on a modal or auxiliary just before the main verb: 'you'll' in 'you'll be paying', 'will' in 'will stay', 'might' in 'might not solve', 'could', 'don't' before 'damage', and 'we' before 'have'. Pushes toward 'end' and 'ends' forms.

L23n1254.name: Drawing and geometry determiners
L23n1254.description: Goes strongly negative on articles and prepositions before shape or drawing nouns ('a sheet of paper', 'the given figure', 'closed curve', 'vector equation of'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'coordinate'.

L26n2988.name: Place-name mid-fragments
L26n2988.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of place and proper names: 'rd' in Córdoba, 'ad' in Mogadore and Filadelfia, 'cl' in clonemates, 'ca' and 'ap' at word starts. Pushes toward 'calculation'; steered output spams 'calculations'.

L27n2866.name: Short onset → screen
L27n2866.description: Fires on a 1–2 letter onset that starts a word split into tokens, mostly 'Q' (QbD, Qatari, Qulu) and 'sm', 'sc', 'sl' (smokes, smoldering, semi-); pushes toward 'screen' tokens.

L26n845.name: Medical mechanism connectives
L26n845.description: Strongly negative on function words and nouns mid-sentence in medical and hormone mechanism text (e.g. 'growth' in 'growth hormone', 'with' in 'activated with', 'when' in 'happens when'); pushes body-part nouns like 'bone', 'skin', 'scalp'.

L24n1691.name: Chemical-name word pieces
L24n1691.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a long chemistry, biochemistry or drug name split into tokens, e.g. 'beta-car|otene', 'Amin|ogly|coside', 'glyc|ogen', 'phosphoryl|ase', 'nit|rogen'. Pushes toward 'bin'. Trigger and output do not match.

L26n823.name: Third digit of years
L26n823.description: Fires on the third digit of a year typed digit by digit (the '1' in 16-1-1, the '5' in 19-5-3, the '1' in 20-1-1), mostly in history and date text. Writes parentheses with weak, unclear effect.

L24n1265.name: Birth-death dates and dashes
L24n1265.description: Negative on digits and the dash inside birth-death date ranges and year spans, e.g. the '8' in 'June 1236' and the '–' in '(1260–1279)'. Also fires on IPA symbols such as 'ˈ'. Pushing it negative writes question marks.

L26n59.name: Newline after user turn
L26n59.description: The newline right after the user's <|im_end|> that opens the assistant turn; pushes toward quote marks and ellipses, which steered outputs spam as '...'.

L26n529.name: second word of titles
L26n529.description: Goes strongly negative on the second word of a multi-word title or term ('Stockholders' Meeting', 'Civil War', 'Patient Safety', 'Cultural Organization', 'Project Update'). Pushes toward 'Re' words such as 'Report' and 'Release'.

L27n2237.name: St/le starts → leaf
L27n2237.description: The short opening piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'St'/'st' (Stems, stearic, stanzas) and 'le' (lemons, lethal); pushes toward 'leaf/leaves'.

L27n2466.name: Word-start 'sw' fragments
L27n2466.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'sw' or 'unw' piece, such as 'Sw' in swelling, 'sw' in swamps and swimmers, 'unw' in unworthy, and on 'seaw' and 'drinking' before a water word; pushes toward 'water'.

L27n1491.name: Acronym starts and digits
L27n1491.description: Fires negative on the first capital of an acronym or abbreviation (CISA, ILO, EDF, PESCO, RRI, D&D) and on NOPASSWD-style caps; pushes output toward digit tokens, especially 3, 2 and 5.

L27n2129.name: Plant and place word-starts
L27n2129.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or second piece of a multi-token plant, animal or place name (sassa-fras, Nan-aimo, shr-ubs, gl-abrous); pushes toward 'params' and 'args' code tokens.

L25n550.name: Commonwealth place names
L25n550.description: Fires on the second or later word or piece of a proper name in Australian, New Zealand and UK exam-board text: 'New' in New Zealand or New South Wales, 'NSW', 'Queensland', 'SE' in GCSE, 'excel' in Pearson Edexcel, and commas in place lists. Pushes toward meaningless fragments like 'avored' and 'umor'.

L27n1741.name: Proper-noun first pieces
L27n1741.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split place or people name (Cast|ile, Par|aguay, Van|ara, Dan|ube); pushes toward settings tokens.

L1n81.name: Think-close and word fragments
L1n81.description: Negative pole: fires most strongly on the '</think>' closing token of chat replies, and on mid-word fragments such as 'tablesp', 'crystall', 'Jama' and 'stainless'. Pushing it negative writes single digits and letters and steers text into dot and comma runs.

L26n1317.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L26n1317.description: Mid-word pieces of rare or split names and words (e.g. 'Al|bre|cht', 'pter|od|actyl', 'Pavan|Put|ra'), peaking on the piece that finishes an unusual word; pushes the model toward 'debug' tokens.

L26n2957.name: List separator comma
L26n2957.description: Goes negative on the comma or 'and' between items in a noun list (wild turkeys, alligators; peas, beans); pushes 'capacity'.

L26n1473.name: Chemical prefix chlor-, hydro-
L26n1473.description: Strongly negative on the opening piece of a chemistry or water-quality word split into tokens (e.g. 'chlor' in chlorides, 'hydro' in hydrogen, 'cyst' in polycystic, 'rom' in dichromate); steering it negative pushes toward 'Dis'-prefixed tokens.

L26n748.name: Rare symbols and glyphs
L26n748.description: Fires on one unusual glyph inside ordinary text: superscript ⁴ in ¹⁴C, ⅔, Ω, √, ∂, accented Č, ´, or a kanji. Steering pushes toward unrelated words like 'skies' and 'porto'.

L27n1469.name: Mid-word and name pieces
L27n1469.description: Scattered mid-word subword pieces and name fragments (Environmental, Di|Prima, tropo|myosin, Con|ventional, Gy|orgy) with no single reading; pushes toward 'duration', 'longer', 'longest', and steered output spams 'longer'.

L25n1524.name: Split noun fragments, code
L25n1524.description: Fires on the first piece of a noun split across tokens inside long lists of animals, plants or places (mac|aws, cor|als, Por|ifera, Not|re-Dame), and on SQL '_id' and 'h(x' maths. Pushes toward '=' signs in code.

L26n2020.name: K-initial name fragments
L26n2020.description: Fires on a 'K' or 'k' opening piece of a split word or name (Kassites, KwaZulu, kerosene, Kafka, Kunitz, kinases, Qanat). Pushes toward 'space', and steered text turns into 'space-faring' spam.

L26n1238.name: Medical word pieces
L26n1238.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of medical or biology terms ('ost' in Ophiostoma and mangosteen, 'ural' in pleural, 'ar' in plantar fasciitis, 'ond' in cyberchondriac, '-em' in zero-emission). Pushes toward 'hyper' and 'hyp'.

L22n1096.name: 'using' before algorithm names
L22n1096.description: Fires on 'a', 'using', 'uses' or 'for' right before the name of a method or algorithm in programming requests ('use a sorting algorithm', 'using the Euclidean algorithm'); pushes toward 'loop'.

L24n491.name: Mid-name fragment before 'string'
L24n491.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name, e.g. 'Mart|el', 'Dal|mau', 'Hert|ford', 'Proudh|on', 'Merc|ier', often a capital letter or 'P' inside a surname. Pushes toward 'string'. The triggers share no concept.

L26n535.name: Mid-compound technical pieces
L26n535.description: Fires on a middle piece of a multi-token medical or technical compound, such as 'lex' in dyslexia, 'acid' in Delftia acidovorans, 'agr' in bermudagrass and 'coronary'. Pushes toward 'other', 'others' and 'another', often with degenerate repetition.

L26n2281.name: Rare name continuation pieces
L26n2281.description: Goes negative on a sub-token inside a rare name or loanword, e.g. 'ñ' in Piñera, 'Pic' in Picudas, 'Maj' in Majorelle, 'Ram' in Rambla, 'ist' in armistice, 'Fab' in Fabergé. Pushing it negative makes the model output 'remote' and 'far'.

L25n1643.name: Cl- word onsets
L25n1643.description: Fires negative on the 'cl' onset of a word split from its ending: 'Cl' in Climb, 'cl' in clots, clenching, clippings, clumping. Steered, it pushes 'hit' and spams 'Hit hit hit'.

L26n277.name: Title-Case heading words
L26n277.description: A capitalised word inside a Title-Case heading or proper name, e.g. 'Does [It] Take', 'Stratospheric [Polar]', 'Generalized [Bone]'; pushes toward more Title-Case text with no clear meaning.

L27n3008.name: Word-start 't' fragment
L27n3008.description: Strongly positive on a bare 't' (or 'St', 'l') that opens the second piece of a split word ('t|igers', 't|amed', 'T|almud', 'St|ilton', 'l|agoon'). Pushes 'container' tokens.

L27n361.name: Rare-name fragments
L27n361.description: Strongly positive on a piece of a rare or foreign name split into tokens, e.g. 'uh' in a Congolese girl's name, 'ry' in Phrynosoma, 'Bh' in Bhagabhadra, 'hr' in Fakhrullin, 'Ram' in Ramihantaniarivo. Pushes toward sentence-end punctuation.

L25n496.name: Word-prefix fragments
L25n496.description: Fires on a word-opening prefix piece that a longer word continues from, e.g. 'tele' in telepathically, 'hyper' in hyperbole, 'self' in self-love, 'non' in nonstick, 'vin' in kelvin. Pushes toward a bare 'k', and steering outputs 'kkkk' spam.

L24n2887.name: URL or path fragment
L24n2887.description: Fires on a piece inside a URL, filename or code path: 'ip' in 'get-pip.py', 'aspx' and 'html' in web addresses, 'fund' in 'superfund', 'tips' in a us-cert URL, 'whats-new' in an MLA link, 'Share' in 'Share-Alike', 'afety' in 'cyber-safety', and ']' in '[root@chris ~]#'. Steered, it pushes '#' (steered output is a run of '#'). Read and write do not match well.

L25n365.name: Split name opening fragment
L25n365.description: Fires on a short fragment that opens a split proper or foreign name, e.g. 'ṛ' in Hṛdaya, 'Gr' in Graceland, 'Har' in Harbor, 'Moh' in Mohenjo; also 'Read' in 'Read More' link text. Pushes toward possessives 'their', 'its', 'themselves'.

L27n1293.name: Inner name pieces
L27n1293.description: Negative on inner pieces of split names and foreign-script terms (Hojiblanca, Rhododendron, Ibn Rushd, mang|ostana, Fil|adelfia); pushes toward '.js' and 'JavaScript' tokens.

L0n178.name: Science-word sub-token
L0n178.description: Fires on a later sub-token of a long chemistry, biology or medical word split into pieces: 'oten' in carotenoids, 'acus' in abacus, 'anth' in chrysanthemums, 'ylation' in methylation, 'igen' in epigenetic, 'aceous' in diatomaceous. Pushes toward generic tokens like 'and', ',' and 'able'.

L27n560.name: Chemical-word later pieces
L27n560.description: The second or later piece of a word split into tokens, mostly chemical roots such as 'to' in 'neurotoxic', 'hydro' in 'hydrogen' and 'hydroxyapatite', and 'EX' in 'T REX'. Pushes toward a bare 'x' or 'X'.

L24n476.name: Coding-task words, writes index
L24n476.description: Fires on the word after a verb or article in coding-task prompts: 'odd' in 'sum of all the odd numbers', 'takes' and 'accepts' in function specs, 'at' and 'the' in 'the second largest', plus stray name pieces such as 'Ah' and 'z'. Pushes toward 'index' and array-index code tokens; steered text spams 'index'.

L24n2063.name: Numeral magnitude → '+'
L24n2063.description: Fires on the zero or second digit of an age or quantity ('60' in 'aged 60 and above', '18-35', '180-1000'), and on magnitude words like 'million' and 'thousand'. Pushes toward '+' ('plus') tokens such as '+x' and '+m'.

L27n161.name: Step end, answer start
L27n161.description: Fires on the period ending a numbered instruction step or the blank line right after </think> in chat replies, i.e. where the answer body begins; pushes plural abstract nouns such as features, factors and concepts.

L27n1649.name: Place-name piece, writes och
L27n1649.description: Fires on the middle piece of a place name or surname split across tokens (e.g. 'Pad' in Paducah, 'Bod' in Bodrum, 'Nar' in Narayanganj, 'Kami' in Kamiros, 'Ib' in Leibniz); pushes German and Scandinavian function words (och, und, ist, mit); steered output loops 'und und'.

L27n1488.name: Place-name word starts
L27n1488.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, often place and river names (Wollong|ong, Del|ville, Ph|ang?, Mar|quesas, cate|cholamines); pushes toward 'Est/estimate' tokens.

L27n2369.name: Name fragments, 'queue' writer
L27n2369.description: Fires on a partial token inside a capitalized name or split word, e.g. 'Stra' in Straits, 'Cr' in Crataegus, 'Caj' in Cajete, just before the word completes. Pushes toward 'queue' and 'que' tokens.

L26n618.name: Given-name and surname starts
L26n618.description: Fires on the first token of a person's given name or surname in a multi-token name (Jean in Jean Lafitte, Gour in Gourdie, Ram in Rajesh, Scott in Coretta Scott King); pushes toward '::' filler.

L27n1898.name: Lone 'm' word-start fragment
L27n1898.description: Goes strongly negative on a lone 'm' or 'M' that begins a word piece, e.g. 'm' in 'mares', 'multim' in 'multimodal', 'm' in 'mussels'; pushes toward 'mat/matrix' tokens.

L26n2123.name: Capital U of U.S.
L26n2123.description: Fires on the capital 'U' of 'U.S.' or 'U.P.' abbreviations, and on other capital-letter word starts like P, Pl and Phil. Pushes the model toward bracket pairs such as '[]', '()' and '{}'.

L24n2291.name: Split name's later piece
L24n2291.description: A later sub-word piece of a name split into tokens: the 'y' in Che|y|enne, 'ikh' in Tikhonov, 'ray' in Phraya, 'Koh' in Kohli, 'Kos' in Kosrae. Pushes the model toward the letter 'X' or 'Y' and invented names like 'Xyser'.

L26n2527.name: Stem-cell differentiation, 'self'
L26n2527.description: Fires on words in stem-cell and differentiation text, peaking on the 'and' or 'into' just before a differentiation or cell-fate term ('integration and differentiation', 'differentiated into'); pushes toward 'self', so steered output spams 'self'.

L25n745.name: URL scheme and digits
L25n745.description: Fires on 'http' and 'https' at the start of a URL, on the first piece of split words (phot|ovoltaic, ozo|ne), and on digits in clock times such as 3:20 or 8:30. Pushes toward code closers like ]: and ):.

L14n2251.name: Product-topic adjective before noun
L14n2251.description: Strongly negative on the topic adjective in a writing request, right before its noun: 'smart' in 'smart home hubs', 'renewable' in 'renewable energy', 'classic' in 'classic chicken noodle soup', 'new' in 'new software program', 'wireless' in 'wireless touch screen'. Mostly silent elsewhere. Steered negative pushes word fragments ('ancial', 'oretical', 'ionale') rather than a clear word.

L27n2247.name: Soil/manure nutrient context
L27n2247.description: Soil, manure and nutrient nouns, peaking on 'organic' (organic fertilizer, organic matter, organic waste), 'nitrogen' and 'sewage'. Pushes toward 'return'.

L26n2591.name: Proper-noun starts, months
L26n2591.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalised name or month (Mer in Merlin or Merck, Per in Perseus, Jan in January, Dor in Dorset); pushes toward 'May' and other month names.

L24n989.name: Proper-noun opener → brace
L24n989.description: Fires on the short first fragment of a capitalized proper noun split into tokens ('Al' in Almohad, Alamo, Almazaras; 'Nan' in Nanaimo; 'Cr' in Crataegus; 'Pall' in Pallene; 'Mal'); pushes toward an opening brace '{'.

L26n1099.name: Word stems → equivalent
L26n1099.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'dise' in diseased, 'stere' in stereotyping, 'pharmac' in pharmacists, 'Mes' in Mesopotamia; pushes toward 'equ' and 'equivalent'.

L27n682.name: Capital token in names
L27n682.description: Fires on capitalised or code tokens inside names, acronyms and sudo rules (ALL=(ALL), American Animal Hospital, Köppen Aw, Neuchâtel). Pushes '=' followed by a capital letter ('=E', '=C', '=False'); steered answers stay coherent.

L26n483.name: Mid-word Latin-root fragments
L26n483.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens, often Latin or medical: 'ech' in petechiae, 'ch' in parenchyma, 'ros' in Ambrosia, 'th' in hawthorn, 'ocom' in nosocomial. Pushes toward French-style endings 'ieu', 'ieux' and 'iae'.

L23n2276.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L23n2276.description: Fires on the middle or split piece of a rare or long word broken into tokens ('oste' in osteoporosis, 'athy' in hypoparathyroidism, 'Att' in Attus, 'ECC' in ECC-000); weakly pushes toward '::' scope operators.

L26n2083.name: Medical adjective stems
L26n2083.description: Fires on an adjective stem right before a noun in a medical or anatomical term ('arterial' in arterial hypertension, 'coronary' in coronary arteries, 'urinary', 'cervical', 'vascular'); pushes toward 'stone' and 'rock'.

L25n1915.name: proper-name first fragments
L25n1915.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a proper name or rare word split into tokens ('Par' in Parthenon and parakeets, 'Rush' in Ibn Rushd, 'ep' in epigenetics, 'Dal' in Dalmau). Pushes toward 'loop' and 'loops'.

L27n2501.name: Prefix 'pre'/'re' starts
L27n2501.description: Fires on the word-initial prefix piece 'pre', 'post' or 'Re' (e.g. 'pre' in preoccupied, 'pre-exposure', 'post' in post-Civil War, 'Re' in Recreational); pushes 'author' tokens.

L23n288.name: Ellipsis and quote breaks
L23n288.description: fires on the last word before an ellipsis or quote break ('The Son of Man came…', 'the last year') and on suffix pieces; pushes toward closing quote and bold markdown tokens.

L24n1920.name: Name fragment, writes interval
L24n1920.description: Fires on the first or middle subword piece of a split name or word, such as 'Str' in Stronsay, 'str' in straits, 'di' in Arnolfo di Cambio, and 'Di' in Diane Di Prima. Pushes toward the code token 'interval' and its variants; steered text spams 'intervals'.

L26n92.name: Opening parenthesis asides
L26n92.description: Positive on an opening '(' that starts an explanatory aside right after a noun or term, such as 'reactants (the substances' or 'sleeping (or journeys'. Pushes the model toward unspaced words and 'supply' or 'room'.

L25n1390.name: Multi-token surname starts
L25n1390.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token surname or place name (Hersch in Lauterpacht, Kos in Kosrae, Kel in Kelentric, Nes in Nesbitt, Sebast in Sebastián); pushes toward 'platform' and 'platforms'.

L23n2114.name: American and European pieces
L23n2114.description: The 'amer' piece of Meso|amer|ica and 'American' in organisation names (American Heart Association), plus 'European', 'Euras' and 'Eu' in Euromonitor. Pushes the model toward 'delete'; its effect on normal text is weak.

L24n3017.name: 'sh'/'arch' word starts
L24n3017.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting with 'sh' or 'arch', e.g. 'sh|ape', 'sh|aking', 'Arch|itect', 'arch|bishop', and on 'egg' or 'nut' before a '-shaped' compound. Pushes toward 'shape' and 'form'.

L24n39.name: Digits inside numbers/dates
L24n39.description: Fires on digits and punctuation inside numbers, years, dates and times ('the 9 in 1970s', 'x' in 0x8, ':' in 01:06). Pushes toward garbled symbols and asterisk spam, so the effect is noisy.

L26n3012.name: Name starts, 'ensure' output
L26n3012.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name split into tokens, such as 'Ju' in Juárez, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Ber' in beriberi, or 'Bar' in Bar Giora; pushes toward 'ensure' and 'ensuring'.

L26n260.name: Bullet markers opening lists
L26n260.description: Fires negatively on the '•' that opens a list item, plus '…' and '–' in list-like lines; pushed negative, it breaks text into stray tabs and odd fragments.

L26n890.name: Name and drug stems
L26n890.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly names or drug and chemical terms (Zeld|ovich, Leeuwen|hoek, ibu|profen, Car|cassonne, Pro|truding). Pushes toward 'each', 'every' and 'daily'.

L24n875.name: Year '1' and 'le/ge'
L24n875.description: The leading '1' of a year from the 1600s to 1900s ('in 1754', 'during the 1600s', 'in 1968'), and word-start 'le', 'ge', 'Le', 'Ge' fragments (lethal, geothermal, Levy, Gary). Pushes toward 'q'-initial tokens (quad, qh, qq).

L26n2025.name: harm and disease words
L26n2025.description: Fires on names of harms, toxins and diseases and on the piece that starts them (radiation, arsenic, chloride, pollution, diarrhea, Zika, rickets, measles). Pushes toward 'pressure', 'stress' and 'force'.

L27n390.name: Word piece to equals
L27n390.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and Georgian fragments; pushes toward equals-sign tokens such as =A and =B.

L27n455.name: Mid-word pieces, chat tokens
L27n455.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long food, place and name words (BUFFALO, cantaloupe, Nauvoo) and on chat-template boundary tokens; pushes toward 'O' word starts.

L25n1927.name: Sch word-start fragment
L25n1927.description: Goes negative on the 'Sch' or 'ch' onset piece of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'Sch' in Schuller, Schwerin, Scholars and Schenck|ensch|ans, and 'proph' in prophylaxis; writes 'protect/protection' tokens.

L25n2197.name: Proper-name first pieces
L25n2197.description: Goes positive on the first or second token of a proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Ob|ispo', 'Ho|jiblanca', 'Rou|en', 'Koh|li', 'Bo|iry', 'Ras|porich'; writes 'efficiency/efficient' tokens, which are unrelated.

L25n2684.name: n/kn word pieces
L25n2684.description: Short n, ne, kne or ut pieces that open the second part of a word split across tokens (kne in kneading, n in nodule, ne in neutrons, -ne in k-nearest), plus Kubernetes; the steering effect is weak and writes little that is clear.

L26n1798.name: Nerve-root and name fragments
L26n1798.description: Fires on 'nerve' in 'nerve root' compression text and on mid-word pieces of names (Nes in Nesbitt, ensch in Schenkenschans, Mel in Melvin); pushes toward 'signal' tokens.

L27n64.name: Inside a multi-word name
L27n64.description: Fires on the word or 'of', 'de', 'the' in the middle of a fixed title or institution name, e.g. Book of the Dead, Order of the Garter, Centers for Disease Control. Pushes toward short word-piece tokens; steered, it turns into run-on fragments.

L27n2458.name: 'St' word-starts; writes 'India'
L27n2458.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'St' or 'st' split off from a longer word: Streak, stearic, stinkbug, stings, Stamps. Pushing it negative steers toward 'India' and 'Indian'.

L27n998.name: Negative: split-word middles
L27n998.description: Fires strongly negative on the middle piece of a split name or word (Coll in Collins, Platan in Platanus, And in Andalusia), pushing 'include'.

L23n2632.name: Technical modifiers before nouns
L23n2632.description: The modifier right before a technical noun in CS and math text ('transition' in state-transition matrix, 'binary' in binary tree, '-vector' in distance-vector); pushes 'graph' and 'Graph'.

L26n89.name: Big-number quantities
L26n89.description: Fires on the digit of a large number attached to a unit such as billion, million, km, acres, pounds, gallons or mph. Pushes toward nationality and country adjectives (American, Russian, Brazilian).

L24n1763.name: Tech and name fragments
L24n1763.description: Negative pole: fires on the second piece of a split name or tech term, e.g. 'om' in Potomac, 'g' in gators, 'K' in Keras, and the software names AWS, Bot Framework, Spark and Python. Pushing it negative writes 'client' and steers text into 'client' spam.

L26n809.name: Digits inside measurements
L26n809.description: Fires negative on a digit inside a numeric measurement with units: '6' in -286 kJ/mol, '8' in 8.34 km, '0' in 1,060 miles and 600 degrees C, '1' in 26,001 pounds, '.' in 22.8 C. Also fires on 'Figure', 'Section' and 'Chapter' labels. Pushes toward code-closing tokens such as ';' and ')', with no clear steering effect.

L26n844.name: Word completing named title
L26n844.description: Fires on the word that completes a named title or term, often inside quotes: 'Lady' in Iron Lady, 'Boy' in Little Boy, 'Meaning' in Man's Search for Meaning, '-otherapy' in logotherapy. Pushes toward closing quotes and punctuation after a string.

L27n517.name: Ingredient and list enumeration
L27n517.description: Fires on ingredient-list and enumeration tokens: 'tablespoon', 'minced', 'fresh', 'dried', and the ',' or 'and' joining items in a series (e.g. 'cucumbers,' 'tomatoes,'). Pushes toward chemistry words ('molecular', 'chemical', 'methane'); steered, it spams 'energy'.

L26n2492.name: year digits in dates
L26n2492.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or second digit of a year in historical text ('1' in 'in 1974', '9' in '1998', '1' in 'Born in 1902'). Pushes toward 'mouth' and 'oral'.

L26n119.name: Mid-word technical fragments
L26n119.description: Fires (goes negative) on a word-internal piece of a technical or taxonomic word, such as 'orp' in scorpions, 'g' in Valgus, 'ula' in tabula, 'roph' in catastrophe and 'sit' in sitting. Pushes toward grammar-category tokens ('N', 'V', 'VP') and NFT-style filler.

L27n1629.name: Name fragment, child
L27n1629.description: Strongly negative on split proper-name pieces (Roth|amsted, Ker|et, Hos|feld, Amp|etro) and on 'Inf|ants'; pushes toward 'child' and 'children'.

L26n1853.name: Articles before noun phrases
L26n1853.description: Articles and prepositions ('the', 'a', 'The', 'of', 'in') in dense prose, peaking where a noun phrase is about to start; pushes toward closing quotes and backticks (``, 」, 』).

L27n1437.name: Name pieces, 'up close'
L27n1437.description: Fires on mid-name fragments (Dal|ma|u, sup|ran|ational, Gal|ap|agos, spr|outs) and on the particle 'up' before 'close' or 'to' (solar technology up close); pushed positive it promotes 'close'.

L27n2771.name: Latin-Greek science stem
L27n2771.description: Goes strongly negative on a stem piece of a long Latin or Greek scientific word ('OCCUS' in 'Echinococcus', 'trans' in 'transcribing', 'Th' in 'Thelypteridaceae', 'cep' in 'cephalosporins'). Pushed negative, it writes 'transform' tokens.

L27n1681.name: Noun stems, pushes '|'
L27n1681.description: Strongly negative on the first fragment of a noun split into tokens (e.g. 'tur' in turkeys, 'sal' in salamanders, 'hil' in hillocks, 'catal' in catalase); pushing negative makes the model write '|' or '*' table and line markers.

L27n786.name: Pest-list separators
L27n786.description: The comma, 'and' or 'of' linking items in lists of insects, pests or animals, such as 'lacewings, ladybugs' and 'fleas, mites and ticks'. Pushes toward 'was' and 'were'.

L27n2066.name: Word piece, pushes 'figure'
L27n2066.description: Positive on a sub-token in the middle of a split name or word, right before its last piece, e.g. 'Tra|uma', 'ple|ural', 'Lak|shmi', 'Hil|figer', 'Mach|egonne'. Pushes toward 'figure' and 'Figure'; steered output spams 'figure'.

L23n603.name: Function-related terms, diffuse
L23n603.description: Fires diffusely on words just before a function-like noun: 'AWS' before 'Lambda', 'asynchronous' before events, 'a method that', 'a subroutine'. Pushes the model toward 'function' and 'functions'.

L26n2828.name: Name start after of/at
L26n2828.description: Strongly positive on the first subword of a proper noun or term right after 'of', 'at' or 'the' (e.g. 'Hash' in messenger of Hashem, 'Mag' in died at Marrakesh, 'Mun' in Minister of Munitions, 'Ast' in Astola); steering it up pushes toward 'translation' and 'translate'.

L27n350.name: Mid-word fragment, writes -ly
L27n350.description: Second or later piece of a rare or split word, mostly names and Latin or Sanskrit terms ('ht' in Ikhtiyar, 'oph' in sarcophagi, 'ś' in sutra); pushes toward 'ly' and 'cy' tokens.

L27n610.name: Name-start fragments before quotes
L27n610.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized surname, place or title split across tokens ('M' in Macc|lesfield, 'P' in Pickett's, 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar, 'Stra' in Straits, 'K' in Kralove). Pushes toward closing quote and apostrophe marks.

L27n248.name: 'st' and hyphen starts
L27n248.description: Fires on word-opening pieces like 'st', 'str', 'pr', 'cons', 'conc', and on the hyphen in compound adjectives (ill-posedness, well-structured, specially-abled); pushes toward sentence openers 'This', 'The', 'We', and steering spams 'The We'.

L20n736.name: Code opener, data nouns
L20n736.description: Fires on 'Here' opening a code answer ('Here is a Java program') and on data-structure nouns in coding requests (array, list, Set, stack, node), weakly elsewhere; pushes toward '<' type or tag starts (<T, <N), with little visible effect.

L27n2808.name: Subword ant to po
L27n2808.description: Negative on subword pieces such as 'ant' (antiseptic, antitrust, antiretroviral) and 'op' that start a split word; pushes toward 'po' and 'poem' tokens.

L27n1657.name: Split-word pieces → mark
L27n1657.description: Assorted pieces in the middle of split words (lem in Radiotelemetric, fold in fold-out, roph in acrophobia, Jur in Jurisdiction); pushes toward 'mark/marks'.

L21n2321.name: 'ur' syllable in names
L21n2321.description: Fires on the 'ur' fragment (also 'Hur', 'Sur', 'Mur', 'Bur') inside split words and proper nouns such as Hurrians, Surinam, murals and Huron. Pushes 'sqrt' and 'square'. The read and write do not clearly match.

L26n2859.name: Surname and place-name pieces
L26n2859.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split surname or place name, usually after a first name or title (Donna Ar|nett, Leth Jø|rgensen, Dr. Fa|uci, Nan|aimo, Ro|che). Writes 'branch'/'trace'; steering spams 'Branch'.

L27n509.name: Continuation fragments, Li Mi
L27n509.description: Non-initial pieces of split names and words where the word continues ('Di|wali', 'Ikht|iyar', 'Zam|be|zi', 'Vit|iligo'). Pushes toward short syllable tokens 'Li', 'Mi' and '(ci'.

L26n1100.name: Prefix fragments ep, comp
L26n1100.description: Goes positive on a prefix or stem fragment that starts a longer word split across tokens, especially 'ep' (epigenetics, epilepsy), 'Comp' (compounds), 'non' (nonproliferation), 'hyper' (hyperbole) and 'post' (post-traumatic); pushes the model toward 'part/partial' tokens.

L23n1848.name: Template slot, year digits
L23n1848.description: Fires on the token that opens a fill-in slot in letters, emails and press releases ('Dear' before '[Name]', ':' after 'Mission Statement'), and on digits inside years such as 1961 or 2002; pushes toward the placeholder 'X'.

L27n535.name: List and heading starts
L27n535.description: Goes negative on list markers and section starts (1., 2., a dash bullet, a line break before a new heading) and on title-case heading words (Can, To, Develop); pushes toward capitalised institution nouns (National, Government, Society).

L27n2447.name: Name-stem fragments, writes 'educ'
L27n2447.description: Strongly negative on the first fragment of a proper name split into tokens (e.g. 'Brid' in Bridgeton, 'Borg' in Borglum, 'Tit' in Titus, 'Br' in Brunsbüttel); pushing negative makes the model write 'teach'/'educ' words.

L23n90.name: '(' after a label
L23n90.description: Fires negative on an opening parenthesis or bracket right after a number, label or clause marker, e.g. '(' in '(inches)', '(c)' in copyright lines, '(1)' in statute clauses, 'Eq. ('. At dose -0.5 the output loses its spaces.

L26n518.name: Name piece, screen dialog
L26n518.description: Strongly negative on the middle piece of a split proper name or technical term (e.g. 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Maz' in Mazaheri, 'Geh' in Gehrig, 'Gar' in Garuda, 'Woz' in Wozniak); steering it negative pushes toward 'screen', 'dialog' and GUI words.

L24n494.name: Reply openers, pointer words
L24n494.description: Diffuse: fires positive on the first word of an assistant reply after the empty think block ('Sure'), and on pointer words such as 'below', 'in detail', 'PDF', and 'out' in 'hear me out'. Pushes toward closing code and reply openers.

L26n159.name: Chat reply sentence ends
L26n159.description: Fires negative on the period or '?' that closes the first sentence of a chat assistant reply, and on the newline right after an empty <think> block. Steered, it degenerates into code-like junk such as '[](' and '!('.

L27n1769.name: Capital P word opener
L27n1769.description: Fires on a bare capital 'P' (also Pl, Ep, St, Br, Dis) that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. P|ies, P|NAS, P|uffins, P|uzzles, P|isan; pushed negative it promotes 'difficulty'.

L24n2796.name: Capital letters opening names
L24n2796.description: Fires on a capital letter or first fragment that opens a proper name mid-sentence, e.g. 'P' in 'Poles', 'Pumsaint' and 'Pteridophyta', 'Rh' in 'Rhododendron', '-P' in 'Boulton-Paul'; pushes toward 'name' and 'names'.

L25n1052.name: Proper-noun middle pieces
L25n1052.description: Fires on a middle piece of a capitalized name split into several tokens: 'ule' in Suleiman, 'ut' in Sutak, 'Serg' in Sergipe, 'Riv' in Riviera, 'Hil' in Hilfiger. Pushes toward 'stage' and 'phase'.

L27n770.name: Subword starts; writes '%'
L27n770.description: Fires on the first fragment of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'ant' (antibiotics, antiretrovirals), 'cent' (centimetres, centred), 'Th' or 'Port' in place names. Pushes the model toward '%' (steering spams '%').

L27n1145.name: Word-prefix fragment opener
L27n1145.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split or prefixed into tokens (sub-, inter-, re-, e-cigarette, hyper-, Mult-, Co-), mid-sentence in web text. Pushes the model toward the token 'text' and repeats 'Text'.

L26n472.name: Math and table operators
L26n472.description: Fires on operator and punctuation tokens between numbers or inside equations, code and tables ('=', '×', ':', ',', '|', '→'). Pushes toward ligature and ellipsis tokens ('ﬁ', 'ﬂ', '...').

L25n2051.name: Name-internal fragment
L25n2051.description: Fires on a middle piece of a person's or place's name split into tokens: 'Ban' in Ban Ki-moon, 'Kon' in Konwar, 'izing' in Huizinga, 'Vin' in Vinke, 'Hon' in Honk, 'win' in Erwin, 'ons' in Stronsay. Pushes toward 'potential', 'possible' and 'candidate'.

L26n1799.name: Technical fragments -> 'procedure'
L26n1799.description: Fires on the start or middle piece of technical words split into tokens (e.g. 'Im' in Imager, 'atom' in hematoma, 'microscopy', 'welding', 'MRI', 'diagn'). Pushed positive, it promotes 'procedure(s)' and spams it.

L27n2040.name: Split-word piece, writes sym
L27n2040.description: Second piece of a split or hyphenated word, often right after a hyphen (quasi-s|culptural, anti-s|hear, abs|cess, Val|gus); pushes toward 'sym' tokens.

L26n236.name: Transition adverbs after commas
L26n236.description: Fires on a transitional adverb set off by commas mid-sentence, such as 'however', 'therefore', 'in fact', 'in other words', 'conversely', peaking on the adverb itself; pushes toward quote-comma-bracket punctuation like '"),"' and '":[' (code or list syntax), with little visible effect on story or Sunday text.

L27n278.name: 'sh' onset in names
L27n278.description: Fires on 'sh' or 'Sh', or another short onset opening a word or name split into tokens ('sh'aking, 'Sh'ope, 'Mu'hammad, 'Cass'ia, 'Ik'eda); pushes toward middle-dot and angle-bracket symbols.

L27n1083.name: Proper-name start, brackets
L27n1083.description: Fires on the first token of a multi-token proper name or place, just before the rest of the name (Bar in 'Barrow-upon-Humber', de in 'de Gaulle', Mount in 'Mount Vernon'); pushes toward closing bracket tokens.

L0n1224.name: Digit inside numbers
L0n1224.description: Fires on a middle digit inside a multi-digit number or year (the '1' in '186', '2,361', '20 1 7', '9 1 1', 'CS610'). Pushes toward odd punctuation tokens like '…”' and '-wsj' with no clear meaning.

L24n1203.name: 'Price' and 'percentage' nouns
L24n1203.description: Fires on the nouns 'price' and 'percentage' in finance and pricing text ('high price tag', 'expressed as a percentage'); pushes the model toward 'point' and 'points'.

L26n2172.name: sp- word onsets
L26n2172.description: The opening 'sp' or 'spr' fragment of a word split into tokens, such as Sp in Spence and Sparta, and spr in sprouts and sprang. Pushes toward 'template' tokens.

L25n2845.name: Name fragments, certainty writes
L25n2845.description: Reads mid-word fragments of rare names and words (Be-, Tan-, Q-); pushes toward absolutes: always, guaranteed, definitely.

L27n1173.name: Modifier before compound head
L27n1173.description: Fires on the modifier that opens a compound before its head noun ('flash' in flashcards and flashbacks, 'electron' before volts, 'lower' before limb, 'dust' before bowls, 'sewer' before lines, 'Iron' in Iron Lady). Pushes toward 'back'.

L27n749.name: gl/Re/Get word start
L27n749.description: Piece opening a split word that starts 'gl', 'Re', 'Get' or 'Pro' (Xyleborus |gl|abratus, |Re|bellions, |Get|away, |Re|creational). Pushes toward data and field names like 'Data', 'User', 'Name'.

L27n339.name: Numbered-list punctuation
L27n339.description: Fires hardest on the '.' or ')' right after a bare list or section number (e.g. '5.', '26.', '1)'), weaker on label words like 'Contents', 'Number', 'Pages' and on mid-word fragments (e.g. 'Man' in Manitoba); pushed strongly, it yields leading tabs and whitespace rather than a clear concept.

L23n1574.name: Modifier before expected noun
L23n1574.description: Words right before an expected noun in technical text, such as 'root', 'the', 'personal', 'partial', 'quantum' (negative); pushes toward 'file' and 'File'.

L27n767.name: Mid-word fragments, 'al' suffix
L27n767.description: Fires on a word-internal fragment that is not a whole word, such as 'exh' in exhale, 'neut' in neuter, 'ceph' in microcephaly, or 'ost' in nostalgia; the pole promotes 'al'/'AL' tokens and steered output spams 'al'.

L26n1213.name: Word stems before suffix
L26n1213.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer term split across tokens: append- in appendicitis, Hydro- in hydrogen, Pero- in peroxide, -Apr- in April, contr- and cerv-. Pushes toward 'tax' and 'taxes'; at dose 0.5 it repeats 'tax'.

L27n2823.name: Place-name pieces, writes 'Inc'
L27n2823.description: Fires on a middle piece of a proper name ('oll' in Wollongong, 'akk' in Makkah, 'Sher' in Sherwood, 'op' in Skopje). Steering it up pushes the model toward company or domain suffixes ('Inc', '.com', 'Ltd', '.org'), and the output spams 'Inc' or '.com'.

L27n2778.name: sh word start
L27n2778.description: The 'sh' or 'Sh' piece opening a split word (|sh|aver, |sh|roud, |sh|atter, |sh|oveling, |sh|akshuka, NOP|ASS|WD). Pushes toward 'Linux', 'printf' and 'Unix'.

L27n730.name: Nationality adjectives
L27n730.description: Fires on nationality or country adjectives just before their noun, such as 'British-born', 'Russian armies', 'Dutch army', 'Italian campaigns'; pushes toward '[' bracket tokens.

L27n2495.name: Proper-noun first piece
L27n2495.description: Fires (goes negative) on the first or second subword piece of a capitalised proper name (Tisha in Tisha B'Av, Ulysses, Oshkosh, Blasco, Kapiri, Archaeology), mainly where a name's spelling is split; pushes output toward 'Muslim' and 'Islamic' tokens.

L27n229.name: Surname pieces in names
L27n229.description: Fires on a surname or its first piece, mostly in citations, bylines and quotes ('Lans' in Lansdell, 'Arn' in Arnott, 'Fish' after Nick, 'News' in Newsom); pushes toward all-caps tokens like 'AS', 'IS', 'AB'.

L25n2371.name: Split name fragments; brace
L25n2371.description: Later pieces of proper names split into tokens (Ban in Ban Ki-moon, Pan in Arvind Pan, Dor in Dorset, ior in Giora); pushes toward '{', the JSON opening brace.

L24n976.name: Pre-claim slot, writes recognize
L24n976.description: Negative pole: fires on the adverb, modal or infinitive marker just before the main verb of a claim: 'widely' in 'widely accepted', 'to' in 'important to remember', 'must' in 'we must suspend', 'be' in 'must be understood'. Pushing it negative writes 'recognize/recognition' and steers text into 'recognition' spam.

L27n2650.name: Consonant starts: contribution
L27n2650.description: Consonant-cluster starts of split words (Br|igid, Kr|ill, contr|arious, Con|quering, Ne|ighboring); pushes the model toward 'contribution' and 'contribute' tokens.

L26n528.name: Word-start noun fragments
L26n528.description: Fires positive on the opening piece of a noun or name split into tokens, e.g. 'bl' in bl|ower speed, 'blo' in blo|ating and blo|oming, 'plac' in plac|enta, 'Co' and 'rd' in Co|rd|oba, 'ass' in K|ass|ites. Pushes toward attribute nouns such as 'price', 'temperature', 'age' and 'weight'.

L25n801.name: Capital abbreviation starts, '&'
L25n801.description: The capital letter or first piece of an abbreviation or proper name (the 'E' in UPV-EHU, EMBASE, EPA; 'Ar' in Arbequina; 'Mar' in Marbella). Pushes toward '&' and 'and'.

L27n991.name: Medical stems, pushes 'per'
L27n991.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a long medical, chemical or food word split into tokens (e.g. 'hyp' in hypoparathyroidism, 'hydrogen', 'pol' in polystyrene, 'par' in parmesan, 'aim' in Nanaimo); pushes 'per' tokens.

L23n571.name: Short and number-unit prompts
L23n571.description: Fires on 'short' before story, bio or essay in writing prompts, and on a number or '.js' right before a unit or word ('500-word', '5-year', 'Node.js'). Pushes the model toward '+N'-style tokens, with no clear effect.

L26n649.name: Word starts, closing brackets
L26n649.description: Fires on a word-start piece that continues (enc|ased, orth|otic, occ|identalis, Misc|arriage) and on the last word of a named group (community, Provider, desktop); pushes closing quote and bracket tokens like } and ].

L27n3046.name: Second piece, split words
L27n3046.description: Fires on the second piece of a split name or technical word (Mes-qu-ita, H-itt-ites, sarc-oph-agus, Cinn-am-omum); pushes toward 'iter' and 'iteration' tokens.

L26n2109.name: br/tort word fragments
L26n2109.description: Short opening or middle fragments of split words: 'br' in bruxism, 'cort' in corticotropin, 'Vit' in vitiligo, 'tort' in tortillas, 'Att' in Attalea. Pushes toward 'html' tokens.

L27n1965.name: 'U' and 'into' cues
L27n1965.description: Fires on 'into' in 'come into force' or 'come into practice', on 'U' starting 'U.S.' or 'UDI', and on some mid-word pieces ('de' in self-deemed, 'pr' in prudence); pushes toward 'force' and 'forces'.

L25n3061.name: Proper-name capital fragment
L25n3061.description: Fires on the short capitalised first piece of a proper noun or taxon split into tokens: 'Pi' in Pietermaritzburg, 'Rh' in Rhododendron, 'Th' in Thessalians, 'Pö' in Pöyry, 'Su' in Suess, 'Cy' in Cyatheaceae, 'Di' in Diaptomus. Pushes toward 'mass'.

L27n237.name: Name-initial 'G' and 'th'
L27n237.description: Fires strongly negative on a lone capital initial that starts a person's surname (e.g. 'G' in 'Dennis G. Molinaro', 'Gellhorn', 'Gourdie') and on 'th' in thyme. Writes no clear token; steered output is blank whitespace.

L26n2704.name: Capitalized name-start pieces
L26n2704.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, e.g. 'Caj' (Cajete), 'P' (Poles, Pope), 'Os' (Osmond), 'Kat' (Katki); pushes toward 'batch'.

L26n3056.name: Split proper-name middles
L26n3056.description: The middle piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, such as 'ib' in Dibrell, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Mer' in Merck, 'Sch' in Schuman. Pushes toward 'course' and 'courses'.

L27n1274.name: Name fragments, writes 'provide'
L27n1274.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece of an Arabic or Islamic name or place ('Daw' in Abu Dawud, 'Al' in Surah Al, 'by' in Abyei, 'jo' in Mohenjo) and on '-pro' in thought-provoking. Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'provide' and 'provided', and the output spams them.

L27n912.name: Opening quote or dash
L27n912.description: Fires on an opening quote, parenthesis, dash or ampersand that starts a term mid-sentence ('“sustainability”', '(50–200% slope)', '“normal”', 'mid–to late'); pushes toward 'er' fragments.

L25n109.name: Month names and pairs
L25n109.description: Fires on month names in dates (August, December, June) and on 'vs', 'between' and 'and' joining two values; pushes toward 'against', so steered output spams 'against'.

L26n2893.name: Name and drug-name fragment
L26n2893.description: The first or middle piece of a split name or technical term, e.g. 'ret' in Isotretinoin, 'at' in Crataegus, 'mer' in methylmercury, 'Had' in Hadley. Pushes toward 'farmers' and 'farm'; steered, it spams 'Farmer'.

L27n1207.name: Short c-fragments; cal
L27n1207.description: Goes strongly negative on a short, often lone 'c', 'oc' or '-c' piece that starts a word, e.g. 'oc' in meningococcal, '-c' in anti-cancer, 'c' in cAMP; pushes toward 'cal', 'Cal' and 'CAL'.

L26n1070.name: Digits and name fragments
L26n1070.description: Negative on a digit or decimal point inside a number (e.g. '.' in 22.8°C, '6' in 60.1 °F), and on name or word fragments like 'ast' in astaxanthin and 'fon' in Alfonso. Pushes the model toward 'second'.

L27n3007.name: Medical word-fragment opener
L27n3007.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split medical or technical word: 'cl' in clenching or clindamycin, 'ural' after 'ple' in pleural effusion, 'gl' in glaucoma or glider, 'Sw' in swelling. Pushes toward 'refer' and loops it.

L26n2461.name: Stem fragment, culture
L26n2461.description: Fires on a stem piece in the middle of a longer word where a suffix follows (priv|atised, solic|iting, persu|asively, prov|okes, servic|emen, comm|unism, ser|fdom). Pushes toward 'culture' and 'cultural'.

L27n2147.name: Word-tail fragment, 'ter'
L27n2147.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment that starts a word continued after it (shr|ub, rit|ters, cro|aking, dr|achmas, -t|ail). Pushes toward 'terminal' and 'ter'.

L26n2152.name: 'a' before quantity phrase
L26n2152.description: Goes negative on the indefinite 'a' that opens a quantity phrase: 'there are a few', 'a lot of', 'a huge number', 'a series of', 'a proliferation'. Pushes toward 'string', a weak link to the reading.

L25n2001.name: Word-start fragment, current writer
L25n2001.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a word split into pieces, usually common nouns or names (contr in contraptions, mel in melon, mac in macrolides, mar in marigold, pur, Dec); pushes toward 'current' and '_current' tokens, producing 'current' repetition.

L27n499.name: Education prose, British spellings
L27n499.description: Fires on the word before a predictable complement in formal education or health prose ('being developed', 'young people', 'actively involved in', 'time is used'). Pushes toward British spellings like 'colour', 'behaviour', 'centre' and 'realised'.

L26n1193.name: Proper-name starts Bar/Char
L26n1193.description: Positive on the first piece of a capitalized proper name, such as 'Bar' in Barrow or Barataria, 'Char' in Charlemagne or Charon, 'Cal' in Calais, 'Che' in Chester. Pushes the model toward 'theory'.

L26n1210.name: ep/micro prefix fragment
L26n1210.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word starting with the prefix 'ep' or 'micro' split into tokens, such as ep|inephrine, ep|igenetics, micro|bicides, micro|cephaly and micro|structure. Also fires on 'Te', 'ap' (apnea) and 'Tim' (Tim Burton). Pushes toward 'at' and 'ats', and steered output spams 'at'.

L27n2281.name: Mid-word pieces of names
L27n2281.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split name or word, such as 'Bod' in Bod|rum, 'Por' in Por|ifera, 'on' in Alon|zo H. Cushing, 'os' in cyn|os|ure, 'he' in Kas|he|fi, 'om' in chamom|ile. Pushes toward 'phone' and 'mobile' tokens.

L27n622.name: Name fragments, Â writer
L27n622.description: Fires on the piece of a capitalized name split across tokens, e.g. 'k' in Dolaucothi, 'Mal' in Malawi, 'L' in Lohmann, 'ort' in Bortnyik. Pushes toward mojibake 'Â'/'â' tokens, so steered text spams 'Â'.

L27n816.name: Proper-name starts, dotted initials
L27n816.description: Strongly negative on the capital letter that starts a proper name, such as 'U' in Uclés, 'Mon' in Monet, 'Jan' in Janeiro, 'Puerto' in Puerto Rico, and 'N' in Native. Pushes toward dotted initials like '.D', '.A', and '.M', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1263.name: Medical-term word pieces
L27n1263.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a rare medical or technical word split into tokens, such as 'br|uxism', 'append|icit|is', 'cen|tigr|ade' and 'qu|asar'; pushes 'process/processes'.

L27n1013.name: Biomedical pieces; writes elements
L27n1013.description: Fires on a word piece inside a long biomedical or chemistry term (tro in antiretrovirals, ret in retinoblastoma); pushes toward chemical element names such as nitrogen, phosphorus, acid, sulfur and hydrogen.

L25n560.name: MATLAB comments, name initials
L25n560.description: Fires on code punctuation in MATLAB snippets (the % comment marker, a semicolon after an assignment, the .m file suffix) and on single-letter name starts (Z|andi, V|espasian); pushes '%', so steering gives '%' spam.

L27n241.name: Named-entity start
L27n241.description: Positive on the first sub-token of a capitalized name, place or institution, e.g. 'Carnegie', 'Cornell', 'Astr|onomical', 'cath|edrals', 'Vol|canoes', and in chat answers on the token where a numbered list begins. Pushes toward digits 1 to 9; steered output spams '1'.

L25n787.name: Capitalized name start, exactly
L25n787.description: Fires on the first letters of a capitalized name or acronym split across tokens (Pre in Sprent, Fre in Frederick, VH in VHDL, H in HAVING, h in hawksbill, Oh in Almohad); pushes toward 'exactly', 'exact', 'perfect' and 'precisely'.

L27n1051.name: Name start, hyphen-capital push
L27n1051.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name in lists (Phar|rell, Mar|bella, Dr|., Daw|, Ken|). Pushes toward hyphen-plus-capital-letter tokens like '-D' and '-P'.

L27n220.name: Punctuation in technical terms
L27n220.description: Negative on hyphens, dashes, and opening parentheses that join or introduce numbers and terms (8-lead, omega-3, (EPA), 3%), pushing toward garbled fragments like 'ascal' and 'erval'.

L26n1465.name: Capital U of U.S.
L26n1465.description: Fires on the capital 'U' that opens 'U.S.' after 'the' (the U.S. Department, the U.S. Geological Survey), and on 'U' in UCLA and Uffizi. Pushes toward 'fun' and 'func' tokens.

L26n764.name: Organization-name start, predicts leaves
L26n764.description: Capitalized first pieces of organization and agency names (UN, Air in Air Force, Sp in Sparta, Space, treaty); pushes toward 'leaves' and 'sets' verbs, which reads as unrelated.

L26n2664.name: Rare-word fragments, 'fluid' output
L26n2664.description: A middle piece of a rare name or technical word split into tokens (Ber-zelius, Hy-dro-gen, Terr-aces, erg-enic). Pushes toward 'fluid', 'wind' and 'flowing'.

L24n1223.name: Punctuation inside expressions
L24n1223.description: Fires on punctuation in the middle of an expression: the '()' in read(), commas in numbers like 4,301 or $656,000, underscore blanks, and '!' or '«' inside a sentence. Pushes toward closing quotation marks; steered text spams the curly quote '”'.

L24n1550.name: Proper-noun name pieces
L24n1550.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or middle subword of a capitalized person, university, or organization name ('Am' in Amherst, 'Gavin' in Newsom, 'Chemical' in American Chemical Society). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'System'.

L26n271.name: Mid-phrase words → cancel
L26n271.description: Diffuse: fires on mid-phrase words right before a noun or verb ('Fast' in Fast Market Research, 'at' birth, weight loss, skin, 'steadily', 'rapid'); pushes 'delete', 'cancel', 'removal', 'decline' and 'logout'.

L27n1092.name: Split capitalized name tails
L27n1092.description: The second piece of a capitalized name or long word, after a capital first piece, e.g. Car|ica, Min|ar, Ch|akma, Con|ception, Fem|ales, Bour|ges; pushes toward 'calculation', 'analysis', 'validation'.

L26n263.name: Opening parenthesis before aside
L26n263.description: Fires on an opening '(' right after a title, code, unit or number ('Edexcel GCSE (9-1)', 'Figure 5.11 (d)', '64.0°F (17.8°C)'); pushes toward word-ending fragments like 'rk', 'rn', 'rd', with no clear steered effect.

L27n3009.name: 'tr' word starts
