L27n3009.description: Fires on a 'tr' or 'Tr' piece that starts a word, such as 'tr' in Gertrude, trapezoid, trinkets, and trams. Pushes toward 'operation/operations', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1623.name: Syllable starts to char
L27n1623.description: Negative on the first syllable of a word split into pieces (mel|on, Squ|ares, pl|ow, Mah|arudhra); pushes toward 'char' and 'characters' tokens.

L26n1569.name: Surname leading piece
L26n1569.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized surname or first name split into tokens ('Gu' in Guinean, 'Le' in Lechner, 'Ant' in Antonio, 'Y' in Yefremov); pushes the model toward 'custom'.

L26n986.name: Connective before device verb
L26n986.description: Goes negative on 'to', 'and', 'which' or 'can' sitting right before a verb in sentences about devices and sensors ('microphone to track', 'records and releases', 'detectors which takes'). Pushes toward 'record' tokens.

L26n3023.name: Capital two-letter word-starts
L26n3023.description: Positive on a short capitalized word-start piece that begins a split word, such as 'En' in Enola Gay or Enrichment, 'Ber' in Beriberi, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Pad' in Padua. Pushes the model toward 'solution'.

L26n1595.name: Word-internal stem fragment
L26n1595.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece inside a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'rib' in arribadas, 'ob' in retinoblastoma, 'ann' in Tyrannosaurus, 'hem' in hemlock, 'hil' in hillocks; pushes toward 'lock' tokens.

L27n235.name: Rare foreign name pieces
L27n235.description: Negative on a middle or first piece of a rare name or foreign word (Ikht-iy-ar, Arabic ابن in Ibn Rushd, Abdu'l-B-ah-á, Po-iret, self-h-arm); pushes toward word-end pieces like 'urer' and 'arter'.

L27n1373.name: Sentence-end punctuation before newline
L27n1373.description: Fires on sentence- or line-ending punctuation, especially '.', ':', '!' or ')' right before a line break or code block. Pushes closing-quote and code-string tokens; steered output spams quote marks.

L24n1544.name: Split-word name fragments
L24n1544.description: Fires on a word-start fragment of a name or word split across several tokens, such as 'Ep' in 'Antiochus Epiphanes', 'Sin' in 'Sinus', 'Cor' in 'Cornutum', and 'Del' in 'Delville'. Its push toward 'options' is weak, so the link is loose.

L27n1543.name: 'cl'/'cons' starts, writes call
L27n1543.description: Goes negative on word-start 'cl' (clonemates, clots, clapping), 'cons' (conscription, consumption) and 'accom' (accompanied); pushes toward 'call'/'calls'.

L27n473.name: 'Over-' excess prefix
L27n473.description: Goes strongly negative on 'over' as an excess prefix or phrase ('over-do', 'over-population', 'over-hype', 'Over time'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'good'.

L27n1723.name: Latin name fragments, null
L27n1723.description: Non-initial pieces of Latin and scientific names ('cord|ata', 'S. cerv|isiae', 'Phryno|soma corn|utum', 'gu|illotine'). Pushes toward 'null' tokens.

L26n1642.name: Place-name starts Gar/Bar/Car
L26n1642.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised place or proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Gar' (gariga, Garvan), 'Bar' (Barrow-upon-Humber, Barataria), 'Car' (carob, Carica), 'Bour' (Bourges), 'Guar' (Guarani). Writes 'flight/fly' tokens, and the steered output is 'Flight flight' spam.

L27n1604.name: Split name piece, instance
L27n1604.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or word split into pieces, just before its continuation (Tim in 'Timely' and 'Tim Burton', Mah in Mahon, Bot in Bot Framework); pushes toward 'instance' tokens when negative.

L25n1402.name: Google brand names
L25n1402.description: Fires on the brand word 'Google' and on 'Maps' in product names, like 'Google Maps', 'Google Tag Manager' and 'Google VR'; pushes toward 'JSON' and 'API', though the steered effect is weak.

L26n2794.name: Word onsets, submit
L26n2794.description: The opening fragment of split words and names: Pan in Panzer, Bro in Broccoli, Bre in Breasted, Syn in Synod, stro in stroopkoek. Pushes toward 'submit' and 'submission' tokens.

L27n644.name: Title and proper-noun openers
L27n644.description: The first token of a title or proper name, such as 'Chief', 'Prince', 'Supreme', 'Electric', 'Linda', 'Yog', or the 'and' in 'Food and Drug'. Pushes toward frequency adverbs 'usually', 'typically', 'often', 'indeed'.

L26n376.name: Capitalized name openers
L26n376.description: The first one or two letters of a capitalized name split into pieces, such as 'Gra' in Graubünden, 'Fra' in Fraunhofer, 'Ja' in Jaipur, 'Zu' in Zigetsu. Pushes toward word endings 'n', 'ities', 'ians'.

L27n383.name: Mid-word piece, then B
L27n383.description: A piece inside a long word or name split into tokens ('neph|ro|logy', 'avers|ine', 'chol|era', 'retro|virus'). Pushes toward capital 'B' tokens.

L26n2238.name: Split-name middle pieces
L26n2238.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name or word (Az|alea, Maz|aheri, Dol|aucothi, Bol|ivian). Pushes toward a capital 'Z', and steering spams 'Z Z'.

L27n1206.name: Quantity digits, Greek letters
L27n1206.description: Fires on a digit or symbol inside a number or formula, e.g. the '0' in '250 F' or '10 times', and on name starts like 'Ik'. Pushes toward Greek letters such as gamma, delta, beta and alpha.

L26n1182.name: Al names and 'of'
L26n1182.description: Fires on 'Al' opening a name (Alfonso, Alonzo, Al Andalus) and on 'of' or 'Dead'/'Dynasty' right before a complement; pushes toward copula 'was/were/being', so steered text repeats 'was was was'.

L27n3027.name: Word piece before 'um'
L27n3027.description: Partial words that stop mid-word, such as 'exh' in exhales, 'gh' in sorghum, 'rhe' in rheumatic and 'perf' in perfumes; pushes the model toward 'um' pieces.

L26n725.name: Word fragments, spaces dropped
L26n725.description: Fires on the start or middle piece of a long word or name split into tokens: 'Comp' in complications, 'Comm' in commission, 'esp' in lifespans, 'Mag' in Magritte. At +0.5 it pushes toward single capitals and words run together without spaces.

L27n1590.name: Bare word-onset letters
L27n1590.description: Fires on bare word-opening letters split off as their own token, especially j in juts, jicama, or jamb, sh in shatter or shored, and sc in scallions or screech; pushes toward newline and LaTeX-style escape tokens.

L26n2758.name: Ex-/Del- word starts
L26n2758.description: Fires on word-start 'ex' and 'Del' pieces that continue into exodus, expanse, exfoliate and expiration, plus Pro- and Ju- starts; pushes 'statement' and 'Statement', so steering gives 'statement' spam.

L27n118.name: Technical tutorial tokens, diffuse
L27n118.description: Weak, diffuse negative drift across tutorial and code text. Peaks on numbers inside decimals or identifiers (0.01, 1.4), colons that open lists, and 'any' in instructions. Pushes toward 'ASCII', 'initialization' and 'README'.

L26n1944.name: Place-region word start
L26n1944.description: Goes negative on a geographic direction or region word that begins a place name or phrase, such as 'Middle' in 'Middle East', 'southern', 'Atlantic' coast, 'northeastern', 'tropical', and the 'P' in Pisa. Pushes toward 'park'.

L27n832.name: Name fragments before closers
L27n832.description: Fires on a middle or late subword piece of a capitalized proper name in encyclopedic or web text, e.g. 'ella' in Marbella, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'line' in linezolid, 'Hon' in Honolulu. Pushes toward closing tokens that end a quoted string or bracket, such as "), "], and '),.

L26n782.name: Diffuse; writes capital M
L26n782.description: Diffuse: fires on list dashes and colons, sentence-final periods, and the second word of multi-word terms (Ice Storm, High Blood Pressure, Stockholders); pushes capital-M tokens 'M', 'Mi', 'My'.

L26n1716.name: Name piece, past-tense did
L26n1716.description: Strongly negative on a name's middle piece (e.g. 'Pan' in Panaridus, 'Hash' in Hashem, 'Hos' in Hosfeld) and on 'and' or 'or' joining two verb phrases ('and was ready', 'or abridged'); steering it negative pushes toward past-tense verbs like 'did', 'came' and 'took'.

L24n1687.name: Mid/multi word openers
L24n1687.description: Fires on the opening piece of 'mid' and 'multi' words ('mid' in mid-section, mid-2000s, mid-April; 'multid' in multidisciplinary; 'multi' in multiple) and on 'every' or 'all' before a group noun. Pushes toward 'domain' and 'area'.

L26n28.name: Intensifier before a noun
L26n28.description: Fires on the intensifier or evaluative adjective ('significant', 'greatly', 'profound', 'critical') that sits between 'a' or 'has' and its noun in the opening line of a chat answer. The written tokens ('Empresa', '+E') carry no clear meaning, and steering gives only mild drift.

L26n1464.name: Word before predicate
L26n1464.description: A function word just before a predicate: 'being' and 'be' before a verb or adjective (being bullied, be afraid), 'so' before an adjective, 'getting', 'use'; pushes toward 'lie/lies/lying' repeats.

L24n1746.name: Persistence after still/remain
L24n1746.description: Positive on 'still', 'remain', 'oldest', 'longest', and the 'a/an' after 'has been' in statements of a continuing state ('is still molten', 'still on display'). Writes 'active' and steers into repetition.

L26n114.name: Line-end punctuation, note labels
L26n114.description: Goes strongly negative on a line break, quote or period that closes a dictionary-style sense or sits in a decimal number (the line break after a quoted example, the dot in 22.8 or python 3.4); pushes toward meta-note labels like 'Note', 'Explanation', 'Insert' and 'Required'.

L27n1367.name: Proper-name fragments Dor/Har
L27n1367.description: Fires (positive) on the first piece of a split proper name or place ('Dor|set', 'Har|binder', 'Har|riette', 'gu|ineensis'); pushes toward 'input' and 'inputs'.

L24n256.name: Latin-name middles; writes '{'
L24n256.description: Fires on middle pieces of Latin and scientific names split into tokens (Di|apt|om|us, X|yle|borus, Ps|oph|odes, Sticher|us bre|vitomentosus), and on digits inside dollar amounts; pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L13n3041.name: Task-prompt quality adjectives
L13n3041.description: Negative on the quality or criterion word in a writing request, the trait the piece should show: 'practical', 'ease' (of use), 'playful', 'variety', 'reliability', 'persuasive', 'intuitive', 'visuals', 'convenience'. Pushing it negative writes no clear token, only asterisk spam.

L27n715.name: Agency and institution names
L27n715.description: The head word of official agency or institution names (National, Army, Drug, Veterans, Wildlife, Military), peaking mid-name; pushes the model toward code type names 'String' and 'Object'.

L27n1549.name: Mid-word fragments, sm
L27n1549.description: Negative on word-internal pieces such as 'squ' in squirts and squishing, 'isc' in omniscient, 'oph' in sarcophagi; pushes toward 'sm' tokens.

L27n1221.name: Split proper-noun starts
L27n1221.description: Fires on the first piece of split names and words (Ker|et, Ze|alots, Tew|a, Azte|cs, gr|illing, LE|P); pushes toward two-letter capital codes like ML and SL.

L27n849.name: Mid-word vowel fragments
L27n849.description: Strongly negative on a middle fragment of a word split into tokens, especially a vowel-ending piece in a rare name (Infl|uen|za, cantal|ou|pe, Zam|be|zi, Leib|n|iz). Pushes toward 'az' and 'AZ' tokens; steered output spams 'Aziz'.

L25n2480.name: Preposition before recipient
L25n2480.description: The function word right before the recipient or object of a verb in feature descriptions (allows [users], enables, for diners, to everyday objects); pushes 'end'.

L26n1660.name: Ar/Mer word openers
L26n1660.description: Goes negative on the 'Ar' or 'Mer' opening piece of split words (Ar in arthritis, arsenic, archaeology; Mer in Merino, Merlins, Merthyr), also 'ter' in mites; pushes toward 'animal' tokens.

L27n1899.name: Split-word first fragment
L27n1899.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into several tokens, e.g. 'Pol' in 'Polycystic', 'Sc' in 'scraping', 'Vil' in 'Vilas', 'se' in 'secede', 'Nar' in 'Narayanganj'. Pushes toward '·', '/*' and 'cdot' tokens; steered, it spams '·' dots.

L26n1559.name: Split-word piece, writes 'ref'
L26n1559.description: Goes negative on a piece of a word split into tokens, either the leading piece (Sp-, Ep-, P-) or a mid-word piece (zy in homozygous, igr in Centigrade, ã in Guimarães). Pushes toward 'ref' tokens.

L26n2598.name: Place-name initial pieces
L26n2598.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letters of a proper or place name split into pieces (Bar in Barrow-upon-Humber and Barataria, Kos|ra|e, Mag in Magritte, Ele in Elephants); pushes toward 'contact', so steered text repeats 'contact'.

L27n2386.name: Word starts before token
L27n2386.description: Fires on the first piece of split words (apol|ipoprotein, bar|ges, bra|ids, sne|ezing, unequiv|ocal); pushes toward 'token' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n1702.name: Word-start G to event
L27n1702.description: Strongly negative on a capital or lowercase 'G' or 'g' that starts a word or name (Gutzon, Glooskap, GDP, gauze, gobbled), and on 'sc' in scarring. Pushes toward 'event' and 'events'.

L26n2215.name: Name fragments, closing-quote output
L26n2215.description: Goes negative on a word-start or middle piece inside a proper name split into tokens (Xer|xes, Se|ville, Hert|ford, Res|ervoir, Shi|loh); pushes toward closing quotes and brackets such as ']' and '}'.

L25n1475.name: Mid-word technical pieces
L25n1475.description: Mid-word pieces of technical or medical words (pan|leukopenia, ca|uliflower, neu|romas, Astr|onomical, ad|renalin); pushes toward 'data' tokens, which steered outputs repeat.

L23n2473.name: Comma/dash after aside
L23n2473.description: Fires negative on a comma, dash or parenthesis that closes an introductory phrase or aside, e.g. the comma after 'we are in space' or 'guilty of it', and the em-dash in 'isn't too complex'. Pushes toward 'after'.

L27n2213.name: Name word onsets
L27n2213.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or compound (Ub in Graubünden, Z in Zatorre, Eug in Eugen, Sh in Shiloh, Mu in Muir Beach, Ch in Chaco, sm in smog, ch in chowders). Pushes toward 'meet/meeting'.

L27n22.name: Closing quote or bracket
L27n22.description: Fires on closing punctuation such as quotes, ')' and ']' at the end of a span in lists and citations; pushes the model toward random capital letters and gibberish.

L26n1792.name: Medical and Slavic fragments
L26n1792.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a medical or Slavic-region term (gl|omerular, cerv|ix, epi|lepsy, Bel|arussian, Yugosl|av); pushes 'Russia', 'Russian' and 'Soviet', so steering gives 'Russia' spam.

L26n1410.name: Ac/Or/cr word starts
L26n1410.description: Opening pieces 'Ac', 'Or', 'cr' and 'ort' of capitalized or split names and medical words (Ac|oustic, Ac|upuncture, Or|mara, cr|anes, B|ort|nyik); pushes toward 'bool'.

L25n1110.name: Physical motion; 'left/front' output
L25n1110.description: Fires on a physical movement or posture word after 'like', 'between' or 'brakes,' (crawling, upright, kicked, motorcycle). Pushes toward spatial direction words 'left' and 'front'.

L26n1318.name: Short word-start h fragment
L26n1318.description: Goes negative on a bare 'h' or other short prefix that opens a split word (h|edges, h|ump, self-h|arm, h|awthorn). Pushes toward quality nouns like 'accuracy', 'correctness', 'reliability' and 'simplicity'.

L27n2579.name: Sanskrit and name fragments
L27n2579.description: Fires on the middle piece of split foreign words and names, especially Sanskrit 'ś' and 'ṭ' or the 's' in Sita and Picual; pushes the '/' path-like token.

L27n2439.name: Citation/URL/number punctuation
L27n2439.description: Goes negative on punctuation inside citations, URLs, dates and numbers: '(' in 4(2), '=' in a URL, '-' in 2021-05, '.' in 1.000.000, '//' and '&' in links. Pushes toward stray single letters like 's', 'S', 'O'.

L25n101.name: Period after speaker tag
L25n101.description: Strongly negative on the period that closes a speaker tag ('she noted.', 'Cameron said.') right before a quoted sentence, plus words inside quotes such as 'Imagine' and 'beginning'. Pushes toward closing quote marks.

L27n38.name: Name piece to is
L27n38.description: Strongly negative on an early or middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, such as 'uh' in Mwawe, 'Hash' in Hashem, 'Cre' in Cremonesi or 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar. Pushes toward short tokens 'is', 'at', 'am' and 'h'.

L2n1596.name: Fixed-phrase second word
L2n1596.description: Negative on the second word of fixed phrases: 'of' in 'an average of', 'only' in 'not only ... but also', 'of' in 'law of'. Writes multilingual junk tokens at this early layer.

L27n1668.name: Word-internal piece, writes enter
L27n1668.description: A non-initial piece of a multi-token word, e.g. 'hem' in hemlock, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'mon' in monounsaturated, 'en' in Cenozoic. Pushes toward 'enter' and 'exit'.

L26n653.name: Name starts, CJK glyphs
L26n653.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or glyph of a proper name or an unusual token: 'P' in Pheasant Wood, 'Hy' in Hyde Avenue, 勇 in the brave sigil, and 分 and 装 in Japanese and Chinese text. Pushes toward accented-letter fragments such as Ä and â, with no clear theme.

L27n2398.name: Word fragment, writes critical
L27n2398.description: Fires on a piece of a rare word or name split into several tokens, mostly the stem or middle piece (e.g. 'erc' in counterclockwise, 'Kra' in Kraig, 'Kh' in Kharkiv, 'alm' in Talmud); pushes the model to write 'critical' and 'crit'; steered output loops 'Critical critical'.

L27n785.name: Rare-name middle pieces
L27n785.description: Fires on a middle piece of a rare name split into several tokens (Abdu'l-B|ah|á, Hot|am|isligil, Alm|oh|ad, Dvur Kral|ove); pushed positive it promotes 'eight'.

L26n1363.name: Name fragments, JS output
L26n1363.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a proper name or species (e.g. 'rg' in Jorgensen, 'Han' in Hanuman, 'chin' in Litchi chinensis, 'pt' in Leptin); pushes 'undefined' and 'document' (JavaScript).

L27n1957.name: Name/compound first piece
L27n1957.description: The first piece of a multi-token name or compound (Cle in Cleve Cole, Has in Hasmon, Mel in Melons, ipation in Emancipation), and the article 'a' after 'highlight'. Pushes toward 'word'; steered output spams 'word'.

L24n2223.name: Tech modifiers before nouns
L24n2223.description: Technical modifiers and name fragments in electronics and ML text ('single' in single-phase, 'receiver' in receiver bias, '3' in 3-phase, 'Rud' in Rudolph); pushes 'input' and 'inputs'.

L27n1069.name: Technical word fragments; 'type'
L27n1069.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of technical or medical terms (catal|ase, hydro|xy|deoxyguanosine, cerv|isiae, ble|ached, per|itoneal). Pushes 'type' and 'Type' tokens; steered output is 'type type' spam.

L24n1547.name: Organization and place names
L24n1547.description: Goes negative on the first word of organization, country and place names: 'World' in World Bank or World War, 'UN', 'United' in United Nations, and 'Wu' in Wuhan. Pushes the model to write 'size'.

L26n2710.name: Opening 'wh'/'sw' fragments
L26n2710.description: Word-opening fragments 'wh', 'sw' and 'unw' split off from the rest of the word (whizzes, whiten, Whiskers, swallowing, swimmers); pushes toward 'sensitive' and 'sensitivity'.

L27n2076.name: Name starts, writes 'else'
L27n2076.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or word, especially 'ble' in bleach or bleached and 'Ch' in Chameleons or Chimp. Steering it up pushes the model toward 'else' and 'otherwise' conditionals, and the output spams 'else'.

L27n408.name: Mid-word fragments before suffix
L27n408.description: Goes negative on pieces in the middle of a split word, e.g. 'wors' in 'worsens', 'spl' in 'splints', 'isk' in 'Oriskany', 'pneum'; pushes toward 'ne/ner' suffix tokens.

L27n2751.name: Mid-word fragment, weight
L27n2751.description: Fires on an inner piece of a split word, e.g. 'bul' in bulges, 'aw' in gigawatts, 'ow' in bioweapon, 'ew' in lukewarm; pushes the model toward 'weight'.

L26n2338.name: Name fragments → con
L26n2338.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a split proper name, often a place or person, e.g. 'lan' in Hojiblanca, 'Dur' in Durban, 'ac' in Chacocente, 'Ras' in Rasporich; pushes toward 'con' tokens.

L26n2933.name: Noun stems, apple/fruit output
L26n2933.description: The stem piece of a plural or compound noun split into tokens, often animal, plant or food words (pige|ons, we|evils, Par|akeet, ind|igo, blo|ating, Z|ebra); pushes toward 'apple' and 'fruit'.

L27n1330.name: Name piece, writes French
L27n1330.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a proper name split across tokens (e.g. 'is' in Bois Blanc, 'Dev' in Devanand, 'Ram' in Ramayana, 'ulk' in Tendulkar, 'erm' in vermilion); pushes 'French', 'France' and 'Paris'; steered output loops 'French French'.

L27n818.name: Capitalized heading key term
L27n818.description: Fires on the capitalised key term inside a title or list heading, e.g. 'K' in 'Vitamin K Deficiency', 'Hunger' in 'Zero Hunger Initiative', 'Dirty' in 'Dirty Dozen', 'Lights' in 'UFO Lights'. Pushes toward 'Log' and 'Math' tokens.

L26n2301.name: Name-start pieces, cloud output
L26n2301.description: The first piece of a split proper or chemical name (sul|foxaflor, T|endulkar, Ash|kelon, Dor|set, Ker|rie); pushes hard toward 'cloud' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L26n814.name: Latin-term middle fragments
L26n814.description: Fires on a middle fragment of a split Latin or scientific term: 'am' in Cinnamomum, 'ag' in Selaginellaceae, 'yle' in Xyleborus, 'OC' in Echinococcus, 'ov' in ovary, 'Pret' in Pretoria. Steering pushes toward closing code brackets like ']):' and '}]', not the text.

L25n1019.name: Goal verbs; 'options' output
L25n1019.description: Fires on the verb right after a subject in a how-to or goal sentence ('can *avoid* mistakes', 'Leaders must *ensure*', 'reduces', 'provide', 'identify'). Pushes toward 'options' tokens.

L26n2889.name: Titus and split-word pieces
L26n2889.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word, most often 'Tit' in Titus (Tit|us Andronicus, Emperor Tit|us), and also 'clus', 'sou' and 'com' (sar|com|as). Writes 'install'/'installation'; steering spams 'Install'.

L26n2906.name: Split-word middles, metric
L26n2906.description: Goes negative on the middle piece of split words (Pot in Potomac, 'od' in Rhododendron, 'kil' in kilogram, 'oe' in onomatopoeia, 'lot' in lotteries) and on digits inside large numbers. Pushes toward 'metric'.

L27n420.name: Mid-word pieces in names
L27n420.description: Fires on the middle piece of split words like cantal|ou|pe, sucr|al|ose and Gett|ys|burg; pushes toward capital-letter codes like PA, PD and PB.

L24n1364.name: Method prepositions, name fragments
L24n1364.description: Fires negatively on the preposition ('by', 'to', 'through') linking a method to its goal in technical sentences about attacks, and on the middle of split names ('auc' in Chaucer, 'ern' in Caernarvon, 'Du' in DuPont); pushes toward 'factor' and 'fact'.

L26n2778.name: Historical proper name starts
L26n2778.description: Fires on the first letter or fragment of an ancient or historical proper name ('H' in Hellenistic and Hittite, 'X' in Xerxes, 'T' in Tiberius, 'Ram' in Ramkhamhaeng). Pushes toward 'probability'.

L26n668.name: Surname fragments, pre-noun words
L26n668.description: Surname or name pieces (Alf|ano, El|f, Sa|uerkraut) and words right before a noun phrase (such as, professor at, a local); pushes toward 'participant' and 'participants'.

L26n2533.name: Word-initial N fragments
L26n2533.description: Fires on a word-initial 'N' or 'n' fragment, usually a capitalized or split word start (N-ell, N-imetz, N-esting, n-ose, N-ausea, Gran-ada, C-en-ozoic); pushes 'zero', 'null' and 'NaN' tokens.

L27n457.name: Compound middle, writes week
L27n457.description: Strongly negative on the middle piece of a split compound, hyphenated name or acronym, such as '-' in Merriam-Webster, 'GV' in GVWR, 'ON' in BRONCO or 'cross' in crossfire. Pushes toward 'week' and 'w' tokens.

L24n808.name: Name pieces, use regex
L24n808.description: Goes negative on mid-name subword fragments ('ø' in Jørgensen, 'ush' in Lepsiushaus, 'eh' in Kaleh) and on 'use' or 'using' before 'regular expressions'. Pushing it negative makes the model write browser-DOM words like 'document' and 'window'.

L25n1090.name: Digits and kana mid-token
L25n1090.description: Mid-token pieces inside numbers and Japanese verbs: the middle digit of a temperature or year (18|6|9) and kana verb endings (た, い, を). Pushes toward '。' and ')'.

L26n3059.name: Recipe list joiners
L26n3059.description: Goes negative on the comma or 'and' that joins items in a food or ingredient list, just before the last item (e.g. 'green beans, bacon, and almonds', 'egg yolks, egg and sugar'). Pushes toward 'protocol'.

L26n722.name: Modal can before effect
L26n722.description: Strongly negative on 'can' or 'will' right after a subject in a claim about an impact or risk (e.g. 'screen time can', 'social media can', 'thinning too much can', 'will lead'); steering it negative pushes toward 'achieve' and 'achieved'.

L27n1452.name: Split-word F fragment
L27n1452.description: Fires on a capital 'F' that opens a word or name split into tokens (Faisal, Festival, Ferry, Fauvism), mid-sentence. Pushes the model toward opening brackets '(' and '['.

L24n1150.name: Mixed technical grab-bag
L24n1150.description: Diffuse: fires on 'subnet' in networking text, 'confidence' before 'interval', '2D' in Excel lookups, 'locate', and capital or fragment tokens like 'bre' and 'Mont'; pushes toward 'range'.

L27n1425.name: Ch word-start digraphs
L27n1425.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'Ch', 'ch', 'Br' or 'P' piece that starts a word split into tokens, e.g. 'Ch' in Ch|aco, Ch|hattisgarh, Ch|ores, Ch|akma, Ch|ao Phraya, and 'P' in P|alla. Going negative pushes toward '>' followed by a letter, such as >i and >d.

L25n2927.name: Split-name middle pieces
L25n2927.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'h' (Bagh), 'Pul' (Pulwarty), 'Kel' (Kelentric), 'roph' (electrophoresis), 'Hil' (Hilfiger), 'Kh' (Khisa), 'ze' (Roozeboom). Writes 'OK/ok' tokens, and the steered output is 'OKOKOK' spam.

L27n2506.name: Rare-word fragment pieces
L27n2506.description: Fires on a piece of a rare or transliterated word split into several tokens, e.g. 'ṭ' and 'Yog' in Sanskrit, 'gr' in 'grilling', 'contr' in 'contrarious', 'trib' in 'tribus', 'yll' in 'Phyllis'. Pushes toward '}{', '))){' and 'speaking'; steered, it repeats 'speaking to her'.

L27n2641.name: Name/word starts, query output
L27n2641.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split across tokens, such as Ac in Acquired, Ish in Ishiguro, ah in Abdu'l-Bahá and per in pernicious; pushes toward 'query' tokens when negative.

L26n1531.name: ALL-CAPS headings and screenplay
L26n1531.description: Fires on words inside all-caps headings and screenplay scene headers ('FADE IN', 'EXT.', 'LIFE CYCLE OF', 'CHECKLIST TO DETERMINE', 'GET SUPPORT'). Pushes the model toward unrelated lowercase words such as 'things' and 'self'.

L27n1530.name: Predicate-opening words, brackets
L27n1530.description: Fires on a modal, infinitive or linking word that opens a predicate (may, to, be, would, become, being, which, before) in prose and instructions. Pushes toward closing brackets and braces (]] and }}); steered output spams ]].

L23n2299.name: Weak reads, vector writes
L23n2299.description: Weak, scattered reads on technical nouns and word fragments (acceleration, Jet, Feature); pushes toward 'vector'.

L26n1458.name: Word-start fragments, mixed topics
L26n1458.description: First piece of a multi-token word, often the start of a noun (fasc|iitis, arr|hythmias, Hug|uenots, puzz|les, UT|I, Scout B|SA); pushes toward 'sports' and 'sport'.

L27n1917.name: Mid-word fragment, writes gap
L27n1917.description: Second piece of multi-token words, e.g. 'deg' in degenerate and degeneration, 'fr' in franchised, 'if' in kiwifruit; pushes toward 'gap' and 'holes'.

L27n1359.name: Auxiliaries before verbs
L27n1359.description: Fires on an auxiliary or infinitive marker just before its verb ('be' in 'will be abandoned', 'to' in 'to repair', 'is' in 'is cut', 'can' in 'can be', 'or' in 'or donated'); pushes toward 'real' and 'Real', so steering spams 'real'.

L27n514.name: Opening bracket or quote
L27n514.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis, quote mark, or URL separator just before an aside, unit, or quoted term, e.g. '(1 m)', '“safe-space”', '://'. Pushes toward 'u'-initial word fragments; steered, it produces 'uuuu' gibberish.

L27n432.name: Capital start of name
L27n432.description: Fires on the capitalised first piece of a split proper name (Br|ueseh, Bl|asco, Br|unsbüttel, Ish|iguro). Pushes bullet and separator symbols '·', '•', '||', '»' and '##'; steered output is a row of dots.

L27n2494.name: 'fl' word-start → backslashes
L27n2494.description: Fires on the 'fl' opening of a word split into tokens (e.g. fluoroquinolones, flares, fluvial, flammable, Flanner). Pushes toward backslash tokens (steered output is runs of double backslashes).

L26n2170.name: Split-word fragments, 'ra' output
L26n2170.description: Fires on a middle piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'neut' in neutron, 'nit' in nitrous, 'cent' in 'recentred', or 'lect' in electrons; pushes toward word-start fragments 'r', 'ra', and 'rá'.

L26n1585.name: Word-start fragments, writes direction
L26n1585.description: Goes positive on word-start fragments of words split across tokens, strongest on 'radi' (radiographs, radiating, radiologists, RADIATION) and also 'stage', 'art' and 'orient'; pushes the model toward 'direction/dir' tokens.

L25n1188.name: Mid-word 'sp' and 'methyl'
L25n1188.description: Fires on short word-start fragments inside a split word or name, mostly 'sp', 'Sp', 'methyl' and 'eth' (Sp|arta, sp|illing, methyl|mercury, Aeth|iopia). Pushes the model toward 'transform' and 'convert' words.

L26n1811.name: Word-start 'hal'/'prof' pieces
L26n1811.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'hal' (halos, halting, halving), 'prof' (professed, proficiency), 'reaff', 'Diff' and 'E' (E|MBASE). Pushed positive it steers output toward 'file' and 'download'.

L23n1647.name: Mid-word fragments, C types
L23n1647.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a rare word split into several tokens: 'op' in 'leopards', 'app' in 'lappaceum', 'Cr' in 'Crataegus', 'ios' in 'Cardiospermum'. Pushes toward C and C++ type keywords such as 'int', 'bool', 'void', 'uint' and 'char'.

L26n2935.name: Foreign name middle pieces
L26n2935.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a multi-token proper name, typically non-English: 'ah' in Maz|ah|eri, 'á' in Kár|old, 'azar' in Alc|azar|as, 'Ho' in Ho|jiblanca, 'Lak' in Lak|shmi. Pushes toward 'plot'.

L27n2820.name: Name opener, perform writer
L27n2820.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a name or word split into pieces (Hil|figer, Mes|qu|ita, Mar|uya, Emilian|ia, Aqua|Bounty). Pushes toward 'perform' tokens.

L26n2924.name: Rare-name later pieces
L26n2924.description: Fires on a later piece of a rare name or word split into several tokens (Bort|ny|ik, Mack|inac, Rab|ag|lia, Ath|ab|asca, th|iam|ine). Pushes toward 'lines' and 'line', and steering spams 'lines lines'.

L27n806.name: Rare proper-noun opener, backtick
L27n806.description: First piece of a rare foreign or proper name split into tokens (P|umsaint, Bo|iry, Có|rdoba, Č|a|čić, Maj|orelle, Ik|htiyar). Pushes toward backtick characters.

L27n833.name: 'to' before action verb
L27n833.description: 'to' or 'or' right before an action verb (cause them |to| swell, ask you |to| lie, begins |to| urinate, shake their head |or|), plus verb stems like 'brushing', 'washing', 'cutting'. Negative firing pushes toward 'drink'.

L27n2803.name: Proper-name fragment San/enc
L27n2803.description: Fires on the opening piece of a proper name or split word, e.g. 'San' in San Luis Obispo or San Simeon, 'enc' in enclosures, 'iod' in Heliodorus; pushes the model toward 'Australian'.

L26n1155.name: Digit or hyphen prefix
L26n1155.description: Fires on the digit that starts a quantity or on the prefix before a hyphen (e.g. '1' in 1/4 cup, '4' in 4x4 keypad, '-f' in three-forked); its output points to 'tab' words.

L25n207.name: Answer-start newlines
L25n207.description: Fires on the newline right after '</think>' that opens a chat answer, and on the line break before a list (':⏎- It'). Writes commas and separators ('，', '、', '—'); pushed, the output adds blank lines and '**end**'.

L27n636.name: Proper-noun word pieces
L27n636.description: Early pieces of multi-token proper nouns and place or person names (Sats|uki, Gu|atem|alan, Nov|gorod, Han|umadh, Middles|brough, Pry|pyat); pushes toward 'uniform' and 'University' tokens, and steered output spams 'University'.

L2n695.name: Diffuse ogenic and unknown
L2n695.description: Diffuse: goes negative on the suffix 'ogenic' (anthrop|ogenic, path|ogenic), on 'unknown' in target or contact contexts, and on 'of' after 'goal' or 'aim'. Steering gives 'virus', 'V' and 'Vm', so the write side is unclear.

L23n1923.name: Token before 'space(s)'
L23n1923.description: Goes strongly negative on connector words in task or spec sentences ('by' in 'separated by spaces', 'have' in 'can have spaces', 'double' in 'double-spaced'), peaking on the word just before a 'space' idea. Pushes the model to write 'space' and 'spaces'.

L21n1228.name: Weak function-word reads, zero
L21n1228.description: Very weak reads on function words after verbs (because, with, of, to); pushes toward 'zero'.

L27n2183.name: Post-system-tag newline; fragments
L27n2183.description: The newline right after '<|im_start|>system' that opens a system prompt, plus mid-word fragments such as 'Emergency' or 't' in 'tail'. Pushes toward code closers ('}]', '");}').

L25n1455.name: Name fragments, prompt writer
L25n1455.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a name or technical term (Mogad|ore, Nemad|ji, Novgor|od, Rhod|odendron, Xyle|bor|us); pushes 'prompt', 'encourage' and 'incentives', so steering gives 'prompt' and 'encouraging' spam.

L27n2401.name: Unfinished word-start pieces
L27n2401.description: Strongly negative on the piece right after a word's first letters while the word is still unfinished, e.g. 'f' in feta and fritters, 'athy' in hypoparathyroidism, 'Ish' in Ishiguro, 'alth' in Waltham, 'infl' in inflamed. Pushes toward 'union'.

L26n1676.name: Prefixed word stems, medical
L26n1676.description: The stem piece before a word's second half in prefixed or compound words, such as 'heart' in heartbreak, 'post' in post-breakup, 'asy' in parasympathetic, 'phys' in physiotherapy. Pushes toward 'operation' and 'operations'.

L27n2115.name: Proper-name fragment starts
L27n2115.description: The first subword piece of a capitalised surname or first name, right after a person's name or title, e.g. 'Gr' in Grisons, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'Be' in Becciu, 'Gre' in Straume, 'Te' in Teesside. Pushes toward 'decision' tokens.

L27n2700.name: Split name/word pieces
L27n2700.description: A first or middle piece of a name or word split into several tokens, e.g. 'Ker' in Keret, 'Hodg' in Hodgskin, 'Hog' in Hogarth, 'Yog' in Yogi, 'spr' in sprouted; pushes toward 'progress'.

L27n949.name: Pro- word opener
L27n949.description: Fires on the 'pro' or 'Pro' token opening a split word (pro|phethood, pro|liferation, Pro|clamation, pro|dded, pro|videncejournal), plus 'Az' and 'Ap' openers; pushed positive it promotes 'test'.

L26n2844.name: Place names, first piece
L26n2844.description: Fires on the first piece of place or proper names such as 'Marr' in Marrakesh, 'Zam' in Zambezi, 'Mal' in Malawi, 'ata' in Crataegus. Pushes toward 'independent' and 'dependent'.

L27n2975.name: Mid-word piece, negation prefix
L27n2975.description: Goes negative on a middle or late piece of a long word split into tokens (e.g. 'g' in polygamy, 'hid' in hidrosis, 'iam' in thiamine, 'k' in kissing). Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'no', 'non' and 'not'.

L24n1513.name: Name/term start, weak
L24n1513.description: Weak, scattered firing on the start or first fragment of a name or term after a title or split: 'Chris' in 'Governor Chris Christie', 'alt' in 'altcoins', 'U' in 'UMDNJ'. Pushes toward '+'-prefixed tokens like +A and +E, with no clear effect when steered.

L26n392.name: line-break and open-paren boundaries
L26n392.description: Goes strongly negative on a newline, opening parenthesis or dash that splits a phrase mid-sentence ('inspired ⏎by', '(' before '27.2°C', '(' in 'LAMP (Linux'). Pushes toward the prepositions 'of', 'to' and 'by'.

L24n1449.name: Opposite words, name fragments
L24n1449.description: Fires on 'opposite' and 'opposing' (opposite polarity). It also fires on odd fragments inside names: the 'ø' in Jørgensen, 'Carl', 'Charles', 'Cart' in Carte du Ciel. Pushes toward 'sign' and 'signs'. The name part is unrelated to the opposition part.

L26n999.name: 'hot' and food-list pieces
L26n999.description: Goes positive on 'hot' (hot chocolate, hot water, hot sauce) and on non-final pieces of food or item words in lists (m|ango, B|ites, t|ummy, ind|igo). Writes 'consume'/'consumption'; steering spams 'Consum'.

L27n1709.name: Grass and plant-name stems
L27n1709.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of split plant names, esp. 'agr' in bermud|agr|ass and '-gr' in grass compounds, and 'pl' in germ|pl|asm; top tokens are scattered and it pushes toward ass tokens.

L27n2065.name: 're-' prefix word-start
L27n2065.description: Goes strongly negative on the 're' piece opening a word with the re- prefix (reusable, reprocessing, recognising, rearranging, recon); pushes toward 'entry' tokens.

L23n1007.name: Name fragments and 'the'
L23n1007.description: Goes strongly negative on the first fragment of a split rare name or term, such as 'Kos' in Kosrae, 'Wol' in Wolpertingers, 'sol' in solstice, and 'Fol' in Folio, and on 'the' before a noun. Pushes toward 'input' and 'source'.

L26n1259.name: Short mid-word fragments, ab/al
L26n1259.description: Positive on a 2-3 letter fragment in the middle of a word, such as 'ab' in abacus or abundant, 'al' in aldehyde or praline, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'Rh' in Rhododendron. Pushes the model toward 'initial' and 'init'.

L26n2375.name: Split-word opening fragments
L26n2375.description: Fires on the first one or two letters of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'P' in Polar, 'po' in poached, 'p' in puffling; points the model toward 'exercise'.

L27n861.name: Quantity words before nouns
L27n861.description: Fires on a quantity word or adjective right before the noun it modifies ('two' teeth, 'a few' organs, 'other' organs, 'numerous', 'sticky' foods, 'sensitive' skin); pushes toward 'company'.

L27n335.name: Capitalized noun-head onsets
L27n335.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun head (Bo in Boer, B in B-29, O in OER, Vil in Vilas, V in V2 rockets), and on nouns like water, ozone and taste (waterways, ozone layer, taste buds). Pushes toward generic data-structure nouns (matrix, network, tree, table, array).

L24n8.name: 'sal'/'hal' word fragments
L24n8.description: Fires on the 'sal' or 'hal' opening fragment of a word split into pieces ('sal|ivary', 'Sal|azar', 'hal|ting'). Pushes the model toward rare, noisy tokens with no clear effect.

L26n2504.name: Technical word-start, writes 'rent'
L26n2504.description: Goes negative on the short opening fragment of a long technical word, e.g. 'photoc' (photocatalytic), 'GC' (GCSE), 'Ac' (Acids), 'oc' (radiocarbon). Pushes toward 'rent' and 'maintenance' tokens.

L26n2631.name: Word-start 'm' and 'P'
L26n2631.description: Fires on a one-letter 'm' or 'P' that opens a split word, mostly mid-sentence (e.g. 'm' in mucus, 'Verm' in vermilion, 'P' in PLOS); points toward 'teacher(s)'.

L25n1597.name: Mid-word fragments → sc
L25n1597.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long technical or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'andes' in incandescent, 'ores' in electrophoresis, 'os' in colonoscopy, 'cre' in Lucrece; pushes toward 'sc' word starts.

L26n876.name: Name starts, writes brackets
L26n876.description: Fires on starts of names and places (St-, Se-, Oltenberg, Domenici); pushes toward closing brackets like '])),' and ')))'.

L25n2311.name: Surname middle pieces
L25n2311.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split surname (Hotam|is|ligil, Mel|vin, Me|aux, Hu|izinga, Herbert Grü|newald, Bot|anik). Writes 'quant'/'quantity'; steering spams 'Quant'.

L25n2750.name: Place-name pieces, missing output
L25n2750.description: Word pieces that open a place or proper name (Marr|akesh, Nord|hausen, Mart|el, Pry|pyat) and '-int' in high- and low-intensity; pushes toward 'missing', which steered outputs repeat.

L27n2096.name: Name piece, pushes 'new'
L27n2096.description: Positive on a sub-token inside a proper name or loanword, e.g. 'Lord S|iva', 'Lak|shmi', 'Tur|abian', 'Ph|raya Nakhon', 'Gar|uda'. Pushes toward adjectives like 'andere', 'neue' and 'erste' (other, new, first); steered output reads as ordinary prose.

L27n90.name: 'of' in titles, first-names
L27n90.description: Fires on 'of' inside a named title or proper noun (e.g. 'Battle of Thermopylae', 'Song of Ice and Fire', 'Life of Wulfram') and on first names such as Richard, Johannes and Jean; pushes odd suffix fragments like ittings, rippling and typing.

L27n2876.name: Mid-word pieces; writes 'appear'
L27n2876.description: Fires on a partial token that opens a longer split word, often a name or noun (Nap|ster, Ch|ame|leons, Mer|ino, thr|ong); pushes toward 'appear' and 'appearance'.

L27n1642.name: All-caps fragment (neg)
L27n1642.description: Goes strongly negative on a capital-letter fragment inside an all-caps word or name ('TE' in INTELLIGENCE and TEENAGER, 'EXT' in screenplay 'EXT.', 'Č' in Tomo Čačić); when negated, it pushes toward sentence openers like 'From', 'If', 'For' and 'And'.

L26n2510.name: Word-start pieces, decom
L26n2510.description: Fires negative on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'decom' in decompose, 'g' in gaseous and gout, 'Com' in compost, 'Ch' in chores. Pushes toward 'subscribe/subscription'.

L25n928.name: Opening paren before acronym
L25n928.description: Goes negative on the '(' that opens an acronym expansion (Federal Emergency Relief Administration (FERA), fatty acid synthase (FAS)) and on 'versus' in 'Fact versus Fiction'. Pushes toward f- and fl- UI and code words such as front, flag, flow and feature.

L27n737.name: Word-fragment, writes female nouns
L27n737.description: A mid-word fragment that opens a longer word: 'cur' in curator, 'inv' in invigorating, 'izz' in frizzled, 'ru' in cruelty, 'mor' in morose. Pushes toward female nouns (women, girl, mother).

L25n1624.name: Place-name fragments, float
L25n1624.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split place or person name ('Nan' in Nanaimo, 'Pin' in Pinatubo, 'Ki' in Ban Ki-moon). Weak and noisy on other fragments. Pushes toward 'float'.

L26n2423.name: Long-word opening piece
L26n2423.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a long technical word split into tokens, most strongly 'metast' in metastasis and 'synth' in synthase, and weaker on 'paraph' in 'Can you paraphrase'; pushes toward 'asset' tokens.

L26n1663.name: Capitalised name's first fragment
L26n1663.description: Fires on the short first subword piece of a capitalised name or split word, mainly 'Ar', 'Gar', 'Cor', 'Or' starts (Arnett, Aragon, Arbuscular), while later pieces stay near 0. Writes 'rank' tokens, which the steered output only repeats.

L26n1724.name: Acronym parenthesis, M-words
L26n1724.description: The '(' or first letter right before an acronym abbreviation, e.g. '(MET)', '(MIF)', '(HMOs)', '(MDA)', '(WMO)', '(ECMWF)'; pushes toward M-initial words such as 'message', 'money', 'match'.

L26n213.name: 'non-' and 'semi-' prefixes
L26n213.description: Fires on the prefix 'non' (non-invasive, non-stick, non-contact) or 'semi' (semiannually) just before a hyphen-joined or compound stem. Pushes toward 'an'/'An' tokens.

L25n2771.name: Acronym and name fragments
L25n2771.description: Fires on a piece inside an acronym or name that is split into tokens: 'isk' in Oriskany, 'mik' in microC, 'PO' in POC, 'GC' in GCSE, 'Ap' in Apocrypha, 'Mir' in Mirai. Pushes toward 'key' and 'keys'.

L25n1700.name: Capital name-starts; '[' output
L25n1700.description: Fires on the first capital letter or abbreviation start of a proper name or code term (E in E.coli, C in C++, Fort in Fort Stanwix). Also fires on 'https' and 'chars' in URLs and code. Pushes toward an opening square bracket '['.

L26n238.name: Capital letter starting names
L26n238.description: Fires on the first letter or piece of a capitalized name or word split into tokens (e.g. 'G' in Gerais, 'M' in Marrakesh, 'V' in Vitiligo, 'metam' in metamorphosis). Pushes toward closing parentheses, brackets and quote-marks.

L27n2081.name: Word-start m fragments
L27n2081.description: Strongly negative on a bare word-start 'm' or 'M' fragment that begins a split word (M|esoamerica, m|ussels, m|ango, m|ated, ym|ade). Pushes toward 'byte' and 'bytes' tokens; steered output spams 'bytes'.

L27n2090.name: Word-start fragments, 'theorem'
L27n2090.description: The opening piece of a long word split into tokens (enc in encroachment, rec in recycling, unp in unpasteurized), pushing 'theorem' or 'lemma'.

L27n2681.name: Bare capital N
L27n2681.description: A bare capital N that starts an acronym or word (NHTSA, Nausea, Nurses, NIE, Nimetz, NORTH); pushes the model toward 'fire' tokens.

L26n1648.name: Name and subword fragments
L26n1648.description: Fires on the second word of a personal name, and on the fragment 'metabol' in metabolite. Pushes toward 'input' tokens.

L27n1663.name: Animal-word first fragment
L27n1663.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens, mostly 'rh' in rhino and 'fl' in flax or flares, plus 'Hel' in helicopters. Effect pushes toward 'str' tokens, which do not match the reads.

L26n1782.name: Indic fragments, pay writer
L26n1782.description: Fires on a mid-word piece in Sanskrit transliterations and other split words (sadh|ana, Lak|shmana, catal|ytic, pal|atability); pushes 'pay', 'paid' and 'payment', so steering gives 'pay' spam.

L25n2099.name: Word-start 'ther/Her' fragments
L25n2099.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (ther in thermostatic, ter in termites, Her in Herat, Tra in Trauma, Archae in Archaeological); pushes toward 'traditional' and 'conventional', so steered output spams 'Traditional'.

L25n651.name: Name-start fragment, brackets
L25n651.description: The first piece of a proper name or odd capitalised word, e.g. 'Ch' in Chaco, 'Min' in Minas, 'Kol' in Kolowich. Pushes toward empty '[]' and '{}' brackets; steered, it spams them.

L25n1422.name: Proper-noun first piece
L25n1422.description: The first piece of a capitalized name (Saint|Francis, Van|Gogh, Car|cassonne, Col|enso, Rep. Maloney); pushes 'origin' and 'start'.

L26n1466.name: Surname starts; men
L26n1466.description: The first fragment of a capitalized personal or club name split into tokens (Mos in Moses, Kos, Roth, Luc, Sk in Skutnabb); pushes toward 'men', 'man' and 'boys'.

L24n2104.name: Proper-noun start fragments
L24n2104.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a capitalized proper noun split into pieces, e.g. 'Har' in Harpenden or Harriet, 'Bag' in Shalimar Bagh. Pushes the model toward '%' format tokens, with no clear effect.

L26n2994.name: Word-start fragments, competition output
L26n2994.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly in names and technical terms (orth|otic, Tomb|stone, elect|rophoresis, Anch|orage); pushes 'compete' and 'competition', so steering gives 'competition' spam.

L27n1161.name: Name fragment to extension
L27n1161.description: Strongly negative on a later piece of a name or word split into subtokens, such as 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar, 'Ker' in Keret, 'Pl' in Plasma or 'Share' in Share-Alike. Pushes toward 'ext' and 'extension' tokens.

L24n876.name: Article 'a' in definitions
L24n876.description: Positive on 'a' or 'an' opening a noun phrase in definitional or geometry sentences ('a closed curve', 'is a polygon', 'a frustum'), with weaker firing on some digits. Writes 'point'.

L26n2604.name: Word root -> 'business'
L26n2604.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split word, e.g. 'car' in carbon and carotene, 'ver' in verbal and verbs, 'om' in Potomac. Pushed positive, it promotes 'business/businesses' and spams 'business'.

L26n1133.name: Name starts, word stems
L26n1133.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a place or person name and on some word stems ('Pou' in Poulsbo, 'Har' in Harvard, 'W' in Waltham, 'patch' in patchy, '-w' in hard-wiring). Pushes toward 'labor' and 'workers'.

L27n2497.name: Short word-fragment start
L27n2497.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, often a short fragment (t in tamed and tummy, par in parmesan, sm in smacking, Th in Thracia, Bl in Blaeu). Pushes toward 'great'; steered output spams 'great'.

L26n303.name: Place-name fragments, negative
L26n303.description: Goes negative on mid-word pieces of place or person names split into tokens, like 'aw' in Manahawkin, 'Brid' in Bridgeton, 'sh' in Honshu and 'Rock' in Rockwall; pushes toward 'ancestor', 'inheritance' and 'reference'.

L26n357.name: Opening quotes and dashes
L26n357.description: Fires on punctuation that opens an inserted phrase: an opening curly quote before a quoted term, a dash before an aside (— or –), or a hyphen inside a compound like well-structured. At dose -0.5 it writes word-start fragments and drops spaces (thedunes).

L27n1562.name: Word-start 'f' fragment
L27n1562.description: Fires on 'f' or 'F' opening the second piece of a split word (fold|ing, fam|ily, fa|ble, F|ossil), plus a few other short word-start pieces. Pushes 'previous' and 'prev' tokens, which the reads do not explain.

L27n1143.name: Latin species-name fragments
L27n1143.description: Fires on a middle fragment of a Latin, botanical, zoological or drug name split into tokens (Cen|chr|us, Psitt|acula, Phil|adelphus, Syc|amore, Cy|athe|aceae). Pushes toward 'CT' and 'pt' tokens; steered output spams 'CT'.

L26n2853.name: N and 'orn' pieces
L26n2853.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word or name, strongest on a capital N or 'orn' (Kona N, N|ayarit, orn|amental, An|tonov, KwaZulu-N|atal). Pushes toward 'gradient'/'grad'; steering spams 'gradient'.

L26n2954.name: Name fragments, thread
L26n2954.description: Goes negative on the second or third piece of a split proper name, especially places and people (Zam in Zambezi, Ch in Chakma, 'omm' in Rommel, 'fig' in Hilfiger, 'Verm' in vermilion). Pushes toward 'thread'.

L26n2396.name: Second part of names
L26n2396.description: Goes negative on the fragment that starts the second part of a multi-part name or split word ('Bl' in Pine Bluff, 'Clear' in Creedence Clearwater, 'Scott' in Coretta Scott King, 'sil' in silhouettes). Pushes toward 'alternative'.

L26n2349.name: F-initial word fragments, 'surface'
L26n2349.description: Fires on the opening letters of a split word or name, mostly 'fe', 'fl', 'fr', or 'Fr', as in Feinberg, fluoroquinolones, Franks, and fevers; pushes toward 'surface' words.

L27n253.name: Mid-word name fragment
L27n253.description: Fires on a mid-word piece inside a rare name or term split into tokens (m|of|ait, Zu|ig|etsu, Co|thi, Mag|othy, spl|ints). Pushes '-itate/-tent' word endings (steered output drifts to 'satiated' and 'stately').

L27n240.name: Names and foreign scripts
L27n240.description: Negative on the first piece of a proper name or non-Latin word (Fr in Franks, Schro in Schroers, Thai พระ, Arabic ابن); pushes toward '(' and '())' bracket tokens.

L26n284.name: Numbers and measurement parentheses
L26n284.description: Fires on numerals, percent signs and opening parentheses in quantitative text ('95%' in confidence intervals, '60mm (2.36 in)', '15.6 °C'). Pushes toward time-period words 'month', 'week', 'year' and 'holiday'.

L26n1457.name: Capitalised name start
L26n1457.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalised proper name, especially after a title or in a list of people or places (Ben in Benito Juarez, W in Waukesha, McN in McNutt, Gen in Genocide). Pushes toward 'tuple' code tokens.

L26n2513.name: Person-name fragments, science output
L26n2513.description: The first or middle piece of a person's name split into tokens, e.g. 'Raf' in Rafid, 'Borg' in Borglum, 'Schro' in Schroers, 'Mas' in Maslow, 'ah' in Abdu'l-Bahá; pushes toward 'physics', 'chemistry' and 'math'.

L27n39.name: Opening quote mark
L27n39.description: The opening quotation mark (“, ‘ or a straight quote) that starts a quoted title, phrase or speech, or a dash before a clause. Pushes toward unrelated tokens such as 'Ikea', 'blat' and 'woodshallaby'.

L26n2355.name: Negative mid-word fragment
L26n2355.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens ('xy' in hydroxylysine, 'il' in vitiligo, 'fal' in fallopian, 'cal' in callosum, 'are' in Karelian); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'lambda'.

L26n1378.name: Split-name middle pieces
L26n1378.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split name, mostly Arabic, Hebrew or Sanskrit names: 'aim' in Maimonides, 'Mah' in Mahal, 'Cord' in Cordoba, 'Acc' in Macclesfield, 'um' in Hanumadhh. Steered output is unrelated (sticks, a pine tree), so the push is unclear.

L27n2634.name: Capital Ch/De word starts
L27n2634.description: Fires on a capitalized two-letter word start, mostly 'Ch' and 'De' ('Chronic', 'Chores', 'Deering', 'Dejnef'), plus 'St' and 'Wh'; pushes toward the pipe character '|'.

L27n1012.name: Mid-word chemical fragments, 'em'
L27n1012.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a long chemical or biological name split into tokens (e.g. 'anth' in chrysanthemum and astaxanthin, 'en' in carbapenems, 'ps' in sepsis, 'ret' in isotretinoin); pushes 'em'/'Em' tokens.

L26n2597.name: 'sav'/'ar' word starts
L26n2597.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces such as 'sav' (savable, Savanna, savoury), 'Ar' (Arbuscular), 'sym' (symphony), 'att' (attired), and the first piece of long names ('Mamba', 'Dimocarpus'). Writes 'navigation/nav' tokens, and the steered output is 'navigation' spam.

L26n1380.name: Indefinite 'a' before noun
L26n1380.description: The indefinite 'a' in 'have a wide selection', 'supported by a resource pack', 'created a Spotify', and similar slots before a list noun; pushes toward 'range'.

L27n2311.name: Church name fragments
L27n2311.description: Fires on the piece of a capitalized name or term split across tokens, in church and memorial text: the '.' after 'St', 'Rem' in 'Remembrance', 'Cath' in 'Cathedrals'. Pushes the model toward 'test'/'Test' tokens.

L27n2079.name: Name fragments, 'available'
L27n2079.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a proper name, such as 'Am' in Amherst or Amish, 'Nem' in Nemadji, 'lem' in Charlemagne, 'Lif' in Lifshitz; pushes toward 'available'.

L20n2391.name: Closing parens and digits
L20n2391.description: Fires on a single digit inside a multi-digit number, and on a closing parenthesis after an item or number, in tables, citations and stats. Pushes the model toward '))' closers, with no clear effect in prose.

L26n2797.name: Technical word-start fragments
L26n2797.description: Opening pieces of long technical words split into tokens (prim|ordial, nos|ocomial, Res|istor, Pert|uss|is), including 'specific' pieces; pushes the model toward 'spec' and 'spectrum'.

L26n15.name: Split-word piece → digits
L26n15.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a word or name split into several tokens (sou|ps, Camb|io, Rest|all, Share|-Alike), mid-word; pushes digit tokens 0-9.

L25n238.name: Semicolon writer
L25n238.description: Fires on a capital or lowercase 'K/k' opening a word or name ('K' in Kitten, 'k' in kami, '-K' in Karelian) and on digits in years or figures ('7' in 787, '9' in 1973). Pushed positive, it promotes ';' and spams semicolons.

L27n2279.name: Mid-word t to task
L27n2279.description: Fires on a short fragment inside a split word, often a lone 't' (twin|t|urreted, Con|ception, Ath|abasca); pushes toward 'task' and 'tasks' tokens.

L27n1966.name: Life fragments → 'support'
L27n1966.description: Fires on 'life' and other split-word pieces that begin a continuation (life|less, life|boat, odef|iciency, os|arcoma, cre|vice). Goes negative toward 'support'/'Support' (steered output: 'Support support support').

L26n824.name: Mid-word pieces of names
L26n824.description: A middle piece of a proper noun or foreign word split into tokens (Sw-ast-ika, Carp-acc-io, tort-illas, Gr-ac-eland). Pushes toward Spanish-like plural endings 'ada', 'atas' and 'itas'.

L27n944.name: Word fragments; writes 'magic'
L27n944.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'Bre' (Breasted, Red-breasted), 'be' (wildebeest), 'agn' (Armagnac), 'pig' (pigweeds). Pushes the model toward 'magic' (steering spams 'Magic').

L27n1570.name: gl/-p starts → instrument
L27n1570.description: The opening piece of a word split into tokens in technical nouns (gl in gliders and glazes, -p in twisted-pair, Dor in Dorset); pushes toward 'instrument(s)' and 'equipment'.

L27n165.name: Word-opening fragment, letter writer
L27n165.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split medical or technical word (hyp|odermis, hyp|oparathyroidism, lact|ose, nan|oscale, fl|axseed). Pushes toward single letters like i, o, e, and a.

L26n2203.name: Name fragments, 'conclusion' output
L26n2203.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or split word, such as 'Sus' in Susilo, 'Jud' in Judah, 'Dis' in Disraeli, 'fo' in foal, or '-br' in blood-brain; pushes toward 'conclusion' and 'result'.

L27n924.name: Foreign name fragments
L27n924.description: Fires negative on mid-word pieces of foreign personal and place names (Ik|htiyar, Ram|ihantaniarivo, Zam|bezi, Rom|mel, Hos|ack); pushes output toward 'political', 'politics' and 'voters'.

L23n597.name: Counting words → counter
L23n597.description: Fires on 'running' in 'a running total', 'loop', 'integer', '(int' in C signatures, and on random word pieces like 'retro' in retroviruses and 'C' in 'Cited'; pushes toward 'count'/'counter' tokens.

L27n826.name: Word-start pieces: customer
L27n826.description: The leading piece of a proper noun or word split into subword tokens (Or|kney, str|onsay, Os|mond, Sil|ent), peaking on the piece before the rest of the word; pushes the model toward 'customer' and 'patient'.

L27n2068.name: Proper-noun start fragment
L27n2068.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split proper noun or food word (And|alusia, Ar|agon, Có|rdoba, Qu|inoa). Pushes toward 'representation'.

L24n1924.name: Name fragment, '=' sign
L24n1924.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split proper name ('Miy|amoto', 'Nes|bitt', 'Mill|an', 'Guill|ermo', 'May|an') and on '=' in code assignments ('ini = 1', 'ydot = -10*y'). Pushes toward 'input' and 'raw input'.

L26n2790.name: Split-word opening piece
L26n2790.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split across tokens when that piece is not yet a word (Sup|pressed, gre|ening, intr|avenous, Jun|o, top|ological, Per|itoneal). Pushes toward 'seat' and 'seats'.

L27n1181.name: Compound modifiers; writes ways
L27n1181.description: Fires on the modifier before a compound's head noun (flip|flops, flash|cards, Savings| Accounts, hang|ing, wood|en); pushes toward 'methods', 'ways' and 'approaches'.

L27n1154.name: Split 'in' and 're'
L27n1154.description: The 'in' inside Mackinac (strongest), the 're' prefix of reconnection, and 'st' starting stirs or stumbles, plus 'social' after a modifier; pushes toward 'connect'.

L25n185.name: List commas, caps connectors
L25n185.description: Commas inside lists and ALL-CAPS headings, plus IS, OF, THE, TO in caps titles, the Arabic ibn in names, and | separators; pushes only weakly toward position or fit words, so the concept is unclear.

L26n2439.name: Mid-word capitals and accents
L26n2439.description: Fires on a capital or accented letter inside a name or all-caps word, e.g. Jean-A|ntoine, IN|TE|LLIGENCE, CAR|TE|NOIRE, Gy|ö|rgy, El|ame|in, STE|AK, Marr|ake|ch. Pushed positive it steers toward consonant clusters like 'nt', 'nd' and 'll'.

L27n2950.name: Surname fragment, writes $
L27n2950.description: Strongly negative on the first or second fragment of a capitalized surname or place name split into tokens (Kepler, Teesside, Leibniz, Thihalolipavan, Ph|ung). Pushes toward '$' tokens, the same write as L27n892+; steered output spams '$'.

L26n471.name: Modifier before proper noun
L26n471.description: Fires on the capitalised modifier that starts a multi-word proper name or institution, e.g. 'Authorized' in Authorized King James, 'United' in United States or Kingdom, 'British' in British-controlled, 'Central' in Central Siberian, 'Romanian' in Romanian Catholic. Pushes toward Spanish and Portuguese form-field labels such as 'Nombre', 'Titulo' and 'Des'.

L26n2779.name: Proper-name pieces, observation
L26n2779.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (Jean Laf|itte, Barg|uzin, Ras|porich, Ole|oestepa, Zar|ago|za, terra|cotta), and on 'hon' in 'honours' and 'Honk'. Pushed positive it steers toward 'observation' and 'observed'.

L27n1996.name: Split-word onsets, 'extra'
L27n1996.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or word split into subword tokens (Hash|em, Tit|us, Sp|icy, Stan|wick), pushing the model toward 'extra' and 'additional'.

L27n2675.name: Split-word fragments, art
L27n2675.description: Goes strongly negative on pieces of long or rare words: 'mp' in sympathetic, 'h' in Stonehenge, 'st' in stumbles, 'poly' in polygamy, 'in' in rhinoceros. Pushes toward 'art/Art'; strong steering spams 'Artart'.

L25n923.name: Symptom word pieces, 'dry'
L25n923.description: Fires on a single piece of a symptom, animal, or plant word, such as 'sne' in sneezing, 'seaw' in seaweed, 'z' in zoonotic, or 'o' in oaks; pushes toward 'dry', 'wet', and 'moist'.

L27n1535.name: Capital N/Sp name opener
L27n1535.description: A lone capital letter or Sp opening a proper noun or word (N|auvoo, N|akhon, N|iti Aayog, Sp|ence, N|CA). Pushes toward 'disrupt' tokens.

L24n1469.name: Adjective before trait noun
L24n1469.description: Fires on the word right before an expected trait noun (desirable, categorical, same, physical, 'of' in 'set of') and on some mid-word fragments (Car-th-age, carp-els); pushes toward 'attributes' and 'characteristic' with a weak effect.

L25n2269.name: Cross and X marks
L25n2269.description: Scattered across game and drawing instructions: 'not' after a contrast ('pictures, not numbers'), 'cross' or 'X' marks (cross out, red crosses), and 'point' in 'fine point marker'; pushes toward 'cross' and 'X'.

L27n1467.name: Word-fragment, predicts 'label'
L27n1467.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into tokens (e.g. 're' in 'record labels', 'rec' in 'recollect', 'Rel' in 'Relational', 'dil' in 'dilates') and pushes the model to write 'label'/'labels'.

L27n1550.name: Nationality adjectives, 'import'
L27n1550.description: Fires on a nationality or country adjective placed before its noun ('Cuban', 'Soviet', 'Danish', 'German', 'Swedish', 'Australian'), and weakly on 'surre' in 'surrealist'; pushes toward 'import', so steering spams 'import'.

L26n3041.name: Mid-word fragments, track writer
L26n3041.description: Fires on a piece of a word split into tokens, often the first or middle piece of a rare name or noun (planespotters, Nauvoo, Malawi, tsunamis); pushes 'track' and 'tracks', so steering gives 'track' spam.

L26n2610.name: Piece after a hyphen
L26n2610.description: Goes positive on the piece right after a hyphen or inside a compound, especially '-b' in 'coal-burning', 'fire-bombing', 'water-borne' and 'non-biodegradable', and also 'Dol|au|cothi'; pushes the model toward 'Mac/mac/Canada' tokens.

L27n1595.name: Pre-quantity words, mask
L27n1595.description: Words right before a number or quantity ('up to', 'melting point of', 'last' before '750 years', 'be' before '2°C') and decimal ranges like '0.2~0.3%'. Pushes toward 'mask' tokens.

L27n1475.name: Word-start radi/thr/dec
L27n1475.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, mostly 'radi' (radiologist, radiocarbon), 'thr' (thrusters), 'dec' (decarbonising), 'ste' (steak); pushes the model toward 'temperature'.

L27n1728.name: Consonant-cluster onsets
L27n1728.description: Strongly negative on a word-start consonant-cluster fragment (sm-, sn-, sh-, bl-, Rh-) that begins a split word (Sm|ell, sm|oking, sn|ippers, sh|ark, bl|ower). Pushes toward 'Delta' and 'offset' tokens; steered output spams 'Delta'.

L27n2768.name: Capitalised word-start fragments
L27n2768.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or split word ('La' in La Verne, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Ant' in Antoine, 'ag' in agarose). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'average' and 'avg', and the output spams 'Average'.

L27n1433.name: Capital G word-start
L27n1433.description: Fires on a word-initial 'G' or 'g', mostly after a hyphen or inside a capitalised name, e.g. 'G' in Gatsby or Glooskap, '-g' in God-given, 'g' in grieved; pushes the model toward 'improve'/'improvement'.

L27n1619.name: imm-/m- word starts
L27n1619.description: Fires on the 'imm' or 'Imm' piece opening immemorial, immune, immobility and immunities, and on bare 'm' starts such as mucus and mugs. Pushes toward 'mem' and 'memory' tokens.

L27n2652.name: Mixed split-word starts
L27n2652.description: Fires on the first piece of split words in mixed text (Sergei Ye|fremov, CRE|ATOR, oxid|ans, Ne|olithic, hydrogen peroxide); pushes toward 'ev/Ev/evolution' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n2592.name: Mid-word fragments, code-closer output
L27n2592.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, often before a suffix or hyphen split (Mont in Montadale, Sh in Shemot, -t in puffins, -f in toxin families); pushes toward semicolon-and-paren code closers.

L25n930.name: St in saint names
L25n930.description: Goes positive on 'St' that opens a saint or place name (St. Mary's, St. Paul's, St. Anthony, St. Andrews), especially after 'at', 'of' or 'dean of'; writes 'np' tokens, which are unrelated to the names.

L26n21.name: Role nouns and commas
L26n21.description: Fires on person-role nouns (Chancellor, physicist, historian, minister, writer, bishop) and on commas or arrows inside lists and equations; steered output drops its spaces and fills with word-end fragments.

L25n1583.name: Number words, place-name starts
L25n1583.description: Goes strongly negative on number words (Three, Two, Seven, eight, ten) and the first piece of ethnonyms or place names (Therm-opylae, Ber-ber, Kass-ites, Bant-us); pushing it negative makes the model repeat 'city'.

L27n1742.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n1742.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a split word that opens with a consonant cluster ('pl' in 'pl|agues', 'spl' in 'spl|ints', 'g' in 'g|ilded', 'Sen' in 'Sen|egal'). Pushed negative, it writes 'attribute' tokens.

L27n892.name: Name-start fragment, writes $
L27n892.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split capitalized name or word, right where it is still incomplete (Tr|ivium, Ste|phen, Sh|iloh, Mer|ck, Rom|mel). Pushes the model toward '$' variable-style tokens; steered output degenerates into '$' spam.

L23n1732.name: Relation words, math problems
L23n1732.description: Words in math and finance problem text right before the key relation, such as 'compounded', 'paying', 'look', 'inversely' or 'with' (negative); pushes toward 'linear' and 'Linear'.

L25n316.name: Unit-prefix pieces, color output
L25n316.description: The piece of a unit or measure word split into tokens, 'mill' in millilitres, 'cent' in centimetres, '1' in 1680, plus '-ize' stems (harmon|ized, optim|isation, util|ized); pushes toward 'color', 'colors' and 'favors'.

L26n2584.name: Proper-name pieces
L26n2584.description: Fires on a piece of a proper name split across tokens (Que|ensland, Pr|zew|alski, Tex|ian, Serg|ipe, Lem|ur), especially 'zew' in Przewalski; pushes toward accented 'é' and 'è' tokens, so steered text becomes 'é é é'.

L27n563.name: Mid-word subword pieces
L27n563.description: Fires on the middle piece of multi-token words and acronyms (e.g. 'ost' in mangosteen, 'ict' in Wydawnictwo, 'yc' in sycamore, 'C' in CPSI). Pushes toward short subword endings like 'anna', 'ANA', 'IFA' (steered output is 'ellaella' or 'OTAOTA').

L27n2012.name: Word-start spr and sl
L27n2012.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, esp. 'spr' (spr|outs, spr|ays), 'sl' (sl|ithered), and Mont and Kr starts; pushes toward release tokens.

L26n1225.name: Str/Dev word starts
L26n1225.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly 'Str' (Strikes, Stroudwater, Strait, stratified), 'Dev' (Devonta), 'sav' (savanna, savoury), 'Dim' (Dimocarpus), 'Ed' (Ed Sullivan). Writes date-like 'Eq/Oct/Nov' tokens, and the steered output is 'Eq Eq' spam.

L27n2821.name: Word-start pieces, 'sheet' writer
L27n2821.description: Fires on the short first piece of a split word, most often 'Fl' (Flanner, flaring, flanged), 'gr' (grubs, grueling) and 'var' (variances). Pushes toward 'sheet' tokens.

L25n1855.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L25n1855.description: Fires on an unfinished word or name piece, usually capitalized: 'hyper' in hyperacusis, 'Ch' in Chhattisgarh and Chakma, 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'Kh' in Khadur, 'Tr' in Trang. Pushes toward comma-quote tuple tokens.

L27n703.name: Name-start fragments → dots
L27n703.description: The first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens (Kh in Kharkiv, Pr in Prussian, Ant in António, Sch in Schizaeaceae, K in Kourou); pushes toward '.' and other punctuation after an identifier.

L27n1375.name: Bare 'l' word start
L27n1375.description: A bare 'l' or 'eyel' beginning a word or subword, strongest on 'lizard', 'eyelid', 'lily', 'lice', 'lollies'. Pushes toward 'sl'/'Sl' tokens, which the steered model spams.

L26n1236.name: Split-word pieces, 'bank' output
L26n1236.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a split word or name (Ge|ob|acter, Charal|amb|os, Yud|hoyono, Dog|ecoin, F|irms, L|AMP) and on 'lowest' in 'lowest monthly payments'. Writes 'bank'/'banking'; steering spams 'Bank'.

L26n2.name: Answer-start and number tokens
L26n2.description: Fires on the first token of a numeric or list answer: the space before a date or price ('<< >>3640 BCE', '<< >>300°F'), the word after '1.' (The Taj Mahal), and 'got' or 'through' in a narrative. Writes 'Not', 'Given', 'Create' and 'go'; pushed, it repeats 'go'.

L27n381.name: Colour words, writes 'glass'
L27n381.description: Fires on colour and shine adjectives that describe how something looks (colored, golden, yellow, brightly, vibrant, glitter, purple); pushes toward 'glass/thin/thick', and steering spams 'glass'.

L24n772.name: Markup and colon boundaries
L24n772.description: Fires on the tag name or colon right before a closing or quoted block, e.g. 'canvas' in '<canvas>' and the colon before a quote; pushes toward '>' tokens that close tags.

L27n1050.name: Negative: assistant reply start
L27n1050.description: Fires strongly negative on the first token of the assistant's reply after '<|im_start|>assistant', pushing 'go'.

L26n2756.name: Medical word fragments, flex
L26n2756.description: Opening piece of medical or anatomical words split into tokens (m|ucus, m|asticatory, sal|iv|ary, eyel|eb|row, str|aits); pushes toward 'flex' and 'flexible'.

L26n850.name: Technical word fragments
L26n850.description: Fires on a mid-word sub-token of a long technical, Greek or Latin word (Pol-yst-yrene, som-atostatin, Ophi-ost-oma, ep-igenetic, mult-iloc-ular, asth-ma); pushes '{' and '[' brackets.

L26n1453.name: Split name tail
L26n1453.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or last piece of a proper name or long word split into tokens ('Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'ew' in wer-wolves, 'al' in cantaloupe, 'an' in Peranakan); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'digital'.

L25n1745.name: Pest and pet words
L25n1745.description: Goes strongly negative on 'pest' in Yersinia pestis and pest control, and on pet, outdoor and flea words in animal-care and disease text; pushes toward 'space' and 'room', so steered output spams 'room'.

L24n818.name: 'am' fragments and 'University'
L24n818.description: Fires on the 'am' piece inside split words, e.g. 'Hot|am|isligil', 'Am|oretti', 'Am|orphous', 'Therm|am', and on 'University' before 'of'. Pushes toward 'moment(s)'. Two unrelated triggers.

L27n2169.name: Split verb/adjective stems
L27n2169.description: Fires on the first piece of a split verb or adjective stem (Sw|allowing, contr|ived, dec|imation, V|itiligo, z|oonotic, -h|itting); pushes toward month names like October and February.

L27n1114.name: Login-token writer, p-fragments
L27n1114.description: Fires on a 'p' or 'P' that starts a mid-word piece (Pisa, pails, puffling, pip) and on the 'G' in Nielsen-Gammon; pushes the model toward the token 'login', and steering makes it spam 'login'.

L27n1225.name: 'f' starts, mood nouns
L27n1225.description: Fires on the 'f' opening fantasy, feline or folding, and on mood nouns (suspense, frustration, exhaustion) in writing prompts; pushes toward 'build' and 'building'.

L27n236.name: Negative: technical word pieces
L27n236.description: Fires strongly negative on pieces of split technical words and names (ish in Torrey, ux in bruxism, cos in glycosylated), pushing 'Al' or 'Ab'.

L27n183.name: Diacritic vowels in names
L27n183.description: Long vowels and diacritic letters (ā, å, ī, ṛ, ø) inside transliterated Sanskrit, Arabic, or Norwegian words, plus some word-start fragments. Pushes toward 'nya', 'ming', 'la', 'mi' syllable tokens.

L23n292.name: S-fragments; brace writer
L23n292.description: Fires on word-start fragments split off a longer word, mostly starting with 'S' ('Sch' in Schwann, 'Sh' in Shu, 'Sl' in Slides), plus ')' after 'if (x=0'; pushes '{' and '{}'.

L26n2144.name: Word-start 'gu' and 'ang'
L26n2144.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, most often 'gu' (guillotine, guerrilla, guayule) or 'ang' (angina), plus some proper names (Dol|aucothi, Rod|inia); pushes toward 'dataset'.

L27n65.name: Hyphen in compound words
L27n65.description: Fires on the hyphen, or an opening quote or paren, inside a compound (Non-qualified, Vehicle-to-vehicle, Notre-Dame, 'horny toad'); pushes code-style identifiers like 'Range' and 'Index'.

L27n2510.name: Name-internal word fragments
L27n2510.description: Fires on a middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, e.g. 'rg' in Györgyi, 'Kas' in Kashefi, 'Ak' in Akande, 'Oz' in Özil, 'Dub' in Dubbert; pushes toward 'comput' and 'compute' tokens.

L27n2467.name: Word-start fragments (dermis, spay)
L27n2467.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'der' in dermis, 'sp' in spay, 'imp' in implicate; pushes 'term' and 'Term'.

L26n57.name: Sustainability copy, digit output
L26n57.description: Strongly negative on mixed tokens, mostly 'be' after 'might not', 'from' after 'made', 'non' in 'non-toxic', 'Call' in 'Call 911', and eco or sustainability words; pushes toward digit tokens and number lists.

L27n2977.name: Rare-word fragment, 'secret'
L27n2977.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment of a rare or name word (Bam|ako, squ|andered, Gen|ocide, Tong|a). Pushes toward 'secret' and 'hidden'.

L25n1373.name: Name-start fragment, pipes
L25n1373.description: Fires on the opening piece of a capitalized name, chemical or technical term split across tokens (Cad in Cadmium, Gi in Giampetro, kr in krill, spl in splint, Kr, bro in brochures); pushes toward double bars '||' and pipe-like symbols.

L26n2348.name: Word-start fragments, writes notice
L26n2348.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'inc|isors', 'inc|ision', 'inc|idence', 'Nec|rolestes', 'ting|ling', 'Cratæ|g|us'; pushes the model toward 'notice/notification/alert' tokens.

L27n1672.name: Name start to quotes
L27n1672.description: Negative pole fires on name openers and prepositions (of, for); pushes toward closing-quote and paren tokens.

L27n1708.name: Name-start fragment, 'generate'
L27n1708.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name or word (Ep|iphanes, P|isa, me|galomaniac, se|ceded, h|ickories). Pushes toward 'generate' and 'generation'.

L25n1771.name: Proper-name mid fragments
L25n1771.description: Fires on the middle or end subword piece of a proper name split into tokens (Rom in Rommel, Sand in Sandia, lem in Charlemagne, orm in Hormoran, alm in Falmouth). Pushes toward 'self'/'-self', and steering yields 'self-actualized' and 'self-teller'.

L1n1245.name: Odd scripts, byte fragments
L1n1245.description: Fires on rare-script characters and broken byte fragments: Japanese and Chinese characters (嫌, 動), Devanagari, diacritics like ṭ and ī, stray replacement bytes, and bullets. The output effect is unclear: steering writes runs of dots.

L26n435.name: Buy/purchase token writer
L26n435.description: Fires on scattered name and brand fragments (the B in '2B Prospects', the -B in 'Abdu'l-Bahá', 'VISION'), with no single clear trigger; pushes the model into repeating 'buy' or 'purchase'.

L26n2019.name: Rec/Rom/rep word starts
L26n2019.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, especially 'rec' (recollected, recaptured), 'Rom' (Rommel), 'rep' (repelling), 'disp' (dispensed), 'cor' (coring), '-k' (-knit). Writes 'slope/peaks' tokens, and the steered output is 'slope slope' spam.

L25n1022.name: 'sur' starts -> 'sample'
L25n1022.description: Fires on the start of 'sur' words (surge, survey, surge protector) and on networking words 'Transmit', 'Receive' and 'pull' (pull-down). Pushed negative, it promotes 'sample/samples' and spams 'sample'.

L27n2564.name: Split-name pieces, LaTeX breaks
L27n2564.description: The mid-word piece of a split name or word (Cro in Croesus, ame in Alamein), pushing LaTeX line-break tokens.

L27n2980.name: st/St word onsets
L27n2980.description: Fires (positive) on 'st' or 'St' opening a word split into pieces ('st|are', 'St|abilizes', 'pre-st|ressed'); pushes toward Android code tokens such as 'android', 'Intent' and 'MainActivity'.

L26n2047.name: Split-name first pieces
L26n2047.description: Fires on the first fragment of a multi-token proper name (Nem in Nemadji, Dum in Dumfries, Zap in Zapata, Vit in Vitória) and on bub in bubonic; pushes toward 'transfer' and 'transfers'.

L27n1609.name: Split names and numbers
