L27n1609.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of long names (Char|lemagne, Mai|monides, Perna can|aliculus, germ) and on the tail pieces of split numbers (7,00|0, 163,00|0, 40 million); pushes output toward 'strong' and 'strength'.

L27n827.name: Water, than, dis fragments
L27n827.description: Fires (positive) on 'water', on 'than' after 'equal or greater' in antibiotic thresholds, and on split pieces like 'undis|covered', '-dis|covery' and 'ozy' in heterozygous; pushes toward 'log' and 'logs'.

L21n1826.name: Purpose-clause function words
L21n1826.description: Fires on function words that open a purpose or use clause, such as 'as a' in 'used as a guiding example', 'To' in 'To address', 'to' in 'to explain', and 'for' or 'during'; pushes toward 'test' and 'tests'.

L26n732.name: Non-Latin script fragments
L26n732.description: Fires on pieces of Thai, Japanese, Arabic and Cyrillic words, plus 'Al' in Andalusian names; pushing it yields garbled caps and noise, though its top writes are punctuation.

L25n2687.name: Digits in numeric amounts
L25n2687.description: Goes strongly negative on a digit inside a number quantity, usually the first or second digit of a money amount or count: '4' in Rs 4 billion, '0' in 60 million, '6' in $2.6 million, '4' in 1.4 billion. Pushes toward 'cr' and 'cro'.

L27n2774.name: Negative: name initial letters
L27n2774.description: Fires strongly negative on the first letter or piece of a name (K in Kourou, F in Faisal, Ze in Zeppelin), pushing 'equal'.

L27n175.name: Name fragments → ordinals
L27n175.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or title split into tokens (La|Hood, La Coupole, Ste|jskal, T|igris), before the rest of the name. Pushes toward ordinal numbers ('third', 'fifth', 'seventh').

L27n1332.name: Capital initial to plus
L27n1332.description: Negative pole fires on capitals and acronyms (N, U.S., NY); pushes toward plus-prefixed tokens such as +a and +N.

L27n1439.name: Post-name pieces, lead
L27n1439.description: Fires on the piece right after a name or term inside a compound or list, e.g. 'the' before 'bass clave', 'and' in National Oceanic and Atmospheric, 'Dev' in Devonta; pushes toward lead, leading, leads.

L27n651.name: Recipe and listing nouns
L27n651.description: Goes negative on the first content word of a noun phrase in recipes, prompts and product copy ('dried' chamomile, 'f' in feta, 'green' beans, 'Christmas' outfit, 'screenplay', 'sandwich'). Pushes toward 'feel' and 'feeling'.

L24n2579.name: Noun heads, handle
L24n2579.description: Diffuse. Fires on the word that starts or heads a noun phrase, such as 'file' in 'sorted seekable file', 'function' after a MATLAB '%', 'Gr' in Diffraction Grating, and 'program' in program files. Pushes the model toward 'handle' and 'handles'.

L27n28.name: Ingredient-list commas, measures
L27n28.description: Fires on commas and the word 'the' inside long enumerations, and on measure words in recipes (tablespoons, minced, freshly, -sized). Pushes toward random capitalised tokens and repeated words like 'cinnamon'.

L25n664.name: Enumeration labels, name starts
L25n664.description: Fires on a parenthesized sub-part label opening a list item ('(b) Is it closed', '(c) A polygon') or on the first piece of a name ('Mazaheri', 'Croesus', 'Al' in Alfonso); pushes toward code '=' tokens like '=DB' and '=document'.

L23n2602.name: 'of' after agency titles
L23n2602.description: Fires on 'of' right after a title or agency name ('Department of', 'Secretary of', 'Minister of', 'Dictionary of') and on digits inside code calls. Pushes the model toward colon-letter emoticon tokens like ':c' and ':v'.

L27n2302.name: Negative: list-item noun starts
L27n2302.description: Fires strongly negative on the first piece of a noun in a list (limes, rambutan, snails, dandelion), pushing em dashes.

L27n569.name: Word-start p, closing punctuation
L27n569.description: Word-start 'p', 'P' or 'Th' piece of a split word (per|inatal, P|erna, p|iano, Th|espians); pushes toward closing quote-paren-period punctuation.

L26n1091.name: Name starts before examples
L26n1091.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a proper name or noun split into tokens, such as 'Anch' in Anchorage and anchovies, 'Bo' in Bois Blanc and boars, 'esc' in escabeche. Pushes toward 'example', 'demonstrate', 'illustrate'.

L27n221.name: Story genre words
L27n221.description: Fires on genre words in creative-writing requests (story, thriller, horror, fantasy, and -packed/-paced modifiers) and on 'be' in 'should be told'; pushes toward damage, injury and disaster words.

L27n1707.name: Latin fragment → access
L27n1707.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a long technical or Latin word, e.g. 'ic' in bactericidal, 'od' in Rhododendron, 'ace' in Pteridaceae, 'rh' in rhizomes; pushes toward 'access' tokens.

L26n975.name: At/of before qualifiers
L26n975.description: Goes negative on function words that open a qualifying phrase: 'at' in at-risk and at least, 'of' in Department of and Secretary of, and 'Sup' in suppressed. Pushes toward 'test' and 'trial'.

L27n452.name: Second word of compounds
L27n452.description: The second capitalized word of a two-word name or noun compound, e.g. Palm|Oil, European| Centre, White| Turkey; pushes toward phrase openers like 'Known', 'Based', 'Before', and at dose -0.5 it degenerates into repeated 'radorra' tokens.

L26n2363.name: Word fragment → 'sentence'
L26n2363.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of split words, like 'ole' in 'Elaeis oleifera' and oleic, 'shr' in shrubs, 'scal' in scallops and 'ol' in scoliosis; pushes toward 'sentence' and 'paragraph'.

L26n1759.name: Scientific word fragments
L26n1759.description: Fires on the second piece of a Latin or Greek scientific or taxonomic word (oph in Psophodes, hyp in hypodermis, heter in heterosporous, od in Rhododendron, H in Hellenic); pushes toward 'sex' and 'sexual'.

L27n2028.name: Mid-word piece, long words
L27n2028.description: A middle subword piece of a long Latin or technical word (epider|der|mis, cur|ator, amino|glyc|osides, corn|uc|opia, in|cis|ors). Pushes toward 'publish'-family tokens.

L26n615.name: Place-name syllables; ancient
L26n615.description: The first syllable or capital letter of a proper name in place and history text, such as 'Lup' in Lupiac, 'P' in Pali, 'Stan' in Stanovoi and 'yll' in Phyllis. Pushes toward 'ancient', 'old' and 'antique'; steered output spams 'ancient'.

L25n1007.name: Preposition before tech object
L25n1007.description: Fires on a comma, '(' or a preposition such as 'for', 'from' or 'in' right before a list or object in tech how-to text ('suited for large', 'range from embedded', 'Microsoft Edge'). Pushes toward 'web' tokens.

L26n2511.name: Capital mid-word fragments
L26n2511.description: Negative on an uppercase or capitalized piece inside a name or all-caps word, such as 'DIN' in DINUZULU, 'AN' in ANNUAL, 'IN' in INTELLIGENCE, '-N' in KwaZulu-Natal. Pushes the model toward 'g' and 'gle'.

L27n638.name: Capitalised name opener
L27n638.description: Fires on the capital letter or short piece that opens a proper name or acronym split across tokens (Z|aidi, U|ML, A|verroes). Pushes field nouns 'theory', 'culture' and 'technology'; steered output is 'culture culture' spam.

L26n2130.name: Varied name fragments
L26n2130.description: Scattered first or middle pieces of split names or words (Dor|is, Kwan|zaa, Van Reenen, KwaZulu-N|atal, Ret|inoids), with no single theme; pushes toward 'letter' and 'letters'.

L27n876.name: Chemistry word pieces
L27n876.description: Negative on inner pieces of chemistry and technical words (trihal|omethane, photocat|alytic, sil|icon, lact|ose, chlor|oform, antiretrovirals); pushes toward 'de/DE' tokens.

L26n1244.name: Name-start fragments, prefix
L26n1244.description: Fires on the first piece of a split proper name: 'Str' in Strangler, 'Cit' in Citigroup, 'Sw' in Swedes, 'Mer' in Meran, 'Pat' in Patagonia. Pushes toward 'prefix/symbol/notation'; steered output spams 'prefix'.

L27n2336.name: Word-start 'n'/'N' pieces
L27n2336.description: The first piece of a word beginning with n or N, such as 'n' in 'nose' and 'narrowing', 'N' in 'Native' and 'Nomenclature', and 'sn' in 'snags'. Pushes toward 'unique' and 'uniqueness'.

L27n1949.name: Place-name fragment, writes 'half'
L27n1949.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, e.g. 'Tr' in Trang, 'Sw' in Swindon, 'Ch' in Chaco, 'Bo' or 'ant' in Bantus. Pushes toward 'half' and 'halves'; steered, it spams 'half'.

L26n2925.name: Syllable start, writes 'script'
L26n2925.description: Goes negative on the first syllable of a word split into pieces, often 'hem', 'rem', 'cal', 'Fe' or 'Fen' (hemlock, Remembrance, Calydonian, Feinberg, Fenway). Pushes toward 'script' tokens.

L27n979.name: Technical piece, writes res
L27n979.description: Goes negative on an inner piece of a technical or scientific compound split into subwords: 'fractional' in fractional-reserve, 'ag' in microaggression, 'magn' in magnification, 'chlor' in chlorides, 'Saccharomyces'. Pushes toward res and Res code tokens, repeated.

L23n2503.name: Negation before mean/necessarily
L23n2503.description: Positive on the negator 'not', 'n't', or 'non' in 'does not mean', 'doesn't have to be', 'does not necessarily'. Writes 'equals' only weakly.

L25n1945.name: Split proper-name middles
L25n1945.description: Fires on a middle or end piece of a split proper name or title (Gett|ys|burg, Bort|nyik, Hot|amis|ligil, Ep|etch|ey); pushes 'gradually', 'increasing' and trend words, so steering gives 'gradually' spam.

L27n135.name: Capitalized name onsets
L27n135.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or token of a capitalized name or title mid-sentence (L in Lotto, S in Sutak, C in CARS, B in Bower, F in Fahrenheit), and on clause-opening 'so'. Pushes toward word-fragment continuations (aps, uff, ild, udge), giving garbled output.

L27n2707.name: Mid-word fragments (gold)
L27n2707.description: Strongly negative on a piece inside a word or name that is still being spelled out, e.g. 'ic' in apricots, 'ec' in Dogecoin, 'et' in whetstone, 'pot' in potash; weaker on mining and coin words. Pushes toward 'gold' and 'metal'.

L26n2963.name: Noun modifiers before head
L26n2963.description: A noun or adjective that modifies a following head noun (horn in horned lizard, back in backyard, front in frontline, command in command area); pushes toward 'post' and 'blog'.

L27n2423.name: Name-start fragments → 'relationship'
L27n2423.description: Fires strongly negative on the first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens (e.g. 'Am' in Amritsar, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'Tim' in Tim Burton, 'Sk' in Skopje). Pushes toward 'relationship' (steered output is 'Relationship relationships').

L27n103.name: Opening paren or quote
L27n103.description: Negative on the opening '(' or quote mark that starts an aside, gloss or example right after a term, e.g. 'Dizziness (vertigo)', 'Btu (British Thermal Unit)', 'Medieval philosophy (Islamic Golden Age)'. Its output weights decode to nothing clear; steered output gives stray spaces and numbers.

L27n2287.name: Rare-name first pieces
L27n2287.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare name or foreign word split into tokens, mid-sentence (Hu|izinga, Ep|ilepsy, Sid|on, Kr|abi, Bod|rum, av|ocados); pushed positive it promotes 'easy'.

L25n1932.name: Proper-noun starts, numerals
L25n1932.description: Fires on the first letters of capitalised place and people names (Ch in Chhattisgarh, Ch in Chakma, Ab in Abilene) and on 'Arabic' before 'numeral'; pushes output toward 'digit' and 'numerical'.

L25n330.name: Closing quotes, line breaks
L25n330.description: Fires on the closing quote mark plus line break after a quotation in quote lists, and on 'worlds' and 'everywhere' in those lists. Pushes toward hyphen-joined fragments like '-be', '-s' and '-p'.

L26n2000.name: Physical-feature words, wire output
L26n2000.description: The second word of a two-word physical term, e.g. 'bow' in bow shock, 'straight' in straight line, 'deep' in deep drop-offs, 'bike' in bike lanes; pushes toward 'wire' and 'cable'.

L25n630.name: Section-label noun before number
L25n630.description: Structure nouns right before a number, e.g. 'Chapter' in 'Chapter 6', 'Table' in 'Table 1', 'Section', 'Figure', 'Step'. Pushes toward 'mask' and 'around'; steered, it spams 'mask'.

L22n203.name: Single-letter symbols and primes
L22n203.description: A one-letter symbol or acronym start (H in HPC, R in R(t), γ, G in GDP, x in x′, C in CDM) right before its subscript, prime or rest of the term; pushes toward prime and apostrophe marks, with no clear steered effect.

L25n1646.name: Enc fragments and negation
L25n1646.description: Fires on 'enc' starting enclosed, encroached or encourage, and on 'not' or 'n't' after a modal or verb ('should not compete', 'do not splash'); pushes toward 'cross', so steered text drifts to 'crossing'.

L27n554.name: Name piece, HTML tags
L27n554.description: Fires on an early or middle piece of a capitalized name or acronym (Gu in Guimarães, A in Abyei, G in GOCI, Luk in Lukin, inn in Cinnamomum), and on the split 'chie' in mischievous. Pushes toward HTML opening tags like '<a', '<span' and '<br'.

L27n263.name: 'and'/'or' in lists
L27n263.description: Fires on a conjunction or preposition inside a list or paired phrase ('games and', 'with or without', 'Number of Pages', 'Las Vegas'). Pushes toward full-width CJK closers like '）。' and '”，'.

L27n2034.name: Mid-name fragments of names
L27n2034.description: Fires on the middle or second piece of a multi-token proper name (Charle|magne 'lem', Schle|per, Mahmoud al-Mab|hou, Dar es Salaam 'Dar'); pushes toward render tokens.

L24n3028.name: Mid-pieces of split names
L24n3028.description: Fires negatively on a middle or later subword of a name or drug term split into pieces (Am|ritsar, Rom|mel, Char|lem|agne, Kap|urthala, eryth|rom|ycin). Pushes toward 'method' tokens.

L26n1645.name: Name-piece fragments, subs writer
L26n1645.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a person, place or species name (Xer|xes, Vespa|sianus, Rodinia, Hash|em, Palamed|es); pushes word-end fragments like 'subs', 'EOS' and 'OTS', so steering gives 'subs' spam.

L26n749.name: Capitalized proper-noun openers
L26n749.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or title (St in St. Louis, Sch in Schleper, Matt in Matthew, S in Sutra, O in OHSU). Pushes toward end-of-sentence punctuation ('.', ':', ';'), and steering repeats '.'.

L27n2166.name: Word-piece 'c'/'oc' fragments
L27n2166.description: Fires on a split-word piece such as '-c', 'oc' or 'ich' that continues a word, e.g. '-c' in 'single-celled', 'oc' in 'palm mesocarp', 'dec' in 'decaying'; pushes toward 'car' tokens.

L27n695.name: Capital letters starting names
L27n695.description: A lone capital letter or abbreviation that starts a proper name (M in Macclesfield, U in Uppsala, N in Nave, M.D.); in steered text it pushes sentence-end punctuation and newlines.

L27n1992.name: Word-start 'st' pieces
L27n1992.description: Fires negative on the word-initial 'st' piece of split words (st|rolled, st|anzas, st|ews, st|aves, st|roma) and on 'micro' and 'Micro'; pushes output toward enumeration labels such as '(a', '(i' and '(e'.

L27n2704.name: st word-onset fragments
L27n2704.description: Negative firing on a bare 'st' split off as the first token of a word, such as st|roma, st|irs, st|umbles, or st|anzas; pushes toward 'happen', 'happened' and 'occurs'.

L27n2295.name: C/con word-start fragments
L27n2295.description: Fires on short first pieces of longer words that begin with c, con, or oc (oc|arbon, con|fluence, CON|sciousness, cam|otes); pushes toward 'Cons' and 'consistent' tokens.

L24n361.name: Rare-name mid-word pieces
L24n361.description: The middle piece of a rare name or word split into several tokens (Bam in Bamako, ver in Averroes, igr in Tigris, Math in Mathews); pushes toward 'round' words.

L27n1872.name: Word-initial s, writes static
L27n1872.description: Goes negative on a word-initial 's' piece, often right after 'www.' or a space (sciencedaily, sugar, silex, sponged); pushes toward 'static'.

L27n534.name: Rare-word middle fragments
L27n534.description: Strongly negative on a middle or late fragment of a rare, foreign or Latin word split into tokens (mang|ostana, Pseud|omon|as, per|nicious, br|ussels). Pushes toward 'x' tokens (tx, rx, xml); steered output spams 'xox'.

L24n1618.name: Preposition before field name
L24n1618.description: Fires on a preposition ('at', 'in', 'of') right before a field, job or organization name: 'engineer at Google', 'career in video editing', 'Department of Energy', 'context of the poem'. Pushes toward 'computer' and 'IT'.

L27n698.name: Technical-term pieces
L27n698.description: Fires on a piece of a technical or name word split into tokens (bi'ostatistics, iod'iversity, gu'ayule, J'ørgensen, methyl tert-but'yl); pushes toward 'data'.

L27n1213.name: Word fragments; writes 'ar'
L27n1213.description: Fires on a word-piece inside a split word, e.g. 'ro' in bullfrogs, 'she' in shears, 'Rams' in Ramsar, 'os' in osteosarcoma, 'ju' in juice. Pushes the model toward 'ar' (steering spams 'ar').

L26n710.name: Name-initial subword fragments
L26n710.description: The first piece of a name or long word split into tokens, e.g. 'Ber' in Berzelius or Berber, 'Al' in Algeria. Pushes toward '(-' and '[-' tokens; steered, it degenerates into '(-(-(-'.

L27n1336.name: Name middle piece (c-words)
L27n1336.description: Positive on a middle sub-token of a capitalized name or place split across tokens, e.g. 'Sk|op|je' (Skopje), 'Sus|ilo', 'Jiang|su'. Pushes toward 'c'-initial word starts like 'cl', 'con', 'cac'; steered output repeats 'clack'.

L27n1128.name: Modifiers of technical compounds
L27n1128.description: Fires on the word or piece right before a technical noun in a compound ('soft' in soft tissue, 'verte' in vertebral, 'computed' in computed tomography, 'Prot' in Protolaurasia); pushes toward the letter 'X'.

L24n77.name: Opening bracket or quote
L24n77.description: Fires on an opening '(' or quote mark that starts an aside, gloss or alternate name, as in 'Nyonyas (' or 'Flora (' and in 'word “ori”'. Pushes the model toward words that list or qualify, such as 'two', 'options' and 'includes'.

L27n660.name: Inner title pieces
L27n660.description: Negative on inner pieces of split names and titles (Kh|ao, Or|isk|any, Mes|quita, Hot|am|isligil, Nat|ional Park); pushes toward '-C' and '/B' style suffix tokens.

L25n2821.name: Proper name capital starts
L25n2821.description: Fires on the capital letter or first piece of a proper name ('N' in Nayarit and Nakhon, 'M' in Middlesbrough, 'Mart' in Martel, 'Cal' in Calhoun, '-N' in PDD-NOS). Pushes toward 'primary' and 'secondary'.

L24n756.name: Code operands and digits
L24n756.description: Fires on the operand or digit inside code or dates: 'x' in 'if (x == 0)', the '0' in 'P0 = 0xA4', years like '1979' and '1914', and the start of names like 'Crist'. Pushes toward printf-style '%' tokens; steered text spams '%'.

L25n1492.name: Legal/official status words
L25n1492.description: Fires on status words that qualify a legal, official or regulatory noun (officially, federally registered, protected areas, legal guardian, National); pushes toward 'design' and 'den'.

L26n1497.name: Compound prefix → light
L26n1497.description: Fires on the prefix piece of a split or hyphenated word (lact|ose, polym|er, nan|ofabrication, non-|natives, green-|lipped, U|plink); pushes 'light', 'Light', 'optical', 'phot' and 'photon'.

L26n2333.name: Split-word opening fragments
L26n2333.description: Fires on the first short piece of a word split into subword tokens, mostly 'f', 'Fe', 'inf', 'conf' (feline, infested, confute, Feinberg). Pushes the model toward 'function(s)', which steering shows only weakly.

L26n1448.name: Name pieces, mo output
L26n1448.description: Fires on a piece of a split proper name or word (jo in Mohenjo-daro, kel in Ashkelon, isk in Oshkosh, Dev in Devonta, accom in accompaniment); pushes toward 'mo' and 'monthly' tokens and steers into 'Mo mo' spam.

L27n2830.name: Split word m/sm start
L27n2830.description: Short incomplete piece starting with m, sm, em or um inside a split word (Mp|um|alanga, potato |m|asher, |sm|acking, em|ulated). Negative firing pushes toward 'distance'.

L27n2575.name: Split-word start, negative
L27n2575.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a word split across tokens, mostly names and nouns (Tr|ainers, bir|thing, Mon|et, Pl|ague, thr|ived). Pushes the model toward 'before' and repeats it.

L26n2521.name: Word-initial Al/Ar/Az pieces
L26n2521.description: Fires on short word-opening pieces like Al, Ar, Az and ḥ that start a word split into tokens, mostly in Andalusian, olive, Arabic and azalea names; pushes toward 'boundary' and 'border'.

L26n2157.name: St-/ste- fragments, plugin output
L26n2157.description: The 'st', 'ste' or 'str' opening piece of a word split into tokens (ste|amer, Str|oudwater, st|retches, Bridge|stone); pushes toward 'plugin' and 'plugins'.

L27n1870.name: Word-start 'm'; writes 'material'
L27n1870.description: Fires on a lone 'm' (or 'mim', 'metam') that opens a split word: mowers, mugs, mucus, mists, masticatory, mofait. Pushes the model toward 'material(s)' (steering spams 'Material').

L27n575.name: Capital-letter word onsets
L27n575.description: Strongly negative on a bare capital-letter start of a split word or name, especially O or R (O|yster, O|steomarkt, O|phthalmology, R|emy, Ul|ster). Pushes toward closing quote-plus-comma tokens; steered output spams them.

L27n1805.name: Stray D/P word fragment
L27n1805.description: Fires on a stray capital or short letter piece inside a split word, mostly 'P' or 'D' (P|uzzles, D|CEG, Al-D|in) or 'd' in 'dunes'. Pushes 'date/dates' (steered output is 'Date' spam).

L27n1463.name: Punctuation before parentheses
L27n1463.description: Fires on punctuation that opens a parenthesis or joins a compound: '-' in protect-your and ill-posedness, '(' in (AIDS) and (Musical, '=' in F=∂A and x=0, '/' in Consumer/Event. Weak effect; pushes toward capital abbreviation starts (SU, LB, SF, DH).

L26n3000.name: Name-start pieces (New, Z)
L26n3000.description: Fires (negative) on the first token of a capitalised name split into pieces, before the completing piece: 'New' in New Year's and New Jersey, 'Maz' in Mazaheri, 'Z' in Zephaniah and Zheng, 'Re' in Reformation, 'Tong' in Tonga. Pushes toward 'xml'; steering shows no clear effect.

L26n497.name: Foreign name fragments, download
L26n497.description: Middle piece of a foreign or unusual proper name split across tokens (Fab|erg|é, Yog|ī, Kuh|aj|da, Alm|oh|ad); pushes toward 'download' and 'upload'.

L27n1490.name: CJK characters, full stop
L27n1490.description: Fires on CJK characters in Chinese and Japanese text (勇 'brave', 室, 美), and on some English word starts ('wal' in whales, 'Astr', 'ign'). Pushes the model toward the Chinese full stop '。'.

L27n2289.name: Split-name starts, 'assign' writer
L27n2289.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name, e.g. 'Zu' in Zuigetsu, 'Vas' in Vasari, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'gu' in guineensis. Pushes toward 'assign' and 'assignment' tokens.

L27n533.name: Split words, generic nouns
L27n533.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (mul in mulch, col in colander, cant in cantaloupe, aut in autocrat, atal in catalytic), and on a word right before a generic noun (open-source, search box, good look). Pushes toward generic nouns: service, program, algorithm, method, project.

L27n2883.name: Name-middle fragments
L27n2883.description: Strongly negative on a piece inside a place, person or organisation name split into tokens, e.g. 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Kr' in Krabi, 'Bak' in Bakunin, 'Ki' in Ki-moon, 'ug' in Chugoku, 'Dev' in Devonta. Pushes toward 'reward' and 'awards'.

L27n409.name: Later name pieces
L27n409.description: Negative on later pieces of split proper names (Nov|gor|od, Ibn R|ushd, Almohad, Armist|ice, Abu Daw|ud); pushes toward 'PD/MD/SD' abbreviation tokens.

L23n1668.name: Slot before a number
L23n1668.description: Goes negative on the word or space right before a numeric amount ('$' before a dollar figure, the blank before '6 hours' or '50 and 100', sleep-related words); pushes the model toward 'x'.

L27n2684.name: Split-name fragments toward immune
L27n2684.description: Fires on early pieces of split names and words (Br|igid, Bl|asco, sarc|ophagi). Pushes toward 'immun' tokens (immune, immunity), which the reads do not explain.

L27n2718.name: Word-initial 'm', writes 'scale'
L27n2718.description: Fires on a word-initial 'm' or 'M' piece that starts a word or name, often when split from its continuation (M|idnite, Mos|he, m|ists). Pushes toward 'scale' tokens, but steered output stays near-normal prose.

L26n2008.name: Split proper-noun starts
L26n2008.description: Negative on the first piece of a split proper noun or long word (Mes|opotamia, Bad|lands, Fol|io, Kub|ayi, Tr|ivium, Vic|ente, Bantus). Writes 'weather', 'rain', 'climate' and 'meteor'; pushed, output repeats 'weather'.

L26n2297.name: name-opening fragments
L26n2297.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a proper name split into tokens ('Hol' in Holman and Holocene, 'Zam' in Zambezi, 'Sol' in Solon, 'Mor' in Morley, 'Am' in Amish). Pushes toward 'proposed' and 'proposal'.

L26n2657.name: con-/contr- word openers
L26n2657.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a word split into tokens, especially con, contr, cont and ab (contortionists, contrived, abstraction, Corn in cornrows); pushes toward 'exchange' and 'trade'.

L26n1342.name: Physics, names → charge
L26n1342.description: Fires on the first piece of a word in circuit, physics or name contexts, e.g. 'washing' in washing-machine circuit problems, 'rel' in relativity, 'fil' in filaments; pushes toward 'charge' and 'voltage'.

L27n1281.name: 'has'/'’ve' before participle
L27n1281.description: Fires on an auxiliary like 'has' or '’ve', or 'which'/'was' after a subject, right before a past participle (Radiology has, we’ve done, it has standards), and on some split-word pieces (-f|ledged, str|addles). Pushes toward 'sorted'/'sort' (steered output: 'sorted sorted').

L26n2941.name: Se fragment of sepsis
L26n2941.description: Fires on the 'se' opening fragment of sepsis, septic, seborrhea and similar split words, plus 'of', 'with', 'and' in lists of fluids or measurements. Pushes toward 'body' tokens, which the reading does not share.

L27n1376.name: Proper-name word onset
L27n1376.description: Fires on the opening piece of a proper name or rare word split into tokens ('Cost'olo, 'Mon'et, 'Mas'low, 'Zam'bezi, 'Aver'roes); pushes toward 'base', 'bases', 'basis'.

L27n304.name: Mid-word piece in names
L27n304.description: Positive on the middle sub-token of a multi-piece word or name, mostly produce, pets and places, e.g. 'cant|al|ou|pe', 'Chatt|ahoo|chee', 'kettle|bell', 'lady|bugs', 'al-M|ab|hou'. Pushes toward generic nouns 'things', 'people', 'folks' and 'everybody'; steered output repeats 'things happen'.

L26n415.name: Holy and Broad names
L26n415.description: The word before the end of a multi-word name, mainly 'Holy' (Holy Bible, Holy Prophet, Holy See), 'Broad' (Broad Breasted), and 'de', 'del', 'la' in Spanish place names; pushes toward the letter 'l'.

L26n511.name: 'into' after came/come/took
L26n511.description: Fires on the particle after 'come', 'came' or 'took' in set phrases ('come into practice', 'came into use', 'took place', 'at risk'). Pushes toward random code and tech tokens, with little visible effect.

L26n1703.name: 'Sh' word onset
L26n1703.description: The 'Sh' or 'sh' onset that opens a word (Sh|aped, sh|akshuka, Sh|irts, sh|ored, sh|roud), plus 'cre' and SQL 'BY'/'LIMIT'; pushes toward 'operator'.

L25n1095.name: Rare-name first piece
L25n1095.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a rare proper name split into tokens, such as Sam|oans, Char|on, Char|lemagne, Daw|es, Guz|mán and M|ennonite, and also on 'magnetic' and 'methyl'. Pushes toward 'measure', and steered output spams 'measure'.

L26n2962.name: 're-' and 'dis-' prefixes
L26n2962.description: The prefix piece 're' or 'dis' that opens a word split into tokens (re|claims, dis|use, well-re|searched, non-re|newable); pushes toward 'utility' and 'util' tokens.

L23n1622.name: Leading '1' of years
L23n1622.description: The leading '1' of a 4-digit year from the 1300s to 1900s ('in 1348', '1580', 'in 1806'), plus a few capitalized name fragments (Pro-culus, Rad-chuk). Pushes toward 'get' and 'getting'.

L26n1937.name: en/em word openers, php
L26n1937.description: Fires on the first fragment of words starting 'en-', 'em-' or 'enc-' that get split into tokens (encroachment, enclosures, emotional, embezzlement, encouraging). Pushes toward 'php' and 'PHP'.

L27n1812.name: Ch word-start to integer
L27n1812.description: Fires on the opening 'Ch' or 'ch' piece of a word or heading (Ch|ronic, Ch|olesterol, Ch|ores), strongest at line starts; pushes toward 'integer' and 'Integer' tokens.

L25n1333.name: Split-word starts lo/qu
L25n1333.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split word, mostly 'lo' and 'qu' (locket, quasar, quinoa, Lo-), also 'wal' and '-pro'; pushes the model toward 'offer/offering'.

L27n2739.name: Split word-start pieces
L27n2739.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'sw' in swimmers and swamps, 'Bal' in Balochistan, 'Bel' in Belo Horizonte, 'Ble' in bleach; pushes toward 'treatment' tokens.

L26n2209.name: Foreign name fragments
L26n2209.description: Fires on a non-English or unusual piece inside a name or foreign word (ø in Jørgensen, Caj in Cajete, Ber in Berber, Est in Estepa, Chi in Chiapas, idade in Universidade). Pushes toward 'est'/'Est' tokens, and steered story text starts with 'Estra'.

L24n46.name: Newlines and code openers
L24n46.description: Fires on the line break right after an empty '</think>' tag and on line breaks and openers inside code (MATLAB '%' comment lines, '#include <', backtick fences); pushes toward 'place', 'put' and 'get' verbs and, at +0.5, into garbled 'lost' repetition.

L27n1053.name: News word-stem, period writer
L27n1053.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word in news-style prose, such as 'susp' (suspending), 'purs' (pursues), 'Cons' (consistent), 'Recon' (reconnaissance), 'roma' (neuroma). Pushes toward sentence endings: a period after a quote, then a newline.

L27n2217.name: Taxon or place fragment
L27n2217.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment of a Latin taxon, place name or technical term: 'ht' in Ikhtiyar, 'put' in Pseudomonas putida, 'apt' in Diaptomus, 'yle' in Xyleborus, 'sap' in sapodilla, 'Bhag' in Bhagabhadra. Pushed positive, it writes 'water', 'Water' or 'waters' and spams it.

L27n2710.name: Name fragment, punctuation writer
L27n2710.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or start piece of a proper name or technical word (Ep|iphanes, Ber|zelius, Eck|strom, trans|istors, pect|in). Pushes toward colons, commas, and exclamation marks.

L27n1318.name: Prefix pieces; writes mod
L27n1318.description: Fires on the first half of a split prefix word (multim|odal, im|modal, accom|panied, decom|pose); pushes toward 'mod', 'Mod' and 'MOD' tokens.

L27n2273.name: '-p'/'-v' pieces, name starts
L27n2273.description: Fires on a hyphen plus letter piece ('anti-p' in antipandemic, '-v' in influenza-vaccinated) and on name starts like 'Char' (Charlemagne) and 'Laf' (Lafitte); pushes toward 'predict' tokens.

L0n38.name: Abstract social-state nouns
L0n38.description: Fires on the head noun of an abstract social or medical condition, right after 'call for', 'the new', 'the problem with' or 'a', e.g. 'equality', 'norm', 'problem', 'epidemic', 'constant', 'migraine'. Also fires on the '</think>' closing tag. Pushing it up writes code closers, but steered output is only newlines.

L27n1285.name: Foreign word fragments
L27n1285.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a foreign name or word split across tokens (e.g. 'Cor' in Coruña, 'imar' in Guimarães, 'ichen' in Gleichenia, 'ラン' in 'home run'), where the next token completes the word; pushes toward short multilingual function words (Indonesian 'adalah'/'hanya', Italian 'è', Spanish 'puede'), and when steered it repeats 'only'.

L26n1350.name: Capitalized name onsets
L26n1350.description: Opening pieces of capitalized proper nouns split into tokens ('Bel' in Belo Horizonte, Belgrave, Belarus; 'Ep' in Epiphanes; 'Ge' in Geobacter); pushes toward 'pdf'.

L27n1972.name: Suffix-bound word starts
L27n1972.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that continues with a suffix (emanc|ipated, pard|oned, Cal|iphate, arm|istice, co-oc|curring); pushes toward 'ip/IP' tokens.

L25n2224.name: Capital F, 'set' output
L25n2224.description: The capital 'F' or first piece starting a name or word (Faisal, Fauvism, Fight), plus placement verbs such as 'stood', 'stay' and 'posted'. Pushes toward 'set'.

L26n1264.name: Word-initial fragments, 'reach' output
L26n1264.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, usually a capital 'H' or an opening 'Sin', 'sh' or 'fl' starting a name or word (Sin-tra, H-avelock, fl-uenza). Pushes toward 'reach'.

L26n1854.name: Word-start 'mult-' fragment
L26n1854.description: The 'mult' piece opening multi- words (mult|ilocular, mult|icolor, mult|ilined), plus 'min', 'sem' and 'ant' opening split words (min|strel, sem|isolid, ant|ibiotics); pushes toward 'io' and 'ias' tokens.

L26n2611.name: Split name fragments, roll
L26n2611.description: First piece of a split or capitalised name or word (dre|idel, Fab|erg|é, Mont|ellaro, Fl|ank, Med|upi); pushes toward 'roll' and 'rolling'.

L25n2487.name: Name fragments, 'random'
L25n2487.description: Fires on a piece of a name or rare word split across tokens, such as Bet- in Betts, Dev- in Devanand, Hend- in Hendrickson, by- in Abyei, and sc- in scattered. Pushes toward 'random'; at dose 0.5 it degenerates into 'riddle' repetition.

L27n1594.name: Hyphen-C compound stems
L27n1594.description: Fires positively on a 'C' or 'c' piece right after a hyphen or prefix (aqua-culture, post-Civil, anti-cancer, Jewish-Catholic), and on 'mac' in permaculture and macro. Pushes the model toward 'sin' and 'cos'.

L27n2205.name: Word-start 'st' / 'sh'
L27n2205.description: Fires on 'st', 'sh' or 'Ant' starting a split word (st|umble, st|ew, sh|rouded, Ant|idote, reint|roduced). Pushes 'introduction' and 'introduce' tokens, which the reads do not match, so the pairing is weak.

L0n1967.name: Specific word-piece tokens
L0n1967.description: Early-layer, token-identity neuron, negative on specific word pieces with no shared context: 'actors' in tractors, 'ite' in Amorite, 'oth' in tooth, 'itt' in Howitt, 'rail' in railroads, 'ons' in axons, and 'Lord' after 'the'. Pushes toward names like 'Charles' and 'Richard' and toward 'List'.

L26n2804.name: Rare-word start fragments
L26n2804.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a rare or split word (Bur-j Khalifa, Bur-ial, sil-houettes, lif-eguards, acc-io in carpaccio, incub-ation, ilit-ers); pushes 'io' and 'os' suffix tokens.

L26n934.name: Surname and name-piece tokens
L26n934.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a multi-token person, place or organisation name (Long in Longfellow or Long Island, Mel in Melvin, St in St. Louis); pushes toward 'stone', 'wood' and 'river'.

L27n1800.name: First pieces of names
L27n1800.description: The first subword piece of a split capitalised name, mostly places or people (Beth|any, Dh|ala, N|akhon, Rom|mel, Hol|man, Hum|mingbird, Kn|idos); pushes toward 'update' tokens.

L24n1310.name: Middle of split names
L24n1310.description: The middle piece of a proper name or foreign word split into tokens, such as 'ago' in Zara|ago|za or 'ang' in Bamb|ang (negative); pushes toward 'members' and 'member'.

L27n524.name: Capitalized compound end piece
L27n524.description: The later piece of a capitalized name or compound (NG in MESSENGER, UGHT in DAUGHTER, Object in Object Management, Product in Product Owner, Service in service-oriented). Pushes toward a capital H; steered output spams 'H'.

L27n2854.name: Proper-name second parts, D
L27n2854.description: Fires on the piece of a multi-word proper or institution name that follows its first word, e.g. 'Educational' in Individuals with Disabilities Educational Act, 'Heart' in American Heart, 'Intelligent' in IEEE Intelligent Systems; pushes toward the letter D.

L27n898.name: Sh/Sc/Sm starts, exclamation writer
L27n898.description: Fires on the opening 'Sh', 'Sc', 'Sm' or 'sh' piece of a word or name (Sh|alimar, Sc|issorhands, Sm|og, sh|aking); pushes toward exclamation marks '!' and '！'.

L26n2374.name: Split name/word starts
L26n2374.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into several tokens (Kos|rae, Có|rdoba, Ell|sworth, sap|otilla, pol|yc|rystalline, e|icos|apentaenoic), and on some whole words in phrases like 'crop' and 'Grand Canyon'. Pushed positive it steers output toward 'ring'.

L25n914.name: Stem before '-ize' suffix
L25n914.description: Fires on the stem piece just before a split '-ize', '-ise' or '-ized' suffix (pasteur|ized, categor|ise, dec|arbon|ised, desens|itized). Pushes the model toward 'normal' and 'standard'.

L24n2074.name: Canvas and pro- prefixes
L24n2074.description: Two triggers: the word 'canvas' in HTML canvas text, and the 'pro' start of words (proliferation, prophets, Proculus, deprotonated); pushes toward 'context'/'ctx' tokens.

L26n1682.name: Place-name first pieces
L26n1682.description: Fires on the first subword of a capitalized place or person name split into tokens, such as 'Al' in Almazaras and Alamo, 'Est' in Estepa, 'Con' in Conception and 'Mont' in Montferrat. Pushes toward closing code tokens like ')")'.

L26n1073.name: Name fragments; policy
L26n1073.description: The first 1 to 2 letters of a capitalized name, such as 'Dev' in Devi, 'Lu' in Lucrece, 'Cong' in Congaree and 'Eng' in Engaging. Pushes toward 'policy' and 'policies'; steered output spams 'Policy'.

L27n91.name: Place and proper-name endings
L27n91.description: Fires on the final piece of a proper place or country name (New Zealand, Hiroshima, Pittsburgh, Madagascar, Portugal); pushes output toward colour and shape words such as Blue, Triangle, Diamond and Silver.

L25n757.name: Hyper- and stem fragments
L25n757.description: Fires on word-internal stems split by the tokenizer, notably 'hyper' (hyperacusis, hyperparameters, hypermethylation), 'adul' in adulterated and 'bas' in basal; pushes toward '-able/ability'.

L25n882.name: Name and list openers
L25n882.description: Goes negative on tokens that open a list or a title: 'as' in 'such as', 'on' in 'Follow Math Help Forum on Facebook', capital 'A' starting a clause or name, and the second piece of split names (Karn|ail, Cinnam|om). Pushes toward 'summary'.

L26n194.name: Digits inside years
L26n194.description: Strongly negative on a middle digit of a multi-digit number, mostly years (e.g. the '9' in 1979, the '5' in 250 million, the '8' in 1863); pushes weak foreign-word fragments.

L27n1483.name: Capitalized name starts; vehicle
L27n1483.description: Fires on the capitalized first syllable of a proper name, e.g. 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'Z' in Zulkifli, 'W' in Waukesha, 'Cl' in Clifton, 'Sl' in Slavic; pushes toward 'vehicle' and 'vehicles'.

L27n1820.name: Capital name opener
L27n1820.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split name or word ('Me' in 'Meaux', 'Pin' in 'Pinatubo', 'Mar' in 'Marquesas', 'Los' in 'Los Angeles', 'Fe' in 'feasibility'). Pushed negative, it writes 'reverse' and 'inverse' tokens.

L27n1780.name: Verb stems, pos
L27n1780.description: Prefix or verb-stem pieces of split words ('decom|posed', 'rep|elling', 'pro|vision', 'neut|rop|enic', 'Expl|orers'). Pushes toward 'pos' tokens.

L27n2628.name: Lone c in compounds
L27n2628.description: Fires on a lone 'c' or 'C' (or 'photoc') opening the second half of a hyphen or prefix compound: 'Anti-c|ancer', 'Self-c|leaning', 'single-c|elled', 'post-C|ivil', 'photoc|atalytic', '(c|liche)'. Pushes toward 'copy' tokens.

L27n1585.name: All-caps word fragments
L27n1585.description: Fires on an uppercase piece in the middle of an all-caps word or acronym, from the second piece on, such as 'SO' in 'SOA', 'NO' in 'CARTE|NOIRE', 'DO' in 'DOI', 'MO' in 'MOBI' and 'APPRO|ACH'; pushes 'pen/pers/plen' fragments.

L27n1822.name: Ex/Con prefix, writes express
L27n1822.description: Fires on a prefix-like first piece of a split word, such as 'Ex' in endogenous, 'Con' in Conduct or Consenting, 'Gen' in Genbaku, or 'Dev' in Devi. Pushes toward 'express' and 'expression'.

L27n1254.name: Medical fragment → closers
L27n1254.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a medical or chemical term ('hyp' in hypodermis, 'di' in dihydrotestosterone, 'ple' in pleural, 'hal' in halibut); when negated, it pushes toward code closers like ')' and '}'.

L26n1421.name: Start of split names
L26n1421.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a capitalized name or word split across tokens, especially 'Str' (Stronsay, Strait), 'imp' (impoundment, implicate), 'Dol' (Dolaucothi), 'Ad' (Aden) and 'Gr' (Grisons); writes 'job/jobs' tokens.

L25n712.name: 'bas' word fragment
L25n712.description: Fires on word-opening fragments of longer words, strongest on 'bas' (basins, basal, basmati, Bas-Armagnac), and also 'wast', 'wid', 'hash', 'orang'. Pushes toward 'ax'/'ex' tokens with little visible effect.

L26n2129.name: Recipe-text word fragment
L26n2129.description: The first piece of a split word, often in recipe or instruction text, e.g. 's' in scones, 'S' in Serves, 'self' in self-raising, 'Tel' in Tel Aviv. Pushes toward 'server' and 'serve'; steered, it spams 'server'.

L26n1617.name: Drug-name middle pieces
L26n1617.description: Fires on the middle piece of a drug, antibiotic or chemical name split into tokens ('ly' in aminoglycoside, 'ind' in clindamycin, 'tert' in methyl tert-butyl, 'ure' in polyurethane); pushes toward 'binary'.

L27n2884.name: Capitalised 'Sch' name openings
L27n2884.description: Goes strongly negative on 'Sch' and similar capitalised name openings, e.g. 'Sch' in 'Schleper', 'Schmitt', 'Scholars', and 'Mer' in 'Merriam-Webster'; pushes toward 'Figure/fig' tokens.

L26n1289.name: Capital H word starts
L26n1289.description: Fires on a word-initial H or h, most often a capital H starting a term such as Habitat, Hiking, Huguenots, Hips, and h in hatching, and on the letter after a hyphen (-H in Multi-Hazard). Pushes toward 'align', 'fair' and 'clarity'; at dose -0.5 it repeats 'fair'.

L26n2980.name: Name fragment → 'sample'
L26n2980.description: Fires on capital-letter or name fragments inside split words, like 'Rec' in recombination, 'B' in Bortnyik, 'Com' in Companions and 'C' in cystic; pushes toward 'sample' and 'samples'.

L27n2511.name: Word-start 'bre'/'cre'/'fl' fragments
L27n2511.description: Goes negative on the consonant-cluster piece that opens a split word ('bre' in breeder, 'cre' in crevice, 'fl' in flakes and flank, 'cr' in craton, 'al' in cantaloupe). Pushes toward 'difference'.

L25n318.name: Name-fragment letters; ';' output
L25n318.description: Fires on a capital letter or short abbreviation piece inside a name or code label (ApoE, the '-N' of PDD-NOS, De|indl, Di|aptomus, C chains). Pushes toward semicolon tokens.

L25n2711.name: Capital-E abbreviations, 'model' output
L25n2711.description: The capital 'E' that starts an abbreviation or name (E. coli, EPA, Eggs, Elaeis, Echinococcus), plus a few other word starts. Pushes toward 'model' and 'models'.

L27n1122.name: Water nouns, was/been
L27n1122.description: Goes negative on water and kitchen-type nouns (Sea in Sea Berry, water in waterways and groundwater, kitchen table, lawn, limestone), and on 'was' or 'been' before a passive verb (was originally presented, have been abandoned). Pushes toward 'table/tables'.

L27n1743.name: Noun start, writes 'hour'
L27n1743.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split common noun, often an animal, plant, food or name: 'ame' in chame|leons, 'Mer' in Merino, 'aw' in hawthorn, 'cous' in couscous, 'Nec' in Nectrolestes, 'is' in Crisps. Pushed positive, it writes time words ('hour', 'hours', 'night', 'afternoon') and spams them.

L27n1141.name: Proper-name fragment pieces
L27n1141.description: Negative on the second or later sub-token of a capitalized name split across tokens, e.g. 'Mend|elssohn', 'Derek Mah|on', 'Int|erscience', 'Roh|ini'. Pushes toward 'Apache' and 'uri' tokens, which read as unrelated; steered output shows no clear shift.

L27n159.name: First-person 'I' clauses
L27n159.description: Fires on a first-person 'I' opening a clause in personal prose ('I usually choose', 'I felt', 'I wrote', 'I believe'); pushes toward list nouns like 'Form', 'Group' and 'Pair', and steered output degenerates.

L27n444.name: Mid-word fragments, quote out
L27n444.description: A non-initial piece of a long Latin, scientific or foreign word (Phry|nosoma 'ry', Thelypter|idaceae 'ely', Phil|harmonic 'har', C|uen|ca 'uen'); pushes toward closing quote and ) tokens.

L25n1605.name: 'World' and name fragments
L25n1605.description: Fires on 'World' before 'Health Organization' or 'Bank', and on the middle piece of foreign surnames or species names (e.g. 'ort' in Bortnyik, 'cord' in cordata). Pushes toward 'result' and 'results'.

L27n2915.name: Name-start fragments → '####'
L27n2915.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or noun split into tokens (Luk|in, Z|ulu, Hor|owitz, mon|asteries, mar|igold, sal|inity, trib|als). Goes negative toward '####' markdown headers and quote-comma tokens, giving '####' spam.

L25n2831.name: Capitalized 'Sl' word starts
L25n2831.description: Goes strongly negative hardest on the 'Sl' that opens a capitalized word (Slavery, Slaves, Slavic), and on other capitalized openers like Chern|obyl, Fern|heim, O|sh|kosh and 'Tibetan'. Pushed negative it steers output toward royal words: 'King', 'queen', 'royal', 'prince'.

L26n641.name: 'National' in org names
L26n641.description: Fires on the first word of an organization name, mostly 'National' (National Science Foundation) or 'American', in education and science text; pushes 'math' and 'mathematics'.

L26n530.name: Recipe lists, formula terms
L26n530.description: Fires on the word or comma right before a list item or value in recipes and formulas: commas between ingredients, 'formula' before an equation, 'scalar' before 'learning rate', and food or unit words like tablespoon and tomato. Pushes toward '$' variable names; at dose 0.5 it degenerates into word repetition.

L27n2388.name: Word-start 'Bo'/'Ber' piece
L27n2388.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split proper noun or word, mostly 'Bo' ('Bois Blanc', 'Boiry'), 'Ber' ('Berzelius'), 'Or' ('Oriskany') and 'Me' ('Meaux'). Pushes 'association' and 'associate' tokens.

L26n2627.name: Word-internal fragments; hand
L26n2627.description: A middle fragment of a word split across tokens (pamph|leteer, inf|irm, leg|ia, Br|ave, Pr|ize); pushes toward 'hand' and 'hands'.

L27n2462.name: Name start, writes exist
L27n2462.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or proper noun ('N' in Nostalgia/Nayarit, 'Sen' in Senegal, 'inn' in Mackinac/cinnabar, 'Mag' in Magiolo); pushes toward 'presence'/'exists'.

L18n901.name: Colon after field label
L18n901.description: Fires negatively on the colon or closing bracket right after a short field label ('Type:', 'Address:', 'Fact:', 'Owner', '[root@chris ~]'). Writes no clear token; when pushed negative, output breaks into runs of spaces.

L26n2677.name: oc/c word onsets
L26n2677.description: The opening 'oc', 'c', 'suc', 'Prec', or 'Rec' fragment of a split word (occur, occlusal, cations, sucralose, Precision). Pushes toward 'kernel' and 'shell' tokens.

L24n2245.name: Name fragment → 'unit'
L24n2245.description: Fires on middle pieces of split names and words (e.g. 'udd' in Muddathir, 'idd' in Meggido, 'Tit' in Titus, 'hai' in Sarabhai), plus 'have' and 'write' in coding prompts. Pushes toward 'unit' and 'tests'.

L27n2195.name: World 'War', writes 'crime'
L27n2195.description: Fires most strongly on 'War' in 'World War II' and on violence-related word stems (Nazi, -ocide, minstrel). Pushes toward 'crime' and 'criminal' tokens, yet steered output is a carriage-return spam.

L27n3028.name: Proper-name onset fragments
L27n3028.description: Negative pole. Fires on the first sub-token of a proper name split into pieces (Laf|itte, Rams|es, Aj|inkya, Los| Alamos, Gh|af, Ch|om, Rob|). Pushes toward 'experiment'; steered, it spams 'Experiment experiment'.

L27n2925.name: Word-start fragments; guess output
L27n2925.description: Fires on the short opening piece of a word split into tokens, often a capitalized name such as 'Le' in Leibniz, 'Pl' in Plague, or 'Ps' in Psophodes; pushes toward 'guess' and 'unknown'.

L26n449.name: Dots and closing punctuation
L26n449.description: Fires on diffuse word fragments and on the <think> token that opens an assistant turn in chat. Pushes toward '...' and closing punctuation such as '）。', '**:' and '”。', and steering spams dots.

L27n1390.name: Negative: name fragments, 'information'
L27n1390.description: Fires strongly negative on mid-name pieces (az in oxazolidinones, at in somatostatin, kes in Waukesha), pushing 'information'.

L26n1582.name: Word-stem fragments, account output
L26n1582.description: A mid-word stem piece of a long word split into tokens, right before a suffix such as -ible, -actic, -actor or -ieves (rodu|cible, gal|actic, benef|actor, satisf|actorily, rel|ieves); pushes toward 'account' and 'accounts'.

L27n3031.name: Word-start Se/Sp fragments
L27n3031.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'Se' or 'Sp' that are split into tokens (se in sepsis/seborrhea, Sp in Spence/Spicy/Spelling); pushes toward 'expand/expansion' tokens, which do not match the read.

L26n2449.name: Mid-name proper-noun fragments
L26n2449.description: The second or later piece of a split proper noun or brand, at the token just before it completes (Alka|-S|eltzer, Christian| Science, Guim|arães, Zu|lu, Mennon|ites). Logit lens writes Spanish -ado/-ido endings, but steering shows little visible effect.

L26n3013.name: Capital 'P' word starts
L26n3013.description: Fires on a capital 'P' that starts a capitalized word, usually a place, name or list-item opener (Palla, Potters, Patches, Pumsaint, Puffins, Pustules, Pacific, Pteridomania), and on 'ort' in Bortnyik. Pushed positive it steers output toward 'measurement'.

L26n585.name: Mid-word fragments, 'across'
L26n585.description: Fires on a word-piece in the middle of a split word or name (oul in Boulton, ile in acoustic neuroma, rel in relatable, par in paralyze); pushes toward 'across', 'between', 'along', so steered output spams 'across'.

L27n184.name: Punctuation opening an aside
L27n184.description: Negative on a punctuation mark that opens an aside or alternative right after a term: '(' before a converted value or acronym, '/' or '&' between two options, '=' in a code assignment. Pushes toward code identifiers like 'str', 'id', 'url' and 'len'; steered output spams 'str' and 'strid'.

L27n1525.name: Mid-word fragment → ge
L27n1525.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split rare word, e.g. 'ann' in crannog, 'ser' in serfdom, 'quar' in quarries, 'gu' in guineensis, 'diver' in diverge; pushes toward 'ge' and 'geo' tokens.

L27n2468.name: Name pieces, 'global'
L27n2468.description: The second piece of a split name or word (Carnegie, allow, the 'um' in Mpumalanga), pushing 'global'.

L25n114.name: Sudoers ALL, word fragments
L25n114.description: Fires on the ALL in sudoers lines like 'ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD' and on word-initial pieces split from longer words ('Ac' in Acquired, 'Sub' in subcutaneous, 'Dec' in Decisions). Pushes toward closing a code string with tokens like ');' and '];'.

L26n1549.name: Technical name suffixes
L26n1549.description: Fires negative on later pieces of long technical or biological names: 'acin' in niacin, 'oc' in tocopherol, 'acter' in Geobacter, 'retro' in retrovirus, 'Edition' in Adobe Digital Editions. Pushes toward 'contain/contains'; steered output spams 'cont'.

L26n1422.name: Lone 'f' word opener
L26n1422.description: Fires on a lone 'f' that opens a word split into 'f' plus the rest (f in fostering, fathom, fiddled, fashions, flossing), plus 'conf' in confute and '-dis' in self-discovery; pushes toward 'discovery' tokens.

L27n411.name: Name and caps middles
L27n411.description: Goes positive on the middle piece of a name or ALL-CAPS phrase, e.g. 'Cape' in Cape Town, 'Rock' in Rockwall, 'IS' in an all-caps 'YOUR TEENAGER IS', 'house' in Greenhouse gas. Pushes toward person nouns like 'student' and 'customer'.

L27n171.name: Name fragments, backslash output
L27n171.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mal' in 'Malawi', 'Moz' in 'Mozambique', 'St' in 'Sticherus', 'out' in 'outperformed', 'Pro' in 'protruding', 'o' in 'oxtail'. Pushes toward backslash escape tokens; steered, it spams a lone backslash or newline escapes.

L27n1020.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n1020.description: Goes negative on the consonant-cluster opening of a word split into pieces, mostly 'cl' (clenching, clots, clippings), 'str' (straits), 'sw' (swishing); pushes toward 'add'/'adding'.

L25n1171.name: Opening quote or colon
L25n1171.description: Goes negative on the opening punctuation that introduces a named term, quote or list: an opening quote before a term, a colon plus newline before a list, a '?' plus newline before a list, and a '(' before a foreign term. Also 'revolution' in 'green revolution'. Pushes toward '_' identifier pieces.

L27n2351.name: Split-word piece near 'absorb'
L27n2351.description: Strongly positive on the second piece of split words, diffusely ('os' in 'osteosarcoma', 'Fr' in 'Frisian', 'ab' in 'overabundance', 'Re' in 'reusable'), and on 'It' right after 'shock absorber'. Pushes 'abs' and 'absorb' tokens.

L27n369.name: Acronyms and Sanskrit fragments
L27n369.description: Goes strongly negative on capital acronym starts and transliterated word pieces, e.g. 'am' in Merri|am, 'HT' in N|HT|SA, 'dh' in sā|dh|ana, 'CC' in (CCSSO) and 'Min' in Minas. Writes capital-letter tokens like 'SA' and 'SF', and steering gives unrelated 'sil'/'sa' text.

L26n2247.name: Hyphen-split c/k → city
L26n2247.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'k' that starts the second half of a hyphenated or split word (foot-|candle, iso-c|andlepower, close-|knit, C|nidus, /c|ities); pushes 'city', 'cities', 'urban' and 'town'.

L26n2709.name: Name-middle fragments
L26n2709.description: Negative on a middle piece of a long proper name or chemical term split into tokens (e.g. 'ob' in Chernobyl, 'ay' in Ramayana, 'Organic' in volatile organic compounds). Pushes the model toward 'processing' and 'raw'.

L26n2190.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L26n2190.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting with a consonant cluster, especially 'gr', 'qu', 'st' and 'cl' split across tokens: 'Gr' in Gr|ating, 'qu' in qu|asar, 'log' in crystal|log|raphy, 'st' in st|itions. Pushes toward 'star' and 'stars'.

L27n2587.name: Word fragments, sigma output
L27n2587.description: Fires on a piece of a word split across tokens, especially cons (conscription, consent), Mit (Mitanni), tub (tuberosum) and bub (bubonic); pushes toward 'sigma' and 'San' tokens.

L27n423.name: Name fragment, writes H
L27n423.description: Mid-word piece of names and rare terms (Hos|ack, dis|ulf|ide, arr|hythmias, Açva|ghosha); pushes toward capital-H tokens like 'HC', 'HA' and 'ho'.

L26n1597.name: Capital letter name starts
L26n1597.description: Fires on the first one or two letters of a capitalized name or noun, often at the start of a list item (P|uma, P|olar bear, O|shkosh, St|ands). Pushes the model toward capital two-letter tokens like 'AP', 'AO' and 'OV'.

L26n2950.name: Name-opening fragment, 'cre'
L26n2950.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'cre' in Lucrece, 'Ann' in Annunciation, 'Ah' in Aaron, 'oul' in Boulton, 'euth' in Euthanasia; pushes toward 'API' tokens.

L25n1931.name: 'come' and 'https' tokens
L25n1931.description: Fires on 'come' in phrases like 'come to', 'come out' and 'come from', on 'https' after 'curl' or 'from', and on name fragments like 'udd'; pushes toward 'close' and 'convergence'.

L27n2053.name: Word-start pieces; 'target' writer
L27n2053.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare or split word, usually a consonant start (Th|espians, Tit|us, C|igarette, sw|amps, lact|ose, Kh|arkiv, ret|inoin); pushes 'target' and 'targets', spamming 'target' when steered.

L25n909.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L25n909.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a word split into tokens, mostly consonant-cluster or short starts such as thr (thrifty, thong), scr (scrupulous), pr (prays), ath (heathen), orm (Kormoran) and Pl. Pushes toward 'thanks', 'respect' and 'honor', and steered output spams 'Thank you'.

L27n2754.name: Split 'S'/'Mos' word start
L27n2754.description: Strongly positive on an 'S' or 'Mos' piece that opens a split word ('-S' in 'Alka|Seltzer', 'Mos' in 'Moslem', 'S' in 'Sita', 'Mes' in 'Mesopotamia'). Pushes 'session' tokens.

L27n2543.name: Ch- and p- openers
L27n2543.description: Fires on the 'Ch' opener of a word or name (Ch|aldeans, Ch|ugoku, Ch|acocente, Ch|aucer, Ch|ivalry) and on 'p' or 'P' starts after a hyphen or at a word start (self-p|ublished, bee-p|ollinated, P|atches); pushed negative it promotes 'technology'.

L26n1211.name: Miles unit to ap
L26n1211.description: Negative pole fires on 'miles' after a number and on word stems; pushes toward 'ap' tokens.

L27n3004.name: Name-start 'ch/Ph' fragments
L27n3004.description: Fires on a short word-start fragment inside a capitalized name or split word (ch in chisel/chowders, Ph in Phatthalung, Cor in Coral, Sh in Shiloh, Jer in Jerk); pushes toward 'connection' tokens.

L26n743.name: Mid-compound technical fragments
L26n743.description: Goes negative on the second or middle piece of a compound scientific or medical term split into tokens, such as 'leasing' in releasing, 'at' in nematocyst, 'hyper' in hyperacusis, 'xy' in hydroxydeoxyguanosine, 'vir' in retrovirus. Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L27n974.name: Mid-word pieces, number
L27n974.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long or split names and terms, e.g. 'filtration' in glomerular filtration, 'os' in tyrannosaurus, 'T' in Talmud, 'musical' in high school musical; pushes toward number and numbers.

L27n2966.name: Word-start fragments, ui/widget
L27n2966.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, especially 'Hy' in hydrogen and hygiene, and 'dec' or 'disc' in decimation and discursive. Pushes toward 'ui' and 'widget' tokens.

L27n1324.name: Capital P/Pl name onsets
L27n1324.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or place, often a bare P or Pl (Pl|atonist, P|alla, Pum|saint, Gr|ange, Zam|bezi). Pushes toward LaTeX-style brace tokens such as }{ and {; steered output spams '{}{}'.

L27n1474.name: Pre-predicate function words
L27n1474.description: Fires strongly negative on function words and adverbs mid-clause that sit right before the verb, adjective or noun that completes them: 'and' in contrarious and hurtful, 'has' in has seen, 'have' in have become, 'probably' in would probably be, 'first' in must first come, 'best' in best known, 'old' in old irrigation. Going negative pushes toward closing quote marks.

L27n753.name: Mid-word stems, colon output
L27n753.description: Fires negatively on assorted mid-word stems and first pieces of names and lists (sa in safflower, mel in melon, Barg in Barguzin, cyc in cyclical, sc in scallions, Maj in Majorelle). Pushes the model toward a colon.

L25n162.name: Latin species-name fragments
L25n162.description: Goes negative on a fragment of Latin species and genus names (Pl in Platanus, alex in alexandri, h in huxleyi, chin in chinensis, yle in Xyleborus); pushes toward 'wait' tokens.

L27n2437.name: Compound starts → media
L27n2437.description: The opening piece of a longer word split into tokens (IMM in IMMEDIATE, multim in multimedia, rem in remembrance, renom in adrenomimetic); pushes toward 'media' and 'med'.

L27n2478.name: Prefix fragment → member
L27n2478.description: Fires on a word-start fragment that opens a longer verb or noun, mostly 'rem' (removes, removed) and 'mes' (mesas, mesosphere), plus '-m' and 'sed'; pushes toward 'member' tokens.

L27n538.name: Name fragments, blank output
L27n538.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'tam' in tampered. Pushes toward whitespace, so the output goes blank.

L27n1943.name: Technical fragments, client
L27n1943.description: Single 'c' or 'C' pieces and 'oc' pieces inside technical or biological words ('c|AMP', 'C|enchrus', 'nemat|oc|ysts', 'Mon|oc|otyledoneae'). Pushes toward 'client' and 'clients'.

L27n2270.name: 'low' compounds, 'resource'
L27n2270.description: Fires on 'low' in hyphen compounds like 'low-resource', 'low-income', 'low-alcohol', and on other first pieces of split words (Gran-, hem-, Bo-); pushes toward 'resource(s)'.

L27n1903.name: 'sc'/'Sc' word openings
L27n1903.description: Fires on 'sc' or 'Sc' opening a word piece, e.g. 'sc' in 'scoliosis', 'Scraping', 'Scrum-half', and 'br' in 'bruxism'; pushes toward 'diff' tokens.

L25n2614.name: Input verbs, env quotes
L25n2614.description: Fires on input verbs in coding prompts ('reads', 'takes', 'accepts' in 'a program that reads...') and on the quoted NOPASSWD and echo lines of sudoers setup. Pushes toward 'environment' and 'env'.

L25n2262.name: Split name fragments
L25n2262.description: Fires on a token inside a split proper noun or technical word that carries its identity (ob in Chernobyl, Beth in Bethany, Dev in Deviations, X in Xerxes, B in Babylon); pushes toward 'shift' tokens and steers into 'Shift shift' spam.

L27n1994.name: Word-stem fragment before suffix
L27n1994.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece of a split word when the word continues in the next token, e.g. 'electroly' before 'te', 'pamph', 'hemat'; pushes toward 'te' tokens.

L23n896.name: Digits and name pieces
L23n896.description: Positive on the last digit of a year ('19<3>2', '194<5>') and on the middle subword of a surname or proper noun ('Hotamis<lig>il', 'Leth Jø<rg>ensen', 'Nag<asaki>'). Writes 'len' fragments.

L26n1778.name: int and contr openers
L26n1778.description: Fires on the opening fragment of words split into tokens, mostly 'int' or '-int' (intensity, intuitional, intonation) and 'contr' or 'cont' (contortionists, contrarious). Pushes toward 'temporary' and 'tmp'.

L27n1622.name: Mid-word pieces, env output
L27n1622.description: Fires on the first fragment of a long or unusual word split into pieces, mid-sentence (La in LaHood, Cru in Cruelty, circum in circumstantial, ven in venoms); pushes toward 'env' tokens when negative.

L27n472.name: bl- word onsets
L27n472.description: The 'bl' that opens a word split across tokens (blanch, blazes, blower, Blu-ray, blurring), plus a few other onsets such as 'bur' in burritos and 'emb' in embrittlement; pushes toward 'Get' and 'get'.

L25n1549.name: Scattered split-word openers
L25n1549.description: Goes negative on pieces of split words across unrelated topics (Sup in Supposedly, ou in Rambouillet, ap in Hunga Tonga, p in Wellpinit, ground in ground beetles, nap in napkins); no single topic; pushes toward 'cover' tokens.

L25n422.name: Joiner punctuation in compounds
L25n422.description: Fires on a joiner punctuation token inside a compound, number or formula, such as the '-' in 'omega-3' or 'Covid-19', the '.' in '1.000', the '_' in 'SiO_2', or a '(' opening an aside, just before the second half. Pushes toward no clear word; steered output degenerates into 'by the the'.

L26n2186.name: Place-name first pieces
L26n2186.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a split place name (And|alusia, Ha|ucourt, G|undisapur, Pe|enemunde, G|uelph). Writes 'height'/'heights'; steering spams 'Height'.

L15n67.name: Polysemantic word fragments
L15n67.description: No single pattern: fires on assorted mid-word pieces and multilingual script tokens ('ed' in Switched, 'ot' in glottalaxolot, 'cribed' in transcribed, 'https', 'Education' in ENABL, Arabic and Devanagari fragments). Pushes toward stray tokens like '//' and '](' with no clear meaning.

L27n1510.name: Mid-word rare-name fragments
L27n1510.description: Fires on a middle subword piece of a long or rare word split into several tokens, such as atem in Guatemalan, hyp in hypothyroidism, Ven in Veneto, or ph in phosphatases; pushes toward 'message' tokens.

L27n1399.name: Middle of proper-name pieces
L27n1399.description: The middle piece of a multi-token proper name or word (Taj Mah|al, Nau|voo, Ram|khamhaeng, enc|roached, Sar|acen). Pushes toward markdown and symbol tokens such as '*', '#', '`', and '""'.

L26n3070.name: surname and name fragments
L26n3070.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a surname, place name or word split into tokens ('Cast' in Castile, 'McInt' in McIntyre, 'McG' in McGraw, 'pict' in pictogram). Pushes toward 'paint' and 'draw'.

L25n1440.name: Name-start piece → %
L25n1440.description: Fires on the early subword piece of a split proper name (Pat|agonia, Th|ammarat, Luc|idchart, N|akhon) and on command starts like 'sudo yum'; pushes printf-style placeholders '%', '%{', '{}'.

L27n2157.name: Omniscient and tense terms
L27n2157.description: The 'isc' piece of 'omniscient' after 'omn' in third-person POV prompts, and 'Present' in tense-label lists; pushes toward 'active' and 'Active'.

L26n873.name: Programming language names
L26n873.description: Fires on programming-language and tech names (Ruby, Python, Perl, Bash, Verilog, PHP, SQL), mostly on the name token itself; pushes output toward big tech company names such as Google, Microsoft and IBM.

L27n2772.name: Name/term onsets, 'goal'
L27n2772.description: Positive on the first piece of a split name or term (Dol|aucothi, Des|ierto, Fil|adelfia, whe|y), pushing toward 'goal' tokens.

L27n2362.name: Word-initial sh, horizontal
L27n2362.description: Fires on a word-initial sh, Sh or Sw fragment split off from its word (shampoos, shunt, Shiloh, Shirts); pushes toward 'horizontal' and 'vertical' tokens.

L27n3050.name: Consonant word-piece start
L27n3050.description: Fires on a single consonant (c, s, g, K) that opens a split word piece, e.g. 'c' in Kirkcaldy, '-c' in candle or cell, 'Sc' in scraping; pushes the model toward 'mis'/'miss'.

L27n1679.name: Split-word piece, db writer
L27n1679.description: Fires on a piece inside a split compound or name, such as '-H' in McGraw-Hill, 'Schw' in Schwann, 'pharmac' in pharmacodynamic, 'crypt' in cryptanalysing, 'iod' in biodiversity, or 'ASS' in NOPASSWD. Pushes toward 'db' and 'DB' tokens.

L26n1056.name: Recipe colon, odd scripts
L26n1056.description: Fires on the colon-newline after 'Ingredients' in recipe lists, and on unit or script symbols (°, ft, km, Devanagari, ṭ, ś). Pushes the model toward accented and foreign letters like Ø, ā and Á.

L26n2805.name: Mid-word fragments; machine
L26n2805.description: The middle piece of a rare word split into tokens (ang|ina, tantr|ic, gar|uda, ang|ered, fully-g|rown); pushes toward 'machine'.

L27n427.name: Unfinished name piece
L27n427.description: Fires on a piece of a name or word that is still incomplete, e.g. 'au' in 'Nauvoo', 'Al' in 'Alamein', 'Kap' in 'Kapurthala', 'bas' in 'basmati', 'Beng' in 'Benga', 'Mass' in 'massacre'. Pushes toward 'changes', 'updates', 'shifts' and 'edits'; steered, it spams 'changes'.

L26n1755.name: Odd/symmetric writer
L26n1755.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'ob', 'und', 'ab' or 'Mend' split into tokens (Observe, Undoubtedly, abacus, Obadiah). Pushed negative, it promotes 'odd', 'symmetric' and spams 'odd'.

L27n1316.name: Mid-word fragments → 'image'
L27n1316.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a long word split into tokens (telesc|ope, Yog|i, ins|cribed, v|ibrate, pilgr|im), just before the word finishes. Pushes toward 'image' (steered output becomes 'Image image image').

L27n2781.name: Word-fragment reads, prime writes
L27n2781.description: Reads scattered mid-word fragments of multi-token words (Franc-, Pr-, Bl-); pushes toward 'prime'.

L26n768.name: Split name starts
L26n768.description: Fires on the first piece of a split proper name (Buk|ima, Gh|afiqi, Kh|ulaifi, Sidd|ons, 'udd' in Shamsuddin) and on commas listing form fields; pushes toward 'token' and '_TOKEN' tokens.

L27n1532.name: trans/col/dis word start
L27n1532.description: The 'trans', 'col', 'dis' or 'repl' piece opening a split word (|trans|cribed, |trans|position, |col|locates, |Dis|integrative, |repl|anted). Pushes toward 'location'.

L26n1767.name: acronym and name-start letters
L26n1767.description: Fires on the capital letter or short piece that starts an acronym or name ('J' in JAXA, 'E' in EPA, 'Caj' in Cajete, 'et' in 'et al.', '(g' in O2(g)). Pushes toward question marks.

L27n2128.name: Split-word starts → 'period'
L27n2128.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or name split into tokens, mid-sentence (G|rotius, mer|cury, Tim|ely, Hos|feld, Ha|irstyles, enc|losures). Goes negative toward 'period'/'Period', giving period spam.

L27n1581.name: Cl/Col name starts
L27n1581.description: Fires on the first 'Cl', 'Col' or 'cl' piece of a capitalized name or word split across tokens ('Cl|ifton', 'Col|enso', 'cl|apping', 'cl|umps', 'Bl|anche'), and on '%' after an interest rate. Pushes toward 'gender', 'male' and 'female' tokens.

L26n2314.name: Opening word fragments
L26n2314.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening fragment of a word or name split into tokens ('str' in straits, 'fil' in filicaleans, 'ri' in Retriever, 'ub' in Edublogs); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'bot'.

L23n2341.name: Split-word and surname pieces
L23n2341.description: Goes negative on a middle or first subword of a split word or surname ('ri' in kriya, 'ni' in Woz-niak, 'zew' in Przewalski, 'eld' in Zeldovich). Pushing it negative makes the model write '()' call parentheses.

L26n219.name: 'mental' in wellbeing text
L26n219.description: Fires on 'mental' in 'mental health' and similar wellbeing phrases, weaker on scattered tokens in SQL, citations and lists. Pushes toward short 'ab', 'ac' and 'ap' word-start fragments.

L26n1379.name: Taxon name middles
L26n1379.description: The middle fragment of a split proper or taxonomic name, mostly 'ter' in Pteridaceae and Pteridophyta, 'uth' in Buthidae, and 'en' in Cenozoic. Also fires on 'San' and 'Sam' starting place names. Pushes toward '+'-prefixed tokens.

L26n1646.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L26n1646.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long word split into several tokens, while the word is still unfinished: 'gh' in sor|gh|um, 'g' in poly|g|amy, 'mac' in per|mac|ulture, 'ob' in mon|ob|actams. Pushes toward 'programming', 'logging' and 'coding' tokens.

L27n195.name: Hyphen or parenthesis
L27n195.description: Fires on '(' or '-' that opens an example list or joins a compound (macrolides (erythromycin, two-dose, de-odorizing, 16-lead). Pushes 'ful' and 'fully' suffix tokens; steered output spams 'ful'.

L26n2855.name: Institution and body names
L26n2855.description: Fires negatively on the first piece of organisation and body names ('Cong' in Congregation, 'Biom' in Biomaterials, 'rom' in Euromonitor) and on many 'm' word starts; pushed negative, it repeats 'institution'.

L27n1150.name: Name fragment, writes print
L27n1150.description: Capitalized name fragments ('Cle' in Cleve, 'Ch' in Chaldeans, 'Cl' in Clifton) and, in the averages, the modifier before 'print' ('fine', 'floral', 'thumb', 'cardboard'); pushes toward 'print'/'Print'.

L21n1674.name: 'a' before result nouns
L21n1674.description: Fires on 'a' or 'as' that opens a noun phrase after 'is', 'are' or 'as', e.g. 'they are [a] result', 'as [a] basis', 'is [a] consequence', 'can be [a] sign'. Pushes toward 'function'. The link between trigger and output is weak.

L24n1541.name: Name starts, list joiners
L24n1541.description: Fires on the first piece of split names ('Mat', 'Mag', 'Bet', 'San') and on 'and', 'or' or 'of' inside technical lists ('number of buckets', 'underscores or'). Pushes toward 'index' and 'indices'.

L26n2488.name: Name pieces and 'too/very'
L26n2488.description: Goes negative on a non-final piece of a split name (Tim|ur, Kut|cher, Long|fellow, Qut|b) and on intensifiers before an adjective ('too low', 'too much', 'very red'). Writes 'depth'/'deep'; steering spams 'deep'.

L26n1980.name: Name starts, bus output
L26n1980.description: The first piece of a split name or term (Ne|utrons, Tar|quin, El|ham, V|itiligo, rav|ens); pushes toward 'bus' tokens, which steered outputs repeat.

L27n1312.name: Math and STEM fragments
L27n1312.description: Fires on 'math' in STEM lists and fragments like '-m' (non-math), 'polym' (polymath), 'and' in 'Engineering and Math', 'M' (M.P.H.). Pushes toward 'math' tokens; steered, it spams 'Math'.

L25n486.name: Name-suffix and abbreviation pieces
L25n486.description: Fires on pieces of capitalized names and abbreviations: 'Jr' after a surname, 'Av' in Confederate Av, 'rg' in Brgoch, 'Cr' in a URL parameter, and 'Ltd' or 'Inc' after company names. Pushes toward short consonant-cluster fragments like 'mt' and 'tn'.

L27n915.name: Word-start 'pl'/'spl' fragments
L27n915.description: Fires strongly negative on word-opening 'pl', 'spl' and 'mor' pieces (e.g. 'pl' in plowing and plagues, 'spl' in splints, 'mor' in moratorium). Pushes toward code-type tokens '(string', 'string', 'vector' (steered output is '(string string').

L27n421.name: Word in multi-word name
L27n421.description: Fires on a word completing a multi-word proper name or title (Educational in Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, Middle in Middle East, Health in World Health Organization). Pushes 'region', 'area', 'context' and 'environment', a weak link.

L27n1507.name: Name or code-piece start
L27n1507.description: A piece inside a name, code or abbreviation (Ω after 200, KL in Koenig, -H in self-harming, M in VISION (M), 2 in AL5 2JQ). Pushes toward accented capitals (Å, À, Î); steered text reads normally.

L25n832.name: sh/Ch onsets, decimal 0
L25n832.description: Fires on an opening 'sh', 'Sh', 'Ch' or 'Ph' fragment of a split word (sh|ut, Ch|ilton, sh|roud) and on a leading '0' or '1' before decimal digits (0|.05). Pushes toward '=' plus a letter such as '=q', and steering spams 'light:'.

L26n2284.name: Word-start fragments → section
L26n2284.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, often a consonant-led fragment such as 'Bre' (Broad-Breasted), 'arr' (arrhythmia), 'Z' (Zhen Jing), 'b' (braising), 'Lal' (Laliberté); pushes toward 'section'.

L26n1107.name: Name second piece, report
L26n1107.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a multi-token person or place name (Coretta Scott, Bryn M|aw|r, H|ert|ford, Ted Hughes, Mc|Int|osh) and on 'dec' in decarbonise; pushes 'report', 'Report' and 'reports'.

L27n1259.name: Clause-start words, expository prose
L27n1259.description: Goes negative on clause-starting words in expository history and science text (e.g. 'ex' in excommunicated, 'who' after 'one is', 'They' after 'Greek philosophers'). Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'post'.

L25n1027.name: Clause modal or negation
L25n1027.description: Fires on the modal, negation or relative word that opens a conditional, relative or purpose clause, e.g. 'if they fall', 'to not go', 'that might damage', 'who are', 'shall go', 'which produces', plus 'fire'. Pushed positive it steers toward 'exit', 'escape' and 'jump'.

L26n1343.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'total'
L26n1343.description: Negative on a non-initial fragment of a split name or word (e.g. 'Sum' in Sumner, 'cor' in coracoid, 'tom' in tomography); its output points to 'total'.

L27n267.name: Rare-word mid fragments
L27n267.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a rare multi-token word, e.g. 'opy' in Therm-opy-lae, 'ry' in Phrynosoma, 'fl' in influenza; pushes toward LaTeX '$' variable tokens.

L25n2193.name: Rare-word middle pieces
L25n2193.description: Fires on the middle piece of a rare, multi-token technical or proper word (Uffizi 'ff', dihydrotestosterone 'hydro', cinnamomum 'inn', aminoglycoside 'ly', arrhythmia 'yth'); pushes toward '!', so steered text becomes '!!!!!'.

L27n491.name: Split-word starts → caps
L27n491.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word (appet|izing, gr|illing, gen|otyped, sc|arring, mic|rometre), mostly lowercase stems. Pushes toward uppercase fragments 'OS', 'AL', 'SC', 'AC' and garbled text, though steering sometimes still gives coherent output.

L27n937.name: Lone l/m word start
L27n937.description: Fires on a lone 'l' or 'm' that starts a word or hyphenated piece: 'l' in lagoon, limes, limited, labeled; '-l' in alpha-linolenic; 'm' in mango and mature. Common in fruit and plant lists. Pushes toward opening '(' tokens such as [(, `( and -(, repeated.

L27n469.name: 'con' fragments, acronym letters
L27n469.description: Fires on 'con' starting a word piece (self-concepts, convection, unconsciously) and on first letters of acronyms, e.g. 'W' in WGPSN and 'C' in CPSI. Pushes toward 'dp', 'CP' and 'HP' tokens.

L26n2232.name: Long-name opening piece
L26n2232.description: Fires positive on the first or middle piece of a long rare word or proper name split across tokens, e.g. 'Mag' in Magritte, 'str' in straddles, 'qu' in reconquering, 'Cl' in Clifton; pushes toward 'fraction' and 'ratio' tokens.

L27n792.name: Name/compound starts; writes St
L27n792.description: Fires on the first word of a two-part name or compound (corner|stones, Downing| Street, non|stick, Food| Stamps); pushes toward 'St', 'st' and 'Street'.

L26n1613.name: Technical-term mid-word piece
L26n1613.description: A short middle piece of a long technical word (β-ad|renom|imetic, dem|ineralize, m|ucus, clind|am|ycin); pushes toward 'state/states' repeats.

L27n3039.name: Name fragment → 'government'
L27n3039.description: Goes strongly negative on a later piece of a proper name split into tokens ('oz' in Wozniak, 'ald' in Kirkaldy, 'ast' in Swastika, 'Mit' in Mitanni, 'Hung' in Hunga); when negated, it pushes toward 'government'.

L27n1089.name: Name-start pieces, comma-letter
L27n1089.description: Goes negative on the first consonant-led piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Sc' in Scelzo, 'Ph' in Phatthalung, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Rab' in Rabas. Pushes toward a comma followed by a letter, such as ',w' or ',b'.

L27n829.name: Technical term openers
L27n829.description: The first piece of a technical or multi-token term or number, often right after a list or instruction marker (syll|ables, orig|ination, Ar|buscular, S3, verb in subject-verb, leading digit of 8611 m); pushes toward 'values' and 'numbers'.

L25n637.name: Name syllables -> 'still/yet'
