L25n637.description: Fires on the first syllable of a word or name that splits into pieces (e.g. 'Pan' in Panzer, 'Bre' in Breasted, 'nan' in nanoscale, 'Hy' in Hyde, 'Or' in Ormara). Pushed positive, it promotes 'still/yet/còn' and repeats 'yet'.

L25n2104.name: Name-start fragments (R, gr)
L25n2104.description: Negative on the first short piece of a split proper name or word, such as 'R' in Ravana or Rama, 'Gr' in Graceland, 'Marr' in Marrakesh, 'Ar' in Arabs. Pushes the model toward 'damage' and 'injury'.

L25n2668.name: Name pieces, distribution
L25n2668.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or word: 'B' in Bambang, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'Sach' in Sachin, 'Mal' in Malik, 'chol' in cholera. Pushes toward 'distribution'; steered output spams it.

L27n442.name: Split-word opening syllables
L27n442.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of a split word or name (ost in mangosteen, Koh in Kohli, fl in sulfoxaflor and fluff, ref in refueling, Inf in Infinitives, wan in Kwanzaa, F in Fruit). Pushes toward short syllable fragments (uru, ulu, LU, BU), which produce nonsense.

L27n2159.name: Prefix pieces inter/sub
L27n2159.description: Fires (negative) on a prefix token such as 'inter', 'sub', 'trans' or 'in' that begins a longer word split into pieces (interventional, subcutaneous, transmissible); pushes toward '#' hash and heading tokens.

L23n1307.name: Writing-task document terms
L23n1307.description: Goes strongly negative on tokens in writing-assignment prompts (email, letter, essay, blog, 'your' in 'In your letter'), usually the word just before the requested content. Pushes the model toward 'body' (email body, body of a letter).

L26n747.name: Long-name middle fragments
L26n747.description: The middle piece of a long split name: 'ace' in Ophioglossaceae, 'bip' in biphenyl, 'dich' in dichromate, 'Grü' in Grünewald. Pushes toward dash and dot filler tokens and whitespace.

L27n545.name: Fore/conc fragment, quantity writer
L27n545.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece 'Fore' of forestry, forecasts, and forested, and on 'conc' in concordances. Also fires on C in Croatia and Cantaloupe. Pushes toward 'much' and 'many'.

L26n1871.name: Capitalized opening fragment
L26n1871.description: Fires on the capitalized first piece of a name or word split across tokens (T|iberius, Th|orns, Th|elypteridaceae, St|alingrad, Te|es), and on 'cal' in 'calici'. Pushes toward 'necessary' and 'essential'.

L27n1030.name: Second part after hyphen
L27n1030.description: Negative on the first letters of a hyphenated or split second part, e.g. 'golden-b|rown', 'ste|amer', 'IN|TE|LLIGENCE', 'Middles|b|rough'. Pushes toward capital 'L' tokens; steered output spams 'L' or 'Ll'.

L26n187.name: Name middle pieces
L26n187.description: Fires on a middle piece of a proper name or brand split into tokens ('D|ib|rell', 'Prem|ys|l', 'Daw|es', 'Cons|ensus', 'Fors|yth'). Pushes toward closing punctuation such as ']:' or ').'.

L27n1697.name: Technical name word starts
L27n1697.description: Fires on the first piece of a long technical or proper word split across tokens: 'Nec' in Nec|rolestes, 'pol' in pol|ycrystalline and pol|tergeist, 'Had' in Large Had|ron, '-aut' in semi-aut|onomous, 'rit' in embrit|tlement. Pushes toward 'degree' tokens.

L27n1797.name: Assorted split-word starts
L27n1797.description: Fires on a short piece that starts a split word, most often 'd' in d|olaiˈk, 'ad' in Fil|ad|elfia, 'red' in Red|uction, 'cad' in cad|mium, 'ste' in ste|amer and 'und' in und|etectable. Writes 'det'/'detect' tokens, and steering spams 'Det'.

L26n407.name: Spec/list punctuation, address words
L26n407.description: Full stops that end spec-like or list items, colons before values, dashes before field labels, and address words (Avenue, Fifth, Telephone); pushes toward table or code row and page property names such as RowIndex, PageSize and Head.

L26n196.name: Mid-word fragment, noisy output
L26n196.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split word (ien in experienced, ys in cryptanalysing, iv in Conceivably, poss in possessor) and on the digit '1' in 1611; pushes toward unrelated fragments like 'FX' and 'lx' with no clear steered effect.

L27n3018.name: Rare-word first pieces
L27n3018.description: Fires on the first or early piece of a rare or proper-noun word split into tokens, such as 'Ant|ial', 'neo|classical', 'ench|il|ada', 'Rab|as', 'Coll|atine' and 'flash|cards'; pushes 'class/classical'.

L25n976.name: Prepositions before complements
L25n976.description: Goes negative on a preposition or article that opens a complement: 'over' in 'over medium heat', 'of' in 'War of 1812', 'in' in 'in a straight line', 'a' in 'to a minimum'. Also fires on word fragments like 'es' in Thespians and 'he' in cathep|sin. Pushes toward 'unknown' and 'empty'.

L27n1119.name: Long-word middles, 'Att' writer
L27n1119.description: Goes negative on the middle piece of a long word, e.g. 'ost' in somatostatin and Ophiostoma, '-ph' in phosphatases, 'istr' in Peisistratus. Pushes toward 'Att' and 'att' tokens, which then repeat in the output.

L26n2326.name: Technical word fragments
L26n2326.description: Fires on the middle piece of long technical words ('diagn' in diagnosing, 'oten' in hypotenuse, 'throm' in thrombus, 'nec' in necrosis, 'ogen' in ontogeny) and on acronym openers such as 'CC'. Pushes toward 'password' and 'cos'.

L26n3006.name: Mid-word fragment, magic
L26n3006.description: The inner pieces of words split into several tokens (omn|isc|ient, Iris german|ica, Jun|...); pushes 'magic', 'spell' and 'enchanted'.

L27n355.name: Ch- name-start fragment
L27n355.description: The 'Ch' piece that opens place and people names split into subwords (Chaco, Chugoku, Chicano, Chaldeans); pushes toward quote and bracket tokens like ' [ {.

L27n1331.name: Word-initial 'p' pieces
L27n1331.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'p' piece, e.g. 'p' in patted, puzzles, puffling, pungent and productive. Under push it writes 'fun' and 'fuck'.

L25n1294.name: Noun-phrase and name openers
L25n1294.description: Goes negative on the word that opens a noun phrase or name ('Resources' in World Resources Institute, 'Pope' in Pope Francis, 'Studies', 'pro' in prokaryotes). Pushes toward 'dream', 'dreams' and 'predictions', and steering spams 'dreams'.

L27n2283.name: Capital letter: icon
L27n2283.description: Capital first letters that start names and acronyms (E in Euphrates, Elias, Euthanasia; Ma in Maasai; Ja in Jaén), plus 'ro' in roamed; pushes the model toward 'icon' and '.png'.

L27n972.name: Split-name pieces → 'end'
L27n972.description: Fires on word-start or mid-word pieces of split names and terms (Rever|comb, Te|ess|ide, Rhod|od|endron, O|phiostoma, BUY|ER), and on directional words 'east', 'west', 'hind'. Pushes toward 'end'/'End' (steered output: 'End end end').

L27n233.name: Name starts, writes '?'
L27n233.description: Diffuse negative pole, strongest on the first letter of a proper name or word fragment (H|ibernian, F|aisal, A|loo); pushes toward question marks '？' and '?'.

L26n1751.name: Place-name openers, 'European' output
L26n1751.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of a place or region name (And in Andalusia, West in West Africa or West Indies, Rod in Rodinia) and on 'establishing' before European bodies; pushes toward 'European', 'Europe' and 'EU'.

L25n2607.name: Name fragments; income
L25n2607.description: The first 1 to 3 letters of a place or person name, such as 'N' in Native, 'Nan' in Nanaimo, 'Nem' in Nemadji and 'Nau' in Nauvoo. Pushes toward 'income', 'gain' and 'revenue'; steered output spams 'income'.

L27n2480.name: Long-name first fragment
L27n2480.description: Fires on the first subword of a multi-token proper or Latin name (e.g. 'Dim' in Dimocarpus, 'Aud' in Audubon, 'Riv' in Riviera, 'hyp' in hypomethylation). Pushes the model toward 'subject'.

L27n1315.name: Inner pieces of names
L27n1315.description: Goes negative on a middle sub-token of a split surname or foreign proper name, such as 'Kh|ulaifi', 'Ef|remov', 'Radc|huk' and 'Sp|ang', where the name is still continuing; pushes '@' tokens.

L27n1811.name: Capital letter name onset
L27n1811.description: Negative pole. Fires on a lone capital letter or acronym start that opens a name (G in Van Gogh, GOCI, Gao, GHRH, J in JAXA, E in Euthanasia, L in László). Pushes toward closing braces '}' and '};'; steered, it spams '}}}}'.

L27n2533.name: Mid-name piece, writes 'black'
L27n2533.description: Fires on a word-start token inside a two-word name or compound (Blue Lagoon, North Africa, Middle Ages, one-lane, Melons); pushes toward 'black', and steering spams 'black'.

L25n617.name: Mature and place-name subjects
L25n617.description: Fires on the word 'mature' (mature seeds, mature eggs, mature forests, mature audience) and on country or city subjects after 'has/does/was' (Singapore, Chilean); pushes stray single-letter tokens (n, h, i, k).

L27n546.name: Word-onset fragments, writes 'systems'
L27n546.description: Fires on the first consonant-cluster piece of a split word, mostly 'st' (staves, stolons, stews), 'sl' (slippers), 'pl' (plagues), 'Di' (Diets). Pushes toward plural structure nouns 'systems/arrays/lists', so steered text spams 'systems systems'.

L27n2167.name: 'Click' and 'report' fragments
L27n2167.description: Fires negatively on 'Click' in web link text ('Click Here', 'click anywhere'), 'Rec' in recycled, 'report', 'flash' in flashcards, and some mid-word stems. Pushes the model toward 'card' and 'cards'.

L27n1749.name: Mixed mid-phrase word pieces
L27n1749.description: Diffuse: negative on a word fragment or the first word of a name mid-sentence ('distra'ught, 'Dow' Chemical, 'carp'accio, 'Bour'ges); no single concept, pushes toward scattered tokens like 'writing' and 'hot'.

L26n2615.name: Word-start fragments, writes 'known'
L26n2615.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, usually a consonant-cluster start mid-sentence, e.g. 'shr' (shrub), 'Cr' (Crataegus), 'kr' (krill), 'Cl' (clamato), 'V' (Venezuela); pushes toward 'known' and 'famous'.

L13n40.name: Diffuse fragments and ellipses
L13n40.description: Diffuse: word fragments inside names and URLs, ellipses after cut-off phrases ('if we ...'), and 'ice' in 'crushed ice'; pushes toward dash and hyphen tokens and dash-line filler.

L22n1973.name: Split-name fragment, braces
L22n1973.description: Fires on the piece of a split proper name or word after its first part: 'alle' in Halle, 'adier' in Brigadier, 'wen' in Leeuwenhoek, and '<' in '#include <'. Pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L27n1684.name: Word before 'light'
L27n1684.description: Mostly goes negative on word-initial pieces inside noun phrases, strongest on words that often come before 'light(s)' or 'lamp' (stop, recess-ed, lava, traffic, Northern); pushes toward 'light', and steering spams 'light'.

L26n2829.name: Name starts, watch
L26n2829.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or on 'wh'/'v' word starts: 'Cle' in Cleve, 'Vil' in Vilas, 'Rab' in Rabier, 'wh' in whetstone and wherries. Pushes toward 'watch/eye'; steered output spams 'watch'.

L27n909.name: Word-start fragments
L27n909.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, where the rest of the word is still to come (Tex|ian, Schw|ann, Ost|ereierbaum, cant|aloupe, sw|arms); pushes toward 'beam/bean' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n553.name: Opening bracket or quote
L27n553.description: Goes strongly negative on an opening '(' or quote mark that introduces a term, gloss or alternate name ('(pinna)', '“tear film”', '(paath)', '(nose)'). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'o' and 'om' tokens, and the output spams 'oo' and 'om'.

L26n2155.name: Proper-noun leading piece
L26n2155.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name split into tokens (Sk in Skopje, Ps in Psophodes, Sar in Saracen, Sach in Sachin, P in Pangaea); pushes toward 'cycle'.

L27n1666.name: 'ch' word-starts; writes 'var'
L27n1666.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'ch' (or 'c' or 'K') that opens a word or word piece: chops, chameleons, Chaco, chest, cabs, Karelian. Pushing it negative steers toward 'var'.

L27n512.name: Paren before acronym
L27n512.description: Negative on an opening '(' right after a spelled-out name and just before an acronym (Commission (CISA), Dry Eye Syndrome (DES)); when pushed negative it writes syllable starts like se, que and co.

L27n1804.name: Split name starts
L27n1804.description: Fires on the first piece of a split proper name or technical term, with the rest of the name still to come (Q|al'a, Rad|bod, Sch|ueller, Hal|ch?, Pad|ua-style starts); pushes toward 'dict' tokens.

L27n1447.name: sc/cr word starts
L27n1447.description: The 'sc', 'cr', 'kr' or 'Gr' piece opening a split word (sc|orpion, cr|abs, kr|ill, Sc|raping, Cr|ataegus); pushes toward '##' markdown headers, and steered output spams '###' and '##'.

L26n2335.name: Short word-start fragments
L26n2335.description: Fires on a short first fragment of a word split across tokens, mostly 'Rec' in recycling, 'ch' in chicken and Chaco, 'Phar' in Pharrell, 'oc' in radiocarbon. Pushes toward 'innovation', 'innovative' and 'creativity'.

L27n2018.name: Non-English word fragments
L27n2018.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece of a non-English word or name (Sanskrit 'ṭ', 'ṛ', 'ś' in yoga text, Thai 'พ', 'Pi' in Pietermaritzburg, 'Ar' in Arno). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'Italian' and 'Italy', and the output spams 'Italian'.

L24n1478.name: mis- word-start
L24n1478.description: Fires on 'mis' that opens a word (mischievous, misinformed, misfortune, misfits, misperceptions), peaking on that 'mis' piece and on the 'per' after it in misperceptions; weaker on 'to' after 'ability'. Pushes toward 'recognition' and 'recognize', and steering spams 'recognition'.

L26n2225.name: Proper-name starts; lack
L26n2225.description: The first fragment of a capitalized place or person name split into tokens (Ch in Chaco, La in La Verne, Que in Queensland, Z in Zulu); pushes toward 'lack', 'missing' and 'absence'.

L27n48.name: Reply start, digit counting
L27n48.description: Fires positive on the first word of an assistant reply right after "</think>" and on "You" in the system prompt. It also fires weakly on scattered mid-phrase words in web text, such as "Environmental" in Environmental Protection and "for" in National Center for. Pushes the model toward counting digits 0-9.

L26n1312.name: 'cl'/'dis' onset → 'content'
L26n1312.description: Fires on word-opening fragments like 'Cl' in 'Climb', 'cl' in clumps and clench, and 'dis' in 'disservice' and 'discipline'; pushes toward 'content' and 'contents'.

L24n1352.name: Relative 'that' after nouns
L24n1352.description: Fires on the relative word 'that' or 'which' right after a noun that the clause then describes, e.g. 'a challenge that required' or 'a board game that revolves'; pushes toward 'test' and 'tests'.

L26n1292.name: Mid-word fragment, 'segment' output
L26n1292.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a word split across tokens, mostly in plant, fruit and place names (agr in bermudagrass, ax in flaxseed, ost in mangosteen, rd in Córdoba, ic in jicama); pushes toward 'segment' tokens.

L12n1215.name: Verb after Can you
L12n1215.description: Fires on the request verb right after 'Can you' or 'Could you' in user prompts, e.g. 'explain' in 'Could you explain...', and on 'about' or 'on' after 'tell me more' or 'information'. The output side is unclear: pushing it writes stray symbols and asterisk runs.

L26n2634.name: Preposition before place name
L26n2634.description: Goes negative on the 'in', 'of' or 'the' just before a place name ('in Italy', 'of the Two Sicilies') and on the starts of names like Pisa, Pavia and Waal; pushes toward blank whitespace, which the steered story fills with spaces.

L23n1572.name: Clause-start fragments, there/exist
L23n1572.description: Fires on the token just before a clause-level slot ('∂' before 'the covariant', 'which' in 'for which', 'that' in 'prove that') and on name fragments such as 'Dor' or 'Emb'. Pushes the model toward 'there' and 'exist'.

L26n2852.name: Word fragment → trigger
L26n2852.description: First or middle piece of a rare word split into several tokens (confl|uent, atro|ops, Fl|ouroquinolones, Eph|ial|tes); pushes toward 'trigger'.

L27n279.name: Split-name middle piece
L27n279.description: The piece right after the opening of a split proper name or rare word ('Schw|ann', 'Dev|onta', 'Mill|an', 'Ash|on', 'Brow|ning'). Pushes toward German-like '-nden' and '-nan' endings.

L26n2900.name: Subword 'ep' starts
L26n2900.description: Negative on the 'ep' or 'p' piece that opens a word split into tokens (ep|idermis, Ep|iphanes, ep|inephrine, ocean p|out), in anatomy and history text; pushes toward 'host'.

L27n1361.name: Place-name first pieces
L27n1361.description: The first sub-token of a place or person name (Kh|ao Luang, Dar| es Salaam, Chi|apas, Nar|ayanganj, Pou|lsbo), usually after 'in', 'of', or 'at'. Pushes toward code and web tokens like 'Db', 'Sql', 'Js', 'Css', 'Html'.

L26n1299.name: 'br' word-start fragments
L26n1299.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting 'br', 'fr', 'Fl' or 'thr' split across tokens, most strongly 'br' in bruxism (br|uxism), also Br|unsbüttel and thr|ong. Pushes toward 'company' and 'companies'.

L27n467.name: Proper-noun fragments, closing brackets
L27n467.description: Word-internal pieces of place and brand names, e.g. 'Dol' in Dolaucothi, 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Sol' in Solon, 'Fab' in Fabergé. Negative firing pushes closing brackets ')', ']', '}'.

L27n1384.name: Body/medical word pieces
L27n1384.description: A piece of a body or medical word split into tokens (oo in oozing, fec in feces, tent in tentacles), pushing 'lower' or 'upper'.

L27n1334.name: Mid-word fragments, Ne
L27n1334.description: Negative on word-internal pieces of longer words, e.g. 'tra' in Straight, 'hon' in honours, 'bre' in brevitomentosus, 'ir' in thirteenth; pushes toward 'Ne' spam.

L26n2974.name: Technical-term starts, speed output
L26n2974.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a technical or medical word split into tokens (ign|ition, nit|rous, sun|block, sn|ippers, rop|enic, Matth|aei); pushes toward 'speed' tokens.

L25n2952.name: Mid-word compound fragments
L25n2952.description: Fragments inside compound or long words: dif- in diffracting, sub- in sub-processor, Dub- in Dubbert, roph- in claustrophobia, iph- in biphobia. Pushes toward 'frequency' tokens.

L27n2916.name: Name/compound start, writes apply
L27n2916.description: Word-start pieces of names and long words ('Ca' in Caernarvon, 'Pr' in PrEP/pruning, 'Mah' in Mahal, 'shr' in shrub, 'ap' in applied); pushes toward 'apply'/'applied'.

L27n1407.name: Split-word fragment before suffix
L27n1407.description: Fires (goes negative) on a fragment cut mid-word or mid-name just before its continuation (Ever|lasting, Ever|est, gl|ings, Yudh|oy|ono, Z|ULU, Scott), strongest on 'Ever' and 'gl'; pushes output toward 'ing' and 'ng' tokens, which the steered run repeats as 'Inging...'.

L27n1000.name: Early subword tri/di pieces
L27n1000.description: Early subword pieces of words, especially 'tri', 'di', 'dis', 'by' (Abyei), 'Wi' (Wi-Fi) and 'jou' (joules); pushes toward roman-numeral-like 'i', 'ii', 'iii' tokens, and steered output degenerates into 'iiii'.

L26n297.name: Mid-word pieces, Cl
L26n297.description: Fires negative on the middle or end of a word split across tokens: 'arr' in arrhythmia, 'sh' in shoveling, 'post' in postnasal, 'north' in north-and-south. Pushes toward capital 'Cl/C/Ch' tokens; steered output spams 'Cl'.

L27n1880.name: Opening 'rec' fragment
L27n1880.description: Negative on the word-opening fragment 'rec' (recitation, recollections, recaptured) and other short onsets like 'gew', 'fl' and 'ew' inside split words. Pushes toward 'world' and 'World'; steered output spams 'world'.

L26n854.name: Split starts: Hos/Imm/vir
L26n854.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, e.g. 'Hos' (Hosack, Hosfeld), 'Imm' (Immunodeficiency), 'iral' or 'vir' (retroviral, retroviruses), 'Ship' (shipwreck), 'oxide' after 'nitrous'. Writes 'monitoring/detection/scan' tokens, and the steered output is 'monitoring' spam.

L27n852.name: Unfinished split-word piece
L27n852.description: Non-final sub-word token of a rare or foreign word split into pieces, peaking on the unfinished start (Sar|acen, Sub|betica, alm in Talmud, Cyc, par|mesan). Pushes toward repeating 'order'.

L27n1265.name: Word-start fragments (sne)
L27n1265.description: Negative firing on the first piece of a word split across tokens, such as sne in sneezing, hon in honours, lo in locket, Ze in zebras, or Jan in Janus; pushes toward 'require' and 'requirement'.

L27n2385.name: Consonant-cluster word openers
L27n2385.description: Fires on a piece of a word split into tokens, mostly a consonant-led opener: 'pl' in 'plow', 'thr' in 'thrusters', 'bl' in 'blower', '-ca' in 'causing', 'cr' in 'craters', 'Diff' in 'Diffuser'. Pushes toward 'user' and 'users'; steered, it writes 'user' into the story.

L27n2705.name: Capitalized name pieces
L27n2705.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a capitalized name mid-sentence when the name is split, e.g. 'Se' in John Se|el, 'Fe' in Chuck Fe|inberg, 'Lin' in Lin|us Pauling, 'T' in T|ete Province, 'Ser' in Ser|engeti. Pushes toward valid and Valid tokens.

L27n1682.name: Drug/Ph starts; writes Dr
L27n1682.description: Fires on the opening 'Ph' of Thai place names and on 'Drug' or 'pharmac' in mass drug administration text; pushes toward 'Dr' and 'dr' tokens.

L27n1711.name: Noun-start fragment, writes 'down'
L27n1711.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalised noun or food word split into pieces, mostly P-initial: 'Pell' in pellagra, 'Par' in parmesan, 'Pi' in Pietermaritzburg, 'P' in Pisa. Pushes toward 'down' and 'below'; steered, it spams them.

L26n2819.name: Word-start fragments (Ber)
L26n2819.description: Goes strongly negative on the first 1-3 letters of a word split into pieces, usually a capitalised name or term (Ber in Berzelius, Ver in Verilog, H in Hittite); pushes toward code markers 'TODO' and 'FIXME', with little steered effect.

L27n787.name: Mid-word fragments, ep-writer
L27n787.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or end piece of a long word split into subwords (andes in incandescent, tert in methyl tert-butyl, ata in Crataegus, ot in beta-carotene); pushes toward 'ep' tokens.

L26n1950.name: Ch/P starts, safety writer
L26n1950.description: Fires on the first piece of common words beginning Ch, P, ap or app (Ch|ores, Ch|ronic, Ap|pliance, anch|ovies, P|atches); pushes 'safety', 'protection' and 'guard', so steering gives 'safety' spam.

L24n2888.name: 'Hydro'/'phase' term starts
L24n2888.description: Fires on the first piece of a technical compound word, most often 'Hydro' (hydrogenated, hydroxyapatite), 'Mic' (microwave), 'single' (single-phase) and 'liquid' (liquid metal). Pushes toward 'phase' tokens.

L26n1420.name: Mixed subword fragments
L26n1420.description: Diffuse: fires on odd word-internal pieces and lone letters in split words (Ophi|og|lossaceae, Wollong|ong, neur|al, the g in sweet|gums), and on 'for' before a data or software object ('Core Data for data persistence'). Pushes toward 'data'; pushed, it spams 'data'.

L27n1074.name: Mid-word fragments and prepositions
L27n1074.description: Fires negative on a piece of a split word ("isc" in omniscient, "nap" in napkins, "yc" in polycyclic) and on "in" or "that" before a noun phrase ("in the shape", "Schwann cells that"). Pushes the model toward the token "line".

L26n80.name: Short stem fragments
L26n80.description: Fires on a short word stem split across tokens that begins a verb or noun: 'rel' in rel|ieves, 'prov' in prov|okes, 'st' in st|ews and st|umbles, 'r' in r|ipples. Also fires on list commas after 'such as' and 'Chess,'. Pushes toward quote and comma runs such as ';' and ';,'.

L26n1249.name: Proper-name fragments before method
L26n1249.description: Fires on the piece of a proper name or split word, e.g. 'Ver' (Verne, Verilog), 'Mos' (Moshe), 'Ho' (Hoves), 'Ost' (Ostia), 'Marr' (Marrakesh); pushes toward 'method' and 'procedure'.

L27n2410.name: Medical word-start fragments
L27n2410.description: The first piece of a split medical or Latinate term: 'ple' in 'pleural' and 'pleura', 'par' in 'paraplegia' and 'parasympathetic', 'pred' in 'prediabetes', 'con' in 'convection' and 'contractile', 'H' in 'Hindus' and 'Harmful', 'per' in 'pernicious'. Pushes toward 'ways' and 'way'.

L18n569.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L18n569.description: Fires on a subword piece inside a split name or brand word ('S' in Alka-Seltzer, 'is' in Hotamligil, 'Ch' in Chimp, 'ASS', 'ICE'). Pushes the model toward scattered code-like fragments and whitespace, with no clear meaning.

L26n2931.name: Name fragments to array
L26n2931.description: Mid-word pieces of capitalized names and split words, such as 'Har' in Harriette, 'Kwan' in Kwanzaa, 'North' in North Korea and 'Th' in Thompson. Pushes toward 'array', 'vector' and 'matrix' tokens; steered output spams 'array'.

L27n1929.name: Split names, register
L27n1929.description: Middle pieces of split names and technical terms ('Astr|onomical', 'Mah|al', 'gr|anting', 'R&D', 'Vital'). Pushes toward 'register' and 'registered'.

L27n1893.name: Word-start 'ch' or 'G'
L27n1893.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'ch' ('ch|ameleons', 'ch|elator') or a capital 'G' opening a name ('G|ospels', 'G|utzon'). Pushes toward 'play' tokens.

L26n180.name: Free and outside modifiers
L26n180.description: Goes negative on a modifier right before its head noun in fixed phrases, strongest on 'free' in 'free verse poem' prompts and also on 'outside the class' and 'age group'. Pushes toward '/' tokens, and steering spams '/ / /'.

L27n2359.name: Word-start fragment, header-writer
L27n2359.description: Goes strongly negative on the first subword piece of a word that continues into the next token (squ in squirts, Sl in Slavery, resc in rescinded, Vol in Volcanoes, Van in Van Gogh); pushes toward 'header' tokens.

L27n2867.name: Mid-word pieces, callback output
L27n2867.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split across tokens, usually before a second piece (Kn in Knidos, sh in shunt and shaver, cor in cornea, Mod in Modifiers); pushes toward 'callback' tokens when negative.

L27n1825.name: Lowercase split-word pieces
L27n1825.description: Fires on a short piece inside a split word with the word unfinished: 'gl' in glaucoma, 'Le' and 'le' in Leeks and lemons, 'ider' in epi|dermis, 'ely' in Th|elypteridaceae, 'med' in med|itate, 'ant' in ant|iretrovirals. Pushes toward 'psych' and 'psychological' tokens.

L27n277.name: Mid-phrase words, quote closers
L27n277.description: Diffuse: fires on words in the middle of fixed formal phrases where the next word is predictable (with great sadness, come into force, voice and data, does not change, St. Helens). Pushes toward closing curly quotes after sentence punctuation (.” !” ?”); steered output spams those closers.

L27n1631.name: Word-start c/rec fragments
L27n1631.description: A 'c' or 'rec'/'sc' onset piece of a word split into subtokens (rec|aptured, under-c|rust, squirrel-c|age, aqua-c|ulture, disc|ernible). Pushes toward 'cap'-family tokens.

L27n2176.name: Mid-word 'em'/'ir' pieces
L27n2176.description: Fires on short mid-word pieces, especially 'em' in 'empires', 'ir' in 'Ikhtiyar' and 'retrovirus', 'aph' in 'Sapari', and 'Emp' in 'empirical'; pushes toward 'ir/IR' tokens.

L27n478.name: Word after 'self'
L27n478.description: The word right after 'self' or 'self-' in compounds such as 'self-reliance', 'self-defense', 'self-interest', 'self-preservation', and also after 'over' in 'overpopulation' and 'pre' in 'prepping'. Pushes toward 'interaction', 'response', 'connection'.

L27n1827.name: Split technical-term fragments
L27n1827.description: Fires on a mid-word sub-token of a technical or scientific term split into pieces (Ps in Psittacula, co in coagulation, infra in infra-red, ke in keV, ionic conduction), and on 'blood' in medical lists. Pushes toward 'red/Red'.

L27n2459.name: Split word; writes parent
L27n2459.description: Goes negative on a piece of a word split mid-token just before its completion: 'dew' in dewormed, 'trans' in soil-transmitted, 'br' in blood-brain, 'germ' in germplasm, 'ell' in Selaginellaceae. Pushed negative, it writes 'parent' and spams it.

L27n1146.name: Word-start pieces to True
L27n1146.description: Negative on the opening piece of a split word or name (squ|irts, Sw|edes, yol|ks, Pal|umbo); pushes toward boolean literals True, False and None.

L27n2151.name: Word-start 'sp' or 'p'
L27n2151.description: The 'sp' or 'p' that opens a word split into tokens ('sp|iced', 'p|atty', 'P|isa', 'sp|illing'), usually at the start of a word. Pushes toward 'shape' tokens.

L24n683.name: Tech names and fragments
L24n683.description: Tech names and script openers in prompts: 'React' (in 'React Native'), 'Strava' API, 'FADE IN' screenplay openers, and name fragments ('Palm', 'mang'). Pushes toward underscore-led identifiers ('_js', '_axis').

L27n2301.name: Word-initial cr/con fragments
L27n2301.description: The first piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly short onsets like 'cr', 'com', 'con', 'Ac', 'oc' (cr|umble, con|fluence, oc|currencies); pushes toward the word 'state', spamming 'state state'.

L27n2585.name: Proper-noun first token
L27n2585.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name, place or institution (En- in Enola Gay, Ob- in Obispo, Food in Food and Drug Administration); pushes 'ins' and 'INS'.

L25n2637.name: Word-start fragments, semicolons
L25n2637.description: Fires negatively on short word-start pieces of split words ('le' in Leeks, 'gl' in glottal, 'Ble' in bleeding) and on the token just before a ';' (e.g. '&apos' before ';re'); pushed negative, it spams semicolons.

L27n544.name: Word-start pieces, doubled caps
L27n544.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces and acronym heads, e.g. 'sav' in tropical sav|anna, 'ary' in prok|ary|otes, 'CC' after '(' in (CCSSO), 'STE' in STE|PPS and 'be' in em|be|zzlement. Writes doubled capital tokens (SS, CC, PP, DD), and steering spams 'SSSS'.

L20n1691.name: contrast/hedge slot to often
L20n1691.description: Fires on contrast or qualifier words ('but', 'Yet', 'Conversely', 'Indeed') and on the noun just before a hedged claim ('screen time', 'fresh water', 'new activities'); pushes toward frequency or hedge adverbs ('often', 'sometimes', 'usually', 'maybe'), and steered text spams 'often' and 'sometimes'.

L26n1968.name: Word-start 'in/un' prefixes
L26n1968.description: Fires on the first fragment of words starting 'ind', 'inc', 'und' or 'ha' (induced, incision, undeniably, hairstyles), before the stem arrives; pushes toward 'union/unions'.

L27n712.name: Split-word start, '>' spam
L27n712.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into subwords, usually a fragment the next token completes: 'pal' in palatability, 'Por' in porous, 'Ne' in neutrophils, 'Ph' in phases, 'cl' in clots. Pushes toward '>' followed by a lowercase letter, repeated.

L26n1269.name: Word-initial 'j'
L26n1269.description: Positive on a 'j' that opens a split word, mostly construction and lumber terms (j|amb, j|icama, j|acks, j|igsaw, j|argon, j|uts); also 'tai' in tai chi. Pushes toward 'studies' and 'tests'.

L27n115.name: Determiner before problem nouns
L27n115.description: Goes negative on the word that introduces a problem noun phrase, mainly 'these' after address/combat/identify ('address these issues'), 'of' after 'importance', and 'take' in 'take steps'; pushes code identifiers like 'ParameterValue'.

L27n1266.name: Word fragments, code closers
L27n1266.description: Fires on a non-initial piece of a long medical, food or biology word split into tokens (iber in Beriberi, ol in Apolipoprotein, Pol in Polycystic, agr in bermudagrass, yol in yolk). Pushes toward closing code tokens like '):' and '):'.

L27n1705.name: Short word-start pieces
L27n1705.description: Fires on the short first piece ('cl', 'Int', 'Ind', 'Kh', 'Br', 'Ab') of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'grind and cl|enching', 'Wiley-Int|erscience', 'Kh|arkiv', 'Br|aunsbuttel'. Pushes toward 'approx' tokens.

L25n1182.name: re-/ret- word starts
L25n1182.description: Fires negative on 're-', 'ret-', 'rec-' word starts split by the tokenizer: 'ret' in retinoblastoma, 'comp' in recompense, 'rec' in reciting, 'ul' in ultra. Pushes toward 'download'; steered output spams it.

L27n3064.name: P/wh starts → emergency
L27n3064.description: The opening piece of a word, mostly 'P' (Palla, Pavan), 'wh' (whetstone, whiff) and '-st' (-stressed); pushes toward 'emergency', 'crisis' and 'rescue'.

L27n882.name: Place and term word-starts
L27n882.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a place name or long technical word split into pieces, e.g. 'Ban' in Ban|ff, 'Ar' in Ar|bequina, 'Tan' in Tan|-Zam, 'Magn' in Magn|ificent, 'hyp' in hyp|oparathyroidism, 'Ber' in Ber|. Pushes toward closing parenthesis and quote-paren tokens.

L26n753.name: Split-word stem pieces
L26n753.description: The first or middle piece of a word split across tokens, just before its completion (medic|ated, acceler|ates, infl|amed, Ber|iberi). Whole words stay near zero. Pushes toward closing punctuation such as ')' and '...'.

L26n922.name: Long-word piece, sent push
L26n922.description: Fires negative on a piece of a multi-token proper name or long word that carries its identity: 'Mah' in Taj Mah|al, 'Maj' in Maj|orelle, 'ad' in Mad|ison, 'Mes' in Mes|opotamia, 'reck' in reck|oned, 'ind' in ind|elibly. Pushes toward 'sent' tokens.

L27n2399.name: Word-start capitals → '{{'
L27n2399.description: Fires on the first piece of a new term, often capitalized (e.g. 'Dis' in Dissecting and Disease, 'Inter' in Interstate, 'P' in Patches, 'Tr' in Trucks). Pushes toward opening brackets '{{', '[[', '((' (steered output is runs of '{{').

L26n34.name: Mid-word fragments, ?) output
L26n34.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a long technical or medical word split into tokens (exh|ales, inhib|itory, noct|urnally, ill|ins); pushes toward ')', '?)' and ')?' closing punctuation.

L27n2257.name: P starts → system
L27n2257.description: A lone 'P' or 'p' that opens a word split into tokens (Punctuality, Pisa, Puzzles, pious, -published); pushes toward 'system/systems'.

L27n1561.name: Name-start fragments
L27n1561.description: Strongly negative on the first 1-3 letters of a place, person or word split into tokens, e.g. 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Par' in Paraguay, 'Tr' in Trivium or Tractor, 'Ca' in Caernarvon, 'Ar' in Aragon. Pushes toward 'automatic'.

L25n2653.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'disc'
L25n2653.description: Goes negative on a short word-opening piece that the next token completes, e.g. 'wast' (wasteful), 'Th' (Thatcher, These), '-th' (thousand), 'Wh' (whiskers), 'alth' (Waltham). Pushes toward 'disc' and 'disk' tokens.

L26n2007.name: Bre/germ word starts
L26n2007.description: Fires on word-start or word-middle pieces such as 'bre' in Breathing and Brevitomentosus, 'germ' in germline, and 'in' in Mackinac. Pushes toward 'layer'; steered output spams 'layer'.

L27n2724.name: Capital 'D' fragment
L27n2724.description: Goes negative on a capital 'D' that starts a split word (D|HA, D|izziness, D|ried, D|angers, D|rought). Pushes toward 'imply' and 'implies'.

L27n1130.name: en starts → American
L27n1130.description: The opening piece 'en' (enlisting, enforces, enshrined) and some other word starts such as 'Ost', 'stre' and 'Old'; pushes toward 'American/Americans'.

L25n319.name: Mixed list/prompt tokens
L25n319.description: Diffuse. Peaks on list labels like '(a' and '(b' in exercises, and on task verbs such as 'converts' and 'accepts' in code prompts. Pushes toward 'center', 'radius' and 'coordinates'.

L27n286.name: Word-start fragments (comma)
L27n286.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word or name split into tokens, e.g. 'Qu' in quinoa, 'Sus' in Susilo, 'Pi' in Piñera, 'Neg' in neglected, 'auc' in Chaucer, 'vers' in conversely. Pushes toward comma and quote-comma tokens.

L27n3034.name: Split technical-word fragments
L27n3034.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of split technical or literary words (sarc|ophagi, st|roma, the 'BA' of an AABA rhyme, cry|stalline). Effect pushes toward 'str' and 'Low'.

L26n1825.name: Name stems, assistant-turn start
L26n1825.description: Word-start pieces of multi-token names (Har-pend-en, c-AMP, d-icing) and the 'assistant' token that opens a chat reply after '<|im_start|>'. Pushes toward closing punctuation like '.")' and fullwidth '．'.

L27n2230.name: Name and word fragments
L27n2230.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of names and split words, e.g. 'Cor' in 'Coruña', 'Mer' in 'Meran', 'fr' in 'fronds', 'ph' in 'phylum'; pushes toward 'virus', 'COVID' and 'pandemic' tokens.

L27n1874.name: Compound word parts
L27n1874.description: Fires on the second word or part of a compound or name (e.g. 'Island' in Long Island, 'South' in South America, '-int' in high-intensity, 'ascending' and 'descending'). Pushes the model toward 'linear' and 'line'.

L25n2340.name: Prefix starts; avoid
L25n2340.description: Word-start prefixes of verbs and nouns, such as 'inf' in infested, 'def' in deflection, 'dev' in deviate and 'dist' in distill. Pushes toward 'avoid' and 'prevent'; steered output spams 'avoid'.

L27n2231.name: Name fragment, writes pointer
L27n2231.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or ethnonym split into tokens (Sl|avic, Kut|cher, Al|fonso, Dev|anand, Hil|figer). Pushes toward 'pointer' and 'ptr' code tokens; steered output spams 'pointer'.

L25n2788.name: Pr/Ch starts, chance writer
L25n2788.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'pr' or 'Ch', mostly place and animal names (pr|airie, Pr|zewalski's horses, Ch|aco, Bod|rum); pushes 'chance', 'opportunity' and 'probability', so steering gives 'chance' spam.

L27n1099.name: Word-initial b/B/T fragment
L27n1099.description: Fires on a word-initial piece that is usually 'b' or 'B' (breading, Bites, Bantus, bunnies) or 'T' (Toss), often in recipe or list text; pushes toward '()' parentheses, and steering spams '()'.

L27n430.name: Medical onset, LaTeX output
L27n430.description: Fires on the first piece of a medical or technical word split into tokens ('ple'ural, 'vert'ebrae, 'ar'thritic, 'Ven'oms, 'Ch'ronic, 'gl'ottal); pushes toward LaTeX backslash openers.

L26n956.name: Word-start 'w'/'un' fragments
L26n956.description: Fires (goes negative) on the first fragment of an adjective or verb, often 'w', 'unw' or 't', such as 'w' in wobbling and wiser, 'unw' in unwrapped and 't' in tamed. Pushes toward 'bound' tokens.

L24n2539.name: Proper-name first pieces
L24n2539.description: Negative pole: fires on the first subword of a split proper or place name: 'Stra' in Straits of Mackinac, 'Car' in Carlin and Caruso, 'Jac' in Jacqueline, 'Jan' in Rio de Janeiro. Pushing it negative writes 'achieve/achieved' and steers text into 'achieved' spam.

L26n1990.name: Word-stub starts (c, cur)
L26n1990.description: Fires (negative) on a one- or two-letter stub that begins an ordinary word split into tokens, e.g. 'c' in ceded, 'cur' in curtailed, 'ch' in chops, 'sn' in snags, and capital stubs like 'Ch' in Chalmette. Pushes toward 'cut' and 'cutting'; pushed, it spams 'cut'.

L27n2282.name: Mid-word fragments, writes [
L27n2282.description: Fires on the second piece of a split word or name (As|qu|ith, En|richment, br|uxism, ur|inating), plus some list-number glyphs like ❶. Pushes toward '[' and '][' tokens; steered output spams '[ ]'.

L27n1602.name: Chat turn-end tokens
L27n1602.description: Fires (negative) on the chat-template boundary after a user message, the '<|im_end|>' and newline before '<|im_start|>assistant', and also on 'onta' in Devonta; pushes toward Polish and Italian word endings like -ja and -zione.

L20n2476.name: 'Called' before defined term
L20n2476.description: 'called', 'known as', 'termed' or 'referred to as' right before a term being named or defined, and 'least' in 'at least' (negative); pushes toward markdown '**' and '__' tokens.

L27n1896.name: Name starts; writes comparatives
L27n1896.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or split word (Hor|owitz, Mar|quesas, Cah|ora Bossa); pushes toward size comparatives like larger, smaller, wider and bigger.

L26n2509.name: Proper-name fragments, chart output
L26n2509.description: The first or middle subword piece of a capitalized proper name split into tokens, mostly place names (Te|esside, Gaz|ala, Pen|ryn, Gat|linburg); pushes toward 'chart', 'diagram' and 'graph'.

L27n1735.name: Mid-word 'ent' and 'title'
L27n1735.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, e.g. 'ent' (entitles, entice), 'conc' (concisely), '-t' (non-touristy), '-h' (self-harm), 'ER' (FERPA). Pushes toward 'title' tokens; steered, it spams 'Title'.

L27n589.name: F/inf letter onsets
L27n589.description: Fires on a word-start 'f', 'F' or 'inf' fragment that begins a split word (F|estival, F|eta, inf|lection, inf|irm, non-F|iction). Pushes toward 'x' tokens such as (x and [x; steered output spams 'x'.

L27n1904.name: Th/wh digraph word-starts
L27n1904.description: Fires on the 'Th', 'wh', 'rh', or 'eth' onset of a word split into pieces (Th|espians, th|yme, wh|izz, rh|izomes); pushes toward 'player' tokens.

L27n2037.name: Single 'c' word start
L27n2037.description: Fires on a lone 'c' that opens a word split off a longer term (c|actus, c|AMP, c|asks, c|abling, c|elsius). Pushes toward 'core'.

L25n24.name: Preposition before place/source
L25n24.description: Fires strongly negative on the preposition right after a verb or noun that opens a source, place or agent phrase: 'from' in launched from Cape Canaveral, 'by' in dropped by the B-29, 'at' in professor at, 'as' in known as, 'of' after a noun. Also fires on 'yes' and '?'. Pushes toward code tokens like '('{' and '()]', with no clear steering effect.

L27n2926.name: Capital J, name openers
L27n2926.description: Fires on the first letter or opening piece of a name, mostly a capital J as in J.J. Thompson, Judd Apatow, or JSL, and also Inst in Instytut and Intr in Interstate; pushes toward 'symbol' tokens.

L26n1633.name: Mid-word technical fragments
L26n1633.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a long technical word or name split into tokens (electrom|yography, metam|orphosis, elect|rophoresis, kin|ases). Pushes toward 'header' tokens, and steering spams 'date header'.

L27n2269.name: Mid-word fragments, route-writer
L27n2269.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word subword piece of a split word (noct in nocturnally, ago in Zaragoza, Xer in Xerxes, gl in polyglots, oc in ocular); pushes toward 'route'/'Route' tokens.

L25n2018.name: Biology name fragments
L25n2018.description: Goes negative on the inner piece of biology and taxon words split into tokens (rhiz|ome, rhiz|obia, Cenchr|us, Rhod|odendron, Klebs|iella). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'dimension', 'vector' and 'matrix'.

L26n2145.name: First piece of names
L26n2145.description: Fires on the opening subword of a long name or medical term split into tokens (Sal|azar, Sal|ish, Pot|omac, Kut|cher, ant|iretroviral, pan|leukopenia). Pushes the model toward 'public' and 'display' tokens.

L27n990.name: Word-start consonant fragment
L27n990.description: The initial piece of a multi-token word, often 'per', 'ch', 'conf', 'fl', 'ph' (perinatal, Chaco, confute, flinch, pharaoh). Pushes toward closing brackets ')', '}' and ']'.

L27n1327.name: Newline before assistant turn
L27n1327.description: Negative on the newline right after '<|im_end|>' that opens the assistant turn in chat text, and weaker on hyphen-split pieces like '-S' in Fat-Soluble or '-h' in rainwater; pushes toward 'source' tokens.

L23n1026.name: Place-name fragments and years
L23n1026.description: Diffuse: fires on mid-word fragments of foreign place or dish names ('Yogy|ak|arta', 'Nakh|on') and on year digits ('17|55'); pushes toward 'get'.

L27n1085.name: Mid-word piece to se
L27n1085.description: Strongly negative on a piece that continues a word split into tokens, such as 'cur' in curiosities, 'op' in cephalopod, 'poly' in polyglots, 'os' in osseointegration or 'ge' in geology. Pushes toward 'se' and 'Se'.

L26n2595.name: Proper-name opener fragments
L26n2595.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a multi-token proper name, such as people and places (Sin in Sintra, Su in Suess, Moh in Mohenjo-daro, Ru in Rushd, Fab in Fabergé); pushes toward 'continue' tokens.

L27n1847.name: Name fragments → precision
L27n1847.description: Fires on a mid-name piece of a split proper noun, e.g. 'Clem' in Clemenceau, 'Ari' in Ariane, 'Kh' in Khisa, 'elt' in Alka-Seltzer; pushes toward 'precision' and 'exact' tokens.

L27n2067.name: Noun-start fragments → 'role'
L27n2067.description: Fires on the first piece of a common noun or name split into tokens, strongest on 'bl' in blower(s), also 'shr' (shrub), 'sk' (skit), 'Rh' (rhinoceros), 'Clem' (Clemenceau). Goes negative toward 'role'/'Role' (steered output: 'Role role role').

L26n87.name: Answer-opening 'Here's'
L26n87.description: Fires on the lead-in words that open an answer before its content ('Here's', 'Here is', 'To put it simply', 'put it another way'); pushes toward off-topic nouns like _security and _payment, and steered output shows little clear effect.

L25n2397.name: Latin and surname fragments
L25n2397.description: Goes negative on mid-word fragments of surnames and Latin or species names (Eck in Eckstrom, 'chr' in Cenchrus, 'ux' in huxleyi, 'bor' in seborrhea, 'Ferr' in Ferriter). Pushes toward 'async' and 'odd'.

L26n1399.name: Mid-word fragments, writes pre
L26n1399.description: Goes positive on a fragment inside a longer word split across tokens, e.g. 'therm|ore|gulation', 'Organochlor|P|esticides', 'R|ip|arian', 'Ap|ol|ip|oprotein', 'gly|cope|ptide', 'Rep|resents'; pushes the model toward 'pre/Pres/preserve' tokens.

L25n1339.name: Name-start word fragments
L25n1339.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name or word (Mon in Monopoly and Monrovia, Lever in Leverkusen, Str in Stroudwater, Tim in Tim Burton); pushes toward 'against', 'contra' and 'resistance', so steered output spams 'against'.

L26n232.name: Genomics and science terms
L26n232.description: Molecular and lab-science terms such as genome, genomic, transcript, sequencing, polymer, fracture, glycosylated, plus 'Un' in 'unidentified'. Pushes toward '[' and '[[' bracket tokens.

L26n123.name: Pre-noun slot, method/tools
L26n123.description: Fires on the token right before an expected key noun inside a name or phrase: 'du' in Abdu'l-Bahá, 'ula' in tabula rasa, 'Upper' in Upper Macedonia, 'to' after 'blood flow', 'ep' in epidermis. Pushes toward 'method', 'tools', 'purpose' and 'implementation'.

L25n1786.name: Modal before action verb
L25n1786.description: Token just before an action verb, mostly 'can' or 'to' or 'and' in permission phrases (users can| install, allow users to| create, settings and| click), plus mid-word pieces (re|configuring); pushes toward 'enable' and 'enabled'.

L25n932.name: URL domain letters
L25n932.description: Fires on the short letters right after 'www.' or a dot in a URL or domain (e.g. 'm' in www.mindbites, 'd' in www.dhs.gov, 's' in www.safetyserve); pushes short abbreviation tokens like 'bc', 'dna', 'cbc'.

L25n2548.name: Mid-word fragments, exception
L25n2548.description: Goes negative on scattered mid-word fragments, often starting with m, mar, com or de (mar|veled, de|odorized, Com|mencing, Gut|macher, Vancom|ycin). Pushes toward 'except', 'unless' and 'until'. No single clear trigger.

L27n1039.name: Word before object
L27n1039.description: Negative on the word just before 'object(s)' in phrases like 'digital object identifiers' and 'large objects'; weaker on other word starts; pushes toward 'object' tokens.

L27n2041.name: Latinate 'pter'/'arch' pieces
L27n2041.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long technical words, strongest on 'pter' in fern family names like 'Thelypteridaceae' and on 'arch'/'arr' fragments; pushes toward 'angle/ang' tokens.

L26n375.name: Connector before its object
L26n375.description: Fires (negative) on the preposition or conjunction that introduces an object or list item: 'by' in ravaged by fire, 'against' in protection against, 'like' in like a cold, 'or' in seizures or, plus the comma in lists such as ulcers, cracked tooth. Pushes toward 'circular' and 'adaptive' adjectives; pushed, it spams 'circular'.

L27n1199.name: Biomedical term word-start
L27n1199.description: Fires on the opening piece of a biomedical or chemistry term split into tokens ('blo'od, 'Ven'om, 'Vit'amin, 'nit'rous, 'dial'ysis, 'oste'oporosis) and on 'the' before them; pushes toward process nouns 'creation', 'generation', 'addition', 'formation'.

L25n2029.name: Digits inside numbers
L25n2029.description: Fires on a digit within a multi-digit number, usually the first or second digit with more digits still to come (e.g. '2' in -286, '9' in 1982, '8' in 1,098 km); points toward 'middle' and 'mid'.

L27n2049.name: Fragments before 'form'
L27n2049.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'sh' in shelve or shatter, 'hon' in honours, 'Par' in Parthenon; pushes toward 'form'.

L24n1878.name: Name fragments and dataset
L24n1878.description: Mid-word pieces of foreign proper names (Dawei, Mesquita, Kubayi, Averroes) and the variable 'dataset' before '.head()'; pushes toward 'shape' tokens.

L26n562.name: Clause-end and list-start boundaries
L26n562.description: Fires on the period or comma that closes an instruction or list item, and on the first token of a numbered answer right after the empty think block. Pushes the model toward Spanish/Italian openers ('En', 'El', 'Es').

L27n2218.name: Mid-word fragments: port
L27n2218.description: Mid-word and word-start pieces (imp|urities, p|teridomaniacs, Pur|ana, op|reservation, CORR|ESPONDENCE); pushes the model toward 'port' tokens.

L27n343.name: Mid-word name fragments
L27n343.description: Negative pole. Fires on a middle sub-token of a proper name or rare word (Mp|um|alanga, Hos|ack, Ban Ki|-m|oon, B|uth|idae, t|urreted). Pushes toward the capital 'D' token; steered, it spams 'D D D'.

L27n1710.name: Name and word fragments
L27n1710.description: The middle piece of a name or long word split into tokens (ro in bullfrogs, iy in Ikhtiyar), pushing 'proof' or 'evidence' next.

L27n1035.name: Word-start fragments rem/som
L27n1035.description: Fires (positive) on a short fragment that begins a split word, strongest on 'rem' (remodeled, remembrance), 'som' (somersaults), 'imm' and 'sh' (headshaking); pushes toward 'variables', 'fields' and 'parameters'.

L26n1263.name: Word starts, ordinals
L26n1263.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split over tokens, mostly 'sm', 'sp', 'K' and 'I' (smooching, spayed, spires, Kassites, Iraq); pushes toward ordinal words and steers into 'Third third' spam.

L26n2792.name: Stem pieces → 'conf'
L26n2792.description: Fires on word-start pieces of split words, mostly 'sur', 'cur', 'Cons', 'contr' and 'Vas' (sur|ges, cur|iosities, Cons|ensus, Vas|ari); pushes 'conf', '(conf', 'confidence' and 'trust'.

L27n1444.name: Place/people name fragments
L27n1444.description: Opening fragments of proper nouns, e.g. 'Par' in 'Parthenon', 'Paraguay' and 'Pariah', 'Tar' in 'Tarquin', 'em' in 'empire', 'im' in 'Imams', 'Sc' in 'Scelzo'. Pushes toward 'example'.

L27n2922.name: Prefix fragment → 'new'
L27n2922.description: Goes strongly negative on a short word-opening prefix piece ('re' in renewable or reusable, 'pre' in preen, 'pr' in pray, 'Le' in leashes); when negated, it pushes toward 'new' and 'New'.

L27n2341.name: Capital starts → void
L27n2341.description: The first one or two letters of a word split into tokens, often capitalized (Ad in Aden, De in Deportation, Ne in Neutrophils, ob in obliterating); pushes toward 'void'.

L27n359.name: IPA and transliteration characters
L27n359.description: Fires on IPA symbols and diacritic transliteration letters (ə, ˈ, ɪ, ḥ, Sanskrit and Arabic romanisation) and rare subword pieces in those scripts; pushes output toward word-initial 's' tokens such as sc, sp and sk.

L27n2981.name: 'sw' start, writes foot
L27n2981.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'sw' (swamps, swishing, swimmers, swelling) and on similar openers such as 'j' in jicama. Pushes toward 'foot', 'feet' and 'leg'.

L26n612.name: Word pieces, comment tokens
L26n612.description: Fires on an unfinished word piece with more to come: 'oc' in tocopherol, 'trib' in tribes and tribosphenic, 'Ven' in venom, 'ecc' in ecclesiastical, 'ul' in ulcers, 'FA' in FADE IN. Pushes toward C-style comment tokens such as '//', '*/' and '/**'.

L26n2679.name: Word-initial 'D' or 'Di'
L26n2679.description: Fires on a 'D' or 'Di' token that opens a longer word or name mid-sentence, especially after a list dash: 'D|izziness', 'D|HA', 'Di|aptomus', 'Di|ets', 'D|ibrell', 'nond|iscriminatory'. Pushes toward 'puzzle' and 'guess'; steered output loops on 'puzzle'.

L27n3057.name: Word fragments; writes 'bacteria'
L27n3057.description: Goes strongly negative on a short fragment inside a word or name, e.g. 'er' in Xerxes, 'lo' in locket and loaves, 'um' in Mpumalanga, 'om' in Chambom. Pushing it negative steers toward 'bacteria' and infection terms.

L27n1760.name: Split-name pieces → 'left'
L27n1760.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a multi-token name or word (Cour|tyard, Dorm|agen, Ton|awanda, Ber|zelius, cl|enching), just before its last piece. Goes negative toward 'left'/'Left', giving left spam.

L27n270.name: Title-case heading words
L27n270.description: Goes negative on a capitalised word inside a title or heading ('Public' in Public Switched Telephone Network, 'Significant' in 'Significant Changes', 'Awareness', 'Comprehensive'), and on the colon or break that opens a heading. Pushes toward stray lowercase letters like p, q, k.

L26n2835.name: Name and word-start fragments
L26n2835.description: Fires on name-start or word-start pieces, e.g. 'Dev' (Devi, Devanand), 'Camb' (Cambio), 'whip' (whipbirds), 'Lib' (Libby), 'home' (home renovation); pushes toward 'modified'.

L23n100.name: Commas and sentence-end punctuation
L23n100.description: Fires on commas mid-sentence, especially digit-group commas (3,294) and commas before an appositive or continuation; pushes the model to end with sentence punctuation (. ! ;).

L27n285.name: Mid-word fragments, R output
L27n285.description: Fires on a piece of a word or name split across tokens, often a middle chunk (ula in tabula, bor in seborrhea, ab in glabrous, 7 in E. coli O157:H7); pushes toward R-initial tokens like RO and RS.

L27n1217.name: Mid-word f/if/oph piece
L27n1217.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word piece in a split word, especially 'f', 'if', 'oph' and 'ph' (e.g. 'if' in kiwifruit, 'oph' in Psophodes, 'f' in fussy, 'op' in cephalopod); pushes 'entries' and 'entry'.

L27n1656.name: Per- prefix opener
L27n1656.description: Fires on the 'per' or 'Per' token opening a word like peri|tonsillar, peri|natal, per|nicious, peri|toneal (also app, unp, par); pushed positive it promotes 'results'.

L27n1517.name: Capitalized name fragments
L27n1517.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a capitalized name or title split across tokens, e.g. 'Medical' in 'Hughes Medical', 'Fl' in Flax, 'Fr' in Franks; pushes toward the letter 'y'.

L22n2372.name: Mid-word name fragments
L22n2372.description: Mid-word piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'utz' in Gutzon, 'itz' in Pietermaritzburg, 'mes' in parmesan, 'gir' in giraffe; pushes toward the token 'range'.

L26n3018.name: Short word-start fragments fe/exc/ca
L26n3018.description: Fires on a short first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly 'fe' (fevers, febrile), 'exc' (excise, excels), 'ca' (cauliflower, carambola), 'mes' (mesosphere), 'inc' (incised); the following pieces stay near 0. Writes 'contract' tokens, and the steered output is 'Contract contracts' spam.

L27n2106.name: Lone 't' opening words
L27n2106.description: The single letter 't' that opens a split word, e.g. 't' in tummy, tamed, tavern, tuliopmania; also 'r' in rangers. Pushes toward the size words 'large' or 'small'.

L26n2421.name: Long-word first pieces
L26n2421.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens (e.g. 'glyc' in glycogen, 'incom' in incomparable, 'decom' in decompose, 'compreh' in comprehensively). Pushes toward 'divide' and 'division'.

L27n2060.name: 'New'/'st' starts, 'issue'
L27n2060.description: Strongly negative on 'New' in place names (New Jersey, New York) and word-start fragments like 'st', 'spr' and 'Saint'; pushing negative makes the model write 'issue'/'issues'.

L26n421.name: Idiom-final words
L26n421.description: Goes negative on the key noun or adjective that ends a short idiom or dictionary-style phrase ('a law unto themselves', 'Egypt', 'the majority', 'a phenomenon', 'hurt', 'efficiently'). Writes closing code tokens such as '):' and '**)'; steering barely changes the prose.

L27n613.name: Opening paren before gloss
L27n613.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis or quote that starts an alternate name, abbreviation or gloss (e.g. '(' in 'vitamin B1 (thiamine)', '(Roman)', '(MSJE)', '(“'). Also fires weakly on some word-start fragments. Pushes the model toward tokens starting with 'm' (mum, mr).

L25n1025.name: Word-start fragments, '!' output
L25n1025.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often capitalized or a name start ('Hon' in Honshu, 'kr' in krill, 'Un' in Unconsoled, 'Ar' in arthritis); pushes toward '!' and exclamation marks.

L25n944.name: Disease-term word fragments
L25n944.description: Goes negative on the consonant-led piece of a word split into tokens, often in disease and medical terms ('R' in rickets, 'rr' in seborrhea, 'des' in desensitized, 'bs' in Klebsiella, 'w' in wobbling). Pushes toward 'delay' and 'blocking'.

L26n933.name: Proper-name start, writes 'travel'
L26n933.description: Goes negative on 'of' inside an agency or organisation name ('Department of Energy', 'Office of Advanced') and on the first fragment of capitalised names (Os-, Car-, Star-). Pushes toward 'transport' and 'travel' tokens.

L26n1474.name: Name and technical middles
L26n1474.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split name or technical word (e.g. 'bre' in Albrecht, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'fasc' in fasciitis, 'gl' in glomerular); its output points to 'out' and 'outcome'.

L27n2163.name: Word-start pieces, 'dev'
L27n2163.description: Positive on the first piece of a split name or term (cre|vice, Kh|ulaifi, Buddh|ists, D|harma), pushing toward 'dev' tokens.

L25n1240.name: Split-word completion pieces
L25n1240.description: Fires on the piece that completes a split word or name mid-word: 'ario' in Revolucionario, 'Hor' in Horizonte, 'ma' in Dalmau, 'vit' in brevitomentosus. Also fires on 'need' after 'will'. Pushes toward 'to', 'à' and 'au'.

L27n1655.name: 'sa'/'omat' pieces, 'aut' writer
L27n1655.description: Goes negative on the 'sa' in sauté and the 'omat' in onomatopoeia, plus 'ron' and 'ry' fragments in acronyms and apocryphal. Pushes toward 'aut' and 'auto' tokens.

L27n191.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n191.description: Goes strongly negative on digits in the middle of multi-digit figures (the 0s and 2s in 25,000, 4,000 MW, 2,400 calories) in web text, and weakly on connectives like However and Therefore; pushes closing quote-bracket tokens such as '),' and '],['.

L27n1660.name: Word-start piece, writes config
L27n1660.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords: 'fe' in febrile, 'Le' in León, 'def' in deflection or defocused, 'RIP' and '-de'. Pushes toward config, configuration and Config code tokens, repeated.

L26n2498.name: Name pieces and 'sc-'
L26n2498.description: Opening piece of split proper names (Bort|nyik, Zat|orre, Rzew|uski, Han|uman) and 'sc' in scoliosis or scarring; pushes toward 'score' and 'scores'.

L27n2835.name: Am/Imm word starts
L27n2835.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting 'Am' or 'Imm' (Amoretti, immune, immunodeficiency, amoeba), and similar 'Hor' and 'Or' starts; pushes toward 'mine' tokens.

L25n687.name: Opening piece, 'str'
L25n687.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, most strongly 'str' in Straits and 'ph' in phylum, also 'acc' in Maccabean and 'idd' in Megiddo; pushes toward 'xy' and 'abc' letter-run tokens.

L27n2342.name: Proper-name first pieces, places
L27n2342.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or place split across tokens, such as 'Khal' in Khalifa, 'Cal' in Calle Joaquin, 'Bal' in Balochistan, 'Se' in Seville, or 'Lal' in Laliberté; the pole promotes 'drop'/'drops'/'dropped' and steered output spams 'drop'.

L27n2035.name: Re-/in- verb stems
L27n2035.description: Strongly negative on a word-initial stem fragment of a longer verb or noun, such as 'rec' in reciting or recaptured, 'reinc' in reincarnation, 'excav' in excavations, 'inc' in incision, and 'Prop' in propulsion. Pushes toward 'feature', which it repeats when steered.

L27n2421.name: Short word-initial pieces
L27n2421.description: Fires strongly negative on a short leading piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'g' in g|ilded, 'Can' in Can|averal, 'm' in m|ementos, 'Cav' in Cav|ities, 'lif' in lif|espans, 'rav' in rav|aged, 'Gro' in Gro|ovy. Going negative pushes toward 'email' and 'mail' tokens.

L27n1573.name: Word openers, 'there has'
L27n1573.description: Fires on word-opening fragments of nouns and names (de|odorized, T|isha, Hem|atoma, Can|ena, pur|ports, dise|ased) and on 'has' or 'have' after 'there' (there has been); pushed negative it promotes 'development'.

L27n1838.name: Proper-name fragments, employee
L27n1838.description: Positive on the first subword piece of a capitalized place or proper name split into tokens (Man-ahawkin, Te-esside, Ne-oplatonic, Ban-ff, Car-thage). Pushes toward 'employee/employees'; strong steering spams 'Employee'.

L27n1255.name: Name start, writes quotes
L27n1255.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalised or split name in encyclopedic text (Ze|alots, tr|actors, B|uleji, Ant|iochus, Ze|ppelin); pushes toward opening quotation marks, and steering spams open quotes.

L26n2472.name: Proper-name starts; '.' output
L26n2472.description: Fires on the first letter or fragment of a capitalized name (Bel|nap, Fl|ora, Pal|umbo, Pr|ima). Pushes toward period and dot-like punctuation ('.', '/.').

L24n1662.name: Predicate slot, writes separate
L24n1662.description: Fires on the word right after a subject that is about to take its verb or complement, e.g. 'be' in 'can be non-religious', 'place' in 'take place', 'exist' in 'do not exist', 'it' in 'keep it pointed'. Pushes toward 'separate/separation'; steered text repeats 'separated'.

L25n1808.name: 'code' and size-word pieces
L25n1808.description: Fires on the word 'code' in coding requests and on size or part words (vast, small, Cod, chunk-like pieces); pushes toward 'segment', 'section', 'chunk' and 'fragment'.

L26n2332.name: Mid-word fragment in names
L26n2332.description: Goes negative on a middle fragment of a long proper noun or word split into tokens (Ne|op|latonic, Nau|v|oo, Hiroshima Peace, epi|psy|lepsy). Pushes toward 'subset', 'series' and 'Set' tokens.

L27n1288.name: Fixed-continuation tokens
L27n1288.description: Fires on a token where the next word is nearly fixed by context: 'yum' in sudo yum| install, 'amb' in Susilo B|amb|ang, 'a' in 'takes a| minute', 'Hello' in Hello| Tractor; pushed positive it promotes 'local'.

L27n2776.name: Capitalized word-start pieces
L27n2776.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, most often a capitalized name or word start, e.g. 'ame' in Cha|me|leons, 'Ze' in Ze|alots and Ze|ppelin, 'Ang' in Ang|olan and 'Kn' in Kn|idos. Writes 'buffer' tokens, and steering spams 'buffer'.

L27n588.name: Onset 'pr/cr/str' fragment
L27n588.description: Negative on a consonant-cluster onset fragment that opens a split word, mostly 'pr', 'cr', 'str' or 'sar', e.g. 'forest-dwelling pr|imate', 'cr|anes', 'str|angleweed', 'sar|coma'. Pushes toward 'condition' and 'case'; steered output spams 'condition'.

L27n1436.name: Mixed technical term pieces
L27n1436.description: Tokens inside technical or UI terms: 'Ω' after a resistance value (200 Ω), 'electrom' in electromagnetism, 'Non' in nonproliferation, 'user' and 'mouse' or 'finger' in interaction lists; pushes toward 'inter' (interaction) tokens.

L27n2995.name: Word-start fragments: sem
L27n2995.description: Word-start pieces such as 'res' (resonant), 'nons' (nonspecific), 'Rem' (Remembrance), 'spr' (sprouts), and 'is' in 'semisolid'; pushes the model toward 'sem' tokens.

L26n685.name: Prefix 'an' → suffixes
L26n685.description: Fires on 'an' or 'An' opening a word split into pieces (an|esthetic, an|emia, An|archism, an|emones, An|arthritis) and on sentence-initial 'The', 'At', 'In'; pushes suffix pieces '-ed', '-est', '-ize', '-ise'.

L24n1939.name: Name prefix → 'token'
L24n1939.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split surname or place name, e.g. 'Bor' in Borisevich, 'Barb' in Barbuda, 'Barn' in Barnette, 'Boss' in Cahora Bassa, 'Arn' in Arnott. Pushes toward 'token' and 'tokens'.

L26n817.name: Word fragments before 'benefit'
L26n817.description: Fires on the word-start fragment before a rare or multi-token word (Cor|rimal, vag|rancy, Mont|adale, clus|al) and on 'it' in 'how it can'. Pushes toward 'benefit' and 'benefits'.

L27n758.name: Size descriptor before noun
L27n758.description: A size or shape modifier before its noun: 'small nonstick', 'large bowl', 'heavy-bottomed sauce', 'cover crops', 'variable frequency drives'. Pushes toward dimension nouns (depth, height, length, width).

L26n2934.name: Name fragment, P/Pr/Be
L26n2934.description: The first piece of a name or split word, especially 'P' in Polding or Pomeranian, 'Pr' in PrEP, 'Be' in Becciu, 'esp' in espotters. Pushes toward 'verification' and 'check'; steered, it spams 'confirmation'.

L26n2629.name: Word-start fragments, multi-piece words
L26n2629.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a longer word split into tokens: 'igr' in centigrade, 'Pat' in Patagonia, 'Det' in detoxifying, 'opot' in hippopotamus, 'tum' in tummy. Pushes toward 'background'.

L26n1315.name: Geo/Gu word starts
L26n1315.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word starting 'ge', 'gu', 'gl' or 'Ge' split into tokens (ge|ology, Gu|atemalan, Ge|obacter, gl|ances). Pushes toward 'communication' and 'communicate'.

L26n2090.name: URL and word starts
L26n2090.description: Fires on the word URL, and on the first piece of a word split across tokens (Sal- in Salamis or Salish, st- in stained or stretches, sw- in swab, Ch- in Chhattisgarh). Pushes toward 'scheme' and 'query', the URL-part words; at dose 0.5 it writes unrelated prose.

L27n316.name: Adverb before a verb
L27n316.description: Fires on an adverb or modal right before its verb (literally, suddenly, barely, will confirm, shouldn't expect, never been able); pushes toward single capital letters, and steering spams capitals.

L26n2865.name: Split name stems
L26n2865.description: Fires on the first piece of a split capitalized name or word (Ser-enity, Sar-abhai, Sk-opje, Br-eathing, Dal-ālat), right before its continuation; pushes 'le' tokens, and pushed output spams 'Le le le'.

L26n2607.name: First piece of names
L26n2607.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized place, book or person name, or the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'T' in Tete Province, Treatise, Tigris; 'Bo' in Bois Blanc; 'Y' in Yogyakarta; 'spe' in asparagus spears; 'blo' in blooming. Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L27n2198.name: Place-name first word
L27n2198.description: Fires on the first token of a multi-word proper name, mostly 'Santa' and 'Saint'/'St' (Santa Rosa, Saint George), plus 'Cl' in Clifton and 'Ch' in Chaco; pushes output toward 'sent' and 'send' tokens.

L27n2433.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n2433.description: Fires on short consonant-cluster word starts that open a split word, mostly 'cl', 'gl', 'br' (cl|apping, gl|iders, br|uxism, br|ain). Pushes 'user' and 'User' tokens with no clear link to what it reads.

L27n2291.name: Word-start 'pl' and '-p'
L27n2291.description: Goes negative on word-start fragments that open a split word, most often 'pl' (plume, plumb, plowing), '-p' after a hyphen (get-pip, shaded-pole, twisted-pair), and 'pr' or 'Pr'. Pushes toward 'zero'.

L27n1105.name: Name start, year
L27n1105.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name (Pic|uda, Tong|a, Har|penden, Dok|sanaltı) and on 'light' before 'years' or 'trucks'; pushes toward 'year'.

L27n2103.name: Lone s/f, writes race
L27n2103.description: Negative on a lone 's' or 'f' that starts a word or hyphen piece (s|cones, f|eta, f|rogs, s|ugar); pushes toward 'race' and 'races' tokens.

L26n2016.name: Function words before verbs
L26n2016.description: Fires on a function word that sets up a verb, mostly 'to', 'be', 'by', 'can', 'which' in procedural tech text ('used to determine', 'will be joining', 'found by quadrature'), plus 'hash' and 'DNA'. Pushes toward 'compare'/'cross', and steering repeats 'cross'.

L27n1640.name: Capital letter opening names
L27n1640.description: Fires on a single capital letter or short first piece that opens a split proper name or term (C in Caao, K in Kitten, Wol in Wolpertingers), mid-sentence. Pushes toward 'direction' tokens.

L27n227.name: Options and alternatives
L27n227.description: Fires on the word opening a list of alternatives or categories ('or' in desktop or laptop, 'study' in study tools, 'Commod' in Commodities) and on split-word starts like 'paraph' and 'Typ'; pushes toward 'options', 'settings', 'terms'.

L27n1413.name: Oven temps, mixed prose
L27n1413.description: The last digit of an oven temperature or calorie count ('40|0°F', '190|4 calories'), plus 'the' or 'at' in mixed prose. Activation is diffuse and low. Pushes toward 'big' tokens.

L27n967.name: Proper-name first pieces
L27n967.description: The first token of a capitalized name split into pieces, e.g. 'Ste' in Stefan, 'Wol' in Wolpertinger, 'Mer' in Merthyr, 'Dal' in Dalmau; pushes toward '{' braces, spamming '{ { {'.

L22n230.name: Technical phrase-final tokens
L22n230.description: Diffuse: fires negative on the last word or closing bracket of a technical phrase, e.g. 'View' in 'Datasheet View', '-name' in '<package-name>', the closing parenthesis in '(AWS EC2)', and the token before a closing delimiter in code. Pushes toward closing code punctuation.

L27n935.name: 'st' onset → negative
L27n935.description: Fires on the 'st' that starts a word split into tokens, e.g. stews, stuffs, stings, stromal, stanzas; pushes toward 'neg' and 'negative' tokens.

L27n614.name: Word starts in lists
L27n614.description: Negative on the first piece of split words in instruction and list text (exc|itable, dri|est, enc|odes, Fr|isia), and on 'bullet points' in the system prompt; pushes toward 'Python' tokens.

L24n2209.name: Filenames, surnames and M-file
L24n2209.description: goes strongly negative on the name token before a file extension, e.g. 'M' in 'M-file', 'ip' in 'get-pip.py', plus Dutch surnames with 'van'; pushes toward file-extension tokens like '.c' and '.rs'.

L27n296.name: Split-word middles, F-prefix output
L27n296.description: Fires on a middle piece of a word split across tokens, often in acronyms or names (chie in mischievous, ICE in UNICEF, NS in National Science, ral in sucralose); pushes toward F-prefixed tokens like FD and FS.

L27n2259.name: Split word first pieces
L27n2259.description: The first piece of a longer word split into tokens (thr|ived, thr|usters, Comp|ounds, pract|ising, juris|prudence, discrim|inated, suff|used, terr|aced); pushes toward 'len' tokens.

L26n633.name: Latin and proper-name starts
L26n633.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a Latin-root or proper name split across tokens (Platanus, Elaeis, Acidithiobacillus, Stangeria, 'N' in Nishi Amane). Pushes toward 'para' and 'pour'.

L27n2599.name: Split-name capital K
L27n2599.description: A capital K, D or E right after a hyphen or name split, e.g. Skutnabb-|K|angas, Boiry-Notre-|D|ame, Kreimer, plus 'heter' in heter|ogeneity; pushes toward 'data' and spams 'lost lost'.

L27n1243.name: Wet and marsh words
L27n1243.description: Fires on 'wet' in wetlands and 'marsh' in marshlands, and weakly on 'freshwater' and 'lush'; pushes toward the 'me' token.

L26n2067.name: Onset fragment → 'bond'
L26n2067.description: Goes negative on the consonant-cluster start of a word split into tokens, like 'squ' in squirts and squander, 'sw' in swamps, 'str' in stricken and 'gu' in guerilla; pushes toward 'bond', 'married' and 'marriage'.

L26n3003.name: 'res-'/'sm-' word starts
L26n3003.description: Word-opening pieces 'res', 'sm', 'rob' and 'exp' of split verbs and nouns (res|erve, res|ided, res|ettle, sm|og, rob|bers); pushes toward 'transaction'.

L26n369.name: Recipe numerals, Sp-words
L26n369.description: Goes negative on the numeral that starts a recipe quantity ('1' in '1 tablespoon', '2' in '2 tablespoons') and on 'Sp' openers (spinal, spicy, spelling); pushes toward ellipsis '…' tokens.

L27n1597.name: Split word pieces
L27n1597.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or compound, e.g. 'dise' in diseased, 'inf' in infantry, 'ar' in Caernarvon, 'eye' in eye-catching, 'iest' in bloodiest; pushes toward 'action' tokens.

L27n635.name: Capital P, IPA symbols
L27n635.description: Fires on a capital 'P' starting a word (Patches, Potters, Packed, Pies, Pustules), on the digit after the copyright sign in years (2 in 2005), and on IPA stress and vowel symbols (ˈ, ɪ, ə). Pushes toward asterisk and symbol tokens (*, %, @, &).

L27n2010.name: Word starts before optim
L27n2010.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (dise|ased, Astroph|ysics, poly|gamy, lo|aves, Ely|pteridaceae); pushes toward 'opt/optim' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n646.name: Verse numbers, field labels
L27n646.description: Goes strongly negative on digits inside verse, time and scale references (e.g. 17:18, 1:380,000, 2:06 am) and on form-field labels like Title, Question, Type, Ingredients and Example; pushes closing Python brackets such as ')):' and ']):'.

L26n2100.name: Film/media nouns, video
L26n2100.description: Fires on media nouns (film, movie, television, Radio) and on the first pieces of some names (Kh-, Pan-, aj). Pushes toward 'video'; steered output spams 'video'.

L26n485.name: Prose fragments; code closers
L26n485.description: Word-start pieces of longer words in prose, such as 'sur' in surges, 'sor' in sorghum, 'Soci' in societal and 'Mult' in multidimensional. Pushes toward code-closing tokens like ');' and ',)'; steered output spams newlines and dots.

L26n550.name: Mid-name subword fragments
L26n550.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of a place or person name split into tokens, usually the first or second piece (Có|rdoba, Fort Det|rick, Nil|otes), often after 'in' or 'at'; pushes toward word-ending 'd' tokens, not the names.

L27n2594.name: Cut-off opening fragments
L27n2594.description: Fires on a short word opener cut off mid-word: 'ref' in ref|ueling and ref|resher, 'tele' in tele|graph, 'fre' in fre|ighting, 'Tr' in Tr|ims, 'f' in f|errat. Pushes toward 'frame' tokens.

L26n1059.name: Split-word first fragment
L26n1059.description: The first fragment of a word or name split into several tokens, such as 'Pr' in Prisc-ius, 'Ram' in Ramkham, 'Prom' in Prompts, 'alm' in Talmud. Fires before the word is complete. Pushes toward code-style '(_' and '{_' tokens.

L27n745.name: Capital R word starts
L27n745.description: Fires negatively on a capital 'R' or '-R' starting a word (Roman in First Jewish-Roman War, Rommel, Rukh, Roses, Rickets), and on 'Ker' in Ketz and 'Cru' in Cruelty. Pushes the model toward an opening bracket followed by a symbol, such as '(*' or '({'.

L27n803.name: Medical and place-name stems
L27n803.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into subtokens, often a medical or place-name stem, such as 'par' in parathyroid, parasympathetic, and parmesan, 'Ch' in Chaco, 'cl' in clindamycin, and 'pr' in prairie. Pushes toward 'value/values', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1713.name: List commas, writes 'temp'
L27n1713.description: Fires on the comma or semicolon separating items in a list of foods, animals or names: after 'tofu' in 'tofu, beans, or tempeh', after 'salmon' in 'salmon, lake trout'. Also on fragments 'contr' and 'cont'. Pushes toward temp, Temp and Tem tokens, repeated.

L26n1354.name: Capital word-start fragment
L26n1354.description: Goes strongly negative on a capitalized first piece of a name or word before it is completed ('H' in Hittites, Hertfordshire, Hellenic; 'Luc' in Lucian; 'k' in kami); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'button'.

L25n1717.name: Time-span words, 'years'
L25n1717.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before a time span or age unit, such as 'first' in first trimester, 'bearing' in child-bearing age and 'one' in one-sixth in a decade, and on 'Har' in place names like Harpenden. Pushes toward 'years'.

L25n1779.name: Fundamental principles and foundations
L25n1779.description: Fires (goes negative) on words for basic or foundational rules, such as 'principle', 'fundamental', 'foundation', 'basic' and 'core', most strongly when they name a set of rules or guidelines. Pushes output toward 'post' and 'ax' tokens, such as 'post-apocalyptic', with no clear concept.

L27n1761.name: Name piece, writes question
L27n1761.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a proper name or split word (e.g. 'Pr' in Priscus, 'Sin' in Sintra, 'esp' in Vespasian, 'Jan' in Janeiro, 'ace' in olivaceus); pushes 'question' and 'questions'; steered output loops 'Question question'.

L27n2719.name: Word-start fl to empty
L27n2719.description: Strongly negative on 'fl' starting a word or name (flinch, flares, flax, flammable, Flintridge). Pushes toward 'empty' and 'blank'.

L26n2383.name: Word-start of proper nouns
L26n2383.description: Fires on the short first piece of a capitalized or multi-piece noun right after 'the' or 'a' (e.g. 'Sal' in Salamis, 'Al' in Al Andalus, 'Sl' in slaves, 'fr' in franchised). Pushes toward 'list' and 'lists'.

L27n986.name: Mid-word piece to quote
L27n986.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece inside a split name or word, such as 'Eck' in Eckstrom, 'sw' in swishing, 'An' in Anjana or 'ol' in scoliosis. Pushes toward closing quote and bracket tokens.

L26n1869.name: Biology word leading pieces
L26n1869.description: Goes negative on the leading piece of a long biology or medical word split into tokens, such as 'tr' in protruding, 'pr' in prokaryotes, 'cr' in crumbly, 'Micro' in microclots, 'Mon' in Monocotyledoneae. Pushes toward 'liquid' and 'fluid'.

L24n1186.name: placement verb before 'where'
