L24n1186.description: Fires on verbs and adverbs of placing, going, or occurring ('starts', 'placed', 'found', 'go', 'going', 'every', 'all') just before a location or time complement ('placed before', 'found anywhere', 'going on'); pushes toward 'where', and steered text spams 'where'.

L27n1107.name: IPA symbols, name pieces
L27n1107.description: Fires strongly negative on IPA stress and phonetic symbols (the ˈ in /ˈdɔl/, ɪ, ə), on diacritic letters (ḥ, ö), and on syllables inside transliterated foreign names (Tar|quin, cre|monesi, Dol|aucothi, Ah|mad). Going negative pushes toward closing quote-bracket tokens such as ]) and }).

L25n2783.name: Mid-word g fragments
L25n2783.description: Fires on a short mid-word fragment such as 'g', 'eg', 'ag', 'rec' inside a split word or name: 'eg' in lifeguards, 'g' in Crataegus, 'ig' in Frigidaire, 'leng' in legendary, 'rec' in recitation. Pushes toward closing brackets like ']))' with no link to the text.

L25n2761.name: Surname continuation pieces
L25n2761.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a surname split into tokens (Roo|ze|boom, Macc|les|field, Cro|ple|y, McInt|ire, D|otten, Mack|in|ac, Whi|itting|ham). Pushed positive it steers toward 'release', 'issued' and 'emit'.

L27n1808.name: Two-letter word-start piece
L27n1808.description: Strongly positive on short opening pieces of split words, mostly 'ul' in 'ul|cers', 'pl' in 'pl|asm', 'war' in 'war|ms', 'bul' in 'bul|ges', 'aut' in 'aut|onomous'. Pushes capital two-letter tokens 'CS', 'TS', 'DS'.

L22n2747.name: Split proper-name fragments
L22n2747.description: Goes strongly negative on a later piece of a multi-token proper name or rare word, such as 'by' in Abyei, 'ver' in Averroes, 'Arist' in Aristotelian, 'Astr' in Astronomical and 'ux' in bruxism; pushes toward 'map'.

L27n2503.name: Split-word piece, writes back
L27n2503.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a name or rare word split into tokens (e.g. 'Wor' in Woramahawihan, 'eb' in eyebrow, 'Bag' in Badshahi, 'th' in thriller, 'Th' in Thelypteridaceae); pushes the model to write 'back'; steered output loops 'back back'.

L27n2479.name: Compound piece to sn
L27n2479.description: Negative pole fires on compound-word pieces (supers-, outs-, odd-); pushes toward 'sn' tokens.

L27n1531.name: Mid-word fragments → 'reflect'
L27n1531.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of split words and names (e.g. 'elt' in Alka-Seltzer, 'anche' in Blanche, 'Mag' in Magritte, '-g' in '-guess'). Pushes toward 'reflect' tokens (steered output is 'Reflect reflecting reflection').

L26n2737.name: Determiner opening noun phrase
L26n2737.description: Determiners and possessives (their, its, the, Its) that open a noun phrase, and word starts such as di and menstr; pushes the model to write 'period' or 'periods'.

L26n385.name: Agent-noun stem fragment
L26n385.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word that will take a person or audience ending (negot|iator, bre|eder, suff|ragette, Im|ager, optim|isation), and on hyphen-split pieces (egg-ste|aling, phos-ph|atases). Pushes toward 'reader', 'writer', 'viewer' and 'audience'.

L24n2670.name: Hardware binary, register
L24n2670.description: Fires on hardware-coding words (binary, Receive, Transmit, bus, decimal) and on port writes like 'P0 = 0xFF', plus some mid-name fragments (Rom|mel, Char|alambos); pushes toward 'register' and 'registers' with a strong 'register' effect.

L27n584.name: Aux/prep words; onset writer
L27n584.description: Goes negative on auxiliaries and prepositions that lead into a verb or noun (will, after, being, ’t, are) and on nouns like tin, tree, oil; pushes two-letter consonant onsets (pl, fl, cl, sp, tr, gr), which garble text when steered.

L25n1985.name: First-person copula
L25n1985.description: The verb right after a subject pronoun in self-description, e.g. 'I [am] writing', 'I'[m] sure', 'We [are] very proud', 'It[']s'; pushes toward the word 'super'.

L27n3016.name: Split p/op fragments, push
L27n3016.description: Goes strongly negative on a split-word piece beginning with p or o, often after a hyphen: 'yp' in pypa, '-p' in roller-pushing, '-p' in self-published, 'op' in aeroplane. Pushes toward 'push/Push/pull'; strong steering spams 'push'.

L26n2245.name: Hyphen-compound second part
L26n2245.description: The short piece right after a hyphen in a compound (two-d|ose, free-d|ocking, heavy-g|auge, high-D|eductible); pushes toward 'patch'.

L26n2714.name: V/fe word starts
L26n2714.description: Fires on a short 'v' or 'fe'/'ev'/'av' sub-token starting a word fragment (vibrate, vaccinated, vaping, fevers, evaporation, Avot, lemons); pushes 'want' and 'desired' tokens.

L27n2859.name: Hard 'c' word starts
L27n2859.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'ch' letter starting a word fragment, mostly inside names or words ('C75', 'cactus', 'caramels', 'carambola', 'chondrite', 'enc' in encodes, 'exc'). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'echo', and the output spams 'echo'.

L25n1518.name: Name-internal subword pieces
L25n1518.description: Fires (negative) on a non-initial subword piece of a multi-token proper name, strongest on 'ob' in Chern|ob|yl and 'qu' in Tar|qu|inius, mostly in place names, people and titles. Pushes toward 'parameter' and 'parameters'; steering shows no clear effect.

L25n2611.name: Word fragments, dress words
L25n2611.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens (e.g. 'cuis' in cuisines, 'ec' in ecologic, 'w' in wobbling) and on dress and outfit words; points toward 'theme(s)'.

L26n600.name: Name-piece, writes 'chapter'
L26n600.description: Fires on a middle piece of a surname or place name split into tokens, e.g. 'js' in Stejskal, 'zen' in Ajzen, 'Hub' in Huberman, 'mar' in Pietermaritzburg. Pushes toward 'chapter' and 'article' tokens.

L27n1546.name: Capital C word starts
L27n1546.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'C' or 'c' that starts a split term (C|iel, c|AMP, C|oupole, c|innamon). Effect pushes toward 'response' tokens, which the reads do not explain.

L26n923.name: Mid-name piece → particle
L26n923.description: Fires on the middle piece of a long multi-token proper noun or loanword (Mp|um|alanga, ts|un|ami, Mund|ial, loco|mot|ives, Dar|es|Salaam); pushes 'particle', 'particles' and 'Physics'.

L27n395.name: Consonant-cluster word onset
L27n395.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens that opens with a consonant cluster ('gr'ubs, 'fl', 'b'oulders, 't'igers, 'st'ews, 'Gr'izzly); pushes toward semicolons and '!' or '?' punctuation.

L23n1516.name: Determiners after verbs
L23n1516.description: Fires negatively on the determiner right after a verb or preposition in expository prose, e.g. 'your' in 'strengthen your company', 'its' in 'simmer in its liquid', 'the' in 'beyond the previous'; pushes toward 'current', and at higher dose collapses into repeating it.

L27n2234.name: Name-stem fragments
L27n2234.description: Fires strongly negative on a capitalized or stem fragment that starts a split word, e.g. 'Camb' in Camb|io, 'Serg' in Serg|ipe, 'Urb' in Urb|ium, 'Tit' in Tit|us, 'trib' in trib|uere, 'app' in app|alled, 'acc' in acc|abean. Going negative pushes toward tile, town and village.

L27n1785.name: 'enc' and 'Cl' word-starts
L27n1785.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'enc' or 'Enc' (enclosures, Encapsulate, encodes) and 'Cl' (Clamato, Clain); pushes toward 'hash' tokens, and steering spams 'hash'.

L23n2106.name: Split-word first fragments
L23n2106.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a longer word or name that is split into tokens (e.g. 'wil' in wildebeest, 'Hos' in Hosack, 'Lib' in Libertarian, 'ob' in Gobitis), peaking on that opening fragment. Pushes the model toward 'other' and 'others'.

L27n2794.name: Capitalized name fragment
L27n2794.description: The word-start fragment of a capitalized name or place: 'Pseudomonas put|ida', 'Mah|awkin', 'Sar|acen', 'Ne|olithic', 'Mi|ocene', 'Sav|anna'. Pushes toward 'depend' and 'dependency'.

L27n587.name: Mid-name fragment, closes code
L27n587.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a capitalized proper name split into subwords, e.g. 'Z' in KwaZulu, 'A' in Abyei or Agra, 'Dai' in Daiichi, 'I' in ICAO. Pushes toward code closers such as ");, ); and ');, repeated.

L23n1482.name: 'machine' and 'inter-' starts
L23n1482.description: Fires on 'machine' before 'learning' and on word-initial 'Inter'/'TE'/'Liter' fragments (interfaith, INTELLIGENCE). Pushes the model toward 'interpret' words, which repeat when steered.

L26n83.name: Word-piece openers, 'but' writer
L26n83.description: Fires on a word-opening piece such as 'pamph' (pamphlets), 'mol' (molten), 'pur' (purists), 'pr' (prisms), and on the bracket, hyphen or comma inside a figure (the '(' before a metric conversion, the '-' in STS-51-G). Pushes toward contrast words 'but', 'then', 'than', and steered text repeats 'then'.

L26n1544.name: Mid-word fragments, Python
L26n1544.description: Goes negative on a middle or late fragment of a multi-token word or name (e.g. 'ly' in aminoglycoside, 'Nay' in Nayak, 'scal' in scallops, 'facet' in facet joint). Pushes toward 'Py' and 'python'.

L27n2125.name: 'St' in place names
L27n2125.description: Fires on 'St' or 'Saint' opening a place or church name (St. Mary's, St. Martin, St. Anthony) and on 'Van' in Van Reenen's. Pushes the model toward '=' followed by short name tokens (noisy).

L26n1965.name: rec/er/m opening pieces
L26n1965.description: Fires on short opening pieces of split words, mainly 'rec' (rec|eded, rec|ollections), 'er' (er|oded, Er|win) and 'm' (newly-m|inted, m|ementos), mid-sentence; whole words stay low. Pushes toward 'walk' and 'walking'.

L26n2820.name: Short word start, 'guide'
L26n2820.description: Fires on a short fragment that opens a split word, often one or two letters after a space (Alka-Selt|zer, o|asis, O|phioglossaceae, Le|ashes, le|thal); pushes 'guide', 'guidance' and 'instructions'.

L27n1125.name: Mid-sentence fragments, float
L27n1125.description: Diffuse: mid-sentence function words or name fragments in web prose ('to', 'who', 'will', 'can', 'Ph' in Thai names) that precede a continuation. Pushes toward 'float' and 'fish'.

L27n2113.name: Capital acronym fragments
L27n2113.description: Fires on a capitalised piece inside an acronym or name, e.g. 'CI' in 'CIHI', 'BI' in 'BI initiative', 'RI' in 'RRI', 'HI' in 'HIT', 'I' in 'I have'. Pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ches', 'ged', 'cks' and 'ble'; steered, it produces runs of 'sches'.

L27n1875.name: Word-start sp/squ/ph
L27n1875.description: Fires on the start piece of a split word, e.g. 'sp' in cerebrospinal, 'squ' in squirts, 'ph' in phagocytes, 'Sp' in spending; pushes the model toward 'Na' (sodium).

L27n1954.name: Rare split word starts
L27n1954.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'uns' in unsupervised, 'Por' in Porifera, '-s' in self-sufficiency; pushes toward 'touch' tokens.

L26n1398.name: Name piece → 'bar'
L26n1398.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split proper name or UI word (Middles|b|rough, Aer|ob|iotic, Boul|ton, H|all thrusters) and on 'URL', 'menu', 'browser'; pushes 'bar', 'Bar' and 'bars'.

L27n2264.name: Split-term tails → 'cost'
L27n2264.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a split name or term (Or|isk|any, Per|itone|al, poly|cy|stic, unw|arranted, inter|ventional), rarely the first piece. Pushes toward 'cost'/'Cost' (steered output: 'Cost cost cost').

L27n1982.name: Short word-start pieces, LaTeX
L27n1982.description: Fires on short or capital word-start pieces inside names and words, e.g. 'St' (Sticherus, stakeholder), 'Per' (Perak), 'w' (waddling), 'Re', 'Pro', 'Part'. Pushes toward the LaTeX backslash token; steered, it spams backslashes and newlines.

L27n157.name: Answer-start newline, verbs
L27n157.description: Fires on the blank line right after '</think>' that opens a chat answer, and on function words like 'of', 'in' and 'for' inside titles or clauses. Pushes toward bare verbs like 'make', 'decide', 'find' and 'define'; steered, it repeats 'find' or 'make'.

L27n2296.name: Verb onset 'st' fragment
L27n2296.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a word split mid-word, most often 'st' or 'w' in verbs (st|rolled, st|umbles, w|aded) and name pieces (Có|rdoba). Pushes toward 'bound'.

L24n318.name: Decade and plural endings
L24n318.description: Negative pole: fires on the piece that completes a decade or plural: the '0' in '1950s' and '1820s', the 's' after a decade, 'ful' in 'capfuls', and 'worm' in 'wireworms'. Pushing it negative writes word-continuation fragments and steers text into junk like 'sun sun'.

L27n2120.name: Prefix-like word start
L27n2120.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that begins with a prefix-like fragment: 'ref' in refueling, 'inf' in infirm, 'ef' in indefinite, 'suff' in suffused, 'unf' in unfunded, 'reaff' in reaffirmation, and 'spl' in splints. Pushed positive, it writes 'fix'/'fixed' and spams 'Fix'.

L26n540.name: Mid-word fragments, dash output
L26n540.description: Word-internal pieces, often 'ca', 'emb' or 'be' starts (be-zzlement, emb-rittlement, ca-ssonne); pushes hyphen-dash tokens such as '-' and '*-'.

L26n635.name: mid-word subword fragments
L26n635.description: Goes strongly negative on the second or later piece of a word split into tokens, mostly technical words and names ('mac' in macrolides, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'sn' in snippers, 'Car' in Carica). Pushes toward closing quote marks.

L26n2566.name: Ancient name starts
L26n2566.description: Negative on the first piece of a split proper or technical word, mostly ancient names and terms (Tar|quin, Sar|acen, Ass|ites, Ṛ|daya, bel|ittled, cred|iting); pushes toward the '&' token.

L27n1408.name: Place/person name pieces
L27n1408.description: A piece of a place or person name split into tokens (Có in Córdoba, cro in Croesus, Y in Yehuda), pushing 'knowledge'.

L24n811.name: Place-name first subword
L24n811.description: The first sub-word piece of a capitalised place name split into tokens, e.g. 'Bl' in Pine Bluff, 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Moz' in Mozambique, 'Ph' in Phatthalung, mostly after 'of', 'in' or a comma. Pushes the model toward code type names like Number, Buffer and String, with little visible effect on prose.

L27n2498.name: Word-start 'h' or 'st'
L27n2498.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting with 'h', 'st', 'br' or 'tr' when the word is split or follows a hyphen (Hit|tite, H|ellenic, st|ings, br|uxism, hon|ours, self-h|arming, tre|acherous); pushes output toward 'wear', 'clothing' and 'fashion'.

L27n814.name: Prepositions before noun phrases
L27n814.description: Fires (positive) on 'in', 'through' or 'and' right after a verb or noun and before a named setting or noun phrase ('in Kubernetes', 'in New Zealand', 'through our skin'); pushes toward 'idea', 'option' and 'choice'.

L23n1444.name: Subject pronoun before verb
L23n1444.description: Fires negatively on a subject pronoun or 'and', 'or', 'who' just before its verb ('what they didn't', 'you cannot', 'they should', 'who have'). Pushes toward 'fail' and 'failure', which repeat when steered.

L26n2738.name: descriptive adjectives in prose
L26n2738.description: Diffuse: fires weakly across most news and history prose, strongest on descriptive adjectives before a noun ('abandoned spacecraft', 'ambitious vision', 'spectacular finds', 'vast'). Pushes toward `` and '' quote marks.

L27n825.name: Word-start 'w' fragment
L27n825.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'w' or 'W' that starts a word piece (wobbling, wiser, wildfermentation, wen), and on 'ly' in aminoglycoside; pushes toward ')' and ']' closing brackets.

L25n632.name: 'Con-' starts, hedged 'not'
L25n632.description: Fires on word-start pieces 'Con', 'Cor' and 'And' (conventional, Conception, Andalusia) and on 'not', 'necessarily' and 'always' in hedged negations like 'does not necessarily'. Pushes toward 'parallel' and 'matching'.

L26n240.name: Lead-in before code block
L26n240.description: Fires on the colon, newline or open bracket that ends a lead-in before a command or code example ('running the following command:', 'Instead of typing', 'issue the command'). Pushes the model toward generic code words like 'top', 'board' and 'width'.

L25n2150.name: Months and conversational tone
L25n2150.description: Negative on 'convers' in 'conversational tone' prompts, on 'ger' in germs and geriatrics, and on the word just before a month or season ('coolest month ... is' June, 'mid-' June); pushes toward month names.

L26n275.name: Bracketed template placeholders
L26n275.description: The word inside a bracketed placeholder slot in templates, e.g. 'Dear [Name]', '[Project Name]', '[Client Name]', plus file-extension and URL tokens such as '.csv' and '://'; pushes toward closing code punctuation.

L26n1952.name: Mid-name fragments (negative)
L26n1952.description: Negative on a middle piece of a name or long word split into tokens (e.g. 'pr' in jurisprudence, 'vl' in Mevlana, 'Bl' in Blasco); its output points to 'opinion' and 'debate'.

L27n2321.name: 'qu' word-onset fragments
L27n2321.description: Fires on the first sub-token of words starting with 'qu' (Qu|inoa, qu|asar, qu|illed, qu|artile, qu|ell), and on some name onsets (Ja|én, Gu|imarães, Dev|onta). Pushes toward 'article'; steered, it repeats 'article article'.

L27n989.name: Verb-stem word fragments
L27n989.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a longer word, especially verb or adjective stems (puzz|ling, padd|ler, add|ing, fre|eware, short| courses, white| syndromes). Pushes toward 'list' and 'lists'; steered, it spams 'list list'.

L25n138.name: Titles before names
L25n138.description: Fires on honorifics and name-leading tokens, peaking on the period after 'Dr' (Dr. Shaheen, Dr. Anastos) and on 'Professor', 'Mrs', 'President'. Pushed positive, it promotes uppercase codes like 'FI', 'BE', 'IRLD' and spams them.

L27n2397.name: Prefix piece, writes program
L27n2397.description: Prefix pieces that open a word, especially 'rep' (repurpose), 'ref' (refueling), 'Pro'/'pr', 'Matth' (Matthaei), 'immun' (immunisation); pushes toward 'program(s)'.

L27n1245.name: Word-start fragments, dashes
L27n1245.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word, mostly 'rem' (remove, remember), 'clim' (climatic), 'cr', 'prim'; pushes toward runs of dashes or dots.

L27n1908.name: Lone 'd' word-start
L27n1908.description: Fires on a lone 'd' or 'D' that begins a word piece, often after a hyphen or at a split word start, such as 'Und|eclared', 'd|umb', 'D|ialysis', 'flower-d|otted' and 'anti-d|rying'; pushes 'die/death'.

L27n2484.name: re-/o- word fragments
L27n2484.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, mostly 're' (reclamation, reintegration, reigned), 'sur' (surges), 'o' (oysters), 'Dor' (Dorset), 'Ch' (Chhattisgarh). Pushes toward 'claim/assert' tokens; steered, it spams 'claim'.

L25n91.name: URL starts, closing terms
L25n91.description: Diffuse: fires (negative) on 'http' or 'https' starting a URL (://), and on the word just before a closing bracket or quote, e.g. '<package-name>', 'learning rate', 'may be present'. Pushes toward quote and closing characters; steering gives no clear effect.

L27n977.name: Mid-name fragment, paren closers
L27n977.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name or word, such as 'ir' in Hirundo, 'B' in Tisha B'Av, 'm' in Mid-nite, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Su' in Suess, or '-K' in Skutnabb-Kangas. Pushes toward closing ')' and '")' tokens and periods.

L26n2189.name: Compound-term first halves
L26n2189.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or two-word term: 'pay' in payback period, 'phil' in philadelphus, 'Nickel' in Nickelodeon, 'solic' in solicitor, 'Golden' in Golden Retriever. Pushes toward 'back' and 'returned'.

L26n763.name: Word-start pieces, 'they' output
L26n763.description: The first subword piece of a longer word split into tokens, such as 'dec' in decarbonise, 'sa' in sauté, 'ma' in Mahal and 'thr' in thrived. Pushes toward 'they' and 'them'.

L25n1822.name: Proper-name pieces, 'via' output
L25n1822.description: A first or second piece of a place name or surname split into tokens (Bal-ochistan, W-onsan, Ag-artala, Hotamis-lig-il). Pushes toward prepositions 'via' and 'through'.

L27n1763.name: Word-initial 'm' in lists
L27n1763.description: Fires on a lone 'm' (or 'pr') that opens a split word in lists of animals, plants and things ('m'ites, 'm'ussels, 'm'ackerel, 'pr'airies, 'm'ists); pushes toward 'option(s)', which does not follow from the reading.

L27n713.name: Word pieces, closing brackets
L27n713.description: Goes negative on a piece that starts a new fragment of a split word, e.g. 'ce' in isosceles, 'FA' in FADE IN, 'vert' in vertebrae. Pushes toward closing brackets and braces such as ')' and '}'.

L27n1936.name: Capital name openers
L27n1936.description: Fires on the capital opener of a proper name split into pieces (Car|ibbean, Ul|ster, Ram|ihantaniarivo, Rom|mel, Ros|alind, Wil|son); also 'cross' before 'flow'; pushed negative it promotes 'reference'.

L27n2294.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L27n2294.description: The first or second piece of a word split into several tokens, such as 'pr' in prairie/pruned, 'cre' in crevice, 'de' in deprotonated, or 'bor' in seborrhea, fires on the incomplete fragment before the word is finished. The completing piece and whole words stay near zero. It pushes the model toward surgery, bone and meat words, and when pushed it spams 'meat'.

L26n2715.name: Name/stem start, writes enhance
L26n2715.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'Có' (Córdoba), 'Č' (Tomo Čačić), 'kr' (krill), 'pal' (palmitoleic), 'wal' (walnuts), 'ith' (clarithromycin); writes 'enhance/enhancement' tokens.

L27n1502.name: Mid-word stems, 'document'
L27n1502.description: Fires negatively on the second piece of a split word, especially 'pend' in Harpenden, 'enced' in a split word, and standalone 'D' or '-d' starting words and names. Pushes the model toward 'document' and 'doc'.

L27n2899.name: Single 'g' word-start piece
L27n2899.description: Fires (goes negative) on a lone 'g' or 'G' piece that begins a word or follows a hyphen (-g in fully-grown, G in Guelph, g in gorges, gilded, gout, Gait), plus 'og' in aminoglycoside and 'ah' in docosahexaenoic; pushes output toward 'balance' and 'balanced' tokens.

L27n2796.name: Word-start g/sh/be
L27n2796.description: Fires on a word-initial piece 'g', 'sh' or 'be' that starts a split word, e.g. 'g' in gums or grafted, 'be' in beaded, 'sh' in shampoos; pushes the model toward 'remove'/'removal'.

L27n2626.name: Stra/tra word starts
L27n2626.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'Stra' in Straits, 'tra' in Trauma, 'bre' in breasted, 'til' in tilting, 'Bal' in Balancing. Writes 'ay' pieces.

L19n2973.name: Line break after title
L19n2973.description: The newline, or the '?', ')' or '.' just before it, that ends a short title, heading or metadata line: 'Written by⏎', 'Vol: 21, No: 21⏎', 'Article number: 645 (2019)⏎', 'Marketing?⏎'. No clear output vocabulary; the dose pushes it into whitespace runs.

L27n1323.name: Word stem, s-suffix push
L27n1323.description: Positive on a short fragment inside a split word, e.g. 'wid|ows', 'water|-soluble', 'Ex|cretory', '-ex|posure', 'NOP|ASSWD', peaking on the fragment itself. Pushes toward 's' or 'S' tokens; steered output spams 'S' or 's'.

L27n1830.name: Proper-noun first fragment
L27n1830.description: Fires on the first subword of a capitalized name or place split into pieces (e.g. 'Sch' in Schueller, 'Ab' in Abilene, 'N' in Nauvoo, 'he' in heathen). Pushes the model toward 'largest', 'larger' and 'biggest'.

L27n963.name: Capitalized split-word start
L27n963.description: The first piece of a capitalized word or term split into tokens (G in Ghetto, C in CARRY, iber in Beriberi, ih in hydrogen, B in Blessed, hydro in hydroponic). Pushes toward 'change'.

L26n2576.name: Verb stem before suffix
L26n2576.description: The first piece of a split verb or adjective, e.g. 'compl' in complies, 'imp' in implicate, 'ab' in abridged, 'priv' in privy. Pushes toward 'reset'; steered, it spams 'reset'.

L27n1091.name: Word fragments; writes 'o'
L27n1091.description: Fires on word-internal fragments of technical or rare words, e.g. 'cre' (crevice), 'rhe' (rheology), 'pneum', 'gor' (Novgorod), 'my' (myotoxic), 'ple' (pleural). Pushes the model toward 'o' pieces (steering spams 'Oo').

L26n48.name: URL and bracket mix
L26n48.description: Diffuse; peaks on URL fragments, numbers, code literals, Arabic names and quote marks (www, youtu.be, 0xA4, ibn in Ibn Rushd, the paren after a number); pushes brackets and ellipses like '()', '...' and '{', so steering gives junk and bracket spam.

L26n3050.name: Word-start cluster, writes 'train'
L26n3050.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a word that opens with a consonant cluster or capitals, e.g. 'Str' in Stroudwater, 'contr' in contrarious, 'extr' in extracurricular, 'TR' in TRULY. Pushes toward 'train' and 'training' tokens.

L25n855.name: Technical terms, 'change'
L25n855.description: Mixed technical terms: 'Hor' (Horowitz, Horrible), 'py' in enthalpy, 'Therm', 'Pro', plus 'of' or 'average' in definitions like 'rate of change'. Pushes toward 'change' and 'changes'.

L26n1094.name: Name starts, modal verbs
L26n1094.description: Fires on the first piece of organisation and person names (ECMWF, Emancipation, Brian Grant, Pontifical, Gutzon Borglum, Tan-Zam) and on modal 'can' or 'may' in health text; pushes output toward 'last'.

L27n982.name: Predicts number words
L27n982.description: Fires on short label tokens that open a list item or field, such as a lone 'G' or 'g', '|', ':', an opening quote or '-', mostly in web text and tables. Pushes the next token toward number words (One, Three, Four).

L25n2603.name: 'array' and name fragments
L25n2603.description: Fires on the word 'array' in programming prompts (Java, Perl, Ruby, PHP) and on name fragments such as Hend- in Hendrickson and Ant- in Antonios. Pushes toward 'ref' and 'reference'; at dose -0.5 it drifts into 'refresher' filler.

L26n1122.name: Relative pronouns, 'power' output
L26n1122.description: 'that' or 'which' opening a relative clause right after a noun ('cells that cover', 'panels that draw'), plus 'it', 'they' and 'to' after a verb. Pushes toward 'power'.

L25n1297.name: Recipe-word opener fragments
L25n1297.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, often in recipe or food text ('ak' in shakshuka, 'ste' in steamed, 'sl' in slivered, 'Ty' in Tylenol, 'ze' in zebras); pushed negative, it makes the model say 'span' or 'sp'.

L27n1244.name: Word-onset s-clusters
L27n1244.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially s-clusters: 'sc' in 'screech', 'squ' in 'squirts', 'sl', 'Sk', 'suff' in 'suffocate', 'sap' in 'sapodilla'. Pushes toward 'he' and 'she' pronouns; steered, it spams 'he he he'.

L27n532.name: Name onsets, comma punctuation
L27n532.description: Positive on the first piece of a capitalized name or term (Dal|mau, Mu|hammad, Be|cciu, D|vur), pushing toward Chinese-style punctuation such as '，' and '：'.

L22n1313.name: Name fragments, matrix articles
L22n1313.description: Diffuse: fires positive on subword pieces inside names (the 'ur' in Kapurthala, 'our' in Gourdie, 'pp' in Köppen) and on 'a', 'the', 'as' and 'having' in linear-algebra text. Pushes toward 'identity'.

L26n1087.name: Ram/Est name onsets
L26n1087.description: The opening fragment of a split name, mostly 'Ram' (Ramayana, Ramkham, Ramnians), plus 'Est', 'Pret', 'Lib', and 'Cham'. Pushes toward C++ tokens such as '.cpp' and 'cout'.

L27n1340.name: Opening piece, long words
L27n1340.description: A short mid-word piece that opens a long word or name (ts|unami, Sus|ilo, fil|icaleans, sal|amandas, tet|raplegia, Sal|azar). Pushes toward 'param'/'parameter' tokens.

L25n3009.name: Tech spec modifiers
L25n3009.description: The number or modifier inside technical hardware and science names, e.g. '7' in '7-inch display', '4' in '4x4 keypad', 'Color' in 'Ocean Color Imager', 'Daw' in 'Dawes Gap'; pushes toward 'channel'.

L27n2720.name: 'v' in viral words
L27n2720.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'v' piece in viral and vaccine compounds (retro|viral, anti|retroviral, non|viral) and on 'lem' in Charlemagne; pushes toward 'mag' tokens.

L27n428.name: Parenthesis and citation openers
L27n428.description: Fires (positive) on an opening '(' before a name, or on the first token of a date, citation or phonetic bracket ('(Litchi', '(Boydston', 'Mar. 1'); pushes toward digits.

L25n2088.name: Verb after infinitive 'to'
L25n2088.description: The first piece of the verb right after 'to' or 'could not' (to wh-iten, to th-icken, TO D-ETERMINE, to foot the bill). Pushes toward unrelated word fragments like 'aren' and 'oten'.

L27n276.name: Sentence opener to nouns
L27n276.description: Negative pole fires on sentence openers (Under, By, In, After); pushes toward nouns such as book, board and box.

L27n1527.name: Stem before -row
L27n1527.description: Word-middle piece right before a 'row' or 'rows' ending (nar|rows, bur|rows, corn|rows, eb|row), plus 'elect' in electrons; pushes toward 'row'.

L26n1146.name: Split name first pieces
L26n1146.description: Fires negative on the first piece of a split name or rare word after a space: 'zew' in Przewalski, 'Sp' in Spence, 'Su' in Suess, 'ru' in Pantagruelion. Steered, it pushes 'corner' or 'angle' and spams them.

L27n166.name: Technical fragments, bracket output
L27n166.description: Fires on pieces of split words in technical or name contexts (contr in contraption, ant in antitrust, ax in astaxanthin, ir in seventeenth, anch in Naduvanchery); pushes toward bracket-plus-letter tokens like '(s' and '[t'.

L27n1770.name: Titles/names, colour push
L27n1770.description: Capitalized titles and names, e.g. 'Chancellor' in Angela Merkel's title, 'the' in 'Magnificent', 'Royal' in Royal Highness. Negative firing pushes colour words 'black', 'white', 'blue'.

L26n1243.name: Contracted negative stems
L26n1243.description: Fires on the stem of a contracted negative ('isn', 'doesn', 'aren', 'shouldn') just before the apostrophe-t, and on 'Copyright'. Pushes toward HTML entity starts like '&' and '"'.

L26n1562.name: Word-start par, b
L26n1562.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word split over tokens, especially 'par' (Parmesan, parrots, Parthenon), 'b' (breading, bumbling, biodegradable) and 'po' (poachers); pushes toward number words and steers into 'Five five five' spam.

L25n1069.name: 'm'/'rem' fragments, mix output
L25n1069.description: The 'm' or 'rem' piece opening a word split into tokens, in lists of foods, objects and mixing or mashing tasks (m|ango, m|asher, rem|oves, verm|ilion); pushes toward 'mix' and 'mixed'.

L27n2178.name: Capitalised name fragments
L27n2178.description: Fires on capitalised first pieces of names or split words, e.g. 'Pl' in 'Platonist' and 'Plague', 'Bel' in 'Belgrave', '-S' in 'Alka-Seltzer'; pushes toward 'sim/simulation' tokens.

L27n1111.name: Decade digits in 19X0s
L27n1111.description: Fires negative on the decade digit in years written as 19|2|0s, 19|7|0s or 19|9|0s, and on split 'al' or 'cl' word pieces; pushes output toward the letters 'O' and 'o' (Ooo runs).

L27n2509.name: Name start → 'part'
L27n2509.description: Goes strongly negative on the start of a name or split word ('Wil' in Wil Wheaton, 'Par' in Paraguay, 'par' in parrots, 'Fr' in Frisian); when negated, it pushes toward 'part' and 'parts'.

L27n2418.name: Hum/name starts, menu output
L27n2418.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, strongest on Hum (Humane, humankind, Hummingbird) and Laf in Lafitte; pushes toward 'menu' tokens.

L24n1003.name: Split-name fragments, 'using'
L24n1003.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word or name (e.g. 'Fore', 'Mont', 'Hor' in Horizonte) and on 'using' or a product name right before a tech name ('using F#', 'Microsoft Edge'); pushes toward 'System'.

L23n978.name: Indefinite a/an before nouns
L23n978.description: Fires on indefinite 'a' or 'an' before a countable noun in technical how-to text ('stored in [a] number of buckets', 'creates [an] array', 'a sorting algorithm'), and on 'memory'. Pushes toward 'temp' and 'temporary'.

L27n1826.name: Mid-word split fragments
L27n1826.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment in a split word, especially the second or third piece of a longer term (Min|st|rel, wil|debeest, omni|sc|ient, Przewal|zew|ski). Pushes toward 'rel'.

L25n51.name: Word-start fragment, placeholder markup
L25n51.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens (Ne in Neolithic, Radi, diagn, Phon, etch), strongest while the word is still unfinished; pushes toward markdown bold and asterisks and blank placeholder marks like [ ] and ____.

L27n2469.name: Lone-letter word-start fragments
L27n2469.description: Fires (goes negative) on the short first piece of a word split across tokens, often a lone consonant or syllable (w in wondrous/wiser/waned, c in ceded, per in periphery, fer in ferocious); pushed negative, it writes 'coin/money' tokens.

L26n258.name: Joiners in compounds
L26n258.description: Fires on the piece right after a compound joiner or punctuation in citations, URLs and technical terms: 'bio' in biofuels, 'o' in osteo|arthritis, 'xy' in hydro|xy|apatite, and '(' or '“' before a unit or quote. Pushes toward short word-ending pieces (-er, -ed, -en).

L26n666.name: Name opening piece, pattern
L26n666.description: Fires negative on the opening piece of a name split into tokens, e.g. 'Ash' in Ash|kelon, 'Suk' in Suk|hpur, 'Rab' in Rab|ier, 'Wak' in Wak|ayama, 'Sp' in Sp|inal, 'pa' in pa|lettes, 'ra' in sauerk|raut. Pushes toward 'pattern' tokens.

L27n1014.name: Rare-word mid pieces
L27n1014.description: Fires on a middle or first piece of a rare split word, e.g. 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'esp' in Vespasianus, 'cl' in clots, 'pl' in germplasm; pushes toward 'user' tokens.

L27n1277.name: Name-start fragments, brackets
L27n1277.description: The first piece of a split proper name or taxon (Gle|icheniaceae, Sel|aginellaceae, Salv|iniaceae, Gu|imarães, Br|unsbüttel) or word (f|ables, str|angle-weed), right before its continuation; pushes toward closing brackets and quotes like ) and 」.

L26n904.name: Name-start fragments, bare 'n'
L26n904.description: Goes negative on the start of a multi-letter name or abbreviation split into tokens, like 'Man' in Manitoba, 'San' in San Francisco, 'Min' in Minn., and the 'N' in [D-NY]; pushes toward a bare 'n' or 'N'.

L26n558.name: Compound-name first pieces
L26n558.description: Positive on the first piece of a multi-token compound or name, such as 'Emergency' in Federal Emergency Relief, 'Jim' in Jim Crow, 'Bay' in Baycrest, 'Border' in Border Protection. Pushes the model toward 'photo'.

L19n2164.name: Year digits, placeholder braces
L19n2164.description: Fires negatively on heterogeneous mid-token pieces: the digit after '20' in years ('202|0'), the '3' in 'pip3', 'I' in a quoted line, and 'http' after a sentence; pushes toward template placeholders like '{X}', '[args' and 'xxx', and at -0.5 writes '*X*' and '{X} {Y}' filler.

L27n1671.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n1671.description: Word-initial consonant clusters split off from the rest of the word (cr|umble, Fl|ank, bl|anch, contr|ived, f|eta); pushes the model toward 'expected' and 'expect'.

L27n2463.name: Middle pieces of words
L27n2463.description: The middle or second piece of a word split into three or more tokens, e.g. 'oo' in sm|oo|ching, 'clo' in clo|aking, 'oph' in Hymen|oph|yllaceae, 'ago' in M|ago|thy; pushes toward 'this', 'these', 'those'.

L27n1284.name: Name fragments, surnames
L27n1284.description: Strongly negative on a name fragment, usually the first piece of a surname, such as 'Hos' in Hosfeld, 'Mol' in Molinaro, 'Her' in Herdwick, and 'chen' in Vlaschenko. Pushes toward 'find/finding', which it repeats when steered.

L27n1621.name: Name pieces to context
L27n1621.description: Negative on the first letter or piece of a rare name or scientific term (L|avinia, L|orraine, heter|osporous, cl|enching); pushes toward 'context' and 'ctx' tokens.

L27n1601.name: Name pieces to handle
L27n1601.description: Negative on a mid-word piece inside a rare name or taxon (Psoph|odes, Hymen|ophyllaceae, Ap|ollinaris, La|Hood); pushes toward 'handle' and 'handling' tokens.

L25n865.name: Rare-name first piece, braces
L25n865.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a rare multi-token name or long word (e.g. 'Ar' in Delftia acidovorans, 'Tur' in Turbine Hall, 'Nav' in Navajo, 'Zam' in Zambezi, 'Mult' in multifunctional); steering it negative pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L25n2582.name: Quality adjectives: good, best
L25n2582.description: Fires on evaluative adjectives after 'a' or 'the' (good fit, best surfing, very popular, better tools, best practice), and on some first name pieces (Yud|hoyono). Pushes toward 'value' and 'economy'.

L27n853.name: Acronym first letters
L27n853.description: Goes negative on the first letter of an acronym or institution name in a proper-noun slot, such as 'A' in 'Texas A&M', 'E' in 'EPA', 'C' in 'CBO', 'H' in 'HIT' and 'A' in 'AWWA'; pushes 'team/teams'.

L27n1002.name: Negative: odd word pieces
L27n1002.description: Fires strongly negative on odd word pieces (-lo in self-love, ə in Middlesbrough, ste in steaming), pushing 'an' or 'as'.

L27n1765.name: 'Happen' verbs; writes 'inf'
L27n1765.description: Goes strongly negative on verbs of occurring or going, e.g. 'happen' (every day), 'goes' (beyond), 'occur', 'go' (away), plus 'New' in place names and 'neu' in neuroma. Pushing it negative steers toward 'Inf' and 'exp' pieces.

L27n711.name: Short word-start fragment Le/Re/Te
L27n711.description: Fires on a short capitalized first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'Le', 'Re', 'Te', 'Fe' starting names or words (Leukocytes, Leptin, Leibniz, Tees) and 'tre' in 'treacherous'. Pushes toward a '+' followed by a capital letter.

L27n2487.name: Mid-word fragments, 'wind'
L27n2487.description: Fires on a second or later piece of a word split into tokens (ict in Wydawnictwo, Gour- in Gourdie, Przew-als, Th- in thicken); pushes 'wind' and 'Tw'.

L27n460.name: 'feel'/'fl' word starts
L27n460.description: Fires on the verb or adjective after a subject in phrases like 'make patients feel comfortable' ('feel', 'specially'), and on word starts 'fl' and 'pol' (flank, fluvial, polycystic). Pushes the model toward adjectives like 'consistent', 'compatible' and 'unique'.

L21n3019.name: Question or type-name opener
L21n3019.description: Fires negatively on the first word of a question or instruction ('What', 'Add', 'Remove') and on type names ('int', 'float', 'string'). Pushes toward '[]' brackets, the array or list syntax, which appear when steered.

L25n768.name: word-initial e and é
L25n768.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'e' or 'E', or accented 'é' or 'É', that starts a word or abbreviation ('e.g.', 'eukaryotes', 'E.coli', 'ecosystems', 'émigré'). Pushes toward 'if' and 'si'.

L27n2197.name: Mid-word piece to upper
L27n2197.description: Strongly negative on a middle subword of a long word split into pieces, such as 'unw' in unworthy, 'vir' in retrovirus, 'in' in rhinotracheitis or 'ile' in Marsileaceae. Pushes toward 'upper' and 'upload'.

L27n2527.name: Start of proper name
L27n2527.description: The first piece of a proper name, place or person ('Lake' in Lake Erie, 'Ban|ff', 'Ost|ia', 'Dim|ocarpus', 'Zheng' He). Pushes toward 'effect' and 'effects' tokens.

L27n2633.name: Medical word middle piece
L27n2633.description: Strongly positive on the middle piece of a split medical or science word ('in' in 'Veter|in|arians', 'uk' in 'Le|uk|ocytes', 'ri' in 'sebor|rhea', 'hemat', 'melan'). Pushes 'Python', 'Java' and 'programming' tokens.

L27n2584.name: 'se' onsets, 'curve'
L27n2584.description: Positive on 'se' word onsets (se|borrhea, se|psis, se|pal) and on 'div' (div|inity, div|estment), pushing toward 'curve' tokens.

L27n2682.name: Mid-word fragments, 'sec'
L27n2682.description: Fires positively on pieces of words and names that start mid-word: 'Health' in CDC Health Statistics, 'cam' in camotes, 'og' in aminoglycosides, 'Sem' in Seminary, and '/s' in a sudoers closing tag. Pushes the model toward 'sec', 'Sec' and 'security'.

L26n1984.name: Proper name opening piece
L26n1984.description: Opening piece of a proper or place name split into tokens (Poly|technic, Bav|aria, Pot|omac, Hung|a Haʻapai, Battle of Gettysburg); pushes toward 'technique' and 'technical'.

L27n3065.name: Name start, writes di
L27n3065.description: The first piece of a name or split word, e.g. 'Có' (Córdoba), 'Go' (Goebbels), 'Be' (Beccaliu), 'sou' (soups); pushes toward 'di'/'Di'.

L26n1018.name: Line-end word (negative)
L26n1018.description: Negative on the last word of a list item or label, just before a line break or period (e.g. 'deficiency', 'site', 'answers'); its output points to closing quote tokens.

L27n2112.name: Technical compound first pieces
L27n2112.description: Fires on the first piece of a technical compound split across tokens, strongest on pharmac in pharmacodynamic and object in object-oriented; pushes toward 'dynamic' tokens.

L27n1194.name: Split 'un' prefix
L27n1194.description: The 'un' piece of a word split into tokens (un|banked, un|regulated, un|viable), and dashes before an appositive. Pushes toward 'on'/'ons' word endings.

L27n1186.name: 're' and 'op' prefixes
L27n1186.description: Fires on a short prefix piece that opens a word split into tokens, mainly 're' ('well-researched', re|trieval, re|productive, re|cks) and 'op' (vas|op|ressin, Neo|op|latonic). Pushes toward 'product' and 'products'; steered, it spams 'Product product'.

L26n2569.name: Name-start fragment, weak
L26n2569.description: Goes weakly negative (about 4-6 of 10) on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mat' in Matoniaceae, 'Tam' in tampons, 'sm' in smokes, 'Ray' in Ray Hubbard; pushes toward 'survey' and 'Sur' tokens.

L27n525.name: Hyphen-split piece, writes 're'
L27n525.description: Fires on a word piece right after a hyphen or inside a place name, most strongly 'iddles' in Middlesbrough and 'un' after a prefix. Pushes toward 're' word-ending tokens, so steered output is 'rerere'.

L27n1131.name: Single-letter onset, time-units
L27n1131.description: Fires on a one-letter or very short onset token opening a technical or name word split into tokens ('g'orges, 'og'lycoside, 'N'auvoo, 'n'avel, 'g'rafted); pushes toward time units 'years', 'days', 'hours', 'months'.

L26n116.name: Name fragments → 'transition'
L26n116.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, like 'mat' in 'bas-mati', 'Taj' in 'Taj Mahal', 'akes' in Marrakesh and 'Nay' in Nayak; pushes toward 'transition', 'transform' and 'initialize'.

L26n345.name: Digits inside big numbers
L26n345.description: Fires on a single digit in the middle of a comma-grouped number (the 5 in 157,000, the 9 in 115,391), mostly in population and money figures; pushing it toward full-width punctuation ('，', '：') and junk tokens.

L27n838.name: Capitalized H/B/T onsets
L27n838.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or word, mostly H, Har, B, T, Th, Ar or Sh (Harbinder, Haven't, Babylon, Talmud, Tibbon, Arnett). Pushes toward exclamation marks.

L26n10.name: Parenthesis and word-start pieces
L26n10.description: Fires on an opening '(' before a measurement or conversion (like '(188 km)'), and on the first letters of a word split across tokens, such as Psycho and pharmac. Pushes toward sentence punctuation ('…', '。', ':', '...'); at dose 0.5 it emits blank lines.

L27n2431.name: Mid-word fragments, writes 'cl'
L27n2431.description: Fires on a piece inside a split or hyphenated word ('u' in radionuclide, '-e' in cotton-eating, 'dis' in superoxide dismutase, '-E' in super-Earths). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'cl' tokens (Cl, CL, cl), and the output spams 'Cl cl'.

L27n1807.name: Word-start pieces, 'fast'
L27n1807.description: Fires on the 'as' in 'such as' and on the first piece of split names (Cal-iphate, Abdul, Min-aret, Ro-che); pushes speed words 'fast', 'quick', and 'rapid'.

L27n515.name: Conjunctions after noun phrases
L27n515.description: Fires on a conjunction or relative word ('and', 'or', 'that', 'which', 'these') right after a noun or clause, where a new clause or alternative starts ('allergies and forms', 'diseases or injuries', 'cells which'); pushes toward 'result', 'cause' and 'form'.

L21n2482.name: Negation 'not' and count
L21n2482.description: Goes strongly negative on 'not' or 'NOT' after is/are/do ('is not eligible', 'NOT recommended', 'not required'), and on count/counted/counting words. Pushing it negative makes the model spam 'count'.

L27n1720.name: Word-initial letter f
L27n1720.description: Fires on the letter 'f' or 'F' when it starts a word or word piece, especially after a hyphen ('-f' in '-forked', '-film') or as a capital starting a word (Festival, Fables). Pushes toward 'parse' tokens.

L27n1028.name: Health text, profession nouns
L27n1028.description: Fires on word fragments and mid-phrase words in health and science text, such as 'intr' in intravenous, 'chronic', 'with' in covered with, or 'financial'; the pole promotes profession nouns like 'logger', 'scientist', 'doctor', and steered output repeats them.

L26n773.name: Second word of titles
L26n773.description: Goes negative on the second word of a capitalized title or institution (Emancipation Proclamation, Working Class, Constitutional Convention, Public Education). Pushes toward first-person pronouns 'My', 'We' and 'Me', and steering spams 'My'.

L0n1301.name: Rare-word middle pieces
L0n1301.description: Fires on the later pieces of long or rare words split into several tokens (Blu|-ray, per|ished, Gen|ocide, in|quiring, Em|phas|ize, In|uit); pushes toward generic connectives and newlines.

L26n2046.name: Word starts ro, Mer
L26n2046.description: Fires on short word-start pieces of split words (ro in roselike and Roche, Mer in Merthyr, Mar in Marquesas, fer in ferocious, Ar in Arctica); pushes toward 'strategy' tokens and steers into 'Strategy strategy' spam.

L25n2730.name: Short E/cad opening fragment
L25n2730.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letter piece of a split word, often a capital 'E' or 'cad' (E|ars, E|uphrates, cad|mium, enc|roachment, phen|omena). Pushes toward 'fall' and 'falls'.

L27n2185.name: Word-start fragments; forbidden
L27n2185.description: The first piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly capitalised or consonant-cluster starts such as 'St' in 'Stuffed', 'Pl' in 'Plague', 'Cr' in 'crater', 'car' in 'carob'. Pushes toward 'forbidden', 'excluded', 'banned', 'prohibited'.

L27n1545.name: Word piece, writes increasing
L27n1545.description: Fires on a continuation piece of a word split into tokens (e.g. 'ste' in steaming, 'sne' in sneezing, 'wal' in walnuts, 'omy' in Saccharomyces, 'um' in Mpumalanga); pushes 'increasing', 'changing' and 'growing'; steered output loops 'Increasing increasing'.

L27n1170.name: Bitcoin and Ethereum tokens
L27n1170.description: Cryptocurrency names, mainly 'Ethereum' and 'Bitcoin' and 'eth' in ETH, plus a few title words like 'A' in A Song of Ice; pushes toward 'white' and 'White', spamming 'White white'.

L27n1989.name: Word-start 'sp' or 'p'
L27n1989.description: The 'sp' or lone 'p' that opens a word split into tokens ('sp|ayed', 'sp|ears', 'sp|ines', 'p|atted', 'p|iled'). Pushes toward 'share' tokens.

L25n1581.name: Word-start ir/ar/str cluster
L25n1581.description: The opening 'ir', 'ar', 'str', 'gr' or 'fr' piece of a word split into tokens (ir|ritable, ir|ises, ar|mpits, str|atosphere, Ar|terial, Str|asburg); pushes toward 'move/transfer' words.

L26n1643.name: Word-initial capital fragments
L26n1643.description: Negative on a capitalized word-start piece, often a lone 'N' or 'Sch'/'Br' that begins a longer word (e.g. 'N' in Numbing, 'N' in Navel, 'NORC'). Pushes the model toward 'normal'.

L27n454.name: Word fragments, turn breaks
L27n454.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces (e.g. 'Pr' in 'Di|Pr|ima') and on the newline gap right after a user turn ends and the assistant's '<think>' block opens; pushing it negative makes replies terse, with short declarative sentences.

L26n2390.name: Stems before suffixes
L26n2390.description: Fires on the stem of a verb or adjective split before its suffix, such as 'ste' in steamed and steaming, 'st' in starched, 'app' in appalled and 'int' in intonation. Pushes toward 'seem' tokens.

L27n477.name: Mid-word fragments of nouns
L27n477.description: Fires on the mid-word piece of a split noun (dwar|fs, phag|ocytes, Nil|otes, quas|ars, oas|ises); pushes output toward generic nouns 'elements', 'components' and 'tokens'.

L27n864.name: Verb after auxiliary
L27n864.description: Fires on the main verb or participle right after an auxiliary or 'is/be/had' (is used, is injected, have not exercised, then works, starts acting), plus some word-piece tails like 'ole' and 'ested'; pushes toward 'system' tokens.

L27n1877.name: Prefix-like word starts
L27n1877.description: Negative on the first piece of a split word that starts with a common prefix, e.g. 'Comp' in Organic Compounds, 'con' in concentric, 'dis' in superoxide dismutase, 'Dis' in Discovered; pushes toward 'complex' tokens.

L26n2654.name: Term-start fragments, tensor output
L26n2654.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a medical, botanical or technical term split into tokens (intr|avascular, otr|acheitis, Pr|EP, ost|oma, abs|cess, Pr|uning); pushes toward 'tensor' and 'TensorFlow'.

L11n1376.name: Digits and mid-phrase words
L11n1376.description: Fires positively on a digit inside a number or ordinal ('3' in 100th, '9' in 91st, the '1116' in a statute) and on assorted mid-phrase words ('large', 'run', 'mind', 'heat'). Writes code-like tokens and asterisks; steered output becomes asterisk runs.

L23n1692.name: Word-end fragments and names
L23n1692.description: Fires on a later piece of a word or name split across tokens, such as 'd' in Honeydew, 'pend' in Harpenden, 'ond' in Arhonditsis, and 'Santa' in Santa Barbara. Pushes toward 'dictionary' and 'dict', which the reading does not explain.

L26n484.name: Opening paren or quote
L26n484.description: Fires on an opening '(' or opening curly quote that begins an aside, definition or quoted phrase (confidence level (a margin..., Excessive DHT (DHT), a “sudden cascade”), plus task verbs like Compose, Create, Craft and Write. Pushes toward a bare 'a' token; steering yields 'aaaa' loops.

L27n392.name: Second piece of names
L27n392.description: Fires on the second piece of a split proper name or rare word, e.g. 'Hos|ack', 'Nov|gorod', 'Sut|ak', 'Marr|akes'; pushes toward 'kin/ki' spam.

L26n2786.name: Stem fragment, writes 'gen'
L26n2786.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly science stems (e.g. 'chlor' in chlorides, 'cultiv' in cultivars, 'rust' in rustica); pushes 'generation' and a bare 'g' token.

L26n1158.name: Split names, animal words
L26n1158.description: Fires on a piece of a split or capitalised name ('th' in hawthorn, 'WH' in WHSmith, 'National' in agency names) and on animal words like walruses, lion, dog bites. Pushes toward 'pet', 'animal', 'dog' and 'cat'.

L27n759.name: Word-start fragments, closers
L27n759.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into tokens (e.g. 'exp' in expel, 'dec' in decoupled, 'cor' in corals, 'mar' in marveled, 'Th' in Thelypteridaceae); pushes closing brackets like '}' and ')'.

L27n530.name: Name-piece start, digits out
L27n530.description: Negative on the first piece of a split name or rare word (contr in contrarious, decre in decrees, gl in glia, pur in purports, De in DeLores, Al in Al-Ghazali). Pushes toward digits; steered output shows digit strings.

L26n1353.name: Short mid-word fragment
L26n1353.description: Goes strongly negative on a short 1-3 letter piece inside or opening a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'if' in Porifera, 'ver' in Averroes, 'rit' in fritters, 'f' in frogs, 'inf' in infested; pushes toward 'Fl' tokens.

L22n1408.name: Year and place-name fragments
L22n1408.description: Fires on the token just before a year or large number ('Year' in 'Year - 2017', 'ends about' before '65 million years') and on word pieces of place names like 'Chern-ob-yl' and 'Siber-ia'; pushes toward '(-' and 'negative'.

L27n1262.name: Technical word fragments, 'food'
L27n1262.description: Diffuse: fires on pieces of technical words (Gradient in Extreme Gradient boosting, nond in nondiscriminatory, intr in intravascular) and on 'food' in resource lists; pushes toward 'des/Des' tokens.

L27n1237.name: Word-initial h/wh onset
L27n1237.description: Single-letter or short onset 'h', 'wh', or 'Th' starting a word split into pieces (h|awking, h|atching, wh|odunits, wh|istling, Th|esis). Pushes toward 'running' and 'living'.

L26n2630.name: Dev word stems
L26n2630.description: The stem 'dev' in deviance/deviate and similar split stems, plus names such as Mandeb, Caliph and Veneto. Reads a word stem and pushes toward word-ending suffix pieces such as '-etic', '-ical', '-emia' and '-ems'.

L27n1133.name: Word-start piece, writes read
L27n1133.description: Goes negative on word-start fragments of multi-token words, notably 'ste' (steamed, steamer), 'ret' (retelling), 'Edition', and '-th' (ruby-throated); pushes toward 'read'/'reading'.

L26n2763.name: Verb onset pieces
L26n2763.description: The onset piece of split verbs, e.g. 'sh' in sh|elve, sh|ored, sh|ut; 'fl' in fl|ank, fl|uff; 'unc' in unc|overs; pushes toward 'stack'.

L27n1238.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L27n1238.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often a consonant-cluster start (Cr-isps, Rh-inoceros, Gr-inds, Sl-), most at word start; pushes 'app' and 'App'.

L24n706.name: Word-start fragments, max/min
L24n706.description: Fires on the first fragment of a longer word split into pieces, e.g. 'Ed' in 'Edexcel' or 'Sim' in 'Simulating'. Pushes the model toward 'max' and 'min' tokens.

L14n1811.name: Answer-topic head noun
L14n1811.description: Strongly negative on the noun or heading word that a reply is about, right where the answer starts: 'song' in 'which specific song', 'film' in 'which film', 'Best' in 'Oscar for Best Actor', 'Subject' opening a drafted email, 'graphic' in 'eye-catching image or graphic', 'Chart' in 'using Chart.js'. Steered, it pushes fragments like 'apore' and 'reshold'.

L26n406.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'not'
L26n406.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of a split word (e.g. 'reg' in reggae, 'Ram' in Rambla, 'chrom' in chromosomal); its output points to negation words 'not', 'no' and 'nicht'.

L27n799.name: Short word-start fragments
L27n799.description: A short word-start fragment such as 'qu', 'd', 'p', 'A', or 'Th' (Mannequ|ins, flower-d|otted, Akh|et, Thelyp|teridaceae). Pushes toward closing quotes, brackets, and markdown '*'.

L27n941.name: Mid-word pieces → 'im'
L27n941.description: Fires on the middle piece of long split words (e.g. 'ch' in parenchyma, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'isol' in isolates, 'negot' in negotiator). Pushes toward 'im' tokens (steered output is 'Im im im').

L27n1978.name: Prepositions linking two terms
L27n1978.description: Goes strongly negative on the preposition or conjunction that completes a pair or 'X from/to/against/on Y' phrase ('or' in internal or external, 'from' in protect from, 'on' in on the surface). Steering it negative pushes the model toward closing brackets such as '())),', but the story and Sunday answers stay mostly normal.

L27n347.name: Split-word fragment, semicolon
L27n347.description: Fires on a word-internal piece of a longer word split into tokens (e.g. 'od' in Granodiorite, 'Str' in Strikes, 'cl' in clots, 'wh' in whorls). Pushes the model toward semicolons (';' and '；').

L27n1486.name: Mid-word pieces: animal
L27n1486.description: Word-start or mid-word pieces, often inside place or person names (Ser|engeti, Hash|em, Pen|ryn, Kut|cher, Sw|indon); pushes the model toward 'animal' and 'cursor'.

L27n2815.name: Capital first letter, names
L27n2815.description: The first token of a capitalized name or term, e.g. 'Sar' in Saracen, 'O' in OER, 'Z' in Zaidi, 'A' in Ayog or network; also 't' starting tamed. Pushes toward 'level'.

L27n2070.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n2070.description: The 'Pl', 'pl', 'pr' or 'sl' that opens words such as 'Plague', 'Plastic', 'plowing', 'prairie', 'slams'. Pushes toward 'actual' and 'actually'.

L27n903.name: Mid-word pieces, medical terms
L27n903.description: Fires positively on mid-word pieces of long medical and scientific terms (arr-ythmia, seb-orrhea, epi-nephrine, hypo-thalamus, neuro-physiology), peaking on the piece just before the word's ending. Pushes the model toward 'th' tokens.

L27n1568.name: 'cl' starts, writes 'analysis'
L27n1568.description: Goes strongly negative on 'cl' starting a word fragment ('clots', 'clumping', 'clenching', 'clippings') and on word-root pieces before '-analysis' ('Psycho', 'crypt', 'Pharmac'). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'analysis' and 'analyze', and the output spams 'Analy analysis'.

L26n480.name: Technical word-stem fragments
L26n480.description: A middle piece of a long medical or science term split into tokens (append-icit-is, elect-rophoresis, crypt-o, pict-ograph). Pushes toward word-start 'b' tokens.

L26n1933.name: Short consonant word onsets
L26n1933.description: Short first pieces of words split into tokens, mostly consonant-led ('mor' in morose, 'mur' in murals, 'b' in bittersweet, 'th' in thriller, 'ob' in Obson); pushes toward 'folder'.

L27n2470.name: Split-word start fragments
L27n2470.description: Fires negative on the first piece of a rare word split into several tokens, such as "pl" in plume, "fl" in flares, "Ber" in Berzelius, "Z" in Zulu, and "Gra" in Graubünden. Pushes the model toward "hyper" and "super".

L27n516.name: 'Pr' starts, link syntax
L27n516.description: Goes negative on the 'Pr' or 'pr' token that starts a word split across tokens (Prize, Principle, Pruning, prairies, prisms, impr in impractical). Going negative pushes toward markdown link syntax like '](' and '"](' .

L27n2011.name: Long-word opening syllables
L27n2011.description: Strongly negative on the opening syllable of a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'las' in lasagna, 'synt' in syntactic, 'Moh' in Mohenjo-daro, 'sw' in swimmers, 'gluc' in glucocorticoids, 'og' in aminoglycoside. Pushes toward 'tag'.

L27n2288.name: Word-ending 'o/om/os' piece
L27n2288.description: Strongly positive on a short word piece ending in 'o', 'os' or 'om' inside a split word ('os' in 'schistosomiasis', 'lo' in 'gloomy', 'end' in 'Christendom', 'ath' in 'fathoms'). Pushes 'dom'/'domain' tokens.

L27n50.name: Capital-letter name start
L27n50.description: Fires on a capitalized word start after a hyphen or slash, or at a list-item name (-S|ponsored, C|atan, S|olanum, H|iroshima). Pushes toward word tails like '-raries' and '-ileges'.

L24n2630.name: Capital L name starts
L24n2630.description: Goes strongly negative on a capital 'L' that starts a proper name or title (László, Lihle, Lori, Linda, Lotto), peaking on the lone 'L' token. Pushes the model to write 'get' tokens.

L27n1454.name: Word after comparative/preposition
L27n1454.description: The token right after a comparative, preposition or quantifier, e.g. 'than' in more stable than, 'as' in such as, 'into', 'least', 'high'; the read is diffuse, and pushing it degenerates into repeated 'single'.

L23n2006.name: Purpose 'to' and modals
L23n2006.description: Fires on 'to' opening a purpose infinitive, e.g. 'done to determine' or 'used to make a diagnosis', and on modals 'can' and 'will' before a verb; pushes toward 'elim' and 'rule' words.

L25n1591.name: Split proper-noun first pieces
L25n1591.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a split proper name, strongest on 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, also 'Yog' in Yogi, 'Mad' in Madison and Madagascar, 'Mat' and 'Mart'. Pushes toward 'enjoy' and 'benefit' forms, which the reading does not share.

L26n1744.name: Mid-word stems, talk write
L26n1744.description: Fires on a stem piece of a word split across tokens (ret in retelling, NG in MESSENGER, ars in farsighted, yt in fairytale, self before -talk); pushes toward 'talk', 'speaking' and 'dialog'.

L25n1258.name: Latin word-start stems
L25n1258.description: Strongly negative on the first sub-token of a Latin genus, plant or rare name split into pieces (Ar-buscular, Ar-bequina, Cr-ataegus, c-arambola, Ar-nett); pushes 'optional' tokens.

L25n489.name: word-opening prefix pieces
L25n489.description: Fires on the opening piece of a prefix or word split into tokens: 'Con' in 'Conversely', 're' in 'nonreproductive', 'In' starting 'In addition', 'Least' in 'Least Recently Used'. Pushes toward 'result' and 'outcome'.

L27n1828.name: Capital G/M word-starts
L27n1828.description: Fires on the first letter or two of a noun that opens a new word in a list or name context, most often a capital G or M (G|hetto, M|ites, G|OCI, H|ittite, M|ackerel). Pushes toward 'react' and 'reaction'.

L26n466.name: Proper-name first fragment
L26n466.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or split word, e.g. 'La' in La Coupole, 'Koh' in Kohli, 'Le' in Ledenhall, 'lif' in lifeguards, 'phot' in photovoltaic. Pushes toward 'possible' and 'available'; steered text collapses into repeated 'Available possible'.

L26n2653.name: Long-word stem pieces
L26n2653.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a long technical or legal word (cov|ariant, constit|uting, emb|rittlement, mach|ined, bas|mati, av|ascular). Writes 'poll'/'voting'; steering spams 'Poll'.

L25n3024.name: f-initial technical word starts
L25n3024.description: Goes negative on the start of a word split into tokens, often beginning with 'f' or 'fe' ('fe' in fevers and febrile, 'f' in fussy, 'F' in FIV), plus 'yc' in sycamore. Pushes toward 'preference', 'favor' and 'priority'.

L25n929.name: 'Ar' word-start fragments
L25n929.description: Goes strongly negative on 'Ar' or 'ar' opening a word fragment (arbuscules, Arnett, Archonditsis, armpits); pushes toward 'possess', 'having', 'belongs', so steered output reads 'possess having belonged'.

L26n1727.name: Mid-word pieces; polynomial
L26n1727.description: Mid-word syllable pieces of longer words, such as 'er' in eroded, 'ce' in isosceles, 'Magn' in Magnificent, 'Inter' in Interferometer and 'dist' in distill. Pushes toward 'pol' and 'polynomial'; steered output spams 'pol'.

L26n2952.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'mock'
L26n2952.description: Fires on the opening piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'min' (aminoglycoside), 'mo' (Moor), 'Hick' (Hickman), 'Ble' (bleach), 'hum' (humus), 'mol' (molten). Pushes toward 'mock' and 'analog' tokens.

L26n2427.name: Word-start fragments → sales
L26n2427.description: First piece of a split or proper-noun word (Cass|ini, Dec|isions, Sy|camore, Cad|mium, Lind|ner); pushes toward 'sales', 'sell' and 'sold'.

L27n1140.name: Word-start 'sh' and 'role'
L27n1140.description: Fires on 'sh' opening a second piece (mis|shapen, molt|shed) and on 'role' before 'models' or 'plays'. Pushes 'model' and 'models' tokens.

L26n944.name: Capitalized name starts
L26n944.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a capitalized name or split technical word (L-oyalists, L-ifespan, Al-fonso, Dyn in DNS provider Dyn, poly-gamy, poly-ethylene); pushes 'money', 'data' and 'information'.

L26n2729.name: Mid-name fragments; zip
L26n2729.description: Fires negatively on a middle piece of a long proper or technical word split into tokens (Kwa-Zu-lu-Natal, Sk-op-je, Gu-ineensis, Mp-um-alanga); pushes toward 'zip' and 'z'.

L27n1816.name: Acronym/technical-term starts
L27n1816.description: Fires on the first piece of acronyms and technical terms, such as 'P' in PESCO or PDD-NOS, 'V' in VSDs or Vortex, 'h' in hatching or hilly, and 'contr' in contraption; the pole promotes 'component' and steered output repeats 'Component'.

L27n1252.name: Word-start fragment, writes application
L27n1252.description: Fragments that open a longer word or name, e.g. 'Ver' (Verbal), 'Men' (Mennonite), 'Re' (Replacing), 'Pret' (Pretoria), 'Mar' (Marquesas); pushes toward 'application(s)'.

L27n960.name: Capitalized/hyphen-prefix word start
L27n960.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a capitalized or hyphen-prefixed word split into tokens ('Har'penden, '-w'atched, 'Ch'ivalry, 'P'olar bear); pushes toward question openers 'Is', 'Can', 'Has', 'Are', 'Will'.

L27n2416.name: Word fragments → 'journal'
L27n2416.description: Fires on a word-initial or middle piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly unfamiliar names and terms ('Del' in Delville, 'mon' in monsoon, 'De' in Deception, 'od' in rhododendron); pushes toward 'journal' and 'magazine'.

L23n785.name: 'the' before anatomy nouns
L23n785.description: Fires on 'the' (or 'of the', 'over the') right before a body part or physical object in medical and technical prose, e.g. 'damages the small intestine'. Pushes the model toward 'value' tokens.

L25n2865.name: Middle piece of names
L25n2865.description: Fires on an opening or middle piece of a proper name split into tokens (Nan|aimo, Tim|ur, Brid|gestone, Dur|ban, Pil|ates). Pushes the model toward 'vector' tokens.

L27n683.name: Noun starts, df output
L27n683.description: Goes negative on the first piece of an animal or common noun split across tokens (gir in giraffes, Bre in Breasted, che in cheetahs, ste in steamer, sn in snags). Going negative pushes toward 'df', 'DF' and 'CF'.

L27n2202.name: 'cons' word stems
L27n2202.description: Fires negatively on the 'cons' stem at the start of words like consent, consensus, conservation and conscription, plus 'res' and 'ab' fragments. Pushes the model toward 'sort' and 'sorted'.

L21n888.name: Answer-start and quote marks
L21n888.description: Fires on the first token of an answer after the empty think block, and on 'Answer' and 'repetition' in the system prompt's instructions. Pushes the model to write quote and backtick characters around words.

L25n1332.name: Verb-adjacent advice word
L25n1332.description: Fires on the word right after a verb or modal in how-to advice: 'more' in turn the pile more frequently, 'ensure' after 'Leaders must', 'put' after 'will', 'routine' after 'changing your'. Pushes toward 'constant' and 'continuous'.

L25n477.name: Acronym and unit endings
L25n477.description: Negative on the last letter or digit of an acronym, unit, or chemical formula in technical text (CH|D, MT|BE, HDHP|s, 107°|C, mm, IGF-|1, SiO2). Pushes toward closing code tokens such as '})' and '},'; the steered effect is weak.

L27n2683.name: Word-start pieces, 'demand'
L27n2683.description: Negative on the piece that opens a split word or name (semi|autonomous, Lav|ender, Ikht|iyar, de|Gaulle), pushing toward 'demand' and 'req' tokens.

L27n2212.name: Word-start f and H
L27n2212.description: Fires (negative) on a word-initial piece such as 'f' in bullfrogs, 'H' in Hertford, 'F' in Fossil, 'sh' in shut down, 'unf' in unfunded; pushes toward && and and.

L27n2529.name: Mid-word fragments, mode
L27n2529.description: Fires on word-internal fragments of longer words, e.g. 'multim|odal', 'cu|cumbers', 'intr|avenous', 'Inter|state'; pushes toward 'mode' spam.

L27n961.name: Hyphen/split compound pieces
L27n961.description: Fires negative on the piece that opens or continues a hyphenated or split compound (self-improvement, vice-versa, tert-butyl, executive vice, mass Drug) before the word finishes; pushes output toward 'pro' prefix tokens.

L26n2171.name: Word-start pieces spr/agr/acc
L26n2171.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces of split words, e.g. 'spr' (sprouts), 'agr' (bermudagrass), 'acc' (Macclesfield), 'cu' (cuirass), 'gu' (guillotine), 'ab' (abstinence), 'idd' (Biddel). Writes 'dot' tokens, and the steered output is 'dot dot' spam.

L27n2057.name: Predicate-opening verb or modal
L27n2057.description: Goes negative on the first word of a predicate right after its subject, such as 'we <<can>> talk', 'people <<took>> place', 'it is <<our>> job' and 'to <<take>> steps', mostly modals and 'take/took'; pushes 'turn/turns'.

L27n718.name: Name pieces, writes yang
L27n718.description: Goes strongly negative on mid-word pieces of names and titles (e.g. 'ipp' in Shippuden, 'Fed' in Fedora, 'Mat' in Matior, 'idas' in Kidas) and on file-tail pieces like '.pdf' or '-report'; pushes Indonesian and Malay function words (yang, dan, atau, untuk); steered output degenerates into 'yang yang'.

L25n1675.name: Place and people starts
L25n1675.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name, place or people split into tokens (Sl|avic, Ad|en, Al|-Andalus, Sid|on, sycam|ore). Pushes toward 'boost', 'increase' and 'enhance'.

L26n2038.name: Word-start al/sh pieces
L26n2038.description: Word-start 'al' or 'sh' pieces (Alka|Seltzer, al|bacore, sh|aver, Sh|ippuden); pushes plural nouns such as 'genes', 'words' and 'items'.

L25n1767.name: Name pieces, 'likely'
L25n1767.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name, plant or place name split across tokens (Cass- in cassia, Att- in Attalea, Tel- in Tel Aviv, tem- in tempeh, Pass- in Passover). Pushes toward hedges 'likely', 'probably', 'maybe'; at dose 0.5 it repeats 'likely'.

L27n1431.name: Split-word middle pieces
L27n1431.description: A middle piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'ely' in 'Thelypteridaceae', 'ch' in 'chelator' and 'choline', 'ry' in 'Phrynosoma', 'vas' in 'crevasse'. Pushes toward 'see', 'saw', 'seen'.

L24n2608.name: file-noun and 'sar' pieces
L24n2608.description: Fires on the noun 'file' or 'filename' where a file name or format is being named (e.g. 'upload a file', 'filenames'), and on word pieces like 'sar' inside 'sarcoma'; pushes toward 'extension(s)' next, and steered text spams 'extension'.

L26n2424.name: Surname first-piece
L26n2424.description: The first or middle piece of a surname split into tokens (Ram|ihant, Nim|etz, Alf|ano, Mac|allum, Hans|berry, Pis|ano); pushes toward closing backticks (.`).

L27n2531.name: Name-start 'Ed' pieces
L27n2531.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or product, most often 'Ed' (Edublogs, Edinburgh, Edexcel, Edsullivan) and 'Jud'; pushes toward 'helper/assistant' tokens.

L27n2894.name: Bare 'h' start, 'region'
L27n2894.description: Fires on a lone 'h' that begins a word, often after a split (e.g. 'h' in hedges, hawksbill, hickories, habitat; '-h' in 8-hydroxy). Pushes toward 'region' tokens (steered output is 'Region regions region').

L27n601.name: Split-word piece, 'pi' 'k'
L27n601.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, often a name or technical term (Cr in Crème, b in Middlesbrough, And in Andalus, agr in bermudagrass, ost in somatostatin, Imm in Immune). Pushes toward 'pi', 'k', 'ph'; steered output garbles.

L26n1728.name: Mid-word name fragments
L26n1728.description: Goes strongly negative on a non-final piece of a word or name the tokenizer split (Me|ister, Ed|ub|logs, Le|ib|niz, Man|itoba, Ber|iber|i, Frank|l), mostly the first or middle piece before the word ends. Pushed negative it steers output toward 'friend'.

L27n2790.name: Split name fragments
L27n2790.description: The first short piece of a capitalized name or rare word that the tokenizer splits, e.g. 'Ne' in von Neumann, 'ep' in Lepsius, 'Fr' in Frisian, 'Ab' in Abi Dawud, 'ent' in entitles; pushes toward 'logic'.

L26n1058.name: Verb-phrase filler slots
L26n1058.description: A filler word inside a verb phrase, such as 'a' in 'give e-cigarettes a go', 'it' in 'I thought it', 'you' in 'get you writing', plus random word-start fragments like 'Har' and 'wh'. Pushes toward 'bit' and 'bits'.

L26n461.name: Sch-initial name fragments
L26n461.description: Fires on the 'Sch' opening of German-style names and words (Schiffman, Schleper, Schizaeaceae, Schwerin), and on the 'lo' start of 'locket'. Pushes toward opening brackets such as '《' and '({'.

L26n1489.name: Prefix fragments
L26n1489.description: Fires on the 2-4 letter opening or middle piece of a split word, not on whole words (eig|envectors, sequ|enced, flu|encer, erg|enic, equival|ently). Pushes toward 'engagement' and 'encoding'.

L27n2662.name: Name-initial fragment, Ap/Et
L27n2662.description: First sub-token of a capitalized name or rare word split into pieces (Ap|ocrypha, Et|gar Keret, Ang|olan, Tr|ivium, Ar|bequina). Pushes toward 'implement'-family tokens.

L27n203.name: Mid-word piece, a syllable
L27n203.description: A piece in the middle of a split word or name ('Sothe|bys', 'whisk|ers', 'Da|ughters', 'Kos|rae'), where the next piece completes it. Pushes toward 'a'-syllable tokens such as 'aman', 'atan' and 'aga'.

L27n1172.name: Place-name fragments
L27n1172.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized place or thing name split into tokens, such as 'T|oulouse', 'Or|iskany', 'cre|vasse', 'lo|cket' and 'cr|annog'; pushes 'station/facilities'.

L26n1254.name: Name-start fragments, CPU
L26n1254.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a name or place, e.g. 'str' in Straits, 'ol' in olivaceus, 'Col', 'Fr', 'Ch'. Pushes toward 'CPU/cpu/GPU', but steering shows only a weak effect.

L27n417.name: Sarcophagus-style mid-word pieces
L27n417.description: Negative on the 'oph' piece of sarcophagus and other split words (sarc|oph|agus, Pterid|oph|yta, vitil|igo, Crata|egus); pushes toward '(pg' and 'PG' tokens.

L26n367.name: Scattered mid-word fragments
L26n367.description: Fires on odd mid-word or name pieces, e.g. 'D' in DHT, 'ov' in Antonov, 'fly' in Venus flytrap, 'Sym' in symphony; pushes toward 'TB'/'TD' tokens and 'tor'.

L24n2863.name: Absence words, name fragments
L24n2863.description: Goes strongly negative on 'Without' and 'Lacks', and on mid-word fragments of long drug, chemical, or place names, such as 'sul' in sulfoxaflor and 'sucral' in sucralose. Pushes toward 'loss', 'lose', and 'losing'.

L23n1909.name: Unique-noun 'a', name pieces
L23n1909.description: Fires on 'a' before a singular, definite noun ('a definite solution', 'a second preimage', 'a sole objective') and on name fragments (Har-, Eun-ice, Ionescu); pushes toward 'unique'.

L27n772.name: Capital 'D' word-start
L27n772.description: Goes strongly negative on a capitalized 'D' that starts a proper noun or word (Drought, Dania, Dachau, D-Day, Domesday, Dialysis); pushes toward '[]' list-bracket tokens.

L27n3037.name: Bare 'l'/'L' word starts
L27n3037.description: Goes negative on a bare 'l' or 'L' that opens a word piece, e.g. 'L' in 'Litchi', '-l' in 'alpha-linolenic', 'l' in 'labeled', 'Pl' in 'Platonist'; pushes toward 'da' tokens.

L27n1730.name: Proper-name fragment, writes 'private'
L27n1730.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a capitalised name or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'Mol' in Molotch, 'E' in Eunice, 'Kh' in Khadur, 'ach' in Dachau. Pushes toward 'private' and 'priv' tokens; steered, it spams 'Private'.

L25n2242.name: Diffuse word fragments
L25n2242.description: Fires weakly and scattered on mid-word pieces (Neuro, rop, akh, arrow, Mah) with no clear pattern. Pushes toward 'forward' and 'direction'; steered output spams 'forward'.

L27n1821.name: Proper-noun start → ')'
L27n1821.description: Fires on the first letter or piece of a proper name right after 'the', a list number or a paren ('the Kassites', '1. Leadenhall', 'Leibniz', 'Jardin Majorelle', 'Scissorhands'); pushes toward a closing ')'.

L27n1961.name: Ornate material adjectives
L27n1961.description: Fires on descriptive material and ornament words in product or building text (Gothic, Decorated, gilded, Leather, Bronze, glittery) and on split pieces like spl|ints. Pushes toward 'detail' tokens.

L25n409.name: Mojibake reads, code closers
L25n409.description: Reads mojibake and accented-letter fragments in garbled text; pushes toward closing quotes and parentheses.

L26n2912.name: G onset fragments
L26n2912.description: Goes negative on the 'G' onset piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly 'gu', 'gr', 'gor', 'Ge', 'Gy' and 'ug', as in 'guising', 'guayule', 'grilling', 'grizzly' and 'Novgorod'; writes 'commit/repo' tokens.

L27n881.name: 'ep' starts; writes result
L27n881.description: Fires on the 'ep' piece opening epilepsy, epigenetics and epinephrine, and on other capitalised first pieces (epa.gov, Cerda); pushes toward 'result' tokens.

L27n468.name: Name piece, writes lowercase
L27n468.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalised name or term mid-sentence (Nau|voo, Astroph|ysics, Ca|ernarvon, I|LO, Z|EV, Figure); pushes toward single lowercase letters, and steering spams 't' and similar letters.

L27n2335.name: Sudo NOPASSWD, name stems
L27n2335.description: Fires negatively on the 'NOP' of NOPASSWD in sudoers lines and on the first piece of capitalized names or words split into subtokens (Bl- in Blanche, Dor- in Dorset, Tit- in Titus, unp- in unpasteurized). Pushes the model toward 'click'.

L27n260.name: Word-start fragment, 'Google'
L27n260.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized or rare word split into tokens (wh|etstone, Att|ired, Ch|aco, Gh|af). Pushes toward 'Google'.

L26n2572.name: Medical term openers
L26n2572.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of split medical and biology terms ('Ven' in venom, 'ket' in ketosis, 'trop' in tropomyosin, 'va' in vaunted, 'Att' in attitude). Pushes toward 'chain'.

L25n1148.name: Proper-noun openers; quote marks
L25n1148.description: The first syllable of capitalized place and person names, such as 'ver' in Averroes, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Tel' in Tel Aviv and 'Per' in Peisander. Pushes toward opening quote and bracket tokens; steered output spams quote marks.

L27n2811.name: Symptom-pair 'or' → enjoy
L27n2811.description: Fires on 'or' linking two near-synonyms in a symptom or description (chest pain or discomfort, pressure or a squeezing pain), plus some split-word pieces. Pushes toward 'enjoying'/'enjoy'/'leisure' (steered output: 'enjoying enjoying').

L27n1032.name: Opening fragments, 'affected'
L27n1032.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into subword tokens while the word is still unfinished ('thr|ong', 'exc|elled', 'uncon|scious', 'sh|rouded'); pushes toward 'affected', 'impacted' and 'damaged', so steering spams 'affected'.

L27n934.name: Name starts, timer
L27n934.description: Starts of capitalized names or hyphen-split pieces ('Bl|anche', 'Tyr|annosaurus', 'Wiley-|Interscience', 'H|aversine'). Pushes toward 'Tim' and 'timer'.

L26n942.name: Name starts -> 'external'
L26n942.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised place or proper name (e.g. 'Có' in Córdoba, 'Sp' in Sparta, 'Pr' in Prato, 'Al' in Alamein, 'Ob' in Ospo). Pushed positive, it promotes 'external/outer' and spams 'outermost'.

L27n1526.name: Demonym suffix pieces, step
L27n1526.description: Fires on the suffix piece of demonyms and -ian or -ic adjectives, e.g. '-lian' in Karelian, '-rian' in Assyrian, '-ian' in Calydonian, '-an' in Sayan; pushes toward step and steps.

L26n153.name: Capitalized name starts, units
