L26n153.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun-phrase opener (Le|ashes, Batter|ies, Kings Cross, Men's, Que|ensland, Bat|eman's), and on unit or quote tokens ('degrees', '%', 'g', closing '?”' and '…”'). Pushed positive it steers toward quote, bracket and 'fire' tokens, and the text garbles.

L27n1379.name: 'im' word start, move
L27n1379.description: Strongly negative on the opening 'im', 'imm', 'omn' or 'em' piece of a split word (imm|unities, im|bedded, omn|ichannel, em|igrated, im|maculate); pushes toward 'move' and 'moving'.

L26n334.name: Digits in numeric values
L26n334.description: Fires on a digit token inside a number or date (the 6 in 60.1 °F, 8 in Mar. 8, the 0 in 1.0, 2 in 826V) and on name fragments (Ast-, Ab-, Ikh-); pushes 'six' and '6' tokens.

L26n2495.name: Split word starts, party
L26n2495.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a word split into tokens, often a place or proper-noun start: 'Stra' in Straits, 'thr' in threaded, 'Tra' in trauma, 'Schw' in Schwann. Steered, it pushes 'party' and spams it.

L24n763.name: Mid-word name fragments
L24n763.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside split names and terms ('ug' in Chugoku, 'Pr' in Prisicus, 'ule' in Suleiman, 'og' in aminoglycoside); pushes '|' and 'absolute' bar tokens.

L26n1051.name: 'Im' word-starts
L26n1051.description: Goes strongly negative on 'Im' or 'imm' word-starts (Immaculate, Immune, immemorial) and on nouns like card, tea, oil and image; pushes toward 'test', so steered output spams 'test'.

L27n2424.name: Word-start fragments (record)
L27n2424.description: Strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'cultiv' in cultivars, 'contr' in contrived, 'def' in defecate, 'Tam' in tampons, 'ot' in otoscope, 'trav' in travails. Pushes toward 'record'.

L27n1794.name: Science and place stems
L27n1794.description: Start of a research-field word (archae|ologists, epidemi|ology, ep|igenome, agr|onomist) or of a place name (Arg|onne, Vol|ga, Est|epa). Pushes toward 'gen'/'gene' tokens.

L27n1286.name: Word-start fragments → 'try'
L27n1286.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word ('gan' in gantry, 'em' in empires, 'Car' in Carica, 'Admir' in admiralty) and on a few whole words like 'virtually' and 'New' before Orleans; pushes toward 'try' and 'trying'.

L27n685.name: Noun prefix, writes projects
L27n685.description: Fires on the first piece of a split noun or adjective, such as 'micro' in microfinance or microaggression, 'lyr' in lyrical, 'ad' in ad copy or 'show' in show notes. Pushes toward 'projects' and 'apps' tokens.

L27n1112.name: Verb after subject
L27n1112.description: Fires on the verb or auxiliary right after a subject (journal 'is' licensed, Singapore 'has' taken, Americans 'left') and on some word fragments. Pushes 'make/making' (steered output is 'Make' spam).

L27n1325.name: Capitalized fragments, 'panel'
L27n1325.description: Fires negatively on capitalized word starts and fragments: 'Har' in Harpenden, 'Sem' in Seminary Ridge, 'Ty' in Tylenol, 'Food' in Food Safety, 'emb' in embrittlement, 'amb' in Rambouillet. Pushes the model toward 'panel', 'plate' and 'Pan'.

L26n2827.name: Word fragment → 'w'
L26n2827.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a split word, like 'eth' in hypomethylation, 'om' in trihalomethane and 'Ele' in elephants; pushes toward a bare 'w' or 'W', and at high dose the model writes 'Ww w w'.

L27n2855.name: Name-like word fragments
L27n2855.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter piece inside a longer name or word split across tokens, usually the second or third piece ('Kh|isa', 'Tong|a', 'chir|ping', 'mel|odic', 'Bel|oved', 'feng-sh|ui'); pushes toward 'energy', so steering spams 'Energy'.

L27n1611.name: Name fragments, JSON output
L27n1611.description: Goes negative on a word piece inside a proper name or foreign word (Schle in Schlepper, ap in Galapagos, Ep in Epiphanes, ule in Suleiman, electroly in electrolyte). Going negative pushes toward 'json'/'JSON'.

L26n719.name: Prefix and hyphen joints
L26n719.description: Fires on the token right after a hyphen or on a word-opening prefix piece (dis, un, sub, bio, hydro, str), often just after an opening quote; pushes toward directional particles 'up', 'out', 'away' and 'down'.

L26n981.name: 'the' before named entities
L26n981.description: Goes negative on 'the' (and 'in', 'of') right before a proper noun or institution in history or news text (the former Soviet Union, the Thatcher family, the Ottoman, the British). Writes tech names (Python, Linux, Android); steering spams 'Python' or 'Earth'.

L26n704.name: Technical word fragments, 'incident'
L26n704.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a longer technical word ('om' in hypomethylation, 'j' in jicama, 'ob' in retinoblastoma, 'inse' in inseparable); pushes toward 'incident', 'occurrence', 'phenomenon'.

L27n1963.name: Name particle → output
L27n1963.description: Fires on the piece of a personal name that continues it, e.g. 'ben' in 'Eleazar ben Simon', 'Ban' in Ban Ki-moon, 'L' in Lauterpacht, 'Hale' in Halevy; pushes toward 'output' tokens.

L1n423.name: Mid-word name fragments
L1n423.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a name or word split across tokens, e.g. 'by' in 'Col|by', 'Lib|by', 'yc' in 'Pol|yc|yclic', 'uc' in 'Ha|uc|ourt', 'ly' in 'Regular|ly', and 'Gaul' in 'de Gaulle'; pushes toward closing code such as '})();' and foreign-script fragments.

L27n1070.name: Compound modifier; writes 'select'
L27n1070.description: Fires on the first word of a two-word technical term, before its head noun: 'genetically' (deficient), 'genomic' (sequencing), 'facilitated' (diffusion), 'tummy' (time). Pushes the model toward 'select' and 'selection' (steering spams 'Select').

L27n740.name: Medical word-start fragment
L27n740.description: The first subword piece of a medical or technical term split into tokens (pur in purists, ple in pleural, par in paraplegia, V in Vitiligo, v in vaccine, tet in tetraplegia). Pushes toward capital letters; steered output spams 'A'.

L27n215.name: Mid-word name fragments
L27n215.description: Strongly negative on a non-initial piece of a capitalized name or unusual word split into tokens (Ik|ht|iyar, Gu|ising, Zam|be|zi, Mar|akes, PAR|RISE). Pushes the model toward 'isis'/'ilia' pieces.

L26n559.name: Verbs of expressing feeling
L26n559.description: Fires on the verb or auxiliary that follows a feeling subject in letters, cards and essays ('expresses', 'expressing', 'feels', 'am', 'were'). Pushes toward 'national', 'country' and 'nation', and steering spams 'National'.

L26n2243.name: dec and mal pieces
L26n2243.description: Fires on the short opening pieces 'dec' and 'mal' of split words (dec|arbonising, dec|oupling, Mal|oney), with weaker firing on 'dosing' and 'fertilized' suffix pieces. Pushes toward 'process' and 'procedure'.

L27n2763.name: Word-start pieces, strict
L27n2763.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most often 't' or 'T' starting tinnitus, tiredness, tangle, and 'Arist' in Aristotelian; pushes toward strict, strictly, tight, stringent.

L25n440.name: Brand and place starts
L25n440.description: Fires on the first letters of a capitalized name, brand or place split across tokens (Brid- in Bridgeton and Bridgestone, Aud- in Audacity, Am- in American, Gr- in Grange, de in de Blasio). Pushes toward ':' and closing-quote tokens; at dose -0.5 it outputs a run of colons.

L27n2680.name: Name-start pieces, 'edit' writer
L27n2680.description: Goes negative on the first short piece of a multi-token name or word, e.g. 'Te' in Teesside, 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'blo' in bloom. Pushes toward 'edit' tokens.

L26n2748.name: Word-start fragments, inf/eff
L26n2748.description: Positive on the first fragment of a word split into pieces, usually a 2-4 letter start such as 'inf' in inflection, 'eff' in effusion, 'intr' in intravascular, 'Diff' in diffusion. Pushes the model toward 'compression' and 'compact'.

L27n2723.name: 'Bel'/'L' word starts
L27n2723.description: Fires on word starts 'Bel', 'Bl', 'L', and 'l', such as 'Bel' in Beloved or Belgrave, 'Bl' in Blanche, 'L' in Lauterpacht, or 'l' in lizards; the pole promotes 'adjacent', 'neighbor', and 'nearby', and steered output repeats them.

L26n58.name: Word-piece starts; negation
L26n58.description: The first 1 to 2 letters of a word split into pieces, such as 'ep' in epidermis, 'l' in lagoon, 'W' in WMO and 'p' in patty. Pushes toward negatives 'neither', 'none', 'never' and 'nothing'; steered output spams 'not' and 'neither'.

L27n1197.name: Proper-noun openers, comma-quote
L27n1197.description: Fires negatively on capitalized openers of names and phrases ('Al' in Al Andalus, 'Pr' in Priscus, 'J' in Jardin, 'San' in San Francisco, 'Trans' in trans fats). Pushes the model toward comma-quote punctuation sequences.

L27n2726.name: 'cl' onsets, 'borrow' writer
L27n2726.description: Fires on the 'cl' that starts a word piece (clumps, clowns, clenching, clonemates) and on 'rom' or 'om' endings like neuroma and acromegaly. Pushes toward 'borrow' and 'loan' tokens.

L26n1654.name: Proper-name stems, 'data'
L26n1654.description: The first piece of a split proper noun or period name, such as 'Mi' in Miocene, 'Ne' in Neolithic, 'Hel' in Heliodorus, 'Mel'. Pushes toward 'data', '_data', 'Data'.

L27n2378.name: 'cr' word-start, pushes 'constraint'
L27n2378.description: Strongly negative on word-start 'cr'/'cre' fragments (e.g. 'cre' in crevice, 'cr' in crab and crannog, also 'mar' in Pietermaritzburg); pushing negative makes the model write 'constraint(s)'.

L27n1688.name: 'wh' word-start pieces: item
L27n1688.description: Word-start pieces, especially 'wh' (whizzes, whorls, whistling, whiten), plus 'sl', 'Kh' and 'Nad' in names; pushes the model toward 'item' and 'items'.

L27n2446.name: Name-start capitals, sql
L27n2446.description: Fires on the capital or consonant-cluster first piece of a proper name or word mid-sentence (M in Merthyr and Mowbray, Cl in Climb, Br in Bruesehoff, Amb in Ambrose, St). Pushes toward 'sql' tokens (SQL, sql, Sql).

L27n1249.name: Name-piece fragments: def
L27n1249.description: Middle pieces of split proper names (Hot|am|isligil, Mos|he, Dor|set, En|cke), peaking on the piece inside the name; pushes the model toward 'def' and 'Def' tokens.

L24n1949.name: Chemical-name mid-word fragments
L24n1949.description: Positive on a middle or late subword piece of long technical words (chemicals, species, breeds), e.g. 'doc|os|ah', 'ole' in oleic, 'oct' in octaBDE, 'c' in carambola. Also on digits in '3-phase' and 'omega-3'. Writes 'four' and 'three'.

L27n2368.name: 'se' starts, writes 'cannot'
L27n2368.description: Goes strongly negative on the start piece 'se' of sepsis, septic and seborrhea, and on word starts like 'migr' in migraines. Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'cannot', 'unable' and 'couldn't', and the output spams 'cannot'.

L23n2580.name: Name-fragment subword pieces
L23n2580.description: Middle or second piece of a capitalized proper name split across tokens (Zam|bezi, Zar|agoza, Rad|ó, Ram); pushes toward '!' and exclamation marks.

L26n1274.name: Linking words in titles
L26n1274.description: Goes negative on the 'of', 'the' or 'New' that link words inside institution, journal and society titles (Board of Periodontology, Journal of Toxic, Daughters of the Confederacy, University of New Mexico, Division of Vital Statistics); pushes toward 'Ab', 'AB' and 'abstract' tokens.

L26n19.name: Onset fragment, pushes punctuation
L26n19.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, often 'cl' (clots, clotted), 'par', 'vacc', 'sc'; pushes punctuation and backslash tokens.

L27n1200.name: Post-hyphen 'c', writes 'files'
L27n1200.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'C' right after a hyphen or prefix (non-c|ancerous, post-C|OVID, post-c|ivil, terra-c|otta) and on 'Sh' in Shunga. Pushes toward 'files' and 'Files' tokens, so steered output is 'files files'.

L11n9.name: Name-ending piece before citation
L11n9.description: Strongly negative on the last piece of a name or word just before a citation, parenthesis or comma: 'man' in 'Schiffman et al.', 'oks' in 'Estabrooks', 'ik' in 'Høivik', 'en' in 'Nordhausen', 'I' in 'RGGI states'. Also on the '(' in 'infrastructure (dwellings' and a few clause-final words ('well', 'above', 'those'). Steered, it gives asterisks.

L27n1426.name: Capital U, writes 'terms'
L27n1426.description: Goes negative on a capital 'U' token that opens an acronym or name (U.S., UML, Ulysses, Uppsala); pushes toward 'term(s)', and steering spams 'terms'.

L27n1793.name: Split-word pieces, digits 0/1
L27n1793.description: A middle piece of a split word, such as 'spl' in 'splints', 'comm' in 'communities', or a digit '0' or '1' inside a number such as '8.0' or '200-120'. Pushes toward closing parentheses and quotes ('())', '”,').

L26n2156.name: Name-start El/Sal fragments
L26n2156.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, mostly 'El', 'Sal', 'Sel', 'Su' as in El Alamein, Selaginellaceae and Salamis; pushes toward 'sector' and 'industry'.

L27n2678.name: 'f' word-starts; 'old' writer
L27n2678.description: Goes negative on a lone 'f' that opens a word or follows a hyphen (trans-fatty, three-forked, f|loss, f|leas, f|umes, f|amily); pushes 'old' and 'Old', which spam when steered.

L26n1014.name: sl/wh word onsets
L26n1014.description: The opening fragment of a split word, mostly 'sl' (slant, slides, slotted), 'wh' (whiff, whizz, whistling), and 'ot' (otoscope). Pushes toward 'Java' and 'java' tokens.

L27n2569.name: Split proper-noun middle piece
L27n2569.description: Fires (goes negative) on a piece of a multi-token proper name that is not its first piece (Ath|abasca, Hal|icarnassus, Stal|ingrad, Per|iander, Ver|ne), plus 'exh' and 'ex' fragments in exhorted and exhaling; pushes output toward 'scenario' and 'situation'.

L27n2201.name: 'and' in lists, 'command'
L27n2201.description: Fires on 'and' inside fatty-acid and oil lists and on the first part of fixed names (Air, Johan, Rolling); pushes 'command'.

L14n2233.name: Opening of explanatory gloss
L14n2233.description: Fires (negative) on the '(' or 'means' or 'change' that opens an explanation of the term just before it: 'VSDs (' before 'also commonly referred to', 'TPR (' before 'temperature', 'arribadas (' before 'arrival', 'which means' before 'strike'. Pushes toward noisy word fragments like 'sai', 'gibi', 'errors'.

L27n2502.name: Mid-word pieces, nature names
L27n2502.description: Goes negative on middle pieces of split names for plants, animals, foods and places (catal|ase, ame|leon, Ela|eis, Get|t|ysburg, Venus flytrap); pushes toward fin and finite tokens.

L27n346.name: Inner word fragment (negative)
L27n346.description: Negative on a middle or final piece of a word split into several tokens (cantal|ou|pe, mar|ipa, philadel|phus, Gar|trap); when pushed negative it writes p-initial pieces like pr, pi, py and pl.

L27n492.name: Diffuse end-of-phrase tokens
L27n492.description: Diffuse: fires on the last word of a noun phrase or list item ('eggs', 'radishes', 'bread', 'inches') and on digits in measurements ('500 °C', '2000 mg'); no clear concept, pushes toward backslash tokens.

L27n475.name: Capital 'G'/'g' start
L27n475.description: Fires (goes negative) on a capital or lowercase 'G'/'g' that starts a name or word (G-d, G-ospels, Garter, Gansu, gloomy, gauze, gangs), weaker on 'R' in Rama; pushes output toward '---', '***' and '____' separator tokens.

L25n1439.name: Material-property words
L25n1439.description: Fires negatively on mid-word pieces and quality words ('rig' in rigidity, 'durable', 'sustainable', 'stainless', 'high torque'); its write is 'properties' and 'characteristics', but the steered output barely shows it.

L25n113.name: mol/ret fragments → braces
L25n113.description: Fires on word-start fragments 'mol' (mol|ars, mol|ting) and 'ret' (ret|arded, ret|aliation), and on '+++NEW+++' banner tokens; pushes LaTeX-style backslash and brace tokens.

L27n2132.name: Initial enc and c
L27n2132.description: Strongly negative on 'enc', 'ac' or a lone 'c' that begins a word split into tokens, e.g. encroached, enclosures, Acadian, acquires, plus '-c' in crust and '-C' in COVID. Pushes toward 'cl' tokens.

L27n863.name: Mid-word fragment completer
L27n863.description: Reads scattered mid-word fragments and nouns (Beorht w-, Car-, uta, ari) with no shared theme; pushes toward 'min' tokens.

L26n2491.name: Mid-word fragments
L26n2491.description: A piece in the middle of a longer word or name, at the token just before its end (Cór|doba, lot|teries, autom|ating, chron|icle, Ub|ünden, Almo|had). Writes 'data' and 'Data' tokens; when pushed, the output fills with 'data'.

L27n488.name: Pre-verb cue, writes nouns
L27n488.description: Fires on 'to', 'or', 'will' and similar cues right before a verb or a second option ('attempted to', 'execute or sell', 'will sound', 'trying to sneak'); pushes toward nouns like 'force', 'value' and 'challenge'.

L24n727.name: Split-word first fragment
L24n727.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word broken into pieces, e.g. 'sil' in silhouettes and siliceous, 'sm' in smacking, 'sl' in slotted, 'neuro' in neurotoxic, 'bro' in brochures; pushes toward 'label' and 'labels' with little other meaning.

L27n2964.name: Mid-word cuts before quotes
L27n2964.description: A mid-word piece near the start of a multi-token word (inf|ested, partic|ulates, cl|ots, euth|anized, fib|rosis, sw|ires). Pushes toward curly quotes and dashes such as '＂', '―', '‐', and '"--'.

L27n1066.name: Names' first pieces
L27n1066.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or long word split across tokens, such as Cart in Carte du Ciel, Vol in Volga, Kare in Karelian, Gra in Graubünden, or Stat in Statista; pushes toward 'model' tokens.

L24n1389.name: Null-value placeholder writer
L24n1389.description: Weak, scattered firing on mid-phrase fragments and link words in web text, e.g. 'es' of 'imputes', 'oves' of 'removes', 'N' of 'N/A', 'Click' of 'Click here'. Pushes toward NA, NULL and null tokens.

L27n1579.name: Word fragments, stay/stand verbs
L27n1579.description: Goes negative on word-start fragments of split nouns (cl|enching, cant|aloupe, apr|icots, ot|ash) and on verbs of standing or staying ('stand up', 'stay behind', 'turn to'). Pushes toward 'put'.

L26n2128.name: Period in numbers
L26n2128.description: The decimal point or sentence-final period right after a number or clause (14.5 oz, 41.5 per, 'Thursday.'). Pushes toward ellipsis and bracket tokens such as '[…]' and ');'.

L27n620.name: Article before noun phrase
L27n620.description: Fires on the article or determiner right before a noun phrase, strongest on 'a' before a quantity ('a total of', 'a spot', 'a CAGR of') and on 'the', 'this' and 'its'; pushes toward intensity adjectives like robust, dense, intense and lush.

L26n2713.name: word-start fragments before splits
L26n2713.description: Fires on the first piece of a longer word or name split into tokens ('Stra' in Straits, 'emb' in embarks, 'Ber' in Berzelius, 'Cass' in Cassia, 'observ' in observables). Pushes toward single-letter variables 'X' and 'Y'.

L26n547.name: Initial letters of names
L26n547.description: Goes negative on a single capital or short fragment that starts a name or term in citations and lists (Z in Zhen Jing, z in zoonotic, Re in Repat Radiology, E in Eclipse Line). The pushed output is garbled multilingual fragments, so the effect is weak.

L26n2298.name: Word onsets -> 'stock'
L26n2298.description: Fires on the opening letter(s) of a word, mostly 'T/t', 'Pl', 'Ret' and 'Te' (e.g. 'T' in TWEAK, 'tummy', 'Pl' in plasma, 'Ret' in retriever). Pushed positive, it promotes 'stock/stocks' and spams 'stock'.

L26n1088.name: Ohm symbol, Con- starts
L26n1088.description: Fires on the Ω symbol after resistance values ('200 Ω', '22 Ω') and on the first piece of 'Con-' and 'Cont-' words (containment, conc-, conventional). Pushes toward 'act', 'acct' and 'tag' fragments.

L27n1533.name: Medical prefix pieces, idioms
L27n1533.description: Goes negative on the middle piece of a medical word (hyp|op|arathyroidism, par|ap|legia) and on prepositions that close a fixed phrase ('on its way', 'at ease', 'up to date', 'on point'). Pushes toward 'par'.

L26n1822.name: Mid-word fragments
L26n1822.description: Fires on a word piece that starts or sits inside a longer word or name split across tokens ('cur' in curricular, 'bor' in seborrhea, 'aling' in Stalingrad, 'ابن' in Ibn) before the word finishes; pushes toward 'ratio', so steered text repeats 'ratios'.

L27n947.name: Capitalized name fragments
L27n947.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, such as 'Fr|anks', 'Fr|isia', 'McM|urray', 'Hojib|lanca' and 'Pr|iscus'; pushes commas.

L26n523.name: Technical nouns in ML
L26n523.description: Negative on the word just before a technical noun in ML, data-science, and linguistics text ('for' in 'for calculating', 'and' in 'tree-based', 'language' in 'natural language', 'a' in 'a data analysis'); pushes toward 'syntax' and 'sentence'.

L25n2765.name: Collocation before paper/slate
L25n2765.description: Fires on a word inside a fixed phrase just before its usual object or surface: 'and' in pen and paper, 'blank' in blank slate, 'on' in stored on a substrate. Pushes toward 'paper' and 'card'.

L24n1155.name: Technical-compound head word
L24n1155.description: Fires negatively on the head word of a technical compound, such as 'cost' in 'variable cost', 'back' in 'payback period', 'outline' in 'outline method' or 'resonance' in SPR. Pushes toward 'method', which repeats when steered.

L27n917.name: Mid-phrase word pieces, commas
L27n917.description: Fires on mid-phrase tokens that leave a word or list unfinished: word pieces (emb|arks, Hymen|oph|yllaceae, chron|ology) and commas inside symptom or item lists; pushed positive it promotes 'function'.

L27n2396.name: Intr/ultr/aqu word start
L27n2396.description: Negative on the first piece of words beginning intr-, ultr- or aqu- that are split into tokens (intr|avenous, ultr|aviolet, aqu|aculture); pushes toward capital 'A' tokens like AD, AP and AC.

L25n2839.name: Word fragment, writes 'keep'
L25n2839.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split word (e.g. 'ont' in strontium, 'ydro' in hydrogen, 'orth' in orthotic); its output points to 'keep' and 'keeping'.

L26n256.name: Naming construction (called)
L26n256.description: Strongly negative on the word that introduces a name or label (called, known as, the word, genus, named), just before the name itself (is called an abscess, the genus Diaptomus, the word khamba). Steering produces code and markdown noise.

L1n460.name: Set-phrase second half
L1n460.description: Fires on the second half of a fixed phrase or comparison, e.g. 'not' in 'last but not least', 'than' in 'no less than', 'also' in 'but also', 'one' in 'one by one', 'side' in 'side by side'; pushes toward closing brackets and punctuation, and at +0.5 the output turns into stray symbols.

L27n1319.name: Word-start fragments, operator
L27n1319.description: Fires positively on the first piece of a long word split into subtokens, mostly 'prim' (primates, primordial, primarily), plus 'tele', 'recre', 'rail', 'cruise'. The peak is the stem before its ending. Pushes the model toward 'operator' and 'operating'.

L26n2927.name: Prefix or word-first piece
L26n2927.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, especially compound prefixes and capitalized starts (hetero-porous, self-d-etermination, non-d-iscriminatory, Cons-istent, S-ponsored); pushes toward word-end fragments such as -ete, -ys and -ez.

L27n502.name: Consonant-cluster word openers
L27n502.description: Opening piece of a split word, often a consonant-cluster start (gre in greening, Gu in Guinean, fl in flaring, spe in spears, bl in blunting). Pushes toward a run of '...' ellipses.

L27n1405.name: Long-word start fragments
L27n1405.description: Negative on the first piece of a longer split word, e.g. 'agr' in agritech and agrarian, 'Com' in compost, 'Aud' in auditory, 'Fr' in Franks; pushes toward 'material', 'service' and 'resource'.

L27n3003.name: Word-start 'cre', 'che', 'Ne'
L27n3003.description: The first piece of a longer word or name, mostly 'cre' in 'creational' and 'crevasse', 'che' in 'Cheyenne' and 'Chester', 'Ne' in 'Neutrophils' and 'Neuchâtel'. Pushes toward 'ever' and 'never'.

L27n1418.name: Word-start fragments → punctuation
L27n1418.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word (e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'Gr' in gratitude, 'Al' in Almazaras, 'ind' in indigo). Pushes toward closing punctuation such as ')', ']' and quote marks (steered output degenerates into runs of '.*' or '.' punctuation).

L27n1628.name: Capital letter in names
L27n1628.description: A capital letter that starts a name part after a hyphen or initial, e.g. 'D' in Miami-|D|ade, 'C' in post-|C|ivil War, 'D' in Sen. |D|ianne; pushes toward 'do' and 'Do', spamming 'Do do do'.

L26n193.name: Word-start fragments; unclear
L26n193.description: Word-start fragments of longer words, such as 'g' in gobbled, 'Gate' in gatekeepers, 'Rose' in Rose Kennedy, 'show' in showy and 'Aut' in Autistic. Pushes toward closing quote and brace tokens with no clear word; steered output is weak.

L27n272.name: Split-word middles (G tokens)
L27n272.description: Strongly negative on a piece in the middle of a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'bul' in bulges, 'arr' in arranging, 'besie' in besieged, 'sur' in surges, 'OM' in OMG, 'brid' in unbridled. Pushes toward 'G' gene-like tokens such as GA, GC and GP.

L27n1696.name: Rare-word middle fragment
L27n1696.description: A middle fragment of a rare or Greek/Latin-derived word split into tokens (Rhodod|endron, seb|orrhea, hid|rosis, nit|rate, imet|...). Pushes toward 're'-type tokens such as 'res', 're', 'rend'.

L27n83.name: Structured text symbols, SQL
L27n83.description: Negative firing on symbols and word starts in structured text, such as SQL clauses, table pipes, the + in '(200+ words)', a newline before ORDER BY, and hydro in hydrology; pushes toward 'result' and 'private'. Pushed negative, it strips spaces from output.

L27n489.name: Percent digits; writes backslash
L27n489.description: Goes strongly negative on the digit before a '%' (the 0 in 70%, the 5 in 8.25%, the 9 in 99%) and on the first word of multi-word names (Passover, Object Management Group, Planned Behavior). Pushing it negative steers toward backslash and backtick tokens.

L26n1035.name: Onset fragments f/fl/bl
L26n1035.description: Fires on a short f or b onset (fl, f, bl, br) that starts the unfinished second piece of a word: 'fl' in flowering and flanged, 'f' in fables, 'bl' in bladder, 'br' in brave. Pushes toward 'benefit' and 'advantage'.

L26n2594.name: Car fragments, Eth
L26n2594.description: Fires on the 'car/Car/CAR' piece of a split word (beta-carotene, carpels, CAROLINA, Car2Go) plus a few other word-middle pieces. Pushes toward 'Eth/ethical/ethics'; steered output spams 'Eth'.

L27n1504.name: Name-start P; comma lists
L27n1504.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a name or noun (P in Polar bear and Pumsaint, Nap|ster, Ap|ocrypha, hypoth|alamus) and on commas in noun lists (Videos, worksheets, games); pushes 'lines', 'rows', 'eyes', spamming 'lines' when steered.

L26n799.name: Pr- and pencil fragments
L26n799.description: Strongly negative on word-start fragments 'pr' (pruned, prairie) and 'apr' (apricots), and on 'pencil' in art-supply text; pushes 'highlight', 'emphasize', 'underscore'.

L27n1977.name: Lone f/d word-opener
L27n1977.description: Positive on a lone 'f', 'd', 'D' or 'F' token that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. 'a f|ad', 'the d|uchy', 'the f|able', 'F|ERPA', 'Acid iph|ilium'. Pushes toward 'work' and 'works'; steered output spams 'work'.

L27n1479.name: Technical name fragments, num
L27n1479.description: Middle pieces of split technical or place names ('Rhod|endron', 'sarc|ophagi', 'sucr|alose', 'Verm|ilion'). Pushes toward 'num' and 'numer' tokens.

L25n1954.name: Word-start fragments; allocate
L25n1954.description: Fires negatively on the opening piece of split words, often 'di' (archdiocese, dihydrotestosterone), 'Arist' (Aristotelian), 'Educational' and 'scientific'; pushes toward 'allocate'.

L27n1421.name: Word after a lead-in
L27n1421.description: Diffuse and weak, peaking on the first content word after a lead-in such as 'such as', 'or', 'according to' or 'for' (flashbacks, nutritional, museum, improving). Pushes toward closing bracket tokens like '】' and '"]'.

L25n1470.name: Word-continuation fragments, 'pl'
L25n1470.description: Fires on the continuation piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'multip' in multiplication, 'sup' in supposedly, or 'p' in stockpiling; pushes toward 'pl' tokens and repeated 'Pl'.

L14n3017.name: Content word before complement
L14n3017.description: Diffusely negative on the content word that opens a purpose or complement phrase in instructions and descriptions: 'explore' in 'to explore', 'water' in 'provide water', 'health' in 'skin health', 'official' in 'official pip website', 'package' in 'pip3 install <package>', 'diverse' in 'its diverse'. Steered, it gives word fragments ('ellij', 'loit', 'ionale'), not a word.

L27n1694.name: Mid-word stem fragments
L27n1694.description: Fires (negative) on a mid-word piece that starts a longer stem ('append|icitis', 'pred|iabetes', 'Rod|inia', 'Ind|ex'); pushes toward 'del' and 'Del'.

L27n1303.name: 'po' piece, group-noun writer
L27n1303.description: Fires on the 'po' piece that starts a split word (po|achers, po|aching, Po|ems); pushes toward group nouns like teams, businesses, communities and companies.

L27n2979.name: Non-word fragments, 'store'
L27n2979.description: Fires negatively on a word-initial fragment that is not a full word: 'imm' (immemorial), 'ph' (phagocytes), 'ble' (bleaching), '-st' (stimulated), 'Aud' (Audacity). Pushes the model toward 'store' and 'storage'.

L27n819.name: Mid-word fragments, closing brackets
L27n819.description: Pieces of rare multi-token words in web text, mid-word ('neu|rom|as', 'tran|se|pt', 'Mog', 'hid|rosis'), plus the first token of a chat user message. Pushes toward closing brackets and quotes such as '）', '”。' and '**'.

L26n1491.name: Word fragments to 'typically'
L26n1491.description: Fires on the first piece of a long or technical word split into tokens (e.g. 'seab' in seabirds, 'lipid', 'Organ' in organochlorine, 'sul' in sulfoxaflor). Pushes toward hedges 'typically', 'usually' and 'generally'.

L27n403.name: Word start to cells
L27n403.description: Fires on the first subword of a longer term or name, such as 'Sh' in Shiloh or Shalimar, 'Fort' in Fort Detrick, 'lent' in lentil or 'fo' in focal. Pushes toward 'cells', 'cars' and 'children'.

L27n2145.name: str/exp/rep word start
L27n2145.description: Three-letter prefix piece opening a split word, like str|aits, str|addles, exp|atriate, exp|ediency, rep|elling, reb|uked, spr|ang. Pushes toward 'flag'.

L27n2761.name: Hyphen 'st' fragment
L27n2761.description: The 'st' or '-st' piece opening a split or hyphenated word (pre-st|ressed, non-st|ick, St|abilizes, Est|epa); pushes toward 'birth', 'born' and 'baby'.

L26n1742.name: Wol/Ber name openers
L26n1742.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'Wol' in Wolpertinger and wolfsbane, 'Ber' in Berzelius, 'sal' in salinity, 'bur' in burrows, 'Hal' and 'Cal' in proper names; pushes toward 'channel' tokens.

L27n2850.name: ALL-CAPS acronym pieces
L27n2850.description: Fires on the middle or end piece of an ALL-CAPS acronym or capitalized term split into tokens, e.g. 'LE' in LEAs, 'TE' in INTELLIGENCE, 'CE' in CEZ, 'IDE' in IDEO; pushes toward 'th', 'nd', 'rd' ordinal endings.

L26n1154.name: Mid-word split before ending
L26n1154.description: Goes negative on a fragment that stops mid-word just before its completing piece, e.g. 'extingu|ish', 'skirm|ish', 'stret|cher', 'sebor|r|hea', 'enc|ro|ached', 'explo|red', and on '(' before an acronym such as 'CIHI'; writes 'ah/gh' tokens.

L27n2863.name: Split-word opening fragments
L27n2863.description: Fires on the opening piece of a multi-token word, e.g. 'ro' in 'roamed', 'sl' in 'slivered', 'cons' in 'conscription', 'Se' in 'Seborrhea'; pushes toward 'migration' tokens.

L27n1901.name: Word-start fragments → 'exception'
L27n1901.description: Fires strongly negative on the opening fragment of a multi-token word or name (e.g. 'Stra' in Straits, 'Am' in Amish, 'Sar' in Saratov, 'sm' in ex-smokers). Pushes toward 'exception' (steered output is 'Exception exception').

L25n680.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L25n680.description: Fires on a leading or middle subword piece of a split word, e.g. 'und' in Undoubtedly, 'pend' in pendent, 'inter' in interconnect, 'bed' in Ambedkar, 'pre' in pre-image, and some whole words in technical text. Pushes toward 'unit'/'Unit'.

L26n1942.name: Mid-word pieces, align output
L26n1942.description: Mid-word pieces of split words (absor-ber, dri-est, scr-apping, ar-mpits, ratio-cinative); pushes toward 'align' and 'alignment'.

L24n785.name: Token inside quoted snippet
L24n785.description: Fires positively on a word inside a quoted, pasted or command snippet, such as 'https' in a pasted URL, 'NOPASSWD' and 'ALL' in sudoers lines, or 'make' in a quoted question. Pushes toward closing quote and period combinations, which repeat when steered.

L26n608.name: Article before key noun
L26n608.description: Fires on a word fragment or article right before the key noun or split word: 'a' before botnet or collision, 'an' before event, 'read' in read(), 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'der' in deranged, 'spl' in splenium. Pushes toward 'condition' words.

L27n701.name: S-cluster word starts
L27n701.description: Negative on the start of 'sn', 'str' and 'sl' fragments, e.g. 'sne|ezing', 'str|angle-weed', 'sl|ippers'; pushes toward sentence-end punctuation.

L26n491.name: Name fragments -> quote-comma
L26n491.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split proper or technical name (e.g. 'then' in Parthenon, 'ru' in Pantagruelion, 'ipp' in Shippuden, 'Inter' in Interferometer). Pushed negative, it promotes closing-quote-comma tokens like '",' and '],'.

L27n1617.name: Consonant-led word openers
L27n1617.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, mostly consonant-led (sur|ges, str|icken, char|ity, sp|ires, ac|urricular, Ac|quired, Unc|les); pushed positive it promotes 'cause'.

L26n1360.name: Name fragments, 'page' output
L26n1360.description: The second piece of a split proper name or rare word (N-au-voo, Robert G-oulet, Fa-uci, As-qu-ith, priv-atised). Pushes toward 'page' and 'website'.

L26n1469.name: Word starts: Wh, Suc
L26n1469.description: Fires negatively on the first piece of a split capitalized word or chemical name ('Wh' in Whittingham, 'Suc' in sucralose, 'Sw' in Swindon); pushes toward 'short' and 'shorter'.

L27n1251.name: 'in' after get; spell-check
L27n1251.description: Fires on 'in' in phrasal verbs like 'get in shape' and 'stay in place', and on 'spell' before 'checker'; pushes toward 'check' tokens.

L26n962.name: Name-start fragments, history
L26n962.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalised proper name split across tokens, mostly place and people names in history text: 'Vers' in Versailles, 'Pers' in Persians, 'Ger' in Gertrude, 'Her' in Herlyne, 'S' in Sardis. Pushes toward 'site'.

L26n589.name: cr/cor word onsets
L26n589.description: The 'cr', 'cor', or 'co' opening fragment of a word split into tokens, such as Crème, crabs, crumbled, coracoid, coriander. Pushes toward quote-and-comma separator tokens.

L27n330.name: Name fragment, writes L
L27n330.description: Mid-word piece of names and words (Kare|lian, Roosevel|ts, de Gaul|le, tocopher|ol); pushes toward capital-L tokens like 'Li' and 'LI'.

L27n208.name: Immune/'imp' word starts
L27n208.description: Fires negative on the 'imm' or 'imp' start of immune- and impotence-type words, and on 'to' or 'of' after a verb; pushes output toward 'integration', 'suppression' and 'inhibition'.

L26n895.name: Capital letter, name opener
L26n895.description: Fires on the short first piece of a capitalised name or noun, often a single letter (e.g. 'D' in Dahi, 'U' in U.S., 'z' in zucchini); its output points to '=' and 'equals'.

L26n2422.name: Split-word first piece
L26n2422.description: The first piece of a word split into several tokens, just before its continuation, e.g. 'TE' in TEENAGER, 'att' in attaining, 'Ar' in Arnett. Pushes toward 'license' and 'cert'; steered, it spams 'license'.

L26n1278.name: Long-word middle pieces
L26n1278.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long word split into several tokens ('eth' in hypomethylation, 'ren' in adrenalin, 'le' in chameleons) and on 'New' or 'Ban' opening place names; the steering effect is weak.

L27n2836.name: Word fragments; writes 'led'
L27n2836.description: Fires on word-internal fragments that split a longer verb or noun: 'bree' (breech), 'bus' (arbuscules), 'cul' (culminated), 'ho' (hoarding), 'exempl' (exemplified). Pushes the model toward 'led' (steering spams 'LED').

L27n2072.name: Word-start pieces → 'display'
L27n2072.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word or name (e.g. 'La' in LaHood, 'Fl' in Flanner, 'cl' in clots, 'ac' in acoustic). Pushes toward 'display' tokens (steered output is 'display display').

L27n2499.name: Proper-name starts; writes drug
L27n2499.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name split into tokens (Ay|ut|thaya, Bl|asco, Kn|idos, Ch|akma); pushes toward 'drug', 'pharmaceutical' and 'medication'.

L27n136.name: Mid-name capitals, citation tails
L27n136.description: Fires on capital letters and short pieces inside long proper names (Ruzvo, Rzewuski, M|ek ong) and on the last token of a DOI. Pushes toward sentence-final punctuation.

L26n865.name: Mid-word fragment → 'before'
L26n865.description: Fires on a word piece that is split across tokens and needs a continuation, e.g. 'al' in albinism and alums, 'micro' in microbicides, 'tid' in tidal, 'grand' in grandparents, 'isha' in Tisha, 'apost' in apostrophe. Pushes the model toward 'before'/'Before'; when steered it outputs 'before' repeatedly.

L27n2048.name: Fragments; writes British
L27n2048.description: Fires on odd mid-word fragments and capital-led pieces in web text (dise in diseased, -w in moisture-wicking, Copyright, Fem); pushes toward British, England, UK and London.

L24n2856.name: Word-start fragment; 'independent' writer
L24n2856.description: Fires on the first subword of a split word or compound term ('Ind' in Indigenous, 'Mid', 'Med', 'Dis', 'Object' in Object Management). Pushes toward 'independent' and 'independence', which repeat when steered.

L27n729.name: Split-word stem pieces
L27n729.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, where the rest of the word is still to come: 'syll' in syllables, 'Pr' in Pruning, 'uk' in eukaryotes, 'bas' in basal. Pushes toward 'line' and 'function' tokens.

L27n1148.name: Word before -ing head
L27n1148.description: A word just before a hyphenated or compound -ing head, such as 'boat' in 'boat-building', 'decision' in 'decision-making', 'pumpkin' in 'pumpkin-patching', 'meal' in 'meal prepping', and 'is' or "'re" after a subject. Pushes toward 'setting' and 'building'.

L27n1819.name: Word-start con/v (neg)
L27n1819.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-opening 'con' or 'v'/'V' piece ('con' in convection, contractile and conventional; '-v' in low-voltage; 'V' in Vitamin and Vermilion); when negated, it pushes toward 'field', 'first' and 'fin'.

L27n1796.name: Consonant-cluster onsets (bre)
L27n1796.description: Fires on a word-opening consonant cluster split off as its own token, especially bre in breeder, gre in Greenshell, cre in crevice, and fre in freeware; pushes toward 'true' and 'True' tokens.

L27n3026.name: Consonant-cluster word-starts
L27n3026.description: Fires on consonant-cluster word starts such as 'bl', 'str', 'kr', 'Cl', and 'Wh' (bl|urring, str|addles, kr|ill, Cl|ifton); pushes toward 'stop' and 'stops' tokens.

L27n2316.name: Word-start fragment, writes schema
L27n2316.description: Fires on a short word-start fragment that begins a split word and must be completed (contr|ived, nond|iscriminatory, d|icing, de|oxyguanosine). Pushes toward 'schema' and 'scheme' tokens; steered output spams 'schema' or 'scheme'.

L27n1313.name: Split-word start pieces
L27n1313.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'sal' in 'salamandas', 'intr' in 'intravascular', 'ro' in 'rots', 'ul' in 'ulcers', 'tyr' in 'tyrannosaurus'. Pushes toward plural nouns for people or lives ('lives', 'hearts', 'minds').

L27n217.name: 'str' cluster start, created
L27n217.description: Fires on a word-opening 'str', 'st', 'sw', 'spr' or 'thr' piece cut from its word (str|olled, str|addling, sw|athed, spr|ang, thr|ong; also ref|ueling); pushes toward 'created' and 'formed'.

L26n322.name: Hedging and degree modifiers
L26n322.description: Fires on degree or manner modifiers before an adjective or verb ('a little daunting', 'slightly darker', 'gently patted', 'barely', 'pretty'), and on a few list-joining words; pushes toward garbled non-English tokens like 'xAA' and 'ogóle'.

L27n572.name: Numeral pieces, seven
L27n572.description: Fires on odd number and name pieces, e.g. '9' in 1979, '7' in 787, '⁴' in ¹⁴C, 'Bad' in Badlands, 'Se' in Seeds; pushes toward 7, seven, Seven.

L27n1633.name: Scattered mid-word fragments
L27n1633.description: Goes negative on scattered mid-word pieces with no single pattern (wind|m|ills, mega|aph|one, embez|be|lement, jar|j|ing); pushes toward ob tokens.

L26n1579.name: Name-middle letters
L26n1579.description: Fires on a short piece inside a proper noun or technical term, usually the letter or syllable right after the first piece (Stir|r|ers, Isa|a|h, Aeth|i|opia, Buddh|ists, Pad|u|cah, Cabr|era). Writes garbled 'f' and 'fh' tokens; pushed, output turns to 'fhirth' noise.

L27n2268.name: Word-start fragments, 'yes'
L27n2268.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, before the rest is known, such as 'fl' in flaxseed or fluoroquinolones, 'conf' in confute, 'And' in Andalusia; pushes toward 'yes'.

L25n1810.name: Split proper-noun fragments
L25n1810.description: Fires on a capitalized piece inside a multi-token proper name, such as 'B' in 'ʻAbdu'l-Bahá', 'Sh' in Shalimar, 'um' in Mpumalanga, or 'B' in Babylon, before the name is finished. Pushes the model toward 'block'.

L27n2036.name: st/str cluster starts, wall
L27n2036.description: Word-start 'st', 'str', 'sne' and 't' pieces split from the rest of the word ('Str|angler', 'st|unted', 't|innitus', 'st|inkbug'). Pushes toward 'Wall' and 'wall'.

L27n1719.name: Mid-word fragment, writes sequence
L27n1719.description: Word-middle piece of split words (sap|odilla, sap|wood, Mes|ozoic, gr|ubs); pushes toward 'sequence' and 'seq'.

L26n2037.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L26n2037.description: Word-internal onset fragments that start with a consonant cluster ('cl' in cl|ots, 'st' in st|unted, 'fl' in fl|ora, 'rel' in rel|atable); pushes toward 'random'.

L27n1577.name: Capital S word-start
L27n1577.description: Fires on a capitalised S that opens a new word or list item (Scoliosis, Scurvy, Sepsis, Slightly, Sodium, Serves); pushes output toward short 'h' and 't' onsets such as hi, hu and tie.

L25n1944.name: Module-like word pieces
L25n1944.description: Short word-internal pieces such as 'id' (Pter|id|aceae), 'omon' (Pseud|omon|as), 'Mod' (Ecological Mod|elling) and 'M' (M-file); pushes toward 'module'.

L27n2165.name: Word starts before struct
L27n2165.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word (inde|structable, sarc|ophagi, extr|acurricular, Pompe|y); pushes toward 'struct', 'structure' and 'structural'.

L27n1968.name: Word-start 'cr' fragments
L27n1968.description: The 'cr' piece that starts a split word, e.g. cr|adle, cr|abs, cr|inolines, plus 'tele' in tele|pathically; pushes toward 'learn' and 'learning', spamming 'learning learning'.

L27n37.name: Inside a fixed title
L27n37.description: The word inside a fixed multi-word title or institution, e.g. 'Christian Science' Monitor, 'Affordable Care' Act, 'Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security' Agency, 'one-of-a-kind'. Pushes toward em-dash '—' tokens.

L27n2085.name: Capital-G fragments → Italian
L27n2085.description: The 'G' piece of a word split into tokens (Gundisapur, G-d, Gospels, Ghetto) plus other mid-word fragments; pushes the model toward 'Italian/Italy' and other European country names.

L27n2574.name: Word-internal fragments
L27n2574.description: Negative on word-internal pieces of split words, mostly the middle or end of a word (nemat|oc|ysts, apoc|ryphal, c|asserole, Sarab|hai); pushes toward 'delete' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n2998.name: Split word-opening pieces
L27n2998.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word or name that the next token completes (Pal|amedes, Ad|en, cho|lesterol, Pic|ual). Pushes toward 'student' tokens.

L27n2033.name: Name-start pieces; writes 'recent'
L27n2033.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or split word (M in Bryn Mawr, Jo in JoVE, bur in burritos); pushes toward 'recent', 'latest' and 'recently'.

L27n1975.name: Inner word pieces
L27n1975.description: Negative on inner pieces of split medical and technical words (epid|ermis, trau|ma, dial|ysate, proph|ylaxis, pl|umb line); pushes toward 'pi' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n690.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n690.description: Fires on a word-start consonant cluster such as 'str' (straddles, straits), 'sc', 'sh', 'bl', 'fl' or 'squ'; pushes the model toward empty brackets like '[]', '()' and '{}'.

L27n406.name: Mid-word fragment, plural push
L27n406.description: The first piece of a word split mid-word, often a verb stem before its ending (j|uts, rel|ieves, d|ries, gl|azes). Pushes toward plural nouns like 'Games' and 'Files'.

L27n209.name: Modifiers before nouns
L27n209.description: Fires on a word right before a noun or fixed name, such as 'ripe' in ripe tomatoes, 'Great' in Great Lakes, 'Seven' in Seven Sages, 'numerous' before hiking; pushes toward 'page', 'file', 'value' and 'model'.

L27n2465.name: Consonant word-starts
L27n2465.description: Fires strongly negative on a short consonant-initial piece that begins a word split into tokens, e.g. 'B' in B|ortnyik, 'C' in C|zar, 'S' in S|imeon, 'Fr' in Fr|anks, 'Br' in Br|igid, 'c' in c|old, 'fer' in fer|ocious. Going negative pushes toward encode, decode and encoded tokens.

L26n1079.name: Capital letters opening names
L26n1079.description: Goes negative on the capital first letter or first piece of a name or acronym mid-sentence: 'H' in Houdon, 'H' in HSPH, 'Sch' in Schwann and Schiffman, 'F' in FACC, '-H' in McGraw-Hill. Pushes toward '--' dashes.

L27n2077.name: Long-word middle piece
L27n2077.description: The second or middle token of a long technical word split into pieces ('aqu'|'ac'|'ulture', 'par'|'ap'|'legia', 'Ge'|'ob'|'acter', 'cephal'|'op'|'od'). Pushes toward 'l'-initial tokens such as 'l', 'lan' and 'lat'.

L24n2213.name: 'to' before goal infinitives
L24n2213.description: Fires on 'to' that opens a purpose or goal infinitive in creative and task prompts ('journey to save', 'journey to discover', 'takes risks to achieve'), plus word-start fragments in names; pushes toward 'become'. Weak and diffuse.

L27n1659.name: Credit risk, emb starts
L27n1659.description: Fires on finance words (credit, loan, collateral, high risk) and on 'emb' in story prompts (em|barks); pushes toward default tokens.

L25n2207.name: Ex- and non- prefixes
L25n2207.description: Negative on prefix pieces that open a negated or existence word (pre-ex|posure, non|-working, non|tribosphenic, ex|oplanets) and on some name starts (G|utzon); pushes toward 'exist' and 'existing'.

L27n855.name: Name and term pieces
L27n855.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a multi-token name or technical term, e.g. 'Bur' in Burj Khalifa, 'ju' in juice, 'brid' in disulfide-bridged, 'Pid' in Pidgin. Pushes toward 'J'.

L27n1435.name: Mid-word fragments, spend
L27n1435.description: Fires (negative) on a short piece inside a long word split across tokens, e.g. 'op' in Neoplatonic, 'oc' in tocopherol, 'ely' in Thelypteridaceae, 'C' in Cacao; pushes toward spend, spent, spending, expenditure.

L27n1204.name: Name fragments, mixed
L27n1204.description: A capitalised word or name piece that the next token completes (De|indl, Mel|vin, Az|aleas, Pont|ifical, H|aversine, hal|ibut), and 'de' in 'de Gaulle'; pushes toward 'gr'/'Gr' tokens.

L27n1216.name: Head noun to run
L27n1216.description: Strongly negative on a head noun that often forms a compound, such as 'run' in run scorer or bank run, 'show' in show notes, or 'ground' and 'ad'. Pushes toward 'run' and 'running'.

L27n1700.name: Diffuse; writes 'condition'
L27n1700.description: Weak and diffuse. Goes strongly negative on determiners, prepositions or name pieces right before a noun phrase: 'la' (de la Cerda), 'the', 'on' (on the volcano), '-A' (Jean-Antoine). Pushing it negative steers toward 'condition(s)'.

L26n1800.name: Prefix stubs: nan, con
L26n1800.description: Fires (negative) on the short first piece of a scientific or long word split into tokens: 'nan' in nanoscale and nanomedicine, 'Ag' in Ag@SiO2, 'con' in conquering and coniferous, 'an' in nanosecond, 'cur' in curtailed. Pushes toward '@' and 'norm'-style tokens; steering has no clear effect.

L26n70.name: Person-name initials
L26n70.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or initial of a person's name, mostly middle initials ('J' in Charles J. Shields, 'J' in Rafid J. Hussein) and name starts ('An' in Anne McKinnell, 'An' in Anja Spang). Pushes weakly toward code tokens like '@return' and 'getPost'.

L27n1542.name: Proper-name prefix (Har, Santa)
L27n1542.description: The first piece of a capitalized place or person name split into subwords ('Har' in Harpenden/Harbin, 'Santa' in Santa Rosa, 'ess' in Teesside); pushes toward 'simple'/'simplify'.

L27n1314.name: Compound joiner → 'thing'
L27n1314.description: Fires on a word-opening fragment or a hyphen or particle inside a compound ('to' in Vehicle-to-vehicle, 'rh' in rhinotracheitis, 'hy' in hydroids, 'cl' in clenching); pushes toward 'thing', 'things' and 'something'.

L27n2624.name: Word-start fragments, constant
L27n2624.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into subword tokens, e.g. 'fl' in flammable/flaky, 'shr' in shrub, 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'ef' in indefinite. Pushes toward 'constant/constants'; strong steering spams 'constant'.

L26n2087.name: Word-opener fragments, 'break'
L26n2087.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of split words and names (Ish in Ishiguro, bra in braids, pa in palettes, Gra in Graubünden, anch in disenfranchised); pushes toward 'break' tokens.

L27n372.name: 'Prom'/'orig' → 'Figure'
L27n372.description: Fires on word-opening fragments like 'Prom' (promising, prompts, prominent), 'orig' (origami) and 'Inf'. Pushes toward document-reference words 'Figure', 'Table', 'Section' (steered output is 'Figure Figure' or 'Table Table').

L27n185.name: Stray fragments, consonant writer
L27n185.description: Fires on stray word fragments in mixed-language text and split words, e.g. Cyrillic 'и' in Сибирь, 'pa' in palettes, 'a' in aches, 'onta' in Devonta. Pushes toward single consonant tokens (t, s, d, c, m, n), so steered text degenerates into strings like 'tmnmnm'.

L27n1398.name: Word-start fragment, writes increase
L27n1398.description: The short first piece of a word split into tokens: 'sh' (shed, shampoos, shelve), 'Pl' (Plague, Platonist), 'Char' (Charlemagne), 'contr' (contraptions). Pushes toward 'increase' and 'increasing'.

L27n1272.name: 'w' word-start, writes 'write'
L27n1272.description: Fires on a word-initial 'w' or 'W' fragment, e.g. 'w' in 'wiser', '-W' in 'Writes', 'unw' in 'unworthy', plus a few other short word-start pieces. Pushes toward 'write', 'writing' and 'written'; steered, it spams 'write'.

L26n0.name: Diffuse word completions
L26n0.description: Heterogeneous: the word-completing token of a phrase in mixed text (high-end, pessimistic assumptions, April, Python, injuries). No single pattern. Pushes toward quote-and-punctuation tokens.

L27n2138.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n2138.description: Fires (goes negative) on the first piece of a word that opens with a consonant cluster, usually when split (sc|oliosis, sc|arring, Stan|wick, str|icken, sn|ags, infl|ow); pushes output toward 'collect' and 'collection'.

L25n1099.name: Re- prefix starts
L25n1099.description: Fires on the 're' sub-token that opens a prefixed word (re-assemble, re-expands, re-processing, reconfigurable, re-signed, reappeared); pushes 'feedback' tokens.

L14n2258.name: Grammar-example clause word
L14n2258.description: Diffuse: fires on an auxiliary, modal, possessive or verb-slot word inside example sentences and grammar exercises, e.g. 's' in 'Jessica's failure', 'must' in 'a robot must', 'you' in 'as you requested', 'to' in 'you (to do)'. Pushes toward unrelated word fragments like 'carbonate' and 'qualia'.

L27n273.name: Mid-word fragments → ane
L27n273.description: Middle pieces of split words (ARR in PARRISE, iox in Vortioxetine, nit in nitrate, Nec in Necrolestes, Kh in Khamba); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ane', 'ice' and 'ave', and steered text drifts into 'cave'.

L27n2262.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'God'
L27n2262.description: Fires on a short word-initial fragment or letter that opens a multi-token word, e.g. 'f' in feta, 'sk' in skit, 'G' in Glee, 'sol' in solis. Pushes toward 'God' and 'god' tokens; steered, it spams 'God'.

L27n2879.name: Short capital word starts
L27n2879.description: Fires on a short one- or two-letter first piece of a word, often a capital (B|abylon, Bl|asco, dr|ab, sc|atters, v|logger); pushes toward 'fiber/fibre' tokens.

L22n1847.name: Noun-phrase joiner tokens
L22n1847.description: fires on the preposition or determiner right after a head noun ('the King of', 'lengths of', 'a minute', 'pop-up'), with no single topic; pushes toward 'object' tokens.

L27n234.name: Word-start sp, Sc pieces
L27n234.description: The first piece of a split verb or adjective, e.g. 'sp' in un|sp|ayed, 'Sc' in |Sc|raping, 'Th' in |Th|inning, 'Hy' in |Hy|giene; pushes toward quotation marks, spamming '"' tokens.

L27n1985.name: Word piece; writes match
L27n1985.description: Goes negative on an early piece of a multi-token word or name: 'And' in Andalusia, 'em' in placemats, 'cro' in crocodiles, 'mel' in melons, 'M' in INDEX/MATCH, 'on' in Borglum. Pushed negative, it writes 'match' or 'matches' and spams it.

L27n329.name: Word-start, writes c-codes
L27n329.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords: 'Enh' in enhance, 'suff' in suffocate, 'pneum' in pneumonic, 'Terr' in terraces, 'SA' in SAARC. Pushes toward short parenthesized codes ending in c, such as (pc, (rc and bc, and toward strings of capital C.

L27n1055.name: Word-start fragment; fi/fl
L27n1055.description: Fires on short word-start pieces of split words (di|hydrotestosterone, idi|abetic, Pro|phethood, intr|uding, ste|amer, self-de|emed). Pushes 'ﬂ' and 'ﬁ' ligature tokens; steered output is whitespace and newline spam.

L26n41.name: Word-start fragment before completion
L26n41.description: The incomplete first or middle piece of a word split into tokens (ab in abundance, -st in non-stick, Under in Understand) and Japanese を or が particles; pushes toward odd word-start fragments and filler such as 'waiting'.

L26n269.name: Adjective before technical noun
L26n269.description: Fires on the modifier right before a technical head noun ('smooth' in smooth muscle, 'near' in near-infrared, 'heel' in heel pain), and on word-start 'mim' in mimicking. Pushes toward 'wait' and 'asynchronous'.

L26n2456.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'rule'
L26n2456.description: Fires on a short first piece of a word split into tokens that is not yet a whole word, e.g. 'Kr' in Krust, 'Sar' in Saracen, 'Tar' in Tarquin, 'hal' in halibut. Pushes toward 'rule' tokens.

L27n1782.name: Word-start piece, writes place
L27n1782.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening fragment of a word split into tokens, especially 'Rem' in Remembrance, 'ul' in ulcers, 'pl' in germplasm, 'mol' in molten and 'som' in sombre; pushes 'place' and 'places'; steered output loops 'Place place'.

L27n2905.name: Word-start 'rem'; writes 'planet'
L27n2905.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces such as 'rem' in remaking, removes, remembrance, plus 'Vid' (Vidisha), 'Hou' (Houdon), 'm' (treadmills). Pushing it negative steers toward 'planet' and 'orbit'.

L25n2678.name: Initial noun fragments
L25n2678.description: Fires on the first one or two letters of a noun or name split into tokens ('j' in jicama, 'J' in OpenJDK, 'gr' in grubs, 'intr' in intravenous, 'wre' in wreaths, 'kr' in krill); pushes toward 'repeat'.

L27n1320.name: Word-start fragments → 'reg'
L27n1320.description: Fires on early pieces of split technical words (e.g. 'imp' in implicate, 'arr' in arrhythmia, 'fib' in fibrillation, '-pro' in protein). Pushes toward 'reg' tokens (steered output is 'Regregreg').

L27n521.name: Split-word first fragments
L27n521.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word, especially 'sl', 'st', 'Ad', 'inter' and 'br' (sl|ant, st|ings, Ad|oration, inter|com, br|ussels). Pushes the model toward 'image'/'message' tokens.

L26n2970.name: 'f'/'ab' start after 'and'
L26n2970.description: Goes strongly negative on the leading 'f' or 'ab' piece of a word that follows 'and' or a hyphen ('brushing and f|lossing', 'full-f|ledged', 'Fire-f|ighting', 'unab|ridged'). Writes 'failure/fault' tokens, and the steered output is 'failure fails' spam.

L27n419.name: Split-word starts; B-units
L27n419.description: Fires on the leading fragment of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'v' in Nauvoo, 'pend' in Harpenden, 'inn' in cinnabar, 'oct' in octa-; pushes toward unit-style tokens ending in B such as MB, GB, SB and (sb.

L24n1282.name: 'Con-' word opener
L24n1282.description: Fires on the 'Con' or 'con' opening piece of a split word (Con|stitution, Con|versely, pre-con|ceived, con|fluence, con|soled), plus 'identifier' and 'and'/'the' before a noun. Pushes toward 'conclude' and 'conclusion'.

L25n1233.name: Infinitive 'to' and 'be'
L25n1233.description: Fires on 'be', 'to' or 'and' right before a verb phrase ('can be used', 'how to make', 'understood and practiced'), and on the first piece of some names (Mu- in Muhammad, Bo- in Bochs, Mp- in Mpumalanga). Pushes toward 'application' and 'applied'; at dose -0.5 it repeats 'apply application'.

L26n2268.name: Medical 'se' word starts
L26n2268.description: Fires on the 'se' token that opens medical and skin words split into pieces (seborrhea, sepsis, septicemia, seawater), plus 'Dis' and 'bi' starts; pushes output toward 'oil', 'fat' and 'lipid'.

L26n1543.name: Modifier before technical noun
L26n1543.description: Fires on the adjective or first word of a fixed technical compound, before its head noun (Large| Hadron, square| matrix, second|-order, grass| verge, Word|Net). Pushes toward 'root'.

L27n1515.name: Split names, 'man'
L27n1515.description: Fires on the first part of a split name or term (Old, Middle, NEW, Ram-, Hodg-, german-), often in history and place text; pushes 'man' and 'Man'.

L27n2292.name: Name/word splits; writes 'wave'
L27n2292.description: Fires on a partial token inside a split name or word (Mp|um|alanga, Tomo|Č|ačić, Nan|aimo, Dec|iduous); pushes toward 'wave' and 'waves'.

L26n1406.name: Place-name fragments
L26n1406.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a place or person name split into tokens ('Nem' in Nemadji, 'Laf' in Lafitte, 'ant' in Nantawarrina, 'Bab' in Bab el Mandeb, 'Me' in Meaux). Pushes toward 'letter' and 'letters'.

L25n1712.name: Name-internal connectives, record/log
L25n1712.description: Connectors and word-internal pieces inside multi-token names or lists (and in EPA and DHA, Con in Immaculate Conception, been after had, the ith in hadith); pushes toward 'record' and 'log', which reads as weak.

L27n2829.name: Word-start S/Sh fragments
L27n2829.description: A word-initial 'S', 'Sh', 'Se', or 'str' piece of a split word or place name (Sw|indon, Se|ville, sh|ui, str|ung, unve|ils, Tr|ang). Pushes toward affix words like 'append', 'supplement', 'prefix'.

L27n1894.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L27n1894.description: Fires on a word-opening consonant cluster split off as its own token, especially scr in scraping, cl in clumping or clippings, str in stricken, and cr in cradle; pushes toward 'begin' and 'beginning' tokens.

L27n887.name: Split name fragment, get
L27n887.description: Fires on an odd word or name fragment, e.g. 'ile' in cantilevered, 'Zam' in Zambezi, '-car' in low-carbon, 'VE' in VE Day; pushes the model toward 'get'.

L27n1003.name: Word-start fragments, open
L27n1003.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'orth' in orthopaedic, 'fr' in frayed, 'anche' in Blanche, 'oste' in osteoporosis, 'wide' in wide-ranging; pushes toward open and opens.

L27n1261.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'cent'
L27n1261.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, such as 'Col' in Colonic, 'Mult' in Multicultural, 'photoc' in photocatalyst, or 'Cost' in cost of goods. Pushes toward 'cent' and 'center' tokens; steered, it spams them.

L26n2127.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'family'
L26n2127.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, like 'il' in 'Vit-il-igo', 'f' before 'amily', or 'Rab' in a surname; pushes toward 'family' and 'families', and at high dose the model spams 'family'.

L27n2331.name: Mid-word fragment, '-ent' push
L27n2331.description: Fires on a word-internal fragment that a suffix completes (Sacr|ament, sed|entary, sed|iments, ind|ented). Pushes toward 'ent' endings.

L27n2276.name: Mixed fragments; visit output
L27n2276.description: Fires on short fragments inside words or names, such as '-r' in rhizobium, 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'b' in Middlesbrough, and 'Ex' in Exile; pushes toward 'visit' and 'visitor'.

L26n2040.name: Word-start capital fragments
L26n2040.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, often a short onset such as 'C' in 'Colds' or 'Cite', 'inc' in 'incorporating', 'oc' in 'recur', 'Anch' in 'Anchorage'; writes 'cor/Cor/COR' tokens.

L26n2013.name: Capitalized name's first piece
L26n2013.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a capitalized name or word split into tokens (Pat|agonia, Pret|oria, Bel|knap, Bot|anical, Os|mond), often after a preposition. Pushes the model toward 'your' and 'Your'.

L1n1919.name: Prepositions after nouns
L1n1919.description: Fires on a preposition, 'that' or 'and' right after a noun phrase head, e.g. 'change in', 'end of', 'assembled by'. Pushes the model toward meaningless code-like tokens with no clear effect.

L27n1939.name: Word fragment → 'day'
L27n1939.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment of a split word, often the piece just before a suffix ('yc' in polycrystalline, 'ar' in arbuscules, 'exc' in excelled, 'Ber' in Berber, 'oc' in cryptocurrencies); pushes toward time words 'day', 'year' and 'week'.

L26n2470.name: Word stems before suffixes
L26n2470.description: A stem fragment of a longer word split into tokens, just before its ending (suff|used, cons|cription, res|istance, odef|iciency); pushes toward 'record'.

L27n1304.name: Latin prefix word openers
L27n1304.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word that starts with a common prefix, mainly 'con', 'cons', 'pres' and 'res' (con|struction, con|ventional, cons|cription, Pres|ently, res|ided, pros|elyted). Pushes toward 'sum' and 'sums'; steered, it spams 'Sum sum'.

L27n914.name: Verb-start fragment, calls writer
L27n914.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a split verb (emb|arks, con|veys, en|forces, sou|ps), mostly before the verb ends. Pushes toward 'calls', 'requests', and 'messages'.

L26n2078.name: Mid-word fragments, motion output
L26n2078.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, often 'm', 'rem' or 'Em' in words about bodies or machines (tread|mills, wind|mills, rem|oves, Em|otional, gently, physically); pushes toward 'motion', 'motor' and 'movement'.

L27n1363.name: Name fragments, closing brackets
L27n1363.description: Fires on a name or word piece inside a proper noun, e.g. 'ensch' in Schenckensch-ans, 'ph' in phagocytes, 'Ker' in Keret, and CJK name characters; pushes toward closing bracket runs like '))]' and '}]'.

L27n2360.name: First split-word piece
L27n2360.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letter piece of a longer word or name split across tokens, while the rest is still unseen ('n' in vicious-n|uns, 'Tit' in Tit|us, 'recogn' in recogn|ising, 'Pots' in Pots|dam). Pushes toward 'nan' and 'nano' tokens.

L27n2051.name: 'dec' starts, writes 'mechan-'
L27n2051.description: Goes strongly negative on 'dec' starting a word ('decimation', 'decoupled', 'decarbonisation'). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'mechan-' tokens (mechanism, mechanical), and the output spams 'Mech Mechan'.

L27n402.name: Unfinished word start
L27n402.description: Fires on a word-initial fragment that is not yet a full word, most often 'sl' or 'pl' (slights, slippers, plasm), plus 't' in tamed and 'h' in hedges, and on an opening '(' before a Latin name. Pushes toward closing quote-comma tokens such as ", and ").

L27n2304.name: Split-word pieces → 'round'
L27n2304.description: Fires on a first or middle piece of a word split into tokens (amin|og|lycoside, gl|ottal, imp|oundment, mor|ose, bra|ai, terr|acing), before the word completes. Pushes toward 'round'/'Round' (steered output: 'Round round round').

L27n1258.name: Rare-word start fragments
L27n1258.description: Fires on the first fragment of a long or rare word split into pieces (inter|red, fl|ares, Dur|ban, Mel|vin, ipp|uden, pre|exposure); pushes output toward 'high' and 'higher'.

L27n1060.name: Split-word pieces, max
L27n1060.description: Fires on a split-word piece, e.g. 'em' (light-emitting), 'Wi' (Wi-Fi), 'cl' (clenching), 'sw' (swimmers), 'Rem' (Reminiscent), '/M' (pMIC). Pushes toward 'max' tokens; steered, it spams 'Max'.

L27n1878.name: Word-initial f pieces
L27n1878.description: Fires strongly negative on a standalone 'f' or 'F' that starts a word split from its ending, e.g. 'f' in f|eral, f|idgeting, f|angs, f|ashions, F|ruit, Prof|iciency, and 'ef' in Y|ef|remov. Going negative pushes toward 'evaluat-' and 'eval' tokens.

L25n1714.name: Surname middle piece
L25n1714.description: Fires on a middle piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (e.g. 'K|re|imer', 'Bruns|bü|ttel', 'Hugo G|rot|ius', 'Clem|ence|au'). Pushes toward 'interest' and 'interested'.

L24n2355.name: Word after UI action
L24n2355.description: Fires on the word right after a software UI action or button name in step-by-step instructions ('click', 'Change button to', 'Auto' in AutoCAD, 'double-click', a bullet dash before a menu action); pushes toward 'save'.

L26n1077.name: Function word before verbs
L26n1077.description: Goes negative on a function word that introduces an action verb ('to', 'can', 'will', 'then') in instructions and explanations ('then deletes', 'can just type'). Pushes toward 'list' and 'List' tokens, and steering spams 'list'.

L27n1381.name: Verb-stem starts, writes reflexives
L27n1381.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a split verb or past-tense stem, e.g. 'spr' in sprouted and sprang, 'sh' in shut down, 'dec' in decimated, 'def' in defied. Negative push writes reflexive pronouns 'herself/himself/myself', so steered text spams 'herself herself'.

L27n1445.name: Odd word-start fragment
L27n1445.description: Negative on the first piece of a word split into odd fragments, often hyphen-attached (-al in human-altered, -l in green-lipped, Sp in Spending, exc in excised). Pushes toward 'problem'; steered output spams 'problem'.

L26n761.name: Name fragments, short syllables
L26n761.description: Fires on a middle or tail fragment of a proper name or acronym split across tokens (ol in Reed-Solomon, Ar in Yaroslavl, kel in Ashkelon, Dor, Col, CAR); pushes toward short lowercase syllables like 'ho', 's', 'y' and 'ya', giving nonsense words.

L27n1891.name: Pre-suffix stem, writes 'ind'
L27n1891.description: Fires strongly negative on mid-word stem pieces that a suffix follows (e.g. 'sil' in silhouettes, 'ox' in oxazolidinones, 'cl' in clindamycin, 'Wau' in Waukesha). Pushes toward 'ind' tokens (steered output is 'Indindind').

L26n2092.name: Word-start pieces, 'k' tokens
L26n2092.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split across tokens, right before its ending (mult- in multilingualism, bur- in burrows, ur- in urinating, -a in one-of-a-kind), and on the start of some names and titles. Pushes toward 'k' tokens; at dose -0.5 it writes 'kowk'-like nonsense.

L27n1725.name: 'thr' word starts, IV
L27n1725.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most of all thr (thrifty, thrived, thong), plus contr, reck, nurt and capt. Pushes toward Roman numerals 'IV', 'iv' and 'III'.

L26n2418.name: Capital starts → sleep
L26n2418.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized word or name mid-sentence, especially short caps such as 'Ad' (Adoration), 'C' (Cohansey), 'G' (Ghetto), 'W' (Wet Weather), and 'ret' in retelling; pushes toward 'sleep'.

L26n1241.name: 'cre/bre' onsets -> 'challenge'
L26n1241.description: Fires on word-opening 'cre', 'bre', 'stra', 'Mer' or 'gre' pieces of split words and names (Cremonesi, creepy, streusel, Merlin, Straub). Pushed positive, it promotes 'challenge/challenges' and spams 'challenge'.

L26n1725.name: Illness word starts (fever)
L26n1725.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of an illness or infection word split into tokens (fe|vers, se|psis, Dis|order, Inf|ection). Pushes toward 'follow', 'followed' and 'Follow'.

L27n1810.name: v-pieces; writes ver
L27n1810.description: Fires on a short opening piece of a split word, mostly 'v' or 'V' (low-voltage, V2 rocket, V-SDs) and 'Non' in nonproliferation; pushes toward 'ver' tokens.

L27n727.name: Opening paren before acronym
L27n727.description: The opening parenthesis just before an acronym or abbreviation, e.g. 'Active Template Library (ATL)', '(LRU)', '(EPA)'; pushes toward fullwidth commas and punctuation, spamming '，，，'.

L27n152.name: Assorted fragments, paren output
L27n152.description: Fires on scattered points: a port number (5 in UDP 520), split word pieces (anth in chrysanthemums, qu in Tarquinius) and newlines before list items; pushes toward an open paren followed by a letter.

L27n1077.name: Word-start fragments and openers
L27n1077.description: Negative on incomplete word-start fragments ("mis", "hyper", "un", "dis", "Eng") just before the word finishes, and on opening quotes, brackets, or "<"/"@" right before a term; it writes function words like "if", "in", "at", "the" and, when pushed, spams "at"/"in"/"the".

L27n2521.name: Word-initial h fragment
L27n2521.description: Fires (negative) on a lone 'h' or 'H' that opens a word split into pieces ('Rh' in rhinoceros, 'h' in hump, hilly, Hips); pushes toward 'factor'-type nouns.

L27n624.name: Mid-word piece, writes set
L27n624.description: Fires on a word piece in the middle of a split word (e.g. 'anos' in deoxyguanosine, 'typ' in typologies, 'jet' in jet-setting, 'Mind' in mindfulness) and on some function words before a verb such as 'to' or 'can'; pushes 'set', 'sets' and 'Set'; steered output loops 'Set set'.

L27n1337.name: Word-start f fragment
L27n1337.description: Fires on a lone 'f' or a 'Fr/Ne' piece starting a split word (f|lossing, f|ussy, f|ashions, Fr|anks, Ne|olithic). Pushes 'success/successful' (steered output is 'Success' spam).

L26n2993.name: short word-start fragments
L26n2993.description: Fires on the start of a word split into tokens, mostly short fragments ('me' in meadow and megalomaniac, 'Man' in Man's Search, 'thr' in thrived, 'der' in deranged). Pushes toward 'brain', 'mind' and 'mental'.

L27n507.name: Title and name middles
L27n507.description: Fires on a word inside a title or proper name, such as 'Social' in Catholic Social Services, 'Living' in Survey of Living Conditions, 'de' in Bureau International de l'Heure; pushes toward answer-type nouns like 'Question' and 'Result'.

L27n1310.name: Numbers, ordinals, fuel terms
L27n1310.description: Fires on the digit, ordinal or quantity word that gives a measure or grade, e.g. 'one' in 'one degree', '7' in '4.76 inches', '0' in '230 degrees', 'th' in '5th grade', 'first' in 'first grade', plus 'diesel' and 'renewable'. Pushes toward 'standard' and 'std'; steered, it spams 'Standard'.

L27n2130.name: 'mis-' prefix and fragments
L27n2130.description: The 'mis' onset of mis-words (misfits, mischievous, misshapen, mischance) and other mid-word fragments of split names (Par|akeet, Esp|asianus); pushes toward 'ident'/'identity' tokens.

L27n2379.name: Letter after Washington, D.C.
L27n2379.description: Fires negative on the single capital letter after a place name, above all "D" in "Washington, D.C.". It also fires on one-letter word-start pieces such as "M" in MMS and "-m" in moon. Pushes the model toward "line" and "lines".

L1n2801.name: Mid-word suffix fragments
L1n2801.description: fires on mid-word fragments that finish an English adjective or adverb, e.g. 'all|ions', 'wast|eful', 'quick|ly', 'inextric|ably'; pushes toward unrelated code-like tokens, and steering gives garbled text.

L27n1341.name: Name-start pieces, '||'
L27n1341.description: Negative on the first piece of a split name or technical term (Fr|isian, Fr|anks, Schw|ann, Verd|igris), pushing toward '||' and '&&' operators.

L27n1192.name: Word-start 'mol'/'Cl' fragment
L27n1192.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split word (mol|ars, mol|ting, Cl|imb, Cl|ifton, hyp|odermis). Pushes toward 'limit' and 'lim'.

L27n1779.name: Split-word first pieces
L27n1779.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, where the rest of the word follows, e.g. 'Ste' in Ste|phn, 'fl' in fl|aring, 'dis' in dis|integrates, 'st' in st|ings, and 'am' in 'I am not'. Pushes toward '{' and brace tokens.

L27n1571.name: Lone 'D' word-start
L27n1571.description: Goes negative on a lone 'D' or 'd', or an 'St' start, that begins a word piece, such as 'Semi-d|warf', 'd|ocking', 'D|harma', 'nond|iscriminatory' and 'St|ewardship'; pushes 'double/dual'.

L27n697.name: Pre-noun modifiers; closing braces
L27n697.description: Goes strongly negative on a modifier word right before its head noun (North in North Yorkshire, celebrity in celebrity chefs, bathroom in bathroom sinks); pushes toward closing braces and quote-brace tokens such as } and 》.

L27n2280.name: Short hyphen-piece fragments
L27n2280.description: Fires on short subword pieces that start or continue a word in list-like or technical text: 'lie' in 'lie on the table', '-c' in 'single-celled' and 'foot-candle', 'line' in oxazolidinones, 'en' in Cenozoic. Pushes toward 'length'.

L26n2076.name: List and instruction connectives
L26n2076.description: Fires on a connective that sets up the next item in a list or instruction: 'with' after brush, cover or seal verbs, 'into', 'or' between options, 'any' after double-click, 'eg' and commas in example lists. Also fires on some word starts like 'P' in Pomeranian and 'm' in mites. Pushes toward 'goods' and 'commodities'.

L25n896.name: Requirement clause opener
L25n896.description: Fires on 'that', 'which' or 'to' right after a build request, opening a requirements clause ('Write a jQuery script that adds...', 'Develop a JavaScript app that plays...', 'Create a form that includes...'), and on word-start pieces like 'Contr', 'decl' and 'conf'. Pushes toward 'filter'.

L27n1610.name: Technical word-start pieces
L27n1610.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a capitalized or technical word split into pieces, e.g. 'Q' in Q|utb, 'Mand' in Mand|eb, 'Var' in Var|iances, 'Har' in Har|penden, 'St' in St|reak camera, 'N' in N|omenclature, 'underst' in underst|udied. Pushes toward width and wide.

L25n1635.name: Split-word first piece
L25n1635.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split across tokens, mid-word, where the rest is still to come (e.g. 'Benef' in Beneficiaries, 'forfe' in forfeit, 'prof' in profusely). Pushes the model toward 'fit'.

L14n92.name: Post-verb complement word
L14n92.description: Diffuse, low-level: fires on the word right after a verb or preposition that opens an object or complement, e.g. 'to' in 'link to', 'just' in 'skip just', 'up' in 'looked up', 'us' in 'for us', plus the piece of a split word such as 'ate' in oxygenate. Pushes toward mid-word fragments like 'lectic' and 'reshold'.

L26n2224.name: und word starts
L26n2224.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, most strongly 'und' (undies, undeniably, undoubtedly), and also 'ry' in apocryphal and 'Bad' in Badlands; pushes toward 'schedule' words and steers into 'schedule schedule' spam.

L25n2430.name: Word-start pieces, 'extract' output
L25n2430.description: Goes positive on a non-final piece of a split word, often starting 'extr', 'exc' or 'sc' (extr|icably, Exc|avation, -sc|ience, Esc|abeche). Pushes toward 'extract' and 'fetch'; steering spams 'Extract'.

L26n1219.name: Rem and Prom word-starts
L26n1219.description: Strongly negative on a word-start fragment that begins a longer word, such as 'Rem' in Remembrance, 'Prom' in Prompts, 'som' in sombre, 'wre' in shipwrecks. Pushes the model toward 'price'.

L27n2054.name: Name fragment; 'law' write
L27n2054.description: Fires on the middle piece of split proper names and words (sl|aw, carn|ivorans, juris|prudence, uncon|sciously, Nan|jing, Ban|ff, Beng|uela). Pushes 'law', 'Law' and 'legal'; steered output is 'Law law' spam.

L27n3042.name: Word-initial f fragment
L27n3042.description: Fires on a lone 'f' or 'Inf' that opens a word split into tokens (f|ared, f|angs, f|athom, Inf|initives, f|ashions). Pushes the model toward 'get'/'gets'/'got' tokens.

L23n821.name: leading digit of numbers
L23n821.description: Fires on the first digit of multi-digit numbers (the '2' in '20', '2,000', '29 million', '2 BCE') and on commas after a word; pushes toward '&', so steered text drifts into HTML entities like '&', a mismatch with what it reads.

L14n2136.name: Diffuse phrase-completing nouns
L14n2136.description: Fires on the content word that completes a noun or verb phrase across mixed topics, e.g. 'infamous' after 'known for its', 'males' in 'castrated males', 'COVID' before '-19', 'Pages' in 'Number of Pages', 'ticket' in 'buy a ticket'; pushes toward technical-sounding nouns like 'Techniques' and 'Error', and at +0.5 it degenerates into 'For Even For'.

L27n2274.name: Name-start piece to database
