L27n2274.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split proper noun or word (Sh|ed, Gutz|on, Ele|phants, .de|zeen); pushes toward 'database' and 'Database' tokens, with a weak steering effect.

L27n2415.name: Capitalised term start
L27n2415.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token capitalised technical or institutional name: 'Computer' in Computer Architecture, 'O' in Oxidation States, 'Meteor' in Meteorological Organization, 'Mus' in Musical Arts. Pushed positive, it writes 'organization', 'organ' and 'org' and spams them.

L25n706.name: Question/idea -> ';'
L25n706.description: Fires on nouns that set up a question or idea ('question' in 'the question - what...', 'idea' in 'One idea I like', 'use' after 'can'). Pushed negative, it promotes semicolons and spams them.

L27n793.name: Word-start clusters, closing brackets
L27n793.description: The first subword piece of a long word split into tokens, usually a consonant-cluster start ('squ', 'spr', 'str', 'sne', 'thr'). Pushes toward closing brackets and braces such as ')] and }}.

L27n1164.name: Set-phrase verbs, -M fragments
L27n1164.description: Goes negative on the verb or preposition in set phrases (come into force, take over, take action, reach conclusions, first line of defense) and on capital-M fragments in names (-M in Wisconsin-Madison, Saif-ul-Maluk). Pushes toward '-al' adjectives (mathematical, financial, economic).

L27n557.name: Name fragment, computer output
L27n557.description: The middle piece of a proper name or rare word split into tokens ('Mos'|'he', 'Qut'|'b', 'Gut'|'enmacher', 'Mir'|'ai'), plus some chat-prompt words. Pushes toward 'computer' and 'digital' tokens.

L26n1072.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L26n1072.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name with a consonant cluster start, e.g. 'Rad' (Radbod, Radchuk), 'cart' (cartilage), 'cond' (conditions), 'trib' (tribosphenic), 'Ram' (Ramnes), and only weakly on the rest of the word. Writes 'Math' tokens, and the steered output is 'Math Math' spam.

L27n1465.name: Rel- and very-least words
L27n1465.description: Fires on the first piece of split words (rel|ays, rel|iance, electro|static) and on 'very' in 'at the very least'. Pushes toward 'less' and 'least'.

L27n580.name: Tech fragments → file-dots
L27n580.description: Fires on a mid-name piece in web and tech text, e.g. 'M' before '-file', 'Vue', 'React', '.gov', 'Write' in 'Write About'; pushes toward file-extension dot tokens like '.h', '.c', '.x'.

L26n133.name: Diffuse titles, sentence-end writer
L26n133.description: Weak and diffuse; peaks on words inside titles and lists (Institute, Operation, Statement, St, Apple, 'to' in 'to end all wars') and pushes sentence-ending punctuation, so steering gives period and newline spam.

L26n2783.name: Recipe-start fragments, chapter writer
L26n2783.description: Fires on the first piece of food and recipe words (accom|paniments, nood|le, cook time, spo|ons, Hop|py); pushes 'book' and 'chapter' words, so steering gives 'chapter' spam.

L27n1078.name: Word-start fragments, comment closers
L27n1078.description: The first subword piece of a split technical or proper word, often a short start ('sc|oliosis', 'Er|win', 'tr|ams', 'Ber|zelius', 'sn|ippers'). Pushes toward comment closers '*/' and '#endif'.

L27n2161.name: Intensifier before noun, diffuse
L27n2161.description: Low, diffuse activation across news prose, peaking on evaluative modifiers just before a noun ('most significant', 'huge difference', 'middle class', 'great German'); pushes toward closing Japanese quote brackets 」 and ».

L27n2841.name: 'con'/'fl' pieces, 'rot' writer
L27n2841.description: Goes negative on 'con' starting a split word (convection, confederation, unconventional) and on 'fl' in flaky or flaking. Pushes toward 'rot' and 'rotation' tokens.

L27n958.name: Word stem → semicolon
L27n958.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'shr' in shrubbery, 'pal' in palamedes, 'tw' in twitches, 'Ar' in Arbequina; pushes toward ';' and ');' code-ending tokens.

L27n2293.name: Word-initial fragment, 'dark' output
L27n2293.description: Fires on the short opening piece of a word split into tokens (often a single letter or 'c', 'r', 'g', or 'carc' in 'carcasses'); pushes toward 'dark' and 'Dark' repetition.

L27n1218.name: Mid-name word fragments
L27n1218.description: Fires (negative) on a word-internal piece of a split name or compound, e.g. 'Dum|fries', 'Daw|es', 'von Ne|umann', 'Tri|beca'; pushes toward 'activity', 'outputs' and 'inputs'.

L27n2449.name: Split word starts, ship
L27n2449.description: Word-start pieces of split words where the word continues, often capitalized or Latinate ('Ven|eto', 'bur|ritos', 'prem|olars', 'Hy|giene', 'Maj|orelle'). Pushes toward 'ship' and 'cart'.

L26n1903.name: Capitalized name starts, news
L26n1903.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun split into tokens (Cit|igroup, Therm|opylae, Hum|mingbird, Przew|alski, McGraw-H|ill). Pushes toward 'news' and 'News'.

L27n788.name: Split rare-name subword pieces
L27n788.description: Fires on the first or middle subword piece of a rare proper name or term split into several tokens (Przewalski 'zew', Tübingen 'ü', Slovin 'lo', Delord 'agn', Croatan 'Cro'); pushes toward 'FN'/'CN'-style tokens and 'knelt'.

L27n1215.name: Word before noun
L27n1215.description: Fires on the word or piece right before the noun it modifies (mult|ilocularis, volt|ages, spinal cord, drinking water, bladder, and 'a' in 'come to a head'). Pushes 'head' and 'heads' tokens; steered output spams 'head'.

L27n822.name: Diffuse word-start fragments
L27n822.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer words, such as co|exist, st|aves, pre|-exposure, and refr|active; pushes toward 'ex' and 'Ex' tokens.

L26n2821.name: Word fragments; determined
L26n2821.description: Word-internal fragments that start a longer word, such as 'Bad' in Badlands, 'Rou' in Rouen, 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'intr' in intravascular and 'inde' in indestructible. Pushes toward 'determin', 'determine' and 'determined'; steered output spams 'determined'.

L27n618.name: Mid-word fragment, writes ai
L27n618.description: Goes negative on second-half pieces of multi-token words ('ill', 'ig' in gigawatts, 'contr' in contraptions, 'extr' in extrinsic, 'gir' in giraffe); pushes toward 'ai', 'ary', 'am'.

L26n1806.name: Word-start s fragments
L26n1806.description: Fires on a lone 's' or 'S' that begins a split word in food, plant and tool lists, e.g. sardines, scones, sausage, sponge, sycamore, sudoers; pushes toward 'occurrence'.

L27n720.name: 'sar' before 'coma'
L27n720.description: Goes strongly negative on 'sar' in sarcoma or sarcomas split into pieces, and on 'reverse' in reverse transcriptase and 'oplan' in exoplanets; pushes toward 'com' tokens.

L27n2448.name: Word fragment → join
L27n2448.description: Fires on a word piece that begins a longer term, e.g. '-br' in blood-brain, 'av' in Pirqe avot, 'erv' in pervasive, 'ptic' in septic, and 'sign' before 'up'; pushes toward 'join' tokens.

L27n1358.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L27n1358.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or heading split into tokens (Tomo|Č|ačić, F in Ferrets, Foods, Festival; Str in Stroudwater); pushes toward programming identifiers like numberOf and batchSize.

L27n1068.name: Mid-word pieces, push 'b'
L27n1068.description: Fires negative on mid-word fragments of multi-token words (cantal|ou|pe, cara|m|bola, Marra|ke|ch, dri|pped, vanco|mycin), mostly food and place names; pushes output toward 'b' onsets such as bi, be, bed and bin.

L25n2716.name: Proper-name mid pieces
L25n2716.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of a multi-token proper name (Dom|esday, Fu|hrer, Heze|kiah, Ram|eses, Hor|owitz, Kle|bsiella, Ru|shd), usually the first or second piece; pushes toward 'normal' and 'ordinary'.

L27n1706.name: Name-start fragment, letter c
L27n1706.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into tokens, e.g. 'he' in heathen, 'ame' in Alamein, 'Ste' in Stephen, 'Gree' in Greeley. Pushes the model toward letter-like starts 'c', 'car' and 'g' (noisy).

L26n2446.name: Single-letter m onset
L26n2446.description: Goes negative on the single letter 'm' that starts a word split across tokens, e.g. 'm|ucus', 'Al-m|ohad', 'm|asher', 'm|ugs', and 'metam|orphosis'; writes compass words such as 'North', 'South', 'east'.

L27n2160.name: Long-word middle piece
L27n2160.description: A middle or first piece of a long word or name split into several tokens (lig in Hotamisligil, ome in Domesday, fres in frescoes, Borg in Borglum, f in flossing). Pushes toward 'face'; steered output spams 'face'.

L27n631.name: Name initial → brace
L27n631.description: Fires on the first letter or short start token of a capitalized name or reference, e.g. 'P' in Potters Bar, 'H' in Hertfordshire, 'p' in pails, 'sc' in scallions; pushes toward '{' braces.

L22n2104.name: Math quantity nouns, fragments
L22n2104.description: Mixed: fires on quantity nouns in math text ('scalar' in 'multiply by a scalar', 'integer' in 'n is an integer', '-co' in change-of-co-ordinates) and on name pieces ('ger' in Asperger, 'auc' in Chaucer). Pushes toward 'constant' and 'constants'.

L26n1373.name: Mid-word name fragments
L26n1373.description: Negative on mid-word pieces of place, person, and technical names split into tokens (Meg|iddo, Gen|oa, Ph|ra, Cam|eras, Mark scheme, Ta|rsal), in history, geography, and tech prose; pushes toward 'down'.

L27n993.name: Mid-word fragments to error
L27n993.description: Negative on the middle piece of a word split across tokens, mostly in rare names and words (Sus|ilo, kr|ainian, loss|aceae); pushes toward 'error' and 'Error' tokens.

L26n2904.name: Proper-noun word starts
L26n2904.description: The first 1-3 letter piece of split proper nouns and rare words (Meg|iddo, Sel|aginellaceae, Sid|on, Sw|indon, Rou|en); pushes toward 'pipe'.

L27n526.name: Opening paren before restatement
L27n526.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis right after a number or term that is about to be restated in another unit or form (15.6 °C (60.1 °F), eukaryotes (, DHT (); pushes toward 'me' and 'ming' word pieces.

L27n1767.name: Word-start fragments, junk tokens
L27n1767.description: Fires negatively on the first piece of a split word, often mid-sentence (Stra in Gay-Straight, con in conveys, Bre in Breasted, ca, cre, se in seep). Pushes the model toward mojibake and junk symbols such as '{@' and 'â'.

L27n1026.name: Acronym fragments; id output
L27n1026.description: Fires on a fragment inside an acronym or name, such as 'DF' in DFID, 'UN' in UNDP, and 'M' in MIF, and on mid-word pieces like 'ta' in curtailed; pushes toward 'id' and 'ID'.

L26n1161.name: Capital word-start fragments
L26n1161.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most often a capital letter that starts a name or acronym: 'V' in Vortex, V2 and Vidalia, 'W' in Wozniak, 'Del' in Delafield, 'Rev' in Revolucionario. Pushes toward 'higher', 'greater' and 'increase'.

L26n2125.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L26n2125.description: Goes negative on the piece of a split word that opens with a consonant cluster, e.g. 'bl' in 'blurring' and 'Blaeu', 'cr' in 'crumbly', 'crabs' and 'crinolines', 'dil' in 'dilates'; writes 'rec/Rec' tokens.

L25n1693.name: Award/prize names → pr
L25n1693.description: Fires on the honour or prize word itself, e.g. 'Knight' (of the Garter), 'Nobel' (laureate, Peace Prize), 'Royal' (Society), 'Booker' (-winning); pushes toward 'pr' fragments.

L27n2392.name: Word-start 'r' and 'b'
L27n2392.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, most often 'r', 'b' or 'rec' (R|ickets, Sebor|r|hea, rec|iting, -B|ahá); pushes toward ret tokens.

L27n1988.name: Word-piece, writes 'act'
L27n1988.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, often in instruction prompts (paraph|rase, synt|actic, bree|ch, rehe|ated, Jo|VE); pushes toward 'act/Act/acting', and steering spams 'Act'.

L26n1008.name: Latinized word fragments
L26n1008.description: Fires on the middle piece of rare, foreign or Latinized words split into odd pieces ('yl' in xylitol, 'ṭ' in Sanskrit saṃghaṭṭa, 'gl' in glomerata, 'iv' in olivaceus); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ção' and 'ried', with little visible effect when steered.

L27n981.name: Numbered answer opener
L27n981.description: Goes strongly negative on the whitespace token right after </think> that opens a numbered list answer ('1. Attention...'), and on heading words like Description, Climate and Lord; pushes code-stub fragments such as 'gl', 'int' and 'pin'.

L25n1399.name: Newlines and word starts
L25n1399.description: Goes strongly negative on word-initial fragments (thr-, und-, nod-, gr-, Bl-) and on the newline before a heading like 'Memo' or 'FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE'; pushing it negative makes the model emit endless newlines.

L27n664.name: Diffuse title-case labels
L27n664.description: Goes strongly negative on diffuse title-case words in headings and labels (Song, Infrastructure, Flower, Game) and on sentence-end periods. Writes adjectives such as 'Low', 'Common' and 'Big', but the effect is weak.

L26n1593.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'js/css'
L26n1593.description: Fires on a short opening piece of a name or word split into tokens (e.g. 'mel' in melons, 'Sol' in Solon, 'Gl' in glowing); its output points to code tokens 'js' and 'css'.

L26n211.name: Tech names, code requests
L26n211.description: Fires on programming and tool names (PHP, MySQL, Vue, Arduino, '.js', canvas) and on the connector right after them ('and' in 'PHP and MySQL', 'that' in 'a PHP script that'). Pushes toward rare word-pieces ('icum', 'nar') with no clear sense.

L26n1143.name: Split-word starts; her
L26n1143.description: The first piece of a split word, such as 'od' in odious, 'Bal' in Balochistan, 'gr' in griddle, 'Wh' in whiskers and 'Or' in Oriskany. Pushes toward 'her', 'Her' and 'HER' tokens; steered output stutters 'Her'.

L26n1628.name: Word-initial fragments before completion
L26n1628.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a longer word split into tokens, such as 'dis' in 'disinfected', 'sym' in 'symphony', 'cyst' in 'cysteine', 'Myst' in 'Mysticism'. Pushes toward 'band', 'music', 'song'.

L27n1250.name: Split-word fragment continuations
L27n1250.description: Short pieces that complete a split word, e.g. '-t' in 'twin-tail' and 'Kaga Sho-taro', 'orth' in 'orthotic', 'reint' in 'reintroduced', 'int' in 'high-intensity', 'ict' in 'Wydawnictwo', plus the short word right after such a piece ('it' in 'toll it takes', 'to' in 'wanted to take'). Pushes toward 'take'.

L23n927.name: Name fragments; 'fix' writer
L23n927.description: Fires on 'black' and on mid-word fragments inside split proper names ('ass' in Kassites, 'itt' in Psittacula, 'rack' in McCracken); pushes 'fix' and 'fixed'.

L27n868.name: Name-middle pieces, school
L27n868.description: Fires on a word piece that begins the second half of a split proper name or term, e.g. 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Phar' in Pharrell, 'Ph' in Ph.D., 'imp' in impurities; pushes toward school, schools, teacher.

L26n1463.name: come/ask verbs, court
L26n1463.description: Fires on 'come' and 'ask' before a preposition or object ('come to a common understanding', 'come up with', 'ask for ten minutes', 'ask their parent's permission'). Weaker on some name fragments. Pushes toward 'court' and 'judicial'.

L27n479.name: Word opener to prepositions
L27n479.description: Fires on an early piece of a split word, such as 'lo' in loaves, 'shr' in shrubs, 'enc' in encased or 'mil' in milpa. Pushes toward the prepositions For, By, To, On and Of.

L27n1634.name: 'that' after a noun
L27n1634.description: The word right after a noun phrase that opens a clause, mostly 'that' before a verb (motifs that permeate, an event that triggers), and 'to', 'still', 'really' before a verb; pushes toward 'definition'.

L26n393.name: Contraction and split-word stems
L26n393.description: Fires on the stem before a split-off suffix: 'don' in don't, 'didn', 'shouldn', 'let' in let's, and the first piece of split words such as 'Te' in teach-back and 'del' in delves. Pushes toward opening and closing quotation marks.

L12n623.name: Diffuse web-prose word
L12n623.description: Diffuse and mild: fires on content words mid-sentence in web prose that are followed by an elaboration or list, e.g. 'is' in 'the body is part way out', 'Cultural' in 'Prairie Acadian Cultural Center', 'language' in 'open-source programming language'. Pushes toward dashes, ellipses and asterisks.

L27n2224.name: Later split-word pieces
L27n2224.description: Fires on later subword pieces of long words (ep|ider|mis, der|mis, inter|connect, fer|mentation, stere|otyping). Pushes toward 'na' and 'ní' fragments, which do not match the reads.

L27n2831.name: P/p word starts; 'listening'
L27n2831.description: Fires on a word-initial 'P' or 'p' or 'ep' piece (PESTICIDES, Pots, Puzzles, pentaBDE, epidermis), including split-off pieces; pushes 'listening', 'hearing', 'reading', spamming 'hearing' when steered.

L27n1667.name: Word-start p/pl/d pieces
L27n1667.description: Fires (positive) on a one- or two-letter piece that starts a word split into tokens ('snow|pl|ow', 'd|ries', 'p|ungent', 'und|ies', 'Char|lemagne'); pushes toward 'describe' and 'description'.

L27n1462.name: Prefix piece, writes array
L27n1462.description: Goes negative on prefix pieces of words split into subwords, especially 'mult' (multilocularis, multicultural), 'micro' (microRNAs), 'agr' (bermudagrass), 'la' (Elaeis); pushes toward 'array'/'arrays'.

L27n860.name: Modifier before noun, 'do'
L27n860.description: Fires on a modifier that precedes a noun ('Canadian', 'National', 'nationwide', 'Unlike') and on the newline that ends a chat question. Pushes the model toward 'do', 'does' and 'did'.

L27n1578.name: Mid-word fragments, load
L27n1578.description: Fires on a letter or fragment inside a split word, e.g. 'nonpro|l|iferation', 'en|chil|ada', 'dile|mma', 'un|screw'; pushes toward 'load' spam.

L27n602.name: Latin-name and compound fragments
L27n602.description: A piece of a multi-token name or compound, such as 'Card' in 'Cardiospermum', 'amb' in 'rambutan', 'db' in 'redbay', 'Ps' in 'Psittacula', and '-b' in '-borne'. Pushes toward the code suffix 'type'.

L27n2310.name: Sh/Kh word-opener, writes 'greater'
L27n2310.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name that opens with a consonant pair (Kh, Sh, Gh, Br, Pr, pl: Kharkiv, Shunga, Ghafiqi, Brigid, Prussian); pushes toward 'greater/great', and steering spams 'greater'.

L26n1589.name: 'self' compound prefix
L26n1589.description: 'self' as the first half of a compound such as self-esteem, self-defense, self-raising, self-sufficiency, self-concepts. Pushes toward blank placeholders like '__'.

L27n495.name: Mid-word fragments, pushes 'c'
L27n495.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a long word split into tokens (e.g. 'bus' in arbuscules, 'ly' in aminoglycosides, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'itory' in inhibitory); pushing negative makes the model write 'c' tokens.

L27n2604.name: Post-hyphen word piece
L27n2604.description: Fires on the word piece right after a hyphen or the 'un' prefix inside a compound or split word (specially-|abled, beta-|carotene, flying-|saucer, un|suited, anti-|shear); pushes output toward 'sk' and 'skin' tokens.

L22n2615.name: Mixed name fragments, check
L22n2615.description: Goes negative on mid-word pieces of names ('Ch|ak|ma', 'Kh|ark|iv', 'Corn|uc|opia') and on 'check', 'worth', and 'and' in phrases like 'check it out' or 'worth it'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'return' repeatedly.

L25n2953.name: Assorted word-start pieces
L25n2953.description: Word-start pieces of split words with no single theme (Bo|aters, Bo|is Blanc, rh|izae, Decre|ased, Gleicheni|aceae); pushes toward 'growth' and 'grow' tokens, which steered outputs spam.

L27n771.name: Word starts; writes Microsoft
L27n771.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often before a consonant cluster (kr|ill, sw|immers, pr|isms, str|ays, blog); pushes toward 'Microsoft', 'Azure' and 'MS'.

L27n2452.name: Mid-word fragments (infinit)
L27n2452.description: Negative firing on a middle piece of a longer word split into tokens, such as infinit in infinitive, init in initives, oct in octopus, iterr in Mediterranean, or in in rhinotracheitis; pushes toward 'tree' and 'trees'.

L27n1123.name: Split-word start, 'need'
L27n1123.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name split into tokens, e.g. 'b' in Middlesbrough, 'ch' in cochlea, 'sn' in snippers, 'Rob' in robotic. Pushes the model toward 'need' and 'needs'.

L27n167.name: Split-word piece, writes p
L27n167.description: Goes negative on pieces of long words split into subwords, especially 'flo' (flip-flops), 'atro' (paratroops), 'stri', 'dri' (dripped); pushes toward the letter 'p' and 'Pp'.

L27n2361.name: Symptom and fragment words
L27n2361.description: Goes strongly negative on a symptom word or word piece in health text ('discomfort', 'sensations', 'pain', 'neuro'-toxic, 'R' in Rickets). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'radi' and 'radio', and the output spams 'Radi radi'.

L27n2696.name: Word starts, Spec
L27n2696.description: Word-start pieces of split words, often capitalized or after a hyphen ('w|ings', 'spr|outs', 'z|razy', 'Otherwise' in 'Not Otherwise Specified'). Pushes toward 'Spec' and 'spec' tokens.

L26n2877.name: Connectives after technical nouns
L26n2877.description: Diffuse: fires weakly on 'of', 'using' or 'with' right after a technical noun ('a year of high school calculus', 'machine learning using', 'Tomography with') and on name fragments; pushed negative, it makes the output repeat 'linear'.

L26n1066.name: Split proper-name openers
L26n1066.description: The first piece of a capitalized name or noun split into tokens, such as 'Lu' in Lucretia, 'Ju' in juice, 'Cr' in Crataegus, 'Kr' in Krusty. Pushes toward 'http', 'https', 'www'.

L27n2555.name: Capital word starts, 'get'
L27n2555.description: Negative on the first piece of a capitalized word or name, especially 'W' and 'Pad' (Padua, Wet Weather, WiringPi), pushing toward 'get' tokens.

L22n1061.name: Diffuse; 'error' writer
L22n1061.description: Weak, diffuse firing on verbs and articles in troubleshooting and instruction text ('am' in 'I am having trouble', 'other' in 'other strange behaviors'); pushes 'error' and 'errors'.

L27n1941.name: Acronym and name fragments
L27n1941.description: Fires on the second piece of split words and acronym tails (hypo|od|erm|is, the D in DHA, Borg|lum, Mis|informed). Pushes toward 'system' and 'girls' or 'boys' tokens.

L27n2716.name: Consonant-cluster start, server
L27n2716.description: Fires on a short opening consonant cluster split from its word (cl|ots, g|ingersnap, g|rafted, qu|illwort, gu|illotine, spr|outs); pushes toward 'server' and 'client'.

L27n174.name: Technical word middles
L27n174.description: Fires (negative) on a middle piece of a long technical word, e.g. 'ni' in Wozniak, 'ose' in femtosecond, 'ly' in aminoglycoside, 'vir' in antiretrovirals. Negative push writes 'c' tokens (kc, coc, cc), so steered text spams 'Coco cecchc'.

L26n591.name: Title nouns, P-words
L26n591.description: Fires on a content noun inside a title or heading list, such as 'Mental' in 'Psychiatric and Mental Health', 'Target' in 'Define Your Target Audience', or 'of' in 'Basics of Web'; pushes toward P-initial words 'Post', 'Path', and 'Pro'.

L25n763.name: Mid-word fragment → 'List'
L25n763.description: Fires on mid-word pieces inside split words and names, like 'if' in kiwifruit, 'Laf' in Lafitte, 'une' in immune and '-H' in self-harming; pushes toward 'List' and 'list'.

L27n2608.name: Name-start fragment, 'Dem'
L27n2608.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name or word (Hor|owitz, Barack, Div|estment, Op|elika, j|amb). Pushes toward 'Dem' and 'dem'.

L26n124.name: Compound-term modifier
L26n124.description: Fires on the modifier half of a technical compound or name (e.g. 'electronic' in electronic cigarettes, '-step' in forest-steppe, 'micro' in microasperities, 'bit' in bit.ly); pushes 'another' and 'further'.

L26n1977.name: B/b word onsets
L26n1977.description: A capital or lowercase 'B' or 'b' opening a split word or name (Babylon, Babbage, B2B, Bahá), plus 'Cong' and 'Cal'. Pushes toward 'conversion' and 'convert' tokens.

L27n1910.name: 'str' word onset
L27n1910.description: Fires (goes negative) on the 'str' piece that opens a word, usually its first subword (str|aits, str|angle, str|ung, Str|onsay), and weakly on 'atro' in paratroops; pushes output toward 'area' tokens.

L26n828.name: Word-continuation fragment, closing parens
L26n828.description: Strongly positive on a short subword fragment that continues a split word (e.g. '-h' in self-harm, '-g' in guess, 'Char' in Charon, 'G' in Gutzon); steering it up pushes toward closing code tokens like ')' and '`). Effect on prose is weak.

L27n190.name: Mid-word pieces, 'ovo'
L27n190.description: Negative on the subword piece that splits a longer word (cant|al|oupe, un|cont|rollably, Ha|'ap|ai), pushing toward short '-ovo' and '-olo' fragments.

L27n1703.name: Word-start pl and cl
L27n1703.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word starting with pl or cl (Pl|atanus, Pl|astic, cl|ots, pl|ume, spl|enium-like starts); pushes toward node tokens.

L27n1589.name: Diffuse, inner-fragment, paren closers
L27n1589.description: Weak on most tokens of encyclopedic prose, peaking on one inner fragment of a split word or name ('l' in Borglum, 'ol' in catecholamines, 'K' in K-turn, 'actus' in cactus). Pushes toward closing ')' and '")' tokens.

L26n2382.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'shot'
L26n2382.description: Negative on the opening piece of a split word (e.g. 'fl' in outflank, 'em' in emerald, 'cal' in calici, 'inter' in interstitials); its output points to 'shot' and 'shoot'.

L27n1753.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n1753.description: The first piece of a capitalized name split into tokens (Hor in Horowitz, Char in Charlemagne, Har in Harbin), pushing 'none'.

L22n681.name: Copula after a subject
L22n681.description: Fires on 'is' or 'are' right after a noun subject, e.g. 'Its domain [is]', 'chars [are]', 'Q [is]', plus scattered '=' in code. Pushes toward opening brackets '[{'. Weak and diffuse.

L26n1750.name: Word-start sp fragments
L26n1750.description: Fires on word-start pieces 'sp', 'Sp', 'Sc', 'sw' and 'Sl' that begin a new word split across tokens (sp|icules, sp|ires, sp|illing, sw|athed, Sc|ads, Schenck|ensch). Writes '*' and '*/' comment tokens; pushed, it writes markdown asterisks around words.

L25n1708.name: Name-start 'Mer' and 'Mor'
L25n1708.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, most strongly 'Mer' in Merlins, Merck and Merthyr, 'Mor' in Moravian and Morley, and 'ev' in evoke and evinced. Pushes toward 'clear', 'clearly' and 'explicit'; steering gives 'clearly visible' loops.

L26n486.name: 'Release' and boilerplate
L26n486.description: Fires negatively on mid-phrase words in press, science and spec text ('RELEASE' in 'FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE', 'oriented' in 'object-oriented') and on name fragments; its write is web boilerplate and pushing it barely changes the output.

L27n2782.name: Word-start 'c'/'cro' fragment
L27n2782.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'c', 'cro', 'rec' or 'ro' that starts a word piece in prose (ceded, Croatan, crocodiles, encroached, receded); pushes toward ')' and '];' closing-code tokens.

L27n1635.name: Mid-word fragments → field
L27n1635.description: A later piece of a word split across tokens (aim in Nanaimo, Ble in Bleach, iti in Citi, ly in Ulysses); pushes toward 'field/fields'.

L27n2193.name: cl and f word-starts
L27n2193.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'cl' in clenching, clippings, clowns, 'f' in bullfrogs, and hyphen-letters like '-l' and '-g'; pushes toward 'non' prefixes.

L26n2089.name: Word-initial 'c' fragments
L26n2089.description: The single letter 'c' or 'C' that opens a word split into tokens (c|asserole, c|actus, c|abling, C|ars, C|ited); pushes toward 'profile' and 'profiles'.

L27n600.name: Stem before qu sound
L27n600.description: A mid-word stem just before a 'qu' sound (Tar|quin, Al|gonquin, collo|quial, elo|quent, a|quin, Marra|kes). Pushes toward 'qu'/'q' tokens.

L27n2354.name: Word-start fragments → 'remain'
L27n2354.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly Sup, Sal, San, Ex, Com (e.g. 'Sup' in Supposedly, 'Sal' in Salazar, 'Ex' in Excretory); pushes 'remain'/'remaining' tokens.

L27n1885.name: Formal-text word fragment
L27n1885.description: Strongly positive on the first or second piece of multi-token words in formal text ('Public' in 'Public Switched', 'Cru' in 'Cruelty', 'Str' in 'Strangler', 'ran' in 'supranational'). Pushes 'Sw' tokens.

L27n1627.name: Onset fragments 'sc'/'v'
L27n1627.description: Fires on the short first piece of a word split into tokens, mainly 'sc', 'v', 'V' and 'Ch' (scoliosis, scarring, Van Gogh, vermilion, Chhattisgarh); pushes output toward 'allow' and 'permitted'.

L22n868.name: Token before proper names
L22n868.description: Fires on the short prefix just before a proper name ('St' in 'St. Paul's', 'Sch' in 'Schleper', 'at' before 'Google', 'by' before a name). Pushes the model toward 'null' with weak effect.

L27n1065.name: Word-onset fragments, colon output
L27n1065.description: Fires on the first consonant-cluster fragment of a word split mid-word (fl in fluoroquinolones and flint, sh in shaver, sne in sneezing, f in flossing, di in diaphragms); pushes toward ':' tokens when negative.

L27n1587.name: Word fragments, 'original' output
L27n1587.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long or technical names ('Kor|moran' as 'orm', 'melan|in', 'Sab|rina', 'ket|osis', 'ac|rophobia') and on some whole names ('Claude', 'Best'); pushes toward 'original' and 'originally', so steering spams 'original'.

L27n1001.name: Diffuse word-opening pieces
L27n1001.description: Weak, diffuse firing on the opening piece of a word or name that runs into more tokens, such as Ch in Chhattisgarh, sp in cerebrospinal, dev in deviate, or Indian in Indian Ocean; pushes toward 'sub' tokens.

L26n2902.name: Onset fragments, 'composition' output
L26n2902.description: Fires on the consonant-cluster start of a word split into tokens, such as 'st' in stirs, 'tre' in treacherous, 'ste' in steaming, or 'bre' in Brecht; pushes toward 'composition' and 'compose'.

L27n393.name: Word fragment, writes '-al'
L27n393.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a long word split across tokens (gor|od, oph|agus, ut|onomous, oc|eses, ider|mis); pushes toward '-al' adjectives (national, central, natural), and steering spams 'central'.

L26n2489.name: Medical word-stem fragments
L26n2489.description: The stem piece of a medical or body-related word split into tokens (infl|amed, intest|ines, fl|aring, pred|iabetes, av|ascular). Pushes toward 'prepare', 'prepared' and 'ready'.

L27n1268.name: Capital letter starting nouns
L27n1268.description: Fires on a capital first letter that starts a name or list item (B in Bicycles, I in IAU, Z in Zaidi, South in South Africa); pushes 'city' and 'cities'.

L27n2969.name: Early piece, writes impact
L27n2969.description: Strongly negative on a short early piece of a split word or name, such as 'E' in Euphrates, 're' in reconnection, 'gre' in greening, 'em' in emperor or 'Cass' in Cassini. Pushes toward 'impact' and 'affect'.

L26n1109.name: 'ho' fragment and names
L26n1109.description: Fires on the 'ho' piece of words split into tokens (hoarding, Hooves, Leeuwenhoek) and on the first piece of some surnames; pushes the model toward 'Chinese' and 'China', so steered output becomes 'Chinese' spam.

L26n2836.name: Mid-word name fragments
L26n2836.description: Fires (goes negative) on a middle piece of a name or rare word split into several tokens, such as 'fon' in Alfonso, 'vas' in crevasse, 'os' in osseointegrating and 'immer' in immerse. Pushes toward 's'-initial tokens like 'sm', 'sc' and 'sl'.

L25n225.name: Prefix pieces (sub, in)
L25n225.description: Fires on a short prefix piece that begins a longer word: 'sub' in subcutaneous and subsequently, 'in' in noninvasive, 'Ind' in Indigenous, 'eff' in efforts, 'od' in hypodermis. Pushes toward math-variable style tokens like '{x', 'yw' and 'wx'; steered output is garbled.

L25n776.name: First letter of names
L25n776.description: Goes strongly negative on the single first letter of a capitalised name (U in Utrecht, R in Rama, l in limes); pushes toward closing quote marks, with no clear steered effect.

L27n2343.name: Hyphen-joined 'N'/'re' pieces
L27n2343.description: Strongly negative on the 'N', 'n' or 're' that starts the second half of a hyphenated name or prefix (e.g. '-N' in Metro-North, 'Re' in Re-establishing, '-n' in non-natives, '-re' in self-reliance); pushing negative has a weak effect and nudges toward closing parens.

L27n888.name: Word-start 'sc', 'wh', 'Sp'
L27n888.description: The first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'sc' in 'scatters' and 'scrupulous', 'wh' in 'whistling' and 'whizz', 'Sp' in 'Spicy'. Pushes toward LaTeX and code tokens '\(' and '$'.

L27n1817.name: Split hyphen-part fragment
L27n1817.description: Piece of a split word or hyphenated compound: 'pl' in U|pl|ink, 'cross' before -links in collagen cross|-links, 'D' in |D|HA, 'L' in |L|ava Lamp. Negative firing pushes toward 'link'.

L27n2014.name: Name fragment, exec writer
L27n2014.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split name or word, such as 'ec' in eczema, 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Bet' in Betts, 'ox' in oxazolidinones, or 'ex' in excommunicated. Pushes toward 'exec' and 'execution' tokens.

L27n1220.name: Word-start 'oc'/'Bo' fragments
L27n1220.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token name or word, e.g. 'oc' in 'avocados', 'Bo' in 'Boer settlers', 'som' in 'somatostatin', 'P' in 'Pies'; pushes toward long dash runs.

L25n1827.name: Rem and similar word-starts
L25n1827.description: Positive on a word-start piece that begins a longer word, most strongly 'Rem' or 'rem' in Remembrance and reminiscent, and also cont, const, cert, indis. Pushes the model toward greetings like 'Hello' and 'welcome'.

L25n438.name: Digits in number runs
L25n438.description: A digit in the middle of a number or counting sequence (the 3 in 0,1,2,3; the 0 in 80,000; the 1 in 4,100); pushes toward closing quote and punctuation tokens.

L24n2059.name: operation verbs before 'element'
L24n2059.description: Fires on arithmetic or operation verbs and word starts ('multiply', 'subtract', 'outputs', 'mul-', 'eigen-vectors', 'concatenates them') where an array or vector element is about to come; pushes toward 'element', and steered text spams 'element'.

L27n2986.name: sm/sh/Em word start
L27n2986.description: Short first piece of a split word, mostly 'sm', 'sh', 'ab', 'Em' or 'Av' (ex-|sm|okers, |sh|ored, |ab|stractions, |Em|otions, |Av|ian). Pushes toward 'behavior'.

L27n1155.name: Single consonant word start
L27n1155.description: Fires on a one-letter or consonant word start that opens a split word (C|attle, C|igarette, V|itamins, g|ators, b|oulders, Pag|len). Pushes pronouns 'He', 'His', 'he' and 'him'.

L26n510.name: Short name-start fragments
L26n510.description: Fires on the short opening piece of a name or rare word split into tokens ('Bo' in Bois Blanc, 'Ho' in Hojiblanca, 'Ha' in Haucourt, 'En' in Enola Gay); pushes output toward 'action' and 'activities'.

L27n1680.name: Word fragment → 'dose'
L27n1680.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split word ('ro' in corroded, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Cul' in Culdcept) and on an opening parenthesis before an acronym; pushes toward 'dose', 'dosage' and 'destination'.

L27n670.name: Name piece, list separator
L27n670.description: Fires on a piece inside a long proper or Latin name split into tokens (e.g. 'inia' in Garcinia, 'ø' in Jørgensen, 'um' in Cinnamomum) and on the ';' separating list items. Pushes the model toward 'W'.

L26n1902.name: Start of split names
L26n1902.description: The first or second piece of a split name or word (Mos|he, Rom|mel, mol|ars, ul|cers, Si Thammarat); pushes 'keep'.

L27n662.name: Word-middle fragments
L27n662.description: Fires strongly negative on a subword piece in the middle or end of a split word, e.g. 'init' in Inf|init|ives, 'plac' in plac|ards, 'Ac' in Ac|adian, 'def' in def|ied, 'she' in she|ars, 'ace' in Laur|ace|ae. Going negative pushes toward '(' followed by a capital letter, such as (C, (P, (A.

L27n1790.name: ent/benef fragments, request
L27n1790.description: Positive on the first piece of split verbs and nouns: 'ent' in entice, entrees, entitles; 'benef' in beneficiary; 'reaff' in reaffirmation; 'Zam' in Zambezi. Pushes toward 'request/requests/ask'; strong steering spams 'request'.

L26n2134.name: Intensifiers and 'stay'
L26n2134.description: Degree adverbs and 'stay' right before an adjective or verb (absolutely, relatively, almost, completely, 'stay' in 'stay hydrated'); pushes toward risk, stress, trouble and disease nouns.

L27n2123.name: Word-start g fragments
L27n2123.description: Strongly negative on a word-start 'g', 'G' or 'w' fragment, often right after a hyphen (-g|iven, second-g|uess, lace-w|ings, Gu|elph, G|overnor). Pushes toward 'rect' and 'rectangle' tokens; steered output spams 'rect'.

L25n2105.name: 'ph' fragments -> 'simple'
L25n2105.description: Fires on 'ph' or 'Ph' opening a word piece or name (Phra-, phagocytes, Phos-, phases, 'aph' in aphasia-like words), and on 'ih' in hydrogen. Pushed positive, it promotes 'simple/basic' and spams 'simple'.

L26n2666.name: Leading capital-letter piece
L26n2666.description: The short first piece of a capitalized name or noun split into tokens, often a lone 'P' or 'Sh' (P|uma, P|olar bear, Sh|iloh, Carr|adine); pushes toward 'DNA' and 'password' tokens.

L27n1193.name: Split-word piece → 'starting'
L27n1193.description: Fires on an early piece of a split word or place name, e.g. 'og' in aminoglycoside, 'by' in Abyei, 'Fr' in Franks, 'g' in gauze or gingersnap. Pushes toward 'starting'/'opening'/'ending' (steered output: 'Starting starting').

L26n460.name: Term-completing word in lists
L26n460.description: Diffuse and weak: goes negative on the word that completes a term or label in lists, quizzes and tables, e.g. 'Compound [Interest]', 'vitamin B1 [deficiency]', 'Roman Numerals - [I]', 'without [soil]'; writes quote and bracket closers, and steering changes the answers very little.

L27n1335.name: Word-start p fragments
L27n1335.description: A word-start piece that often begins with 'p' or 'P' (shaded-p|ole, unp|asteurized, P|atches, COMP|ASS, multip|lex). Pushes toward 'pass'-family tokens.

L27n1922.name: Inner split-term piece
L27n1922.description: Fires on an inner piece of a split anatomical or technical word ('ch' in paren|ch|yma, 'ider' in epi|der|mis, 'uter' in intra|uter|ine), and on 'in' in 'stay in shape' and 'series' in series motor. Pushed positive, it writes 'character' or 'characteristic' and spams it.

L27n1512.name: Tense and compound-interest terms
L27n1512.description: Negative firing on a word in a tense or finance phrase that sets up a predictable next word, such as 'Present' or 'past' in tense lists and 'compounded' in 'compounded quarterly'; pushes toward 'continuous'.

L25n2732.name: Latin/scientific name starts
L25n2732.description: Fires on the first piece of a Latin, scientific or chemical name split across tokens, e.g. 'H' in 'Hirundo', 'oph' in 'Psophodes' or 'Hymenophyllaceae', 'catal' in 'catalase', 'f' in 'locked'. Writes 'switch' tokens, and the steered output is 'switch switch' spam.

L27n2428.name: Non-/anti- prefix pieces
L27n2428.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a word split at a prefix or hyphen ('nond|iscriminatory', 'anti-d|rying', 'self-d|etermination', 'Ga|stric'); pushes toward 'draw' and 'drawing'.

L27n1501.name: Split-name first piece
L27n1501.description: Fires on the first subword of a capitalized name or word (cre-vice, Bo-ats, Dol-aucothi, Ho-jiblanca), usually inside a list or name; pushes 'true' and 'false'.

L27n2804.name: Sp word-start fragments
L27n2804.description: Fires on the 'sp' start of a word split into pieces, e.g. fast-|sp|reading, oil |Sp|ill, |Sp|inal, un|sp|ayed, |sp|elling. Pushes toward 'mill' and 'thousands'.

L27n1934.name: Word fragments → 'sample'
L27n1934.description: A short piece inside a split word (wh in whiff, min in minima, Pr in Priscus, bro in brood, sc in screech); pushes the model toward 'sample/samples'.

L25n2988.name: Word-initial T/L -> 'cost'
L25n2988.description: Fires on a word's first letter 'T' or 'L' (or lowercase 't' or '-l') when the word is split, e.g. 'T' in Tacos, Tens, Taste, 'L' in Lotto, Lilies. Pushed negative, it promotes 'cost/costs' and spams 'cost'.

L27n1647.name: Stem fragments, Der
L27n1647.description: Stem pieces of split words and names ('st|aves', 'idi|abetic', 'Thely|pter|idaceae', 'Van|aras', 'Hot|amisligil'). Pushes toward 'Der' and 'derive'.

L27n2534.name: Word opener to fuel
L27n2534.description: Fires on the opening piece of a multi-token word, such as 'agr' in agritech, 'cro' in crocodiles, 'str' in straits, 'gl' in glaucoma or 'oc' in diocese. Pushes toward 'fuel', 'carbon' and 'combustion'.

L27n3053.name: Word-start b and Ar
L27n3053.description: Fires on the second piece of a split word, esp. '-b' or 'b' before -irth, -iodegradable, -olts, and 'Ar', 'Ast', 'Ang' starts of names (Ar|bequina, Ast|urias, Ang|olan); pushes toward atom tokens.

L27n2069.name: squ/pur/bl word onsets
L27n2069.description: Fires (positive) on a split word opening with 'squ', 'pur', 'bl' or 'sl' ('squ|irts', 'squ|ishing', 'pur|ulent', 'sl|ams'); pushes toward 'press' and 'pressure'.

L22n74.name: File types, URLs, closers
L22n74.description: File-type, protocol and code-name tokens ('pdf', 'https', '.py', 'PDF', 'IPv', 'Swift') inside references and code; pushes toward closing code punctuation such as ')'] and quote-comma endings.

L26n1086.name: Split stem → 'name'
L26n1086.description: Fires on the stem piece that opens a split word (Plate|lets, Organ|izational, germ|plasm, embry|onic, pal|atability); pushes 'name', '_name', 'ID' and 'NAME'.

L27n2139.name: Names and place fragments
L27n2139.description: Negative on split word-starts in names and terms: 'P' in Palla, 'T' in Tigris, 'Z' in Zeldovich, 'A' in Agra, 't' in turret, 'sea' in sea floor; pushes toward 'grade' tokens.

L27n1158.name: Split word-starts, writes 'create'
L27n1158.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often 'sc' (scoliosis, Scissorhands, scraping), 'conc' (concordance), 'ac' (across), and on 'Digital' in Adobe Digital Editions. Pushes toward 'create/creation' tokens, so steered text spams 'Create creation'.

L27n368.name: Word fragment, writes B
L27n368.description: Assorted word-piece fragments, e.g. '-ver' (nonverbal), 'om' (Potomac), 'tert' (tert-butyl), 'CS' (HCSB), 'flash' (flashbacks); pushes toward 'B'/'Bb'.

L26n1979.name: w/ow word splits
L26n1979.description: Goes negative on short 'w', 'ow', 'Char' and 'Sw' fragments inside split words (bi|ow|arfare, hard|w|ired, Ship|w|reck). Pushes toward 'equality', 'inequality' and 'equation' tokens, and steering spams 'equality'.

L27n693.name: Modifier before noun
L27n693.description: Negative on a modifier word or sub-word just before the noun it describes, e.g. 'primary| learning styles', 'New| England', 'Primary| School', 'hip| hop'; top tokens are scattered word fragments. Pushes toward 'number' and 'Number'; steered output spams 'number'.

L27n2375.name: Name-start, digits out
L27n2375.description: The first piece of a capitalized name, code or abbreviation (Ch in Chao Phraya, Ste in Stejskal, AL in AL5, Carm in Carmarthen, A in A1C). Pushes toward digits; steered output turns into number strings.

L27n1648.name: Word onsets, 'raise'
L27n1648.description: Positive on the start of a split word (fl|aring, cam|otes, Cor|imal, Gu|elph, con|duction), pushing toward 'raise' and 'raised'.

L25n2229.name: Articles before proper names
L25n2229.description: Fires on 'the', 'and' or a name-piece right before or inside a proper noun (the Erechtheion, Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Perna); pushes toward 'original' and 'raw'.

L27n1241.name: Word-start fragments; defendant output
L27n1241.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letters of a word split into pieces, often capitalized starts such as 'Se' in Seville, 'Res' in resettlement, and 'sa' in safflower; pushes toward 'defendant' and 'plaintiff'.

L26n1994.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L26n1994.description: Goes negative on a piece in the middle of a name or word split across tokens, e.g. 'Giamp|etro', 'Woll|ongong', 'CAR|olina', 'Hel|ens', 'self-lo|ve'; writes 'loop' tokens, which do not match what it reads.

L26n396.name: Ar/Har word starts
L26n396.description: Negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'Ar', 'Har', 'Hos', 'Ste', 'gar', 'Se' (Arabs, harvest, Hosfeld, Stepping, garages). Pushes toward code and comment syntax: '#', '#if', '}' and '*/}'.

L27n1453.name: cons/ins prefix start
L27n1453.description: The 'cons', 'ins', 'res' or 'ass' piece that opens a split Latin-prefix word (cons|cription, ins|cribed, cons|istent, ass|essor, s|own). Negative firing pushes toward 'sign'.

L25n1187.name: word-initial g fragments
L25n1187.description: Fires on the 'g' or 'G' that starts a word or name piece ('gilded', 'gloomy', 'Galloway', 'gorges', 'Gospels'), mostly mid-sentence. Pushes toward 'general', 'universal' and 'global'.

L26n2323.name: Headword initials; numbers
L26n2323.description: Capital or word-start letters of headwords, such as 'F' in Filing and Families, 'Se' in severe and seawater, and 'ef' in Indefinite. Pushes toward 'numbers', 'nums' and 'numerical'; steered output spams 'numbers'.

L27n1772.name: Name-start word fragments
L27n1772.description: Mostly the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'S' in Sita, 'Co' in Coopworth, 'Hy' in Hygiene, 'Ja' in Jaén, 'T' in Tibbon, 'ye' in Yehuda; pushes toward 'maintain' and 'keep'.

L26n2678.name: 'Ar' starts, X-ray/CT
L26n2678.description: The 'Ar' or 'ar' piece opening split words (Ar|terial, ar|thritis, Fossil Ar|chaeology, Donna Ar|nett) and '-ray' in x-ray text; pushes toward 'sensor'.

L27n1305.name: Mid-word name fragments
L27n1305.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word fragment inside a name or compound, e.g. 'ng' in Miguel Ángel, 'arch' in archnemesis, 'ich' in Cowichan, 'omn' in omnichannel. Under push it writes JSON quote-and-comma tokens, while steering at -0.5 gives normal prose.

L27n632.name: Opening punctuation before aside
L27n632.description: An opening mark that starts an aside or definition: '(' after a term, an opening quote, a dash or hyphen before the next clause ('macrolides (', 'the tear film' quote). Pushes toward '-ting' and '-ted' suffix tokens.

L27n965.name: Name-like split pieces
L27n965.description: Fires on a piece of a split word, often the start of a place or person name ('Her' in Herat, 'Mand' in Mandeb, 'Wak' in Wakayama, 'Rep' in Repat, 'ent' in entitles); pushes toward 'points' tokens.

L27n1952.name: Split-word start: address
L27n1952.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly 'wh', 'sk', 'fl', 'sw', 'sl' (whetstone, skit, flaking, swaddle), peaking on that opening piece; pushes the model toward 'address' tokens.

L27n445.name: 'an' before adjective
L27n445.description: Fires on a word in a chat answer that comes right before an adjective or noun phrase, e.g. 'an' in 'an important role', 'an essential part', or 'employs' and 'significant'; pushes toward quote-comma tokens.

L26n2325.name: Body and medical word-starts
L26n2325.description: The first piece of a split body-part or medical word (co in cochlea, eyel in eyelids, ang in angina, eb in eyebrow, tum in tumour); pushes toward 'flat' and 'straight'.

L27n160.name: Modal/infinitive, writes suffixes
L27n160.description: Diffuse: modal verbs ('should', 'must', 'can', 'not') and 'to' before a bare verb, plus sentence-initial 'A'; pushes toward suffix pieces like 'ial', 'ity', 'ation'.

L27n1704.name: Mixed technical word pieces
L27n1704.description: Fires on a piece of a technical or hyphenated word ('anded' in single-stranded, 'ux' in bruxism, 'Cl' in clamato, 'ov' in acidovorans) and on 'higher' in 'a higher density'. Steering it up pushes the model toward 'positive' or 'negative', and the output spams 'Positive'.

L27n859.name: Name fragment → 'k'
L27n859.description: Goes strongly negative on a later piece of a name or split word ('ys' in Gettysburg, 'ame' in chameleons, 'oo' in smooching, 'hus' in husk); when negated, it pushes toward a bare 'k' token.

L27n2903.name: Split-word fragments
L27n2903.description: Fires on a fragment inside a word split into odd subword tokens, such as the H in Hertfordshire, suff in suffocating, r in ripples, or -b in Battle; pushes toward 'delivery' and 'transport'.

L25n428.name: Clause-ending comma or newline
L25n428.description: Fires on the comma, colon or line break that closes a clause or code step in tutorial text (SQL, shell, pandas), e.g. the comma before a new instruction or the line break before an example. Writes no clear token; steering gives blank output.

L27n1624.name: Word-start piece, writes enum
L27n1624.description: Fires on the early piece of a split word or name, often a short word start: 'mel' in melon, 'pl' in plume, 'wal' in walnuts, 'Reg' in Regrettably, 'P' in Pumsaint. Pushes toward code tokens '(Enum', 'enum' and 'ctx', repeated.

L26n560.name: Compound-noun modifiers; 'E' output
L26n560.description: Fires on the modifier word that starts a compound noun or fixed phrase (tummy in tummy time, scrambled in scrambled egg, problem in problem-solving, meat in meat-eaters). Pushes toward bare 'E' token repetition.

L27n1151.name: Capitalized name-start letters
L27n1151.description: The first sub-token of a capitalized proper name (Pannotia, Nakhon, Sita, Sugriva, Kashefi), often a single consonant that opens an unfinished name. Pushes toward '<'-prefixed tokens like '<x', '<v', '<c'.

L26n2987.name: Short word-start fragment
L26n2987.description: Fires positive on a short first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'le' in lethal, 'Lo' in loosely, 'fo' in Styrofoam, 'H' in HAVING, 'F' in focusing; pushes toward 'cond' and 'Conditional' tokens.

L27n839.name: Mid-word fragments → 'en'
L27n839.description: The middle piece of a word split into tokens (cl in clenching, ark in harkened, qu in quell, wors in worsens, euth in euthanized); pushes toward 'en' and 'En'.

L26n1002.name: nond/und/d word fragments
L26n1002.description: Short opening or inner fragments such as 'nond' (nondiscriminatory), 'und' (undies), 'd' (Datasheet, dwellings), and '-d' (anti-drying). Pushes toward 'crypt' and 'encrypt' tokens.

L27n1513.name: Mid-word piece to small
L27n1513.description: Fires on a middle or later piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'oct' in 'octopus', 'nos' in 'Gymnospermae', 'rap' in 'tetraplegia', 'append' in 'appendicitis', 'anos' in 'deoxyguanosine'. Pushes toward 'small' and 'little'; steered, it writes 'small little little'.

L27n2031.name: Technical-word fragments, writes ax
L27n2031.description: Fires on the first or second fragment of a technical or scientific word split into tokens (asymp|totes, inter|posed, gal|actic, Squ|ibb, proph|yl|axis). Pushes toward 'ax' and 'axis' tokens; steered output spams 'Ax'.

L27n984.name: Word-start 'g', name-fragments
L27n984.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word, especially 'g' onsets (gums, Guelph, gingersnap, goslings) and Sanskrit or Hindu name pieces (Ram|ayana, Si, jan|eya); pushes output toward 'string' and 'strings'.

L26n713.name: Acronym letters, js
L26n713.description: Goes negative on letters inside capitalized acronyms and abbreviations (MS in MSJE, MD in UMDNJ, BH in BHJ, LW in LW 102D, CNS) and on 'Large' in Large Hadron Collider. Pushes toward 'js', and the steered text degrades into 'Jajaja'.

L27n11.name: Copula after topic, negative
L27n11.description: Negative on 'is' or 'was' right after a topic noun at the start of a chat answer (Flamenco is, The Taj Mahal was, Nigeria is, Anubis was). Pushes toward uppercase codes (AK, AB, DP); steered text drops spaces and CamelCases.

L27n1090.name: Word-initial 'Ar' and 'ar'
L27n1090.description: The 'Ar' or 'ar' that opens a word split into tokens, such as 'Arbuscular', 'Arterial', 'Arthritis', 'arable', and 'ph' or 'ch' starts like 'Phrynosoma'. Pushes toward the letter 'Q'.

L26n943.name: Split w-fragment, dot paths
L26n943.description: Goes weakly negative on a lone 'w' or 'wh' piece inside a split word or abbreviation (w.r.t., wobbling, Wadsworth, dwelt, /w); pushes toward dot and slash path fragments like './' and '../'.

L1n1682.name: Mid-word subword pieces
L1n1682.description: The middle piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'com' in 'sarcomas' and 'accommodate', plus 'suspects' and 'unknown'; pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ment' and 'imony', and newlines when steered.

L27n1558.name: Stem after hyphen/un-
L27n1558.description: Fires on the stem token right after a hyphen or 'un-' prefix in compounds ('hard-wiring', 'unpasteurized', 'uncovers', 'wild-catch', 'Self-cleaning'); pushes toward 'plus' and 'minus' sign words.

L27n266.name: Odd fragments, quote tags
L27n266.description: Goes strongly negative on scattered word fragments and punctuation: 'def' in defocused, 'Elf' in Johan Elf, 'd' in douches, '(' before a figure reference, '<' and '>' tags. Pushes toward two-letter capitals 'FC/CB/MF'; strong steering spams 'CBBC' or 'FC' strings.

L27n2738.name: Early word pieces, vertex
L27n2738.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a multi-token word, often a noun after 'the' or 'of' (Sk-opje, ju-venile, def-ecate, sp-ayed, ep-inephrine); pushes toward 'vertex' tokens.

L27n679.name: Mid-word fragments, writes 'z'
L27n679.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece inside a split word ('E' in CHEESE, 'ape' in trapezoid, 'ozy' in heterozygous, 'Life' in SciLife). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'z' tokens, and the output spams 'Zz'.

L27n1591.name: Mid-word piece, ant writer
L27n1591.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-internal piece that starts before a suffix (repl|anted, entr|ants, penn|ies, oct|opus, acceler|ates, elect|rophoresis). Pushes toward 'ant' tokens.

L27n1322.name: r fragment, writes hot
L27n1322.description: A lone 'r' or 're' piece inside split words (legume-r|hizobium, sebor|r|hea, igr in Tigris, r|ambutan); pushes toward 'hot' and 'heat'.

L27n899.name: Word-initial capital R
L27n899.description: Strongly positive on a word-initial capital 'R' (or lowercase 'r') at the start of a word, e.g. Rickets, R&D, Rational, Routines, RADIATION, 'r' in ripples and rationally. Pushes toward '&' tokens.

L27n1840.name: Word-start stub, 'Com-' 'Aut-'
L27n1840.description: Opening fragment of a split word, e.g. 'Com' in comprehension, 'accom' in accompanied, 'incom' in incompletely, 'Aut' in autism. Fires negative on these and promotes 'complete'.

L25n1531.name: Split-word 'v' fragments
L25n1531.description: Mid-word fragment inside a split name or word, especially 'v' or '-v' (Nau|v|oo, un|v|accinated, low|-v|oltage, '-z' in zippers); pushes toward 'criteria' and 'threshold'.

L25n1966.name: Opening fragment, 'kneading'
L25n1966.description: Goes negative on the opening fragment of a split word, most strongly 'kne' in kneading or kneaded (also 'Sh' in shaped and 'Z' in Zaidi); pushes toward 'assume' and 'assumption' tokens.

L27n1308.name: Word-start re/rh fragment
L27n1308.description: The first piece of a split word, mostly 're', 'rh', 'Re' (rept-, rhe-umatic, Re-), also 'th', 'Le', 'Comp'. Pushes toward 'recovery', 'recover' and 'restore'.

L27n3014.name: Consonant-cluster onsets → 'amount'
L27n3014.description: Fires on a word-initial consonant-cluster piece of a split word, mostly cl, cr, sn, sp, fl (cl|umping, cr|umble, cl|apping, sn|ail, Clo|jure), plus a few -ch and -sc pieces. Pushes toward 'amount'/'Amount'.

L27n128.name: Mid-phrase tokens, closing parens
L27n128.description: Negative firing on assorted mid-phrase tokens in web and chat text, such as the colon after a path, 'by' after a title, 'and' in a list, or '(' before a parenthetical; pushes toward ')' tokens, and pushed negative it spams ')'.

L25n1623.name: Titles and historical adjectives
L25n1623.description: Diffuse: fires on adjectives and title words in citations and descriptions (exact, Historical, Harper, Hist-ories, Ant, Print); pushes 're' and 'heavy' tokens.

L25n1537.name: Split name second halves
L25n1537.description: The inner piece of a name or rare word split across tokens, e.g. 'Tong' in Hunga Tonga, 'be' in Zambezi, 'Yog' in yogi, 'pp' in Peppermint; pushes toward 'adult'.

L27n2404.name: Word-start fragments, heter/squ
L27n2404.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'heter' in heter|ogeneity, 'squ' in squ|ander, 'bree' in bree|ch, 'quar' in quar|ries, 'anch' in anch|ovies. Writes 'feed'/'Fe' tokens, and steering spams 'Fe'.

L27n275.name: Word fragment, writes Japan
L27n275.description: Word-internal piece of multi-token words (inhib|itory, cultiv|ars, Hoj|ib|lanca, Hunga Ha'|apai); pushes toward 'Japan' and 'Japanese'.

L26n1050.name: List-junction tokens, office output
L26n1050.description: The comma, 'and' or 'a' that closes or joins items in a list or pair of noun phrases (Medicare|,, factoring |and| merchant cash, a| consulting group); pushes toward 'office', 'department' and 'staff'.

L26n1762.name: Proper-name start, writes 'discuss'
L26n1762.description: Goes negative on the first fragment of a capitalised name, mostly 'G' or 'Gr' (Gogh, Goulet, Grizzly, Gobitis), and on 'Cong' in Congaree. Pushes toward 'discuss' and 'discussion' tokens.

L25n1111.name: Split-word piece → 'perfect'
L25n1111.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of split words (Ps|oph|odes, cam|phor, Fem|ale) and on intensifiers 'Very', 'pretty', 'particularly', 'Grand'; pushes evaluative 'perfect', 'ideal' and 'good'.

L27n2407.name: Mid-name fragments
L27n2407.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a proper name or word split into tokens, e.g. 'Col' in 'Colosseum', 'Sk' in 'Skutnabb', 'Pel' in 'pellets'; pushes toward 'sea' tokens.

L26n314.name: Apostrophe and prime fragments
L26n314.description: Diffuse: fires on the letter or digit just before an apostrophe or prime (l in l'Heure, d in d'état, 3 in 3′-UTR, x in x′, 0 in 8.0); pushes curly apostrophes and closing quotes.

L25n1523.name: Adverbs before main verb
L25n1523.description: Diffuse: fires on an adverb or 'to' that sits between an auxiliary and its main verb (have also suggested, were also found, only formally recognized, clearly entitles), plus the name Alonzo; pushes 'point' and 'points'.

L27n582.name: List and clause joins
L27n582.description: Diffuse: fires on commas and conjunctions that join list items or clauses (', Asperger's', 'and PDD', 'is arguably'), plus 'heat' and 'before'; no single concept, pushes toward 'aware' and 'wish' words.

L27n2191.name: Medical word fragment, 'suggest'
L27n2191.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split word (sc|oliosis, pl|ating, medic|ated, t|innitus). Pushes toward 'suggest' and 'recommend'.

L27n1950.name: Split place-name fragments
L27n1950.description: Fires on a short piece that opens or sits inside a longer word split into tokens, mostly place and group names ('Te'sside, Eup'hr'ates, 'Cl'ifton, 'ph'agocytes); pushes toward 'your' and 'you'.

L24n1526.name: Code keywords and backticks
L24n1526.description: Fires on the word right after a command or keyword in code and terminal text ('du -sh', 'CREATE TABLE', 'ORDER BY', 'echo'), and on 'All Rights' in footers. Pushing it negative makes the model emit backticks.

L27n2020.name: Word-start sc/c pieces
L27n2020.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'c', 'C', 'sc' or 'sh' piece that starts a word or follows a hyphen, e.g. 'sh' in sh|ut down and mis|sh|apen, 'c' in c|asserole and c|igarette, 'C' in Anti-C|atholic, 'sc' in sc|atters. Going negative pushes toward owner and own tokens.

L26n354.name: Clause-head onsets, param output
L26n354.description: A grab bag: the token just before a noun or verb phrase head, e.g. 'mando' in 'tomando en cuenta', 'while' before 'exercising', 'God' before 'asked', 'La' before 'Coruña'; pushes toward '(param' and other code parameter tokens.

L27n1565.name: 'cr' word-starts; 'man' writer
L27n1565.description: Goes negative on the 'cr' or 'cro' start of a split word, mostly animals (cr|abs, cr|anes, cr|ickets, cro|codiles), and on 'agr', 'Pest', 'ple' starts; pushes 'man', 'Man', 'mans', spamming 'man' when steered.

L27n2025.name: Mid-word fragments, clean
L27n2025.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subword tokens, strongest on '-st' in non-stick and pre-stressed, and on mid-word 'ro', 'co', 'fe' (neuroma, cochlea, roots). Pushes toward 'clean' tokens; steered, it spams 'Clean'.

L27n1395.name: Mid-word fragment splits
L27n1395.description: Fires on a short non-word fragment in the middle of a split word, such as 'erc' in clockwise, 'ic' in bactericidal, 'oc' in radiocarbon, 'sh' in shatter, and 'rd' in Córdoba. Pushes toward 'count/counts', which it repeats when steered.

L27n2858.name: Mid-word fragment starts
L27n2858.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into tokens, mainly short fragments like 'fl', 'Sw', 'contr', 'intr' in names and technical terms; pushes toward 'coordinate' tokens.

L26n241.name: Noun-phrase end words
L26n241.description: Goes negative on the word that completes a noun phrase or predicate ('tumble dryer', 'magnetic field', 'triglyceride levels', 'Call or Put', 'was inspired', 'more difficult'). The push is weak and nudges output toward code-string closers.

L26n1148.name: Word-start fragments; master
L26n1148.description: Word-start fragments of longer words, mostly nouns and names, such as 'bar' in barista, 'law' in lawman, 'Strateg' in strategist, 'fasc' in fasciitis and 'ma' in Taj Mahal. Pushes toward 'master' and 'Master'; steered output spams 'Master'.

L27n2095.name: 'w'/'re'/'bre' onset
L27n2095.description: Fires on the consonant-cluster onset of a word split into tokens ('wre'cks, 'thro'ats, 'tre'ble, 'bre'eding, 'Re'nen's, 'Gre'te); pushes toward 'search' and 'Search'.

L25n1380.name: Split-name first pieces
L25n1380.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly place names (Marr|akesh, Có|rdoba) and 'miss' in misspelled or misspelling. Pushes toward 'sp' fragments, and steering spams 'Sp sp'.

L26n1186.name: Foreign word-starts, percent writer
L26n1186.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word in mid-sentence foreign or technical terms (Sup|posedly, Comp|ounds, Imm|unodeficiency, Out|wardly); pushes '%' and 'percentage', so steering gives '%' spam.

L27n310.name: Rare-name fragment → d
L27n310.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of rare names and loanwords, e.g. 'ṛ' in Hṛdaya, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Cyc' in Cycadales; pushes toward tokens starting with 'd'.

L26n2563.name: Split-word fragments, names
L26n2563.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a rare word or proper name split across tokens (cil in superciilium, ivil in Civil War, archae- in archaeologists, Kos- in Kosrae), and on list commas. Pushes toward 'net' and 'network' with no clear steering effect.

L27n2702.name: Capitalised 'Sch'/'Kh'/'Th' openings
L27n2702.description: Fires on capitalised or consonant-cluster word openings split across tokens, e.g. 'Sch' in 'Schleper', 'Kh' in 'Khouri', 'Ph' in 'Phrygia', 'th' in 'thorns'; pushes toward 'accept' tokens.

L25n567.name: Mid-word 'p' fragments, adjust
L25n567.description: The 'p' or 'P' piece inside a split word (stock|p|iled, un|p|asteurized, NO|P|ASSWD, P|PT) and similar mid-word fragments; pushes toward 'adjust' and 'adjustment'.

L27n2620.name: Word-start pieces, Africa
L27n2620.description: Fires (negative) on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'sa' in sauté, 'sm' in smacking, 'sc' in scorpion, 'M' in Maccabean; pushes toward nationality and country words like African, Nigerian, Brazilian.

L27n2173.name: Split-word 'C' fragments
L27n2173.description: Fires on a short first or middle piece of a word split into tokens, mostly capital 'C', 'c', 'Ch', 'Ac' (Cats, Cigarette, kissing-crust, Acquired). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'low' and 'lowest', with no visible link to the fragments.

L26n90.name: Name fragments, writes adverbs
L26n90.description: Name or word fragments mid-token, e.g. 'aph' in Sapphari, 'rev' in Trevor, 'Dyn' in the Dyn attack, 'oh' in Almohad; pushes toward sentence adverbs such as 'actually', 'furthermore', 'luckily'.

L27n1219.name: sh/w word onsets, arg
L27n1219.description: Fires on word-onset fragments sh and w that begin a split word (shatter, wiser, waned, shored, shrouded); pushes toward 'argument' and 'arg' tokens when negative.

L27n1165.name: Word-start fragment, opens brace
L27n1165.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subwords when the word is a verb or adjective start: 'j' in jarring or juggling, 'sp' in spiced or spoons, 'spe' in spears, 'p' in patty, 'rem' in remolded. Pushes toward opening braces { and ({, repeated.

L26n455.name: Negating un- prefix
L26n455.description: Fires on the 'un' prefix token that opens a split word (unimportant, unqualified, unvaccinated, unclaimed, unaltered), plus some hyphen and capital-N word starts; pushes toward 'c'/'ci' tokens, so steered output degrades into 'c' spam.

L27n1441.name: p/squ starts → x
L27n1441.description: The opening piece of words beginning with p, squ or scr (Patches, squirts, scraping, hyp- in hypoparathyroidism); pushes toward 'x' as in a variable.

L26n2870.name: Word-initial 'em/ex' prefix
L26n2870.description: First piece of words starting with em- or ex- (em|igration, em|pires, em|ir, ex|otic, Ex|clusion); pushes toward 'export' and 'foreign'.

L27n1857.name: Word starts, arr
L27n1857.description: Word-start pieces and capital letters mid-phrase ('he|aring', 'rhe|umatic', 'N|omenclature', 'n|arrowing'). Pushes toward 'arr' and 'arrangement'.

L27n1139.name: Proper-name start fragments
L27n1139.description: Negative on the first pieces of capitalised names split into tokens (Lo in DeLores, Pot in Potomac, Hos in Hosack, Pur in Puritan, Las in Las Vegas, tur in turkeys); pushes toward 'key' tokens.

L27n2427.name: Stem fragments, ans
L27n2427.description: Stem fragments of split words right before their ending ('prof|essed', 'proph|esied', 'osc|opies', 'isc|ient'). Pushes toward 'ans' and 'an' tokens.

L25n7.name: Formal title name fragments
L25n7.description: Fires on the capital or first piece of a title or proper name inside a long formal phrase ('Royal' in 'His Royal Highness', 'Mart' in Martel, 'Cre' in Cremesi), and weakly on chat-template header tokens. Pushes toward code braces and string closers ('{', '({', '?");').

L27n2590.name: Capitalised term starts
L27n2590.description: Negative on the first piece of a capitalised title or term, e.g. 'Old' in Old Fashioned, 'Arist' in Aristotelianism, 'ham' in Arkham; pushes toward 'tri/triangle' spam.

L24n2044.name: Web-page and HTML nouns
L24n2044.description: Diffuse: fires on 'HTML', 'web' and 'the' in markup and web-page text (an HTML page, a web page), plus scattered name fragments like 'Bo' and 'Pl'; pushes toward 'page'.

L27n1516.name: Pre-verb word → 'give'
L27n1516.description: Fires on a word that sets up a following verb or verb phrase ('then' before 'proceeds', 'simply' before 'give up', 'd' in 'I'd', 'gradually' before 'weakened'); its reads are diverse and it pushes toward 'give' and 'gives'.

L27n2099.name: Mid-word split fragments, split
L27n2099.description: Fires positively on arbitrary mid-word fragments inside names and hyphenated or split words ('tre' in treble, 'coy' in coyote, 'Dor' in Dorset, '-B' in Boulder, 'r' in raku). Pushes the model toward 'split'.

L25n2237.name: -st and rem fragments
L25n2237.description: Goes strongly negative on the '-st' or 'st' piece of a split or hyphenated word ('stressed', 'stimulating', 'stearic') and on 'rem' in 'remained'. Pushes toward 'remain', 'stay' and 'persist'.

L27n1859.name: Name-start fragments; writes 'status'
L27n1859.description: Fires on the first piece of a split capitalized name or Latin genus word, e.g. 'Att' in Attica, 'Cr' in Crataegus, 'cr' in crannogs, 'Hur' in Huron. Pushes the model toward 'status' (steering spams 'status').

L26n2543.name: Initial R of names
L26n2543.description: Fires on a capital 'R' or the 'rem'/'res'/'rhe' start of a word or name split into pieces (George R.R. Martin, Rama, Ravana, 'rem' in removes); pushes toward 'sky' and 'heaven', so steered text repeats 'sky sky'.

L27n2838.name: Split-word starts; writes sun
L27n2838.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often 'c', 'sh' or 'co' (sh|ampoos, co|conuts, Ac|ropolis, c|ensuses); pushes toward 'solar', 'Sun' and 'sunlight'.

L27n199.name: Words inside proper names
L27n199.description: Fires on a word inside a proper name or title, e.g. 'Knight' (Knight of the Garter), 'Cape' (Cape Mount), 'Kuala' (Kuala Lumpur), 'Is' (How Old Is My Kitten), 'Queen', 'Copyright'. Pushes toward code identifiers 'Val/Var/Sec'; steered, it spams 'Val'.

L27n307.name: Function word; writes 'users'
L27n307.description: Goes strongly negative on function words or word pieces right before a verb or noun head, e.g. 'to' in allowed to drain or cool, 'of' in practice of being, 'the' in the brain. Diffuse. Pushing it negative steers toward 'users', 'players', 'customers'.

L26n1805.name: Word starts and the
L26n1805.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split word (dist-illery, inst-igated, Bo-aters, Dev-onta) and on 'the' before a team or organization name (the Denver Nuggets, the New York Giants); pushes 'primary' and 'secondary'.

L27n1788.name: Name fragment, writes page
L27n1788.description: Word-start piece of names and words (Pag|len, Ker|et, sou|ling, Sp|elling, Cop|eland); pushes toward 'page' and 'pages'.

L27n2391.name: 'rh' word-start, door-writer
L27n2391.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'rh' or 'Rh' start of a split word (rhino, rhizobia, rhizome, Rhinocerous), plus similar starts like 'Por' in Porifera and 'fec' in fecal; pushes toward 'door' and 'gate'.

L27n1643.name: p/sp starts → paper
L27n1643.description: A 'p' or 'sp' that opens a word piece (Spallation, spurious, pungent, -pip.py, potash); pushes toward 'paper/papers'.

L26n894.name: Place-name second pieces
L26n894.description: Goes positive on the second piece of a split place name, often UK or US towns (Vicks|burg, Middles|brough, Te|ess|ide, Inver|ke|ithing, K|wa|Zulu). Writes 'Int'/'Bool'/'Integer' type names; steering spams 'Int'.

L27n1063.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n1063.description: Fires on the first letter or piece of a capitalized proper name ('G' in Garter, 'E' in Eunice, 'Har' in Harriette, 'Ban'); pushes toward the code token 'const'.

L27n311.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n311.description: Fires on the first 2-3 letters of a word split into tokens, usually a consonant cluster ('squ' in squirts and squander, 'str' in strung, 'Sel' in Selaginellaceae, 'kne' in kneading, 'Kon' in Konwar). Pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'owns' and 'ailable'.

L25n1335.name: Search and pursuit words
L25n1335.description: Fires on pieces of words and titles about searching or pursuing, usually mid-word (purs|ues, explor|ation, 'Man's Search for Meaning'). The pattern is diffuse. Pushes toward 'seek', 'seeking' and 'search'.

L25n1754.name: Scattered mid-clause fragments
L25n1754.description: No single pattern: fires on word-start fragments of names (Lav|ender, Ch|ilton, Barb|uda), on 'from' in 'wiping from back' or 'flows from', and on 'too' in 'too light-handed'. Pushes the model toward 'top', 'left' and 'right'.

L25n3069.name: Word stem before suffix
L25n3069.description: Negative on the stem piece of a word that continues into a suffix or second piece (e.g. 'ex' in exposed, 'rip' in ripe, 'semi' in semi-transparent, 'Russ' in Russians); its output points to 'exposure'.

L27n446.name: Split-word openers → pronouns
L27n446.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word split into tokens (kne|els, fo|als, And|alusia, self-h|arm, Ze|alots), before the word ends. Goes negative toward sentence-opening subject pronouns ('You', 'We', 'This', 'It').

L27n879.name: Proper-noun initial letter
L27n879.description: Negative on the first capital letter of a proper noun or acronym, e.g. 'A' in Agra, 'R' in Raisin, 'R' in RIPv1; pushes toward data-format names like json and html.

L25n1195.name: Word-start consonant clusters
L25n1195.description: Fires negatively on the first piece of a split word, especially consonant-cluster starts (Cl in Clain, tr in tracts, kr in krill, ph in phylum, Pr in Prisc); pushed negative, it writes 'form' and 'formless'.

L26n1147.name: Compound-word first halves
L26n1147.description: The first piece of a split compound word, right before its second half, e.g. 'dough|nut', 'dust| jacket', 'sand|lot', 'Con|versely', 'visually| impaired'; pushes toward the letter 'j' as noise.

L27n2817.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n2817.description: The consonant-cluster start of a split word or name, e.g. 'thr' in |thr|ived, 'Kr' in |Kr|ill oil, 'ste' in |Ste|ak, 'Gre' in |Gre|enshell; pushes toward 'sound', spamming 'Sound sound'.

L26n2102.name: Later name pieces
L26n2102.description: Fires on an unfinished later piece of a split name or word: 'amb' in Rambouillet and Bambang, 'Mand' in Mandeb, 'row' in Woodrow, 'spe' in asparagus spears, 'tre' in treble, 'inated' in polychlorinated. Pushes toward 'dec' tokens.

L26n2320.name: Word-start 'Rep' fragments
L26n2320.description: The first piece of a split word, mostly 'Rep' or 'rep' (Repat, Representative, repurpose), also 'Commod' and 'Nem'. Pushes toward 'position' and 'positions'.

L27n2798.name: pr word-start fragments, variables
L27n2798.description: Positive on the first piece of split names and words: 'pr' in prairies, prune, Prius, Priscus; 'Pe' in Peisistratus; 'Bh' in Bhagabhadra; 'hon' in honours. Pushes toward 'variable/variables'; strong steering spams 'variables'.

L27n824.name: Name fragment, writes station
L27n824.description: Word-internal piece of names and terms (Tar|qu|inius, Bre|asted, sarc|oph|agi, C|en|ozoic); pushes toward 'station' tokens.

L26n26.name: hyphen and name-piece fragments
L26n26.description: Goes strongly negative on a fragment right after a hyphen or inside a split name or word ('-W' in Abu l-Walid, '-A' in Abdulaziz, 'Kr' in krill, 'Ro' in Roche, 'SW' in ALLOW). Pushes toward odd word-end pieces such as '-ILITY' and '-ATTLE'.

L19n972.name: Tech-text word pieces
L19n972.description: Fires on the word piece that ends a compound or identifier in technical or contact text, e.g. 'sh|ower', 'pip' in pip3, 'sudo', 'info' before '@', 'Consumer' in a package path, 'install' in a shell line. Pushes toward underscores '_'.

L27n1239.name: Split-word pieces, quote-period
L27n1239.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle or last piece of a split word, e.g. 'id' in Pteridaceae, 'ro' in roselike, 'Man' in Manilkara. Pushes toward closing-quote-period tokens (a quote mark followed by a period).

L27n821.name: Person-name first pieces
L27n821.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a person's name split into tokens, e.g. 'Clem' in Clemenceau, 'Koh' in Kohli, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'Eli' in Elián; pushes toward handle and handles.

L27n2556.name: Pre-completion word fragment
L27n2556.description: The piece just before a word or name finishes ('str|icken', 'snow|plow', 'Dead|wood', 'Koh|li', 'Beng|a'), often the stem of a split word. Pushes toward first names such as 'Bob', 'Tom', 'Alice' and 'Joe'.

L25n991.name: Word-start gr/pl
L25n991.description: The opening 'gr' or 'pl' piece of a word split into tokens (gr|ain, gr|ubs, Gr|izzly, gr|inds, snow pl|ow); pushes toward 'w/v' letter tokens.

L26n1134.name: Word-internal 're' prefix pieces
L26n1134.description: Fires on 're' and rem, res or rom pieces that open a word split into tokens (ique in riqueza, -re in self-reliance and dose-reduction, irre in irreparable); pushes toward 'lab' and 'laboratory'.

L26n3048.name: Modal before verb, 'pick'
L26n3048.description: Fires on a modal or infinitive word ('can', 'to', 'may', 'must', 'be', 'that') right after a noun subject and before a bare verb (sensors that can communicate, heart rate may increase); pushes the verb 'pick'.

L27n1004.name: Word-internal fragments
L27n1004.description: Fires on a fragment inside a longer word or name (hip in hippos, cal in calici-, vis in cerevisiae, ely in Thelypteridaceae, isc in Priscus), and on a few plain words after a preposition ('direct fan', 'head start', 'higher efficiency'). Pushes toward 'start/starting'.

L27n1789.name: Word start → 'gas'
L27n1789.description: Fires on a word-start fragment whose word continues in the next token, e.g. 'gan' in gantry, 'Brid' in Bridgeton, 'kil' in kilogram, 'ys' in Gettysburg; pushes toward 'gas' tokens.

L26n394.name: SQL/code syntax keywords
L26n394.description: Fires on a keyword or symbol at a syntax boundary in SQL and code: 'OFFSET' after 'LIMIT n', 'BY' after 'ORDER', '=(' in formulas, '<' in comparisons. Pushes toward code identifiers such as addr, seq, expr and pos.

L26n2777.name: Mid-word name fragment
L26n2777.description: Fires on a middle piece of a rare or proper name split into tokens (Therm|opylae, Schro|ers, Pantag|ruelion, tobra|mycin, Le|ashes), strongest on the stem piece before the ending. Pushes toward 'effect' and 'impact'.

L27n2000.name: 'cr' word onset
L27n2000.description: Fires on the 'cr' (also 'car', 'po', 'spe') opening a word split into tokens: 'cr'umbly, 'cr'abs, 'cr'isps, 'cr'ickets, 'cr'ammed, 'put'rid; pushes toward 'noise', 'waste', 'garbage'.

L27n2762.name: Contr- and split-word openers
L27n2762.description: Fires on pieces of words split into tokens, such as 'contr' (contr|ived, contr|arious), 'd' (d|ouches) and 'Wu|X|ing', plus 'the' before body or nature nouns. Pushes the model toward 'inner'/'inside' tokens.

L27n531.name: Capital B word starts
L27n531.description: Goes negative on a capital letter or fragment that opens a name or noun ('B' in Bicycles, Babbage, Bofors, Buthidae, Bortnyik; 'oc' in tocopherol; 'ant' in antlers). Pushes toward closing '?' and '!' punctuation.

L25n63.name: Pre-noun modifiers
L25n63.description: Fires on an adjective or determiner right before the noun it modifies, e.g. 'black' in black plastic or black tea, 'magical' in magical powers, 'important' in most important advancement, 'practical' in practical preimage attack, 'a' before 'line'. Pushes toward time-order words ('afterwards', 'before', 'later'), and steered text fills with 'once' and 'before'.

L26n2113.name: Word-piece starts, brand output
