L26n2113.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'rem' in 'removes', 'pl' in 'placentitis', 'Long' in 'Longfellow', 'mon' in 'monolith'; pushes toward 'brand' tokens.

L27n623.name: Long-word fragments → quality
L27n623.description: A piece of a long word split into tokens (Stra in Straits, pow in powdery, Therm in Thermopylae, Gen in Genoa, ou in cantaloupe); pushes toward 'quality', 'safety' and 'accuracy'.

L27n650.name: Short word-opening fragments
L27n650.description: Fires on a short piece that opens a longer word split into tokens ('S'curvy, 'de'oxyguanosine, 'Ne'utron, 'blo'oming, 'Se'eded); pushes toward 'are' and 'were'.

L26n403.name: Word-start fragment, writes quotes
L26n403.description: Fires on a short word-opening fragment, usually 'cr', 'c', 'kr' or 'gr', that starts a longer word (cradle, crannogs, krill, censuses). Pushes toward closing quote marks such as ' and 』.

L27n2573.name: Split-word fragments, mut
L27n2573.description: Fires on a second or later piece of a split word (gam in game, corn in cornutum, LOC in multilocularis, ne in neuter, ial in Ephialtes, scr in unscrupulous). Pushes toward the subword 'mut' and 'ut' (Mut, UT).

L26n1192.name: First word of compounds
L26n1192.description: Fires on the first word or piece of a two-part name or compound (Mid|-air, Middle|sbrough, Bl|anche, Bad|lands, Big West, Main Street). Pushes the model toward 'air' and 'Air'.

L26n1890.name: Word-initial fragments, explore output
L26n1890.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word or name split into tokens, at the start of a new item or title (Se|baceous, T|endulkar, T|almud, aqu|aculture, t|innitus); pushes toward 'explore' and 'exploration'.

L27n1999.name: Split word first piece
L27n1999.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into two tokens, such as 'my|corrhizae', 'Ath|lete', 'out|grow', 'mis|fits' and 'Mal|agasy'; pushes 'think/idea/thought'.

L27n386.name: Digits and lists, diffuse
L27n386.description: Diffuse: digits inside long numbers and formulas (the '2' in '2n', the '0' in long decimals) and items in long lists; pushes toward code-like ':' and quote-tuple tokens.

L26n546.name: Compound middle, 'c' onset
L26n546.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a hyphenated or split compound (50-_Start-ups, sub-spec-ies, IP (Internet), retrie-vers, behind-the-scenes) and on ALL-CAPS function words; pushes word-start 'c', 'cl', 'cr', 'cur' tokens.

L27n2951.name: Am/Com word starts
L27n2951.description: Fires on word starts 'Am', 'Com' and 'im' split off names and words (Am|ritsar, Com|positions, Nan|aim|o, Kartid am|ir); pushes toward comment tokens.

L27n3005.name: Word fragments, writes 'counter'
L27n3005.description: Fires on a piece of a split name or word ('-k' in tight-knit, 'fon' in Alfonso, 'reck' in reckoned, 'ex' in exotic, 'j' in jarring). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'counter' and 'contr', and the output spams 'counter'.

L27n1537.name: Split-word openers
L27n1537.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, mostly consonant starts (Lips|chutz, contr|arious, st|earic, molt|sh|ed, Pr|iscus); pushed negative it promotes 'choice'.

L27n2526.name: 'bl/br' word start, smart
L27n2526.description: Fires on the opening piece of words split after bl, bre, bra, ble, wh, sh or p (bl|anch, bre|aching, bra|ai, ble|aching, wh|olly, sh|aking); pushes toward 'smart'.

L24n1824.name: C language name, brackets
L24n1824.description: Goes strongly negative on the letter 'C' naming the C language in coding prompts ("C++", "C#", "in C"), peaking on the 'C' just before '++' or '#'; weaker on array-like tokens such as 'chars' and '[ch'. Pushes the model toward writing empty '[]' and array-bracket tokens, and its steered output adds '[1]'-style markers to plain prose.

L27n2748.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L27n2748.description: Fires (positive) on a word-opening consonant cluster split into its own token ('cr' in crannog, 'br' in bruxism, 'chr' in Cenchrus, 'Th' in thinning); pushes toward 'exam' and 'examiner'.

L27n2649.name: Word-start fragment, font output
L27n2649.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name split across tokens, mostly mid-phrase (sea in 'sea scallops', fil in 'fillets', Data in 'Datafiles'); pushes toward 'font' tokens when negative.

L27n1492.name: Word-start 'com'/'suff' fragment
L27n1492.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word, often a prefix-like piece (com|ical, suff|ragette, contr|arious, Ab|ilene). Pushes toward 'comparison' and 'compare'.

L27n1047.name: Term-start fragments, possessives
L27n1047.description: Fires on the first fragment of a drug name, proper name or content word that opens a clause ('am' in amikacin, 'Con' in Conventional, 'Pr' in Prussian, 'O' in Oceania). Pushes toward 'its' and 'their'.

L27n480.name: Determiner before a noun
L27n480.description: Fires on 'the', 'that' or 'his' right before the noun it introduces ('the fall', 'the Moon', 'that day', 'his death') and on 'desktop' in 'desktop or laptop'; pushes toward plural abstract nouns 'limits', 'benefits', 'costs'.

L27n1127.name: Negative: word-piece fragments
L27n1127.description: Fires strongly negative on fragments of split words (ah in docosahexaenoic, os in osteosarcoma, st in stearic), pushing 'less' or 'low'.

L27n2775.name: N-start and kne fragments
L27n2775.description: Fires (negative) on a capital 'N' or on fragments like 'kne' (knead), 'Des' and 'Desc' (Desert, Descend) that start a split name or word; pushes toward 'tool' and 'tools'.

L27n1166.name: Word-start 'P' and '-p'
L27n1166.description: Fires on a capital 'P' or hyphen-'p' starting a word piece, e.g. 'P' in Puzzles and Punctuality, '-p' in apple-picking and self-published. Also fires on 'og' in aminoglycoside. Pushes toward 'entity' tokens.

L27n1096.name: Mid-clause function word
L27n1096.description: Negative on a function word or comma right after a noun phrase inside a sentence ('and' in 'concept and perform', 'to' in 'come to', 'has' after 'warming', 'with' after 'bee,'), and on list commas. Pushes toward punctuation; weak effect on answers.

L27n2654.name: Short fragment, livestock nouns
L27n2654.description: Fires on a one- or two-letter piece that splits a word or acronym, e.g. 'c' in 'casks', 'k' in 'kettles', 'N' in 'NTDs', '-c' in 'e-cigs', 'unc' in 'uncovers', 'Rec' in 'recycling'. Pushes toward animal and unit nouns ('horse', 'cow', 'sheep', 'Newton'); steered, it spams 'horse'.

L27n2181.name: l/cl starts, library
L27n2181.description: Single 'l', 'cl' or 'Ad' word-start pieces, often after a hyphen or inside split words ('free-l|iving', 'l|itters', 'l|izards', 'Lady|bird'). Pushes toward 'lib' and 'library'.

L27n1109.name: Mid-word fragments
L27n1109.description: A middle piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'ahoo' in Chattahoochee, '-t' in tarred, '-p' in preserved, 'g' in gilded, 'ah' in docosahexaenoic, 'sur' in surges; pushes toward 'file'.

L26n1304.name: Con-word opener (negative)
L26n1304.description: Negative on the 'Con', 'con' or 'Cor' opening piece of a word or name (e.g. 'constit' in constituting, 'Con' in conventional, 'Cor' in Coral); its output points to participles like 'resulting', 'leading' and 'remaining'.

L27n422.name: Dermis-style word middles
L27n422.description: Fires on middle pieces of long words split into tokens, most often 'der', 'ider', and 'mis' in dermis and epidermis, and 'nos' in gymnosperms; pushes toward word-final 'm' and 'ms' pieces.

L27n1823.name: Upper/lower level words
L27n1823.description: Fires on 'upper', 'of', 'over' and 'Ming' inside phrases of rank or level (upper limit, Upper Macedonia, Ming Dynasty), mid-sentence. Pushes toward 'middle' and 'mid'.

L25n2905.name: Predicts 'best' after 'our'
L25n2905.description: Fires on 'our' in 'do our part' and on mid-word fragments of split names and words (A|by|ei, S|eps|is, Hojib|lan|ca). Pushes toward 'best', plus 'optimal' and 'recommended'.

L27n2133.name: Name continuation fragments
L27n2133.description: Fires on a non-initial piece of a name split into tokens (Char|lem|agne, P|ö|yry, Daw|es, Mes|ozoic, Fo|xx); pushes toward 'format' tokens.

L27n2024.name: Mid-word fragment before comp
L27n2024.description: A subword piece in the middle of a long technical or foreign word (pork|chops, enc|hilada, eicosapent|aenoic, un|shunt, dec|imation). Pushes toward 'comp'/'compound' tokens.

L27n2937.name: Word fragments; writes 'activity'
L27n2937.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'aqu' in aquaculture, 'thr' in throng, 'accom', 'os' in osseointegrating. Pushes the model toward 'activity' (steering spams 'Activity').

L26n272.name: Agency and payment names
L26n272.description: Goes strongly negative on the word inside an institution or agency name, like 'Environmental' in 'U.S. Environmental Protection Agency' and 'of' in 'State Board of', and on regulatory or utility nouns like racial, municipal and wastewater; pushes toward 'Payment', 'Authority', 'Parties' and 'authentication'.

L26n45.name: Named-example introducer words
L26n45.description: Fires on the word right before a named example or entity list ('such *as* Amazon', 'sites *like* Napster', 'including the Air Force'), mostly brand and agency names. Pushes toward hardware and tech proper nouns (FPGA, VGA, SCSI).

L27n3070.name: Capital-initial term starts
L27n3070.description: Negative on the 'C' or 'c' that opens a capitalised term, e.g. 'Cited', 'CLEPs', 'Catholicism', and 'enc' in encroached; pushes toward 'circ' spam.

L27n2233.name: Phrase start → edge
L27n2233.description: Fires on word-start fragments like 'Ste', 'cu', 'stret', and on 'Cutting' before a likely 'edge' (cutting edge); pushes toward 'edge' tokens.

L26n1001.name: Sequence words, writes 'review'
L26n1001.description: Goes negative on transition words in step-by-step process text ('then' in 'drawn out... then remove', 'and' in 'rest and digest', 'need' in 'need replenishing') and on the first piece of some split names (Mit-, Max-, Mer-). Pushes toward 'review' tokens.

L25n525.name: Diffuse; writes 'program'
L25n525.description: Fires weakly and diffusely in web prose on words that set up an expected next word, like 'going' before 'to grow' or 'had' in 'has had a significant'; pushes toward 'program', 'project', 'device' and 'system' nouns, and at high dose loops on 'program'.

L25n1264.name: Writes 'almost/nearly'
L25n1264.description: Fires on scattered tokens with no single reading: hyphen-split name pieces (get-pip, Nauvoo), 'at' in 'at the same time'. Pushed negative, it promotes 'almost/nearly/roughly' and spams 'almost'.

L27n464.name: Open paren, split-word pieces
L27n464.description: Fires on an open parenthesis before an abbreviation (the paren in 'task (MET)' and '(ISMP)') and on the piece completing a split word (fo in Styrofoam, ach in drachmas); pushes toward short caps tokens like PM, DM, CM.

L27n2653.name: Acronym and name starts
L27n2653.description: Fires on a token that starts an acronym or name piece (GC in GCSE, o in ophthalmologists, Dar in Dar es Salaam, Insurance in CHIP), mostly in education or insurance text; pushes 'credit' and 'alpha'.

L27n1353.name: Prefix-like onset, 'position'
L27n1353.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or prefix-like stem ('Comp'ounds, 'p'ines, 'presup'positions, 'pre'disposition, 'ap'entaenoic, 'bl'urring); pushes toward 'position(s)'.

L22n1761.name: Task verbs: create, construct
L22n1761.description: Fires on the action verb right after 'to' or 'that' in a coding-task request, such as 'creates' in 'a program that creates' and 'create' in 'Use Java to create'. Pushes toward 'instance', which the reading does not explain.

L27n1658.name: Name starts, writes escapes
L27n1658.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or term (Th|ompson, Ga|uguin, Kö|ppen, Can|aan); pushes toward HTML entities, escaped quotes and mojibake such as &eacute and �s.

L27n1584.name: Word start, writes correctly
L27n1584.description: Fires on the first letter or opening piece of a content word right after a list dash, 'is' or a line start (e.g. 'R' in Rickets, 'g' in grafts, 'Re' in Reconciliation, 'r' in riqueza); pushes manner adverbs like correctly, properly and successfully; steered output loops 'safely safely'.

L25n1493.name: Adjective stems before -ly
L25n1493.description: Fires on an adjective or noun stem that takes a suffix like -ly, -ness or -al (heart in heartbroken, natural, moral, mental, racial), and on some first names like Richard; pushes toward '-ly' and '-ness' endings.

L26n856.name: List-item head noun, steps/terms
L26n856.description: The first word of a list item or category name (macaws in parrots, macaws; focus in focus groups; sub in subheadings; food in food chains); pushes toward sequence nouns such as steps, terms and stages.

L27n791.name: Name/word fragment, writes return
L27n791.description: Goes negative on mid-word or name fragments ('bre' in breeder, 'uel' in Guelph, 'tele' in telegraph, 'cam' in camotes, 'Mill' in Millman); pushes toward 'return'/'returns'.

L27n680.name: List-joining 'and' and commas
L27n680.description: Fires on the connector between items in a noun list: 'and' or a comma in 'Food and Drug', 'sardines, and albacore', 'Arithmetic, Algebra 1', and the 'a' in 'highlight a word'. Pushes toward 'min', 'max', 'tech', 'math', and its steered output only repeats 'min'.

L27n911.name: Chat-end token and adverbs
L27n911.description: Goes strongly negative on the <|im_end|> token closing a user chat turn and on adverbs before a verb or adjective (well, poorly, highly, positively); pushes toward JSON and code closing punctuation.
